The five form an unlikely team as they are the rejects of the department, yet through teamwork and dedication, they succeed in solving the most unusual murder cases.

~~ This drama was adapted from the real case of Wang Xue Mei, the Chinese chief female forensic doctor. Based on thirty years of real-life experiences accumulated by Wang Xue Mei, who is the first female forensic expert in China.
Su Bei was forced to marry the domineering president Lu Nan in order to save her family. However, during the process of getting to know each other, the two soon parted ways due to misunderstandings.

Two forensic scientists with an unexpected connection partner up to solve murder cases. Layer by layer, they shed light on the truth as they speak for the dead and punish the guilty.
Because of family issues, Gu Chu had to quit school and was only able to return several years later. For her graduation internship, she crosses paths with Lu Bei Chen, the chief of the forensic science center.
Lu Bei Chen is the older twin of Gu Chu's late boyfriend, which leaves Gu Chu with conflicting feelings. Meanwhile, Lu Bei Chen still has unsettled grief over his brother's death that he pins on Gu Chu. As they work together, Lu Bei Chen and Gu Chu realize that they can start over, but the misunderstandings between their two families start to come between them.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Qinian Guchu Rubei" by Yin Xu.
~~ Two versions available: 34 episodes (TV) // 37 episodes (DVD)

About four friends in university who meet after graduation and decide to start a business together. They prepare to use the mindset of the Internet generation coupled with a whole new business model, to serve Beijing drifters, who are facing problems with renting a room. Through mutual understanding and co-operation, and after undergoing a series of challenges, they finally manage to achieve their dreams.

A story revolving around a one-sided crush between Hu Li Shan and Xia Bai Cheng as he helps her chase after her crush, all while being unable to confess his own feelings due to a wretched curse.

Hu Li Shan is a genius in the field of architecture, who has always harbored a crush on his childhood friend Xia Bai Cheng. After rejecting a strange girl in high school, he was left with a curse that prevented him from ever confessing his feeling towards Xia Bai Cheng. If he does, Xia Bai Cheng will bear the brunt of the misfortune.

Hu Li Shan eventually figures out that he must help Xia Bai Cheng confess her feelings to the person that she likes in order for him to be freed from the curse. When Xia Bai Cheng falls for Hu Li Shan's enemy from school, Hu Li Shan jumps at the chance to help Xia Bai Cheng chase after the person that he hates the most, even if it pains him to do so.

dramas.nt: 我的刺猬女孩之念念不忘
dramas.syn:
Having the same stylistic tone as the first season, Closer to You 2 follows Han Fei as she time travels to her university days and reunites with her boyfriend Wu Jing Hao who was supposed to be lying unconscious in a hospital bed. They continue their love story while trying to solve the mysteries of fate.

Ten years ago, Wu Jing Hao fell into a coma to save Han Fei; and she has been waiting for him to wake up ever since. By chance, the 28-year-old Han Fei travels back in time to the commencement ceremony at the university campus. If things were as it once was, Wu Jing Hao should've been in the hospital. Instead, Wu Jing Hao has lost part of his memories. Han Fei's mind is burning with questions yet she walks into Wu Jing Hao's life once again to continue their romance. In the process, she discovers that there is no escape from fate.

A rebellious teen from a single-parent deaf family time travels to the past, befriending her young, hearing mother and "scumbag" father, as she forms a "Fireworks Squad" to prevent her parents' relationship, save her mother, and ultimately change her destiny in a heartwarming, fantasy-filled coming-of-age story.
dramas.t: Xiang Yan Hua Yi Yang Can Lan

dramas.syn: Five years ago by chance, Chen Bao Shan, a newcomer reporter at the time, met financial talent Lu Zi Heng on the first snow day. The two got to know each other and fell in love, but on their wedding day, Lu Zi Heng died in a car accident. Five years later, she was determined to forget the past completely and went to the port city where it never snows to start anew. However, during an interview assignment, she met Xiao Mu Chen, the prince of the Xiao Group, who looks exactly like Lu Zi Heng.

Lin Yi Cheng came from a poor background and became a TV reporter as he wished after graduation. He was gradually and conscientiously the backbone of the television network team. He has certain principles and bottom lines, and has experienced various stories of youth along the way. He is very polite and responsible with a strong sense of self-esteem. Wang Ran, a high-IQ  woman, a gold-digger, but also a self-made professional elite, was born into a poor family. Under her beautiful appearance, she is good at relying on beauty to obtain resources for herself and help her friends tear off the 'mask of men'. 

In Lin Yi Cheng's journey of mutual encouragement and understanding Wang Ran, love creeps up quietly, but facing reality, he can only endure the pressure of life patiently and enjoy it. Also, because of Lin Yi Cheng's dedication and understanding to Wang Ran's life and work, she was…

Lin Huan Huan and Lin Shang Shang are twin sisters. The younger one, Huan Huan was sent to the mountains to study Traditional Chinese Medicine when she was small. Years later, her elder sister, Shang Shang, fell in love with the crowned prince. Unexpectedly, the queen deliberately married Shang Shang to another prince, Shangguan Li. Lin Shang Shang hanged herself and died for love. Lin Huan Huan was forced to marry off as her sister’s substitution, who begins her married life full of quarrels and sweet times.
The story of a workplace rookie and four male colleagues with different personalities.

As soon as Xia Tian Tian turned school bully Guo Zhi Yu into a "loyal dog" boyfriend, she was strongly opposed by mother He Qing Ning. In He Qing Ning's heart, Xia Tian’s company president Qin Zhi was the perfect son-in-law. Unexpectedly, one day the mother and daughter actually exchanged bodies! He Qing Ning began to do whatever she wanted with her daughter's body, but Xia Tian used her mother's body to fight back. The two slowly understood each other in their interchanged lives. At the same time, two high-sweet romances are also brewing..

As a horrible drought settles over the land, the world begins to wither and die. Desperate to save their lives and their livelihoods, the people of the Chentang Pass offer all they have as a sacrifice to the Dragon King of the Eastern Seas, but their efforts to appease the mighty lord just aren’t enough. Watching the world fade to dust, the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King’s son, Ne Zha, realizes that the only way to save the ones he loves is to take down the evil forces responsible for this terrible drought.

 Setting out on a desperate quest, Ne Zha soon hears rumors of five magic weapons that will help rid the world of evil. Determined to find these weapons, Ne Zha searches far and wide, facing off against every sort of evil imaginable along the way. But not every soul he crosses paths with is vile and not every member of the Dragon King’s court is bent on destruction. When fate brings…

Forced into a marriage with Lu Jing Ming, Shen Jiang Li is later framed and imprisoned by his family. After surviving a traumatic childbirth, she returns to the Lu Mansion to save her ailing son, determined to reclaim her dignity and protect him.

This is the story between the "love queen" Han Ting Ting and ace producer Lu Bai. Han Ting Ting is a sweet, cheerful woman who works as a white-collar planner of a love game company, who has never really had much kissing practice. Lu Bai, the business savvy producer, is an ice cube on the outside a  warm softie on the inside.  What could a stolen kiss between these two possibly lead to?

Mystery video blogger Yang Zheng Hui uncovers a disturbing connection between the long-term disappearance of his ex-girlfriend, Liu Wei, and a ceramist named Zeng Jie. A fire that broke out at Zeng Jie's studio a year ago appears to have concealed crucial secrets about Liu Wei's fate. Now, Zeng Jie is scheming to murder his wife and take over her fortune. As Yang Zheng Hui digs deeper, the logic behind the truth slowly surfaces...

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zong Yan Zhi Mi" (棕眼之谜 ) by Jiu Jie Xian Sheng (九介先生).

In the late Shang Dynasty, King Zhou listened to the demon words of Daji possessed by the fox, lewdness and cruelty to Zhongliang, causing turbulence in the court and unrest among the people. For the people of the world, Ji Fa, the son of Xibohou, decided to organize an army to help justice. His brother, when he was a proton in Chaoge, the son of King Zhou, Yin Jiao, originally hated King King's licentiousness with Ji Fa but couldn't resist his inner yearning for power. He was separated from Daji and became King King's subordinate to resist Ji Fa's army. Master. 
The brothers turned against each other, heralding the opposition between justice and evil. Ji Fa worshipped Jiang Ziya as the image, killing all the way to the court song, Yin Jiao retreats steadily, and his heart becomes devilish. In the end, Ji Fa reluctantly killed Yin Jiao, annihilated Yin Shang, established the Western…
dramas.t: Feng Shen Zhi Tianqi - God's Revelation

dramas.syn:
Lin Wu Yu has been named the academic god of his high school: calm, confident, and forever effortlessly able to get first place. Ding Ji flaunts his photographic memory and claims to be the most powerful person in the world. These two people who initially don’t have anything in common meet due to the spinning gears of fate. Lin Wu Yu discovers that the seemingly sloppy, careless Ding Ji is in fact outstandingly smart. After a series of hilarious misunderstandings, the reason why Ding Ji is unwilling to be called a child prodigy gradually reveals itself. Two equally clever and exceptional teens, with similar yet not completely identical family troubles, slowly grow closer as they deepen their understanding of each other, little by little.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Arrogant" (嚣张) by Wu Zhe (巫哲).
tags: Censored Adaptation Of Same-sex Original Work

dramas.syn:
A story revolving around an artist and a chef courageously going after their dreams no matter what obstacles they face. They get caught in a family dispute over inheritance.

Gao Xing is a talented artist who sells his drawings online. His parents are billionaires, but he has never been swayed by their fortune as he focuses on honing his craft. Yang Xiao Rou is a genius at cooking. The two people of different backgrounds and personalities become embroiled in the power struggles within the Gao Family as they start on a road of establishing a first-rate restaurant.

~~ Two versions available: 36 episodes (TV) // 42 episodes (DVD)
dramas.t: Meet in Youth Love in Foods

dramas.syn: In the autumn of 1997, Chen You Xi escaped from the orphanage to find her missing best friend, Xiu, and came to Tanling County alone because of that. Before her disappearance, Xiu worked as a nanny for the Li family, and after her disappearance, the Li family accused her of running away after stealing from them. You Xi is very sure that Xiu didn't do it, and the family is highly suspicious. Soon, You Xi finds out that the Li family's daughter, Li Wen Wen, also went missing many years ago, and she was similar in age to her. So, You Xi decides to pretend that she is Li Wen Wen and enters the Li family's house to find the truth about both girls' disappearances

For sixteen years, Gu Qing Zhou was thrown by her biological father to the countryside, but because her stepsister took a fancy to her marriage contract with the Governor's Mansion, she asked her to come back and give way. Her stepmother and stepsister bullied her as a countrywoman, but she didn't know that she had unique skills: traditional Chinese medicine, marksmanship, dancing, etiquette, and pretending to be a pig, but was actually a tiger. 

However, the revenge plan that was obviously in control was broken by the fiancé's eldest brother. This domineering, powerful man, pressing her under him, said, "You are the woman I like. I don't want you to marry another man!"

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shao Shuai Ni Lao Po You Pao Le" (少帅你老婆又跑了) by Ming Yao (明药).
dramas.t: Young General Your Wife Has Run Away Again

dramas.syn: "Basketball Fever" tells the self-realization story of a basketball juvenile carrying his friend's last wish, working hard on the basketball court, and finally overcoming his narrow personal heroism.

Little Princess Gong Yi Yin was bestowed in marriage by the emperor to Qin Mo, the dream lover of countless girls. She was neglected on their wedding night. There was even news that the consort wanted to divorce her. Gong Yi Yin got angry and disguised herself as a man and went to Tingwei Court to be an official. She went to settle accounts with her husband, who she has never met before. And begin a game of him running and her chasing...

Tells the story of ordinary folks and their battle against the Covid19 pandemic.

~~ Based on the real-life event of the Covid19 pandemic in Wuhan.

Li Chu Chu's sister was forced to commit suicide by three wealthy sons, and her mother was poisoned into a vegetative state. Since then, Li Chu Chu dropped out of school and joined the Yundian Club to get close to the man in power in Beijing and Hong Kong to achieve revenge. In this exploitation, she pretended to be weak and cautious, but she never expected to give her true heart to Pei Qing Ji.

Xue Ling Long, a beautiful snake demon, must now go to the mortal world to fulfill a mission under the guidance of her teachers. This is how she meets  Lin Hao Xuan, a human, settling some unfinished business from their last life.
~~ Adapted from the web comic "Fall in Love with My Trouble" (惹上首席总裁) by Yoolook (有鹿文化) and Li Zhi Zi Zi (荔枝吱吱).
dramas.t: Fall in Love with My Trouble Season 2

dramas.syn:
Lin Yue and Gu Chuan have been married for about a year. The two of them have very different opinions about their marriage and two very different personalities. Go Chuan, a structured, disciplined and busy lawyer, thinks that his wife's job has her on the edge of the law most of the time and that her life lacks discipline and order. Lin Yue, a loose and free-spirited painter, finds her husband’s meddling in her job as a freelance illustrator disrespectful and doesn’t welcome his attempt to “shape” her life for her, acting more like a drill sergeant than a husband. 

Finally, she has had enough, and the two of them start the divorce procedures, initiating the 30-day cool-down period. But her failure to book a train ticket back to her parents and his unilateral decision to go back with her has the two of them face her parent’s marital problems and possible divorce. In the process, they…

Web writer A Xing was working alone in his big city office when an evil and arrogant man suddenly crawled out of his computer! The uninvited character was none other than Xing’s own fictional villain, Zhong Zhuo Hang. Dissatisfied with having to die each and every time, Zhuo Hang has come to the real world to guide Xing in creating more suitable plots for him. The kind-hearted Xing takes Zhuo Hang in and thus begins our peek into their ridiculous living arrangement. 

~~ Adapted from the novel "Farewell My Villain".
tags: Censored Adaptation Of Same-sex Original Work

dramas.syn:
When Ye Wan Chu was desperate, she followed Mr. Mu back home. Unexpectedly, four years later, she would become Mr. Mu's sweetheart.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Jia San Ye Chao Chong De" (我家三爷超宠的) by Xiao Sheng Man Tian (萧笙满天).

Ye Sang Nian married her blind date, Shen Ting Bai in a flash. After receiving the certificate, she unexpectedly learned that he was the president of Shen's company. Ye Sang Nian had no choice but to hide her identity and continue working. Because she was a cleaning lady in the company, her cousin Ye Wan Yi, who was in a high position, made things difficult for her in every possible way. The identity of the CEO’s wife is exposed, and she counterattacks and becomes the tyrant’s little wife.

Li Qian Jin, from an unhappy family, travels back to 1998 with a chance to change her fate. Determined to help her father start a business and mend her parents' relationship, she crosses paths with Huang Xiao, a young man from a small town. Believing he stole her family's secret sauce recipe and took her mother away, she opposes him at every turn. As they become rivals, a romantic bond forms, leaving Li Qian Jin to decide whether to stay or leave, uncertain of their fate.
A modern-day actress is reborn in ancient times as a proud princess who endeavors to gain the queen's throne.

On the night of her wedding, Shen Chang Ning, the daughter of a shipping magnate was slaughtered along with her entire family and thrown into the river. Yet she miraculously awakens in a new life, reborn as Xi Yan, a dancer in the residence of the powerful Governor Pei Yu. 

Carrying the weight of blood-deep vengeance, she uses beauty as bait and wit as a shield, advancing step by step. Together with Pei Yu, whose influence spans the entire court, she joins hands to maneuver through a deadly game of revenge. In this high-stakes struggle where every move decides life or death, they vow to reclaim her destiny and the justice that was stolen from her.

Yan Rong Rong is under the thumb of her family, working herself to the bone. Discovering that she is pregnant after being drugged, she promises herself that she will protect her baby. A chance encounter with the baby's father convinces her to hide the pregnancy until untenable circumstances give her away. From that moment on, she becomes fiercely protected by the formidable Si Bo Yan.
dramas.t: The World Is Kind to Me

dramas.syn:
Heroine Ye Mu from the 21st century accidentally obtained an ancient book while performing a mission. What she didn't expect was that she would get sucked into the book world and become the General's mistress daughter. Only by protecting Mo Lin Yuan, the little slave who she has been bullying, who is also the future emperor, then only she can return to the real world.

Ye Mu, therefore, recruited Mo Lin Yuan as her personal bodyguard and constantly got on his good side. Cultivating him in the development of morality, intelligence, and physique from an early age. Under Ye Mu's care and support, Mo Lin Yuan lets go of the hatred he has towards her. And the story of the domineering lady and the loyal bodyguard slowly unfolds.

As the plot progresses, the two who grew up together gradually develop feelings for each other. However, there are many difficulties and hardships on the road to…

dramas.nt: 痴傻千金二叔宠我入骨
dramas.syn: Somehow, Su Nan only has the IQ of a 3-year-old, so her husband tries to divorce her and steal her company - but a seemingly powerless Huo Mu Han acts to protect her. Meanwhile, an act of abuse restores Su Nan's faculties and leads back to her true identity even as greater challenges are placed before her. Huo Mu Han continues to try to protect her even as he conceals his own true situation from the rest of the world.

Ji Xian Yu comes back from the dead and returns to Crown Prince Qi Lian Xiao’s side. Only this time, she has Lan Ruo Xi’s appearance. In order to get close to him and to get him to recognize her, Lan Ruo Xi becomes the Emperor’s medical officer with her superb medical skills. However, due to the loss of his wife, Lian Xiao changes, and he continues to hide from Ruo Xi’s good intentions. Finally, with the efforts of Ruo Xi and her friends, Lian Xiao comes to believe that Ruo Xi is Ji Xian Yu, and they’re able to reconcile. But, with war looming from the enemy, will he choose love or his country?

A group of teenage ice hockey players dreams of going professional. Chen Che, the star player of the United Nations Hockey Team, is a talented but impulsive teen with a strong sense of loyalty. Shen Zhou Zhou, a former graduate student from North America, is a cold, handsome figure with remarkable skills on the rink. Together, the team faces struggles and competition as they chase success and glory on their journey.

~~ Dedicated to the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics.

It mainly tells the story of An Xiao Man who ran away from home due to a misunderstanding with her husband Gu Chen, but was unfortunately kidnapped and lost her memory because of the heavy blow. Under Gu Chen's constant doting, the love was rekindled, but the rival Ling Mu Qing pressed step by step.

Detectives Jiang Guang Ming and Shi Luo investigate a case, when they discover that the crime scene bears a remarkable resemblance to the crime scene from a novel written by Gu Yu Ming.  Fiction and reality get intertwined. 

Is it truly a coincidence?

~~ Adapted from the novel "The Passed Scene" (渡された場面) by Matsumoto Seicho (松本清張).

Feng Ning Wan is a guard of the Dowager Empress with an extraordinary skill; she can change her face into that of others at will, and is ordered to do so to become a princess and marry the minister Chen Yu. Chen Yu has pretended to be weak and ill for many years when he is in fact a master of martial arts.  In living out daily married life together, they come to appreciate and love each other, but will this love survive in the face of lies and the struggle for power?

The drama revolves around six youths: the strategic and decisive Song Ci, the highly skilled physician Bai Xue Yan, the photographic memory holder Li Zi Fang, the mysterious and reserved Zhao Xiao Liu, the formidable martial artist Yin Qiao, and the ingenious planner Shen Xi Yue.

These six individuals come together for various reasons and, working together, solve numerous mysterious and intricate cases. After facing several life-threatening challenges, the once young and naive youths gradually mature.

United in purpose, they dispel the fog of mystery and harbor a sense of justice to protect their home and country.

Wen Ying and Jiang Chen Ye married through a family alliance agreement. What began as a mechanical, routine way of getting along gradually shifted into a sweet, irresistible pull of affection. The icy, aloof husband is slowly melted by his soft and adorable wife, leading to a mutually devoted, healing romance.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ban Shu Lao Gong" (半熟老公), also known as "Jiang Lv Shi Jin Tian Dong Xin Le Ma?" (江律师今天动心了吗？), by Qing Shan Gui Yu (青山归屿).

It is based on the story of young cartoonist Xiong Dun who encounters double setbacks in love and the workplace. In the face of adversity, she bravely fights her illness and spreads positivity with her infectious smile.
Xiang Yang is a carefree young woman who comes to Beijing to fulfil her dreams of becoming a manhua artist. After persuading her family and finally finding a job and a house, Xiong Dun settles down in Beijing. Life may be hard but Xiang Yang is surrounded by people that she loves.
Unfortunately, life does not treat her kindly. Xiang Yang's boyfriend cheats on her and she experiences a setback in her career. Misfortunes come in threes as she starts to get sick. When her childhood friend forces her to go to the hospital for an examination, Xiang Yang learns that she has a tumor. From being unwilling and unable to accept her circumstances, Xiang Yang gradually finds the…

Dong Ning Shu, a paternity tester, meets heir Zhang Xi Da in an accident. He becomes attracted to her and invests in the An He Paternity Center, posing as an internet celebrity. Initially resistant, Dong Ning Shu warms to him as they work together on paternity cases. As they grow closer, they uncover a shocking secret: might they share the same father?

A failed bidding for a project lets locomotive designer Lin Zhen Yi experience a sense of failure. Her position as the project leader was replaced by an elite overseas returnee, Tan Qing Chuan. As Lin Zhen and Tan Jing Chuan work together, Lin Zhen Yi observes Tan Jing Chuan and his assistant Jian Ai Xing's working methods and realizes the reason why she failed. Learning from her experience, she achieves success in her next project. At the same time, Lin Zhen also faces pursuit from Tan Qing Chuan, as well as her new neighbor Li Yan Feng, a research test pilot.

Royal Princess Li Yanchu rescued Han Shu from the execution ground and trained him in order to cultivate him as the lackey of the imperial court for the emperor, also her younger brother. When she was dying of illness, she designed her own death so that Han Shu could faithfully assist Li Jie. Three years later, Li Yanchu was reborn on Xie Yugui's body, and found out that she was seriously ill because of being poisoned, so she started to investigate, but got entangled again with Han Shu whose personality changed totally..

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xi Shi Gui" (喜时归) by Yue Xia Wu Mei Ren (月下无美人).

After a fall, food blogger He Qing Qing wakes up in ancient times, where she builds a new life through hard work, unexpected love, and motherhood. Just as she finds success and happiness, she's faced with a difficult choice: return to her world or stay where her heart now belongs.

Ye Ning, who is suffering from ALS, confronts the devil Xie Yu Li in order to fulfill her late mother's last wish. Yu Li knows Ning’s weakness, leaving her trapped. Ye Ning is determined not to compromise, such that even the cold King of Hell has to submit to her at times. After a series of events, Ning discovers that Yu Li is not as scary as she imagined and gradually falls in love with him.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bai Ri Chan Huan" (白日缠欢), also known as "Ye Ye Wen" (夜夜吻), by Hong Luo San (红萝伞).

He Han and Lin Zhan Qiao are well-known figures in the world of web novels. He is acknowledged for his high-quality writing, while she is a leading editor of his works. Together, they have won numerous awards and gained significant recognition.

He Han resides in a hotel and values his privacy, showing a strong aversion to social interactions.

Lin Zhan Qiao has been in a long-term relationship with He Han and hopes to deepen their connection, but it appears that He Han may not share the same sentiment.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Du Shen Nv Ren" (独身女人) by Yi Shu (亦舒).

Meng Fan, after succumbing to a terminal illness, finds himself trapped in a year-long cycle of rebirth. On his 1001st rebirth, he breaks free and returns to high school ten years in the past, now armed with infinite knowledge and power to rewrite his regrets.

Five years ago, Kun Tai, a top student at the police academy, was accidentally imprisoned because of Su Mi Na, a daughter of a wealthy business family, and missed the chance to say goodbye to his father. Five years later, he returned as a gangster and got deeply involved in the game between black and white. She was the trigger for his revenge and his obsession. The temporary paradise is about to collapse, and no one can escape it.

The story continues after Qin Zhan and Yu Chen have conquered the pugilistic world in the gaming realm of New Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils.

After being transported into an online game and overcoming many battles as RPG characters, Qin Zhan (Kenny Kwan) and Yu Chen (Sun Xuening) finally gain absolute control as they are seated at the center of power with martial arts skills second to none. However, they begin to feel a sense of boredom. At the same time, they discover that along with their reality, there exists many self-awakening gaming worlds that are numbered in the thousands.

Yao Wei is a female director in a company. Being a workaholic, she's so focused on KPI's that she doesn't realize her relationship with her husband has become estranged. Many women in her department also face gender-specific challenges. At this time, Yao Wei learns that she's pregnant.

Yao Wei has always wanted a child but she has become pregnant at a stage of her life when her career is on the rise. Meanwhile, Yao Wei's boss Ding Lan has recruited a rival into the company. New director An Chang is not only qualified, she also has her husband's support. They have a DINK (dual income no kids) household which seems to be the perfect way to avoid the problems plaguing many women in the workplace.

After some deliberation, Yao Wei chooses to give birth, and it is this decision that changes everything. In her personal life, Yao Wei and her husband regain their feelings and trust in each…

High school student Li Er crushes on her outstanding classmate, Xu Yi. However, Xu Yi is mesmerized by Li Ba La, who's somehow involved with his rival, Zhang Yang. After a series of events, Li Er becomes good friends with Ba La. The story examines the relationships and misunderstandings between their families and friends. After graduation, the news of Ba La's death changes everything.

Gu Qing Cheng, a florist from Pingcheng, accidentally inhales the "flower spirit" of a white peony, unaware that it is Lu Geng Yun, a thousand-year-old half-demon. Mistaking him for the Flower Immortal Lord, she pledges to be his disciple, while Lu Geng Yun, seeking to reclaim his spirit and uncover his past, stays by her side under a false identity. As they embark on magical adventures, their bond deepens, but fate and the true Flower Immortal Lord’s arrival bring new trials.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo He Hua Yao Lian Ai Le" (我和花妖恋爱了) by Lan Jing (蓝菁).

In the early 1990s, orphan Jane Xiao Ai is forced to drop out of school due to her family’s poverty and move to Guangzhou to get work. In Guangzhou, she works as a small restaurant worker and a tea girl in a foreign trade company. With her cleverness, kindness, and daring fighting spirit, she has grown into an excellent foreign trade merchandiser and business manager. But Jane Xiao Ai is not satisfied with the identity leap that has been achieved. After several setbacks, she establishes her own foreign trade company. After experiencing the 1998 financial turmoil in Southeast Asia and the 2008 financial crisis, she relies on the results of China’s reform and opening up China’s booming foreign trade trend and eventually grows into the boss of a multinational company.

Summer 2003 in Beijing during the SARS epidemic. Hua Duo Duo, who just graduated from university, bumps into the conglomerate heir He He and a conflict between the two results. By coincidence, Duo Duo ends up getting a job at the He’s. Although her first impression of He He was extremely bad, after associating with him for a while, she realizes that he isn’t the good-for-nothing he pretends to be, but in fact dreams of founding a gaming company. When He He falls off a building and loses his ability to walk, he becomes depressed. During these difficult times, Duo Duo is the one to stay by his side and support him.

Xing Xing is the owner of a traditional hanfu clothing shop. She has a bright personality and is very hard working. One day, she was kidnapped by a mysterious man from Tianting Xing. Tianting Xing is a celestial star sect from heaven that has existed for the past 5000 years. She also has unexpectedly fallen in love with Yu Tian Qi, the grandson of Tianting Xing leader. As she learned more about the Celestial Stars, she discovered that she was actually the crystallization of the forbidden love affair of the human 'immortal'. The half-human half-immortal in the world was an excellent material for cultivating "Mortal Pills". At the same time, because of her love affair with Tian Qi, she was regarded as a thorn in the eye by the leader of Tianting Xing, and he wanted to get rid of her. How should Xing Xing deal with the prevailing problems? How should her love with Tian Qi continue? Xing…

A story that follows a Shanghai drifter who works her way up the ladder to become an accomplished buyer. 

Ding Yi Ke has been down in luck. Despite the fact that she isn't getting any younger, she experiences failures in love and in the workplace. She joins a reality show to prove herself and lands a job in a profession that is completely foreign to her. As a rookie buyer, she clashes with fashion extraordinaire Zhao Mo Yuan. They become instant frenemies, but the trials they encounter eventually pave the way for them to find their place in the industry.

A woman and a man, each burdened by personal problems in their lives, accidentally travel to a remote, unknown island. Together, they'll explore the secrets of time and space that sent them to the island, and start a love journey.

When Prince Ning Xuan Zhou became a hostage in a rival country, he found himself forcefully rooming with Master Hua on the very first day. However, Hua Xiyu, who had been disguising herself as a man since childhood, mistakenly believed that Ning Xuan Zhou, the secret spy leader, was a princess. Their fake friendship blossomed into a real romance. As for the villainous forces that sought to ignite a war between the two countries and tear them apart, they were joyfully defeated by the couple working hand in hand.
After his family is massacred, a boy is raised by his enemy to become a lethal weapon. Twins are like flames, they will either rise together, or burn together.

Yi Hua, an aged female doctor, meets Ye Xiang, who's injured and unconscious from an accident. Out of a doctor's benevolence, she takes him back for treatment. However, Ye Xiang loses his memory due to injury. At the same time, he has a tendency of split personality, thus he becomes changeable, sometimes he's sweet but sometimes grumpy. Yi Hua takes him as a medicine boy, calling him "Yun Gui". While getting to know each other gradually, Yun Gui began to launch a fierce love offensive at Yi Hua.

dramas.nt: 完蛋我养的小白脸是大佬
dramas.syn:
A possessive Beijing tycoon changes career to become a male model for love? He is really a top-notch man. Who can resist such a boyfriend?

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wan Dan! Wo Yang De Xiao Bai Lian Shi Jing Quan Tai Zi Ye" (完蛋！我养的小白脸是京圈太子爷) by La Bi Xiao Nian (蜡笔小年).

Song of Life takes on the perspective of young individuals born after 1995. After a series of events, Zhao San Yue finds herself working as a mortuary makeup artist at a funeral parlor. The story tells the journey from when she first starts and doesn’t understand much of the career, to when she becomes serious about doing makeup for the deceased as she comprehends the matters of life and death.

The undercover list of the Hidden Team was leaked and stolen by a mole, causing panic among the members. The emperor ordered the head of the Hidden Team, Shen Yi Feng, to investigate the mole. However, in order to protect the undercover agents still operating outside, the stolen list had to be recovered. Zhang Xiao Hua was tasked with investigating the intelligence and learned that there was information about the list in Nahezhai. She pretended to be kidnapped by the second master, Luo He, and planned to offer herself to the lustful leader of the Great Clan to retrieve the list. However, she did not realize that the leader already had a jealous wife, and she almost lost her life. At a critical moment, the second master came forward and claimed that he was enchanted by Zhang Xiao Hua's beauty and wanted to marry her. The leader of the Great Clan feared Luo He's power within the clan and…

A car accident leaves Wen Li in a vegetative state. Fu Zheng,  a non-blood related uncle, has taken care of Wen Li for three years. While Wen Li still cannot escape the fate of death, she comes to understand Fu Zheng's feelings for her and secretly vows to reciprocate his feelings.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tao De Xiao Jie Geng" (她的小桔梗) by Tian Tao Yao Yao (甜桃夭夭).

Set during the Republican era, the story tells of a young girl by the name of Du Chun Xiao. A smart young girl who uses her strange but unique ability to deduct clues and solve mysteries through the use of tarot cards. However, one day, she decides to return to Jiangnan with her friend Huang Meng Ching. As the Huang family accepts Chun Xiao as one of their own, Mr Huang proposes the idea of marriage between his son, Mo Ru, and Chun Xiao.

Though she is not particularly attracted to Mo Ru, she continues to live with the Huangs until strange things begin to occur that endanger her life. It is during her difficult times that she notices Huang Mu Yun, the youngest son of the Huangs. As the two discover their feelings for each other, secrets regarding Chun Xiao's true identity, as well as the darker nature of Mr. Huang's past deeds, are unravelled.
dramas.t: The Chronicles of a Town Called Jian

dramas.syn:
A story about a socialite in Shanghai whose family falls to ruin and starts on a journey to become a spy.

Lu Han Zhi's fate is intertwined between two men from opposing sides of a war. Gao Chen who appears to be a traitor to his country is actually a Communist spy. Han Shou Min who appears to be a patriot and used to be a top spy of the Kuomindang is treading on a path of no return after being betrayed by his own comrades. Caught in a dangerous and increasingly complication situation, Lu Han Zhi grows from a mere socialite to an impassioned revolutionary.

The thing Shen Qing Li regretted most was probably that she asked the man she had a crush on for eight years to pay her after a one-night stand. From then on, Gu Heng became addicted to her, lingering with her at night and acting like a stranger during the day. When Gu Heng's marriage was confirmed, she drew a line between them. She thought they would part ways amicably, but she was taken back home by the man.

The old grudges and grievances, the Gu family in Beijing, turned upside down overnight. The man sent Shen Qing Li away with injuries, but he frequently appeared to save Shen Qing Li from danger. She thought she was a plaything, dispensable. Little did she know that he had already fallen madly in love with her and was addicted to her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yao Qing Li" (咬清梨) by Yi Ke Hui Hui (一颗慧慧).

After her mother falls ill, Lin Yi Ran leaves her job in Beijing and returns to her hometown, where she takes the civil service exam and becomes part of the Economic Development Office in Taohua Town. There, she witnesses the decline of the traditional Xuan paper industry, once represented by the thousand-year-old Xuan family, now struggling to survive. Determined to help preserve this heritage, Lin Yi Ran launches new projects — from developing Xuan paper notebooks and securing wallpaper orders in Beijing to organizing a cultural festival celebrating the Four Treasures of the Study.

Through her efforts, Lin Yi Ran not only revitalizes the local Xuan paper trade but also rediscovers her own connection to her roots — growing from duty to genuine affection for her hometown. Along the way, she meets Xuan Lu, an innovative yet misunderstood Xuan paper artisan devoted to cultural…

When her younger brother mysteriously disappears in Dengzhou—a city plagued by vanishing citizens, shifting mirages, and the sudden appearance of an iron giant—warrior Zeng Qian joins forces with a cunning strategist, a masked outlaw, and a talented but arrogant fighter. As the unlikely team follows the clues, they uncover a powerful conspiracy behind the city’s supernatural disturbances and must risk everything to stop it.

The story follows the process of constructing the Zheng Canal, linking it to the process of Qin's unification of the six kingdoms. During this period, Ying Zheng and Chancellor Changping Jun, childhood friends, share a deep bond as they face political enemies and the six kingdoms together. In the end, however, due to differences in personality, nation, and blood, they find themselves in armed conflict.

A story that follows a full-time mom reentering the workforce and the adjustments that she and her family have to make.

Full-time mom Shen Hui Xing used to be a top student at a top university. After marriage, she has chosen to put her talents towards running the family. Her husband Sheng Jiang Chuan is extremely busy at work. He barely has any time for them which is why all the responsibilities have fallen on Shen Hui Xing's shoulders.

As her daughter grows up, Shen Hui Xing feels that the time is right for her to finally return to the workplace. However, she gets into a competitive relationship with the company Sheng Jiang Chuan is working for. Shen Hui Xing needing her husband to share more family responsibilities also becomes a source of conflict. Things get so bad that the two are battling for divorce! Through their repeated confrontations in the workplace and relationship…

Song Dian Xin, a devoted general of Haiyin Kingdom, is falsely accused of treason and executed, only to learn her beloved master, Shen Mu Si, framed her. Reincarnated, she breaks off her engagement with Mu Si and becomes Queen of the Sea, secretly plotting to uncover the true mastermind.

In Shanghai in the early 1930s, various forces were surging and the society was in turmoil. Ding Yi Qing, the daughter of a wealthy Ningbo businessman, went to Shanghai alone to find her missing brother, but unexpectedly used her business skills to embark on the road of revolution. On this road, she has seen hope, that promising young man named Lin Mo Sheng, who is willing to fight with her hand in hand. On this road, she has also witnessed despair, where her revolutionary leaders Dong Hong Yu and Du Ying fell one after another. On this road, she finally took over the baton from Miss D, vowing to bring prosperity to the younger generation...
Fang Mu returns as a criminal profiler working for the police force. He reunites with Tai Wei to find their captain's kidnapped daughter.

The immensely powerful eunuch, Pei Qian Yu, crossed paths with the revenge-driven princess, Jiang Si Li, who carried the burden of a deep national vendetta. Together, they embarked on a heart-wrenching yet sweet love story. Hand in hand, they navigated the treacherous world of political intrigue, redeeming and saving each other, ultimately transforming their small personal love into a profound love for their country—a destined tale of love.

Single dad Fang Yong Fu doesn’t have it easy with his three children. His still unmarried eldest daughter Tian Xin works successfully as the CEO’s secretary in a conglomerate. But everything changes when the CEO’s son Wang Shuo appears and misunderstands her relationship with his father. The eldest son Tian Yi works as oncologist but is ashamed of his poor family. And the youngest son Xiao Long, the biggest troublemaker, is unemployed. Chaos becomes perfect when Li Yue Yue, a girl from the countryside, suddenly appears at their door.

Hai Tang is a wealthy girl who falls to rock bottom financially. She then meets Yang Ku An, a rich runaway son, and together, they change the trajectory of their lives. Their story will be told through the eyes of their best friend, a girl who is kind and gentle, and carries a torch for Yang Ku An.

Some articles are describing it as the Chinese version of Gossip Girl.

Tong Yu Xin, who is tone-deaf, possesses a magical necklace. When she wears it, she can make the audience fall in love with her for one hour through her singing, making her a very popular online singer-songwriter. Suddenly, one day, she accidentally kisses Tang Yu Tong, a music teacher, which leads to the necklace transferring to him. Now, Yu Xin, deprived of her magic, reverts to her original self and is eager to seduce Tang to get the necklace back.

God Ye Zhao descends into the mortal world for love, only to become entangled with Princess Chu Xi He, who hides a dangerous dual identity. As their relationship spans lifetimes, they confront fate, power, and buried truths, ultimately unraveling a story of devotion and sacrifice.

Hu Tian is a 25-year-old delinquent leading a carefree life with Xiao Jin Ya, whom he considers to be like a sister. One day, a mysterious woman named Bing Lun appears with news of his long-lost parents, who disappeared for more than 20 years. A man named Lei Li also appears and claims to be a friend of his father. Along with his new-found friends, Hu Tian sets out on an expedition to find his long-lost family; while figuring out how to differentiate friend and foes.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Candle in the Tomb: Mu Ye Gui Shi" (鬼吹灯之牧野诡事) by Zhang Mu Ye (天下霸唱).
dramas.t: Ghost Blows Out the Light: Finding Hu Ba Yi

dramas.nt: 十八岁太奶奶驾到，重整家族荣耀
dramas.syn:
In 1955, Professor Rong Yu died unexpectedly. When she opened her eyes, she traveled to the body of an 18-year-old high school girl with the same name 70 years later. In a blink of an eye, her son has become the chairman of the Ji Group in his 70s, and she has several handsome great-grandchildren. Later, in the process of adapting to the new life, Rong Yu began to rectify this group of unfilial grandchildren with her wisdom and ability, helping the Ji family return to its peak. At the same time, she also found her own beauty in this new era.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Zi Xian Sun Dou Gui Xia, Wo Shi Ni Men Tai Nai Nai" (孝子贤孙都跪下，我是你们太奶奶) by Wu Ying Xia (乌英夏).
dramas.t: Shi Ba Sui Tai Nai Nai Jia Dao, Chong Zheng Jia Zu Rong Yao

dramas.syn:
It is a love story revolving around basketball ace player, Gu Han, and a student of the Chinese department of Jiangcheng University, Zhou Xiang Xiang. 

Gu Han, a student at Jiangcheng University, seems very cold to others and doesn't like to talk. Actually, he has a fear of separation and yearns for love from his family. His parents have been separated since childhood, and his mother has been busy with her career. Gu Han grew up and gradually became a cold boy until Zhou Xiang Xiang appeared. 

Zhou Xiang Xiang is a cheerful girl who wants to become a host, but has stage fright. Growing up in the love of her parents, she has been a cheerful and caring person since she was a child. When she encounters difficulties, she uses her own methods to solve the problem, and she always brings warmth to the people around her.

Jiang Li concealed her identity as a CEO and went on a blind date, hoping to find an obedient man. Lin Jun is the current head of the Chenglin Group. Because he didn't want to marry a gold-digger, he pretended to be a poor man to go on a blind date. The two hit it off and got married in a flash. Unexpectedly, their respective groups had many collaborations, and the two almost discovered each other's true identities many times...

Yun Wan spent three years playing the "perfect wife" to save her family’s business, but after her husband, Shen Liang Chuan, is hospitalized, she seizes the chance to end their marriage. She pursues her music dreams as a rebellious punk CEO, starting her own company and holding concerts.

However, the divorce awakens her “green tea” personality, obsessed with Shen Liang Chuan. The two sides of Yun Wan vie for his attention. Meanwhile, Liang Chuan, facing his own feelings, attempts to win her back, practicing romantic tricks and cheesy lines, but struggles with both of Yun Wan’s personalities.

In a detective story full of bizarre twists and turns, perfectionist Cheng Yang and analytical reasoning expert Jun Wu Gui represent the boys, while Su Wen Yue who is skilled in martial arts and the quirky Ouyang Chu Chu are their female counterparts. Together, they examine every piece of evidence to shed light on the truth.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Tui Guan Jun Wu Jiu" (推官君无咎) by Su Qiao (苏桥).

Twenty-eight-year-old Gu Yun Su, facing heartbreak and unemployment, returns home to her mother, Wu Li Mei, who is unexpectedly pregnant at 48. As Wu Li Mei’s caregiver during the high-risk pregnancy, Gu Yun Su navigates life with her determined mother, new stepfather, and non-biological brother. Along the way, she forms a special bond with Dr. Xu Wen Bin, her mother’s physician. Over 180 days, mother and daughter develop a deeper understanding and appreciation for each other.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "180 Tain Pei Chan Ji Hua" (180天陪产计划) by Chu Tang (楚棠).

Zheng Qiu Dong is a persistent man when pursuing his ideals. He survives through business failures, economic pitfalls purposely set up by adversaries and unfortunate romances without losing his moral principles to become an elite of the financial world, described metaphorically as the "hunting ground".

~~ Two versions available: 52 episodes (DVD) // 58 episodes (TV)

A sudden car accident turned fangirl Song Yu Fei into the hidden wife of the entertainment industry actor Qin Jing Xiao. Facing Song Yu Fei, whose temperament changed drastically, Qin Jing Xiao began to care about her every move. As they learn to get along, their first impressions of each other changes, and soon sparks of love appear between them.

Su Chen, the Mr. Durian, who is hard on the outside and soft on the inside, has secretly been in love with Yi Xiang Nuan for many years. One day, he bravely shows his heart to Yi Xiang Nuan, and unexpectedly, Yi Xiang Nuan has also fallen in love with him. The two spent a happy and romantic campus couple life, but an accident forced them to separate. 

Three years later, Yi Xiang Nuan returned to her hometown from abroad, but on the day she arrived, she was forcibly taken away by Su Chen, and he forced her to marry him. Su Chen waited for her for three years, and for the past three years, Xiang Nuan has heard nothing from him, but time has not changed his affection for her. Xiang Nuan always believed that Su Chen married her to take revenge for her departure without saying goodbye. 

Then, she became his direct subordinate, and after spending time together, she discovered that Su Chen…

Si Jiu Yin left the mountains in the wrong car. Bo Xi Yan instantly felt there was something familiar about this fake miracle doctor.  Known for his immunity towards women, Bo Xi Yan's immediate protectiveness towards the petite Si Jiu Yin baffled him and all those who knew him. Yet even as the mysterious JiuYin struggled against the scars of her past and sought retribution from a family that had persecuted her, she found solace and affection in Bo Xi Yan's company.

Songstress Shen Zhi Qiu, determined to uncover the truth behind her abandonment by her sister years ago, carefully schemes to get close to the young master of the Yin family. However, she unexpectedly ends up in an arranged engagement with the third master, Yin Heng. In the perilous Yin household, Shen Zhi Qiu and her sister find redemption and reconciliation. Meanwhile, her relationship with Yin Heng evolves from mutual exploitation to genuine love. Together, they orchestrate a grand and dazzling act of revenge.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Min Guo Feng Yu Nian Hua" (民国风雨年华) by Mo You Zi (墨忧子).

Zhu Gong Yuan arranges an engagement between his daughter Zhu Ying Tai and Ma Wen Cai. To test Ma Wen Cai's talent, Zhu Ying Tai exchanges letters with him, but unexpectedly notices something suspicious. Determined to uncover the truth, Zhu Ying Tai disguises herself as a man and goes to Xiaoshan Academy. On the way, she encounters Liang Shan Bo, who has gone out to purchase supplies. Zhu Ying Tai and Liang Shan Bo immediately get along well, and after resolving a staged accident scam together, they make their way to the academy.

When Zhu Ying Tai unexpectedly discovers the secret behind Ma Wen Cai's letters, the love, hatred, and emotional entanglements among Zhu Ying Tai, Liang Shan Bo, and Ma Wen Cai begin to unfold, setting the stage for a timeless tragedy.

~~ Based on the Chinese legend "Butterfly Lovers" (梁山伯与祝英台).

Mei Shi Qi is a junior Secret Guard in the Secret Guards Department. She is young and frivolous, and her life goal is to gain the respect of her superior, be promoted to a special-grade Secret Guard, earn a million dollars in silver, and find a husband who meets her standards. However, due to her relatively low qualifications, she has not been able to find opportunities to showcase her prowess or meet a husband who meets her requirements and loves her.

Emperor Yu's favorite concubine Lady Chen dies unexpectedly, shocking both the court and the public. He orders the Secret Guards to investigate the case secretly. Because the palace is involved, there are many inconveniences for male Secret Guards. Mei Shi Qi bravely recommends herself, and after much persuasion, a military order is issued, and she finally gets the job.

The senior brothers are all worried she would be torn to pieces by…

Fifteen years ago, Ying He Meng's mother was unjustly accused of murder and executed by the Ye family. In order to find out the truth and get revenge, she marries into the Ye family as the heir's concubine. She and her husband, Ye Bu Han, gradually move from distrust and calculating moves against each other to joining hands to discover the truth and fight for their love.

This is a story of a single mother and a man who woke up with amnesia.

Hawick is a man, who had just woken up from a 6-years-long coma, with no memory of who he is but only with a memory of Yan Song being his wife. Yan Song, though, insists that she has never seen that man in her life!

Their encounter spins into a pure love that is filled with many questions, seeking answers that lead to the exposure of terrible secrets...

~~ Adapted from the novel "Suiyue Shi Duo Liang Shenghua" (岁月是朵两生花) by Tang Qi Gong Zi (唐七公子).

It tells the story of a court intern who falls in love with her work and goes on her way to become a judge bringing justice to those who need it.
Qiao Nuo, a fresh graduate, comes across an unexpected opportunity to become an intern for the city court. Because of her lack of knowledge for what the work entails, her abilities are questioned by the judge. Qiao Nuo witnesses the intense confrontations between prosecutors and defense lawyers with her own eyes and starts to develop an appreciation for her profession. She becomes determined to become a good judge. Under the guidance of the chief judge, Zuo Dong Hai, she is unafraid to put in the hard work to search for useful clues to help a trial case, to accumulate experiences, to meet friends and to find love.

dramas.nt: 许少的隐婚甜妻 第二季
dramas.syn:
This mini-drama tells the story of three childhood lovers, who are entangled in conspiracy, love, guardianship, shackles, and many other emotions that are intertwined and mixed.

In the scene where they love her, there is she who loves her first, then finds out that she truly loves her and that many people love her.

There are ups and downs in entangled emotions. The hidden marriage between the arrogant leader and his childhood sweetheart is finally reaping love after hardship.

It tells a delicious, interesting and sweet story about Acha, a little palace maid from Xuanwu City who loves food and is quirky. When she went out of the palace to look for ingredients, she picked up the young master He Lianyu who was ambushed and was in a coma, which led to a delicious, interesting and sweet story. Acha and He Lianyu, whose status is completely different, are entangled because of food. In a series of ridiculous events, the two develop a sweet love and pursue their dreams and goals.
Set in the republican area, it revolves around eight strange cases that resurface after the suicide of Baizong Wei and the emerge of a corpse in Hai River.
dramas.t: Eight Strange Cases of the Republic

dramas.syn:
A story revolving around young aspiring idols who train together to reach for their dreams and an inexplicable encounter that turns Lu Fei into Lu Xiang.

Lu Xiang, Bai Ying, Zhang Han and Wei Chi are members of the newly-formed band A.C.E. Lu Xiang is the cute and clueless main singer. Bai Ying is the rapper who is full of passion on the inside but looks cool on the outside. Zhang Han is the main dancer while Wei Chi is the resident boy next door with a gentle personality. Due to an accident, Lu Fei who used to be fat magically transforms into Lu Xiang and from then on, he is the handsome trainee by day and a convenient store worker by night. Meanwhile, the appearance of a nurse named Wu You You brings unexpected excitement into his life.

dramas.nt: 颤抖吧阿部之朵星风云
dramas.syn: The story continues as we find out what happens next to our favorite alien, Abu (who previously assumes the identity of Tang Qing Ye after accidentally landing on Earth), who becomes entangled and falls in love with Tang Qing Feng.

Seven mysterious listeners and Zhou Yu, the world's first storyteller, are trapped on a desert island. Soon, they find there is a large number of clues related to the "Xu's Annihilation Massacre" which took place many years ago. And it's not a coincidence - Zhou Yu is the sole survivor of the tragic events. With help from Liu Ru Meng, who pretends to be his wife, he tries to  solve the original murder case and find the real prepetrator. To do so, the guests must find clues in six scripts left on the island. Each of them has a criminal case, which need to be solved, to get further information about the massacre. However, what the participants didn't anticipate, is that after each solved case, one of them dies.

It tells the story of a princess of a fallen kingdom who died to show her loyalty to her kingdom and becomes resurrected by the power of the Aqua Tear Pearl. She utilizes the power from the Pearl to weave a fulfilling dream for those who are willing to pay the price of death, using chords to guide the illusions. Through various encounters along her adventure, she learns about the various kinds of love and weaknesses faced in love. 

~~ Adapted from the novel "Hua Xu Yin" (华胥引) by Tang Qi Gong Zi (唐七公子).
dramas.t: The Lure of the Hua Xu Song

dramas.syn: Song Yu Die, a renowned chef in the Jiangnan area, was actually a lost Song Dynasty princess. She grew up among the commoners and learned her trade from her adoptive mother. Just when she was about to marry her childhood sweetheart, she got entangled in a warfare between a Song prince and a Jin general. To settle the conflicts between the two countries, she left her beloved to marry her country's enemy.

Because of their completely different personalities, Zhou Yu and Sun Jing Cheng decide to divorce through a mutual agreement. Zhou Yu is composed and emotionally intelligent, while Sun Jing Cheng is carefree and irresponsible. The two quietly prepare for the divorce while trying to keep it hidden from their families, hoping to end their marriage without causing a stir.

However, Sun Jing Cheng’s mother, Hu Su Ying, firmly believes that “a family should never lose a member” and forcefully intervenes in their relationship, causing their divorce plan to collapse. At the same time, Sun Jing Cheng’s twin sister Sun Jing Fei returns home with an unmarried pregnancy and a young daughter named Xiao Wan Zi, claiming the child belongs to a friend and temporarily leaving her with the Sun family. Knowing their mother’s conservative nature, the family realizes that if the truth is revealed, it would…

It is the first Chinese drama to explore the Hanfu culture that has been rising in popularity with a theme that brings ancient influences into a campus setting.

When the handsome ruffian Wang Bei Chen meets his quirky 'younger brother' Chu Yi, when the mischievous  Xia Tian crosses paths with Wan Nian who dotes on her excessively, when the scholarly Cheng Gong encounters the Yu Xiu Mei who's tough yet gentle at the same time, when the food-obsessed Zhang Wei faces the graceful goddess Qin Yu Yan and textbook green tea Lin Wei Wei, their stories began that dark and windy night.

~~ Adapted from the short web story "Xiong You Di Gong" (兄友弟恭) by Dian Deng (点灯).

Zhou Quan submitted his resignation to his employer with great enthusiasm. It just so happened that his wife Che Li’s public account became famous overnight, and she was pushed to the position of entrepreneur. Zhou Quan happily accepted a new job with full board and lodging and a monthly salary of 20,000 yuan after tax. As soon as he joined the job, he directly contacted the core customer - his son Zhou Ai Wen. His wife is his boss, his son is his client, he is a stay-at-home dad, and it is a story where the father’s role returns to the family and a new life is about to begin.

(Synopsis: Chinesedramaworld)

~~ Adapted from the novel "Quan Zhi Ba Ba" (全职爸爸) by Mao Li (毛利).

Cheng Yu, a woman with a rebellious spirit, struggles to break free from Zhou Jin's control. In a staged "infidelity incident," she meets Pei Zheng, a "male model." Cheng Yu repeatedly provokes Pei Zheng, giving him opportunities to "rescue" her. From feigned indifference to calculated advances, the two initially use each other but gradually develop genuine feelings.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wei Xian Chui Diao" (危险垂钓) by Qi Lin Jiu Gui (祁临酒鬼).

Three men are thrown together by a toddler who comes out of nowhere, disrupting their already stressful lives. 

The loyal and kind-hearted Gao Han has just lost his legal battle with his ex-wife for custody of their daughter. His ex-girlfriend and first love, Guan Ling Ling, who died in a car accident, has just sent her son to live with him.

Gao Han and his two tenants Wang Dong Yang and Yu Bo suddenly find themselves becoming nannies to a child, Du Du. Not only must they look after this little one, they must deal with an even bigger headache - Du Du's aunt Guan Shan Shan. 

While the three grown men busy themselves with raising Du Du, they try to determine the child’s paternity. They undergo a custody battle, as they deal with issues tied in with the return of Han's ex-wife’s Liu Min. Han and Shan Shan develop feelings for one an other. To complicate matters, Yu Bo also falls for…

Lai Min and Ding Yi Zhou, two young people from Liuzhou, Guangxi, once attended elementary school together. Originally, their lives never intersected but because of Lai Min’s hereditary family disease, the two met again and fell in love. As Lai Min’s illness gradually worsens, she draws up a wishlist of places throughout China that she would like to visit. Ding Yi Zhou decides to help fulfill Lai Min's wish and together they embark on a trip across China.

A story revolving around a dangerous drug ring and an undercover agent who works from the inside in an effort to take it down.

A package containing methamphetamine shatters the once peaceful life of an average white collar worker named Dou Dou. The sender is Dou Dou's ex-boyfriend Jin Yuan who ran from their wedding seven years ago. Dou Dou changes course en route to the police station and decides to confront Jin Yuan. Detective Qiao Liang has been keeping tabs on Jin Yuan for his suspected involvement with the crime syndicate that range from drug trafficking to money laundering. Unwilling to let go of her ex, Dou Dou takes it upon herself to help Jin Yuan turn over a new leaf, oblivious to his real identity as an undercover cop.
When the funny student meets the cool student a battle of intelligence and physical strength is about to begin. How will they become friends?

Wan Shi Cheng is a self-made man who started out as a street vendor. After 40 years of hard work, he has succeeded in establishing the biggest restaurant in the city. However, his family is on the brink of collapse. His eldest daughter Wan Jia Ling has been living with the passing of her son three years ago. Since then, she has learned to endure the abuse of her mother-in-law and the neglect of her husband Song Qiao Zhi. Wan Shi Cheng's eldest daughter-in-law Zheng Qing Tian has devoted everything to her family and the restaurant, yet her sacrifices are met with her own husband's betrayal. His youngest daughter Wan Jia Ni who is against the idea of marriage becomes pregnant after a one-night-stand with a second-generation rich. Wan Shi Cheng's own wife walks out on him because of his failure to properly address their family's problems. These trials become stepping stones for the Wan…

Media student Bu Xiao Gu has a dream: she is determined to become an outstanding producer. Her idol is Chun Yu Qiao, who is a top-notch producer at Xintian production company, and Xiao Gu manages to enter the company as an intern. But Yu Qiao’s unreasonable personality makes Xiao Gu feel great disappointment. With her hopes shattered, Xiao Gu is asleep at the wheel and not only causes a live broadcast accident which makes her lose her job, but also misses the deadline for her master thesis. However, Yu Qiao takes on the sole responsibility for the accident and thus saves Xiao Gu’s career. Xiao Gu finally recognizes Yu Qiao’s true personality and the two start to work and fight for their dreams together.

Hu Man Li, a thirty-nine-year-old insurance practitioner, lost her marriage and job at the same time when she thought she was about to reach the peak of her life. Competitors secretly interfered, and Hu Man Li was fired from the company. The instigator turned out to be 28-year-old Xue Xiao Zhou.

After several encounters between Hu Man Li and Xue Xiao Zhou, they gradually went from misunderstanding to mutual recognition. Hu Man Li decided to ignore the past grudges and join forces with Xue Xiao Zhou to start over. Xue Xiao Zhou has grown into a gold medal seller who cannot be underestimated in the insurance industry, and Hu Man Li has also decided to return to her career home ground.

A story about rekindling the romance as an old married couple find themselves in their twenties once more and the hilarious hijinks that arise from adjusting to life as young people.

Shen Meng Jun has too many problems to bear. Her son has failed in his own ventures and begs for her help in paying off his debts. She needs money to pay for a house as her daughter's about to get married but she gets scammed and has to borrow from an old friend at the expense of being humiliated. Meanwhile, her do-gooder husband Xiang Da Hai continues to lend money to others because he doesn't know how to turn anyone away. They have a huge fight and Shen Meng Jun swallows half a bottle of sleeping pills in a fit of anger. Surprisingly, she becomes twenty year old once again. This time around, Shen Meng Jun is determined to live for herself. However, her husband discovers her secret and downs the remaining…

Xia Yuan, a Shanghai girl, is the director of the sales department of a well-known brand. After her career was stable, she proposed marriage to her boyfriend, Song Hang Yu, who had been dating for three years, but he disappeared. Xia Yuan learned that Song Hang Yu had gone to Europe, so she gave herself a year to go to Europe to find Song Hang Yu.

On the other hand, Hao Wei Lai, who had a holiday with Xia Yuan in Shanghai, was arranged by his father to work in Europe because of the bankruptcy of his father's enterprise. Ye Si Qi, a post-95s girl living in Shanghai, and Qiao Bin, who grew up in Shanghai, had a flash marriage and divorce. Ye Si Qi, who was hot-headed and wanted to pursue a new life, also embarked on a trip to Europe. Qiao Bin, who regretted the divorce, followed Ye Si  Qi's footsteps to Europe

The four met and went on the road together. This year, the four of them went…

Eighteen year old genius volleyball player, Chen Wei Lan, receives a heavy blow after failing to qualify for the national youth team. After a quarrel with her mother, she returns to her home village and enrolls in the local academy. Under the goading of her playful grandpa, she joins the beach volleyball competition and meets fellow classmate, Li Guo Duo. The two become the best of friends.

Shui Chan Academy used to be known for its top volleyball team, but is no longer able to live up to its former glory. Li Guo Duo and Gaoge Zhang Luo set up a volleyball club, but the members are inexperienced and weak. Chen Wei Lan and Li Guo Duo lead the team of inexperienced members, and set out to revitalize the club. Along their journey is a series of tough training and hilarious encounters. Finally, with hard work and determination, the club finally becomes the sports team it envisions to be.

Jiang Qiao and Pei Yun Xiao have been engaged since they were children. They grew up together expecting to get engaged and then married, despite differences in their family situations. The day they officially announced their engagement, Jiang Qiao got a glimpse into their future - Pei Yun Xiao cheating with another woman.

Pei Zhi He, Yun Xiao's elder but unloved brother, had always silently stood by in support until that moment. Seeing the woman he loved being betrayed, he whisked her away and offered her a shoulder. Understanding her unspoken conflicts, he offered her another choice - fulfilling the family marriage with an alternate groom... himself.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Sheng Wen You Wen" (升温诱吻) by Bi You (彼呦).

When her unfaithful ex-husband and ex-best friend reappear, single mother Xu Kai Xin rises to the challenge - protecting her children, reclaiming her home, and rebuilding her life. Along the way, she meets Mei Cheng Yi, a single father of two, and together they navigate the chaos of parenting four kids, growing closer through life’s unpredictable twists.

While drunk, the heroine travelled into the past... and got kidnapped to marry Chen Tian Xuan, who is also forced into this marriage by his brother. But Chen Tian Xuan kills himself just before this marriage and his body is stolen by a mysterious snake monster.

Jiang Wan Sheng has never been loved by her parents since she was a child and grew up alone. A conspiracy has linked her to the mysterious big boss Qin Mo in Beijing circle. It is rumored that Qin Mo is cold and unkind. Although he is the uncle of her best friend, she is very scared every time she meets him.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tian Ni! Jing Quan Da Lao You Chong Wen Ruan Xiao Xian Nv" (甜溺！京圈大佬诱宠温软小仙女) by Mu Mu Cuo (木木错).
dramas.t: Yu Jian Xin Ruan De Shen

dramas.syn: Amidst the mermaid civil war, the Empress stripped Princess Yun Ling —the heir with a sacred mission—of her powers and exiled her to the mortal realm. Four merfolk closely tied to Yun Ling transformed into a doctor, a celebrity, a CEO, and a mafia boss to infiltrate the human world. Their quest: Find Yun Ling, uncover why she vanished... and confront her mortal incarnation, Xia Shi Yue, in a story of fire and tides.

A girl named Lu Zhi Yi was admitted to the Flight Academy with super high grades, but the school bully Chen Sheng thought she was arrogant, and Lu Zhi Yi also looked down on this rich brat who was born into a flying family and didn't know the sufferings of the world. 

As Lu Zhi Yi's physical training senior, Chen Sheng originally wanted to go through strict physical training to make her realize that learning to fly is not easy, but Lu Zhi Yi's tenacity in training gradually conquered Chen Sheng.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tou Zou Ta De Xin" (偷走他的心) by Rong Guang (容光).

The Refornment Movement of 1898 resulted in the "Six Heroes" dying. Huo Yuan Jia, who was filled with patriotic enthusiasm, had been eager to participate; however, he fell into the enemy's trap and could only watch as the heroes of the country died. Not long after, China was invaded by the enemy.

A year later, Huo Yuan Jia, who was now living in Changzhou, took a stroll along the mountainside. Discouraged by his past and in fear of falling into the enemy's trap again, he decided to move to Shanghai. Huo Yuan Jia's following reputation grew quickly. The Japanese (who had invaded China) grew worried and began to provoke Huo Yuan Jia. Huo Yuan Jia fearlessly charged into battle and finally defeated the enemy with his courageous actions.

~~ Adapted from the novel written by iQiyi.

In Shanghai in 1943, Chen Qian, a military agent, was ordered to assassinate the Japanese, but fell into the trap of Yujiro Ida, the head of Japan's plum agency. Born on the day, and accidentally learned of the Japanese conspiracy. In order to stop the sinister plan of the invaders, Chen Qian began to receive special training, disguised as a Japanese envoy to visit Mei's agency again. Chen Qian, who went deep into the enemy's camp, walked step by step in the dark, walking on thin ice, and with the help of the Communist Party member Chun Yang, he repeatedly avoided danger. 

When several Communists sacrificed, Chen Qian was strongly shocked and gradually strengthened his communist belief. After that, he cooperated with the Communist underground organization and successfully smashed the conspiracy of the Japanese aggressors. After the defeat of the Japanese army, Chen Qian returned to…

Xiao Yan, an independent woman who is most powerful in the workplace, is determined to enter the senior level of Thea Group and create a domestic original makeup brand. Because of Xiao Yan's outstanding performance, the company appointed her to be responsible for better prospects for the maternal and child sector. 

This is a great challenge for Xiao Yan, who advocates that true love is only oneself and insists on DINK. With the help of your girlfriend's full-time mother, You Ya, Xiao Yan gradually understood the difficulty and hardships of maternal love, and her strong and independent values ​​gradually changed You Ya's personality of being clingy. When Xiao Yan was fully preparing for the maternal and infant project, Chen Jiao Rui, also a competitor, had to quit because of pregnancy. 

When Chen Jiao Rui returned to the workplace after giving birth, she couldn't balance family and…

Su Jin Xia, the daughter of the Great General, was appointed as the Empress consort of the sickly old Emperor. Unfortunately, on the wedding day, the old Emperor passed away. Upon hearing the news that she was to be buried together with the old Emperor, Su Jin Xia collapsed. Her body was then taken over by the soul of a fashion designer from modern times. This new Su Jin Xia was different from the original one. She was bold and cheerful. The new Emperor spared her from the sacrificial burial as long as she was willing to marry him. So she became the Empress consort of the new Emperor.

Unaware of the Emperor's true love, Su Jin Xia eventually ran away from the palace. When this plump Empress consort learned that fat women were considered low in status and bullied outside, she decided to open a plus-size clothing store. Soon, the Emperor appeared to pursue his love.

In the wave of comprehensively deepening public security reform, the four characters, Shao Shuai, Marquis, Wang Zheng, and Yang Fan, each young police officer with expertise, are assigned to the police station located deep in the alley to serve as "film police officers".

Shao Shuai, an arrogant and serious detective, initially had low ambitions for community work and was once depressed. Under the guidance and help of his master, Chang Qing Shan, and his partner, Lin Xiao Ma, Shao Shuai realized the profound significance of doing a good job at the grassroots level during his law enforcement duties.

In the process of integrating into the police station and pursuing police officer Liang Bing, Marquis repaired the tense relationship with his original family and gained family, friendship and love. Special police officer Wang Zheng and publicity police officer Yang Fan also continue to…

In the 1930s, Ouyang Tian Qing and other young women from Sanshui, Guangdong, arrived in Singapore to work on construction sites, wearing red headscarves and known as "Red Scarf." Bai Wei, who came to work as a tutor for the Lu family, met the handsome Lu Xueting, the third young master of the family, on the same boat. Tian Qing's sister, He Xiao Chan, came to escape an arranged marriage.

After disembarking, Xiao Chan was blackmailed by gangster Kuang Haisheng but was helped by Bai Wei. The three girls formed a bond, and Kuang found love. They soon encounter Nan Lan, a mysterious and wealthy woman, as their lives unfold in a tale of Chinese overseas struggle and the beauty of Chinese culture.

At the age of seventeen, Lin Shi Lan narrowly survives a devastating flood in her hometown, but the experience leaves her deeply traumatized. Every rainy season thereafter, the people and places of her hometown begin appearing before her eyes as though two different timelines have overlapped.

Four years after the disaster, while outside a psychiatric clinic, she unexpectedly meets Tan Jin, a former high school classmate who can see the same visions. Sharing a similar experience, the two embark on a journey through a recurring rainy-season time loop, traveling between moments in the past and present.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chao Re Yu Ji Wei Jie Zhi Mi" (潮热雨季未解之谜) by Fan Da Wang (番大王).

Teenager Lin Lu Sheng is transported into the world of a popular comic, where she teams up with four charming constables to solve mysteries and face thrilling dangers. Along the way, she captures their hearts—but who will ultimately be her true love?

At the turn of the century, due to the water storage requirements of water conservancy projects, a small riverside town was about to be submerged. People were in full swing in the construction of a new city and population migration. In the summer of 2002, there was heavy rain in Dongjiang City. A bizarre murder case broke into the police's view. A dead lover and a disappeared and resurrected husband were both the "murderer" and the "dead." Finally, under the unremitting investigation of the police, a past that had been dusty for many years was revealed. The complexity of human nature has blinded many people, but the truth will never be drowned out. Everything you can see is sunshine.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Blind" (盲目) by Mu Yao Er Xun (慕遥而寻).

Lin Sui Sui is transported into the broken plot of My Fair Princess and becomes a maid in the Empress’s palace. To return home, she must fix the story, while unexpected complications from a mysterious guard threaten to derail everything.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Princess Pearl" (還珠格格) by Chiung Yao (瓊瑤).

Physics genius Li Tian is focused on his investigation of a special type of energy. However, his mother Mei Xue Yan, a famous musician, gets embroiled in a mysterious car accident in Japan. Li Tian heads to Japan alone, but he never expected to fall into an intricate trap set up by a crime organisation. The man behind the scene manipulate Li Tian and uses advanced technology to commit a series of crimes. In Japan, Li Tian meets the bubbly Zhang Ni, as well as the investigation officer responsible for the case - Shan Qi. The three of them form a special investigation team and traces the incident back to a mysterious band twenty years ago. They also find Fu Bu Jie, a reporter who has been investigating the band for many years. A huge conspiracy which links back to a dark secret involving Li Tian's parents awaits them.

Cheng You Ran, a fallen heiress, disguises herself as her close friend, Su Xin Yue, to avenge her mother's murder and reclaim her family’s fortune. She feigns an engagement to Xu Shi An, heir to Xingyun Group and the son of her mother’s killer. As she gathers evidence, Xu Shi An uncovers her identity but quietly aids her in her quest for revenge. However, Cheng You Ran eventually uncovers a deeper conspiracy and learns the true mastermind behind the tragedy.

After the Mukden Incident of September 18, 1931, Ma Zhong Qiu and his family's peaceful life erupts in chaos. Ma Zhong Qiu grows from a low-level swordsman to a righteous police officer, and finally becomes a soldier for the Communist Party of China. Fate forces him to suffer many hardships and life-death situations.
