At first, he fights for the day that his family can reunite again in peace, and then he fights for love. Eventually, he fights as a protector of his country and people. Over the course of his journey, he meets and falls for dancer Nan Yan. Their love suffers ups and downs against the backdrop of war, but eventually, their genuine and unselfish love gives them strength as they fight for their country together.

Pan Jun, a descendant of a famous physician from Chong Cao Medical Hall, meets the descendant hailing from the five great families from the Chong tribe. Together, they discover a trail leading to the hidden treasures of the Chong tribe. On their journey to retrieve these treasures, they undergo various adventures which leads them to discover the secrets behind these treasures dating back twenty years ago.

~~ Adapted from the novel “Chong Tu Teng” (虫图腾) by Yan Zhi Yang (闫志洋).

Su Yan Xi lost both her parents and was raised by the Gu family. However, Gu Yan Ze said that they should go their separate ways before marriage. She lost consciousness and fell into the swimming pool. She was rescued by her fiancé's friend, Fu Lin Chen. Fu Lin Chen had a crush on Su Yan Xi since childhood. When they met again, love surged like a tide. He seduced her, flirted with her, and fought for her. She fell in love step by step and finally found happiness.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hen Ye Hen Yu! Bei Jing Quan Tai Zi Chong Cheng Xiao Gong Zhu" (很野很欲！被京圈太子宠成小公主) by Wo You Xiao Xi Yao (我有小细腰).
dramas.t: Master Fu's Fight for Love Again

dramas.syn: Bound by a tragic love across lifetimes, Lu An Ning and Ling Cang break free from fate’s control. From enemies to allies, they embark on a journey of cultivation to gain power and rewrite their destiny.

Zhang Guang Zheng is a nerdy couch potato who just takes what life gives him and doesn't aspire for more. However, he decides that it's time for a change after falling for flight attendant Zhang You En. Joining Zheng You En's mother, Liu Mei Li's group of dancing grannies at the public square becomes an eye-opening experience for him. The ladies' courage and passion for life inspires him to do the same. At this time, his seemingly strict hotel manager has initiated a program on employee development. With the encouragement of friends, Zhang Guang Zheng works hard to pass the assessment in order to obtain opportunities for further studies. He forges ahead, constantly narrowing the distance between Zheng You En and him. In turn, he also makes an impact on the lives of the people around him, such as Zhang You En, who used to keep to herself; Wang Niu Lang, who was afraid to fall for someone…

With an archery competition as the main backdrop, two passionate same-age youths from different time periods meet. Zhou Tianyu unexpectedly faced an accident in the year 1999 and died in 2000. Twenty years later, his son Zhou Xingchen who was longing for his father found his father's old bow which caused a miracle to occur. Zhou Tianyu, who had an accident in 1999, traveled to 2019 where he met his wife and son. Unexpectedly reuniting with his family, Zhou Tianyu gained family affection, love, and discovered the peculiarity behind his "accident" that year.

The school bully met the newly-transferred top student and mistakenly thought that the love letter that the top student handed over to others was for him.  So he started to stick to the top student in various ways, and at the same time, the top student also helps the school bully to study hard and get into college. The two-way rush caused by misunderstanding.

A strong and intelligent career woman, Yu Xi Ling, crosses paths with Gu Zhao He, a bold and fiery athlete, through a drunken misunderstanding. Sparks fly as their push-and-pull dynamic turns into mutual attraction. With a younger, straightforward lover making bold confessions, who will give in first? But just as romance heats up, her fiancé, who disappeared three years ago, reappears—what secrets and schemes lie behind his return?

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ling Zong You Yang" (令总有恙) by Yu Bo Le (鱼伯乐).

In the new season, Ning Yi, Su Tan'er and a group of relatives and friends go to the capital of the Wu Dynasty to continue to expand the "Suning" business territory, spanning multiple industries, and innovating new ways of playing to establish a business empire and lead the trend of the Wu Dynasty.

As the situation changes, Ning Yi once again travels to the six states of Qingyun, unravels the cocoon, breaks the undercurrent of the current situation, stirs up the situation in the mall and on the battlefield, and moves towards a bigger world.

(Source : Chinese = Weibo || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the novel "Zhui Xu" (赘婿) by Fen Nu de Xiang Jiao (愤怒的香蕉).

Set in the 1990s, the series follows Chinese criminal investigators as they solve a string of major crimes that shook society. Through breakthroughs in investigation, forensic science, and technology, these young officers risk everything in their pursuit of justice and truth.

~~ Adapted from the book "Gong He Guo Xing Jing Cui Dao Zhi" (共和国刑警崔道植) by Feng Rui (冯锐).

A story about wacky encounters and life-and-death situations that begins when a young woman obtains lipstick that allows her to change her past.

Because of a scar, Su Ye has closed herself off to others. When her grandmother passes away, Su Ye obtains a lipstick that she uses to travel back in time to regain her beauty. In the present, she goes from an ordinary job to working at an S4 car shop and manages to quell any danger that comes her way. In the process, Su Ye meets Huading CEO Han Shao, the man who is tied to how she got her scar in the past. Her actions have a significant impact on his life trajectory.

Ji Xiao, who has pursued Su Ye for years to no avail, becomes Han Shao's personal lawyer. Su Ye returns to high school in order to meet Wan Zi, an old friend whom she has lost contact with. In the present, the dim-witted Wan Zi has become a beauty blogger who is full of hatred…

It tells the story of the ruthless killer Jiang Li, who took root in Shanghai under her anonymity in order to avenge her family for many years. She married Shen Shi You, the owner of a trading company. The two of them live harmoniously, and their love increases, but they are unintentionally involved in more lies and conspiracies...

The two confront each other, and the lover becomes the enemy. They are the sweetest couple, but also the strongest opponents. They are evenly matched, falling in love and killing each other.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Qing Nan Zi Kong" (情难自控) by Mo Jie Da Yu (摩羯大鱼).

The mediocre bank intern Song Qing Qing is full of vocational skills, but because of her natural nemesis physique, she is plagued by life. In an accident, Song Qing Qing turned into Ning’s richest daughter, Song Qing Ning, who opened her eyes every day and only needed to think about how to spend money. However, before she could enjoy the joy of being a young lady, she was bestowed by the new emperor because of her physique. Married to Zhenbei General Jiang Jing Huai, and needs to complete the "Kef" task. In the battle with Jiang Jing Huai again and again, Song Qing Qing finally reaped love, friendship and growth, and understood the true meaning of life.

In Jiangcheng, the prestigious incense-making family is betrayed by their steward. Orphaned Lin Wan Yue returns years later, seeking revenge, and joins forces with the steward’s son, Zhang Han Yi. Together, they rise from humble beginnings to confront their enemies and fate.

dramas.nt: 糟糕，和闺蜜一起穿书后把反派玩儿坏了
dramas.syn:
Best friends Tan Nian and Su Chun He are reborn as the Empress and Empress Dowager, respectively. The system orders them to corrupt Regent Xiao Chen Yuan and the Eastern Depot's Chief Eunuch Qiu Jian Qing within three months. Initially intending to torture the villains to complete their mission, they discover that Xiao Chen Yuan is ruthless yet protective of the people, and Qiu Jian Qing is sinister yet righteous; the so-called villains are merely a fabrication. 

When enemy states frame them, the emperor becomes suspicious, and the system forces them to act, the two best friends resolutely protect their loved ones with their own flesh and blood, ultimately erasing the villains' infamy, rewriting their predetermined fate, and living a life of unbridled freedom.
dramas.t: Zao Gao, He Gui Mi Yi Qi Chuan Shu Hou Ba Fan Pai Wan Er Huai Le

dramas.syn:
Ouyang Yue, seeking to uncover her father's death, makes Qin Ji Feng her bodyguard, sparking feelings that strain her engagement to Liang Jia Hao. As they confront external threats, a shocking truth surfaces, dividing them and fueling a turbulent love triangle.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Da Xiao Jie De Tou Xin Bao Biao" (大小姐的偷心保镖) by Zhuo Jiu Lao Xian (浊酒老仙).

dramas.nt: 你在我的右手边 第二季

dramas.syn: To assist the great artist Wu Daozi, poison doctor Bai Mengmeng works with demon hunter Xiu Yu, disciple Lu Li and descendant of the Gu tribe Chun Yu; and heads to Peng Lai to eliminate demons.

Set in the final years of the Qing Dynasty, the drama follows Rong Er, a commoner who becomes a palace lady-in-waiting. After gaining recognition for her cooking, she becomes the disciple of Shouxi, a palace maid. When Shouxi is murdered by a eunuch, Rong Er is drawn into a conspiracy. With the help of Li Qi, a palace guard, she uncovers the truth and investigates the theft of national treasures.

The drama tells the story of Qiao Qing Qing, a second-year forensic student, who accidentally encounters System Xiao Yi and becomes a script traveler. While on a mission to an unknown script, she becomes trapped inside and meets Yan Jun Huai, a character in the script.

The young girl Saori beats all other applicants and is hired as nanny for arrogant superstar Su Da Hao. But what nobody knows is that she is actually a robot. Da Hao continuously tries to make her leave but fails at every attempt. Things turn complicated when he eventually develops feelings for Saori.

Is it a perfect marriage or a perfect act? A woman's life starts to crumble when she starts to realize that her husband is having an affair.

Power couple Zhang Yi and Zhang Xin are the envy of everyone in the field of architecture. After Zhang Yi became pregnant, Zhang Xin offers to resign and become a househusband. Years have passed, and their daughter Xiao Xiao is now five years old. On the surface, Zhang Yi's career is on the rise, and her family is a happy home. However, she never imagined that she was actually living in a cesspool of lies...

After breaking up with her cheating fiancé, lively Xia Yang Yang unexpectedly obtains a marriage certificate with domineering CEO Gu Qi Chen. Despite her initial fear of being taken advantage of, she finds herself falling for him as he showers her with affection.

However, just as their relationship is deepening, everything comes to a halt when Gu Qi Chen's ex-girlfriend returns from overseas. Will Xia Yang Yang, fearless in the face of love and hate, and reserved Gu Qi Chen be able to overcome the obstacles in their relationship?

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gu Xian Sheng De Di Yi Chong Qi" (顾先生的第一宠妻) by Feng Jia Xiao Qi (丰家小七).

After being diagnosed with terminal stomach cancer, Li Shan Shan selflessly plans for her family's future, unaware that her husband, Xiao Cheng, and her half-sister, Li Xiao Shu, have secretly betrayed her. In a sinister plot to claim her huge insurance payout, they trick her into a fatal, high-risk surgery. Discovering their malicious conspiracy right on the operating table, Li Shan Shan dies in utter despair. However, she is unexpectedly given a second chance at life — determined to exact relentless revenge on those who wronged her.

Xu Nan Yin, a fashion shop manager, is on her way to a class reunion when she has the same dream once again of her and Pei Jing Mo, her classmate, whom she had a relationship with 4 years earlier - a relationship that ended abruptly when he got engaged to someone else. But, thinking that he isn’t attending the reunion, she enters the venue and surprises everybody by having changed from an ugly and poor classmate to a well off and beautiful woman. Little does she know that Pei Jing Mo, now a powerful CEO of his family business, has cancelled all his plans in order to attend the reunion, wanting to reconnect with Xu Nan Yin.

As soon as he arrives, he goes straight towards her and declares to everyone present that she is his future wife. But what happened back then has Xu Nan Yin on the defense, not wanting to get hurt again. So she refuses him, claiming to already have a husband and…

Empress Gu Qing, betrayed and perished in flames, is reborn as Feng Qing, a lowly seamstress in the Imperial Wardrobe Bureau. To protect her sister Gu Wan and uncover the truth behind her death, she navigates the treacherous harem, joining forces with her younger brother, Imperial Physician Gu Xuan. As she schemes amidst the palace's shadowy powers, her fate becomes inextricably tangled with Emperor Xiao Luo. Their bond rekindled with every confrontation.

Zhu Li Zhi, a journalist working in investigative journalism, meets Wang Zhi Cheng, a cardiac surgeon. Under his gentle and attentive advances, Zhu Li Zhi falls in love, only to discover after marriage that Wang Zhi Xheng has a pathological controlling nature, jeopardizing her idyllic life. Zhu Li Zhi fights back, resisting the unequal relationship, ending the engagement, and reclaiming control of her own life.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Ai Qing Man Man Sha Si Ni" (爱情慢慢杀死你) by Yi Shu (亦舒).

Celebrating her graduation, Jiang Xing Chen is out camping alone. Although her bestie warns her, she is convinced that it’s safe since there aren’t that many perverts out there - or so she thinks, because just as she finished saying so, the young master of the Mo family, Mo Xiao, appears, holds his hand over her mouth and drags her into the tent. Here, he kisses her against her will, simulating a loving couple, while people outside seem to be looking for him. Afterwards, he gives her a ring and tells her to come find him in order to be compensated.

Later, when Mo Xiao is pressured by his mother to marry, he chooses Jiang Xing Chen, who just happens to be there delivering some ordered food. Little does he know that Jiang Xing Chen’s father died from jumping off the building - and the Mo family seem to be the reason why he committed suicide. But even if she slaps him and throws his ring…

After being betrayed by her family, Lu Xin Nian rises from a delicate noblewoman to a formidable warrior. Entangled in a battle of love and power, she joins her Fang Hua Sisters on a fiery, empowering journey that reshapes their destinies.

In a rapidly developing Hanzhou, police officer Qin Feng and his sworn brother Liu Tian Ye face off against dangerous criminals while grappling with deep moral dilemmas and the complicated ties between family, power, and justice.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Ying Xiong Jian Shi" (英雄简史) by Shu Zhong Min (舒中民).

The freshly graduated Yang Yi Fan became an intern in an advertising company but unexpectedly found out that her ex-boyfriend, Huang Yu Chen, was competing with her for the promotion. But she's not aware, that Yu Chen, didn't want to break up with her, in the first place, and now he's trying to help her get a stable position in the company, as a form of compensation and to win her heart again. Soon, thanks to working in a new environment, Yu Chen realizes what the real reason for their breakup was.

When Ren Xiao Ming was preparing to reclaim the copyright. After her husband plagiarized her work, a 20-year-old case resurfaces. It involves a hidden corpse, and it triggers a series of coming to light secret entanglements between Xiao Ming's mother, Ren Mei Yan, her best friend, Bai Shu, her teacher, Zhou Yun, and many other women.

Su Tang and her husband run an art gallery together and seem to have a perfect, loving marriage that everyone is envious of. But what if one day you discovered that the person sleeping next to you is a terrifying serial murderer? What would you do? 

One step forward is destruction, and one step backwards is sweetness. There is only a thin line between the man you love and the terrifying killer. Su Tang, can you tell the face of love?

~~ Adapted from the novel "Xi Xiu Wei Tang" (细嗅薇糖) by iQIYI.

In order to lift a curse from the leader of Tiansha Pavillion, Mo Jia, he has to cut out and eat the heart of An Chang Xia, a woman he has held captive for 10 years, in order to survive on drinking her blood.

10 days before the ritual, the greedy demon, Tan Gui, steals the Moon Shadow weapon that is needed to complete the ritual. That sets in motion a string of events involving An Chang Xia’s family and a truth about her past that perhaps was better left undiscovered.

dramas.nt: 我的掌门女友 第二季
dramas.syn: Two characters in the wuxia game "New Soul Land" travelled across the real world. One is Yan, the villain of this game, the other is the master of Bowu Sect, Bo Ye. However, Huang Xiao Yu, the leader of the Bowu sect in the real world, was possessed by Bo Ye and accidentally became the bodyguard of the popular star Yuan Fan. Yan kept controlling people to rob the Ice Stone. To prevent the Ice Stone from being robbed, they caused farce after farce...

Determined to impress her parents, Jiang Chuan Yu leaves home in search of business opportunities. For protection, she hires the world's best swordsman, Shi Tian Qing. The two later reunite, and along with Jiang Chuan Yu's fiancé, they collaborate to carve out a profitable business. Can they succeed amidst all of the trials and tribulations they face?  Will Jiang Chuan Yu wind up having to choose between the swordsman and the scholar?

A report reveals that JuLun Group in Canghai City has covered up a past mining disaster. Deputy Director Qu Jiang He becomes central to an anti-crime campaign but soon realizes that the line between right and wrong is blurred. As various interests are at play, he faces pressure from opponents, friends, and superiors to hide the truth. New female director Yan Ge is equally shocked by the harsh reality, realizing that covering up the truth is a greater evil than the crime itself.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Yan Gai" (掩盖) by Wu He Ping (武和平)

Empress Xiao Ling, born into a military family, shed her armor for love and married Emperor Li Yun Xi. However, after marriage, she was constantly neglected and suspected by him. Hurt and heartbroken, Xiao Ling ultimately cut her hair and divorced him, only to be murdered while fleeing the palace. But to her surprise, Xiao Ling resurrected and went back to the events that happened a month before her death. After rebirth, Xiao Ling starts doing everything to sever her relationship with Li Yun Xi and change her fate. However, the more she tries to do so, the more secrets she uncovers about Li Yun Xi, shedding new light on the events of her past life.

To save her mother, andrologist Tang Tang marries into the Shen family, becoming the wife of Shen Juan, the richest man in Beijing. However, she becomes embroiled in family intrigue and the mystery of a dual personality. On her wedding night, she encounters Shen Juan's yandere younger brother, Shen Xing Ye, and finds herself torn between the aloof CEO Shen Juan and the gentle, yandere Shen Xing Ye.

Eccentric medical examiner Qin Ming, police detective Lin Tao and assistant medical examiner Chen Shiyu team up to find a mysterious killer known only as the 'Scavenger', who specifically targets the wanderers and misfits of the city.

~~ Adapted from the 4th novel "Scavenger" (清道夫) in the novel series "Medical Examiner Dr. Qin" (法医秦明) by Qin Ming (秦明).
dramas.t: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin 2: The Scavenger

dramas.syn:
The Food Fairy, Feng Li Li, was punished and sent to the mortal world to experience a calamity of love. In order to find her destined partner to help her through this tribulation, Feng Li Li entered the mansion of Shen Yu Chuan, the Lord of Jiuli City. Through a series of coincidences, she ended up marrying the Lord.

Unexpectedly, her true destined partner turns out to be someone else, prompting Feng Li Li to desperately try to escape the mansion. However, a political conspiracy was quietly unfolding. Shen Yu Chuan, in order to protect Feng Li Li, intentionally distanced himself from her. Only then did Feng Li Li realize her feelings for Shen Yu Chuan.

As she was caught in a dilemma, she unexpectedly discovered that Shen Yu Chuan's affection for her was nothing more than a carefully planned deception. Driven by love-turned-hatred, she decided to seek revenge on Shen Yu Chuan, until…

Ruan Tang is a super foodie with special skills. Not only can she crack the secret recipe of any food; she can also use her nose to determine the food within a radius of ten miles. She wants to become a food editor, but her father wants her to take over his restaurant. Wang Moyu, a talented and black-bellied male chef comes to study cooking from Ruan Tang's father. After seeing Moyu's love for food, her father decides to teach him all that he knows. Ruan Tang and Moyu butt heads as Eastern and Western food culture collides creating sparks between the two.

Xin Zhi Yao accidentally spent a night with her university professor Zhou Ji and got pregnant. Just when she was anxious and helpless, Zhou Ji proposed marriage, and the two began a secret marriage life, living in separate rooms.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Jiao Qi Yan Yi Hong, Jin Yu Jiao Shou Lan Yao Hong" (小娇妻眼一红，禁欲教授揽腰哄) by Lan Qi Ming (懒起名).

The math genius, Rao Yu Ci, was framed by her best friend and business partner, Bai Jing Jing. Accused of drug addiction after attacking her mother, she was forced by her family to be admitted to the Cardiac Health Treatment Center. From that moment on, family, friendship, love, and career disappeared from her life. During her fall, Rao Yu Ci never forgot the face of the one who pushed her into the abyss. Three years later, after recovering, Rao Yu Ci leaves the hospital and begins to meticulously plan her revenge, vowing to unmask Bai Jing Jing and expose her evil deeds.

A story of an internet celebrity's transformation follows Xia Ru Xing, a post-90s girl who lived her life without worries. Her father suddenly dies and her boyfriend disappears without a trace. Xia Ru Xing is left with a spicy hotpot restaurant.

Xia Ru Xing is not alone for long because her older half-sister Xia Ru Yue shows up to take over their spicy hotpot restaurant. Xia Ru Xing doesn't even have the recipe in her hands but in order to protect her father's legacy and prove her abilities, she is determined to do whatever it takes to succeed. Having experienced the worst and being subjected to cyberbullying, she manages to comes back strong. The sisters join hands in search of the recipe that can save the restaurant. Ru Xing becomes an apprentice of rival chef Li Hao Shan. Feelings of romance spark between Hao Shan and Ru Xing. At this time, Ru Xing's ex-boyfriend Cheng Jie…

Lin Man Ge, a righteous and smart medical student, sneaks into the Lu family to avenge her friend Lan Lan's bizarre and tragic death, and becomes the eldest son's fiancee. However, she is discovered by the fox-like second son Lu Hao Ran, and a series of abuses and counter-killings begin. As she gets along with Lu Hao Ran, she is attracted by his sincerity and justice under his disguise. These two go from suspicion to trust to love, and finally find justice and the truth.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ta De Wei Zhuang" (她的伪装) by Shui Yue Ling Xian (水月灵仙).

In her previous life, Yun Lian, the female Emperor, favored the youngest son of the Prime Minister, Jiang Zi Yan, emptied the Harem for him, and even let him command the Three Armies. He repaid her by killing everyone around her before seriously injuring her. All because he despised her for making him her male pet and wanted to ascend the throne himself. He also told her that her real savior was General Ning Bu Yu, the man she hated the most. Even though Ning Bu Yu arrived in time to kill Jiang Zi Yan, she could only watch as Ning Bu Yu died in her arms before dying herself - regretting hurting the man who loved her the most and trusting the wrong person.

Luckily, Yun Lian is reborn on the day of her male concubine draft. That day, she refused to choose one as she wanted only her savior, Ning Bu Ju, as her consort. But this time around, she decides to change her fate, starting by…

Game designer Zhu Yao accidentally gets drawn into a new Xianxia VR game that is currently in development. There, she becomes the disciple of the most beautiful male immortal, Yu Yan, who had to wait 16 thousand years before finally getting a disciple of his own. Yu Yan carefully teaches Zhu Yao and cherishes her a lot. But when Zhu Yao finally begins to understand some of his teachings, she suddenly dies. Yu Yan then gets a new discipline, the reborn Zhu Yao and she dies again. He then gets another disciple, and she dies once again…

~~ Adapted from the web novel "My Disciple Died Yet Again" (我家徒弟又挂了) by You Qian (尤前).

Shu Ya Wang’s peaceful life with childhood friend Tang Xiao Tian is disrupted by his senior, Qu Wei Ran, whose obsession with her leads to assault and a breakup with Tang Xiao Tian. To protect her friend Xia Mu, Shu Ya Wang marries Qu Wei Ran under the pretense of pregnancy, but after a miscarriage, she disappears. Four years later, Shu Ya Wang returns, reigniting the complex relationships between her, Xia Mu, Qu Wei Ran, and Tang Xiao Tian.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xia You Qiao Mu Ya Wang Tian Tang" (夏有乔木雅望天堂) by Zi Yue (籽月).

Wealthy Zhong Wan Ruo infiltrates the Xia army to avenge her fiancé but is forced into marriage with its young general, Mu Shao Li. As the two scheme against each other, love unexpectedly blossoms. However, when Wan Ruo uncovers Mu Shao Li’s true identity, their growing bond is tested by secrets, distrust, and the chaos of war.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jun Zuo, Qing Fang Shou!" (军座，请放手！) by Wang Xiao Jie (王小杰).

Shen An Ruo wants to get married upon graduation, but her boyfriend broke up with her on the day of her graduation ceremony. Meanwhile, Cheng Shao Chen wants to focus on starting his own business but is constantly pressurized by his parents to get married. The two of them meet at a wine party, and somehow accidentally finds themselves getting married. The two of them wanted to resolve the misunderstanding as soon as possible, but because of their respective problems, has no choice but to maintain the current arrangement. Upon agreement, they become a "contractual couple" for three months. However as time passes by, they experience unique incidents together and begin to fall in love.
dramas.t: Do You Want to Marry Me?

dramas.syn:
Luo Man and Chen Kai Xi were college classmates. After graduation, the two gradually drifted apart. One became a successful screenwriter, and the other became a rich housewife.

Real and fake best friends of ten years meet again; they don’t want the other person to have a bad life, nor do they want the other person to have a good life. Luo Man is not satisfied with her career and hopes to achieve a leap in life through marriage and become equal to Chen Kai Xi, who is deeply stuck in the quagmire of marriage. 

When the undercurrent between the two was raging, the young and beautiful Zhong Qing Cheng became a key figure in the contest between the two.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Qin Ai De Chou Di"( 亲爱的仇敌) by Ni Yi Ning(倪一宁).

In Shenzhen, a jobless Lu Da rekindles hope in a 24-hour bookstore; opera star Fan becomes a tech sales whiz in Huaqiangbei; delivery rider Tan earns dignity; drone engineers Zhang Yi and Nuan build love with code; teen Xiao Peng creates a wildlife overpass; planner Wang Peng Qian and daughter protect mangroves, with spoonbill Y075 marking eco-change. These stories weave entrepreneurship, innovation, and sustainability, showcasing Shenzhen’s 45-year transformation and future promise.

The story takes place during the Tang Dynasty and revolves around a secret government agency trying to obtain a national treasure weapon called the dragon sword. To do that, they assassinated two great martial artists, leaving their kids to survive in the chaotic world. They are taken in and taught martial arts by Elder Yang. On their journey to Jianghu to uncover the conspiracy of the secret group, they meet the love of their lives in Cai Wen Jing and Fan Shi Qi.

~~ Adapted from the anime "The Degenerate-Drawing Jianghu" (画江湖之不良人) by Beijing Ruosen Digital Technology Co., Ltd. (北京若森数字科技有限公司).

When Wen Tong, the red thief, and Gu Jin Cheng join forces to investigate an unsolved case of disappearance, their clues lead them to more unsolved cases that only get more complicated and dangerous. Will they be able to find the truth amidst the turbulent forces against them?
The story follows a mysterious chef and his late night diner open from midnight to dawn, featuring ordinary stories from his patrons every night as they chatter and eat the one requested dish.

Two brothers reunite after a long time and decide to go fishing together. During the trip, they meet with a tragic accident and are rushed to the hospital. But when the younger brother regains consciousness, he is shocked to discover that his soul has been swapped with that of his elder brother. How will this impact their lives, and can they ever go back to their original bodies?

Yun Shao, a young woman from a prominent clan, narrowly escapes death after being marked for a ritual sacrifice involving a "blood jade." Her fate becomes inextricably linked to Pei Zhao of the Fengyi Guard through a symbiotic "mother-child" gu-poison bond. Driven to seek justice for the tragic death of Yun Xiang and to uncover the truth behind the anomalies at the blood jade mine, Yun Shao defies societal conventions to join the Fengyi Guard. 

As the investigation unfolds, bizarre sacrificial rituals and dark imperial secrets come to light amidst a turbulent court rife with power struggles and rival factions. Standing shoulder to shoulder, Yun Shao and Pei Zhao brave perils to confront treachery; they remain steadfast in their convictions while navigating a labyrinth of love, hatred, and mystery in search of the truth and their own future paths.

The comic author Mao Douzi modified her comics, again and again, making the big villain in the book—Su Wang mad and coming to the real world. “Forcing” the author to give himself a finishing end. They developed feelings when they got along in the real world. At the same time, they also had to deal with a crisis caused by  another comic character who came to this world a decade ago, hero Jiang Lin.
dramas.t: The Man Ripped From the Sky

dramas.syn: The drama tells a story of self-preservation and strength of an ordinary woman who worked hard for a life of stability who is faced with her husband's malice and betrayal, the burdens and problems of life.

In the female-dominated city of Yueling, a group of killers hid in an inn waiting for a chance to take revenge. Unexpectedly, the inn was bought by a merchant lady, Lu Huai Shuang. The killers who were good at kinds of weapons were forced to practice playing and singing, and the leader of them, Yue Qi Shan, even became the head of the inn under Lu Huai Shuang's guidance and also completely fell in love with her.

After years of working in major cities, three siblings from the Wu family return to their hometown. Through life’s challenges and family conflicts, they rediscover the strength of their bond and learn to support one another, rekindling the true meaning of sibling love and unity.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hush" (嘘) by Yi Shu (亦舒).

Orphan Jin Shi San sets out to avenge his foster father’s death after a rare ginseng is stolen. His quest leads him to a sacred mountain, where he uncovers a surprising connection between his own identity and the mountain god.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shan Shen" (山神) by Tian Xia Ba Chang (天下霸唱).

In a psychiatric hospital overseas in Country M, the most dangerous patient, Xiao Mu Chen, passes his 144th mental evaluation and is finally discharged. But no one knows that his condition has never truly improved-he still sees the phantom of his fiancée, Jin Zhao Xi, whispering in his ear, urging him to take bloody revenge. Four years ago, on the day he had planned to propose, Jin Zhao Xi was brutally murdered. He arrived too late, only to see the four culprits walking away, laughing. Now, at last free, he begins the revenge he has long prepared for...
dramas.t: The Dark Side of the Sun

dramas.nt: 我的医妃不好惹 第三季
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Princess Consort Is No Pushover" (神医毒妃不好惹) by Jian Bing Juan Da Cong Gou Zi (煎饼卷大葱狗子).
dramas.t: I Have a Smart Doctor Wife Season 3

dramas.syn: The host anchor disappeared inexplicably before the start of the broadcast. So the domineering female president Xinruila personally went to battle and went live broadcast with the mysterious chief bartender of the Mi Qing Bar... An unexpected live broadcast made the two meet again like fate, and the secrets of fifteen years ago gradually surfaced. Shiwei secretly helped Xinruila, who was framed by the villain's jealousy. But Xinruila discovered that he was the childhood sweetheart of Wen Qi, who had been unforgettable for fifteen years. However, why did Wen Qi change his name and change his surname? Why did the once genius of Go give up Go now? Xinruila made up her mind to uncover the mystery of the game...

After Lu Yuan Zhi fell apart from his teacher and suffered oppression from his seniors, he left Beiping and headed to Shanghai. With his hard work, he earns recognition in Shanghai. When war erupts in Beiping, Lu Yuan Zhi heads back and swore not to make cheongsams for the Japanese. He uses his skills to become one of the greatest costume designers in China.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Hua Fu Chuan Qi" (华服传奇) by Er Huo (尔火).

It tells the story of the Communist Party underground worker "old ghost" breaking into the Japanese pseudo-intelligence organization but being cut off at a critical juncture and facing the danger of identity exposure. In a crisis, the "old ghost" dealt with the enemy and tried every means to transmit information.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Feng Sheng" (风声) by Mai Jia (麦家).

Lu Ren Jia is a lonely young man. After being abandoned by his mother as a child, he lost all trust in others and became a total introvert, burying his memories deep inside. He has shunned society but has also taught himself a range of IT-related skills, transforming himself into something of a tech whiz. His daily existence is dull and uneventful—until he discovers the latest gaming craze, an AI-based game called 5W. 

5W becomes a massive phenomenon in the gaming world, pitting humans against one another and artificial intelligence, allowing them to interact with one another and aid or harm each other in the battle to gain ultimate transcendence. In this online arena, Ren Jia meets Zhou Zhi Shu, a beautiful and kind-hearted kindergarten teacher with mysterious secrets of her own. Her former boyfriend led Zhi Shu into the virtual world of 5W, and now she's developed a deep connection…

Modern-day best friends Tian Yu Yuan and Lin Shu Tiao unexpectedly find themselves transported into a novel about household power struggles. They become sisters-in-law destined to be framed in a flower boat scandal on their wedding night and die together as sacrificial characters. The two team up to thwart the eldest sister-in-law and the adopted daughter, Shen Wan Wan, as they expose one scheme and trap after another, making money along the way to survive. 

Shen Cheng, the cold and aloof heir, is afflicted with a deadly poison and needs the heroine’s blood to stay alive, while Shen He, the unruly third young master, secretly aspires to become a coroner. Romance gradually blossoms between the two couples. However, the reborn original heroine Song Zhang and the Third Prince, who plots rebellion, launch a series of attacks.

After surviving a fire, Song Wan pretends to have memory loss and adopts the persona of an 8-year-old to find her mother's jade pendant in the Lu family. Meanwhile, wheelchair-bound Lu Ting Sheng proposes marriage to the Song family, making Song Wan his bride. Their union serves both their hidden goals, bringing them closer as Song Wan searches for the pendant and Lu Ting Sheng reunites with her.

The TV series "Speedy Rescue" revolves around Dr. Si Qiao, nurse Mo Mo, Dr. Xue Ba and Yan Qing. It tells the story of two helicopter pilots forming a flight medical rescue team, overcoming a difficult and dangerous environment, flying through the clouds and racing against time to save lives...

Gu Liang is the head of an entertainment company where her ex-husband Jiang Yun Ze is the CEO. A position he got when he married Gu Liang. She is murdered for her company shares by her cheating ex-husband and sister Gu Su Yan. Somehow she gets a second chance to go back one year and change her life.

Changing the decisions she made back then stirs up trouble with her ex-husband and sister, but also leads to meeting a mysterious young man whom she offers an acting contract to. Who is the young man, how will she avoid falling into the same traps and is she able to find her true love along the way?

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Bright Stars: Pick A Boss To Be A Husband" (星光璀璨: 捡个boss做老公) by Ake Culture (阿柯文化).

The play tells the story of Gu Yao Yao, a small star wandering at the bottom of the entertainment industry. Through chance and coincidence, a series of ridiculous and fascinating events occurred in a far cry from the idol praying Thoughtful story.

~~ This adaptation of the comic IP series is based on the user’s certain knowledge of the original comics of “Rebirth Only for the Movie King”.

During the time of great prosperity and splendor in the early years of the Tang Dynasty, nights in Chang'an were shrouded with evil and wickedness. Underneath the bizarre and dazzling scenes lay all sorts of strange happenings, and hidden dangers lurked for those being hunted amidst the bloodshed and carnage. A tale of the prosperous era, the mysteries unveiled.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Tang Chao Gui Shi Lu" (唐朝诡事录) by Wei Feng Hua (魏风华).

The cleaning girl Ming Xiao Xiao and the domineering president Huo Yun Ting happen to meet at a resort because of a misunderstanding, and they become a pair of happy friends because of an unexpected kiss. Ming Xiao Xiao is simple and cute. Huo Yun Ting is cold-hearted and black-bellied but poisoned by a family traitor.

Huo Yun Ting needs to hire a personal caretaker after being injured, so the two are forced to "cohabit" and live in together. Although there were a lot of misunderstandings and challenges in their short time together, there were also many sweet moments. The two gradually developed into a pair of intimate lovers who complement each other.

Falsely accused of murdering her father, Princess Feng Li returns from exile as a feared ruler to uncover the truth behind the crime. At a decadent banquet designed to flush out her enemies, she draws close to Yun Zhan, a mysterious slave who is secretly a fallen prince. As their hidden motives collide and political conspiracies close in, Feng Li and Yun Zhan must choose between revenge, power, and the love that threatens to undo them both.

This drama mainly tells the reunion of Jiang Xia, who was born on Chuanshan Island, with her childhood playmate Chen Yujiu. Over eight years, the two go from being familiar to being strangers and back to being familiar. In the process of getting acquainted and understanding again, the growing pains followed one after another, and the two got closer and closer as they grew up. Jiang Xia discovered Chen Yu's unknown past, and when fate struck again, she stood behind him and became his sun.
dramas.t: Zhi You Na Ge Xia Tian Zhi Dao

dramas.syn:
In the TV show "Fallen Peach Blossoms”, the supporting actress Wei Wei, who played the malicious Director Xu, lived through the full three episodes, the peak of her acting career. She gathered family and friends to watch the premiere, only to be shocked when she was executed by the eunuch Jiang Yu in the first episode. 

Furious, Wei Wei confronted the producer, who arrogantly explained that everything was for the sake of the lead actress Dai Yao's character development. Wei Wei fainted from anger, only to discover that she could travel between the show and reality whenever she fell asleep. Rising from the depths of the palace, as well as the villainous Director Xu, she vowed to live a long life and take control of her own destiny!

An Jing and An Ning are twin sisters who were separated at an early age after their parents divorced. However, their father who values males over females quickly remarried and had another daughter named An Le. An Jing, the gentle sister, followed their father. An Ning, the aggressive sister, followed their mother. An Le was kidnapped when she was 10 years old. The three sisters all lived in different environments and faced their own unique obstacles. What will ultimately become of them when they reunite?

A story that follows the romantic entanglements between the experienced head of the major crimes division and a young quirky screenwriter. 

Zhou Yuan is the head of the major crimes division of the police department. During an undercover operation to catch a drug dealer, he inadvertently crosses paths with Bai Xiao Lu. Her impulsiveness almost causes the entire sting to fail. Upon graduating from school, Lu Hao requested to be transferred to major crimes division to fulfill his aspirations to become a good police officer. However, Zhou Yuan's parenting tactics at work often result in tension between the two. 

Zhou Yuan and his ex-girlfriend Lin Yao were having problems in their relationship. By some strange arrangement, he moves into Bai Xiao Lu's home thus beginning a co-habitation between two quarrelsome individuals. At this time, Xiao Lu's good friend Yuan Ming Qing starts falling…

Yuan Ming Yu, who was transported to the ancient kingdom of Suyue, must become an Empress to return to modern times. With her fiery personality, she seeks to secure her path to power, enlisting the help of her loyal guard, Ye Shao. Together, they navigate various challenges and obstacles as Yuan Ming Yu strives to achieve her goals.

Shen Meng who is nearly 30 years old, is an ordinary reporter who was about to get a promotion opportunity but was passed over in favor of a younger, beautiful woman Su Nuo. At the same time, her seven-year relationship with her boyfriend Han Zuo also ended.  Shen Meng encountered a double crisis in career and love. By chance, she got the opportunity to interview the mysterious fitness coach Zhou Qiao who helps her in her slimming journey. In the process of stumbling growth, the two reshape the warmth of life and finds romance.

After three years working as a secretary, Lin Han decides to resign and start a new life. His boss, the poised CEO Qin Mei Li, tries her best to make him stay, but he’s determined to move on. As they prepare to say goodbye, both realize how much they’ve come to mean to each other. 

~~ Adapted from the web novel "What's up Ms. Kim?" (김 비서가 왜 그럴까) by Jeong Gyeong Yun (정경윤).

Gu Nian, exhausted by marriage, gets a chance to rewrite her past through a high-tech life reboot. Determined to change her love-obsessed ways, she’s shocked to wake up in the body of a stranger—a man. Facing her younger self from seven years ago, Gu Nian must navigate life in her new form and guide her past self through a series of life-changing decisions.

During a mission, Gu Yan Luo accidentally rescues the pursued Qin Wu Wang. Qin Wu Wang, who has always shied away from women, develops an interest in her. For the first time, these two people, who never knew love, experience what it truly is and learn how to love. Hunted by both the Qin family and the organization, the two stand together, fearless of life and death, their eyes fixed on each other.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zai Bing Jiao Da Lao De Huai Li Si Yi Sa Ye" (在病娇大佬的怀里肆意撒野) by Su Man Shu (苏蔓殊).

An MP3 from the past allowed the almost 30-year-old star Zhao Man Er to communicate with her 11-year-old self through recordings. When she thought she could finally use this to change her current bad life and get rid of her dark past that she is being threatened by now, she did not expect to cause her past and present self to sink into a bigger crisis...

Lu Ran is a trainee in an entertainment company who wants to be an actor. He deliberately failed in the company's group assessment. However, the pheromones he inadvertently emitted made the female boss, Mai Xiao Mai, fall into a coma, relieving her long-standing insomnia. Mai Xiao Mai was determined to keep Lu Ran by her side, so she started chasing each other in her love life.

Focusing on judicial protection of minors, it tells the story of the founding of the juvenile prosecution team, prosecutor Lin Zhi Tao and assistant prosecutor Bai En Yu, who join hands to fight against the evil of human nature for the sake of children. It starts with suspense and ends with redemption; clearing away confusion, the mountains stop, and the rivers flow.

During the Republic of China, Feng Xiao, the adopted son of a wealthy businessman, and Lin Wan Xiu, the adopted daughter of a warlord, were married. But were assassins with hidden agendas. The two need to trust in love and resolve their misunderstandings and join forces to smash a conspiracy to sell national treasures.

During the war-torn era of the Republic of China, the city of Ning was plunged into turmoil. Lu Ye, the young chief of the Qingtian Gang, returned from studying abroad to discover that police chief Shen Tian Bai had killed his father. Concealing his anger, Lu Ye spent a long time interacting with and testing the down-and-out, amnesiac Shen Tian Bai, unaware that Tian Bai was actually a lone hero working undercover within the ruthless Shisha Gang. Once sworn enemies, the two gradually developed an inseparable bond as they unraveled hidden clues amid gang conflicts and police corruption.
She used her madness to roll up the huge waves of the deep palace and make this evil dynasty dark tide surge!

Qin Si Yuan, an immortal shopkeeper of "Wu Wang Zhai," spends her days guiding souls to the afterlife, lighting lanterns to fulfill their last wishes. Bound by her past sins, she cannot end her own life. When Shen Zheng stumbles into her shop, an unusual event reveals that he is the key to ending her eternal wait. However, Qin Si Yuan learns that Shen Zheng's life will end before he turns twenty, and she decides to extend his life, hoping to fulfill both their destinies.

At both ends of the Milky Way are two rulers obsessed with the life and death of all things. One day, the two rulers started a gamble using one's feelings as a medium and one's life as the wager. Using the Beidou Black Pearl to descend to the world of mortals, they experienced three generations of love tribulations.

A group of boys and girls, who have undergone rigorous choices, have entered a flight school preparatory class that is different from their peers. On the basis of excellent completion of the study of the culture class, it has experienced the rough and tempered and bears the responsibility and pressure that the peers can not perceive. Start with the basics of flying and study the knowledge and skills of flying. After completing the physical experience, they also completed the reshaping of the soul, enhanced the awareness of national defence and the belief in resolutely defending the airspace of the motherland.

In a picturesque town, the Li family and the Xiong family who are very close neighbors gave birth on the same day. Xiong Qi Wi's first words were not "mom" or dad" but her dad's catchphrase of "Something bad has happened." As the two kids grow up, their personalities develop. Xiong Qi Qi is a huge slacker who's happy to achieve nothing in life while Li Yi He is a strict and disciplined perfectionist.

Such an outstanding Li Yi He has always cared for and protected Xiong Qi Qi from elementary to middle school, from high school to university. As the two of them venture out into the big city, they inevitably face roadblocks. Reality leaves Xiong Qi Qi battered and beaten. Li Yi He resorts to unique methods to spur her fighting spirit. Xiong Qi Qi's family and Li Yi He's unyielding companionship allows Qi Qi to learn how to bravely face the unknown and to appreciate small fortunes.
dramas.t: Hey, Your Big Business Is Wonderful

dramas.syn:
Ambitious fashion magazine editor Xia An Ran teams up with enigmatic dessert chef Lin Hao to create a new column. As their partnership deepens, romantic tensions and professional rivalries test their bond. Together, they navigate the challenges of love and ambition in a world of high stakes and hidden truths.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Bu Ke Ai De Ta" (不可爱的她) by zero.

Jiang Yi Yi is a graduate student majoring in artificial intelligence. Ever since her twin sister passed away, she has been carrying a sense of guilt and has been determined to develop an AI that can "resurrect" her sister. This led her to be enter the world  OG  "Al Guru", Gu Yu.

Gu Yu, although hailed as a master in the field of AI, has a little-known mental illness. He has been searching for his childhood "Green Plum" to cure his illness, but by coincidence, he found Yi Yi, the older sister of his "Green Plum".

These two "romantic fools" who should not have fallen in love gradually grew closer to each other during their joint research project, as their values aligned. As they helped each other solve problems, the seeds of love began to sprout.

In the early 1980s, Pingchuan County decided to set up "Yuehai Town" in order to accelerate development. Li Qiu Ping and Zheng De Cheng, two cadres with outstanding abilities and personalities, adhered to the concept of "the people's city is built by the people", and with the help of the reform and opening-up policy and the Central Document No. 1, they found a way to reform and led thousands of farmers to build a modern city on the tidal flats through the "fund-raising and partnership" initiative without using a penny from the state. 

This is a miracle of city building from scratch, and it is also a feat in the history of city building in China. The fate of hundreds of thousands of farmers has been changed. Li Qiu Ping, Zheng De Cheng, Jie Chun Lai, Gao Xue Mei and other city builders dared to think, act and be the first, and wrote a magnificent chapter in the sunny 1980s.

~~ Adapted…

Zuo Zai Jun and Zheng Lei were university classmates and best friends, who have an 8-year-old step-daughter called Miao Miao. Miao Miao’s mother, Ning Xiao Meng, was Zai Jun and Zheng Lei’s dream girl during their university days. 8 years ago, she left to study in America and was never heard from again. 8 years later, Xiao Meng returns to Shanghai. Zai Jun cannot accept her so she attempts to mend their relationship. When she succeeds, Xiao Meng becomes very close to Zheng Lei, ruining the friendship between the men as they become love rivals creating comedic situations. Little by little, Xiao Meng’s secret about Miao Miao’s birth and her disappearance is unraveled.

In the beautiful years of youth, two pairs of familiar friends, Fang Yi Le and childhood friend He Tian Tian, and Xie Chi and same table Xing Jia Liang, because of accidental ignorance and adding a little courage and oolong, were dragged by fate to become an important part of the other's life. Several people encouraged each other and appreciated each other. In the exquisite, warm and interesting stories that happened one after another, they spent a fulfilling and lovely high school era and joined hands towards an unknown but hopeful and challenging tomorrow.

About a group of friends who were born in the early 90s, and later focuses on their career in the automobile industry.

When Chen Yi Duo was nine, a young boy named Bi Lai Fu suddenly appeared in her home for a short stay. The two initially did get along, competing on everything at home and in school. At the same time, Lai Fu befriends a group of loyal friends, but their playful and chaotic nature worries the adults. With the upcoming high school examinations, the youths each pursue their onward journey. Lai Fu and Yi Duo also faces the problem of work, love and life.

As the year 1998 arrives, the automobile industry also undergoes a rapid development and change. The old bicycles are no longer in trend, and continue to see a decline in business and sales. In order to preserve their generation's memory, Lai Fu decided to rent an assembly workshop, and think of new ways to innovate and…

Smart, humorous and tenacious, 25-year-old Qiu Yu is adept at working and is the right-hand secretary of CEO Ji Xiang Dong. Faced with the constant challenges of old love and family interference, Ji Xiang Dong's feelings beneath his cold exterior gradually emerge. Secretary Qiu bravely chooses her own happiness in the whirlpool of work and love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Qiu Mi Shu De Hun Shi" (邱秘书的婚事) by Shui Bu Liu Hen (水不留痕).

During the primordial chaos, the Three Realms were formed; for a thousand years, demons and humans coexisted. The White Snake demon named Xiao Bai saves the world against Heaven’s Will, then reincarnates as Linghu Yu, the daughter of the righteous demon hunter Linghu Chu Qiu. While the War God Yang Yi Zhan falls into the mortal realm, becoming a demon hunter himself, he faces new challenges and is conflicted by human emotions in serving justice. 

Reincarnation brings them together again, forming an alliance and embarking on a series of detective adventures in the human world as their nemesis reunites. Amidst the battles to eliminate evil across the land, karma becomes a calamity.

Gao Feng, a retired tycoon disguised as a delivery man, is hired by CEO Su Qing Yan to be her fake husband, unaware he’s the real boss she wants to impersonate. As they enter a contract marriage, their hidden identities and growing feelings complicate everything.

Yu Zhen Xin is a robot, secretly and specially designed in specialising in serving the needs of slightly older unmarried women, intern doctor Lin Meng Nan accidentally chanced upon and is being served by Yu Zhen Xin, who treats her especially well, making Meng Nan feel pampered and in bliss.

A bizarre case similar to that from ten years ago involves the Jizhong (Abnormalities)—individuals who develop supernatural powers after a meteor fall. Chong Ming Wei, a special force created to deal with these people, investigates the case. As a result, three young heroes who are either compelled by ideals, identity or curiosity become embroiled in the mystery.

Xu He Qiao, a humble pleasure house waiter, is recruited on personal recommendation from the King. Duan Rong is the cute at times and serious at times martial arts heroine. Duan Jin is a coroner who indulges in his life's work. For their own reasons, they must face off against the series of supernatural occurrences that take place amidst a huge conspiracy.

Arrogant and domineering, Gu Lin Xing, and Chen Si Nan, a resilient and kind university assistant professor, met unexpectedly when Gu Lin Xing was forced to sign a co-housing agreement. Soon, those two start a sweet cohabitation life, but family disputes, gossips and money temptations, makes it a lot harder to continue living together. What will Gu Lin Xing and Chen Si Nan choose? ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhao Zhao" (朝朝) by AQ (阿Q).

Xie Quan Jia, a farm girl from a small town who came to Changle City in search of her father, overnight becomes the heiress of the local magnate, Li Tian Di. However, she soon discovers that instead of inheriting vast fortunes, she has been left with massive debts.

At her wit's end, several individuals meet at the Li residence: the noble young creditor Shangguan Gu Chuan, the scholar Fan Zhong Ju, who's in the capital to take the imperial exams and looking for accommodation, and the young man Liu Lang who comes to repay his debt of gratitude to Li Tian Di. With her father gone and the debts outstanding, Xie Quan Jia, while dealing with the pressing creditor, decides to let these men settle in the mansion and rent empty rooms to a princess from the Western Regions and her servant fleeing from an arranged marriage, along with Guo Dong Li, a restaurant manager, to alleviate the debt…

Chen Si is a righteous detective who got partnered up with Yuan Bu Jie, a dream reader with unrivaled interpreting skills as well as a dark past. They work together to find the truth behind a series of serial murders.

A modern financial prodigy, Li Qing Qing, is suddenly transported back to ancient times, where she becomes the wife of General Pan Yang. Hoping for a quiet and peaceful life, she is blindsided three years later when her husband returns home with his mistress, Li Mu Yan. At the same time, a long-hidden family secret comes to light, revealing that Li Mu Yan is the true daughter of the Li family. 

Faced with betrayal on every side, Li Qing Qing remains calm. Secretly controlling the empire's most powerful intelligence and business network, Wangshi Tower, she deftly resolves the chaos within the household while matching wits with the ruthless Crown Prince. Armed with her modern financial expertise, she reshapes the ancient business world, overcoming one challenge after another with intelligence and wit. Through every scheme and upheaval, she carves out her own extraordinary path to power…

In the 1990s, as China continues to embrace—and grapple with—the global market economy, Qiu Shui and his friends attend med school, an ambition that has more to do with getting out of the country than with actually becoming doctors. Following the exploits of a young student and his classmates, from drinking binges, sex, and playing video games all night to military training, homework, and college-age high jinks, Beijing, Beijing provides an inventive, hilarious, and incisive look into how a culture—and one man—struggle to reconcile their past with the changes brought by modern times. As the years pass and friends, family, and lovers move on, Qiu Shui confronts the loneliness and confusion that define his generation.
dramas.t: Ten Miles of Spring Wind Can't Compare to You

dramas.syn: Lan Ruo Xi travels to another state to prevent war in Dong Li. She saves Prince Rebu Feng Yao and slowly gains the trust of his elder brother, Prince Rebu Ha Di.

It follows the everyday life of Qi Miao, a 30-year-old media company employee with beauty and confidence, and Zhou Ye, president of a finance company who is handsome, sweet, and gentle. Their paths cross during a chance encounter with a bully and later, due to coincidental work-related meetings that eventually blossom into a sweet romance.

Their journey starts with a hiccup as Zhou Ye has to stand Qi Miao up on their first appointment due to urgent work. However, on their second meeting, they discuss work matters and later share a delightful dinner, laying the foundation for their growing fondness.

The show explores the nuances of Qi Miao's friendship with Fang Luo Luo and Qi Miao's relationship with her mother. Amidst the romance, the show also captures the beauty of ordinary everyday joys and nuisances.

It tells the story of the talented painter and embroidery master Han Ximeng, who grew from a girl who was inexperienced in the world to a generation of female craftsmen.

The female members of the Gu family are good at embroidery, with Miao Ruiyun's skills being the highest, and Gu embroidery has become famous. Gu Mingshi admired Miao's embroidery, and Gu Huihai tried to get Miao to take over the Gu family embroidery workshop and then Luxiang Garden. However, Gu Mingshi preferred his second grandson Gu Shouqian. When he was young, Gu Shouqian studied under Dong Qichang and learned his true story. Dong Qichang founded Danfeng Painting Garden, and Gu Shouqian temporarily took over as his successor.

Han Ximeng stood out in the painter examination. She has lofty ambitions and is determined to become a female master who teaches and teaches.  Seeing that Han Ximeng was very accomplished in…
dramas.t: Lu Xiang Yuan Han Yuan Chuan

dramas.syn: A lighthearted drama about the odd friendship between a study slacker and a straight-A student.

She was adopted as a toy - a distraction for the rich heir - but as they matured, their feelings turned to passion. Her passion and possessiveness added to her mental issues. His passion interfered with the future his father had carefully crafted for him.

At the end of the Qing Dynasty and the beginning of the Republic of China, the wealthy Lin family is destroyed overnight. The only surviving daughter, Lin Meng Chen, is sold to the wicked wealthy Huang family to marry their deceased son in a ghost wedding. Just as Meng Chen is about to be buried alive, Xiao Sheng, the Blood Sacrifice Hall’s top assassin who has been tasked to wipe out the Huang family, accidentally comes to her rescue.

Witnessing the entire process of Xiao Sheng killing someone, not only does Meng Chen show no fear, but she also regards the man on the mission as her benefactor. Xiao Sheng then decides to keep Meng Chen by his side. They address each other as brother and sister, with Xiao Sheng vowing to protect Meng Chen for the rest of his life. 

Ten years have passed in the blink of an eye. In order to let his "sister" grow up in a good environment, Xiao Sheng has…

Si Yi Chen, son of King Zi Shang, loses his entire family in a massacre on his wedding day. To seek revenge, he assumes the identity of Mu Han and gains the trust of the Eldest Princess. Meanwhile, his fiancée, Hang An Ning, believing him to be dead, infiltrates the palace by swapping faces with the princess. Under the same roof, their hidden identities lead to unexpected emotions, and love and vengeance become inseparable.

An inhabitant of Meow Planet meets a handsome cat lover and gets into a series of romantic and crisis-ridden situations in her quest to obtain true love's kiss.

Song Zi, who hails from Meow Planet, has returned to Earth in order to repay the person who saved her life many years ago. Furthermore, she has to seal the deal with true love's kiss within one year! She takes the identity of a proud female star and begins a cross-planet romance with Lu Wu.

~~ Adapted from the novel "San Jie Song Zi Shi Wu Suo"  (三界送子事务所) by Gu Meng.

While working overtime, Fang Xi Mu, a programmer for the romance game "Secret Relations," accidentally gets into the game as an NPC who could be logged off at any moment. To save her life, she must first win over the male lead of the game, Bai Hao Tian, by completing the main romance quests. Fang Xi Mu, who is an expert in love but remains a lifelong single, is up against the so-called "ultimate dream guy" of every girl, the very charming CEO. Who will outmaneuver with their tactics? Hard mode is activated, and the only rule for survival is clear — only by "stealing hearts" can one stay alive. It's time to show some real skills...

Set at the dawn of the 21st century amidst China's economic boom. Due to his brother's death, rural youth Lu Yun Xiang is forced to drop out of school to take over Xuntong Express, his brother's company. The private delivery firm struggles against the state-owned "Postal Service" and internal conflicts.

Faced with fierce competition and outdated methods, Lu Yun Xiang recognized that the economic boom and the rise of e-commerce demanded transformation. He expanded his vision, recruiting talent and focusing on technological development. He replaced the failing "family business philosophy" with modern management, culminating in a bold "share swap" to repurchase franchised locations. This drastic move from a decentralized "franchise system" to a centralized "direct operation system" laid the foundation for Xuntong's rebirth.

Wen Jing attends a high-school gathering and finds out that her ex-boyfriend Du Xiao Feng's first love is not her but her best friend Su Su, and that Meng Fan, who used to crush on Su Su, is dead. Wen Jing then helps Su Su collect Meng Fan's magazine publications. As she starts to gather the items, she discovers lost memories and a secret that nobody knows.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chu Lian Ai" (初恋爱) by Jiu Ye Hui (九夜茴).

In order to treat her sister's illness, Xu Yan Qing sold her virginity at a high price and committed herself to a strange man, Yu Zhi. A year later, she met Yu Zhi again at a party with her pursuer Song Jin's friends. He recognized her and pushed her against the wall. Xu Yan Qing fled in panic and returned to the box, but Song Jin told her that only Yu Zhi had the medicine that could save her sister. She lowered her status and begged for medicine, but Yu Zhi made things difficult for her and was determined to pull her back to the madness of the night she fell.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Yu Da Lao Ta Lun Xian Len" (禁欲大佬他沦陷了) by Gu Xiao Yi (顾小易).
dramas.t: Celibate Big Shot Falls in Love

dramas.syn:
As the puppet heir of the Fu family, sculptor A Che, disguised as a docile man, maneuvered between his "control freak" brother Fu Wen Shu and the venture capital queen Su Man Yue. Fu Wen Shu was adopted by the Fu family at a young age and became A Che's "x-bag", controlling the Fu family with a twisted emotional connection of abuse and protection. 

A Che took advantage of Su Man Yue's investigation into the unusual movement of Fu's stock to make his move, using a sense of brokenness to stimulate her desire to conquer. But he got into a car accident and lost his memory. In the confusion of memories, he regained his childhood bond with Fu Wen Shu.

Disillusioned by Empress Wu’s actions, detective Di Renjie leaves the capital to investigate strange occurrences in Jiangnan. Beneath the empire’s prosperity, he uncovers dark forces and dangerous conspiracies. Using his sharp intellect, Di Ren Jie must solve mysterious cases where the supernatural and human corruption intertwine.

Yuan Chu Yu coincidentally encounters Liang Ze, the senior she had secretly admired. The two of them start a passionate and intense love affair. However, just when their love reaches its peak, Liang Ze leaves without saying a word. Many years later, they meet again, but this time Liang Ze has changed his name to Bai Ze and transformed into a mature man who is steady and aloof. As the mysteries gradually unfold, their relationship once again sparks and collides in a push-and-pull manner. Suddenly, a woman named Su Qing intrudes…

In her previous life, Shi Xing followed her family’s arrangement and got engaged to He Sheng, only to suffer his betrayal and cruelty, ending in mutual destruction with Qi Chen Yan.

After being reborn, Shi Xing bravely pursues Qi Chen Yan, and the two begin a sweet romance. The story unfolds around their emotional journey, gradually revealing the truth of their past lives, and ultimately, the two attain a happy ending together.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chong Sheng Tian Feng Le, Gou Jing Quan Tai Zi Ye Hong Tan Re Wen" (重生甜疯了，勾京圈太子红毯热吻) by Zhang Xin You Ke Tang (掌心有颗糖).

Twins Xu Zhi Xin and Xu Xia Wei are identical in every way except for their personalities. Xu Zhi Xin is obedient and intelligently capable while Xu Xia Wei is mischievous and rebellious.  Lin Zheng is Xu Xia Wei's first love; they fell in love at first sight upon meeting each other one day in high school. Their youthful and innocent love story comes to an end when Xu Zhi Xin dies and Xu Xia Wei is compelled by their mother to abandon her dreams, her identity, her entire life, to live instead as  Xu Zhi Xin. By the time the former lovers reunite Xu Xia Wei has become the successful but notorious lawyer "Xu Zhi Xin". But as they rekindle their old love Lin Zheng begins to realize that the person in front of him is not the real Xu Xia Wei.

Tells the sweet love story of Lv You, president of Biotech Company, and Lu Pan Pan, a talented track and field athlete, who meet each other due to a "memory retrieval experiment" and gradually fall in love.

The Cangyun Goddess Jiang Zhi Yu and the young tanuki from the Li clan, Jiang Jing Huai, fell in love after getting to know each other. However, due to their difference in social status, their relationship was opposed by Nan Gong Xiao, the leader of the Cangyun clan. He set a trap to turn their love into hatred. Yet, as the two continued to be entangled with each other, they gradually uncovered the truth.

It tells the story of a frustrated modern man named Wang Heng who accidentally came to the Western Han Dynasty and met a female knight named De Jiu, who looked like his ex-girlfriend in real life. With the memory of reality, Wang Heng met the cheerful prince Liu He. The two became close friends after going through misunderstandings and challenges. He and De Jiu became colleagues. They tried to challenge history and change their fate but fell into the abyss because of their own obsession and cowardice. Brothers in distress faced their own failures and grew together. People who fought side by side healed each other.

Over a decade ago, a treasure map led to the destruction of the Li family, which was once powerful officials of the previous dynasty. Years later, the sole survivor, Li Yun Zhi, returns with a heart full of vengeance. Disrupting the arranged marriage of the Ye family, Li Yun Zhi collaborates with Princess Ye Ling Yue to carefully plot a scheme, positioning herself by the side of the ailing Crown Prince Song Chen, waiting for the perfect moment to strike back. 

As she endures several tests, Li Yun Zhi gradually realizes that the prince seems like someone from her childhood… A forbidden love blooms amid hidden emotions and newfound desires, blending torment with unexpected tenderness. Ye Ling Yue and Li Yun Zhi, once enemies and now reluctant allies, grow closer as they face countless challenges together. But as the downfall of the Ye and Wan families unfolds, the secrets of the treasure…

In the Nine Underworlds, where the heavens, the demon realm, and the mortal world intersect, souls strive for reincarnation, guided by their cultivation. Young rebel Tong Feng is accompanied by Xuan Pei, the Lord of the Nine Underworlds, as they journey through ancient times, the Republic Era, and the modern world, forging a remarkable love story. Along the way, Tong Feng soon discovers that beneath the peaceful facade of the Nine Underworlds, dark forces are stirring.

Reborn with the memories of her previous life, Princess Xie Yu Zhang of Baohua is determined to avoid the tragic fate that once awaited her. When her kingdom faces a political crisis, she once again accepts a marriage alliance with the northern frontier, but this time, she is resolved to take control of her own destiny.

Relying on her intelligence, courage, and foresight, Xie Yu Zhang navigates court intrigue, political rivalries, and the challenges of an unfamiliar land. As she strives to protect those around her and reshape the future, she discovers that changing fate is far more difficult than she ever imagined.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gong Zhu Gui Lai" (公主归来) by Xiu Ce (袖侧).

Chen Ru Yan is a successful screenwriter, she is the daughter of Chen Group's president. Because her father's company had to get through the verge of bankruptcy, she is forced to marry the president of Zhou group, Zhou Mu Han. During their forced marriage, the two begin to slowly understand each other and gradually fall in love.
dramas.t: The Darkness Is No Darkness with Thee

dramas.syn: Ruan Meng is admitted to the city’s best high school, but on her first day, she keeps getting into trouble, misunderstanding, for example, room number "601" for "109". During the first class meeting, as the students are introducing themselves, the homeroom teacher asks Xue Song what his first impression of Ruan Meng is. He utters the words: "cannot look straight at her", which angers Ruan Meng, who swears: "One day, I want you to be unable to ignore me!".

In year 3018 on a parallel earth, the creatures from the Classic of Mountains and Seas are living among the humans. They have evolved with the humans while secretly preying on them. Three friends from different species, who believe that humans and monsters can live together in harmony, are doing what they could to keep the peace between the two sides. 

~~ Adapted from the novel "Du Shi Yao Qi Tan" (都市妖奇谈) by Ke Rui (可蕊).

dramas.nt: 古董局中局之掠宝清单
dramas.syn:
An evil conspiracy has swept the capital in the year 1928. The chief of police has used his birthday celebration as an excuse to imprison notable people in the antique industry. At the critical moment when the Five Meridians are caught in a dangerous situation, Xu Yi Cheng manages to save the day. A new wave rises before the first wave subsides. Xu Yi Cheng's good friend Chen Wei Li sent him a note with the faintly visible marks of "wind" and "earth" before his tragic death.

Upon launching his investigation, Xu Yi Cheng is surprised to learn that the Japanese are involved. Yu Fang, a beili of the Qing Dynasty, reveals that the tomb of Imperial Noble Consort Shushen has been robbed. Xu Yi Cheng was commissioned to resolve the crisis at the Eastern Mausoleum. In order to prevent the looting of national treasures and to find the truth behind his friend's death, Xu Yi Cheng gets help from…

The story takes place in two parallel universes named Yuan and Yi, where people share the same life and death. Nian Yang Xiao came from the Yuan World to save his true love, Kong Ling Hui and crossed the border to the Yi World in search of the killer who assassinated his love. In the Yi World, however, he and Kong Ling Hui were enemies. Kong Ling Hui tried everything to kill him.

At the same time, the mysterious girl Yong Er, the romantic street gangster, the cold-faced police officer Nuo Dun and others appeared one after another, each accompanied by a complex case. The involvement of Nian Yang Xiao made the cases more complicated and confusing.

~~ Adapted from the donghua "Hua Jiang Hu Zhi Huan Shi Men Sheng" (画江湖之换世门生) by Beijing Ruosen Digital Technology Co., Ltd. (北京若森数字科技有限公司).
dramas.t: A Portrait of Jianghu: Reincarnated Disciple

dramas.syn: Ye Xiao Ai, who aspires to become a designer, becomes friends by chance with Zhuang Li Li, a model who is trying to escape an abusive marriage. Xiao Ai helps Li Li stand up to her husband, Li Jin, while Li Li helps Xiao Ai resolve the emotional knot between herself and her “uncle,” Lin Sen. Through mutual support and conflict, the two pursue their respective dreams and step into new stages of their lives.
Detailing the love story between Yun Chen, the daughter of a traitor, and the Minister of Qingliu, Yan Xuan Yue.

In the coastal city of Kungang in the 1990s, a young auto repair genius named Tang Shi goes undercover in a smuggling organization to clear his father's name and joins hands with the mischievous girl Ye Ling to help the police crack a major smuggling case.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Yin Qing (隐擎) by Chang Shu Xin (常书欣).

The story started in 1937 when the war against Japanese aggression broke out. It revolves around Zhang Han Shi / Zhang Song Ling, who is a simple man born into a family of scholars. On the eve of his wedding, his wife and family were murdered, but he survived. He then embarked on his quest for revenge, joining the communist party and the mounting anti-Japanese resistance.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Farewell to Arms" (烽烟尽处) by Jiu Tu.

After a mysterious fall, modern girl Song Zhi Yun awakens in the Song Dynasty as famed courtesan Liu Ru Yan. While secretly investigating the disappearance of several courtesans at Huanyue House, she teams up with a cunning young nobleman to uncover a dangerous conspiracy.

~~ Adapted from the script "Zhen Hong Zhuang" (枕红妆) on Migu Reading (咪咕阅读).

A series of bizarre cases have re-emerged overseas. With Tang Ren's senior disciple Lin Mo, the genius hacker Kiko, and many new detectives and characters making their appearances one after another! In the pursuit of truth, the veteran detectives once again gather to stir up the storm in Chinatown! The suspenseful story combines a humorous style with profound meaning, presenting a new wave of detective works.

The martial arts heroine, Wang Rui Qiu, mistakenly entered the royal palace and replaced the bride, disrupting the cunning prince's wedding and his meticulously planned thief-catching scheme. Unable to escape, Wang Rui Qiu had no choice but to pretend to be the princess and cooperate with the prince. Through a series of intellectual battles, they eventually developed feelings for each other and joined forces to uncover and foil the sinister plots and schemes.
dramas.t: I Don’t Want to Be a Queen

dramas.syn:
Jian Hong Cheng, the son of the Director of Linshui No.2 Agricultural Machinery Factory, falls in love at first sight with his university classmate Ning Yu. However, he was constantly rejected and only gave up on her when she graduated and got married. His father, Jian Zhi Guo, was injured by his employee Cui Hao, and his health deteriorated, thus passing on the factory to him.

In order to secure his son's contracting rights in the factory, Jian Zhi Guo also forces his daughter Jian Min Min to marry his disciple Zhang Li Xin, who temporarily took over as the head of the factory. However, Zhang Li Xin secretly fights for authority. After Jian Zhi Guo passed away, Jian Hong Cheng left his village. 

Many years later, Yu Ning was betrayed by her husband and got a divorce. Jian Hong Cheng discovers that Zhang Li Xin wants to sell the factory to pay his debts. Not willing to let his…

Qin Chuan and Xie Qiao grew up in the same compound. They have been bickering with each other for ages. Qin Chuan is simple and does not mince words but he always stands by Xie Qiao and will always be her most important friend. No matter where life leads them, they will come together. Theirs is a story about a group of young people seeking their dreams and striving to grasp the opportunities of the times.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Once Young" (曾少年) by Jiu Ye Hui (九夜茴).
dramas.t: Once and Forever: The Sun Rises

dramas.syn:
The story of Wei Xiao Bao, a little man born at the bottom of society. He entered the imperial palace by chance without knowing any martial arts and used his extraordinary wisdom to deal with gangs and court issues. He pretended to be a eunuch to help Kangxi capture and kill Obai. Then he met Chen Jin Nan, who became his closest disciple. He assisted Kangxi in attacking his enemies. 

Wei Xiao Bao grew up as a gangster who only wanted to make friends with the emperor in exchange for a rich and noble life and grew up into a "deer prince" who discerns loyalty and evil. He meets many different women and lives a flowery family life full of fireworks.

~~ Adapted from the novel "The Deer and the Cauldron" (鹿鼎記) by Jin Yong (金庸).

Yi Zi Mo has always grown up under the control of his parents until he met Wu Xiu in Fu'an. He chooses to resist his parents, changes his name to Ren Zhan, goes abroad for further studies and becomes a photographer.
