After returning to China in 2021, Ren Zhan came to Fu'an again due to work needs. On a meteor shower night that only happens once in ten years, he picked up a mobile phone that Wu Xiu had once used. Through this phone, he can communicate with Wu Xiu from ten years ago. The emotions between Wu Xiu and Yi Zi Mo from ten years ago suffered severe damage.

In 2021, Ren Zhan appears, taking care of Wu Xiu to help her recover her memories and trying to mend the love that was missed a decade ago. Thus begins a displaced love story across time and space.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zong Ran Ai Ni You Shi Cha" (纵然爱你有时差) by Ye Nv San Geng (夜女三更).

Pan Yan is a trainee lawyer at Rongke Law Firm. He and Shu Yinan, Zuo Na, and Zhu Xin Xin, who entered Rongke's internship at the same time, encountered confusion when they first entered the workplace. During the internship, they are exposed to various types of litigation commissions.

As trainee lawyers, they can neither undertake the litigation entrusted by the client nor determine the direction and strategy of the litigation, but they all hold the original intention of respecting the law and conscientiously prepare materials and make suggestions for each litigation.

Growing pains are not only in the workplace but also in the family. How to handle the relationship with their parents is also exhausting. In the end, under the guidance and help of Lan Hong and Du Fei Yu, senior partners of the law firm, and after frank communication with their parents, they all grew up.

dramas.nt: 傅先生别追了，大小姐是假的
dramas.syn:
Fu Jing Yan rescues a girl who eerily resembles his sister. Unfortunately, she appears to be mentally challenged. Nonetheless, he is determined to use her to thwart his bastard half-brother and his father while taking emotional solace in her resemblance to his beloved sister.

Meanwhile, Si Nian hides behind the roles she is playing for him and his family and takes the opportunity to get revenge on the prominent family that abused and then casually discarded her.  But when she is found out, their relationship becomes more entangled, not less.

Chu Zi Qian, a General's daughter, was supposed to marry her childhood sweetheart, the Seventh Prince, Zhao Qing. When she suddenly dies, the Emperor issues a decree for the Seventh Prince to immediately marry Lin Yan, a minister's daughter. Inexplicably, Zi Qian wakes up inside the body of Lin Yan, who's in a bridal sedan headed to her wedding. On the way, they see a funeral being held for Zi Qian's real body. 

The last thing Zi Qian remembers is fainting after drinking a cup of tea poured for her by the Seventh Prince. Convinced that the Seventh Prince poisoned her to death, Zi Qian firmly resolves to take revenge on him while inside his new wife's body. Little does she know that everything is not as it seems.

The noble-born yet impoverished thief Xie Tian Xing never imagined that accepting one mission would completely upend his identity in the most shocking way! Due to his uncanny resemblance to his target, Lu Chen, Xie Tian Xing transforms overnight from a down-and-out thief to a wealthy merchant basking in luxury and opulence. However, beneath the seemingly perfect facade lies a web of deadly intrigue, and everyone around him appears to have two faces.
dramas.t: May Your Heart Be Like Mine

dramas.syn:
The series tells the love story of a rich man meeting a poor girl. He is the general manager of a premier jeweller who discovers the heroine's talent for design and hires her as an employee. She brings along her baggage as a breadwinner who has to support everyone in her family including her boyfriend. 

~~ Adapted from the novel by Du Mu Zhou.

The story of civil aviation captain Li Fu Zheng and air traffic controller Meng Li Yue who got married first and then fell in love. The secret love in the school days finally came true.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ji Zhang Xian Sheng, Lei Yu Qing Rao Fei" (机长先生，雷雨请绕飞) by Zhao Le (昭乐).
dramas.t: San Wan Ying Chi De An Lian

dramas.syn:
Han Qing, a female police officer who is part of the Criminal Investigation Team, is a hard-working woman who only cares about her work. She has had a good working relationship with her partner, Zhong Wei, for many years. However, two months ago, Zhong Wei disappeared after following a suspect. Ever since Han Qing has been looking for any clues as to what has happened to him.

During the investigation of a new case, Han Qing stumbles upon a connection to Zhong Wei's disappearance and gets pulled into a network of organized crime.

Singer Jin Xi’s foray into acting was a disaster, drawing widespread ridicule for his abysmal performance. Refusing to admit defeat, he charted a new course by trying his hand at musical theater, determined to stage a comeback and prove his detractors wrong. By a twist of fate, he fell for Ning Jin—a cool, uncompromising, and elite musical theater director—after an accidental, intimate kiss; their paths crossed again shortly after at an audition. Ning Jin, already skeptical of idols crossing over into theater, was incredibly harsh toward Jin Xi—a "traffic-driving" newcomer who had seemingly parachuted into the production—subjecting him to a relentless gauntlet of grueling, "devilish" training. 

Braving ostracism from senior troupe members, sabotage by rivals, and public scrutiny, Jin Xi practiced day and night to hone his craft. He gradually shed his idol persona to reveal his…

Shen Wan Qing, condemned as "impure" after spending four years in prison, was ruthlessly hunted down by the Liu family for the sake of their reputation. After being reborn with a new face as the merchant's daughter Lan Meng Yan, she marries into the Liu household to exact her revenge, using herself as bait to capture the hearts of both father and son. To make the Lius pay, Lan Meng Yan deliberately walks into danger, until Qin Mo Xiu, who has been secretly watching over her, can no longer sit idly by...

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Du Fei Liao Ren: Jin Yu Leng Wang Chong Shang Shen" (毒妃撩人：禁欲冷王宠上身) by Ka Fei Xiao Tuan (咖啡小团).

The heir of the Jiang Group, Jiang Mu Chen, is forced to marry Xia Yu, the granddaughter of his grandfather’s comrade.

When Jiang Mu Chen sees Xia Yu, a village girl, he can hardly believe that this is the arranged marriage set up by his grandfather.

Ni Wu takes her daughter to the hospital, only to discover that the attending doctor is her ex-boyfriend Pei Huai Yu, from whom she broke up seven years ago. Pei Huai Yu does not recognize her and is unaware that she secretly gave birth to his daughter. This unexpected reunion brings back painful memories for Ni Wu, while fate continues to intertwine their lives. Pei Huai Yu’s heart recognizes her before his mind does.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wu Se Mi Mi" (雾色靡靡), also known as "Bie Hou Chong Feng, Pei Yi Sheng Zhui Qi Tao Lu Duo" (别后重逢，裴医生追妻套路多), by Chen Ruo Zhuo (陈若舟).

To save her father, young A Yuan is sold into a courtesan house and begins a life of constant change. She becomes a student in Japan, a governor’s wife, a woman brave enough to leave an unhappy marriage, and a devoted mother who raises four daughters on her own. Refusing to surrender to fate, Dong Zhu Jun navigates the power struggles of old Shanghai and rises against the tide.

~~ Based on the life of female entrepreneur Dong Zhu Jun.

A group of friends went their separate ways after graduating from college but get reunited years later in the real world. Fang Hui, Qiao Ran, Lin Jia Mo, Zhao Ye, Shen Xiao Tang and Zeng Wen Hui have all had different life experiences and have tried to pursue their dreams. But when they come back into one another’s lives, old and new conflicts emerge, and old feelings that were long forgotten come flooding back. What will become of these friends now?

Modern teen Qin Fang, born into a renowned swordsmanship family but lacking skill, is transported to the Qin Dynasty. Forced to survive in a brutal world, he embarks on a journey of growth. Along the way, he meets Meng Yu, an orphan from a rival tribe who secretly protects him and ultimately becomes his sword spirit.

A young couple’s relationship unravels after the birth of their child, leading to their eventual separation. Years later, their lives have moved forward, but the sudden onset of leukemia in their child shatters their peaceful reunion. Forced to put aside past differences, the divorced parents unite to battle fate, bringing several families together. Through their efforts to save the child, the adults also find healing, reconciling with both the past and themselves.

It tells the story of the head doctor of the emergency department He Jian Yi and the new Ph.D. advisor, who just returned from America, Jiang Xiao Qi. At first, these two are wary of each other, but they come to understand each other and rescue not only patients side by side but also themselves in the end.

The drama is set in the context of an unbroken serial murder case of a girl for many years, which tells the story of an "experimental instructor", Situ Kun, who formed a special experimental class to train a group of criminal police elites. Reasoning genius Li Jun Cheng and super-intuitive gifted girl Lin Xi, fat belly Qin Chuan, iceberg beauty Nalan Hui, intelligent  Ding Xiao Bing and others have passed the multiple rounds of assessment step by step with wisdom and superb reasoning skills, using strong convictions to overcome the dark storm and carry the justice mission, in a turbulent and turbulent case Zhong gradually grew into first-line criminal police capable and responsible.

Zhang He Nian and Qin Tang have liked each other since they were younger, but Qin Tang’s father marries Zhang He Nian’s sister, and because that makes them uncle and niece, it is impossible for them to be together. Fast forward seven years, Qin Tang comes back from becoming a doctor abroad and Zhang He Nian is at the airport waiting for her. This time, he is going to do everything in his power to make her his wife.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Cang Yu Zhou Ye" (藏于昼夜) by Lan Diao (蓝掉).

It revolves around an old case that happened in northeast China. It tells a wonderful story about the protagonists searching for clues in a blizzard, fighting wits and courage with criminals, and finally solving the case and resolving the incident, thus safeguarding justice.

The drama is about a girl, He Zhao Zhao, whose destiny was altered the moment she had a car accident. When she was in distress, she heard a very nice voice encouraging her to support herself. In order to find this voice, He Zhao Zhao searched various voice channels on the Internet, and joined the dubbing club "Sound Love Studio" by chance, and met two great god-level figures Fang Xin Chen and Su Mo Sheng. With the development of the dubbing industry, He Zhao Zhao's dream is also closely connected with everyone in the studio.

Xun Zheng and Qin Qiao Chu are opposites as one values efficiency the other hard evidence. When working on cases, they are both competitive yet can rely on each other. Defence Attorney Di Shuhan must be mindful of their methods lest the suspect's procedural rights become violated. 
Their unabating efforts to adhere to their personal convictions is the reason that the rights of all criminal litigation participants, victims and criminals alike, are protected. Prior trials have served to illustrate the complexity of human nature, leading the trio to adopt an objective interpretation of maintaining faith in the law.

Three years later, Jiang Wan Zhi and Ximen Li Chen, who had broken up, reunited in an accident! Ximen Li Chen also learned that Jiang Wan Zhi was with his nephew, and the two became uncle and nephew's fiancée! In order to save this relationship, Ximen Li Chen started to chase her like crazy. In the process of getting along, the two also revealed the reason for their breakup, fought against obstacles together, and finally successfully reunited.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jing Zhi Yu Ye" (京枝欲夜) by Tan Qing Zhu (檀青竹).

Her childhood sweetheart, Lu Jing Ran, is obsessed with the game of saving Cinderella. Shen Jin Yi decides to break up the engagement and find another man. After much deliberation, she musters up the courage to find Lu Jing Ran's eldest brother, Lu Hui Shi, the current head of the Lu Group.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Pu Xiang Mei Gui" (扑向玫瑰) by Wu Su Pao Xian Bei (乌苏泡仙贝).

The drama tells the story of the housewife Bai Ying Ying who is disheartened by her marriage life after discovering that her husband Ding Zhi Yuan cheated on her with her friend Gu Fei Er. She then finds out many unclear points connected to her sister Bai Jing Jing's suicide. While escaping from Gu Fei Er, with the help of Jiang Chuan, Jin Rui and other friends, Bai Ying Ying tries to open a new chapter in her life.

The drama on the "slow-growing" people who are currently confused and tells about the problems of work, life and emotions among young people in the context of a large society. How this group of "slow-growing" people find themselves, return to their hearts, and change their life plans are the highlights of the show, which resonate with young audiences.

In the drama, after suffering the double blow of unemployment and lovelorn, He Jia Jia, facing the harshness and control of her mother, awakened from her late adolescence, leaves the high-pressure urban life, and comes to the idyllic countryside full of natural beauty, where she encountered all kinds of people including Fang Wen Yu, a writer who is completely different from her.

The two went from misunderstanding each other to solving problems together. In the idyllic scenery and simple interpersonal care, they gradually learned to slow…

With the passing of her landlady, Shen Tong, her ever-present "grandson," enters Pei Ling Ling's life and becomes her new landlord. This brings with it a series of strange occurrences... This creates a whole new, "unspeakable" world, shattering Pei Ling Ling's illusions of a peaceful, ordinary life.

Thus, Pei Ling Ling enters Shen Tong's world. The mysterious and aloof Shen Tong, immortal for centuries, approaches Pei Lingling for ulterior motives. A mutual affection gradually develops between them. However, Shen Tong discovers that Pei Ling Ling is the host of the "Eye of Judgment," a world-destroying alien energy source. A centuries-old romance unfolds once again...

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bu Ke Ming Zhuang De Cheng Zhen" (不可名状的城镇) by Zi Qiong (子琼).

Forensic doctor Kong Qi Qi, a woman, traveled back in time and became a foster daughter of the capital's Xiangfu family. After the time travel, Kong Qi Qi lost some of her memories from before the journey. She discovered that each time she worked on a case, she could recover some of her lost memories. Kong Qi Qi then embarked on a journey of investigation. Along the way, she met the weak and fragile Ninth Prince, Mu Zhi Xi, who was dressed in white and had a striking resemblance to her ex-boyfriend. Mu Zhi Xi was also attracted to Kong Qi Qi's unique style of doing things, and the two developed feelings for each other. Kong Qi Qi learned that Mu Zhi Xi had been poisoned and suffered from after-effects due to being involved in the struggle for the throne 20 years ago. With Kong Qi Qi's help, Mu Zhi Xi gradually uncovered the mysteries of the throne struggle case.

Gu Jin Yu, the brilliant young lord of Bailong City, disguised herself as a boy since childhood due to the old lord's lack of offspring. She is ordered to infiltrate the mountain in search of a treasure map. Meanwhile, Bai Yun Xi, a naive girl from Black Tiger Stronghold, is forced to abduct a man to inherit her father's business and fulfill his dying wish. Thus, Gu Jin Yu is forcibly taken to the mountain to marry into the family. The two sign a contract to pretend to be husband and wife, thus beginning a hilarious and unexpected journey.

When war breaks out between the Su and Ning nations, the losses on both sides are great. Determined to drive their enemies to their knees, the Su advance without mercy. Ultimately, the Ning nation has no choice but to concede defeat. 

To keep the tentative peace between their nations, an alliance was struck. As part of the negotiations, Ning Princess Qian Xi was ordered to marry the son of one of the Su’s generals, Xiao Qi Feng. But on the day of their wedding, a ghost emerges, which leads to the discovery of a woman’s skeleton lying in a well. Ordered to investigate these strange events by the emperor, Qi Feng and his childhood sweetheart, Su Qing, immediately get to work. 

Following a string of clues, Qi Feng and Su Qing soon discover that there’s more to this case than the death of a single woman. Finding evidence that ties recent events into events twenty years ago, Qi Feng and Su…
dramas.t: The Bright Moon Worships Your Heart

dramas.syn: As He Si Mu mourns Duan Xu's death, a surprise changes everything.

Set in wartime China, the story follows Chen Kai Lai, an apprentice photographer who is entrusted with crucial intelligence after an underground operative is killed. Accompanied by a dancer down on her luck, Chen is drawn into the shadowy world of espionage, corruption, and political intrigue in Shanghai.

As rival factions clash and hidden agendas surface, Chen is forced to rely on his sharp perception and courage while navigating constant danger. With the guidance and protection of underground agents, he begins a transformative journey from an ordinary civilian into someone deeply entangled in the resistance, where every choice could mean survival—or sacrifice.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Xing Lai" (醒来) by Hai Fei (海飞).

Ruan Su marries CEO Bo Xing Zhi out of gratitude, but he believes she's only after his wealth and treats their marriage as a mere contract. After four years of silent endurance, Ruan Su leaves with nothing and sets out to take revenge on those who wronged her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bao Tai Tai Jin Tian You Bei Ba Ma Jia Le" (薄太太今天又被扒马甲了) by Qi Qian Wan (七千万 ).

During an undercover mission, post-90s policeman Huang Wei Ping got into an accident and fell into a coma. Twenty years later when he woke up, he still retains his youthful appearance. However, when he returned to the police team, he felt out of place and often create a joke out of himself. Together with his "old" partner Li Ming Feng, he set out to investigate the mysterious case of the past.

Demon Lord, Lin Fang Zun, annihilated the whole family of Zhao Lu on her wedding day. To save everybody, Zhao Lu went back 300 years and tried to kill Lin Fang Zun to avoid that previous tragedy. When she just arrived there, she accidentally saved Mu Ting who was held in captivity. So trying to requiting favors, Mu Ting helped Zhao Lu to find Lin Fang Zun. However, it turned out Mu Ting was that Demon Lord...

After a tragic mistake leads to the downfall of her benefactors, orphaned Su Jin Yuan returns seeking redemption. Her fate becomes entwined with Xie Yun Yuan, the adopted son of the fallen family. Together, they defy betrayal, fight to survive, and ignite a passionate, fate-defying love as they seek justice and reclaim their destiny.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhang Shang Qi Mei" (掌上齐眉) by Jin Yi (锦一).

The story is about Chinese students at the prestigious Ivy League college. The efforts they made to get accepted, when just being gifted students isn't enough; their experiences, struggles, relationships, and the blend of Chinese-Western cultures while studying there.

Gu Nian planned to study abroad because she wanted to be with her foreign boyfriend for a long time. Without any experience in studying abroad, she enrolled in a studying abroad agency, LZ, on the net but had a dispute with the company's owner, Lin Yao, and her boyfriend, Zhuo Peng. The reason was that Lin Yao took Gu Nian's order even though the company was short of staff. Zhuo Peng, who was a legal entity but did not work in the company, was forced to become Gu Nian's temporary tutor and helped her become a university student.

Shortly afterwards, Lin Yao and Zhuo Peng broke up. Zhuo Peng was hired as a psychological…

Pan, a desolate plastic surgeon, lived a repetitive and boring life every day until a conspiracy happened. He woke up in an abandoned factory,  and found that someone had replaced his identity with a face exactly like him. His world has been completely overturned and left in a perilous situation. Can he overcome the difficulties and peel away the truth? How would he regain his identity?

Divorced mom An An, in her twenties, is determined to rebuild her life and turn her dreams into reality. After her marriage ends, she faces the challenges of raising her son alone. Xu Lang, a brilliant lawyer in his thirties, becomes a single dad after a tragic car accident. His life, once solitary, is disrupted when he meets An An and her son. As their families come together, they learn to overcome misunderstandings, heal past wounds, and discover love in an unexpected but heartwarming journey.

Modern girl Gu Jin Yan accidentally travels to ancient times and switches souls with the Emperor despite being the Empress herself! After using the Emperor’s body in various ways and engaging in unexpected palace conflicts, the Emperor and Empress, who initially despised each other, must work together to find a way to switch back.

This leads to hilarious bickering and acting both inside and outside the court. As a result, the Empress, who is ignorant of politics, faces difficulties in the court, while the Emperor, who resides in the palace, sees the true colors of his lover from a different perspective.

After accidentally traveling into a novel about ancient times, a modern female student becomes Lu Shuang Shuang, a vicious Crown Princess. Knowing the plot well, she decides to divorce Mo Cheng Qian, the Crown Prince who detests her, to save herself and shifts her affection to the second male lead. However, the Crown Prince refuses to sit idly by and tries the best he can to win her heart. With the Crown Prince on the chase and the Crown Princess on the run, how their story unfolds remains to be seen...

Reporter Shen Ning disdains evil and is good at disguising herself to infiltrate cross-border illegal forces. She wins the trust of the leader Rong Ming through deception and eliminates him. Three months later, Ning meets Ming again at a TV station investment banquet, but Ming now goes by a new identity-the well-respected heir Jiang Chi with a clean record. Through investigation, Ning confirms Ming's identity and suspects that he is here for revenge. But in this elaborate deception, Ning deeply realizes her own insignificance. Facing the paranoid and hostile Ming, Ning has no choice but to bet on herself and fight back desperately.

Su Wan Yan, the eldest of the Su Group, caught her fiancé and step-sister having an affair at the wedding. She was angry and chose Qin Tian Ling, the president of the Qin family, who came to the wedding banquet as her new husband. It turned out that Su Wan Yan found out that her father had caused the car accident which resulted in the death of her biological mother three years ago, so she chose Qin Tian Ling as her revenge tool. Before the wedding banquet, Su Wan Yan exchanged her own shares in the Su Group and asked Qin Tian Ling to help herself acquire the Su Group. When she wanted to transfer the shares after the wedding banquet, she accidentally discovered that she had entrusted the shares to her ex-boyfriend, Mo Qin, and Su Yu Yan had to find her ex-boyfriend in private. Until one day she discovered that the so-called Mo Qin was Qin Tian Ling, and everything was Qin Tian Ling's…
dramas.t: Fall in Love with You Before Falling in Love

dramas.syn:
A story revolving around a complicated romance between the Crown Prince of Da Xuan, the Princess of Beichu, the son of the Prime Minister and a political conspiracy brewing in the palace. 

Ye Qing Ge and Su Yu became a married couple due to an alliance between their respective kingdoms. Upon discovering each other's secret, they begin to plot against each other oblivious to their real feelings. On one side, Ye Qing Ge's childhood friend Xie Qing Yun appears and disrupts the strained relationship between the two.

Set towards the end of the Jin Dynasty and the beginning of Qing Dynasty, Sumoer is a Khorchin Mongol woman with a generous personality. She is someone who would rather endure difficult times alone for the sake of others. Su Moer meets Dorgon at a horse competition and they form a tight bond. One day, her world is turned upside down when an army invades their territory. Sumoer loses her parents and her homeland. 
To receive the protection of the Great Jin, the Khorchin Mongols arrange a marriage alliance between Princess Bumubuqin and Huang Taiji. Sumoer is also sent to Jin as a handmaiden of the princess where she crosses paths with Dorgon again and realizes that he is a man of high power. Initially hesitant to admit her feelings for someone she cannot reach, Sumoer tries to stay away, but she becomes a woman that Dorgon can turn to in his time of need and their friendship blooming…

Xu Xian suffers from autism since young due to the loss of his mother. He wants to lead a normal life, until he sees someone named Zhou Tong who looks 70% similar to him. He is determined to find the familiar stranger. Due to a matchmaking session, he meets Shi Dian Dian, who readily agrees to help him find Zhou Tong. They went to watch a ballet performance together. Co-incidentally, the main actress of the performance Wen Xiao Yao is Zhou Tong's girlfriend. On the way to watch Wen Xiao Yao's performance, Zhou Tong got into a car accident. From that day onwards, the relationship between the two pairs of lovers took a huge drastic turn. After experiencing life's turning point of separation and reunion, the youths are able to understand the true meaning of life. With Shi Dian Dian's help, Xu Xian is able to walk out of his trauma. Wen Xiao Yao also gets up from the lowest point of her…
The story revolves around the mystery of a fake painting in 1930s Shanghai, financial intrigues, and intricate schemes among the women.

Super popular mystery and detective writer Huo Yun Ya, who is struggling with a creative block, is forced to intern at the “Always-Help” law firm. There, he encounters Nie Rou Zhu, the only female staff member and a “super-part-time expert.” The two become partners, and after solving cases like a wealthy man's will and an ex-boyfriend's stalking case, they gradually develop feelings for each other.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Jing Chang Zhao Wo Ma Fan Ne Nan Shen" (经常找我麻烦的男神) by Xian Ge Luo Hua (闲谭落花).

After losing her memory, Qiao Xiao Mi is put in a difficult position by her brother Qiao Zhi Wei at their father’s funeral. At this moment, her fiancé Qin Yu, who has been missing for three years, suddenly appears and helps her out. With Qin Yu’s assistance, Xiao Mi’s fragmented memories begin to point toward a deadly fire in the past. However, Qin Yu’s reappearance turns out to have been arranged by Qiao Zhi Wei. As the truth gradually comes to light, the love built on deception is forced to face a critical choice.

Excellent Investor deals with the distance between dreams and reality and raises the question of how to find yourself. Fang Yu Bin is no different from tens of thousands other young men who leave their small town to realize their dreams in the big city and can only rely on their own talents and efforts. Yu Bin becomes the vice-director of investment of Rongding Capital’s Shanghai branch, but is soon drawn into the internal fights between those who occupy high positions. Yu Bin’s hardest phase of life thus begins. He doesn’t give up though and manages to be recognized by his boss Yuan Rui Liang as well as by the chairman. However, he is soon tempted to make a decision that envolves the betrayal of Rui Liang.  Will personal gain or moral integrity be stronger?

~~ Adapted from the novel "Excellent Investor" (金牌投资人) by Long Zai Yu (龙在宇).
~~ Two versions available: 44 episodes (TV) || 41…

A mix of comedy and mystery revolving around a school for students with special abilities. 

Ding Yi is a homebody with stellar academic records. He is lazy and loves to sleep, but he has an ability that nobody knows - a photographic memory. However, he has one great weakness. Whenever he is scared, his short-term memory disappears in an instant, which could be problematic come exam time. Ding Yi gets accepted to Qing Hua, where he meets his playful and wealthy roommate Feng Zixi and guidance counselor Ai Mei, who helps him hone his abilities.

Due to an emergency mission, military doctor Zhang Du Hang is suddenly sent aboard a naval medical ship dedicated to humanitarian efforts. There, he clashes with female doctor Lu Yang due to their contrasting ideologies towards medicine.

As a doctor, Zhang Du Hang is far from impressed with Lu Yang as he finds her to be overly rational and calm. Lu Yang actually shares a similar contempt for his methods which she finds to be from the wild. They are both transferred to the same department leaving them no choice but to cooperate with each other in the face of urgent situations like a merchant ship in distress, transnational disaster relief, a virus epidemic and anti-terrorism efforts. Their story is an ode to the contemporary Chinese navy.

In 1999, journalist Shen Le Shui used her camera to document the gritty daily lives of workers at Lapi Brewery in La City during a turbulent era of corporate restructuring. When the factory went under, the workers pooled their savings to buy it back, but the money vanished, culminating in the suspicious, unresolved snow-night death of female worker Liu Xue Mei.

Sixteen years later, a broke and debt-ridden Shen Le Shui returns to La City with the sole intention of selling off her old home to clear her finances. Needing money, she takes on a job from the brewery director, Ma Guo Wen, to shoot a promotional film. However, on the very first day of shooting, Ma Guo Wen is found dead on the train tracks. When a commemorative beer bottle cap — the exact same signature clue found at Liu Xue Mei's death scene sixteen years ago — is discovered on his body, a modern-day serial murder…

Tian Xiao Ni is a top fashion designer who is at the peak of her career thanks to her meticulous personality and razor-sharp focus on what she wants out of life. She has lived by the motto of “Perfect Self + Perfect Other Half = Happy Life.” But because of her impossible-to-meet “18 Standards for Mr. Right,” Xiao Ni finds herself still single despite her charm, beauty and talent. When she meets Zhan Wang, she thinks she has found her “ Perfect Other Half” and begins to pursue him. Zhan Wang is a professional race car driver who suddenly quits at the peak of his career and now helps a friend manage an auto body shop. Will Xiao Ni discover that true love can’t be customized to her ideal specifications?

A Dali princess and her team of trusted followers end up in the business of solving mysteries after leaving the comforts of the palace.

Duan Xin Yao is a quirky and lovable princess from Dali who grew up with a silver spoon. After escaping from a fire in her sleeping quarters, she is forced to leave the palace to experience life among the people, thus starting a journey of fighting crime through their quest for the truth.

Gu Man Qing couldn't stand her husband Shen Jun's long-term domestic violence, so she faked her death to escape. Later, she met the plastic surgeon Wen Yi Huai and begged him to change her face. Wen Yi Huai agreed and asked Gu Man Qing to pretend to be his deceased wife. Unexpectedly, Shen Jun found out, and the three of them started a thrilling game of chase and escape.

After being betrayed by her ex-boyfriend, Shen Xing Li gets drunk and has a one-night stand with Sang Mu Ye. When photographs of the encounter are exposed, the two have no choice but to enter into a hasty marriage.

As they gradually spend more time together, Shen Xing Li discovers many of Sang Mu Ye's secrets, and the two experience numerous difficulties, including a kidnapping and misunderstandings about their identities.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Yu Lao Gong Si Xia Wei Zhuang, Tian Tian Ba Wo Qin Ku" (禁欲老公撕下伪装，天天把我亲哭), also known as "Re Shang Feng Pi Xiang Pao Lu, You Hong Hui Jia Chong Dao Ku" (惹上疯批想跑路，诱哄回家宠到哭), by Lou Xiang (陋巷).

It's a story of a huge meteorite hitting earth, upon which Xuan Hu, Chi Long, and Gai Tian fight against each other for the overlord of the world.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Mega Dragon and Tiger" (龍虎５世) by Wong Yuk Long (黃玉郎).

Sanbianpo is an area with a tropical monsoon climate, where good and bad people mix, and the gap between the rich and the poor is huge. Shen Xing, who has just entered the society and has been working everywhere to make a living, accidentally ends up in Sanbianpo. By chance, Shen Xing meets Uncle Cai, a peacemaker who is well-connected in both the black and white worlds of Sanbianpo.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Bian Shui Wang Shi" (边水往事) by Shen Xing Xing (沈星星).

After her nouveau riche stepfather murdered her family and seized their fortune, Chu Ming Hui narrowly escaped death and changed her identity to survive. To enact her revenge, she entered into a contract dating agreement with the Young Marshal to help him assassinate his younger brother, Gu Tong Pei. 

However, a forbidden love ignited between her and Gu Tong Pei. Just as Chu achieved her revenge, she was shattered to discover the man she loved was her enemy. After resolving a series of misunderstandings, the two joined forces to subdue the true culprit—the Young Marshal.

Jin Yu Hong is a well known actress who marries into a wealthy businessman's family, only to painfully realize she fell into an insidious trap that had been set for her long ago. This is her story of revenge on those who had used and harmed her.

In the process of solving a murder case, female police officer Ran Dongdong accidentally discovers her husband has been renting a place in secret. The pressure is mounting as she tries to deal with the complex case and the possible betrayal from her husband, putting a strain on her mental health.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Hui Xiang" (回响) by Dong Xi (东西).

After being betrayed and left disfigured when a lookalike steals her identity, Lin Hong Er receives a new face and a new name from a mysterious healer. Now living as Hong Lin Lang, she sets out on a path of revenge against the powerful family that destroyed her life and to reclaim her lost love.

After suddenly awakening from a dream, eighteen-year-old Lu Zhao Xi unexpectedly finds herself twelve years in the future. Her former home has been reduced to ashes, and the massacre of her entire family is shrouded in mystery. Inhabiting another person's body, she risks her life to pursue those responsible amid layers of conspiracies within the imperial court and the inner palace.

Tu Yin, the powerful regent who holds authority over the imperial court, harbors a deeply rooted obsession that has endured for twelve years. Meanwhile, the exceptionally beautiful Imperial Noble Consort Yu, who resides in the inner palace, is revealed to share a fate identical to hers.

This is a story of destiny and personal growth, filled with intricate mysteries, intense confrontations, and intertwined love and hatred. It is also a romance of mutual devotion and redemption, in which two people move…

The play tells about the Hakura planet next to Kepler's 186 red dwarf star, 560 light years from Earth. 

According to the tradition of the Hakura, in order to maintain the superiority of the gene, the born baby will be inoculated with various abilities. The Princess Ah Luo Lei is born with amazing beauty and hidden powers. 
Suddenly the planet is threatened. To protect Ah Luo Lei, her parents send her with their secrets to Earth along with  Melia and Ella to protect her. 

The singular alien girl with princess disease, Ah Luo Lei encountered a variety of  ridiculous things on the earth, involved in the whirlpool of the conspiracy and the murderous case, and staged a wonderful love of crossing the planet with the driver Li Jin Yu.

dramas.nt: 穿书之我要活到大结局
dramas.syn: Shen Jia Jia transmigrates into a book and into the spy character sent to infiltrate the villain's household, as his wife. The original character fails her task and is executed, so now she must ensure her character survives to the end of the book. Only then will the book be complete and she can go back to the real world. Gu Jiu Cheng, the villain, and her husband, is a cautious and domineering man who finds himself enamored of his new wife.
dramas.t: I Want to Live to the Finale

dramas.syn: Talented painter Xin Yi returns to her hometown to uncover the truth behind a family tragedy. Posing as a rising artist, she targets a powerful collector linked to her past. When his son offers a secret alliance to gain power, the two enter a dangerous game of deception, unleashing turmoil in a seemingly quiet town.
One is a top student girl, the other is a bad boy. They met in midsummer and became a beam of light in each other's lives, but the boy's love is like a rose that stays forever in midsummer.
dramas.t: Mei Gui Cang Yu Sheng Xia

dramas.syn:
Tan Xu Ze is the pride of heaven, while Shu Mian secretly admires him but never dares to hope. One night in college, after getting drunk, Shu Mian blurted out that she wanted to pursue him. From then on, Tan Xu Ze walked her back to her dorm, sat through classes with her, brought her breakfast—teasing openly and tempting subtly, showering her with indulgence and affection. When the little girl shyly asked if she could chase after him, Tan Xu Ze pulled her into a fierce kiss: “What do you think?”

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Ye Tou Wen Ni" (今夜偷吻你), also known as "Tang Zi Gao Bai Wen" (糖渍告白吻), by Zhe Qian (折浅).
dramas.t: An Lian Shi Ke Xing Xing Tang

dramas.syn:
During the Republican era, Zhu Luo Li, the daughter of soap makers, married the warlord Song Huai Nan. But on their wedding night, by his order, the entire family was massacred.  The only survivor was Zhu Luo Li herself, who miraculously escaped. She also discovers that the Yao family conspired with him and helped with the massacre. Wanting to kill two birds with one stone, the woman takes the identity and face of Yao's heiress. Now, as completly new person, Luo Li remarries Song Huai Nan to seek revenge.

At the same time, she befriends Song Qing Zhou, the second son of the Song family,  and decides to help him find his mother, Aunt Hong, who had been persecuted by Song Huai Nan. From then on, connected by a mutual enemy, they use their joined forces to take down the whole family.

After a finance officer’s suspicious death, Yan Ping An escapes to Beijing to expose corporate tax fraud. Teaming up with a former tax inspector and law enforcement, he helps to uncover major financial crimes, dismantle a criminal network, and deliver justice.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Gu Yu" (谷雨) by Gu Yuan (谷渊).

The play is set in the turbulent period of the Republic of China in Shanghai. In a turbulent era, the forensic doctor Che Su Wei and the gentleman detective Gu Yuan are intertwined with various forces. Deputy Inspector Kang Yi Chen, and the innocent and lively reporter Cao Qing Luo worked together to crack out a number of weird and curious cases, and restore the truth.

Jiang Sheng, an intern of the Li's group, accidentally slept with her boss, Li Ting Yi. When she woke up, she planned to leave without notice, but accidentally dropped the resume of her friend, Lin Xiao in the room. As a result, her friend, Lin Xiao Xiao took her identity and moved in and became the girlfriend of her boss.

Kong Zhen, an employee of Lusheng Group, accidentally met Ruan Zheng, the president of Ruanshi Group. She then was sent as an undercover agent by Lusheng boss Lu Yun, becoming Ruan Zheng's secretary, to investigate clues about Ruan Zheng's twin brother. What Kong Zhen didn't expect was that one of the twins was actually Liang Yu, her crush who embarrassed her in front of everyone ten years ago. But which one was him? Kong Zhen was really confused. 

Kong Zhen wants to find out the one she once loved, but Ruan Zheng is already engaged to Xia Luo, and Yang Yang also falls in love with Kong Zhen. The four of them struggled painfully in the whirlpool of misplaced love, whether to let go or hold on tightly, whether to admit it frankly or continue to act. At the crossroads of fate, where will they go?

dramas.nt: 暖婚轻宠妻 第一季
dramas.syn:
The Eldest Young Miss of the Mo family, Mo Shi Shi, was forced to leave her house after her mother, Gu You Wei, passed away. Her sister, Mo Jing Jing, had killed her mother and loved Shen Mu Han. However, Shen Mu Han loved Mo Sha Sha, another sister of the Mo family. He believed that Mo Shi Yi was the one who had killed her and decided to marry Mo Shi Yi to take revenge. Mo Shi Yi wakes up one day and finds out that she has traveled back in time to the day she married Shen Mu Han, after thinking that she had already died. What will happen now?

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Your Turn to Chase After Me" (重生暖婚轻宠妻) by Ake Culture (阿柯文化).

dramas.nt: 十八岁太奶奶驾到，重整家族荣耀 第二季
dramas.syn:
In 1955, Rong Yu unexpectedly passed away. Upon opening her eyes, she was transported to the body of a high school girl with the same name, seventy years later. Her son is now in his seventies, and she has several handsome great-grandchildren. However, each of these great-grandchildren has their own problems. Using her wisdom and ability, Rong Yu reorganizes them, while also growing in this new era and finding her own happiness.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Zi Xian Sun Dou Gui Xia, Wo Shi Ni Men Tai Nai Nai" (孝子贤孙都跪下，我是你们太奶奶) by Wu Ying Xia (乌英夏).
dramas.t: Shi Ba Sui Tai Nai Nai Jia Dao, Chong Zheng Jia Zu Rong Yao Season 2

dramas.syn:
A love story revolving around Wen Si Yue, who dreams of becoming a professional e-sports player and Jiang Ye, the captain of the successful e-sport Team, The DC Team.

Wen Si Yue is the only woman player from the DC Team, who has a sassy and intelligent personality. Her parents died when she was young and she grew up with her uncle, Niu Kai Rui. She is a very talented player and has great skills. She also wants to prove her own strength as a top player in the team. With talent and passion, she hopes to be the king of the game who brings honor to her team.

Jiang Ye is the captain of the DC Team. He seems cold but actually has a heart of gold. He is a wise and responsible leader, who managed his team well. He is also very passionate about e-sports and very loyal to his teammates. He suffers from serious insomnia. When Wen Si Yue accidentally entered his life and joined his team, he was…
dramas.t: Guo Fu Wang Zhe Shi Nu Sheng

dramas.syn: Fifteen years after witnessing their father's murder, Lu Si and Lu Xi seek justice while unaware they’re both investigating his death. As they close in on the truth from different paths, their personal lives are also put to the test.

Every seventh day of the seventh month, a phenomenon occurs at Youlan Lake that allows those who have died a chance to live again. A eunuch who cooks for the imperial family travels to the modern day and becomes a second-generation rich.

Xiao Hao Zi hails from a family of imperial chefs but gets disowned due to an accident that leaves him with a disability. He is sent to the palace to live as a eunuch and earns the favor of the head chef due to his talents, all while inviting the ire and jealousy of Da Hu Zi. 

Upon learning that Xiao Hao Zi is secretly in love with Concubine Yi, Da Hu Zi conspires to harm Concubine Yi, which backfires when all three parties fall into the thousand-year lake. Xiao Hao Zi gets rescued by a woman who looks like Concubine Yi and finds that he has travelled to the modern day inside Duan Ming Tian's body.

However, things are complicated in this world as…

The first time in her life was too much of a failure. Her fiancé of seven years and her best friend set her up, resulting in the loss of both her love and house, but also accidentally allowing her to start a second life ..... What kind of Mr. Right will she meet?

dramas.nt: 今天总裁顺利退房了吗
dramas.syn:
Thrown into a world of CEOs, Yu Xian Xian ends up at the fancy Nevaehland Royal Hotel. Her job is to break down the overused romance plots she created and separate the CEO couples. However, things get complicated when she realizes each CEO not only has the same face but also shares the same memories.

Facing challenges from these CEOs, Xian Xian, a hardworking employee, cleverly deals with them, only to discover they’re all different identities of Long Qing, the mysterious boss of the hotel. Without knowing it, she’s been caught up in a series of love adventures with him.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Tian Zong Cai Shun Li Tui Fang Le Ma" (今天霸总顺利退房了吗) by Fan Bai (饭白).

Brain scientist Shan Yu accidentally learns of the death of his first love Min Ying , who was holding a birthday candle before she died; Shan Yu lit the candle, and a miracle happened with the light of the fire - the candle could take him back ten years ago! Shan Yu crossed many times to save love, but accidentally caused a butterfly effect. A fond past that has been hidden for ten years has also surfaced...

Near the end of 1990s, the forestry industry began to "reduce production, limit logging, and lay off workers." For the first time, Gu Changshan's family and members of the 923 work team faced the choice of staying or leaving. 

Gu Changshan has adopted Xingjie, the orphaned son of his late colleague who died on duty. Despite their initial hesitation, the Gu family decides to help Xingjie continue with his studies. Meanwhile, the layoff crisis among forestry workers gradually resolves itself as the younger workers became the first to leave. Gu Changshan leads the remaining people to participate in the "family ecological forest" project.

In 2007, in order to protect the ecology and improve people's livelihoods, the resettlement project in remote areas began, and the 923 team once again faced a tough choice. Xingjie is pulled back to the mountains as he takes over the task of mobilizing…

It revolves around the unique story of siblings Su Zhi Qiu and Song Feng Xia. Through repeatedly saving one another, the two continually alter the course of their destinies, embarking on a journey in which fate is rewritten time and time again.

Consists of 8 different stories that talk about the problems and pain women face in the modern-day.

Topics include leftover women, objectification of women, the role of a housewife, domestic violence, social appearance anxiety, women’s career choices, midlife crises, and family of origin issues.

~~ Inspired by BBC’s Snatches: Moments from Women’s Lives.

After getting drunk, the genius scientist An Ding, accidentally acquired a super power that can change the objects around him to be human beings. In the beginning, these humans can stay alive for 24 hours before turning back into their original shapes. But gradually, they can be humans more than 24 hours. Then An Ding lives with them like a family.

The persistent and cold Li Xin, the founder of a game company, knew this secret and is dragged into the chaos. Li Xin helps An Ding and his "family" to fight the evil power who wanted to destroy them. In the process, they learn about friendship and love, and grow together as a family.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Xian Ding 24 Xiao Shi! An Ding Bo Shi He Ta De Pu Ren Men" (限定24小时！安定博士和他的仆人们) by Su Xia (苏夏).

Ye Xiao Wei, a winemaker from a poor background, suffers betrayal from both her lover Cheng An and her mentor Lin Wan Mei. She rises from the ashes of hatred, taking over the Cheng family's household under the identity of their illegitimate daughter, Sang Luo. She navigates the complexities of the wealthy and powerful, each with their own agenda, luring her prey into her trap. Having traversed thorns, the rose will ultimately bloom, dripping with blood.

Chen Jiong, disillusioned by his parents' separation, fears love and marriage, helping others but unable to resolve his own issues. Jiang Xiao Xi, a talented pianist from a good family, loses confidence after a competition mistake and gives up on her dreams. Both experience breakups: Chen Jiong with Xiao Yu over commitment issues, and Jiang Xiao Xi with Wang Cong after his infidelity. Their separate struggles eventually bring them together.

In her previous life, Jiang Qing Zhi gave her inherited shares of her mother's company to her boyfriend Ye Junll Liang, who was a school idol. However, he, her father Jiang Da Ming, her stepmother Jin Mei Yan, and her stepsister Jiang Qing Xue conspired to murder her. After her death, she learned that her mother was also killed by these people. 

When the underworld yandere boss Chu Chen An avenged her and committed suicide, she realized Chu Chen An's deep love. After her rebirth, although Chu Chen An still did not believe her sincerity, Jiang Qing Zhi decisively turned to him, vowed not to marry anyone but him, and began to fight back with the help of his power.

What is it like to work in the same airline with a husband who is secretly married? The two met and got married under the arrangement of their families. After marriage, Lin Kong Yu joined Qin Si Yan's airline. As they got along, they gradually understood each other and fell in love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gong Ni Lan Qing Kong" (共你揽晴空), also known as "Bao! Bing Liang Liang De Jin Gui Ji Zhang Si Xia Liao Fan Le" (爆！冰凉凉的矜贵机长私下撩翻了), by Ni Zhe Ban Dong Ren (你这般动人).

Nan Cheng, who was working hard to gain a foothold in the big city, was forced to pause and rethink her life after a betrayal at work. After much consideration, she decided to return to her hometown, Ali Village, for a short break. Unexpectedly, she met Ding Ke Qin, a spoiled rich boy like "the prince on the pea."

The two clashed at first but got to know each other through a series of events. As they spent more time together, their hearts slowly drew closer, healing each other. Eventually, they joined hands to welcome the brighter days ahead.

At eighteen, Ruan Tang woke up to find herself eight years in the future—married to her former archrival Leng Jing, with a child, and branded as a scheming villainess! Determined to redeem herself, she launches a “reputation-cleansing” plan: cutting ties with scumbags and fake friends, showering her neglected child with love, and stunning everyone as the passionate and fearless Ruan Tang they once knew returns.

As for Leng Jing—no matter how bad her reputation is, he trusts her unconditionally. Archrival? Hardly. He’s the childhood friend who’s secretly loved her for years. So she takes his and their child’s hands and steps together toward a happy future.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yi Jiao Xing Lai, Wo He Si Dui Tou Sheng Le Ge Zai!" (一觉醒来，我和死对头生了个崽！) by Ri Cun Jin Xin (日寸今心).
dramas.t: Lao Gong Qing He Wo Lian Ai Ba

dramas.syn:
It follows Ye Zhi Mei, the heiress of Chenghai Group, who suffers a head injury and loses her sight in a diving accident with her newlywed husband, Wu Xi, who goes missing. After she wakes up, a stranger named Zhou Xu Bai impersonates Wu Xi and takes care of her, even guiding her into signing documents declaring Wu Xi legally dead, as part of a carefully orchestrated deception involving multiple people.

When Ye Zhi Mei gradually regains her vision, she begins to sense that something is wrong. Though she attempts to escape several times, Zhou Xu Bai repeatedly risks his life to save her, leaving her increasingly confused about his true identity and intentions.

After a successful auction, renowned auctioneer Qi Xuan accidentally damages an ancient painting and faints after touching it. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the unfamiliar Jing Dynasty as Su Wang Fei, the wife of War God Duke Su Qian Yu. To her surprise, just as she finds a way back to her time, she and her husband swap bodies, complicating her situation even further.

dramas.nt: 小白的男神爹地 第二季
dramas.syn:
5 years ago, the Qin Group was facing a financial crisis. Qin Mu Xuan was designated by the family to go out with Gu Zi Jin, the youngest heir of the Gu Group. This conspiracy did not help the Qin Family and the Gu Group was declared brankrupt. Therefore, Qin Mu Xuan's family was crumbling while she was pregnant and she had to quit school to raise the child.

5  years later, the patriarch of the Gu family was deadly ill. He learned about Qin Xiao Bai and as his last will. He asked Qin Mu Xuan to have the child  back home at the Gu mansion. Qin Mu Xuan agreed to Qin Xiao Bai's return. She only required to stay with him for 2 months. 

Will Qin Mu Xuan and Gu Zi Jin resolve all the misunderstandings?

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Xiao Bai’s Mr. Perfect Daddy" (小白的男神爹地) by Ake Culture (阿柯文化).

35 years old, divorced and single, Yi Xing Yan met Zhou Si Xing, a young career junior and her former student in the company. The age gap, the pressure of reality, and the company's system ultimately did not hinder their advent of love. In the process of trying to get along, there is the sweetness of love, and it is full of differences that cannot be ignored. Yi Xing Yan and Zhou Si Xing were learning how to love each other better during their running-in. However, her ex-husband failed to reconcile and used despicable means to separate the two, which triggered a crisis of unemployment for the two.

dramas.nt: 裴总每天都想父凭子贵
dramas.syn: Lin Jia Jia was drugged and gave birth to twins, but was told that the children were dead. Five years later, she met a man and a pair of twins. With the help of the child, the two got married and started their married life as a family of four.

Lan Xiao Yu, a mediocre lady from the capital, is always forced by her father to go on various blind dates, but she already has a place in her heart - she has always been secretly in love with the most handsome man in the capital, Prince Wei Qing. An accident caused her to exchange souls with Chi Jing Yu, the top assassin of the Qingluan Society, and Lan Xiao Yu became a peerless martial arts master. Instead of Chi Jing Yu, she sneaked into the Qingluan Society to investigate an assassination case...

In the late Ming Dynasty, during internal and external troubles and the battle for the crown prince over the ruling and the opposition, pirates were rampant in the southeast of the border, and the northwest was rising. Jin Yiwei Zhou Huai'an has no interest in political struggle, but he also hates Dongchang. Under the persuasion of his master, he did not confront Dongchang directly. In order to protect the loyal minister, Yingguanzhen, the only son of King Lao Ying, he stood on the opposite side of Dongchang; later, to rectify the name of Lao Ying Wang, he became the first rebel against the dark forces of Dongchang.

After the adventures on the islands, Zhou Huaian not only improved his martial arts and became the owner of the 36 islands respected by the archipelago forces but also broadened his horizons and became a great hero for the country and the people. And the King King who…

In 1941 Shanghai, a man captured the attention of the Japanese due to his resemblance to a BIS spy. He gets pulled into the dangerous world of espionage, yet through the influence of another, he realizes his responsibilities as a citizen of his country and throws himself into the anti-occupation efforts.

Chen Shan makes a living on the streets by trading intelligence. Because he resembles BIS operative, Xiao Zheng Guo, Japanese spy leader Huang Mu Wei kidnaps Chen Shan's sister Chen Xia so that he will have no choice but to do their bidding. To save her, Chen Shan undergoes special training and proves to be an exceptional spy.

Assuming Xiao Zheng Guo's identity, Chen Shan infiltrates the BIS headquarters in Chongqing and starts a mission where one small misstep could cost his life. As a Chinese citizen, Chen Shan never really wanted to betray his motherland. He meets Zhang Li, a woman…

Designer Shen Tian Tian is adopted by fashion mogul Li Man Li and begins her career as a ghost designer for Man Li's daughter, Tang Guo Er. The two become close, but their friendship is tested when Guo Er sends Tian Tian on a date with Zhao Group heir Zha Ming Yuan, only for both women to fall for him.

Tian Tian steps aside for Guo Er, even designing her wedding label, only for Guo Er to betray her out of jealousy. When a scandal forces Ming Yuan to resign, he partners with Tian Tian to launch a new label, Made in China. As Li Group crumbles and the former friends become rivals, only one brand can rise to the top of the fashion world.

The story is about the love triangle between the fourth prince, the crown prince and the number one female scholar, Shu Yuan, during the Qing dynasty. The war for love is also the war for the throne. The feminist plot, the uniqueness of the characters, and the ups and downs of the events are geared towards female viewers.
dramas.t: The Flowers Filled the Palace and Missed the Time

dramas.syn: Programmer Guo Xin Nian develops a mobile app that converts text messages into voice recordings, quickly gaining popularity with the support of investors, friends, and analyst Na Lan. Facing fierce competition and setbacks, Guo Xin Nian learns from his failures and, with Na Lan's help, finds success as an entrepreneur.

In this game of love, Nan Ye Jue is the conqueror, the brutal plunderer. He gives Rong En ten days to compromise, then gradually closes in, completely destroying Rong En's once-normal life. The superior bows to love, but Rong En always remembers the pain he inflicted. Her unwavering clarity drives Nan Ye Jue ever more mad, and he's determined to keep her by his side at all costs.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "An Yu" (暗欲) by Sheng Yao (圣妖).

Sang Lu despised her husband for being mute, and colluded with vicious relatives to plunder his family fortune and commit all kinds of evil deeds, ending in a miserable situation. But Sang Lu suddenly realized that she was the big fool. Absolutely not. So she started to stick to her mute husband every day, mumbling and talking to him, until the president actually said, "Wife, you are so cute."

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Gei Ya Ba Zong Cai Zuo Hua Liao, Hao Men Quan Meng Le" (我给哑巴总裁做话疗，豪门全懵了) by Lu Chi (鹿迟).

After losing his memory in an accident, martial arts heir Ye Wu Ming works as a driver until fate pairs him with top actress Song Yi Ran. As her bodyguard, he helps fight off powerful enemies and gradually uncovers the truth behind his forgotten past.

It's not easy to be a mom, not to mention a single mom. Zhou Nan Nan, a single mother, believes that she can give her son Xiao Yang a happy life just on her own. But at the critical juncture of getting her son into a primary school after his graduation from kindergarten, she realizes that all the moms in the kindergarten have their own troubles. 

he competent career women find themselves failing to be good moms, while those full-time housewives who just focus on their husbands and children feel quite ignored. For example, a shop owner who places her unrealized dream on her child and finally pays the price for her vanity; a young rich girl is directly exposed to the storms of life overnight. Children are childish, but moms are also novices.

No one is born to be a mom. Should they cultivate their children into elites at all costs or just let them be? Should those moms give up everything…

Set in the early Republican era, the story follows a policeman with a dual personality who lifts the veil on a series of strange cases.
The year is 1911 and China is on the eve of revolution. A series of connected homicides occurs in rural  Fuyuan County, a prefecture on the outskirts of Tianjin. Tianjin detective Tan Bodun and his team head there to solve the case. After peeling back the layers of the mystery, he uncovers a shocking secret about Fuyuan County and a struggle between justice and evil begins.

Top-tier agent Nan Cai Yun and the extremely self-absorbed agent Yan Ying Jun pose as a married couple with a fake daughter to infiltrate the world of the elite. As they navigate danger and deception, their pretend family slowly transforms into something real.

The Qian family is the top florist in Hualing City. In order for their family to become a royal merchant, Qian Jin Jin pursues the young master of the Yan family to ask for his hand in marriage. Eager to help, her 4th sister Qian Bao Bao asks to marry the young master's uncle. Two sisters end up marrying uncle and nephew, turning things into one big mess.

The five sisters of the Qian family, which is considered to be the wealthiest in the capital, are called the "Five Beauties of Qian." Each sister has their own role to play. Qian Jin Jin, who is the eldest and the person in charge, is obsessed with making money. The second sister, Qian Yin Yin, with her top visuals, is a well-known socialite. The third sister, Qian Zhu Zhu, is highly skilled in martial arts. The fourth sister, Qian Bao Bao, is cute and kind. The fifth and youngest, Qian Bei Bei, is the resident troublemaker.

As the…

Ye Man deliberately gets close to his stepsister Lu Zhu as part of a calculated scheme, while their stepmother works to destroy Lu Zhu’s reputation, status, and place in the family. But as the power struggle intensifies, Ye Man unexpectedly falls in love with the very person he was meant to manipulate, turning their dangerous game into a complicated and forbidden romance.

A story of hope and despair surrounding the lives of a mother and son from a small town in Subei.
The 18-year-old Ding Xiao Jun who lives with his mother Ding Bi Yun has been admitted to a university in Beijing. However, as soon as he entered university, he is ridiculed by his classmates. Ding Xiao Jun starts to rebel  until he gets a warning that he will no longer graduate. Luckily, his mother gets through to him in time for him to pull himself together and earn enough credits to graduate.
Ding Xiao Jun enters society full of passion and hope, but is scammed and left to wander Japan as a bum for months. Beginning to understand all the hardships his mother went through for him,  Xiao Jun manages to make a long-distance call to her in order to return home.
During New Year's Eve of 2010, Ding Xiao Jun learns that he has landed a job in Beijing. What seemed like the perfect beginning to a…

Set towards the end of Sui and the beginning of the Tang Dynasty is a story of intense upheaval that paves the way for a Golden Age under the rule of the Li Imperial Family.

As is often told in history, there is no peace without bloodshed and the story follows a father and son rising above the dangerous and long-drawn battle for power among the nobles and the royals. They wave the banner 'Tang' and established their capital in Chang'An. However, favoritism within the family leads to more turmoil between Li Shi Min and the Crown Prince Li Jian Cheng. Amidst the political rife, Wei Zheng who serves as the Prime Minister remains dedicated to keeping the peace in Chang'An.
dramas.t: Peace in Palace, Peace in Chang'An

dramas.syn: After working hard under pressure, novelist Lin Xiao Yu, famous for being unlucky in love, faints and wakes up in the world of "True Love". In order to go back to her real life, she must complete the task of finding true love.

A plain-looking, middle-aged guy, Li Hong Hai, with a net worth amounting to billions, simply wants to find true love. All women seem to fall for him because of his money. Hence, when he accidentally meets a young and sassy designer, Xia Ke Ke, and gets attracted to her, he decides to keep his wealthy background a secret and woo her as a simple, small-time entrepreneur. They go through many experiences together and finally tie the knot. 

Once married, he finds out that she knew of his wealthy background all the while. Feeling betrayed, he wants to divorce her immediately, but he has no choice but to keep up appearances as husband and wife for 3 months in order for his company to go public.
dramas.t: Don't Think Twice, Love's All Right

dramas.syn: Xu An Ran lost her memory in a car accident and was rescued by the chairman of Gu Group and arranged to marry Gu Jin Cheng. On the eve of the wedding, the two had a relationship by accident. They canceled the wedding and missed their meeting. Later, Xu An Ran became a designer in Gu Jin Cheng's company. He mistakenly thought she came for love.
dramas.t: The Heart Is in Care and the Time Is Worth It

dramas.syn:
Qiao Zhi founded a restaurant called "Canteen" by using the skills inherited from his grandfather. He carefully cooks every dish rich in culture and history by using traditional ancient cooking, awakening the memory of traditional food in everyone's hearts, and helping his family overcome difficulties time after time.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Da Guo Ming Chu" (大国名厨) by Yan Dou Lao Ge (烟斗老哥).

A story spanning ten years follows three couples and their struggles of love from university to adulthood.

Wang Yi and Du Xiao Ju, Peng Feng and Lang Ting, Liang An Qing, and Zhang Chun Lan met each other when they were in university. Six years after graduation, their relationships have undergone many changes.

When the three pairs meet again - can the love that remains still continue? can the person who no longer has any feelings muster up the courage to be free? can the one who left have a chance at a reunion? It's about loving someone that you can never be with, having feelings of resentment, loving, parting, and experiencing sorrow and joy.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Get a Kick and Die" by Wang Shuo.

Internet celebrity Xu Luo humiliated her husband, MCN president Lu Ze Zhen, by cheating. A year later, they reunited, and Lu Ze Zhen sought revenge by passionately pursuing her, even confessing live online.

They cleared up misunderstandings and exposed the truth behind the "scandal," ruining the reputation of Shen Ruo Xi, who had orchestrated it. Xu Luo and Lu Ze Zhen rekindled their love and began a sweet life together.

During the turbulent years of the Republic of China, love blossoms between the gangster daughter, Qin Man Zhi and her bodyguard Lu Huai. But unexpectedly, everything is a game within a game. Because the true agenda of Lu Huai's and his helper, singer Zhou Liu, is to get closer to Man Zhi, to infiltrate the Qin family, only to take revenge on them, for their past deeds. In the meantime, Man Zhi herself , has her own internal struggles. Torn between deep hatred and attachment,  after she discovers that her beloved brother,  is the mastermind behind the Lu Huai's tragedy., she knows, she soon will need to pick a side.

Coming from humble beginnings, Xiang Qian throws himself into the rat race of high-stakes business to provide the very best life for his young family while his wife, Xun Zhao, stays home with their adorable 5-year-old son, Hua Han. For a long time, they were happy living the good life, but when Xun Zhao is suddenly hospitalized and diagnosed with depression, the couple's perfect life starts to fall apart. 

Will they be able to come through this rough patch unscathed, or have they grown too far away from each other to find their way back together?
dramas.t: Hope All Is Well with Us

dramas.syn:
It tells the story of a young guard who turns into a charming wife after travelling through time and space to hunt down the crown prince who has run away.

Mo Lin Chuan, the prince of the Great Food Country hid inside a closet in an attempt to escape his own marriage. He then comes to the world 300 years later and starts his own business to become the president of a food company. However, his life is disrupted by Su Fan Fan, a guard sent by his emperor father and she's determined to bring him back home. During the chase, Mo Lin Chuan develops feelings for his loyal little guard.

After the 20-year-old glasses girl, Hua Xiao Chi, failed to confess her love to Jiang Yi Qi, she unexpectedly traveled ten years later and met Jiang Yiqi, who suffered from emotional apathy and lost memory. At the engagement ceremony between Jiang Yao Qi and Chen Xin Ying, the young and energetic Hua Xiao Chi kicked the scumbag man aggressively and tore Chen Xin Ying's hands! And all of this is something that 30-year-old Hua Xiao Chi dared not do! The low self-esteem, cowardice, and failure in the past erased the edges and corners of 30-year-old Hua Xiao Chi, and the appearance of the 20-year-old broke everything!

Ji Yu, an internet celebrity agent, was betrayed by Xia Mu, a famous influencer. Due to this scandal, he was banned from the industry. This is why he is now forced to collaborate with a food influencer. The two embark on a journey to Shaanxi's culinary culture. Will love find its way?

During the time when Manchuria was a puppet state of the Empire of Japan, a young woman from the Northern Country engages in a life-and-death struggle against her enemies and earns the name Snow Queen. After the Mukden Incident in 1931, the Gu Family, who had been resisting the Japanese military, was massacred. Only their adopted daughter Gu Xue Ying escapes, and she travels to Qiqihar to reunite with her fiancee Gu Zhao Long, who has infiltrated the Manchukuo military. 

Believing her fiancee has betrayed the family, Gu Xue Ying vows to kill him. Her journey takes her to the Qian Mountains, where she joins a band of freedom fighters and takes part in the Defense of Harbin. She and Gu Zhao Long encounter each other several times as opponents in battle. Meanwhile, she finds herself falling in love with military strategist Shen Lei Zhi.

Heir Chen Zhuo goes undercover as a security guard at Xu Mei Ying's company to uncover the truth behind his mother's death, only to unexpectedly become her live-in son-in-law. Meanwhile, his ambitious twin brother, Chen Yue, impersonates him to secure the family inheritance. Under mounting family pressure, he faces challenges that lead him to confront deception and seek a fresh start.

With the help of a mysterious game, the protagonist rises from an unknown broadcast jockey to a superstar.

~~ Adapted from a web novel "I’m Really a Superstar" (我真是大明星) by Chang Yu (尝谕).

In the once-vibrant state-owned Asahi Factory, the body of a female college student with a severed foot is accidentally found discarded in an abandoned sewage tank. The deceased is Shen Xiao Zhou, the daughter of a factory worker. Criminal police team leader Lian Hai Ping is ordered to investigate the case. Shi Qiang Feng, a young criminal police officer who reported the case on the first day, gets accidentally assigned to Lian Hai Ping's investigation team.

The unexpected case and investigation team starts a fateful journey between the two to hunt down the murderer. At the same time, this case also brings back an unknown past deep in Lian Hai Ping's memory, and his new partner, Shi Qiang Feng, seems to have his own secrets. During the investigation, Lian Hai Ping finds out a mysterious force is behind the manipulation of the whole case.

A partner with a mysterious life experience, a…

Shen Qi is a carefree girl who falls in love at first sight with the mysterious Chi Ye who suddenly arrives one day, and so she begins to chase him, hoping her love strategy works. However, Chi Ye's constant rejection and avoidance of her makes Shen Qi think that it's all just wishful thinking, until she tells him "My wish is to be with you". With those words Chi Ye's heart begins to loosen. As those gears of love start moving, the two spend every day together, feeling the winds and watching the clouds and sunsets, gradually moving towards the wedding hall with the blessings of the islanders. But when the memory of a hundred years ago is recalled, the beautiful love has a past story that one dares not look back on.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ta De Ye Gu" (她的野骨) by Ni Zhe Ban Dong Ren (你这般动人).

Piao Qi Cai has 5 flawless men in her surrounding, with the same surname; including adopted son and cousin. One day, she crosses paths with a young man, named Quan Xi Zheng, because of a cellphone. He may be handsome and excellent at everything, but also has one flaw - sharp tongue that pushes Qi Cai's buttons. To make matters worse, Qi Cai can never beat him at his own game. Qi Cai's older brothers, step in to help her with handling him, but nothing works, until Qi Cai discovers Quan Xi Zheng's secret, that revolves around a musical score, called G March Minor.

~~ Adapted from a novel "G Minor March" (G小调进行曲) by Xiong Jing (熊静).

Ni Xiang Dong agrees to deliver a wooden box to an abandoned cabin, only to uncover a shocking secret that ties him to a missing persons case. As police investigate, they uncover a complex web of relationships and buried truths involving Ni Xiang Dong, his estranged friends, and a troubled past.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yi Sheng Xuan Ming" (一生悬命) by Lu Chun Wu (陆春吾).

It's about a younger twin sister being asked to 'temporarily' exchange her identity for the elder twin in a marriage to a rich guy due to some very serious allergic reaction on her face that she needed some time and cosmetic surgery to heal it. She didn't want to miss the chance to marry a rich guy so she had to ask a favour from her estranged younger twin sister. In return she agreed to take care of their sick mother, who is in coma while they exchange their identities.

Pei Zhen, a candidate for the best actress award, turns into a cat by accident and then is kept by Fu Sichen, the best actor and her bickering childhood friend. Just like that, they start a sweet life of cohabitation as Fu Sichen brings up his lovely pet.

"Cang Lan Jue" content team creates the same world view A new chapter in oriental fantasy. It tells the story of a Jurchen who has been cultivating immortals for hundreds of years but was still unable to ascend to Shuiyuntian, so she returned to Yunmengze to find her mortal heart, and finally achieved enlightenment and became the new Siming of the Siming Palace.

~~ Adapted from the short story "Shi Fu Xin Sai" (师父心塞) of the novel "Shi Fu Xin Sai" (师父心塞) by Jiu Lu Fei Xiang (九鹭非香).

A nurse by day is a bar singer by night. During a performance, he is kissed by a random girl, thus starting the story of the nurse with musical dreams and the new intern.
Jiang Han is an attractive male nurse who works in the rehabilitation department. At the hospital, the gentle Jiang Han is often 'harassed' by his patients. None of them have any idea that he has a rebellious side behind his good guy image. Every weekend, Jiang Han's biggest joy is to rock out at the bar and let loose. 
One day, Xia Tian walks into the bar completely drunk, her boldness catching the eye of Jiang Han. As fate would have it, Xia Tian walks into the hospital the next day as the new intern.

A beautiful yet heart-wrenching tale follows the romance between the son of the number one tea merchant in Jiangnan and a tea harvest girl.

Cheng Jing Mo is the only son and successor of an established tea business. He is a carefree child who has a passion for the arts. Ruan Qiu Shui is incredibly skilled with numbers. She is a tenacious girl who takes on the burdens of her father's debt and cares for their family. As the two meet, Shui and Mo's lives become so intertwined, just like water that has been mixed with ink.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shui Mo Ren Sheng" (水墨人生 ) by Chen Xiao Tao (陈小桃) and Yao Ying (姚璎).
dramas.t: When Shui Met Mo: A Love Story

dramas.syn:
Zhang Pei, Gou Dan Dan, Dong Jia Xi and Wu Yun are four girls who grew up together. 

Zhang Pei is a strict insurance agent, Gou Dan Dan is a brilliant beauty blogger, Dong Jia Xi works at a theater to pursue her dream and Wu Yan was admitted to become a subdistrict civil officer. 

They were working towards each of their goals in different cities, but chance and coincidence caused them to reunite again in their hometown. Company development meant Zhang Pei returned to her cowtown to do business there, Gou Dan Dan moved back to give birth, Dong Jia Zi moved back because of her mother's illness, while Wu Yun looked forward to their return amidst her busy work. 

In their hometown, they found a new direction in careers, gained friendship, the comfort of family and the beauty of love.

Twin brothers, impersonating a warlord, massacre the Zhuang family. Zhuang Yun Qiu survives, posing as the warlord's daughter to marry into the warlord's household and seek revenge. During her marriage, she senses something amiss and learns that the warlord is actually one of the twins in disguise. The two avengers, testing each other and developing feelings for one another, join forces to expose the evil deeds of the powerful and protect the peace of their region…

Xia Tian is a young woman, who is still single. Her sister is about to be married and one day Xia Tian overhears her mother talking to her sister, that if she will come to the marriage of her sister with a boyfriend, her mother will pay for the marriage. Xia Tian has 258 days to find a boyfriend, in order to score off her bothersome mother and to enable her sister a wonderful marriage.

~~ Remake of the Argentinian TV series “Blind to Dating" (Ciega a Citas) [2019].

A modern girl named Cheng Su Yue, with a head full of strange business ideas, accidentally enters the mysterious Ye Shiyi’s bar and travels into the SIM game “Mogul of Wild Wolf City”. Cheng Su Yue runs her business brilliantly and meets the doctor Zhu Shi Zhen. The two spark a romantic love and work together to protect the peace of Wild Wolf City.

Su Nuan Nuan, a 25-year-old blind box designer, has a terrible birthday filled with overtime, misunderstandings, and a breakup. She wishes for a perfect boyfriend on her birthday. In her despair, she buys a seemingly ordinary blind box from a corner store. From then on, she embarks on a fantastical journey with a blind box boyfriend. Will her hope for true love come true?

dramas.nt: 十八岁太奶奶驾到，重整家族荣耀 第三季
dramas.syn:
In 1955, Professor Rong Yu passed away unexpectedly. When she opened her eyes, she found herself seventy years later in the body of an eighteen-year-old girl with the same name. Her son was now a seventy-something-year-old chairman of a company, and she had several handsome great-grandsons.

In this season, Rong Yu experiences events such as the third young master of the Ji family becoming mentally impaired, the old master of the Ji family experiencing heartbreak, and being maliciously detained by the Lighthouse Kingdom. However, she uses her wisdom and ability to bring everything back to order!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Zi Xian Sun Dou Gui Xia, Wo Shi Ni Men Tai Nai Nai" (孝子贤孙都跪下，我是你们太奶奶) by Wu Ying Xia (乌英夏).
dramas.t: Reborn at 18: The Great-Grandma Takes Charge Season 3

dramas.syn:
Three thousand years ago, Mo Bing was betrayed and had her heart gouged out, transforming her into a half-human, half-puppet existence. In pursuit of regaining her human form, Mo Bing searched for a millennium and finally discovered the "Heart of Flame." However, its owner, Mu Yuanqi, held a triple identity just like her. When Mo Bing forcefully married into his household, a series of tests and tensions unfolded. Slowly, a drama filled with purpose and conspiracy, both sweet and torturous, began to unfurl.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wang Fei Fang Ling San Qian Sui" (王妃芳龄三千岁) by Yue Xia Qing Hui (月下清辉).
