The tale of a gifted cartoonist, Qi Cheng, who suffers from social phobia. He is like a cat living alone in a bungalow. He is sensitive, vigilant, and stays away from crowds. He wishes to make friends with people, but he is afraid of approaching people. Chi Zhi Han, a popular food blogger, has become Qi Cheng's private chef because of a bowl of Yang Chun Noodle. With a contract and two people in a house, Chi Zhi Han uses her true love to take Qi Cheng out of the door that he hadn't dared to step out of for ten years.

~~Adapted from the novel 'Yang Fang Li De Mao Xian Sheng' (洋房里的猫先生) by Ying Yang

Sang You You rode her bike to a school recruitment event, but when she was on the phone, she accidentally bumped into Gao Leng's chairman, Huang Fu Hao. They met by chance and started a "Contract Marriage". The appearance of rivals in love and the challenges of their careers have caused both gradually to develop feelings for each other. But faced with numerous difficulties, can their love last to the end?

In the near future, all the surface water on the earth rose into space without warning, forming a magnificent and strange ice ring in the low-earth orbit. It's an existential crisis. The scavenger hunter Jiang Xing Bei leads the mysterious genius Yan Dong  embark on a journey of many dangers.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Meng Zhi Hai" (梦之海) by Liu Ci Xin (刘慈欣).

Dong Ni, Xi Jue and Nan Yin are three cousins from the Zheng family, who knows each other from childhood. Dong Ni has a rebellious personality because of her parents' situation. Before she decides to run from her family problems and get married in Germany, she tries to take Xi Jue with her, and to do so, she tried to mess with his relationship with his girlfriend. At the same time Xi Jue, after losing his parents, raised by distant relatives, is still trying to repay his debt of gratitude to them, working hard for the whole family. The last of them, Nan Yin had a perfect family since she was a child, and her only form of disobedience over the years was to get a marriage certificate in order to resist her mother's control.

Three different people, three different stories and one family. Each of them tries to cut themselves off from their roots, but the past and blood ties, don't let them…

Xu Wei Zhao, who had just started teaching at Jiangzhou University, wanted to live a peaceful life, but was drugged overnight and accidentally entangled with Fang Su Li. He said, "Follow me, I will protect you." She was ready to withdraw at any time, until the words "Zhao Zhao, don't leave me" made her confused.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Da Lao, Chu Men Ji De Zhuang Bu Shu" (大佬，出门记得装不熟), also known as "Ti Zhi Nei Da Lao Xin Gan Qing Yuan Dang Kao Shan" (体制内大佬心甘情愿当靠山), by Lu Xiao Jiu (卢小久).

Luo Wei Qi and her husband Meng Ying Chao have been married for seven years, and their relationship has entered a bottleneck period. Facing the sharp contrast between her husband before and after, Luo Wei Qi couldn't help but started to wonder if the person in front of her, is the real husband...
dramas.t: The Perfect Husband in the Mirror

dramas.syn:
The story of three couples or lovers aged thirty to forty who are chased by life in a fast-paced environment and work hard to save themselves and realize their own life values. Facing their own dilemmas in life, they do not complain or feel sorry for themselves, but faced their hearts and weathered the crisis of life together.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Wo Bu Shi Fei Chai" (我不是废柴) by Ji Jing Rong (纪静蓉).

To take care of the increasingly-rampant international drug trafficking organizations, a joint team was formed. Suspicions and betrayals surround both parties, and among the key players are a gangster with multiple identities and a prison guard.

The son of the famous doctor Gu Feng in Qingyuantang pharmacy was accidentally drowned and Gu Feng’s mother blamed his death on their butler, Fang Cheng. Fang Cheng felt grudged, as his bastard Qiang Wei with his mistress named He Xiu has nowhere to foster her. He secretly substituted his daughter for Gu Feng’s daughter Ren Dong who was once fostered elsewhere. 

Qiang Wei was brought to Gu family and raised up in a well-off environment, while Ren Dong was raised by He Xiu in a poor family. After they grew up, Ren Dong accidentally got a job in Qingyuantang pharmacy and met with Han Chong, who suffered many hardships in his life. Her optimistic nature and medical talent had soon made her popular in the pharmacy. Even Zheng Ding, the boy that Ren Dong had a crush on for many years, was well affected by her. 

After Fang Cheng found out that Ren Dong was the real daughter of Gu Feng, he…

Lin Zhe Xia and Chi Yao have grown up together since childhood. When they were young, Chi Yao was sickly and was the person Lin Zhe Xia especially looked out for. Lin Zhe Xia later discovers that her "frail" childhood friend has unexpectedly become a prominent figure at school, and the story unfolds from there as she comes to see a new, grown-up side of Chi Yao.

Together, they experience all kinds of small moments while growing up, helping each other overcome their fears and vulnerabilities and giving each other warmth, courage, and strength, becoming better people in the process. From relying on each other to eventually becoming a couple, they remain each other's unwavering favorite.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chasing Summer" (逐夏) by Mu Gua Huang (木瓜黄).

It tells the story of the complicated love-hate relationship between Lin Yue Er, Guo Feng and Zhao Ding Hong. Lin Yue Er, the daughter of a general, wanted to marry Zhao Ding Hong to avenge her father's murder, but her plan was exposed before she could take action. She was "imprisoned" by Guo Feng for two years in the name of protection. After being rescued by her father's subordinates, Lin Yue Er transformed into a stunning dancer and infiltrated Guo Feng's side. She planned a revenge drama step by step. Returning to her hometown, can she clear her father's name and escape the vortex of love and hate?

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xia Nv Fu Chou" (下女复仇) by Shi Qian Ah (十千啊).

dramas.nt: 等到世界颠倒你会来爱我
dramas.syn: He Yan, the president of Fanxing Group, was in a car accident on the anniversary of her father's death. After being disfigured, her fiancé Yu Ge seized power. She asked Lin Xiao, who looked similar to her, to pretend to be her, trying to find evidence of Yu Ge's guilt. In the process, Yu Ge developed feelings for Lin Xiao, and Lin Xiao gradually wavered in their relationship. As the truth was revealed, He Yan's revenge plan, Yu Ge's life secrets, and Lin Xiao's life secrets intertwined, triggering a series of emotional entanglements and fierce conflicts.

Rock star Zhou Yi Li's life takes an unexpected turn when the idol Shen Ji Xing asks him if he can live in his house, bringing their past grudges and unresolved memories to the surface. As Shen Ji Xing struggles with a public crisis, Zhou Yi Li finds himself stepping in to help repeatedly, but their path is anything but smooth. With the mysterious Bo Yu a man who sheltered Shen Ji Xing as a kid, schemes against them from the shadows to take Shen Ji Xing back, can they overcome the challenges and reclaim the bond they once shared?

dramas.nt: 顶级豪门总裁成了我的金丝雀
dramas.syn: Wild child Xiao Qing Chen drunkenly sponsors Cen Yu after hearing that his family has gone bankrupt. Having had a serious crush on him since schooldays, she had originally kept her distance, believing him to be in love with her sister.  Meanwhile, her family forces her into an engagement with the Duan family heir, but she balks, trying to stay true to her own heart.
dramas.t: Ding Ji Hao Men Zong Cai Cheng Le Wo De Jin Si Que

dramas.syn:
The story follows the ever-victorious lawyer Tang Ying Ying and her boss Kang Jun as they navigate a series of diverse cases, unraveling the complexities of "human relationships versus legal principles" in the Chinese context, and ultimately experiencing personal growth. The drama selects hotly debated topics such as love and marriage, career and family, and the rule of law versus morality, striving to deeply portray the lives and choices of different groups and encouraging viewers to maintain courage and hope when facing life's challenges.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Themis" (女神蒙上眼) by Jin Ya Tai Tai (金牙太太).

Yu You Wei had her identity as a rich heiress taken away from her and replaced by another girl at a young age; all without her knowledge. Years later, with the help of Han Ming she begins to reach her sailing dream. During her journey she encounters various obstacles including finding out the truth about her identity.
Based on the song written about friendship growing apart after college, the movie follows a group of freshmen in college as they navigate through the wild days of friendship, pranks, and love.

Ai Qing, who is loved by her parents in the city, falls in love with Li Da Li, a hairdresser from the countryside. Li Da Li takes the start-up capital supported by Ai Qing's parents and starts a business together with Ai Qing. The business was booming, and Li Da Li let Ai Qing go home for pregnancy on the grounds of not making Ai Qing work too hard. Two years later, Ai Qing did not get pregnant successfully. When the mother-in-law Xu Jin Zhi moved in, the war broke out.

The story begins when hero Zhao Huai’an decides to take refuge at the Dragon Gate Inn after being pursued by government officials for rescuing one of their captives. There, he is saved from death by the inn’s previous owner, Jin Xiang Yu, who wants him to leave the mundane world with her.

In the spring of 1931, after The Communist Party successfully set up many communication stations in China, they set their sight on Western Europe and assigned 2 of their agents ''Asthray'" and "Porcelain", to Paris. From there on, the stories of the secret deals, hidden betrayals, questionable death, forbidden love, and brotherhood among the military and a prominent family's members were unraveled.

Young General He Jing Yao, in order to expand the power of the He family army, visits Banyue City under the pretext of marrying a daughter of the Su family. At this time, a series of murder cases of brides occurred in the city

In order to protect Banyue City and her family, Su Mei, the eldest daughter of the Su family, teams up with He Jing 
Yao, to resist greedy and evil opponents. From testing, suspicion and exploitation of each other to cherishing each other and healing each other, they finally uncovered many mysteries side by side and found the truth and light.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Luo Mo, Leng Xue Shao Shuai Qing Dian Ai" (落寞，冷血少帅轻点爱) by Li Mo Chou (李墨酬).

The story revolves around Shen Jia Yue, who is framed and killed by her husband, Chu Jing Yan, and Wu Liu Li. She then reincarnates to seek revenge and rewrite her destiny.

The series centers on the intertwined fates of two female leads with different backgrounds and personality traits, uncovering an unknown conspiracy. Like two flowers blooming, each has its own merits: one struggles in the mud, resorting to any means to climb up, striving for the highest status and the most glorious prosperity; the other is manipulated by fate, her kindness betrayed, yet her resilient heart supports her to grow towards the sun with composure. 

These twin flowers grow either sharp thorns or warm branches. Their entwined struggles form the rich content and dramatic tension of the story, filled with love, hate, greed, anger, delusion, and desire, making the narrative even more intriguing.

Commander in imperial guard, time travels to modern days and wakes up in house of  Lin Gu Jiu. Without thinking twice, girl decides to hire him as her bodyguard. But little she knows, Lian Lian, found himself in our reality after fighting his nemesis. Soon, the two discover that their meeting may not be as accidental as they think. However, in discovering the truth, they are hindered by an enemy, the same one who drove Lian Lian from his reality.  Will the couple manage to defeat the evil and get to the bottom of the whole story?

~~Adapted from webcomic "Wo Nan Piao Shi Jin Yi Wei " (我男票是锦衣卫) by ZQQ Hong or Hongjun (ZQQ虹or虹君 )

Zheng Ying, a scandal-ridden actress drifting through life, crosses paths with Shen Yi Fan, a dying genius investor who refuses to let her give up on herself, and together their clash of wills turns into an unexpected romance that fuels her comeback and his redemption, shaking up the entertainment industry.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Bu Shi Sui Bian De Ren" (我不是随便的人) by Hong Jiu (红九).

Four female detectives in Pingling City reopen cold cases, facing brutal truths and twisted humanity. Led by the talkative Luo Ying Wei, the team includes gossip-loving Cai Wen Xin, determined Xia Luo Yang, and quiet, bookish Feng Yi. Despite their differences, they prove their skills while tackling cases. With support from Cai Wen Xin's brother Cai Wen Fei and their police superiors, they ultimately confront a massive drug syndicate.

After years of cultivation, Zuo You finally transformed from a grass fairy into a human being, but she was chased and nearly killed before she even had a chance to think about her transformation. At the time of the crisis, Zuo You shouted for help in her heart, and someone actually arrived and rescued her. Why did the real person, Qing Ming, who came to rescue her, hear Zuo You's voice, and what kind of wonderful story will Zuo You, who has cultivated the ability to predict the future, unfold with him?
This tells the inspiring story of three women of different backgrounds coming together to face the difficulties in real life bravely.

It tells the touching story of heroine Yu Xin Huan in the VR game "When Will The Son Go Off", who is unyielding and brave to fight against evil forces, thus gaining true love.

 ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gong Zi He Shi Xiu" (公子何时休).

dramas.nt: 暗恋的小青梅她人美声甜
dramas.syn:
Qiao Zhen dreamed that she was abandoned by Ji Xian, whom she had been in love with for seven years in her past life, and she decided to stay away from him when she woke up. Later, she discovered that no matter in her past life or now, the one who had been with her for more than ten years was her childhood sweetheart, Qin Yi Chi. Qiao Zhen could not ignore her heartbeat, and Qin Yi Chi, who had been secretly in love with her for many years, finally waited for his "pearl".

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhu Ma Geng Chong! Shei Hai Zhui Gao Leng Xiao Cao A?" (竹马更宠！谁还追高冷校草啊？), also known as "Xin Dong! An Lian! Xiao Qing Mei Ta Ren Mei Sheng Tian" (心动！暗恋！小青梅她人美声甜), by Yue Ye Shan Hu (月野山狐).
dramas.t: An Lian De Xiao Qing Mei Ta Ren Mei Sheng Tian

dramas.syn:
The pilot school senior students will be in the nursing school for a two-week first-aid training. Mu Xiao Xiao is called by the new head nurse Zhang Su Jin. She thinks that she has shared a kiss with Jiang Yun Tian and must pursue him within two weeks. The school prepared a masquerade for them.

At the ball, Mu Xiao Xiao thought that Jiang Yun Tian would appear handsomely and deliberately dressed up, mixed with some Kamen Riders and executioners, but she did not find Jiang Yun Tian. Seeing everyone so happy and with slight drunkenness, the frustrated Mu Xiao Xiao left alone and fell at the playground.

At this time, a Shrek appeared. Shrek spoke of his childhood and the girl of his childhood who gave him origami wings which accompanied him to the sky. Now the girl is helping him through the crisis. He has finally confirmed his love. Mu Xiao Xiao was drunk and fell asleep, not knowing…
dramas.t: Look at the Sky and See the Cloud

dramas.syn: At the end of the Nan Dynasty, the two parties of the Crown Prince and the Eldest Prince fought for power. Under the guidance of Lord Xiao Lin Zhou, the Crown Prince's group was getting powerful gradually. But Xiao Lin Zhou's great merits made the Crown Prince feel insecure. So the Crown Prince sent Qin Che, the Ninth Prince, to live in Xiao Lin Zhou's mansion so as to prevent him from meddling in state affairs. To make both sides satisfied, Qin Che stole the official letter and hid it in The Plenilune Tower.
Four aliens now call Earth home. The drama follows them as they try to live ordinary "human" lives, yet strange occurrences require them to use their special abilities.

Liu Qing Yang is a rich, spoiled playboy. Chen Yi Fan is the icy, aloof vice president of a real estate corporation. Despite their differences, they both happen to be motorcycle racing enthusiasts. They find their lives intersecting after Liu Qing Yang saves Chen Yi Fan during a race, where Yi Fan notices that he resembles her former lover, Mei Heng, who passed away. Soon, Qing Yang and his mother suffer some mishaps and fall into debt. Yi Fan helps him out by offering him a job at her company.

When her company is pushed into a corner by its competitors, Liu Qing Yang attempts to save it by seeking guidance from its founder Mei Dao Yuan, who was a genius entrepreneur and Chen Yi Fan's former professor. Mei Dao Yuan teaches Qing Yang how to apply the principles of the Chinese Taichi known as "pushing hands (tui shou)" in the business world.

Rookie model Jiang Ye had been in a four-year relationship with Zhou Jing Su, the powerful heir of the Zhou family. After being mocked as nothing more than a “plaything,” she breaks up with him on the spot—only to stumble right into the arms of his younger brother, Shen Jing Si. Shen Jing Si takes the initiative to seduce her, and in a fit of anger, Jiang Ye kisses him. The next morning, when she tries to end things, she realizes that Shen Jing Si is dead serious!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhan You Qiang Wei" (占有蔷薇) by Shao Hua Bu Fu (韶华不负).

In the neon alleys, the black doctor Mu Wan of the "Renxin Clinic" is cold-blooded and money-loving. In fact, she has been dormant for five years and is targeting Ma Yu Ting, the prince of the Dark Empire. When he stepped in with a serious injury, her deadly chess game started. But he had already seen through her revenge plan. Training and testing, the calculations and conquests of the two powerful hunters are intertwined, and the bone-eroding desire bursts out in the fatal confrontation. She is his destiny, and an inescapable disaster.

Wen Yan goes undercover as the younger sister-in-law of a wealthy family in order to gather evidence, while Lu Ting Xiao schemes to seize power as part of his revenge for his mother. By coincidence, Wen Yan is also the imposter who once spent a night with him.

By day, she confronts her useless husband while he secretly sets deadly traps; by night, the two engage in intense emotional games, each hiding their own motives. What begins as mutual suspicion gradually turns into an alliance to overthrow the family, as their forbidden relationship spirals out of control amid the power struggle.

Due to an incident, An Ding unleashes a miraculous ability to turn inanimate objects into people, but only for the duration of 24 hours. As the things in An Ding's house become human, it starts them on a bizarre yet dangerous adventure.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Xian Ding 24 Xiao Shi! An Ding Bo Shi He Ta De Pu Ren Men" (限定24小时！安定博士和他的仆人们) by Su Xia (苏夏).

In the 1990s, Wei Guo Ping, a seasoned police captain, relentlessly pursues justice, beginning with a serial murder case in 1988 that left him scarred after losing comrades. Eight years later, a shocking dismemberment case in Ningjiang brings him back into the fight. As he investigates, Wei uncovers connections to the past case, leading him closer to a notorious criminal organization. Despite his dedication, the investigation becomes increasingly complicated, clouding his judgment.

Set in the winding hutongs of old Beijing, the story begins in 1979 following a group of young people's return home to Jiudaowan. Aiming to change his social status to match his first love, heiress Shi Xiao Na, Yang Shu Mao decides to venture into business in Guangzhou: the forefront of reform and opening up. As he learns on the job he quickly discovers his high business acumen, leading him to startup a real estate development company with childhood deskmate, Zhao Ya Jing. In spite of his improved financial standing, the large social gap is too much to overcome for Xiao Na's parents and the couple eventually accept their reality and drift apart. There by his side to console him is childhood friend Ye Fei, the older "sister" he's always protected. Only after growing up does he come to realize his feelings for her went beyond that of "kinship". But just as Shu Mao and Ye Fei find their…

Si Ning, in an unknown way, finds herself in a script she wrote for a writing contest. The last thing she remembers, is that she wanted to make final touches to it, including cutting out the romantic plot, because she didn't know how to lead it, because she had never been in love herself. Now, trapped in her own work, the girl not only has to find herself in the realities of the Republican Era, but also she meets characters who are a reflection of those from her real life.

One of them is Xiao Mo Ya, who forced her to change the script and who in the new version of it,  becomes the object of her affection.

A "man-machine" alien who accidentally landed on the earth met a two-faced IT female academic who was calm and rigorous on the surface but was obsessed with idol dramas. During the process of living together, the two started a ridiculous story. A heartwarming and healing romantic love story.

Hu Ba Yi and Wang Pang Zi had planned to go abroad with Shirley Yang. However, they were entrusted by Professor Chen to travel to the Coral Spiral with Mr. Ming to search for the Qin Emperor's Bone Mirror. They befriended Ruan Hei, Gu Cai, and Duo Ling on Coral Temple Island. Together, they set sail. One night, they were sucked into the underwater cave of Guixu. In despair, Hu Ba Yi and Shirley Yang decided to risk their lives using the Sun-shooting wooden mechanism to lead everyone out of Guixu.

~~ Adapted from the 6th volume in the novel series "Candle in the Tomb" (鬼吹灯) by Zhang Mu Ye (天下霸唱).

Cui Xi Yue, the descendant of the princess exiled in a foreign country, changed her name to Hua Yue Er and sneaked into E country to avenge her enemy Ke Yi. She approached Ke Yi's beloved Wei Li and unexpectedly found that he was her childhood friend. During her revenge, she discovered that the real culprit was Ke Yi's brother Ke Yun, who had been eyeing her for a long time, and she fell into the "sweet trap" designed by him.

Su San, a witty reporter with an extraordinary sense of smell, and detective police chief Luo Yin team up to solve a serial murder case in Shencheng; fighting to protect the people, social justice, and each other.

Branded as the daughter of an adulteress, Shen Qing Ru grew up under scorn, finding solace only in Shen Cheng, the mute boy who became her refuge and forbidden love. Forced into a cursed marriage, then widowed before the wedding, she was nearly buried alive by her in-laws. To save Shen Cheng from a trap, she married the clan leader's son, unaware it would cost her dearly. Presumed dead, Shen Cheng survived. Years later, he returns as a powerful marshal, hiding his identity, all for her.

dramas.nt: 戏精美人且会撩得宠着
dramas.syn: When it comes to love and love, making money is the king!
dramas.t: Beauty Can Flirt Need to Be Pampered

dramas.syn: Fang Meng, born with a taste disorder, inherits her late father’s failing restaurant, Hua Su. With Shu Zheng Yan's support, she evolves from a culinary novice into a skilled chef, transforming Hua Su into a city landmark. Together, they overcome challenges and build a life filled with love and success.

Switched at birth, Qiao Xing Ye returns to her biological family but is never treated like she belongs. She is schemed against by her adopted sister and almost loses her life. No one in her family seems to trust or love her. Her family and fiancée's mistreatment only increase when her adopted sister, Liang Yu Tong, is diagnosed with cancer. Whilst planning for her wedding, Xing Ye is abandoned as her fiancé is really in love with her adopted sister. After three whole years of disappointment, Xing Ye grows tired of the cold indifference, her scumbag fiancé and the life she had come home to. 

Previously adopted by a wealthy family, Qiao Xing Ye runs to her adopted brother after leaving the Liang family. Ruthless and somewhat immoral, Qiao Rong Chuan's only weakness is his adopted sister. He often protects Xing Ye from her relatives and ex-fiancé, who refuse to leave her alone due to her…

The newly appointed Director of the Juvenile Prosecution Department, Lei Xu, along with juvenile prosecutor Du Zi Yu, clerk Yang Tian, and bailiff Xu Zhang Li, and other members of the Ninth Prosecution Department, are handling juvenile criminal cases when a case suddenly takes a dramatic turn.

At the same time, a juvenile suspect in an accidental death case also comes to their attention. Several seemingly unrelated cases are found to be intricately connected, and the prosecutors of the Ninth Prosecution Department uncover the truth behind the cases step by step, bringing the criminals to justice. They work together to protect the youth, nurturing the future with love, hoping for the day when there will be no more cases to handle.

Fu Sheng Nan grew up to be an uncompromising grade-A student, whether in studies, sports or hobbies, she was always number one. Although she has always been the first, in the class, there is someone who is more favored than her, which is her childhood friend - Li Xiu Hao. Li Xiu Hao relies on his harmless look and gentle appearance to coax both his friends and elders around him to be very fond of him, while Fu Sheng Nan is the only one who knows, how vicious Li Xiu Hao is. It was like that, until Fu Sheng Nan's senior Liu You Wen appears. Li Xiu Hao for the first time, encounters a person who doesn't get caught up in his games. It is also so complicated that the boy begins to realize that he has more feelings for Sheng Nan, and may miss the chance of developing their relationship, because of his actions.
dramas.t: My School Hunk Boyfriend Next Door

dramas.syn:
Shi Xiao Fan, a modern engineer, transmigrates into a fictional dynasty as Shi Fei Fan, a notorious playboy, and secretly uses his advanced knowledge to protect his family, build power, and reshape the empire. While pretending to be irresponsible, he quietly amasses wealth, outsmarts political enemies, and rises from “good-for-nothing” to a hidden military force pivotal to the kingdom’s survival.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Song Chao Bai Jia Zi" (宋朝败家子) by Chi Huo Da Lian Meng (吃货大联盟).

The life story of Da Yu Er, an influential woman who oversaw three dynastic successions in the early Qing Dynasty. As a girl, Da Yu Er, the future Empress Dowager Xiao Zhuang, was a free-spirited princess roaming the Mongolian prairie and dreaming of marrying her love, Dorgon. But as fate would have it, she married his brother, Hong Tai Ji, in a political alliance. She struggled between her heart's desire and her responsibility to her clan.

Zhang Chi, the former head physician at Third-A Hospital, left thoracic surgery for the emergency center due to an accident and teamed up with Qi Ji, an experienced emergency doctor who was not in line with his medical philosophy. Zhang Chi is overwhelmed with work in the emergency center. He thinks he is a good professional, but all kinds of emergencies still expose him to the shortcomings of "new first aid".

After being reborn as Su Qing Ran, a noblewoman betrayed and killed in her past life returns to seek justice for herself and her family. Fate brings her into a political marriage with Wanyan Jin, a man burdened by his own deep-seated vendetta. Though initially wary of each other, they join forces to uncover the truth, avenge their families, and find love as they fight side by side.
Love story between a brilliant, blind perfumer Fang Ze and perfume thief Su Qing whose kiss lets him see a few moments of light.

Luo Dan Ni resents her life as an adult. It's a far cry from what she had imagined for herself when she was younger. She had been a bright student with a very promising future, but things didn't work out the way she had imagined. A car accident has her thrown back into her high school years, giving her a chance to change her life with the knowledge of an adult. She works furiously, making different decisions with the hopes of achieving the future she had imagined.

Xuan Qian Cao, the daughter of a guilty minister, has outstanding aptitude and is determined to avenge her father's grievances. She is actively looking for a strong backer and in that place comes the emperor's illegitimate son, Chen Tong Xue, who got tricked by the prince.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Shang Guo Fu Zhi Qian Dui Xue" (上国赋之千堆雪) by Ga Cha Shang Hua (呷茶赏花).

Set in a futuristic sci-fi world, the sudden reddening of the moon awakens extraordinary powers in some humans. An ordinary office worker, Lu Xin, unexpectedly passes the test and becomes the ace solo agent of the Special Pollution Cleanup Department. Together with partners, each possessing unique abilities, they resolve various bizarre and mysterious incidents while protecting humanity’s last refuge. Meanwhile, they relentlessly pursue the hidden truth behind the red moon.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Cong Hong Yue Kai Shi" (从红月开始) by Hei Shan Lao Gui (黑山老鬼).

dramas.nt: 爱你情出于蓝 第二季
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the manhua "More and More Loves You" (爱你情出于蓝) by Ake Culture (阿柯文化).
dramas.t: More and More Loves You Season 2

dramas.syn:
Set in ancient times, the story follows a young emperor who leads a double life as he works in the theater with a group of artists.

In a certain dynasty that is prosperous and peaceful, the people praise the young emperor for being brilliant and wise. In reality, the emperor has not yet taken power because it remains in the hands of the Queen Mother and the emperor's uncle. Uninterested in government affairs, the emperor simply wants to go outside the palace to travel and feed his obsession with the opera.

One day, the emperor discovers a secret passage. When he quietly slips out, he is surprised to find that at the end of the passage is a theater house that is about to reopen its doors to the public. As he meets its owner Bai Xiao Qing, he conceals his true identity to associate with a group of wonderful artists. Being one with the people, the emperor goes through several ups and…

Heroine Gu Nianhe is the domineering leader of XianYi sect, whose members have been forced to serve a General through poisoning. One day she sneaks into the General's mansion to find clues about the antidote, and there she finds and rescues a mysterious, wounded man, Mu Yichuan. 

She takes him as her servant and they make a deal: Mu Yichuan will tell her all he knows about the antidote if she heals him. Despite their initial untrust, in the process, the two of them grow closer. But among enemies both within and without, the General's continued demands, and Gu Nianhe's responsibilities to her sect, their future seems doomed.

And Mu Yichuan's real purpose and identity is not as simple as it seems, either... Who will fall first?

A talented cooking girl enters a game repair program, but unexpectedly the handsome city lord turns out to be the bug.

In order to eliminate the code and restore normalcy, she must come up with various ways to poison the city lord a hundred times.

However, in the process of love-hate interactions with the city lord, they develop affection for each other. What should she do?

On the wedding day, her fiancé ran away because of a phone call from his ex-girlfriend, making Nan Wan the laughing stock of the whole city. Nan Wan turned around to support a handsome young little milk dog, but she didn't expect that the little milk dog was actually the prince of the Beijing circle, and he was so teasing and flirting.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hun Dan! Jing Quan Tai Zi Pian Shen Pian Xin, Hai Pian Hun" (魂淡！京圈太子骗身骗心，还骗婚) by Mo Ni Ka (茉妮卡).

A story that follows urban planner Lin Qiao Qiao who after meeting Wang Jue joins hands with a group of people in reviving Rainbow Town.

Lin Qiao Qiao is an urban planner with her whole future ahead of her until she encounters a tragic blow. To recharge and find peace of mind, she decides to go to a place called Rainbow Town where she meets some same-aged friends: the firmly idealistic Wang Jue, the bookish Shen Tian Chen, the proud romantic Ye Yu Mo and the melancholic Feng Zao.

As their hometown declines day by day, Wang Jue and the others become strongly opposed to its industrialization. They work together to bring back the Rainbow Town from their memories.

Set during the late Qing dynasty, the story follows Yu Chu Hao, an academic official who returns to his hometown of Liuli Village in western Fujian. When his clan faces a crisis, he steps forward to protect them, only for the Qing Empire to collapse the next day.

Centered around the century-old earthen fortress of Liuli Village, the story spans several generations and time periods, portraying the lives of its residents as they struggle to survive in turbulent times. Through moments of love, loss, loyalty, and conflict, the series captures how ordinary people navigate history’s great changes—revealing a vivid portrait of resilience, humanity, and the passage of time within one enduring village.
A story that begins when the new boss of a ski park meets a ski-loving coach and work hand in hand to save the place from closure.
dramas.t: Hey Pro My Mountain Girl Second Season

dramas.syn: In order to pursue the male idol flight attendant, Lear, Wang Hai Xian came to the airline to interview as a flight attendant. The company hired a group of actors and actresses to play passengers to train the newcomers' adaptability. During the training process, Wang Hai Xian gradually realized the charm of the flight attendant profession and worked with his partners to solve various difficult passenger problems.

Three years ago, when Yan Chu Qing fell into the sea and was on the verge of death. It was Fu Yan, the captain of the Flying Eagle Team, who saved her. When it was raining heavily and she was desperate, the big hand that the man handed to her became the only light and salvation in Yan Chu Qing's heart. From then on, Captain Fu became the person she had always secretly loved in her heart!

Fan Da Yao, the mighty Tiger Demon Queen, rules Qianchun Mountain with absolute power. Shen Wang Chen, a frail and distant nobleman’s son, seeks a cat demon to cure his illness. When they meet, an unlikely and humorous cohabitation between human and demon begins.

After a courageous general named Fu Yun Yun time-travels into the body of a wealthy heiress, she becomes entangled in a web of love and deception. As she searches for the truth behind an ancient promise, Fu Yun Yun must rely on her strength and wit to find her place in a world both familiar and strange.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gao Men Zhu Mu Chuan Cheng Hao Men Xiao Ke Lian" (高门主母穿成豪门小可怜) by Tang Tu (唐途).

His soul transmigrates into the body of Ning Chen, the illegitimate son of the Ning family in the Great Xuan Kingdom. After enduring endless humiliation, he rises up and strikes back. He stuns the capital with his poetry, joins the Inspection Bureau and cracks one mysterious case after another, revolutionizes the battlefield with innovative firearms, captures enemy commanders alive at the frontier, and ultimately uncovers the truth behind his mother's murder.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Yao Si Gong Zi" (逍遥四公子) by Xiu Guo (修果).

The continuous pursuit of a murder case of 10 years sheds light on the darkness of human nature and unravels a well-planned revenge.

Feng Lang is an intelligent criminal detective. Through multiple cases, he unearths a shocking conspiracy involving a pharmaceutical factory many years ago. Together with young police officer Fan Yun and other investigators, they engage in a battle of wits and will to solve the mystery.

In a hospital in K City, a sudden car accident caused Gao Yuan and Huo Shang, who hadn't seen each other for eight years, to meet again. Eight years ago, the dumb student Huo Shang and the smart student Gao Yuan became best friends by helping one another. They made a deal to be enrolled in the same university, but Liang Qi ended up in an accident,  and after Huo Shang helped Gao Yuan and Liang Qi out, he  went missing.  It has been a pain in the neck for Gao Yuan as Huo Shang left without saying anything. Now, they have a chance, to re-create the relationship and clear up understatements.
Su Fan Xing was betrayed by her fiancé and got drunk in a bar. She became pregnant with Pei Jing Yue's child, but thought the biological father was someone else.

After a divorce with the CEO of Lin Corp, Ruan Rong leaves with a fortune in her hands and offers handsome pay to whoever she deems fit to father her child. Her assistant introduces her to a male model who seems perfect in every aspect—except that he is her ex-husband’s friend, the powerful and ruthless CEO, Mu Jin Chen! Rumor has it that he rarely involves himself with women, so why did he agree to the offer? Meanwhile, her ex-husband unexpectedly proposes remarriage. Who is she going to choose?

In the ever-changing tide of the times, the fates of Chun Xiao, Jin Lan, Lin Kan Shan and Ma Qi intertwined and collided on the secret front, and their stories were closely linked to national security and social change. As new forces in the National Security Bureau, Chun Xiao and Jin Lan launched a 21-year-long battle of wisdom and courage with Lin Kan Shan, code-named "North Wind".

 In a series of major cases related to national security, Chun Xiao and Jin Lan grew from fledgling novices to determined secret front fighters. They unwaveringly cracked down on espionage and defended the country's secrets and security, while Lin Kan Shan and Ma Qi gradually lost their way in the political whirlpool. As time went by, Chun Xiao and Jin Lan guarded the unity of the motherland and the tranquillity of the country at the cost of their youth and blood.

Shu Ke  is a salesman who aspires to be a designer. After entering into a contract marriage with Tao Hua, a second-generation rich baifumei, Shu Ke finds himself facing all sorts of troubles. He has to deal with his steely mother-in-law, a childhood sweetheart who has come to find fault, a father-in-law who seems to be neither friend nor foe and Tao Hua's good friend who is crushing on him. Being in too deep in their lies, the two start to develop real feelings for each other.

However, the time will come when their fake marriage is exposed. Tao Hua's mother demands that Shu Ke give up on his dream of becoming a designer to join the family business instead. Shu Ke reluctantly agrees and experiences various ups and downs in the workplace as the chairman's son-in-law. Meanwhile, Ta Hua puts her life on hold to focus all her energy towards Shu Ke. With their relationship reaching an…

Gu Hao Xuan, the leader of SD Group, became a worker at Cheng Ning Nang Animal Park many times because of his pet dog. With the help of his dog "Pluto" again and again, Gu Hao Xuan slowly fell in love with that sassy girl.
This drama will show how the animal park officer fights the leader and is something that will warm the hearts of the SD group leader!
dramas.t: The Sweet Love With Me Honey

dramas.syn: The story revolves around the World's Best Matchmaker, Young Master Wuji, who boasts a stunning face and a jade-like voice, and the bold and decisive No. 1 Pretty Lady, Tang Xiaolu. They accidentally meet during the Marital Festival and end up getting engaged. Together, they unravel the mystery of their identities while deeply in love. However, all of these turn out to be a scheme within a scheme, a play within a play, orchestrated by others.

After a twist of fate, street orphan Ruan Fei Fei assumes the identity of a famed courtesan and enters the prestigious Huo family, transforming into the heiress Huo Qing Wan. Determined to seek revenge, she maneuvers through a web of power and deception while becoming embroiled in a fierce, emotionally charged relationship with the commanding young marshal, Huo Xiu.

dramas.nt: 为了你我愿意热爱整个世界番外之光之子
dramas.syn: The drama tells the story of the protagonist Long Bow Wei from the light of a lazy boy who grew up in contact with magic and became the son of the light of the future generations.

A story about the joys and sorrows of the young generation born in the 1990s. It follows four people who have a secret that they keep.

Because of an incident when she was in high school, Luo Xi transformed into a submissive and weak person when she entered university. Li Xin discovers that Luo Xi was the hero who saved him in the past, so he sets out to help her regain the part of her that she lost. Their youth is filled with embarrassing moments, but in each of their hearts is a secret. When it comes to family, friendship and love, what choice will they make?
dramas.t: Waiting for You in a Long Time

dramas.nt: 薛小冉的古代搭伙之旅
dramas.syn: ~~Adapted from the novel "Xue Xiao Ran's Ancient Companionship Tour" (薛小苒的古代搭伙之旅) by Qian Mo (千墨).

The play tells the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of the Republic of China. During her time there, she met three men: Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. They did not succumb to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate and gradually experienced the ups and downs to become a female national entrepreneur who was bold, steadfast and trustworthy, and finally set her sights on... The story of the rise and fall of a country.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ye Xin Jia" (野心家) by Shi Tou Yu Shui (石头与水).

Because of a wrongful conviction, Rong Zhe Lan ventured alone into the palace, vowing to carve out a path to survival in the male-dominated Imperial Medical Academy. Facing the scorn and contempt of the male physicians, she used her medical skills as a weapon to rise against the tide; she treated the Crown Prince, saved the Empress Dowager, and quelled a plague, becoming the first female official of the court with her world-saving achievements, making the scornful bow down and writing an inspirational legend of "women at the table".
Mu Qi is a retired soccer coach who is drawn in by Pei Duo's enthusiasm for soccer. She convinces him to return to the world of sports to train their local high school soccer team.

dramas.nt: 被偷听心声后，豪门全家追着我宠
dramas.syn: The soul of the big boss in the cultivation world travelled into the body of Lu Li. When she woke up, she faced Shen Jun Yue, asking her for a divorce. Then, her husband found that he could hear her inner voice and later discovered that the whole family could hear her as well. They began to verify the truth of a series of funny stories.

After being betrayed, violated, and buried alive, Su Hua returns under the guise of courtesan Qing Yan to infiltrate the Xiao family, rescue her persecuted sisters, punish the guilty, and reunite with her true love, General Xiao Yun.

To save her ailing mother, Lin Qing Zhu makes a deal with Chu Nan He, unaware he is actually Chu Guan Xing — reborn and haunted by the past that once drove her to suicide. As he secretly helps her while battling his lingering feelings, hidden family secrets, and a long-buried car accident truth resurface, bringing all three lives to a fateful crossroads.

Set against Beijing's successful bid for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the story follows Chen Mian, a young woman determined to make short-track speed skating her life’s goal. From amateur to national athlete, she joins Zheng Kai Xin’s team in Qingdao, where she faces challenges and perseveres. Through hard work, she earns her father’s approval and uncovers a past connection between him and Zheng. As the older generation retires, Chen Mian is ready to represent China at the 2022 Winter Olympics.

~~ Dedicated to the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics.

Ai Si Xi, the innkeeper who firmly believes in staying single, finds herself embroiled in an absurd lawsuit that labels her as a "single exemplar" targeted by the authorities. Grateful for her past kindness, Jing Kan is compelled to marry Ai Si Xi to help her out of her predicament. 

Initially thinking they could go their separate ways after marriage, the "little couple" instead get caught up in the power struggles of the Jing family, a prominent local tea-producing household. Under the roof of the Jing family, every member is peculiar in their own way: the outwardly serene but sharp-minded grandmother Wei Jun Yi, the power-hungry and ruthless stepmother Luo Xu Si, the self-important and pampered eldest sister Jing Zhen Zhu the vain and two-faced maidservant Lv Jiao, the arrogant and unruly younger brother Luo A Ji, and the submissive and crafty son-in-law Lin Dong Lin.

Facing…

In 1992, Xiao Jin, a staff member at the Harbin 731 Museum, discovered incomplete records while organizing historical materials, thus embarking on a transnational journey to uncover the long-buried truth. The film returns to Harbin during the Japanese invasion of China, using the perspectives of multiple participants to profoundly expose the brutal human experiments and crimes against humanity committed by Unit 731, condemning the evils of militarism and highlighting the indomitable spirit of the Chinese people.

Two boggling mysteries have occurred in a small town in Xinan. A female police captain joins hands with a young detective to conduct an investigation. Although a clear motive can be seen, the two discover a series of unknown secrets.

One case involves a late-night ride hailed through an online platform that goes terribly wrong. As more and more clues resurface, the cases in the hands of the police hands become complicated and entangled. In a desperate attempt to find the real culprit, events closely link the past, present, and future of the small town.

~~ Loosely adapted from a true story involving a ride-hailing murder case

A story that details the the lives of ordinary civilians amidst the magnanimous changes in Chinese society over the years. At the end of the 1970s, the Zhou family lived in a provincial city in the north. The father, Zhu Zhi Gang, has just participated in the Third Front Movement in Xi Nan. The eldest son, Zhou Bing Yi, responds to a national call to become part of the first batch of "educated" youths sent to live and work in rural areas. The eldest daughter, Zhou Rong, follows her poet husband to the countryside of Guizhou. The youngest son, Zhou Bing Kun, is the only one left at home with their mother.

In the span of 50 years, the Zhou family is swept by the tides of change in China. Zhou Bing Yi entered politics after graduating from university and experienced ups and downs in his career during the drastic reforms. Zhou Rong stays on to teach after receiving her Ph.D. She has a…

Li Meng Jue and Xie Jing Shu became a contractual "hundred-day couple" due to the Huachao Tower Incident. In the eyes of outsiders, the two are deeply in love and well-matched. Li Meng Jue possesses the dignity and elegance of a real lady, while Xie Jing Shu is considerate and gentle despite having limited mobility. But who knew that the two were already harboring malicious intentions towards each other and plotting against each other?

Li Meng Jue is actually a scout under the Suoming Sect who infiltrated the Huachao Tower to investigate the "Tianshu Case". Likewise, Xie Jing Shu is concealing his identity as a Northern Marquis and pretending to be a wealthy businessman and playboy until one dark and stormy night when the two of them look at each other with smiles on their faces, and Li Meng Jue gives herself away. The couple, who has been pretending to be loving, instantly sheds their…

Muyang Technology's Tan Mu, to make up for the regret of his father's death, returned to the university era in 2010 through memory. As Qi Mu, a student of Ningzhou University, he met Su Cheng Cheng, who was also a student. They experienced university life together and finally reaped friendship and love.

A modern-day office worker wakes up in the body of a noble princess, unloved by all, including her cold new husband, Prince Ling. Branded a villain and suspected in the death of his mother, she fights back with wit, introducing stand-up comedy and scripted mysteries to gain the people's favor. As her antics draw Prince Ling’s attention, the two begin to uncover the truth behind his mother’s tragic death.

To avenge his father, Xu Bei Sheng goes undercover as the warlord’s adopted son, plotting to sabotage an arranged marriage between the Xu and Zhou families by getting close to Zhou Meng Huan. But as genuine feelings grow, their relationship spirals into a destructive cycle of love and revenge, culminating in a tragic downfall amidst the turmoil of war and power struggles.

Living under a false identity as a live-in son-in-law, Ye Chen hides his past as the heir to a powerful family. As he rises through high society to uncover the truth behind his parents' murder, he battles hidden enemies and forms unexpected alliances.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shang Men Long Xu" (上门龙婿) by Ye Gong Zi (叶公子).

Mu Xia is a talented locksmith. While dealing with a strange murder case within a locked room, Qin Zuo Man inadvertently discovers that Mu Xia is the new security consultant hired by the police academy. As more locked room cases arise, the simple-minded Qin Zuo Man, the monotonous Mu Xia and celebrity cop Tan You join hands to form an investigative team that seeks to uncover the truth through every door.

Ai Chang An and Shen Xia represent Huaqi employees along with other college students who have joined the company as interns. Their stories are connected to the Chinese automobile industry from which their livelihoods depended on.

In the mid-1980s, a group of college graduates came to an automobile factory located in the northwest to start their internship. Shen Xia, who intended to study abroad, witnessed the development of the 7-ton truck and decided to stay. Together with Ai Chang An, a young technician at the factory, they begin their journey to turning the tide for the industry. The market is ruthless such that the new generation of dedicated men and women face countless difficulties. The backbone of Huaqi has almost been completely dug out by opponents.

Shen Xia and Ai Chang An make bold choices to reform old mechanisms and develop new trucks. They eventually gain a foothold in…

In her previous life, Jiang Song Chu died in an earthquake. The husband she had never truly cared about, Zhou Qi An, instead chose to quietly watch over her until the end.

Given a second chance at life, Jiang Song Chu returns to four years earlier, to the time when she and Zhou Qi An had been married for just one year through a whirlwind marriage. This time, she decisively cuts ties with the charming but shallow Lin Tian and reunites with Zhou Qi An.

Jiang Song Chu soon confirms that Zhou Qi An has not been reborn like she has. Armed with the experiences of her previous life, she quickly realizes that beneath Zhou Qi An’s serious and proper exterior as a university professor lies feelings for her that he has harbored for a long time. However, his overly restrained and principled nature was precisely why she noticed nothing in her last life.

Determined not to repeat her regrets, Jiang…
dramas.t: Shi Zhou Jiao Shou Xian Dong Xin

dramas.syn:
All encounters in this world are reunions after a long absence.

~~ Adapted from the comic "Wan Zha Chao Huang" (万渣朝凰) by Shi Dai Man Wang (时代漫王).

Xu Tian was a 21-year-old young man. He carried on the revolutionary predecessors' beliefs, and to fulfill their entrustment, he went all the way from southeast Asia to Shanghai to deliver the materials to Communist International. In this arduous journey, he went through hardships and setbacks with Sun, Yu Yi Xiu, Zhang Jia Yi, and many others. Finally, he managed to finish the task. The smiles on their faces reflected their firm belief and their hopes for a bright future.

Spanning a decade from 2008 to 2018, this story follows Han Yong Qiang, a chauffeur for Li Xue Dong, a director of Cheng Yang city’s  Economic Development Zone Management Committee. After “marrying” his boss's mistress, Lin Jun, Han Yong Qiang’s fate takes a dark turn. Navigating between the edges of power and evil, he evolves from a mere “pawn” into a “chess master” after going through oppression and murders, eventually forcing his boss to commit suicide and becoming a triad leader bound by blood and vested interests.

In 2018, an investigation regarding the incident of Han Yong Qiang’s daughter, Han Yong Yu’s fall from a building, exposed his shocking ability to manipulate public opinion and interfere with justice, which facilitated his crimes to their peak. Nevertheless, justice, no matter how late, shall always prevail. 

Led by criminal investigation police officer, Gao Yuan, a…

General Yun Shu, who is known as the "living king of hell", meets Song Huan Bei, who approaches her as a male lover, while on a mission. Song Huan Bei is the leader of Qian Ji Pavilion, the first intelligence agency in the martial arts world, and is determined to find the murderer of the Mo family tragedy. Yun Shu, an orphan of the Mo family disguised as a man, falls in love with him during the test...

~~ Adapted from the web manhua "Love in Blossom" (君面似桃花) by Huang Fan Fan (黄烦烦) and Ji Wu Yun (季无云).

Jiang Wan Zhi and Ximen Li Chen, the prince of a scientific research family, were having an underground love affair.

They dated for three months in college and then broke up for three years. Jiang Wan Zhi was forced to marry the playboy of the Fu family. She drove her fiancé and lover to the hotel on a rainy night, but she didn't expect that the noble man sitting in the luxury car that was hit by the car accident was actually her ex-boyfriend who had been dumped.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jing Zhi Yu Ye" (京枝欲夜) by Tan Qing Zhu (檀青竹).

The Night Guard was an important force in the border defence and intelligence system of the Ming Dynasty and was mainly responsible for sentry and reconnaissance. "Ye Bu Shou" appeared in the Yuan Dynasty dramas. Its establishment began in the third year of Xuande (1428) in the Ming Dynasty and was cancelled in the first year of Tianqi (1621). It got its name because of activities outside all night. 

Mainly stationed in military towns on the western and northern borders, they are also distributed in other areas. As the sentinel and spy arm of the border defence army, they play an important role in detecting enemy situations, transmitting intelligence, burning wasteland, making surprise attacks, and ensuring border security.

One of the important sources of night harvest is the Dun army stationed in and around the pier. According to Liu Xiaozu's "Four Towns and Three Passes", the number…

Bai You You and Yu Zi Heng, a couple for four years, face a painful breakup on the eve of graduation when Yu Zi Heng proposes ending their relationship. After dealing with betrayal and her parents' divorce, Bai You You hits rock bottom, but is supported by her best friend, Gao Shang, who secretly loves her. Meanwhile, Yu Zi Heng, trying to save his family from debt, enters a fake relationship with Zheng Ni Na to discourage Bai You You from longing for him.

Hu Kan Kan and Xie Ruo Lin, who have never interacted despite attending the same school, are forced into a new family bond after their parents marry. Kan Kan also becomes entangled with his teacher, Song Wei. The drama explores the dreams, struggles, love, and friendship of post-95s college students like Bai You You, Yu Zi Heng, Hu Kan Kan, and Xie Ruo Lin.

Many years ago, Gu Tian Cheng’s father’s cosmetics company, Medea, was taken over by his uncle, Gu Rong Zhen. After years of working in corporate acquisitions at a multinational financial firm, Gu Tian Cheng finally sets his sights on reclaiming Medea.

Just as he is about to succeed, his health suddenly deteriorates, and he is forced to undergo surgery. During the procedure, he receives a heart transplant from Du Zheng, the fiancé of Lin Jia Qi. After the operation, Gu Tian Cheng begins to experience a drastic change in personality, seemingly caused by a rare form of “cell memory disorder.”

Once cold and hostile, especially toward his female secretary, he becomes noticeably kinder, particularly to Jia Qi. As he develops unfamiliar emotions and a growing connection to her, a gentler side of him gradually emerges.

In the 20th year of the Great Chu Dynasty, Shen Ye, the illegitimate son of the Empress, seeks revenge and plans to place his lover, Shu Cheng, on the throne. But Shu Cheng, unwilling to cause more bloodshed, convinces Shen Ye to abandon his rebellion, and they both retire. After Shu Cheng's apparent death in battle, Shen Ye becomes the ruthless regent, obsessed with reclaiming him. Eight years later, Shen Ye, now in hiding as Wang Shu, encounters Mo Hui, a princess who looks strikingly like Shu Cheng. Believing her to be his lost love, Shen Ye’s quest for the past reignites, drawing him and his former allies into a new web of fate and love.

Huace Media's project 'The Legendary Tycoon' will be based on the life of Sir Run Run Shaw, to showcase the tycoon's legendary life using the most beautiful cinematography, to depict the story of a man and his enduring love with three women in his life. It will also reproduce the golden era of fashion and style in the changing landscape of that era.

An extraordinary story about finding love follows an ordinary university student who experiences the shock of her life when she realizes that she has become a man!

Jiang Nan Xue has been having some frustrations when it comes to love and friendship. Things take a turn for the worse when a chance encounter causes her to have the appearance of a handsome young man. Adjusting to her new gender is difficult and she also has to live with Lu He who seems to hate her with a passion. Yet as time passes, both come to realize that they might just be each other's one true love.

He Su Su, a girl majoring in archaeology, accidentally traveled back in time to Tian Shi Kingdom in a landslide accident, and became a girl on the run. He Su Su had only two thoughts at that moment: one survive, and two find a way back to her time.  When she runs into Pottery Master Song Yi Chen during a confrontation with spies, she accidentally kills one which leads him to believe she's in league with the spies. In order to keep tabs on her he enrolls her in his clay pottery class, and their love story begins.

A story about Shanghai citizens is told from the perspective of Feng Xiao Qin and Gu Qing Yu, two sisters-in-law who work through their differences to grow closer in the quagmire of life.

It has been ten years since Feng Xiao Qin came to the Gu family while pregnant with a child to become their new daughter-in-law. The family's eldest daughter, Gu Qing Yu, has always been wary of her and believes that Feng Xiao Qin has "ambition" written all over her face. Feng Xiao Qin urges her husband, Gu Lei, to borrow money from his twin sister Gu Qing Yu so they can buy a house. Gu Qing Yu cleverly evades the request by revealing her plan to buy a luxury house. 

After Gu Lei dies unexpectedly, the conflicts between the two sisters-in-law continue to escalate. As a single mom, Feng Xiao Qin is desperate, yet the trials that she faces allow her to realize her true potential. Meanwhile, Gu Qing Yu…
dramas.t: Life Is a Long Quiet River

dramas.syn:
A story that follows a married couple during their "trial period" and the mother-in-law who turns into a "strict examiner" to put the relationship between the newlyweds to the test.

Beijing drifter Ying Bao walked down the aisle on her wedding day wearing the jade bracelet that her mother-in-law gave her. On her honeymoon, she discovers that the bracelet in her possession is a fake and she becomes extremely anxious at the thought of losing a valuable family heirloom that was also a seal of her mother-in-law's approval.

Ying Bao's husband Shi Da Yan, mother-in-law Li Shuang Qin and many others are pulled into a commotion over the real and fake bracelets especially when there turns out to be more than one. When the secret is revealed, a change in the fate of a family from turbulent to prosperous times emerges. Everyone realizes that although the jade bracelet is precious, it can never…

Love story between the elite domineering president of the financial investment industry and the beautiful boss of the live broadcast company. They have known each other since childhood and grew up together, separated by two places for various reasons in adulthood, and met again through a love bracelet and began a sweet love story.
This drama tells the story of forensic doctor Dai Yu, who dares not take off his gloves, and criminal policeman Zheng Ming, who dares not shoot, who join forces to fight crime and grow up together.

Ye Qing Ru is a blind girl, who by a twist of fate becomes pregnant with the child of the River God. Despite her ordinariness, Qing Ru and the River God fall in love...

~~ Adapted from the novel "Xuan Men Jiao Qi You Mei You Sa" (玄门娇妻又美又飒) by Ming Yue Jing Que (明月惊鹊).

After taking over his family’s company, Tan Jian Fei becomes locked in a corporate power struggle with his former lover Li Shu Jing, reigniting old feelings—unaware that she has returned to uncover the truth behind her father’s death, turning their romance into a dangerous game of love and revenge.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Huo Guo Ai Tang Yuan" (火锅爱汤圆) by Ye Yi Jian (叶亦健).

To save her gravely ill sister, Tang Mian accepts a million-yuan mission — to secretly photograph Shang You Ting — but ends up being chosen by him instead. To escape, she takes on another job worth five million: to seduce the crippled young master Yin Fei Yun, only to be drawn into a web of conspiracy. When she discovers that the affectionate “cripple” and the ruthless tycoon are actually the same person, a dangerous game of deception and redemption begins, where revenge and desire intertwine.

Orphan Mai Tian saves an injured, amnesiac crown prince and enters a fake marriage with him to escape an unwanted imperial decree. As they grow closer, their contractual union blossoms into genuine love, and together they work to restore her family’s honor.

"The Lost Swordship" revolves around a martial arts expert who experiences defeat at the hands of his enemies and gains the help of an old man. He joins the righteous alliance and embarks on a journey to become a true hero.

~~  Adapted from the novel by Gu Long.

Aspiring painter Wen Qian invites bar singer Bai Ji Ran to be her model but is repeatedly rejected. Sent to Chengdu to retrieve a family heirloom for her father, she unexpectedly crosses paths with Bai Ji Ran again. He recognizes her from childhood, though she doesn’t remember him. After Wen Qian loses all her belongings and Bai Ji Ran tries to escape his fans, the two embark on a journey together to protect a mysterious brocade bag tied to Wen Qian’s family business. Amid danger and close calls, their bickering gives way to an unexpected romance.

Mute Mo Yun was accidentally involved in the Quan Yu Xi's family struggle. The two gradually became in love with each other in the process of getting along, but they have been suffering from many sides. But the straw that broke the camel's back was miscarriage, after which Mo Yun decided to go abroad.  Desperate Quan Yu Xi decide to take revenge on his own family, because of that. But what he didn't predicted, is that Mo Yun will back,  much stronger, and thirsty for bloody revenge.

Based on the preliminary storyline posted on the web, the male lead is an ad director, rides motorcycle, roller-blade skating and temporarily loses his vision.

The female lead loses her hearing at 18 yrs. old. Her world changes, but she didn't give up. When true love comes, how should she face him? Although she has already had a guy staying by her side since youth and she even thinks that they will be together for this life.

The story centers around the three ladies, the career elite Lei Li, the full-time wife Ren Duo Mei, and the socially adorable Shen Jia Nan are facing dilemma in the workplace and life. They are of different ages and personalities, and has no overlapping experiences, but became close friends who knew each other, fight each other and loved each other. Together, they face optimistically amidst the thorns along the way, witnessing each other growth, and join hands to embark on a new journey to find happiness.

Sang Chu Zhi's childhood sweetheart and fiancé, Shen Zhi Jin, sent her to his uncle Shang Yu Zhou's bed in order to attract investment. Sang Chu Zhi gave up on love and gave in to the "business deal" with one goal in mind: to become her ex's new aunt. Unexpectedly, the indifferent Shang Master accepted the deal and took responsibility. However, what everyone thought was a business deal was actually a long-term plan crafted by Shang Yu Zhou.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "You Liao You Diao, Ling Zheng Hou Wo Bei Shang Ye Qin Hong Wen" (又撩又钓，领证后我被商爷亲红温), also known as "Lao Po Guai, Bu Xu Xi Huan Qian Nan You" (老婆乖，不许喜欢前男友), by Wang Fan Xing (望繁星).

The story of a journey to find the key to the king's city, the jade screen. Teams in the adventure, unlock secrets about the xixia dynasty at the same time, also with the dark forces to juggle, explored dangerous on the road, practice the ability of a suit "extreme sports". Among them, as the captain, tang feng, is more open all the way: racing car, rock climbing, running cool, bicycle and so on all can be called "all-around sports boy".

J who is born in a family of genius is eccentric and unsociable, he likes to skip classes and study weird formulas, a problematic student. He disappeared after he deliberately cuts his own face as an act of self-harming in front of his classmates. After a few months, a new transfer student, Chu Xia goes to find J under the instruction of her teacher to send him a letter. In the process, she discovers that J’s house is very mysterious. During his disappearance, China’s telecommunication companies are involved in a heated business battle.

Li Fu Yuan returns to her hometown years after her brother’s suspicious death, teaming up with a seemingly carefree magistrate to uncover the truth behind a long-unsolved case.

~~ Adapted from the short story "Shen Xiao Guan Yi Niao Hai Qi Ming" (沈小官一鸟害七命) in the book “Yu Shi Ming Yan” (喻世明言) compiled by Feng Meng Long (馮夢龍).

Gu Shi Yu devoted six years of her youth to giving birth to her daughter, and her relationship, but still couldn't  become a wife to her other half and her child father.  Her mother-in-law's violence and her boyfriend's suspected cheating, made her even more cold and unease.  Soon, Gu Shi Yu  ends up in car accident, and as an result of it, she  loses her memory. Trying to regain her memories and plagued by nightmares, she soon meets a man who gives her some hope for a better life, and finding the truth. But can Shi Yu fully trust him?

This story's heroine is Qiao An, but it's kinda told through the eyes of her friend, Ni Hao. Qiao An used to be from a wealthy family, but then something happened; her dad ran away, and now she's working from the bottom up. She's a real power woman, cold on the outside. She goes to apply for a job at Lu Yuan Yang's company, but because he once worked for her father and knows of her position, he refuses her.

During the Jiajing reign of the Ming Dynasty, the Jiajing Emperor was incompetent, and the court was dominated by the corrupt Yan faction. Corruption ran rampant within the government, and coastal pirates terrorized the shores. The entire political landscape was firmly controlled by Yan Shi Fan, son of the treacherous Grand Secretary Yan Song, placing the Ming Dynasty in grave peril. After the abbot Guan Hai of the Shaolin Temple retired to the Dharma Cave, the Shaolin monks were troubled by the national crisis and uncertain about the future.

Three new secular disciples—Cheng Wen Dao, Gao Jian Xiong, and Hai Da Li—each had a personal vendetta against Yan Song and Yan Shi Fan for the destruction of their families. Due to their exceptional talents, they were assigned to train in martial arts, medicine, and Zen at the Dharma Hall, Medicine Bureau, and Prajna Hall. Seeking to control…

A former elite detective, Cheng Bing, is sent to prison after an interrogation accident, shattering his career and his team, the Third Brigade. Ten years later, he is released, stripped of everything, while the true culprit, Wang Da Yong, remains free. Reuniting with his former teammates, Cheng Bing sets out on a relentless pursuit of justice, rediscovering purpose and the value of life along the way.

~~ Adapted from the non-fiction novel "Qing Zhuan Gao Ju Zhang, San Da Dui Ren Wu Wan Cheng Le" (请转告局长，三大队任务完成了) by Shen Lan (深蓝).

After returning home to revive her mother’s failing restaurant, Ren Xi Zhou reunites with her estranged high school classmate Xiang Nan Feng. As they work together to save the restaurant and confront their past misunderstandings, they heal old wounds and find the courage to embrace a new beginning.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Zhe Fu" (蛰伏) by Rao Xue Man (饶雪漫).

In 1933, a Communist spy meeting was betrayed. Agent Chen Qian Li races to uncover the traitor and secure a critical mission amid relentless enemy pursuit.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Qian Li Jiang Shan Tu" (千里江山图) by Sun Gan Lu (孙甘露).
dramas.t: A Panorama of Rivers and Mountains

dramas.syn:
After a devastating betrayal that costs her everything and nearly her life, Lian Xin Ruo, a wealthy merchant’s daughter, returns years later disguised as a famous singer. Partnering with Pei Yu Ze, the enigmatic man who saved her, she embarks on a calculated and thrilling quest for justice and revenge.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yi Pin Ming Yuan" (一品名媛) by Yi Lv Xiang Si (一缕相思).

Ye Chun Meng is a talented medical intern who is hardworking and determined, even the so-called "demon mentor", Zhou Ming secretly acknowledges her effort. However, she feels inferior because of her poor family background as she came from a small town. Thus, there was once a time when surviving and staying in the hospital became her only life goal.
During her internship, she was once sensitive to the superior background of Chen Xi and Bai Xiao Qing, she also wavered before when faced with a temptation that can reduce 10 years of hard work in the hospital and also hesitated before in front of the tough romance between her and her mentor, Zhou Ming. But in the end, under the guidance of Zhou Ming and through the process of curing her patients, Ye Chun Meng found herself and discovers the happiness and significance of being a doctor. She finally understands the true meaning of happiness.…

On the eve of the launch of a new product, the chairman of Dama Group suddenly goes missing. As the first heir to the group, Chu Xing Yu is forced to take over the company and handle the crisis. Meanwhile, upon receiving the news, Duan Jing Ze rushes back to the country overnight, disguising himself as the chairman's secretary. A real-life game of Werewolf is about to unfold. Faced with the enigmatic Duan Jing Ze and the "werewolves" lurking within the group, how will Chu Xing Yu win this "game"?
dramas.t: Why Did Secretary Duan Behave Like That?

dramas.syn:
Tang Ying once gave up her career to become a full-time housewife for her husband. Five months pregnant, she was humiliated and thrown out by him and his mistress. After their divorce, she married the charismatic Jiang Ci Yun, who helped her grow stronger. The two entered a marriage first and fell in love later, joining forces to take revenge on her ex-husband and the mistress—ultimately achieving success in both career and love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhao Re" (招惹) by Su Zhen You (苏贞又).

Roland Academy is a very old and super elite school where rich and powerful send their children. When three sets of alumni receive an anonymous letter alerting them that their school will be shut down due to outside influence, they send their children to investigate.

Xu Xing Lan, a new employee in the workplace, accidentally traveled to ancient times and became bound to her target, Yu Wen Yan, the second young master of Anjin City! By mistake, they started a cat-and-mouse game of love and hate. And she used modern thinking to start a wonderful journey from the "first female killer" to the "first female official" in Anjin City.

Female Doctor Sheng Xia is in a hurry to get married and bear children due to a hereditary disease. CEO Qiu Yang went through two failed marriages and now even experiences a crisis at work. To save his company, Qiu Yang is being forced to marry. Thereupon, he ends up in a contract marriage with his neighbor Sheng Xia. In the end, the two come to have a new understanding of what marriage means and learn to sincerely love.

The teenagers in the play show courage and growth when facing friendship, love, academics and life choices. Their passionate, youthful and energetic images will bring endless touching and inspiration to the audience.
dramas.t: Dynamic Enthusiasm: Boys Over Flowers in Beijing

dramas.syn: After transmigrating into the body of a burial concubine destined to die, modern graduate Lu Zhen Er refuses to accept her fate. When she discovers that the puppet emperor Xiao Wen Jing is from her hometown, the two become entwined in a dangerous struggle against destiny—one in which he may be the only person who can change, or seal, her future.

In 2017, army aviation pilot Lu Yi Hang and elite tank soldier Han Jia Liang meet during a terrorist attack while attending a military exchange abroad. After returning home, they are assigned to test the advanced “Sun Wu System” battlefield command platform, forcing the two rivals to train and work together despite their misunderstandings. Through intense tank-versus-helicopter exercises and various military missions, they gradually learn to trust each other and grow as soldiers.

Facing challenges such as disaster relief operations, cross-branch combat training, and large-scale military drills, the pair sharpen their skills within a newly formed synthetic battalion. After defeating the powerful Blue Army Lynx Brigade in an important exercise, they later join an overseas peacekeeping mission where life-and-death experiences strengthen their bond and turn them into outstanding commanders…

After Tan Shu Yu, the adopted daughter of the Gu family, was murdered by her fiancé, she was reborn and returned to the night she eloped with her fiancé three months ago. Suddenly, she realized that Gu Si Ye was the one who had been protecting her. But will Gu Si Ye, who has been hurt by Tan Shu Yu, believe Tan Shu Yu's love for him?

dramas.nt: 原来你就是我的命中注定
dramas.syn:
The countdown to their contract marriage is on! Loyal CEO Nie Ling Feng, to protect his beloved wife Gu Ya Shan, disguises himself as a bodyguard to stay close by her side—almost ending up fooling himself in the process!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zai Si Gui Zong Cai Huai Zhong Shi Chong Er Jiao" (在死鬼总裁怀中恃宠而骄) by Shui Ling Long (水玲珑).

Shen Qing and Lu Zhi Yuan's family have been at odds for over 10 years, fighting over whose family makes the best tea, but now, Shen Lan, Shen Qing's sister, has been arranged to marry Lu Zhi Yuan. Not willing to marry, Shen Lan runs away on her wedding day, much to Shen Qing's disappointment. He had planned to have his sister use this opportunity to enter the Lu household and find the secret behind their family's tea. With her gone, Shen Qing decides to dress as a woman and marry Zhi Yuan in his sister's place. Will he be able to find the secret to the tea and use that information to improve the Shen family's tea?

~~ Two versions available: 30 episodes (Original) || 6 episodes (International)

During the Republican era, a wealthy heiress loses her entire family in a massacre. Twenty years later, she returns as the First Madam of Mo City. On her path of revenge, she forms a blood pact with a proud dragon prince and a cunning jiao dragon. The two become her protectors and silently fall in love with her. Later, a dashing detective joins the race for her heart. With three men vying for her affection, she reopens the investigation into her family’s tragedy. Thus begins a legendary Republican tale of love and vengeance.

Zhao Zhan, an expert swordsman, saves the life of Justice Bao Zhen during the Northern Song Dynasty and is rewarded for his brave deed. But Ji Pang, an evil minister who is hungry for power, uses Zhan’s name to provoke a group of legendary swordsmen known as the Five Mice of Xian Kong Island. Bai Yu Tang leads the Five Mice to the capital to locate Zhan and seek revenge. During their journey, the five swordsmen hear about the evil doings of Ji Pang and his son and decide to go to Chen Zhou to deal with them first. When Justice Bao is framed by his enemies and put in prison, Zhan is left to protect the Song Dynasty on his own. Zhan needs the help of the Five Mice to protect the court against their mutual enemies, but how willing will Yu Tang be to help when the two men get entangled in a love triangle with Ding Yue Hua, a beautiful woman who wields a deadly sword better than any of her…
dramas.t: The Three Heroes and Five Gallants

dramas.syn: When Tong Si Jie becomes an orphan at an early age, she struggles and has to work different jobs to take care of her siblings. Then she meets the rich Yi Yi – a love that seems to be written in the stars. Just when Si Jie and Yi Yi decide they want to stay together forever, Yi Yi’s dominant mother interferes in their relationship, spreading lies that drift the two lovers apart.

Su Qiang Wei was originally a well-known obstetrician and gynecologist, but she was fired by the hospital because of her ex-husband's lover. Her hand was injured, and she could no longer perform surgery. She heard that the well-known overbearing boss's family was recruiting a physical therapist for his grandmother, and went to apply for the high salary. But she didn't realise that Huo Si Ting was looking for a wife, and she had always thought she was just applying to be the family doctor.
dramas.t: Qing Dui Wo Xin Dong Ba

dramas.nt: 去你的世界再爱我一次
dramas.syn: Fang Jian Jian and Lu Ze are lovers who met and fell in love at university and successfully married, but behind the perfect love, lies a crisis. An accident caused Lu Ze to fall into a coma. In order to save and wake up her beloved spouse, Fang Jian Jian sought the help of brain expert Dr. Song, and participated in Dr. Song's brain-computer experiment. Through technology, she enters her lover brain, and to save him, she must re-experience three, crucial for them both memories.

A boy loses an arm in childhood, and a cheerful girl grows up as neighbors over two decades. Their intertwined lives, marked by mutual rescue and growth through life's trials, culminate in a comic, "My Crab Girl", reuniting them and unveiling a decade of hidden affection.

~~ Adapted from the novel "My Mister Ostrich" (我的鸵鸟先生) by Han Yan (含胭).

dramas.nt: 校花前传之很纯很暧昧
