dramas.syn: The story of an everyday student stumbling into possession of technologically advanced contact lenses that endue the wearer with special learning abilities. Once worn, his world will never be the same. Based on the same-named Chinese book series.

Ye Ran loves drawing manga but can only accept handsome guys from the world of anime. She actively avoids handsome guys in the real world and lacks confidence. Unexpectedly, her immediate superior, Meng Zhao, is not only a fan of her manga but also the most feared handsome guy in her life. Terrified, Ye Ran tries to avoid him, but Meng Zhao relentlessly pursues, leading to a comical and unconventional romantic relationship between the two.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Quan Shi Jie Dou Zhi Dao He Zong Xi Huan Lin Mi Shu" (全世界都知道贺总喜欢林秘书) by Qu Bu Zhi (曲不知).

Corporate drone Dr. Zhang Zi Qi accidentally enters a "fantastical" game and becomes the wealthy Li family's daughter, Li Chun Ri. Initially eager to indulge in the luxurious life of a young mistress, she soon finds out she's been designated as a sacrifice. Unexpectedly, she forms a symbiotic bond with the assassin Ling Xing He. In order to return to reality, they must kill each other. Behind this absurd domestic struggle lies yet another sinister conspiracy.

~~ Adapted from the game "Jian Xia Qing Yuan" (剑侠情缘) produced by Seasun (西山居).
It tells the story of a group of hot-blooded young adults who grow up as brothers and fight for their dreams during the tug-of-war movement.

Despite his fierce appearance, the kind-hearted Gou Ling Feng dreams of becoming a hero. After accidentally mastering demonic martial arts, he faces prejudice but joins forces with Ma Ying Dan and Zhuge Heng to solve mysteries. Along the way, he learns that true heroism transcends labels and continues his journey to become the hero he aspires to be.

Han Ning is a young detective who was inspired to join the police after his sister was murdered seven years earlier. Gifted with an extraordinary talent for criminal profiling, Han Ning is able to immerse himself in a criminal's psychological perspective and accurately reconstruct the sequence of a crime. While this remarkable ability makes him indispensable in solving numerous cold cases, it also forces him to walk a fine line between reason and emotion.

As a member of Major Crimes Unit Two, Han Ning works alongside teammates driven by different ideals and responsibilities. The decisive and action-oriented captain Ren Fei leads the team with unwavering resolve, while the reserved and highly experienced He Lai provides invaluable guidance and insight.

As new criminal cases become intertwined with long-buried secrets from the past, the team pursues justice together, demonstrating that…

The story follows He Jun, a hard-working detective who meets a young and passionate criminal profiler named Gu Ming Zhe. Gu Ming Zhe's life begins to change when he unexpectedly finds a mysterious old phone that connects him to a certain Cao Zheng, a clumsy yet resolute detective who unbeknownst to Gu Ming Zhe, has been missing for 20 years and is calling from the year 1998. The team then takes on the task of resolving impossible cold cases.

The story follows 21st-century man Lin Wan Rong who is touring around Mount Tai when he accidentally falls into a dark space, transferring him to a parallel world, existing at the same time as the Song dynasty. In this world, many historical facts are in contrary to what is written in historical books. For instance, Xiang Yu defeated Liu Ban at the Battle of Gaixia and never committed suicide, as a result. While he’s described as smart and generous, he also enjoys joking and playing around as much as the next person. Using his economics wits, modern knowledge, and a whole layer of thick skin, he’s able to rise to become a lord of his own. However, with money and power, he inadvertently gets entangled in a power struggle between the royal members and somehow finds himself leading a troop to war.

~~ Adapted from a web novel of the same name by Yu Yan.

A tired modern-day doctor sneezes and finds herself back in time to the ancient Kingdom of Xiyue. She is now living as the prime minister’s daughter Gu Ming Yan and wife of the cold-hearted Second Prince, Duan Cheng Xuan. She learns he agreed to the marriage because Gu Ming Yan's blood can cure Duan Cheng Xuan's childhood friend from her illness. While not starting off seeing eye to eye, they gradually become attracted to each other. Gu Ming Yan becomes hesitant to accept her feelings knowing one day she may return back to her time.
A full-level demon lord teams up with a high-energy newbie human to raise a child and hunt spirits, rekindling family bonds through laughter, chaos, and heartfelt moments.
dramas.t: Mei Guan Xi Shi Jia Ren A

dramas.syn:
Yun Qi, a woman of unrestrained charm and countless admirers, was suddenly transported into a fictional tale that vilified her, becoming a universally despised and wicked heiress. Her cold-hearted husband abandoned her with a letter of divorce, her gloomy half-brother, whom she had once bullied, mocked her with disdain, and the hot-tempered prince she had once rejected now relentlessly pursued her. But not long after—Yun Qi chuckled, "Didn't everyone say they hated me? Now they're all vying to be my dogs."

~~ Adapted from the web novel "E Nv Xun Gou Wu Shu! Pan Gao Zhi! Yin Xiong Jing" (恶女训狗无数！攀高枝！引雄竞), also known as "Hao Nv Ren De Dao Ming Sheng, Huai Nv Ren De Dao Yi Qie" (好女人得到名声，坏女人得到一切), by Tao Hua Ying Jiu (桃花映酒).

The drama mainly tells the story of Gu Nuan, an illegitimate daughter of the Gu family, who found out that her boyfriend had cheated on her sister Gu Ling. Her mother was pushed down the stairs by Gu's father and wanted to murder, so she vowed to take back everything that belonged to her. Zhen appears and wants to contract with Gu Nuan to marry. It seems that Gu Nuan wants to take revenge, but Wen Ren Zhen actually hides a secret.

Two people who meet by chance uncover conspiracies from the past. How will they choose between love and doing what's right?

As Meng Yao and Sheng Wei Yin get to know each other, they begin to unravel an earth-shattering conspiracy from five years ago. It involves an ex-boyfriend that went missing mysteriously and an intellectually superior green-eyed beluga. The couple who slowly fall for each other find themselves at the center of the schemes.

In this tale, a mythical Jade is said to cure all illnesses but carries a deadly curse that only the heart’s blood of a woman from the Ruan family can lift. To break his fate of dying before 30, Gu Sui Zhi devises a plan to make the orphaned Ruan Shu fall in love with him. As they struggle between love and redemption, they unknowingly awaken a past-life grudge.

The son of an aristocratic family Wang Yuan Feng is not interested in wealth or romance but is obsessed with solving cases. After he accidentally saves the kind-hearted and naive fox spirit Xiao Cui, she marries him to pay the debt of gratitude. Yuan Feng, however, stays away from her while Xiao Cui continuously makes trouble for him. When Yuan Feng later becomes county magistrate, she helps him with his investigations.
The mastermind behind the series of high-profile crimes in Chang'an has a nefarious plan for Samoyeds. Can the team spot the connections before it's too late?

Luo Wan Wan, the outspoken "chivalrous woman" and daughter of the Director of the Ministry of Rites, was involved in a murder case on the way to escape from marriage. She and her husband, Li Yi Chen, the young minister of Dali Temple, became a pair of "enemies" without knowing each other. In order to find out the truth, she disguised herself as a man in Dali Temple and became Li's assistant. Together, they fought crime, solved crimes, upheld justice, and developed an ironic romance.

Jiang Ruo Yan's father buried her alive with his own hands in order to inherit the family business. But she did not die and was rescued by seven mountain masters. Many years later, Jiang Ruo Yan goes down the mountain to prevent the domineering Zhan Jing Wang with whom she has a baby date from getting married to someone else. At the same time, her father and his illegitimate daughter continue to make things difficult for her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shan Hun Hou, Feng Pi Zhan Shao Mei Tian Chan Hong Wo Sheng Zai" (闪婚后，疯批战少每天缠哄我生崽) by Bei Yue Xiao Mu (北月小木).
dramas.t: Jiang Xiao Jie Ta Xia Shan Le

dramas.syn: Xia Meng Xun, Tang Chao, and Bai Zhou are three individuals from rich families brought together by 3 mysterious Buddha statues. They embarked on an adventure filled with dangers to uncover their family secrets and find love in the process.

Lin Wan Qing, the timid and hesitant leader of the Miduoduo Armed Escort Agency, infiltrates the supreme court as a part-time assassin to revive the agency. Su Mo Yi, the cold and ruthless official of the supreme court, plays along and gets acquainted with the kind Lin Wan Qing head-on. They join forces to investigate cases and protect the imperial city, ultimately achieving a successful love story that goes both ways.

Wei Hao, a top science and engineering student, unexpectedly transmigrates into the Dayong Dynasty and becomes the well-known “Wei Han Zi.” With his unique way of thinking, Wei Hao relies on modern knowledge to rise rapidly, amassing great wealth and even being granted a marquis title. In this other world, he breaks through obstacles and turns the tide, staging a hard-hitting and exhilarating ancient rise-to-power legend.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhen Guan Han Xu" (贞观憨婿) by Da Yan Xiao Jin Yu (大眼小金鱼).

Fang Hao Wen holds the cheapest weapon in Huanshi City— a pen. Though far from a bestselling author, his sharp words cut through the absurdities of everyday life. His brief rise to fame comes thanks to the admiration of powerful businesswoman Jin Fu Rong. But when he rejects her romantic advances, his fall from grace is swift and brutal.

A drunken tumble from a building turns into a staged suicide spectacle, catapulting him into viral fame. His former agent sees an opportunity and urges him to "sell death for clicks", using the scandal to boost his online popularity.

Just as their livestream scam gains traction, things spiral out of control with the arrival of Bie Fan, a book lover who idolizes Fang Hao Wen. Their chaotic meeting sparks the creation of the oddball duo “The Prisoners". Together, the washed-up writer and his fervent fan embark on a wild, darkly comic journey, trapped in…

Because of her father's medical expenses, Lin Mian is desperate and almost goes astray. Fortunately, she is saved by the kind-hearted doctor Shi Lin. Shi Lin is attracted by her weakness and strength, and builds a fortress of love for her to resist the darkness. Under Shi Lin's protection, Lin Mian transforms and grows, and the two welcome the light together.

Academy students Tao Sheng and Wang Sheng find themselves caught in a series of mysterious deaths. As they delve deeper, clues tied to the mythical "cat demon" and dark sorcery lead them to uncover a hidden web of corruption and academic deceit.

Explores the complex lives and struggles of people traveling through the Li Cheng train station, highlighting the intense conflict between good and evil with high-stakes action and intrigue throughout a series of thrilling railway anti-pickpocketing cases.

Wen Qian Su witnesses her scummy fiancé cheating with her stepsister, then gets kicked out of the house by her unprincipled father. Collapsing in front of Mr. Huo’s car during a stormy night, she wakes up expecting the rumored gentle and handsome Huo to serve her medicine. Instead, she finds that Huo is indeed gentle, caring, and gradually sticks to her, changing her life completely.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xin Ji Bing Jiao Zen Ke Neng Mei Lao Po! Lao Po Tian" (心机病娇怎可能没老婆！老婆甜) by Su Yu Liao (苏欲撩).

Lawyer Mu Qian and mediator Ou Yang decide to divorce due to lack of trust and mutual understanding. They have been given 30 days of cool-down period before the finalization of the divorce. Since the nature of their work and different cases they work on, the two of them frequently met in the workplace. 

While handling the divorce cases for some other couples, they come across the problems existing in their own marriage and realise the mistakes they have made. Can the two solve their problems in their marriage and fall in love again after 30 days?

Su Mu Yan is a descendant of the Northern Liang witch clan. According to the contract between the royal family and the witch clan, she was fated to marry the most unappreciated but pure Yang body of the ninth prince, Feng Luo Chen, even though the three princesses Feng Luo Chen had married before,  were all missing and rumored to have been killed by him.

In order to open up her spiritual roots and save her beloved, the Eighth Prince Feng Qi Yu, who is being held in Nan Yang, Su Mu Yan starts a “contract marriage” with the “God of Killers.” With her messy sorcery and her sincere heart, Su Lu Yan captures Feng Luo Chen step by step, gradually falling in love with him and unraveling the many conspiracies surrounding him.

Ma Qian Qiu, a modern woman, suddenly wakes up in the body of an ancient princess and is drawn into deadly palace power struggles. To protect herself, she strikes a deal with the cunning General Qin Che and pretends to be in love with him. As their alliance deepens, real feelings begin to grow, but hidden motives and dangerous secrets soon surface. Between returning to her own world or risking everything for him, Ma Qian Qiu must decide where her heart truly belongs.

A story about two sisters falling for one man after the younger sister asks the older sister to go on a date in her stead.

Ning Xia (Jiang Mengjie) is an ordinary office worker. She once saved Zhao Dan Qiao (Dennis Oh), a young executive who has been searching for her for years. She finds a job at his company though the two start out with their initial biases towards each other and oblivious to their connection in the past.

Ning Xia has been using the username Little Red Bean to keep in touch with a person named Shu Dong online. When she finds out that Zhao Dan Qiao is the person that she has been chatting with, she becomes suspicious and tells her cousin Ning Xin (Lu Jiarong) to meet with him instead. After being dumped by her ex-boyfriend for money and learning that Zhao Dan Qiao comes from a rich family, Ning Xin becomes determined to marry him and becomes a roadblock when Ning Xia…

A story in the entertainment industry follows a celebrity assistant assigned to five trainees who are preparing for their debut.

Qian Niao knows that she is ordinary in every way. After graduating from college, she submitted over 20 resumes to different companies to no avail. Fortunately, she finally lands a job at Lingxi Culture, a famous and reputable entertainment company. Her new job as a PA requires her to look after all aspects of the lives of five trainees that are preparing to debut as a group. Even though each of them are different, they have common goals, dreams and a passion for music and dance. In dealing with the five boys, Qian Niao finds love along the way.

Tells the story of Lin Chu Ning, an orphaned girl in the Republican era, who mistakenly believes that her dear friend Xiao Rou died at the hands of the playboy Lu Si Yen. To take revenge, she disguises herself as the Lu family’s daughter and assumes the role of Lu Si Yen’s twin sister, infiltrating the Lu household to carry out her plan.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shan Hun Hou, Wo Bei Da Shu Chong Shang Tian" (闪婚后，我被大叔宠上天) by Lin Chu Ning Lu Si Yan (林初宁陆司宴).

Heiress Zhao Chun Man infiltrates the Yuchun Opera House to avenge her father’s death, but when she’s killed by gang leader Zhou Chi and time resets, she finds herself trapped in a cycle of fate. As she unravels the truth and fights to change her ending, an unexpected romance begins to bloom between them.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "You Feng Qi Wu" (有凤栖梧) by Yu Lou Chun (雨楼春).

The story of a father who separates with his daughter, their love, hate and reconciliation.

Sun Jia Yuan is a tough woman who tries to escape the harsh life of poverty with a strong passion to gain success, overcome her lower status and rise in society. On the road to fulfill her dream, she cuts ties with her poor family and incompetent father who still love his daughter despite her bitterness.

Lawyer Xiao Mu Chen died on November 11,  1999,  while trying to protect his fiancée Chen Bao Shan. Driven by guilt, Bao Shan decides to end her life. But instead of dying, she travels back in time to September 11, 1999. Initially, she tries to do everything to save her beloved. Unfortunately, stuck now in the time loop, no matter what she does, each time her fiancé dies. Seeing no solution to the time loop, Bao Shan decides that the best course of action is to remove herself from the Mu Chen's life, hoping that if their paths never cross, he will live. However, to her surprise, fate makes both of them unable to escape from each other and their paths cross again. Will they find their happy ending this time?

Xie Yan Li has secretly admired and loved Lou Ruan for years, but she has eyes only for Zhou Yue Tian. A momentary encounter gives him an opportunity to capture her attention and perhaps earn her love. As each person deals with the rippling effects of their choices, an old love is lost, a path once taken reaches its conclusion, a quiet and committed love is revealed, and a chance of new love blooms.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ruan You" (软诱), also known as "Mei Gui Guan Mian" (玫瑰冠冕), by Jiu Jiu Qi (久久萋).

Betrayed by someone close to her, Yu Luo dies filled with resentment. After being reborn, she vows to take back control of her life, using memories from her past to make waves in the financial world. However, fate intervenes, and she finds herself once again entangled with Liao You Ting—the same dark figure who haunted her previous life.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Hao Men Chong Sheng: Zong Cai Fu Ren Tai Biao Han" (豪门重生：总裁夫人太彪悍) by Lu Wei (卢苇).

The two sisters of the Wang family have had very different personalities since childhood. The elder sister Wang Yan suffers from congenital anemia, while the younger sister Wang Ling Jun is willful and naughty. Wang Ling Jun came to Shenzhen despite her family's objections, breaking the seemingly peaceful life of Wang Yan, who was also in Shenzhen.

Unemployed Wang Ling Jun moved into Wang Yan's home, and the relationship between the two gradually became harmonious and warm. The two sisters also gradually gained their own feelings. Wang Yan's old illness relapsed, and Wang Lingjun, who once wanted to get rid of her sister, chose to stay by her side.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Ni Shi Guang Yin Pai De Tang" (你是光阴派的糖) by Ai He Shui (爱喝水).

Jiang Wu has lived under the shadow of her father’s debts until she meets the mysterious and protective Jiang Yan—unaware he is actually undercover cop Lu Xiao. Years later, their paths cross again, and she discovers that his distance and secrecy were his way of keeping her safe, sparking a journey of rediscovery, trust, and enduring love.

~~ Versions: 60 episodes (iQiyi) || 70 episodes (Apps)

Step siblings dance around their mutual attraction and bring others into their drama. She tries to fit into his world of racing and smoking, and he tries to protect her from her fake boyfriend.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ta De Bai Mo Li Hua" (他的白茉莉花), also known as "Gao Shao Fa Re" (高烧发热), by Pu Sa Ye (菩萨野).

A strong-willed disciplinarian mother (tiger mother) faces mountainous pressure raising her daughter, while her husband (cat father) has an opposite view of how to raise their daughter. Qian Qian is the school-aged daughter of Bi Shen Nan and Luo Su, and the princess of the family. After learning from others that the educational foundation starts in elementary school and witnessing first hand the difficult process of entering a great school, Bi Shen Nan finally realized that they have spoiled their daughter for way too long. Determined to catch her daughter up with all the other kids, she has quickly grown into the role of a tiger mom while her husband maintains that the happiness of Qian Qian is the most important, even if that means being academically behind. Mixed in the bag are two sets of opinionated grandparents and the reappearance of Luo Su’s gentle ex-girlfriend.

Huo Zhi, who grew up in an orphanage, happens to save the rich heir Jiang Cun when he gets into a car accident. Jiang Cun falls in love at first sight with his savior and tries to pursue her. However, he mistakenly pursues her twin sister Qin Ying Su instead. When Huo Zhi and Ying Su meet and recognize each other, Ying Su pleads with her sister to pretend to be her for a while so that she can treat an illness in secret. Huo Zhi agrees and enters the Jiang household. However, an accident happens, and she loses her memory. Thereupon, Huo Zhi turns into her old naive and simple self. Jiang Cun is happy about her character change and becomes more considerate and loving towards his wife, but what will happen when he discovers the secret?

Modern forensic science student Tang Bing Er unexpectedly finds herself in the body of Qin Xi Yue, the notorious concubine of the Heng Kingdom. Using her forensic knowledge, she unravels mysteries, solves numerous strange cases, and joins forces with Crown Prince Ling Xuan. Together, they bring stability to the Heng Kingdom and protect its people

In 1930s Yuncheng, estranged adopted sisters Song Jia Yu and Huo Ran, bound by contrasting origins and family conspiracies, evolve from rivals to allies as they deploy business acumen and underworld tactics to dismantle their father's treachery, reclaim their mother's legacy, and transform the oppressive Huo estate into a sanctuary for women’s education and medical care, forging their own destiny at the dawn of a new era.

In her love life, Yun Su Ran has been thinking about why happiness is like walking on thin ice. After meeting Feng Jin, Yun Su Ran shines a ray of light on Feng Jin's chaotic life, and Yu Xiao enjoys the pain of repeatedly opening scab wounds while getting along with Yun Su Ran. This is how the love story between Feng Jin, Yun Su Ran, Feng Jin, and Yu Xiao begins.

Qin Tian Yue, who used to work for a major Internet company, was dispatched to the dating agency Xindong.com as a manager. She is passionate about using big data to help clients screen and find the most suitable partner, pursuing fast-paced dating. Feng Qing Ming, a gold medal consultant known as the "Cupid on Earth" at Xindong.com, has a completely different work philosophy. Rather than efficiency, he prefers to observe the emotional needs of customers and advocates "stewing over low heat" to cultivate customers. feelings between.

In the head-to-head business friction, the two overcame various obstacles, found blind dates for customers with different identities, backgrounds, and demands, solving all kinds of problems in the blind date process, and helped many people who were hesitant about marriage and love. people. In repeated confrontations, the two have gone from being enemies at…

dramas.nt: 走过路过之原来他也喜欢我
dramas.syn:
At sixteen, Shen Zhu Ying fell for a boy who wore white shirts and played the drums, seeing him as a distant, untouchable sun, and secretly loved him for eight years. At twenty-four, when they met again and she was just about to end her long-standing crush, the boy suddenly said: “Let’s get married!”

~~ Adapted from the web novel "An Lian Ta De Di Shi Yi Nian Chun" (暗恋他的第十一年春) by Bie Jiao Wo Mei Li (别叫我美丽).
dramas.t: Love Unexpected: He Likes Me Too

dramas.syn: Just because her younger sister couldn’t act, Mu Qi Qi was constantly framed and became the most scapegoated person in history! To escape her toxic family, she made a wish—to marry her parents’ enemy. Unexpectedly, that wish actually came true! Being a daughter wasn’t easy, but being the enemy’s wife turned out to be addictive! As she helped him take revenge and strike back, her life became more thrilling and prosperous than ever.

Set during the reign of Emperor Ren Zong in the Northern Song Dynasty, it follows a series of bizarre cases occurring amid undercurrents between the imperial court and the martial arts world. When a strange “lantern hanging case” takes place, Song Yuan, an upright and decisive Vice Minister of Justice, and Su Jin Xuan, a meticulous coroner, are brought together as investigative partners. 

Together, they traverse the streets and alleys of Bianjing, solving many seemingly bizarre cases — such as a haunted house with hidden human scheming and a poisoning incident unraveled through careful reasoning and keen observation. While each case stands alone, they also lay the groundwork for a larger overarching mystery.

It tells the story of Tang He Qing, a young girl from a seaside town, and Zhou Hai Yan as they stand together against domestic violence and drug-trafficking forces. Zhou Hai Yan, whose father died in the line of duty, abandoned his police academy studies and hid in a small town with his mother to escape a drug gang’s retaliation.

Tang He Qing’s arrival rekindled his dream of becoming a criminal police officer, and during their mission to dismantle a campus drug-trafficking network, the two gradually developed feelings for each other. After Tang He Qing’s father revealed the truth behind Zhou Hai Yan’s father’s death, Zhou Hai Yan chose to hide his identity and undertake an undercover mission.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "He Qing Hai Yan" (河清海晏) by Ju Zi Bu Suan (橘子不酸).

Lu Qiao, Zhong Bai, and Ren Yi Fan are very close high school friends; they get admitted to the same university and begin their college lives. They meet new friends there. However, their friendship is put to the test when Lu Qiao falls in love with a new classmate, creating tension between him and Zhong Bai (who has a crush on him) and Ren Yi Fan, who has to mediate between the two.

Bai Lu is a police officer still devastated from the failure of an undercover operation. In the process of solving a case she meets the neurotic and talented forensic doctor Gu Yu. These two women with different personalities become deeply entangled in each others' lives, and are bonded by a common goal of investigating and finding the truth. They, along with An Huai Yu, lead a team of young officers to unveil evil and maintain the dignity and integrity of their professions,

A modern girl accidentally travels to a mysterious world and is caught in many crises. However, she receives an amazing power by chance, and her true identity slowly emerges. The divine power in her body gradually activates and awakens, and she shoulders the safety of the entire mysterious world.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "The Great Queen" (吾凰在上) by Ao Xiao Ze (嗷小泽).

Han Ruo Fei obtains a time traveling polaroid that enables him to go back to 10 years ago on short periods of time. He attempts to revive his dead celebrity wife and find the mastermind of the conspiracy plotted against him 10 years ago.

Two legendary snipers with a seamless partnership find themselves on opposite sides due to differences in values and beliefs. One dangerous mission brings about a deadly battle that takes place in the shadows.

During the spring of 1949, expert sniper Su Wen Qian who's been hiding his identity receives a mission to come into the special crimes division as a consultant in order to take down an organization of secret assassins. At the same time, the enemy sends in Chi Tie Cheng who is their number one assassin.

Su Wen Qian used to be an activist against Japanese occupation and he was partners with Chi Tie Cheng for many years. After many life and death encounters with the members of special crimes, Su Wen Qian who once vowed never to use a gun again starts to see hope and finds a reason to fight again. Two friends with unmatched lethal skills engage in a battle of wits and will.

A story revolving around the crises in the public relations industry and the people whose lives intertwine because of it. Lin Zhong Shuo switched from an entertainment reporter to work at a PR firm. Tasked with sensitive and difficult-to-handle situations, he manages to avert crisis by playing his cards right. He helps his boss face off against his toughest enemy.

He left the entertainment industry after an incident wherein he misreported the news. Innocent people got hurt and he has been blaming himself. He tries to make amends and atone for the mistakes of the past. He has two important women in his life - Yuan Wei and Xu Wen Wen. Through his journey, he gradually comes to realize who he truly loves.

Lu An Na is an ordinary girl working for a magazine company. She gets a call from her Malaysian boyfriend saying his last words of "Farewell". She turns on the television and learns that the Malaysian ferry he is on is sinking. Unwilling to believe the tragic turn of events, she resolutely embarks on a journey to chase the truth and find her lover.

It tells the story of Liu Tian, who is arrested by the imperial city chief, because of the case related to the magic. Juggler Ling Dong met, and the two people who are considered masters and apprentices were involved in this case. The case was intertwined and foggy. In the end, love was secretly born because of the company along the way.

After surviving a factory explosion, Xia Guan Guan and Jiang Ye are reborn into their high school years. Amid family struggles, school life, and a love that transcends time, they embark on a sweet, coming-of-age romance that becomes a journey of mutual healing and redemption.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jian Ye" (见野) by Ning Yu Chen (宁雨沉).

Top actress Rong Dai awakens to find herself as the eldest daughter of the Rong family, who were tragically wiped out. Reborn at eighteen, she sheds her former glory and uses her wit as a weapon. She forges a secret alliance with the lurking Third Prince, Chu Yan Sheng, and plots amidst the undercurrents of social gatherings, vowing to uncover the bloody truth behind her family's destruction. How will this revenge across time rewrite everyone's destiny?

Liu Sang and Li Jia Le were dispatched by Wu Shan Ju to participate in an archaeological project. The two saw a mural at the archaeological site. The mural recorded the story of Moonbend Princess Qi Xia and young Jiang Wu. At the same time, they also found a peculiar meteorite. In the process of studying the meteorite jade, the two unexpectedly came to the world recorded in the mural.

Because a female immortal sealed a mischievous and sly fox into his right hand, ordinary senior high school student Liu Yi henceforth began his extraordinary journey as a immortal cultivator. 
~~ Based on the novel "My Fox Immortal Wife" by the novelist Ram de Night.

An unsolved murder case of a young girl repeats itself twenty years later and awakens the memories of a peaceful town. Shan Feng, who was once a witness to the murder case, now returns to the town as a policeman, unable to forget the painful memories. He seeks out the truth and discovers all the people related to the case have undergone drastic changes.

In her first life, Jiang Wan Wan married someone else and ended up dying. Her best friend and her husband teamed up to kill her. In her second life, she was reborn ten years ago and fought back, binding her husband and best friend in her previous life together in advance to fight back and take revenge. Fu Yun Sheng was also reborn, helping Wan Wan teach the scumbag a lesson and refuting the girl's rumours. Wan Wan doesn't know that he is here to save her, which is a complete redemption plot.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Marry My Husband" (내 남편과 결혼해줘) written by Seong So Jak (성소작) and illustrated by Aria (아리아).

A seemingly perfect crime sets off a chain of events that gradually reveals the darker side of human nature. As the plot thickens, a child's unexpected involvement uncovers hidden truths and the deep complexities of those entangled in the mystery.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wan Mei De Jiu Shu" (完美嫌疑人) by Chen Yan Yi (陈研一).

At eighteen, Xu Xing's mother tragically died. Forced by her father to dig out her heart to save his stepdaughter, she fled to a mountain village in search of her grandmother. She met 26-year-old tattoo artist Wen Xun, who became protective and took care of her. After the college entrance exam, she planned to confess her love to Wen Xun. But he was caught in a mudslide and disappeared. Xu Xing switched to studying geology to find him. Four years later, they met again, and after some evasive action, Wen Xun finally confessed that he had missed her every day.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chi Ye Wen Rou" (炽野温柔) by Jiu Wan (九绾).

The drama revolves around a group of newly graduated college students, telling a story about youth, dreams and struggles.
Ling Xiao, Tan Yue, Rao Shi Kai, Ning Xue, Ning Yu and others, after graduating from college, went through the struggle of their respective careers. 

When Ling Wei met Wei Wei, Tan Yue met Chen Hao, and Rao Shi Kai met Ning Yu, they began to have a new understanding of love and career. Under the resolute opposition of his father, Ling Xiao insisted on working and wanted to rely on his own efforts to realize his dream. But when love knocks on the door, Ling Hao's wealthy family background has become a stumbling block on his way to love. 

Ling Xiao introduced classmate Tan Yue to work in 4S shop, Tan Yue secretly fell in love with Chen Hao. However, Chen Hao wanted Tan Yue to create a good opportunity for her and Ling Xiao. After Zhao Xiao Nan, the cousin of Ling…

Yu Xi Xi and Yu Chao grew up under the same roof. Yu Chao was reserved and rarely smiled, sticking to his principles, while Yu Xi Xi was lively, mischievous, and free-spirited.

Their mother entrusted both the Will Immortal Tower and the Yu family to Yu Chao before her passing. Simultaneously, she urged Yu Chao to marry Yu Xi Xi as soon as possible, hoping that the two could support and take care of each other in the future. However, the two harbored mutual displeasure towards each other. Simultaneously, a scandal from fifteen years ago resurfaced in the martial world, adding complexity to the situation with intricate martial forces, grudges, and romantic entanglements. 

Amidst conflicts and struggles, Yu Xi Xi and Yu Chao found redemption, discovering their own path in the martial world. As the martial world returned to calm, Yu Xi Zi and Yu Chao returned to the Will Immortal Tower,…

The fate of 11 Li Xian's that look identical to one another but live in different dimensions and have different destinies. They become involved in a confusing game through software that allows them to travel through time and space and jointly start a decryption adventure.

Our main protagonist, Chen Zhen Yu is a down-and-out entrepreneurial failure. He is heavy in debt, but he firmly believes that luck will find him before his creditors. He is addicted to betting on horses, not hesitating to bet all of his fortunes. A transaction in a mysterious pawnshop gave him a turning point in his fate. However, is this luck good luck or bad luck? Who is that man who looks exactly like him?

~~ Adapted from the short fictional story "11LEFT".

Apprentice Matchmaker Tong Ling encounters skilled swordswoman Lin Yi Yue when she's forced by an elder to visit the Matchmaker's Temple. As a female constable, Yi Yue would rather devote her time and energy to catching criminals than marry a man and so she runs away from the Temple. 

Having felt a wisp of familiar power from her, Tong Ling realizes Yi Yue might have had something to do with his own sudden loss of magic three years ago. As he sticks close to Yi Yue under the pretense of helping her solve a mysterious case, Tong Ling realizes that, like him, she, too, has no memories of events that occurred three years ago. 

What is this inexplicable link between them? Is it a mere coincidence that there is a sudden rise in cases of people becoming possessed just as the two of them meet? Who is behind the mystery surrounding the events that happened three years ago?

dramas.nt: 宴律，你的白月光回国了
dramas.syn:
After serving a stint in prison, single mom Gu Xing Wan is released and struggles to find a job in the law field. She ends up as the legal assistant to her ex-boyfriend, Attorney Yan, who can't understand why she wouldn't let him wait for her 5 years ago.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yan Lv, Ni De Bai Yue Guang Hui Guo Le" (宴律，你的白月光回国了) by Ruan Zhi (软之).

After her sister escaped from marriage, Jiang Ni married into the top wealthy family of Beijing. She became the wife of Mr. Zhou, the head of the Zhou family. Mr. Zhou was a workaholic and went on a business trip on the first day of his marriage. Jiang Ni thought this marriage was very satisfactory. Until one night, Mr. Zhou broke the estrangement. It turned out that this marriage, which started with shared interests, would eventually lead to love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jing Hun Bu Shu" (京婚不熟) by Ni Zhou (溺舟).

Xu Hao Ran’s life changes when he falls in love with Yu Bo, a Dai girl. Embracing her culture, he becomes passionate about protecting the rainforest and its animals. But their love faces obstacles. Yu Bo’s romantic ties to Yan Long and Xu’s complicated past with her aunt, his father’s former lover, complicate things further. As Xu struggles with his relationship and the conflicts around him, he must confront the challenge that staying together is harder than falling in love. Will he overcome these hurdles to be with the woman he loves?

Xiang Zhen, Qian Bei Bei, Jin Xiao Ni, Ding Lan, Yu Hui, five different girls meet at the university slowly learn life's complications such as not being able to find a job and not being able to find love. When Xiang Zhen's boyfriend disappeared, Qian Bei Bei's boyfriend locked her up, Jin Xiao Ni's boyfriend turned out to be a player, Ding Lan's parents couldn't approve her boyfriend, and Yu Hui who lost all her money after her company failed, all of them was suffering from many complications from both work and love.

tells the story of the “alien” female priest. In order to find the king who lost the connection when traveling on Earth, he came to the earth and lived in the 18-line star Xiao Qin. In the body. The first time  was a person on earth, because the female priest did not understand the emotions and relationships of the people of the earth and created many oolongs, and with Gu Liunian in a way that was ridiculous.

In the autumn of 2019, on the first day of the new semester, Ling Hu Zhong, a poor student who transferred from Guangzhou to Ningbo, was helping an old lady to cross the road on the way to school when he met a classmate who had never met Mi Xiao Long and got his help. Both of them were late but became connected. They are both sports students in the school's track and field team, and they are both studying in the second-year art and sports class at Longhu Boys' High School.

In order to reduce the burden on the family, Ling Hu Zhong often sneaks out to work, and Mi Xiao Long's family has a favorable family condition, so he often helps Ling Hu Zhong in secret. While the friendship between the two is rapidly warming, they have also undergone various tests from themselves and the outside world.

In the art and sports class, a special group is composed of art students and sports students.…

dramas.nt: 住在我身体里的那个她
dramas.syn: Xiao Xiao, a soul harried by marriage pressures, unexpectedly traverses time and ends up in the body of an ancient man, embarking on a joyous journey where she cohabits a body with Chu Xiao Ran, an ancient bathhouse attendant. Armed with a magical pouch that produces any modern item at will, Xiao Xiao helps Chu Xiao Ran win over the aloof princess. Meanwhile, she takes advantage of inhabiting Chu Xiao Ran's body to flirt outrageously with the handsome and attractive men of the era.

After five failed attempts at winning the (second) male lead over, she is reborn for the sixth time. Suddenly, the system adds a new option: she can now pursue the (second) male lead’s close friend, who is the actual male lead. So, she shifts her mission to him — but he has already loved her through all five lifetimes.

After the Jinshan Mountain was flooded, Snake Xiao Qing was sealed by Monk Fa Hai and guarded by the Demon Control Department. Five hundred years later, Li Xiu Ning, who came here to take the talent election exam of the Demon Control Department, stepped into Xiao Qing's sealing area and broke the seal by accident. As a result, Xiao Qing woke up but lost her memory because the seal was broken by force. 

To find her memory back and get to know the world, Xiao Qing went to Qingyun Valley with Li Xiu Ning and started a new life. As they grew familiar with each other, Xiao Qing found out about another identity of Li Xiu Ning. Just like that, what happened 500 years ago gradually came out, and a love tragedy began between them…

During the war between Sheng and Yu kingdoms, Sheng was defeated. On her deathbed, the Sheng princess tasked her maid, A Yue, to impersonate her, marry for peace, and steal Yu’s defense map. Meanwhile, in Yu, Prince Chu Ru Heng, branded a “rebellious son,” seeks the truth behind his mother’s mysterious death. A "fake princess" and a "disgraced prince" cross paths in a treacherous palace. Amid suspicion and love, they join forces to uncover secrets and fight for peace.

Timecaster Luo Jie is accidentally transported into the body of a tycoon's illegitimate son, Lang, with the power to turn into a time pocket watch. In his quest to uncover the truth behind Lang’s mysterious death, he becomes entangled in the Qian Gang's power struggles, crosses paths with Inspector Ye Si Jia and the quirky Qi, and finds himself hunted by multiple factions. Luo Jie eventually uncovers that the mastermind behind it all is deeply linked to One Word of Humility and an impending catastrophe yet to come...

The story follows our independent heroine Lu Xiao Nan (Tina Tang) and she’s quite fearful of marriage. She knows it is not simply the union of two individuals, but confronting and solving conflicts together. Moreover, it’s the unification of two families – father and mother-in-laws, etc, hence she doesn’t take marriage lightly. She meets the man of her dream in Kevin (William Chan), a professor at a university, who basically comes with no strings attached (no family on his side…) He radiates warmth and kindness and is able to adjust in any condition e.g throw him in the kitchen and he can cook! The two get married and Kevin reveals that he wants to look for his long-lost family. When they do locate his family, the newlyweds are brought along into the family and Xiao Nan struggles to adapt to the crowded place. But with the help of her steadfast husband, she finds new meaning in family.…

Xu Yuan is an ordinary antique shop owner. One day, a visitor lets him know that he’s involved in a conspiracy he could never have imagined: a legendary treasure is actually linked to him in many ways, and a mysterious office has already arranged his fate. He embarks on a dangerous journey to clear his family’s name and tear down a counterfeiting organization.

After escaping a brutal prison, 47 arrives in Wangcheng to track down the men who betrayed his father years ago. Along the way, he gets caught between old alliances, deadly pursuers, and an unexpected connection with a woman named Qi Jun.

Yang Zhao is an antique restorer who lives a luxurious but solitary life. Chen Ming Sheng lives a poor life as a taxi-driver in Yang Zhao's city. He was an undercover anti-drug police and lost his leg during a mission. After an accidental encounter, an unconventional love relationship develops between them. Despite social rejection as a couple, they look forward to a peaceful life together with courage. All is about to change when Chen Ming Sheng receives a phone call and has to return to his mission.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Na Ge Bu Wei Ren Zhi De Gu Shi" (那个不为人知的故事) by Twentine (周爱华).
Editor Lin Xiao Xi  enters a parallel universe because of a time transmitter created by scientist Zhou Yu Heng of that universe. Thus their love story across time and space begins.

College student Lin Mian was born in a family that favors boys over girls and was deeply persecuted by her mother. In order to raise money for her father's surgery, she had no choice but to believe the advertisement that sold her own eggs. By mistake, she called a rich doctor. Shi Lin made an appointment with her to persuade Lin Mian to give up and protect her, but he fell in love with her at first sight, and the two began another kind of lingering transaction.
dramas.t: A Night Deeply Drunk on the Spring Breeze

dramas.syn:
Zhu Pu Yu was framed by her stepmother and stepsister, losing everything she had. She was driven out of her home by her biological father and lived a life of wandering for years. Returning, she vowed to make them pay and take everything back. The moment she saw her stepsister holding her fiancé, Wen Jing Si, she knew her chance for revenge had arrived.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Heng Dao Duo Ai" (横刀夺爱) by Tian Nan Lan (天难蓝).
dramas.t: Take Away Love with a Knife

dramas.syn: “A Detective Housewife” is a republican drama with a dash of humor and a heroine as the focus. Gou Ji Xiang is a housewife undergoing a huge change after her husband is mysteriously murdered. Determined to expose the murderer(s), she becomes a detective under the wings of Mao Ru Yi.

Through skateboarding, a young man suffering from depression overcomes his fears and finds the warmth of friendship.

Yang Bu Fan and his dad travelled from their hometown in the South to a first-rate city in order to provide a better education for Bu Fan. Bu Fan's grades suffer because he finds it hard to adjust to his new life and starts to lose sleep.  Bu Fan spots four uniquely-dressed guys playing on their skateboards. Their leader Chen Xi Wen wanted to prank Bu Fan by asking if he would like to try skateboarding. Bu Fan fell as expected, but as he was kneeling on the ground, he did not feel any pain. That night, he had the best sleep he's had in a long time. 

 Bu Fan's dad worries that skateboarding would be a bad influence on his son and forbids Bu Fan from the sport. Through the encouragement of teacher-in-training Su Li Shan, Bu Fan learns the techniques of skateboarding from…

Fei Fei suffers from phobia and began to live with an attractive male. Throughout their daily lives, due to their conflicting personalities, there are countless of disputed making life harder. Zheng Er Xun dream of being one of the best-selling authors is met with difficulties due to Fei Fei taking up most of his time and attention. Also, Zheng Er Xun is a Chunibyo which made him attend in a cosplay contest. In their most difficult period with many setbacks, they start to heavily depend on each other and encourage one another to endure through.

Twin sisters switch identities turning the school bully into a gentle lady as she makes the move on a doctor. Meanwhile, the female executive turns into a school beauty, capturing the heart of a little "puppy." 

After their parents divorced, twin sisters Lin Chu Xin and Xia Qing were raised separately. Lin Chu Xin works hard to make money but has poor grades. Meanwhile, Xia Qing has lived a life of luxury since her mom remarried into a wealthy family. The twins inadvertently meet as adults. Through exchanging identities, they manage to solve various problems yet also create a bigger crisis for each other.

Lin Wu tried her best to sleep with her future brother-in-law Xie Yan Shen. She was very ambitious and wanted him to submit to her, to avenge her stepmother and half sister, and to take back her mother's relics.

Xu Yuan wishes to be reborn at 18, determined to repay Zhou Qi Xing, who died in revenge for her in her previous life. She begins actively flirting with him, bringing him soup and medicine, shielding him from trouble, and making him blush, believing him to be innocent. Little does she know that Zhou Qi Xing possesses a hidden talent. While seemingly passive, he's actually calculating, using tactics like his "abs" to gradually win Xu Yuan over.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Xiang Xu Yuan Zai Shen Bian" (我想许愿在身边), also known as "Ta Zong Tiao Xi Wo" (她总调戏我), by Yang Bao Fu Er (羊暴富儿).
dramas.t: Wo Xiang Xu Yuan Zai Shen Bian

dramas.syn:
A man dealing with anxiety and depression after a painful divorce manages to find warmth when he least expects it and it reignites his passion towards life.

In order to chase after her dreams, Qiao Na aborts her own baby which leaves her husband Jiang Nian Hua in shambles. After getting divorced, Nian Hua accumulates much wealth through sheer determination and hardwork but he isn't able to enjoy the fruits of his labor as he is diagnosed with severe depression. Just when he has decided to give up on life, he encounters a young corporate woman named Lin Li. Not long after they meet, Lin Li deals with the fallout from a toxic relationship with her boyfriend whom she works with and she becomes devastated at the realization that she should no longer be with him. Both bearing emotional troubles of their own, Nian Hua and Lin Li get to know each other through work and a romance ensues.

Gu Man Qing has been dependent on her sister, who was a dancer since she was a child, but she never thought that on her big wedding day, she would be witnessing  Lu Yi Chuan, her future husband, murdering her only family. After trying to take revenge on the spot and failing, Man Qing decide to run.  But even after starting her new, happy life, Man Qing still can't forget the faithful night, and she's plotting a revenge plan. Her first step to do so is taking a new identity and becoming a stepmother to her past lover.  But the woman discovers a seemingly simple plan, and her sister's death has more mysteries than she thought.

A year after Qin Hong fled a murder case, her body is found missing at sea. With solid evidence and a confession, the case appears solved, but detective Liu Wang is haunted by the missing body and doubts whether Qin Hong is truly dead, suspecting there’s more to the story.

dramas.nt: 爱的年龄差 第二季
dramas.t: The Age Difference in Love Season 2

dramas.nt: 闪婚后夫人不按常理出牌
dramas.syn: Han Xi Xi was sent to the mountains by her stepmother as a child. She practices martial arts in the mountains and does not understand the laws of human relationships in modern society. One day, her master wants her to go down the mountain, lies to her that she can improve her skills by getting married and sleeping with someone. Xi Xi thinks sleeping with someone means two people lying together in bed, until she meets her man. After a series of ridiculous incidents, she realizes what sleeping together really means.

In the early years of the Republic of China, Su Man Li, a stand-in dancer at the XianYuess Club, crosses paths with Chen Bi, a noblewoman whose family has been tragically wiped out, while searching for her father’s killer. Borrowing Chen Bi's identity, Su Man Li approaches Yang Zi Qin, a council member of the Haitang Society, to uncover the truth behind the Chen family massacre. Upon learning Yang Zi Qin's true identity, the three join forces to confront the mastermind behind it all.

Simple Man follows four ordinary people who under accidental circumstances get some super powers when they make a deal with a devil. However, they discover that behind all of this is the existence of a conspiracy. Adapted from the comic book.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Simple Man" (微能力者).

On their engagement night, Jiang Wan Zhi, a movie producer, is driving the car where her fiancé, Fu Heng Yue, the young master of the Fu family, is openly having sex with her cousin, Sun Qui An, in the backseat. Since Jiang Wan Zhi’s family went bankrupt and left her with a lot of debt, she has to endure marrying this scumbag.

Wanting to have a bit of fun with the two, she drives fast and recklessly, and ends up hitting another car. It turns out that the owner of that car is none other than Zhou Li Cheng, the CEO of the Zhou Group, but also Fu Heng Yue’s uncle, and Jiang Wan Zhi’s ex-boyfriend, whom she cruelly broke up with 3 years earlier.

Soon, the two of them are yet again entangled as Zhou Li Cheng tries his best to persuade Jiang Wan Zhi to get back together, while Jiang Wan Zhi does her best to repay the debt to the Fu family and conceal the real reason for her breaking up back…

Fu Zhen dies in a car accident, but Zhao Ji Yuan, the last remaining god in the mortal world, revives her. However, due to an unexpected accident, Zhao Ji Yuan's divine power mark is transferred onto Fu Zhen. At the same time, Fu Zhen's grandfather's will states that she must marry to inherit the Fu Group. Faced with scheming relatives eager to seize control, Fu Zhen and Zhao Ji Yuan agree to a partnership and enter a flash marriage...
Set in 2029, university professor Liang Si Mu uses a code he developed to travel back to the day of his sister’s death and, together with his best friend Yue Ling, tries to uncover the truth.
Qi Yi Tiao is a tabloid reporter who bumps into a superstar by accident, and ends up signing a short term contract with him to be his assistant.

Xiao Jiu, a female corpse handler, is sent to deliver the body of a wealthy young man to an old mansion, where she discovers his parents are holding a ghost marriage ceremony for him. The following day, the parents show up at her door, demanding the return of their son’s body, which they claim has gone missing.

Set during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, Yuan Yue Zheng's love for the ambitious Eldest Prince Feng Lin entangles her in a web of betrayal and ambition. Unaware of Feng Lin's secret love for Du Si Yu and his plot to usurp the throne, Yue Zheng agrees to a marriage alliance to help him. Though initially indifferent, Feng Lin falls for Yue Zheng after her repeated sacrifices. However, misunderstandings fueled by his past actions and Du Si Yu's interference threaten their relationship. In the end, Feng Lin's sincerity wins Yue Zheng back, and their love is rekindled.

~~TV series adapted from the chinese novel (结缘) Entwined Fate written by the author of Desperate Love.

On the eve of graduation, Wang Yang Ming, who took reversing heart failure as his mission, had a disagreement with his supervisor in medical experiments, and resolutely decided to switch from scientific research to clinical practice, and successfully joined the emergency department of Ruiren Hospital, which ranked first in the country. 

Wang Yang Ming's competitive instinct was aroused by his busy life in the emergency department, when he took risks to deal with ventricular fibrillation in the elderly, rescued heat stroke migrant workers, treated stroke patients, and so on, constantly refined his medical skills. At the same time , on the ward formed group named "four masters of emergency medicine" , which Yang's Ming is a part, alongside with  Lu Qing Qi, Zu Wen Da and Liu Fei.  Now four of them, witness each other's growth and change, gain friendship and love, and experience…

The mountain bandit king Ma Da You kidnapped Princess Jiang Qian Er and was accidentally struck by lightning in the process. Miraculously, they swapped bodies and even shared each other's feelings, becoming intertwined in fate. Jiang Qian Er wanted to swap back and marry her beloved young general Lu Tian Xing, and Ma Da You also wanted to avenge his father. The two had no choice but to compromise with reality and cooperate to overcome various difficulties. 

Prince Ying secretly plotted a rebellion, sending people to infiltrate Ma Da You's stronghold and take control of it for a secret military base. Jiang Qian Er, Ma Da You, and Lu Tian Xing moved into Prince Ying's mansion, each with their own goals: Jiang Qian Er to investigate the death of Ma Da You's father and Lu Tian Xing to find evidence of Prince Ying's treason. Prince Ying rebelled ahead of schedule, overthrowing the court and…

Song Yao, an intern member of the law enforcement team, accidentally mistook Pei Che for her contact colleague while on duty. Pei Che, the president of Jianghai Group, who was urged to get married by his grandmother, also mistook Song Yao for his marriage partner, and the two got their marriage certificate by accident.
The story is about a young man Li Jia, who goes to Hong Kong to study psychiatry.

Upon returning from study abroad, her fiancé quickly ends their marriage, leaving her with a sick son to care for. She then meets architect Du Fan and the two fall in love. But then something happens and it tears them apart. They meet again years later and eventually end up as a couple.

In troubled times, there are grievances and intrigues, but if it is for love, it is not a problem to give up your life. Xie Lan Qin, a hothouse flower who suffered a huge change in her family, pushes away the love of her life, Feng Yan, for revenge and transforms into a thorny rose to achieve justice on her own. But when everything went as she wished, she found that Feng Yan was always guarding her and would not give up until death, so Xie Lan Qin vowed to bravely pursue her old love.

High school teacher Song Wan Xing's ex-boyfriend cheated on her, didn't give a dowry, and wanted a Mercedes-Benz as a dowry. Her family was not good either: her stepfather was a pervert and her mother was weak. She got married to the neurosurgeon Jin Ze after a blind date. 

It is a healing love story of marriage first, love later, and long-lasting love and companionship.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wan Xing Yu Ni" (晚星予你) by Gao Kao Di Li 150 (高考地理150).

After a career setback, Beicheng lawyer Wen Xu travels to Hong Kong Island to relax and unexpectedly meets Zhou Lie, the owner of a local inn. They agree to a three-month romance that gradually turns into genuine love. When Wen Xu must return early because of a friend’s misfortune, Zhou Lie follows her north, determined to protect her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhi Lie" (炙烈), also known as "Yi Jian, Zhong Qing" (一见，钟情), by Jiu Jiu Mao (纠纠猫).

After betrayal drives Huanhua Valley into exile, its heiress Fang Mu Wan rebuilds her life—only to be drawn back into turmoil when an assassination case exposes the masked leader of Wufeng Pavilion as her former husband, Xie Ci Yuan. As tyranny tightens its grip on the realm, old love and deep grudges resurface, forcing her to choose between the fate of a nation and the heart she once tried to forget.

Ai Qing is a volunteer participant in a scientific experiment from a peaceful future world in the year 2317. During her journey through time, she accidentally arrives in a war-torn region of ancient northwestern China, thousands of years in the past, where she encounters a teenage Tocharian monk named Ru Ji Bo, later known as Luo Chi.

Having renounced his royal heritage at an early age, Luo Chi has devoted himself to the rigorous study and practice of Buddhism. He travels far and wide, hoping that through his own efforts, he can dispel the conflicts and animosity in people's hearts and inspire a world filled with tolerance and love. Having experienced firsthand the stark contrast between their two vastly different worlds, Ai Qing and Luo Chi develop a deep spiritual bond. She encourages him to remain steadfast in his beliefs and strengthens his resolve to pursue his ideals.

~~ Adapted…
dramas.t: Faithful to Buddha, Faithful to You

dramas.syn: In ancient times, the Emperor God exhausted his cultivation to suppress the Demon King. Before entering seclusion, he reincarnated a trace of his essence as Han Mu. Unaware of this, Han Mu encountered Xuan Li, a demoness with innate demonic power, while cultivating in the Jiuchong Mountains. As they trained together, a deep affection grew between them, and they came to know and accept each other.

Set against the backdrop of China's early Reform and Opening-Up era, the story spans the years leading up to the 1997 revisions of the Criminal Procedure Law and the Criminal Law. The central characters, Chen Yi Zhong, Yu Gao Yuan, Zhang Li Hui, Xia Ying Jie, and their fellow law school graduates, embark on careers in different branches of the justice system after graduation. Through the fast-paced evolution of judicial practice, they witness history, help shape it, adapt to the changing times, and grow both professionally and personally. Coming from different backgrounds and possessing distinct personalities, the group experiences the highs and lows of work and life over more than a decade, ultimately following very different paths. Told from the unique perspective of China's evolving judicial system, the drama brings together judges, prosecutors, police officers, and legal…

Xin Li Hua, a beautiful and wealthy middle-aged woman, finds herself entangled in a web of emotions and conflicting interests with Qiu Yue, a younger man with a hidden past, amidst a broken marriage and family intrigue. After deception, betrayal and reconstruction, they finally redeem each other.

Younger man Chi Heng harbors an obsessive love for Sheng Shu Ran. He stages a car accident to bring her back, and in the midst of the Fu family feud and ruthless business wars, he rises against the odds, uncovers buried secrets, and seeks revenge—until he finally breaks through all obstacles to stay by Sheng Shu Ran’s side.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yue Guang Wen Guo Feng Zhang De Teng" (月光吻过疯长的藤), also known as "Jie Jie Bang Wo! Nian Xia Di Di Feng Pi Ai Liao" (姐姐帮我！年下弟弟疯批爱撩), by Li Si (橦肆).

After accidentally entering a script, struggling actress An Ran hides her true abilities to survive, only to become entangled in Yuwen Rui’s carefully laid revenge plan as a conspiracy threatens the fate of the kingdom.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhi Zi Zhi Shou, Jiang Zi Tuo Zou" (执子之手，将子拖走) by Tian Xia Wu Bing (天下无病).
dramas.t: The Royal Highness of the Princess

dramas.syn: Something strange happened after an autistic girl is involved in a car accident. Su Tang survives the crash only to realize that her brain has developed to an extremely high intellectual level and all of her senses have become so powerful that she is able to observe and detect the minutest details. Su Tang begins to use her newfound powers to help the police solve the most difficult or bizarre cases. But why do all of these strange cases seem to somehow lead back to one mysterious person, and could Su Tang herself be involved somehow?

Set in China’s hardscrabble, industrial northeast, it tells the story of a young police officer investigating the murder of a taxi driver, only to find a childhood friend may be involved. To solve the case, he explores layer by layer, revealing a past buried 12 years ago.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Moses on the Plain" (平原上的摩西) by Shuang Xue Tao (双雪涛).
dramas.t: Why Try to Change Me Now

dramas.syn:
A graduate student in the Archaeology Department at Qin Chuan University, Fang Kun assists in the recovery of cultural relics lost overseas. He discovers that an unknown tomb in Yincun, Bailuyuan, might be the Ziling Tomb of Emperor Taizong of the Han Dynasty. His mentor, Zhan Mao Chang, takes him to Bailuyuan for an on-site investigation, but he unexpectedly loses his life. With his mentor's wishes in mind, Fang Kun volunteers to go to Yusai for Great Wall archaeology. 

The unknown tomb in Yincun, Bailuyuan, draws the attention of the archaeological team, and Fang Kun is invited to participate in the investigation. There, he reunites with his former lover, Luo Qing, who has become the team leader, and they discover an ancient tomb shaped like the Chinese character "亞" (ya). Fang Kun revisits his previous theories, sparking controversy and interest while also attracting the attention…

Dou Ling was the most beloved granddaughter of General Dou Wu. When she was eight years old, her family was murdered by eunuchs, and the whole family was raided. The young Dou Ling was forced to live among the people. Unwilling to accept her fate, Dou Ling used the pseudonym Yan Huang to infiltrate the "Xuan Yi Pavilion" controlled by the eunuch Cao Jie.

Tells the rich and interesting high school life of five senior high school students before the college entrance examination covering their sweet daily school life, emotional development and the true friendships formed.

Yuan Wan Er, who traveled to the Tang Dynasty, tried hard to return to her original world - but when she tried so, she only traveled five years later! This time, Wan Er became a student at the Great Eastern Academy. At the same time Wan Er's best friend Lin Yu, mistakenly believed that she has crush on the overseas student, Silla Prince Jin De Cheng, so she designed a confession plan for her. As a result, Wan Er became love rival to her classmate Fang Qing Cheng.  She liked Jin De Cheng and kept provoking and harassing Wan Er, because of that. Soon Wan Er,  wanting to stop her bullying agreed to the debate competition proposed by Fang Qing Cheng.

Rising actress Yin Shan Shan's perfect life collapses in a single day after scandals, public backlash, and a breakup. Following a mysterious fall, she becomes trapped in a time loop, reliving the same day. In her quest to escape, she meets the enigmatic hotel owner Shen Jia Qin, leading to a startling revelation that changes her fate.

An Rou left quietly six years ago, and Jin Bai Chen waited for her for six years. When he met her again, An Rou deliberately pretended to be ugly, but he was still attracted to her. Until he saw her true appearance, he would never let her go.
dramas.t: Tian Cai Meng Bao Fu Hei Die Di

dramas.syn: Mi You is the cowardly and forbearing wife of Zhao Fei Ran, the second son of an executive of the pharmaceutical giant Qi Zhong Group. After a car accident, her personality changes drastically, and she divorces Zhao Fei Ran. Later, Mi You learns that her car accident was not an accident at all. Meanwhile, the new CFO of Qi Zhong Group, Han Yi Cheng, is secretly investigating past illegal drug testing at the pharmaceutical company. Mi You and Han Yi Cheng join forces to discover the truth behind the scenes.

The wealthy young lady Jun Qing Lan had her home confiscated and her family exterminated. Her fiancé, Li Cong Yao, not only failed to save her but also disfigured her appearance. Jun Qing Lan escaped by chance and changed into the number one widower just to reverse the case and take revenge, but even still, she didn’t want to see Li Cong Yao again. This person she once loved became cold-blooded and cruel, and even kidnapped her and imprisoned her. And so the games began.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Wu Zuo Nu Fu Ma" (仵作女驸马) by Ye Wu Shuang (叶无双).

Ping An Ning and Lin An Jing are brothers from the same father but different mothers. Both inherited their father Lin Zhong Dao’s musical talent and end up falling for the same girl Wei Lan. While An Ning’s mother Ping Yi arranges for her son to study Western flute, An Jing follows in his father’s steps and learns how to play the classical flute Shakuhachi. At a concert abroad, student leader An Ning cancels An Jing’s solo performance, which puts the brothers’ good relationship to an end. When An Jing later confesses his love to Wei Lan, she rejects him because she has An Ning in her heart. Even more setbacks await An Jing thereafter until he becomes depressed and gives up on himself. An Ning and Wei Lan consequently try to get him back up on his feet.

In Shanghai in 1941, a spy stationed at No. 76, the secret service during Wang Jing Wei's puppet regime, is in danger of being exposed. At this time, a woman barges into his life with two children, and they must pretend to be a family to keep up a front.

Fang Jia Shu and Tao Yu Ling, a woman who was meant to be his wife since childhood, are both agents of the Communist underground. They have to try everything they can to ensure that all the members of their little family "perform well" in their roles in order to keep their identities safe. It proves to be no easy task given the suspicions from Li Li Xing, the head of No. 76 and intelligence director Ye Xing Cheng.

Fang Jia Shu also has another identity as a Juntong agent, which is complicated by fellow agent Su Ya Lu who is in love with him and team leader "Silver Fox" who is secretly monitoring his every move. Even in such a…
Su Nian sets up a trap to protect her family because her stepfather has passed away. She goes from hostility to entanglement with Fu Chen Yan, the eldest son of the Fu family.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Once Upon a Time, There Was a Spirit Sword Mountain" (从前有座灵剑山) by His Majesty the King (国王陛下).
dramas.t: Once Upon a Time in Lingjian Mountain Season 2

dramas.syn:
A young woman loves tea art. But Du Xin Yu is never allowed to touch tea while growing up because of her father’s tragic death. But after watching a show by tea master A Fei, Xin Yu’s love of tea art is revived, and she sneaks into Zhuo Qing Garden to take the qualification test to become A Fei’s disciple. 

As Xin Yu works hard to prove herself, she falls in love with the tea garden chairman’s oldest son, Tang Zheng Hao, who also works in the garden. Zheng Hao’s younger half-brother, Cheng Feng, also falls for Xin Yu, which further fractures the brothers’ already contentious relationship. Di Yi Rou has always loved Zheng Hao and will do anything to make Xin Yu fail after seeing Zheng Hao’s heart taken away from her. 

But despite the obstacles, Xin Yu finally became the first female tea reviewer in China, only to lose her sense of smell at the peak of her career. To complicate matters,…

The students in sophomore class E have very bright personalities and are almost impossible to control. Can exchanging the teacher in charge of this class finally bring some positive change? Wang Ge Bi, a son from a rich household, decides to take on the role of the teacher in charge of class E. Wang Ge Bi, who doesn’t abide by any rules, physical education teacher Wu Wei as well as Su Yi, a rookie teacher, bring a lot of chaos and change the school into a very lively place.

Five years after a deadly confrontation with poachers left one forest policeman dead and another severely injured, former officer Wei Jiang is called to help find missing ranger Qin Chuan. In the process, they join forces with veterinarian Ye Xiao Wan and animal rights activist Saina. Together, they uncover a poacher trail, facing danger from both ruthless criminals and bloodthirsty wolves as they pursue justice without fear.

The very rich and venomous investor Jian Yu Chen and the money-loving designer Wen Ni got married in a flash. The two have known each other since high school. After an accidental meeting, she impulsively proposed marriage and he accepted. Because they were in the same company, they chose to keep their marriage a secret. In the workplace, they quarreled with each other, but they were very loving in private. Wen Ni always thought it was an accidental flash marriage, but she didn't know that his long-planned ten-year secret love came true.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ling Du Ai Mei" (零度暧昧), also known as "Wen Rou Ye Gu" (温柔野骨), by Lan Sheng (澜笙).

dramas.nt: 假戏真做后他永失所爱
dramas.syn:
Liang You Xin was hospitalized after a car accident. In order to amuse her boyfriend, Lu Yu, and see how anxiously he cared about her, she pretended to have amnesia. However, she never expected that Lu Yu would choose her best friend Chen Yue Ying as his girlfriend and ruthlessly push her to his good brother Qin Yan Zhou.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "You Xin" (幼歆) by Ting Rong (聽容).
dramas.t: Jia Xi Zhen Zuo Hou Ta Yong Shi Suo Ai

dramas.syn:
Yin Zheng seeks revenge for her mother and meets Prince Wen Ze under unexpected circumstances. As they search for the truth, they overcome misunderstandings and develop trust and love for each other.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chu Wo Yi Wai, Quan Yuan Chong Sheng" (除我以外，全员重生) by Xi Yao Xiao (昔邀晓).

Lu Ming and Xu Xin’s marriage weakens over time due to daily conflicts. After Xu Xin falls into a coma from a car accident, Lu Ming discovers her novel about an idealized husband, forcing him to confront his shortcomings and regret his past mistakes.

Amid political chaos caused by the former emperor’s suppression of the military, the general’s son Nan Chen Xiao disguises himself as a woman to stay safe, while aspiring official Rui Yu hides her identity by posing as a man. Forced into partnership through an unexpected marriage by the new emperor, the two face dangerous trials and uncover each other’s secrets to help the emperor restore stability to the realm.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Disguised Couple" (指夫为妻) by Yu Feng × Mo Qian (聿枫×默千).
Story of Jia Bao Rong, Zhen Yin Hui, Princess Ling Jing and the Crown Prince, each with their own destines, who team up together due to an unexpected incident to investigate cases.

Mei Lin, a shadow agent of the Dark Bureau, carries a blood debt that drives her to stake her very life in a deadly game. She weaves her way among several men—she is the sharpest blade in the hands of the mad prince Murong Jing, a stand-in for a lost love in the eyes of the ruthless Grand Prince, and the fiercely guarded obsession of Yue Qin, the hostage prince from Zhao. Amid the power struggles for the throne, a brutal arena of manipulation and devotion unfolds—both beautiful and tragic.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chun Hua Yan" (春花厌) by Hei Yan (黑颜).

A series of bizarre cases plague the capital of the Xueyuan Kingdom, drawing Wen Jue — the eccentric, brilliant, and mysterious prisoner known as "Qiongqi" — back into a treacherous undercurrent of court intrigue.

When a kind-hearted street patrolman, Gu Xian, becomes a wanted fugitive overnight, he risks everything to break Wen Jue out of captivity to help clear his name. Reentering society, Wen Jue takes charge of the investigation. Utilizing the "Gold Coin Mirror Revenge" case as a starting point, he begins to uncover a deeply buried injustice involving the family of a former Town General that has been hidden for 20 years.

As Wen Jue spearheads the investigations, the "Lingmei Self-Immolation," "Border Bewitching," and "Surprising Marriage" arcs unfold one after another. With the aid of Gu Xian and judicial minister Wei Nan Zhu, what begins as an effort to clear a local patrolman's…

An ordinary boy inadvertently gets involved in the conflict between two groups of spirit agents. He is shocked to discover the existence of "Qi Ling," a collection of 7 antique weaponries that can transform into beautiful girls to engage in battle. And, a friend of his may not be who she says she is. He finds himself in one danger after another and can't explain any of it to his concerned family or friends.

It is the periods of the Spring and Autumn and the Warring States Era. The feudal lords are at war, and the people are in a constant state of suffering. The Jade Emperor's sixth daughter comes down to earth to save humanity.

Zhong Li Wu Yan used to be a goddess from the heavens. She is the sixth of Jade Emperor's seven beautiful daughters. Born out of kindness and compassion, she could no longer bear to see humanity falling to ruin, so she volunteers to descend to the mortal world to help them. As it is forbidden to reveal her true self, she reincarnates as the daughter of a humble family from a small village.

Growing up, no one would go near her due to her ugly appearance, but there is no skill in the world that she has not mastered. The Qi State is the strongest among the seven states. Qi Xuan Wang assumed the throne after his father's death, but he had no ambition nor intention to…

A pair of embroidered shoes sets cultural relic expert Chen You Xi on a dangerous adventure. As he and his team search for the legendary Lingxiao Pearl, they repeatedly clash with tomb raiders—only to discover, after finding the first pearl, that they’ve become entangled in a far greater conspiracy.

~~ Adapted from the 2nd-4th volumes in the novel series "Candle in the Tomb" (鬼吹灯) by Zhang Mu Ye (天下霸唱).
dramas.t: The Secret of the Lost Pearl

dramas.syn:
Five years ago, Su Xiao Han and Xiao Mo fell in love, and rumors started that Xiao Mo was engaged to the big star Gu Jing. With the “solid” evidence and Su Xiao Han and Xiao Mo did not confess to each other, Su Xiao Han left for France without any news for five years. She further studied her major design and won many awards.

One day, a person who claimed to be Xu found Su Xiao Han and gave her a chance to participate in the BRD Jewelry Design Competition. After coming back home, she went to Mingzuanfang Jewelry, whose boss happened to be Xiao Mo. The juniors Meng Mengmeng and Yuan Hao were also in the company.

That year when Su Xiao Han left, Xiao Mo tried to find her but in vain. Because of the promise they made, Xiao Mo established the Mingzuanfang Jewelry Design, and her return is also the plan of Xiao Mo and Yuan Hao. Su Xiao Han still can’t let go and said that she only returned…

Huo Cheng Yang, seeking revenge for his family, has been searching for the murderer for years and stumbles upon Feng Zhi Qing again. They were childhood sweethearts, but a marriage contract severed their bond. Now their enemy keeps her by his side, and the two of them sink deeper and deeper into mutual torment.

Young but brilliant Haigang Police captain Lu Xiao is known for cracking tough cases. When a bizarre floating corpse leads to the elusive "Water Ghost" killer, Lu teams up with his new roommate Fang Yi Tong. Despite setbacks and the devastating loss of his wife Jiang Yi Ran, Lu overcomes despair with support from his team and ultimately brings the killer to justice.

~~ Adapted from "Peeping for 120 Days" (偷窥一百二十天, Tou Kui Yi Bai Er Shi Tian ) by Cai Jun 蔡骏

Li Nuo Nuo was once betrayed by her boyfriend and she is determined to take revenge. In order to do so, she loses weight and undergoes plastic surgery. She then uses Ding Chen Yu as her "tool man" for her revenge and they start falling in love, but Chen Yu realizes that he was only a tool and decides to break up. Will they have a happy ending?

During graduation season in Shanghai's Lujiazui Financial City, Tao Wu Ji, a young man from a small town, starts his career as a teller at a bank's Pudong branch. Through hard work and emotional intelligence, he rises through the ranks and is selected by Zhao Hui, the branch's vice president, to join the "Sunshine Project." Zhao Hui mentors Tao Wu Ji, who follows his example to find purpose in his work. However, as Zhao Hui succumbs to temptation and corruption, Miao Che, head of the audit department, resists pressure and investigates his former classmate, Zhao Hui.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Cheng Zhong Zhi Cheng" (城中之城) by Teng Xiao Lan (滕肖澜).

At the start of the school year, the Yibei Basketball Club was on the verge of disbanding. Gu Chen Yang, Xu An Bo, Fu Bin Yan, Li Hao Yu, Lin Qing Yuan, Zhou Yang, Chen Song, Xie Yi Zhou, and others joined for various reasons, saving this underdog team.

The teammates faced challenges in games, unleashed their potential through practice, and bonded over music in their secret music studio. They gradually transformed from teammates into close friends, developing a strong team spirit, supporting each other in reconciling with their families, and experiencing the joys of youthful growth.
