Modern CEO Lin Yu Hao suddenly finds his consciousness transported into the tea merchant game he developed, now inhabiting the body of Wei Xiao Tang, a new bride of the Li family. The only way back to his world is to complete the game's mission and win the title of "World's Best Tea". Thus, Wei Xiao Tang joins forces with her husband Li Zi Xuan, embarking on a journey filled with witty schemes and steadfast kindness to claim the ultimate prize.

In 1929 Shanghai, a string of brutal murders targeting showgirls uncovers a dark conspiracy tied to a powerful underground network. A forensic doctor, a sharp-witted detective, and the owner of a lavish dance hall form an unlikely alliance to expose the truth, risking everything to shine a light on the city's darkest secrets.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Zhu Que Tang" (朱雀堂) by Gui Ma Xing (鬼马星).

When Yu Xing Chen learns that his first love Su Ruo has died, he’s suddenly pulled into a time vortex that sends him fifteen years into the past. Now back in high school, he finds Su Ruo alive at eighteen. As he relives their youth, he revisits forgotten moments and uncovers hidden clues about her fate. Caught between the past and present, Yu Xing Chen must solve the mystery of her death—before time runs out and he loses her forever.

Lin Yan Ting, a psychologist burdened with a hidden secret, possesses sharp combat skills and an exceptional ability to read people. Joining the police force as a consultant, he investigates a series of bizarre and complex cases while pursuing the truth behind the death of a close family member. As the investigation deepens, he works to tear apart the vast web of fate and conspiracy that surrounds him.

~~ Co-production with Hong Kong.

In the Song Dynasty, young painting prodigy Xi Meng rises within the Imperial Painting Academy while navigating mentorship, rivalry, and loyalty at court. As his journey becomes intertwined with Emperor Huizong, his struggles and revelations ultimately inspire the creation of the legendary painting A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains.

Lin Fen Fen is working hard to become a singer but continually fails the auditions. Through a series of events, she is discovered by a company and enters her idol training. Through hard times and lots of work, Fen Fen chases her dreams, forges new friendships, and discovers love.

A story that revolves around five families in the neighborhood and their interactions with their friends and family during the late 1980's.
Inside a small city in the south of China lived a mix of people both young and old. There was Gao Xiao Min and her three sisters, four boys with very different personalities and their parents who worry over and laugh about the simplest things. Gao Xiao Min bears the burden of their family's debt and her father's unemployment. Bao Zi's dad has had to deal with ups and downs. This is a slice of life view into the ordinary living of a special neighborhood.

While fleeing loan-sharks that were chasing her childhood friend Zhou Xing, hustler Tong Hua encounters young CEO Qiu Tian. Realizing she's lost a cherished necklace in his car, she seeks him out only to discover a conspiracy against him involving his secretary. Thankful towards Tong Hua, Qiu Tian offers her a favor, a favor that ultimately leads to her living with Qiu Tian for a period. 

What happens when Qiu Tian's father and intended fiancé discover Tong Hua’s past? Will they be able to stay together or are they destined to walk different paths?

Qiao Su, the older brother, has been secretly in love with Li Mo for a very long time. He comes back after years abroad with his sights set on marrying her. Unfortunately, Li Mo has to marry the heir of the Qiao family, the unscrupulous Qiao Yi Zhou, according to a marriage contract set by their families. 

If Qiao Su has to become the Qiao family heir, that's just what he'll do.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Jia Gei Le Qian Nan You Ta Tang Ge" (我嫁给了前男友他堂哥) by You Zhi Yu (尤知遇).
Forensic doctor Xia Ying and police captain Shang Jie join hands with friends of the major crimes division's special case team to solve various bizarre cases!

With one foot in modern times and the other in ancient days, multiple romances transcend time and space to intertwine across centuries when a café worker discovers that he was a Taoist immortal in a past life. Can he reclaim his powers and his long-lost love in the present day?

In order to save her "seriously ill" adoptive father, the heroine Jing Qi Er went down the mountain to Wangyou Tea House to look for the magic medicine - Guiyuan Pill. She met Huan Yun Hua, the master of Yunshan Pavilion, who pretended to be the tea house owner's son that had been missing for many years. The young owner of the tea house comes to rob it, and the two pretend to be a couple "with their own agendas". However, an old grudge is involved, and an unexpected combination of circumstances restores the reputation of the tea house, and they fall in love with each other. The world is vast, but pleasure and happiness are within easy reach.

The ninth princess of the Southern Kingdom, Hong Dou, grew up smart and mature, read the art of war and strategy, and hid her talent to avoid the front line. Later, she came to the throne by thunderous means and crowned herself the Empress. On the night of her ascension to the throne, Hong Dou travelled to modern times and met the star Ye Xing. Ye Xing and Hong Dou, a happy couple, tried all kinds of ways to help Hong Dou cross back to the southern country. 

When Hong Dou returned to the southern country began to reorganise the country vigorously but did not know that Ye Xing also followed the crossing to the southern country and became Hong Dou's "male favourite". Thus, the happy couple began to play the court version of the battle of wits.

It may seem like a story of martial arts hegemony, but it is actually a story of reasoning and suspense: 20 years ago, a tragedy occurred in the Huashan faction. The old leader was alone and his daughter-in-law Zhou Ruoxi was killed by the traitor Li Zongyou. Since then, the third and fourth skills of the Huashan School were lost. In the Dugu family, only Duguying, a young girl, and Duguxue, whose legs are disabled, are left. Twenty years later. A young mysterious man boarded the Huashan School. The man had a hoarse voice, a scar on his face, and a veil on his head, and looked ugly and terrible. This person claims to challenge the Huashan faction. If no one has beaten himself alone, this palm position must be taken by himself. Duguying panicked for a while, thinking her father's foundation would be ruined. Suddenly, a young man came to Huashan School. This person was giggling, saying…

Su Lyu Xia, a bright girl, shoulders the mission of maintaining the comic space. She is supposed to enter the body of the supporting actress to correct the plot. However, she enters the body of the heroine in the small fictional world by accident. After checking with the system Shushu, she finds that Bai Ting, a woman who doesn't belong to the world, has occupied the body of the supporting actress. Bai Ting intends to make the supporting actress into the leading actress by changing the plot in the time and space of the small world. In order to prevent the story line from being altered and the small world from collapsing, Su Lyu Xia starts to rectify the main plot during one after another confrontation with Bai Ting. Su Lyu Xia tries her best to get the altered plot back on track by correcting some branch lines.
A family. An inheritance. An accident. Nothing is an accident.

Li Zhi's world shatters when she discovers she is not the biological daughter of the family she grew up with. Her adoptive parents throw her out, and her fiancé, who she trusted, breaks off their engagement. To make matters worse, the biological daughter of her family takes her place, inheriting everything that once belonged to Li Zhi. Heartbroken and in despair, Li Zhi drowns her sorrows in alcohol. In a drunken state, she ends up spending the night with Lou Yan Jing, her school friend and a wealthy CEO, who has secretly loved her for years.

The next day, Lou Yan Jing, unable to bear the thought of Li Zhi suffering alone, demands that she marry him. Desperate and confused, Li Zhi agrees, and they quickly marry. As they begin their life together, they participate in a couple's game, which helps them bond and develop a deeper relationship.

However, Li Zhi’s ex-family and fiancé are far…

It tells the story of Li Qing Tong, a brave female general who faithfully defended Great Song Kingdom, after her father, the late General, died. However, her life changes forever when she meets Si You Yu, a young talented doctor who approaches Li Qing Tong purposefully, but later falls in love with her.

Liu Xiao Xiao, a female disciple of the Chen family whom are known for being the best in the world of puppet opera, has been restarting the tragic day when their club suffered a fire. Unexpectedly, she meets Song Ke Yang, a cartoonist from the future; together they expose the truth of the fire and unravel the mystery of her life.

After rigorous cultivation, humans can ascend to become gods. Above gods are immortals, and above immortals are emperors. Jiang Feng, after a thousand years of hard cultivation, finally ascended to become the Nine Extremes Immortal Emperor. Once mortals broke through the realm of the Immortal Emperor, they could tear through the rift of space and time to defy fate. Determined to rectify all his past regrets, Jiang Feng decided to return to the mortal world. 

However, upon his return, he discovered that his benefactor, Master Liu, had been poisoned and was in critical condition; his wife, Liu Chenfei, the most beautiful woman in Jiangcheng, was being forced into remarriage; and the entire Jiang family of 138 members had been massacred. At this moment, Jiang Feng unsheathed his Tiangang Sword, which had been sealed for a thousand years.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xian Di Gui Lai…

Su Ning confessed to Lu Chi Xu but was fired. She slept with him that night and tried to run away, but was taken back. She decisively refused Lu Chi Xu's request to "marry" her, but they eventually got married.

Twin sisters Chu Xia and Xiao Jin meet and reunite due to an accident, but both accidentally fall in love with the same boy, Guan Hao. After repeated hardships and life and death tests, Chu Xia takes friendship and love on a different course, fighting with her lover...

Jin Qian has constantly failed her examinations to become a city employee. Feeling frustrated, she wants to use the broken time machine her friend made to cheat. However, the machine malfunctioned and sent her back to the Northern Song Dynasty. She disguised as a man and became a constable at Kai Feng Manor, and comes under the lead of the renowned Bao Qing Tian. Thus begins her career as a civil employee in the Northern Song Dynasty, where she meets many famed historical figures and also the final boss Prince Xiang Yang...

Fu Jiao possesses an extraordinary talent in the field of IT and computing studies. She develops an application but finds out that it shares many similarities with an application that is developed by Teng Yao, a powerful and influential organization. This leads to misunderstandings that Fu Jiao is an "inner spy" and is chased out of her company and living quarters. In a twist of fate, she ends up living with Wang Yang, with whom she is at odds. As time goes by, the two loggerheads develop a bond and work together to find out the truth.
dramas.t: The Geek Is on the Run

dramas.syn:
On the eve of the Spring Festival in 2020, the sudden outbreak of the epidemic completely changed the lives of senior high students thus opening the curtains to their "biggest test".

The epidemic suddenly hit China in early 2020 and the senior high school students of Jinhe County, Anhui Province faced an unprecedented test. Just as everyone overcame difficulties to take the gaokao (college entrance examination), a flash flood brought forth new challenges. With the joint efforts of the party, the government and all sectors of society, satisfactory answers were handed in for this "big examination".

As the sole heir of the Qian family, Qian Ye is troubled by the family curse that will subject her to experience misfortune at the age of twenty-nine, so she has to accept the bodyguard her grandmother has hired to protect her. 

Due to their different backgrounds and personalities, Qian Ye  and her bodyguard Wu Shi Mao are constantly in conflict with each other. Qian Ye tries her best to drive Wu Shi Mao away yet he risks his life to rescue her from her ex-boyfriend and brings her back to the place of the Plum Blossom Fist. 

Wu Shi Mao's master agrees to take Qian Ye in temporarily on the condition that she will not disturb other disciples from practicing. Who would have thought that QianYe's grandma is actually an old friend of Wu Shi Mao's master? His master uncharacteristically turns into the biggest "wingman" to help the two find love.  At this moment, Qian Ye's ex reappears,…

In the 1980s, the top student of the police academy, Du Xiang Dong, was assigned against his wishes to a detention center. Two suspects escaped from the jail; one died, and the other got away. Du Xiang Dong blamed himself and impulsively resigned. For the next twenty years, he found himself in a battle of wits with the escaped suspect, Xu Wen Geng. Both followed their own ways of life, engaging in a strategic duel amidst the tides of the times.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Jie Ming Er Sheng" (借命而生) by Shi Yi Feng (石一枫).

On the day Chen Xi and her boyfriend broke up, she accidentally encountered her destined man – Ao Chen, the future sea god.  Accidentally, they started living together.  During their time together, they started to get closer.  Ao Chen sees Chen Xi as his destined partner.  However, an unexpected test arrives silently at this time to test their feelings for each other.

Su Xiao Mu has a secret sideline business. She opened a "men's supermarket" and specializes in matchmaking. But her latest client, Xia He Xi, president of Zhengwei Group, has frustrated her, and make her doubt, her career choice. With the help of the three brothers of the Su family, the two not only joined forces to solve the group crisis, but also finally settled each other's lifelong events.

Forced by life’s hardships, Xu Qing Zhi unexpectedly crosses paths again with Lu Yu Chen — the man she has secretly loved for eight years.

Lu Yu Chen, having tasted the forbidden, treats her only as a hidden lover and never dares to hope for forever. She feels the same — until the agreed-upon deadline arrives. She leaves with composure, and only then does Lu Yu Chen realize he has loved her to his very core.

The tide of life pushes everyone forward. You can either face it head-on or lie flat. This is an open-book exam with no standard answers. You can draw lessons from each other but can't cheat. 

Lin Shao Tao and Jian Ai fell in love at first sight in college, didn't break up after graduation like most couples did, and managed to get married after years of ups and downs. Every stage of their love made people around them feel jealous. Therefore, it took Lin Shao Tao by surprise that his family life broke down when he was trying to achieve a revolution in his industry in middle age. As for Jian Ai, she didn't tell anyone about her reason for the divorce.

Jian Ai planned to leave Beijing for Dali. But because of her previous working experience, she was engaged by Liu Ying Xia to solve the optimization crisis of VG China. Coincidentally, her ex-husband also got back to work in VG as an…

When the lead actor is also the benefactor funding the whole shoot, and he's hysterically changing the script to fulfil his dream of being a hero in various costumes, things are bound to get a little out of control. 

The humble yet stubborn screenwriter is powerless to resist the demands of the show's investor who wants to be the male lead in every conceivable story. As a result, the plot is haywire, and characer building is a fail. From palace fights and suspense to xianxia and time travel, it's a melting pot of costume dramas. With everyone thinking that they're witnessing a farce, you'll find that beneath it all is an actor's unrestrained pursuit for redemption and for his dreams.

"Sick Cat" Chen Ting, a freshman at Xicheng Technical School, secretly changes his major from cooking to auto-repairing in order to resist his father's harsh discipline. He thus becomes acquainted with a group of friends, including "Page Boy Hao," a junior who is keen to create avant-garde fashion, and "Shark Zhen," a locomotive girl who is eager to go to Hong Kong to pursue her dream. Seven small partners hand in hand with each other to face difficulties of growth, eventually help "Shark Zhen" achieve distant dreams, and also let "Sick Cat" find his own ideals step by step and grow into a truly responsible teenager.

A gifted girl protected by a mountain deity falls in love with an amnesiac general she once saved. Bound by a vow that drives them apart, she later reunites with him, only to be met with cold suspicion. Disguised as a soldier, she joins his army and uses her prophetic abilities to protect him. But when her people face annihilation, Bu Ni An’s true identity awakens, forcing her to choose between the man she loves and the destiny she was born to fulfill.

Zhu Yi Ran inherits the Su fan-making skills from her grandfather and reunites with her childhood sweetheart, Shen Feng, at the intangible cultural heritage market. At that time, he is already an ancient city cell structure engineer who has returned from abroad. The two work together to protect Suzhou.

The story follows Ling Chuxia, a young girl trapped in a difficult situation, who bravely defies family constraints and societal criticism. She forms a bond with the male lead, Liang Junye, who shares her struggles. Together, they support each other, overcome their life challenges, and join forces to uncover an evil conspiracy by a foreign tribe, ultimately protecting their homeland.

After the illegitimate daughter Jin Wu ended her 17-year pursuit of Fu Yu Chen, she reunited with Duan Shi Yan, who had been secretly in love with her for ten years. At first, she thought that her marriage with Duan Shi Yan was just a formality, but later she realized that he had been waiting for this moment for a long time.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Lun Xian! Dai Jin! Qing Leng Mei Ren Bei You Chan Kuang Chong" (沦陷！带劲！清冷美人被诱缠狂宠) by You Yi Li (幼一栗).

Ling Yun, a cunning palace maid, rises through the imperial ranks to become the emperor’s favored consort, exposing the empress’s hidden corruption. But her ascent comes at a terrible cost, as she becomes ensnared in ruthless palace intrigues and a forbidden love that could destroy her.

A century-old pig demon, Chen Xiao Zhu, sets out to steal a demon-catching gourd from the powerful demigod Feng Pan but ends up bound to him by a curse. Forced to stay by his side, they embark on a journey of demon hunting, encountering love and conflict between humans and monsters. As they grow closer, they uncover a forgotten bond from a past life that ties their fates together.
dramas.t: Chun Hua Lan Man Chen Xiao Zhu

dramas.syn: Game artist An Mei has always been addicted to the illusory love of the game NPC Lu Ting. After six years of companionship, Lu Ting has already become her emotional sustenance. When the company chose to eliminate Lu Ting for profit, An Mei couldn't bear Lu Ting's disappearance and planned to enter the game to help Lu Ting change the plot line, but an accident happened...

Su Mu Li, the dual-personality lord of Fengcheng City, is feared for her unpredictable nature. While the world sees her as both gentle and ruthless, her true struggles remain hidden. Assassin Duan Yun Yi, tasked with eliminating her, infiltrates her palace by posing as Han Zi Ling and marrying her. His plan is simple: get close and strike. However, he uncovers an unexpected truth—Su Mu Li's kind-hearted side seeks the same goal as him: to destroy her vicious alter ego. Together, they confront the darkness threatening to consume her entirely.

A story about grassroots efforts follows Mei Xiao Ge and his colleagues uniting the people to develop Guangming County.

On the eve of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, Mei Xiao Ge takes office as the governor of Guangming County and becomes colleagues with Lv Qingshan, Secretary of the County Party Committee and Ai Xian Zhi who's the Deputy Secretary. At this time, Guangming County is in urgent need of repair and development. 

With his high EQ, Mei Xiao Ge manages to get along well with his colleagues to smoothen out issues that may arise from new governance; he also has the courage to see things through to the end no matter how difficult. Upon taking office, he starts off on a journey to travel across hundreds of villages in Guangming County. 

After being elected as the secretary of the county party committee, Mei Xiao Ge commits to promoting deepening…

The Luo family, a blended family living on Good Luck Street, consists of a widowed father with twins, a divorced mother with a daughter, and their young daughter from their marriage. They lead a warm, simple life, admired by neighbors as a "lucky family." While the parents wish for their children's happiness, the children face personal struggles and hide them from their elders. With the support of the parents, the children eventually find happiness: the second daughter reunites with her ex-husband after resolving their issues, and the youngest daughter courageously returns to college, eventually becoming a couple with her brother-in-law's sibling.

Cheng Wei Ran's firm specializes in the services of celebrities and wealthy businessmen. As a newcomer, she works with lawyer Song Jun Wei, a partner in the firm. Lawyer Song is very protective of Cheng Wei Ran who has a strong and courageous personality but lacks understanding of adapting to the dark rules. The mistress of one of the directors of Hengren Group had a "stealing habit", and she was detained for stealing wallets in the shopping mall, Cheng Wei Ran was sent to clean up afterwards.

In order to escape, the mistress provided important clues to a late-night sports car traffic accident. The suspect in the sports car accident case is the security guard at a clubhouse in Hengren Group. As a result, the evidence was thus transformed, and the traffic accident case was characterized as a brutal murder, which became a scandal of Hengren Group, which blamed lawyer Song and Cheng for…

In order to save his seriously ill mother, Xiao Can trades his own life. After recovery, his mother returned to her 20-year-old appearance, but Xiao Can could encounter an accident at any time, so he decided to help his mother fulfill her dream while he was alive.

~~ Adapted from the web manhua "Wo De Mama Shi Xiao Hua" (我的妈妈是校花) by Hong Seung Pyo (洪承杓) and GuGu.

An exciting collaborative project featuring an all-star ensemble of the "Xiren" comedy troupe, this series sparks a creative collision between classic cinema and a new generation of comedy. Giving a fresh spin to familiar themes, it serves up a unique "rural business war" that is both deeply moving and laugh-out-loud funny.

~~Adapted from Stephen Chow’s 1999 film of the same name "The King of Comedy".

After being betrayed by the man she gave everything up for, Dong Fang Xi, a wealthy heiress, discovers she's the villainess in a novel and makes a deal with a mysterious system to change her fate—only to find that the system itself hides a long-buried secret of love.

Jiang Li, daughter of the Grand Tutor, often retreats to the secluded Wenxiang Pavilion with her confidante, A Zhao, to avoid an arranged marriage. Forced into a marriage with the Left General, she enters the palace, only to discover that A Zhao is the reigning emperor. From then on, they are deeply entangled in love and palace secrets.

Lin Mian, a student in the Department of Architecture, called Shi Lin by mistake because his father was critically ill and needed money. The two of them had a relationship, and Shi Lin solved the dilemma for Lin Mian. After one night, they thought they would never meet again, but they met again in a bar the next night. She was saved by Shi Lin and they had sex again. After that night, Lin Mian felt that she could no longer be entangled with Shi Lin, so she deleted his contact information. Unexpectedly, she met Shi Lin again at the internship place.

Set in Northern Song, it revolves around the life of Wang Ling Zhi, the son of legendary doctor Wang Wei and his wife Yu Guan Niang, an expert in Chinese food therapy, as they went through struggles and turmoils to redress the injustice of Wang's family grievances, and eventually successfully spreading the knowledge of medicine and saving lives.
The love story between Mo Yue Ying, a young girl who is eccentric and addicted to alcohol, and Hua Wu You, a genius young man with extremely high brewing skills.
dramas.t: Hua Jian Jiu Ren Jian Yue

dramas.syn: Slum girl Wu Bao Hui unexpectedly obtains a huge fortune and pretends to be the daughter of a wealthy family, Li Zi Yu. At the same time, she is horrified to find that she may have fallen into the power conspiracy of the wealthy family.

The modern and humble son-in-law, Li You, arrived at the Xujiang County of the Daning Dynasty and took on the role of a yamen runner, following in his father’s footsteps.

Being mocked as a lowly yamen runner, Li You, filled with anger, presented a poem as a gift to Li Huan, a songstress who had also been humiliated. Unexpectedly, the poem gained great fame, making him a talented official and catching the attention of the county magistrate. Li You’s path to success was opening up, but little did he know that being a talented young man could also be dangerous. He found himself caught in a marriage dispute between the martial officer Liu and the wealthy merchant Guan, becoming a son-in-law of both families due to a twist of fate. To his surprise, even after changing time and space, he remained a son-in-law and even upgraded to being a double son-in-law! Fortunately, Li You was clever and…

After losing everything and falling into a coma, Hua Xiao Fei awakens in a bustling imperial city, where she rises from nothing to build a thriving business through integrity and grit. As she joins forces with undercover royal agent Xu Zi Qi to expose a dangerous price-fixing conspiracy tied to the merchants’ guild, their pursuit of justice leads to love and Hua Xiao Fei’s rise to a legendary merchant.

It focuses on the ancient legal system figure of the “pen-wielding woman”, a woman who wielded the brush like a blade to argue the law. The drama presents a powerful female ensemble skilled at using words to uncover truth, while also highlighting the clear-minded and resolute growth of a woman who breaks free from the confines of her household.

The journey of an ordinary girl in becoming a North Drifter. Chen Ke moves from Sichuan to Beijing to start her life, only to be dumped by her school sweetheart. She learnt quickly that to succeed in her career and lifestyle choices, she not only has to work hard and smart but also requires the assistance of successful men whom she would love and leave. 

~~ Adapted from the short story "Tokyo Women's Guidebook".

A story revolving around a woman who chooses to stay in Shanghai after graduating from college. She encounters many men in her life but doesn't stray from her aim to become part of the upper 10% of the city's population.

Luo Hai Yan is a university student from a small town who strives to carve out a career for herself in Shanghai. When Zhang Tian Hao, Chen Xiao Wei, and Yan Bing come into the picture, they make an impact on her life.

dramas.nt: 如果这辈子我还记得你
dramas.syn: Jiang Yuan Yuan, a well-known jewelry designer, and Lu Zhao Wei, the group boss, are pregnant and about to get married. On the eve of the wedding, Yuan Yuan was plotted against and lost her memory. She was sold to the countryside to be a daughter-in-law. Five years later, she meets Zhao Wei and his daughter again. Can they find each other this time?
dramas.t: Ru Guo Zhe Bei Zi Wo Hai Ji De Ni

dramas.syn: After surviving a brutal massacre, Qin Shi Yue is taken in by Commander Dai Shi Yao and finds herself caught between two brothers: A Sheng, whose feelings evolve from greed to love, and Dai Shi Yao, who moves from suspicion to affection. As war erupts, they challenge their destinies through sacrifice and loyalty, while Qin Shi Yue uncovers the truth behind her father’s wrongful death and discovers a new beginning.

Wu Ming, the heir of a traditional Chinese medicine family, descends the mountain to save his fiancée’s life. Unexpectedly, he encounters the ailing Chairman of the Yang Group, who’s offering a hundred million for a cure. Wu Ming’s journey is filled with challenges and opportunities, attracting the attention of several beautiful women. How will he navigate these temptations?
The story of a workplace rookie and four male colleagues with different personalities.
dramas.t: I Don't Want to Run Season 2

dramas.syn: It tells the story of Bai Luo An and Huo Ling, who, once in love, divorced due to lies and misunderstandings. Five years later, they reunite through work. Huo Ling still holds a grudge over Bai Luo An's past deception and mistakenly believes she is now married with children. In retaliation, he deliberately halts Bai Luo An's children's art therapy project. Determined to protect her hard work, Bai Luo An persistently fights for the opportunity. The two go from outwitting each other to working together, thus unfolding a bittersweet and deeply emotional love story.

After realizing she was a small supporting character in a novel, one who is tragically killed right at the beginning and subjected to constant injustice, Song Zhen Xing begins to break the narrative.

When a man she was set up with on a blind date attempts to frame her as a mistress and takes nude photos to socially destroy her, assuming she wouldn't dare speak out because she graduated from a strict "virtuous women's academy," she retaliates by plunging a knife.

When her elders attempt to seize control of her company under the guise of "helping," she politely declines, announcing that she will personally manage the company, effective immediately.

When her mother forces her into blind dates in the name of "love," she hires Lu Zheng. Lu Zheng is 20 years old, very obedient and compliant, and acts as her shield. Even when he is bruised and battered, he never takes a step back, only…

“Out of Court” is a new streaming drama series that focuses on Chinese legal professionals and intriguing legal cases.

The new drama features two different series of the Blinding elephant and The last Straw that take place in different times but are still interconnected. These two stories add to the suspense of the series and as little clues are added in the final truth is revealed at the show's end.

On the road of revenge, the genius perfumer Gu Ying Ying encounters Han Yi Chen, the only son of the president of the Han Group. He gets into a car accident and becomes colorblind, and the unique scent of her perfume restores his optic nerve, and the two fall in love. Seemingly happy and happy marriage, dark tide is surging. The truth of family affection and love will begin.

Back in their school days, Wen Ni and Jian Yu Chen were fierce rivals, always at odds with each other. Who could have imagined that years later, they would become a married couple by contract? At work, their sharp and decisive styles make all employees tremble in fear. Yet, what shocks everyone even more is that this awe-inspiring duo are secretly husband and wife. The shifting tides of the workplace and the unpredictable turns of love constantly test their relationship.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ling Du Ai Mei" (零度暧昧), also known as "Wen Rou Ye Gu" (温柔野骨), by Lan Sheng (澜笙).

After Jiang Yun Zhi transmigrates into a novel, she becomes the cannon-fodder “fake daughter” in a rich-family drama. The original Jiang Yun Zhi slit her wrists for scumbag Shen Xu Zhou, but upon waking in her place, the new Jiang Yun Zhi decides to seize control of her fate — and treat being the richest man’s wife as a high-paying job. At first, Yan Wen Jing is indifferent to her past entanglement with Shen Xu Zhou, but gradually, he finds himself drawn to her bright and lively nature. The two go from mutual testing to genuine affection.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jing Quan Da Lao De Lian Yin Xiao Mei Gui, You Tian You Yu" (京圈大佬的联姻小玫瑰，又甜又欲), also known as "Zhao Jia Bu Zhu! Jing Quan Da Lao Di Tou You Chong" (招架不住！京圈大佬低头诱宠), by Tang You You (唐呦柚).

With the overall achievement of a well-off society in 2020 as the background, the theme is grand. But in storytelling, it is not from a grand perspective, but to explore the lives of ordinary people.

There are 6 mini-stories:

1. Fei Chang Xia Ri (非常夏日)
2. Qing Chun Yong Zhu (青春永驻)
3. Nian Qing You Wei (青年有为)
4. Lai Wan Ya Xue Fen Si Tang (来碗鸭血粉丝汤)
5. Nian Ye Fan (年夜饭)
6. Xiang Wang (向往)

In a country called Wushuangguo, the new king and the beautiful female beggar Qian Duo Duo find themselves in each other’s bodies and hilarity ensues, causing an uproar in the palace and in the harem.

During filming of a play about a legendary sword by the name of Si Yun, an actor, an actress and a movie-investor is sucked into the play itself.
In this alternate world the actor Zhou Lou Chen and the actress Xu Yi Nuo, who normally dislike each other, are now the legendary Sword Saint and his wife. In order to be able to return to the real world again, the “couple” has to participate in a competition to acquire Si Yun along with several other skilled martial artists. But they soon realize that there seems to be a hidden agenda and unknown forces are already trying to ruin the couple’s chances of winning and that they will have to rely on each other to succeed. The appearance of the movie-investor Song Ning Yan as one of the fellow competitors complicates matters even more.

The five ladies on the 22nd floor of the Ode to Joy community face new challenges and opportunities in their careers, lives and relationships. 

Ye Zhen Zhen and Dai Wei really hit it off but given how devoted she is to scientific research, she is inevitably caught in all kinds of criticism at work and the tug-of-war between the two families. Fang Zhi Heng  gradually walks out of the shadows of her past thanks to her lovely group of friends. Zhu Zhe may have a difficult boss, but she believes there is no road that is forever blocked and there will be opportunities for ordinary people to shine. He Min Hong  experiences more setbacks and under the influence of her boyfriend, she drifts away from the girls. Yu Chu Hui focuses on work and she's no longer as confused as she once was after graduation. The 22nd floor is like a safe haven. Although there will be disputes and doubts among the…
~~ Adapted from the webcomic "Under One Person" (一人之下) by Mi Er (米二).

Ouyang Xia Lan is a trade investigator. Her work leads her to Peng Yue, the second son of the Tianguan Group. With two people from different worlds, their differences in ideals and motivations immediately put them on opposite sides.

Set against the backdrop of the automobile industry, Ouyang Xia Lan is a professional who can do what it takes to complete her job. She has a personal reason for getting into Tianguan Group, which is to find the reason behind her father's death. Peng Yue is in charge of R&D for their company. Ouyang Xia Lan and Peng Yue's first meeting was a disaster, yet despite their bickering, the two developed feelings for each other.

After several twists and turns, the two finally came together after overcoming many difficulties and brought the world to see China's automobile achievements.

~~ Adapted from the novel "The Golden Turtle" (金龟记) by Jinjiang Literature…

Against the backdrop of three important historical events before the founding of New China, The Eve follows Lin Xi, Su Nan and other passionate youths who join the revolution and devote themselves to serving their country.

The story is set in the three historical stages of the Shanghai Concession in 1941, the Battle of Jinzhou in 1948 and the liberation of Shanghai in 1949. Gang member Lin Xi and progressive female student Su Nan represent the unsung heroes of their time. It depicts the secret battles and hidden dangers during the Anti-Japanese War of Resistance and the difficult path revolutionary workers have taken for the sake of their ideals.

To reclaim her mother’s company, Shen Qing Ci transforms herself from a mysterious assassin into a seemingly aloof and innocent “white flower.” According to the agreement, she enters a flash marriage with Xi Xing Ye. At their first meeting, Xi Xing Ye is stunned by Shen Qing Ci’s delicate appearance, and as they spend more time together, he falls ever deeper for the mysterious and powerful woman behind the façade.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Lao Po Tai Ye, Fan Gu Tai Zi Ye Ku Zhe Qiu Tie Tie" (老婆太野，反骨太子爷哭着求贴贴), also known as "Hong Bu Liao, Zuo Jing Tai Zi Ye You Cha You Ku Bao" (哄不了，作精太子爷又茶又哭包), by Tu Lao Xi (秃老师).
dramas.t: Fu Ren Ta Zhuan Zhi Bu Fu

dramas.syn: As soon as graduation, in order to be able to confess smoothly, intern Su Ran Ran worked hard to join the game company where Xu Qi Heng’s love object is located, but unexpectedly clashed with the company’s founder, Zhuang Xu, on the first day of employment. When evaluating the game, the two unexpectedly exchanged souls. In the face of Su Ran Ran’s confession, Zhuang Xu agreed with the mentality of writing a man, and Xu Qi Heng, who only regarded Su Ran Ran as his sister, was very distressed. In order to minimize the damage, the two had to make mistakes. But in the day and night with Su Ran Ran, both of them had a wonderful chemical reaction with this girl. At the same time, Su Ran Ran gradually became aware of the strangeness. After the truth was revealed, where would the three people’s feelings go.
dramas.t: The Bamboo Horse Falls into the Sky

dramas.syn:
As soon as the story of "Floating Dream Song" begins, the audience is dragged into a vortex of rivers and lakes full of grievances and hatred. Su Meng Yan, the daughter of the head of the Liuying Sect, and Fu Sheng, the young master of the Lengyue Sect, were originally a match made in heaven, but they were trapped in the quagmire of fate due to the disputes between the two sects. Su's father, Su Yao Tian, was obsessed with power and designed to kill Fu Sheng's parents. 

Later, in order to quell the war between the two sects, Su Meng Yan was forcibly married to the Lengyue Sect as a hostage for a truce and forced to steal the Lengyue Sect's sacred object "Leng Lingzhu". Before getting married, Su Meng Yan was sealed with all her memories related to Fu Sheng and mistakenly believed that Fu Sheng had caused her brother to be seriously ill. Fu Sheng, who was deeply hurt by the loss of his…

It follows a group of idol trainees with dreams to brave the winds and waves in their journey to stand on stage.

Gu Yang who has been playing piano since he was a child was accepted to the Julliard School of Music. Alas, with his family going bankrupt, he can no longer enroll as planned. In order to hold on to his musical dreams and appease his distressed mother, Gu Yang joins an agency as a trainee. Since Gu Yang only knows classical music and practically nothing about pop music, he is put into the backup group. Here, he meets Zhao Zhengnan  who dances well and Lu Xinghao, who sings well. With their help, Gu Yang steadily improves and manages to beat out the rest to become part of the debut group. Meanwhile, Lin Chen who used to follow Gu Yang around is no longer the person he once was. He considers Gu Yang to be his fiercest competitor and will do anything to surpass him.

After 500 years of seclusion, cultivator Hua Zhao Yang attains the Heavenly Being Realm and confronts her nemesis, Ye Tian. To complete her ascension, she must fulfill Ye Tian's final wish. Thus begins Hua Zhao Yang's journey through reincarnations, seeking Ye Tian's past self to erase his malice and uncover the true power of redemption.

Meng Li Yue's mother thinks its a crime not to be married at 28 - but her heart belongs to the hero of her high school days. After meeting again she takes a chance with a flash marriage. He treats her well but their relationship stirs up old conflicts with her father's other family.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ji Zhang Xian Sheng, Lei Yu Qing Rao Fei" (机长先生，雷雨请绕飞) by Zhao Le (昭乐).
dramas.t: Shan Hun Gao Leng Ji Zhang Da Ren

dramas.syn: A youth sports drama centered around the world of professional and international car-racing.

19 years ago, the angelic sister of the Xuan family was murdered bizarrely. The murder case was stagnated for many years, and the murderer remains at large. As a result, the Xuan family spread out from north to the south, living on their own. 19 years later, a bizarre case occurred in a small town ropes in the Xuan family again, causing the divided family to reunite in their hometown. As the truth of the old case gradually surfaced, years of conflict between the tormented brothers and sisters finally broke out. Where will the family of four go? Can they untie the knot they have and get out of this thick mysterious fog?

Jian Qiu, an heiress, loses everything when her family goes bankrupt, her fiancé betrays her, and she is pushed to her death from a building. After making a pact with a Cat Immortal, she is reborn as Xia Mo, an obscure C-list actress, and embarks on a meticulously planned journey of revenge.

~~ Adapted from the visual novel game "The Heart-Stealing Screen Siren" (偷心魔女) by Yi Guan Chu Chu (伊冠楚楚).
dramas.t: Ni Xi Zhi Tou Xin Qian Jin

dramas.syn:
The amnesiac youth killer Yue Yao finally embarks on her first killing mission at the age of sixteen, where she is ordered by her master to assassinate the ruthless General He Yun Xing of the Fourteenth Government Office. Yue Yao sneaks into the general's mansion but fails to assassinate He Yun Xing, and she is even tricked by him into becoming his newly-married bride! In order to complete the assassination mission, Yue Yao plays along and assumes the role of He Yun Xing's newly-married bride.

Soon, a series of murders occurs in the general's mansion, and Yue Yao becomes the first suspect. Stimulated by the bloody murder, Yue Yao gradually begins to recover her lost memories, unaware that she has already been embroiled in a shocking conspiracy.

The story follows Wang Ke Ke and Li Xiao Jun as the two prepare to get married. They bought a house together. But on the day of their wedding, Ke Ke discovers that for some reason, her name is NOT on the house lease. Despite Xiao Jun’s explanation, she flees the scene, leaving his family in shock. His mother asks a friend to pose as the bride but her son is adamant on marrying one woman only and cancels the wedding. The two rekindle soon after but Xiao Jun’s mom pressures for them to have kids. To prove that she’s not just a housewife material, our heroine seeks for a better job, which is when she meets Xiao Jun’s big boss and becomes his assistant. Lol. Mixing in personal misunderstandings and work conflicts, the two lovebirds are often at odd.

When Tang Chen's career was booming, he had to declare bankruptcy when he was "sold out" by his girlfriend Shuo Bing. But soon he withdrew from the swamp of failure and actively devoted himself to a second venture. Sha Zhou, a good friend for many years, has an excellent writing style, but he has always been a depressed little reporter. With the persuasion of Tang Chen and the support of his wife, he was the first to join the entrepreneurial team. 

According to the division of labor within the team, Tang Chen and Sha Zhou worked together to find Hou Zhi, Zhu Ran, and Bai Ying, and set up a gray whale public relations company. Tang Chen used his industry acumen for many years to actively search for customers, lead his partners to overcome difficulties, help pig feed magnate Xie Liqiang to build a public image, push the furious divine comedy, and win Feida's public relations contract.…
dramas.t: In Spite of the Strong Wind

dramas.syn:
The story of Chen Xiaohua, the “couch potato king” of the virtual world, and the AI “savage concubine” Madam Xiao/2099. When the country of Chen was unstable, they joined hands to rectify the treacherous officials, resist against the enemy country, and rewrite the path of fate. After experiencing nine lifetimes of “deleted files”, they still chose to restart their lives, continuing their mutual redemption and achievements.

Madam Xiao’s system-core military strength tamed her husband into someone lawful; as the intelligent robot 2099, she was made to carry this mission— thus, she wholeheartedly helped Chen Xiaohua into becoming stronger and more powerful on his road of officialdom. The good-for-nothing king Chen Xiaohua could only end his life of being a “couch potato” after meeting Madam Xiao, advancing bravely for the goal of being “history’s most assiduous emperor”. 

However, when…

Two sisters enter the palace and quickly earn the emperor’s favor, but their rise ends in tragedy when the elder sister—pregnant with the heir—is killed in a palace scheme. Left with nothing, the younger sister Lu Jiu Ning hides her grief and, as a lowly palace maid, carefully plots her revenge. Moving between rival consorts and imperial power, she wages a quiet but ruthless battle to avenge her sister’s death.

Ye Ru Yi is unexpectedly transported into a comic book as a minor, doomed character, where she encounters Zuo Qian Chen, a fallen prince living a double life as a hero. Together, they move from mutual manipulation to redemption, awakening other characters and reshaping their fates to rewrite the story.

To avenge her mother’s death, Wan Lin goes undercover for three years, posing as the fiancée of Fu Yan, heir to the underworld empire in Mai City. But on their wedding day, during a raid led by her own agency, Wan Lin shoots Fu Yan. When they meet again, enemies become allies as Wan Lin begins to see the sincerity in Fu Yan’s heart. Together, they dismantle the criminal forces from within. Vengeance eventually gives way to love, and the two step into a new life, hand in hand.

dramas.nt: 难哄，许枝俏谈个恋爱吧
dramas.syn:
Xu Zhi Qiao avoids love because of her fear of men, while Zhou Cong is resistant to feelings because of his misogyny. At a banquet, Xu Zhi Qiao met Zhou Cong, who was determined to impress her with his heart and heal her psychological trauma. As the story develops, Zhou Cong's sincerity gradually melts Xu Zhi Qiao's defenses. Can they overcome their inner obstacles and harvest true love? 

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Nan Hong, Ye Pi Tai Zi Ye Yao Ku Le" (难哄，野痞太子爷要哭了) by Ai Chi Dun Rou De Dong Hua Qi Zi (爱吃炖肉的东华七子).
dramas.t: You're the Best Thing That Ever Happened to Me

dramas.syn:
It tells a story of female revenge in which Xu Jing, a director who has returned from overseas, comes back with a revenge drama aimed directly at her top-star ex-husband, Zhao Xiao, fighting her way through lies, betrayal, and conflicts of interest.

Three years ago, Zhao Xiao deceived Xu Jing in the name of love and took half the skin from her face, leaving her disfigured before abandoning her. Now, she sets a trap under a new identity, using the filming of a drama as a pretext to close in on him step by step. As the truth behind the face transplant and the identity of the missing child gradually comes to light, this meticulously planned revenge will ultimately tear away every false mask.

This is the legend of Zhu Tian Bao. He is the second son of Prince Jian Xing, and his older brother is Zhu Tian Xiang. The story starts off with Yang Ruo Nan finding out she's marrying the eldest son, Tian Xiang, when she wants to marry Tian Bao. Tian Bao doesn't like her and leaves the city. Ruo Nan secretly follows him around, and even though Tian Bao knows, he doesn't do anything about it but enters brothels and shows her what kind of man he is. 

Through this, he meets Meng Xiao Die, who was brought into the city by her teacher, Du San Niang. Seeing the closeness between Tian Bao and Xiao Die, Ruo Nan leaves. However, to clear up the misunderstanding, Tian Bao tries to find Xiao Die but instead gets ambushed along the way. He falls down the cliff and loses his memory, only to be saved by Xiao Die's father! His brother is usurping the throne, and there are misunderstandings to be…

Can two people from completely different backgrounds, with different family legacies and even ages that don't align, find a way to be together?

Jiang Nan, 29, a renowned lawyer known as the unbeaten iron lady, whose life revolves entirely around her career. Shi Jie, 19, the chosen one, and the future heir to Wanchang Group.

When these two worlds collide, love sparks between them. But leaving their own lives behind to step into each other's worlds is far from easy. Will they ultimately return to their separate lives, or will they have the courage to break free from their constraints?

In the Northern Song dynasty, a young man named Gu Ping An came to Qiantang to investigate an unsolved case left by his father, which is where he meets Song Shi Rui,a young woman worried about paying the "singles tax". In order to not pay the tax and also allow him to investigate the happenings of the people in Qiantang, they decide to team up and pretend to be a couple and open a restaurant together.

Wu Jin, a demon hunter with moon man powers, travels with Shui Yao, Song Zhiru, and Li Yan to uncover the truth behind the demons. As secrets unfold, Wu Jin and Shui Yao fall in love, and dark pasts emerge, leading to a world-threatening crisis and a severe test for all.

Lv Shao and Li Dun, once lovers, are torn apart when she becomes a consort and he a prince. After taking the throne, his love turns to cruelty, forcing her to plan an escape. A freak accident swaps her body with Noble Consort Wen Zhao, who seizes power as Empress Dowager and tries to eliminate her. As Li Dun uncovers the truth, his obsession traps Lv Shao once more, leading to tragic consequences.

Xia Jin, as the illegitimate daughter of the Xia family, suffers constant humiliation from her stepmother and stepsister, Xian An’an. To take revenge, she climbs into the bed of Si Yan, the man Xia An'an is infatuated with. The seemingly aloof and reserved heir of the Si family finds himself unable to control his feelings for Xia Jin. Amidst the intertwining of desire, love, and hate, the two become deeply entangled.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jiao Ying" (娇莺) by Jiu Zhi (玖之).

In the mist-shrouded Xixin Sanctuary on Mount Emei lives Xi Xin, the laid-back "Palace Deity of Idleness," who spends his days doing as little as possible. His peaceful existence is shattered when the head of the Qin family mysteriously dies from spontaneous combustion during a festival procession honoring the gods. To Xi Xin's shock, all of the evidence points to him as the murderer.

Determined to clear his name, Xi Xin joins forces with Lu Wu Jiu, the newly appointed constable of Luomu Town, to uncover the truth behind the bizarre case. Their investigation not only exposes the real culprit but also reveals the long-buried secret of a curse placed upon the Qin family by the so-called "Greatest Evil God Under Heaven."

A legendary wartime epic that covers Wang Yunshan's relentless battles in both love and war.
Wang Yunshan is the leader of the Eighth Route Army Regiment. Although uneducated and has a hot temper, he possess an extraordinary military mind. He dared to fight hard, was good at making strange strategic moves, hitting and winning against the Japanese army.

Due to many controversies, related to the historical background and the way the main character is presented, and many protests,  from viewers, the series was taken off the air, on November 16 with official notice,  after 9 episodes and replaced by another drama.

He Mu is the youngest son of a rich family.  As a free-spirit, he runs away from his family to avoid being tied down by an arranged marriage. Highly adaptable, he works his way up at a different company and meets a hard-working girl in the process.

In her childhood, Gu Yu Xi was bought by Gu Yan Chen as a playmate. However, Gu Yan Chen never treated her as such; instead, the both of them developed feelings for one another.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Cha Cuo" (差错) by Yi Bao Xun Xian Yu Xia (一包熏咸鱼小).

The story of Bian Nan and Qiu Yi, two rivals from opposing schools, who became close friends through an unexpected incident which brings them together.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Lang Xing Cheng Shuang" (狼行成双) by Wu Zhe (巫哲).
tags: Censored Adaptation Of Same-sex Original Work

dramas.syn: Gu Qian Yu, as a child, was involved in a car accident in which he lost his parents. Tragedy left a deep scar on him, in the form of psychological trauma, that doesn't allow him to get closer to other people. So he goes through his life, unable to love and feeling loved, by anyone.  However, that changes one day when he meets Zeng Fan Xing. And there would be nothing strange about this meeting, if not for the fact that the girl is a robot who is supposed to keep him company, but also to heal his emotional scars.

To find his missing sister, police officer Han Chuan assumes the identity of legendary con artist Brother Thirteen and infiltrates a scam-ridden island, uncovering a web of deceit, greed, and hidden crimes.

Nan Zhi and Zhou Ji Li have been in love for many years. When the sweetness faded and their views began to diverge. she discovered that her boyfriend and Bai Yue Guang had been secretly hooking up. Dirty men are worthless. Nan Zhi has no regrets and decisively broke up with Zhou Ji Li. At the same time, the handsome captain Shang Chen Yu, who has been secretly in love with her for nine years, began to pursue her passionately. Zhou Ji Li regretted it and tried his best to win back Nan Zhi.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yu Yun Xiao Re Wen" (于云霄热吻) by Liu Lang De Lu Ci (流浪的鸬鹚).

Su Jian had a crush on Chi Yu for seven years. She got a second chance at life, and her wishes started coming true.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Qiang Niu De Xiao Cao Suan You Se, Chong Sheng Ta Bu Zhui Le" (强扭的校草酸又涩，重生她不追了) by Dao Shang Xie (刀上邪).

A heart transplant bonds the life of talented musician Xia Yuan Xing from Chongqing with Luo Jia Heng, a wealthy son from Singapore. When Luo Jia Heng obtained Xia Yuna Xing's heart, it retained its love for music and led Jia Heng back to Chongqing where he met past friends of Xia Yuan Xing: Yu Xiao Xiao, Dai Ying Xi, and Cheng Feng Ming. Together the four embarked on a journey of love, laughter, and tears.

The resourceful protagonist Zhang Yi,  who sought medical expenses for the weak and sick sister Zhang Ying, entered the college with the purpose of finding the legendary treasure of the heavens, and met the Mohist school here. The descendant of Duanmuzheng, the sultry and human librarian Nantang Prince Li Yu Yu, the melancholy divination of the divination girl Cui Jia Luo and the innocent and lively Korean Princess Wang En Zhu. 

After experiencing the incompatibility with each other and the frequent contradictions, several people began to work together to assist the school and investigate the strange cases that have occurred frequently in the local area. Zhang Yi, who originally wanted to find the treasure of the sky, was gradually open to his friends and learned to care for friends other than his sister. In the care of Duanmu, the younger sister Zhang Ying has gradually separated from…

The drama tells the warm story of three generations on the road of growth, guarding family, love and happiness. The protagonist of the story is called Zhao Jia Di, a rich young man who originally had a worry-free life because he was dissatisfied with his father's busy work all year round and neglected to care for the family.

The separation between the father and son was very deep, and he refused to accept his father. Financial aid, relying on one's own efforts, leads to a precarious life. During school, Zhao Jia Di began to emerge with his business acumen, and his life gradually became clear. What challenges will they partake in through their life's journey??

~~ Adapted from the novel "Lao Zi Shi Lai Ha Ma" (老子是癞蛤蟆) by Feng Hou Xi Zhu Hou  ( 烽火戏诸侯).

Xia Yan and Fang Yun, two best friends, accidentally transmigrate into a novel. Fang Yun becomes the obsessed wife of the cunning second male lead, Gu Bo Chuan, while Xia Yan is forced into the role of stand-in lover for the dangerous yandere antagonist, Gu Wang. On the surface, they play their parts as lovelorn captives, but behind closed doors, they are secretly indulging in every luxury their lavish, high-society lives afford. When the "white moonlight" female lead, Shen Mian Mian, returns, the two decide to "fake their deaths" and escape to avoid being swept into the tragic plot of the original story…

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Fang Xia" (方夏) by Wei Yu (卫雨).

It tells the story of several protagonists who encounter a series of emotional entanglements while helping their clients hold or win their expected love. 

The mysterious "love operation team" selects clients through specific methods to help them keep or win the love they desire. In the process of manipulating love, there seems to be some secret connection between their ordinary clients. 
 As for the members of the operating team, it seems that they also hide some unknown secrets. 

Can the operation team complete each client's order? Can the operation team really work together after all those difficulties? What will happen to the relationship between Kong Yi Ran and Xu You Chen?

It depicts the life of an ordinary married couple, how they overcome hardships together and both mature over ten years. In the 1990s, roadman Chen Ye falls in love at first sight with the department store clerk Li Zhao Di. He tricks her into marrying him by promising her that he will take the TOEFL test and emigrate with her, turning her into a wealthy expat lady. 

Meanwhile, Zhao Di has been pampered by her family since little, and her temper comes to light when the newlyweds start living together. In order to help her husband concentrate on taking the test, she takes care of the whole household, but Chen Ye still fails in the end. Moreover, Chen Ye even loses his job and Zhao Di is found out to be infertile. Zhao Di falls into despair and starts questioning whether she made the right decision.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Moonlight at City" (城里的月光) by Teng Xiao Lan (滕肖澜).

Jiang Mu Fan, who comes from a wealthy family, came first in the National Examinations. Despite his introverted personality, he was selected as the class monitor. He meets Lin Luo Yan, who makes his heart skip despite his vow not to enter into a relationship early. Meanwhile, the resident "bad kid" of the class Shao Tian Yang also has his eyes on Lin Luo Yan. The arrival of Du Xin Yue, a girl from a vocational school and the daughter of the CD shop, also influences Lin Luo Yan with her rebellious and free-spirited nature.

To avenge her father, Shen Bing Fan disguises herself to uncover the truth behind his unjust case. Along the way, she encounters the elusive "Spirit Cat" Hua Man Ge, the resourceful Cheng Xin Tian, and others who share her ideals. Together, this group of young individuals, driven by their mission, fearlessly tackles strange cases and gradually uncovers the truth to bring the traitor in.

Bai Su Zhen, a millennium-old white snake, instructed by Avalokitesvara after she failed the retribution, comes to the mortal world to find her love. Song Ye, a demon, claims he and Bai Su Zhen had an engagement a millennium ago, and Scholar Xu Xian falls for her at first sight. In two minds, she marries Xu Xian to save his life. 

Fa Hai, a monk of Jinshan Temple with his conviction that humans and demons take different ways, strongly objects to it and tries all means to separate them. However, he saves Bai Su Zhen in a life-and-death crisis. Physical wounds, memory loss and the pain of childbirth give Bai Su Zhen a spiritual awakening. Eventually, Bai gives her life for the safety of all.

Lai Dui Dui is a young college student who dreams of becoming a successful artist. She has little talent or ability when it comes to other subjects, however: She detests math, English, and other matters – and that is reflected in her dreadful grades. She is in serious danger of flunking if she does not do something about her academic performance. Also attending the same college is Jiang Zuo, a straight-A student who has no peers when it comes to all things study-related. The two have actually crossed paths before in high school. But due to a bout of prosopagnosia (a condition that means Lai Dui Dui could not recognize faces), she cannot recall who he is.

Jiang Zuo is trying to escape the attention of a possessive ex-girlfriend, so he agrees to help Lai Dui Dui if she pretends to be his girlfriend. She agrees, but this decision leads to countless complications. It turns out that Jiang…

The wandering healer Zhao Qing Qing meets a tragic death, but her soul becomes bound to the body of Su Nan Yan, the general’s daughter, through the mystical artifact "Twin Blossom Mirror" due to their identical birthdates. However, Su Nan Yan is deeply entangled in the circumstances of Zhao Qing Qing’s demise. With Su Nan Yan’s exceptional martial skills and Zhao Qing Qing’s sharp intellect, the two women, sharing one body, embark on a journey of vengeance in the imperial court.

Liu Xiang Xiang had a dream where she was in the Kingdom of Chu and became assassin, and had four opportunities to assassinate the prince Mu Chun Shen. If she failed, she was poisoned to death. In order to complete the assassination mission, she turned into a maid, a guard, and a beggar boy in the prince's mansion. Every time the assassination was about to succeed, there would be unexpected surprises.

In the process of fighting against Mu Chun Shen, she gradually discovered Mu Chun Shen's kindness and sense of responsibility and gradually fell in love with Mu Chun Shen. At the same time, she realized that there was a background/history behind this assassination mission.

Hai Tong was unlucky before she left the city where she grew up. Although her grandmother loved her, she was often bullied. Many years later, Hai Tong, who was working hard to make a living, accidentally got the certificate from a strange man but they never saw each other. It wasn't until the president of the company returned from overseas and had an ambiguity with each other that he remembered that he was a married woman.

Since her father was imprisoned, she pretended to cheat and broke up with her lover. Six years later, her son needs medical treatment. The child's father thinks she is a gold digger until a DNA test reveals his mistake.

During the anti-revolutionary coup in 1927, Xia Heng Xuan died while saving the Communist Party member Ren Zhi Yuan and left behind his younger sister Xia Yu Zhu and her maid Shuang Ju. While the delicate Yu Zhu tries to earn a living alone, Shuang Ju enters the Kuomintang’s special agent organization on the recommendation of Zhi Yuan’s lover, Xiao Cheng Bi. 

A few years later, Yu Zhu saves Zhi Yuan by chance. After Zhi Yuan sacrifices his life, Yu Zhu is touched and decides to work for the Communist Party’s underground organization. There she gets to know Cheng Bi’s younger brother Xiao Jun Hao, who received the same mission. While they work together, feelings develop.

Grandmother Liu Xiu Ying, with her perfect social skills, is the opposite of her introverted granddaughter, Liu Qi Meng. They depend on each other but have been separated for many years until an unexpected event leads to the exchange of souls, and they experience the contrasting lives of each other. They gradually understand each other and heal each other with love.

Qiao Yang, deputy chief physician at the Third Hospital, reunites with former classmate Zhou Jing Wen at Gemu Plastic Surgery Hospital a decade after a falling-out during medical school. Now, old misunderstandings resurface as they cross paths again.

Hou Liang Ping was appointed as an associate prosecutor and the director of the anti-corruption department in Bian Xi Province, to investigate a case of murder. His wife Zhong Xiao Ai, appointed by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, in the name of looking after the family, was also deployed to Bian Xi to secretly investigate the corruption of Hu. Experiencing many difficulties and setbacks, Hou and Zhong had been approaching the truth and the criminal groups behind the murder.

A corporate war that centers around Huading Group grows more and more complicated. Han Shao takes over as the chairman of the board and suspends trading for the company's stock to put a dent in Wang Rui's plans. Wang Rui sends the mysterious K to gather information on Han Shao and the others. Han Shao joins hands with Ji Xiao to hold up the fort. As Han Shao starts a new company called Wei Mei, Tang De, his egotistic business partner, becomes an obstacle and even publicly challenges him because of Su Ye. Meanwhile, the lipstick starts to lose its magic from overuse. Su Ye continues to travel different dimensions for everyone's sake.

Peng Lai has a very unconventional relationship with her daughter Bai Tian and that's because Peng Lai left her young daughter with her father in order to pursue her own dreams of becoming a rockstar abroad. When Bai Tian's father dies unexpectedly, Peng Lai is forced to return home to a now teenager and learn how to become a mom while not giving up on what she left behind. Can the two find a common tongue and have a bond or is being a mom just not something this rockstar can ever achieve?
A little mute who lost her voice for three years becomes talkative after a kiss! Yan Qian Xun gets entangled with the cool and arrogant Huo Xiao. The sweet girl starts chasing him for a kiss.
The romance between two royalties of opposing kingdoms - the Crown Prince of Eastern Song, Lian Chaochen, and princess of Southern Chu, Bai Die.
dramas.t: You Are My Peach Blossom Debt

dramas.syn:
The story begins with a romantic conspiracy confession - if, one day, my daydreams come true, who would I be? What exactly would I want? Who would appease my anxiety? Would I really be omnipotent? Would I ever want to wake up?

~~ Adapted from the novel "Bai Ri Meng Gao Bai Shu" (白日梦告白书) by Zhang Hao Chen (张皓宸).

Yun Luo Li, the eldest daughter of the Yun family, suffers from a car accident and accidentally loses her memory after waking up. She bumps into Du Si Tang, the president of the Du Group, in the hospital. Yun Luo Li had a sense of familiarity with Du Si Tang, and Du Si Tang also had an inexplicable heartbeat reaction to Yun Luo Li approaching.

In order to find out what happened, Yun Luo Li kept approaching and testing Du Si Tang, and the relationship between the two also heated up as they got to know each other. But then the loss of the secret recipe handed down by the Du family made Du Si Tang suspect Yun Luo Li's strange behavior.

Disappointed, Yun Luo Li left, determined to use the ancient wine-making techniques of the Tang Dynasty to re-develop the Yunjia wine industry and create the "Datang Style Garden". In the end, the truth about the loss of the secret recipe was found out,…

The story is about university student Cheng Da Lei who accidentally transmigrates into a video game.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "It Starts With A Mountain" (开局一座山) by Ha Ma Da Wang  (蛤蟆大王).

Lin Wan Wan is a young woman from ancient times who, in trying to save her village, opens up a box that somehow brings her to the 21st century. Here she meets Tang Zhe Yuan, who's a lawyer. They start living together and fall in love, but then someone from her past time travels to the present and she realizes that there is a way to go back, but will she?

Top secret research on the newest Bathyscaphe technology is stolen. Task force headed by Hong Shao Qiu and Ye Han is assigned to solve this case in which the nation's secret and defense is on the line.

In 1920s Shanghai's French Concession, Lin Lan, a young lady who has returned from studying in France, is parachuted into the Central Police Station as a detective. She teams up with Qin Xin, a forensic doctor from a humble background, Dou Ming Cong, a clever and quick-witted police officer, and Zhao Er Bao, a witty and humorous gossip, to form the Fourth Criminal Division team and embark on a journey of investigation.

About the daily life of teenagers in a gymnasium.

~~ Remake of the Norwegian TV series "Shame" (Skam) [2015].

When a sales agent and her husband find that all their dreams may vanish into thin air due to problems at work, they scrimp and strive to make a better living for themselves.

Liu Ai is the best salesperson in the business. Her husband Yang Guang is a designer. The two have a simple dream, to make enough money so that they can have kids and buy a house. Liu Ai is shocked when come year end, her boss reneges on the money that she rightfully earned, so she quits her job in a fit of temper.

Already in a slump over her situation, her husband also encounters problems at work. Reality hits hard, but through the encouragement of friends, she and her husband decide to cast aside the roadblocks in their lives. Riding against the tide, Liu Ai starts a small company in a road to becoming the real queen of sales.

~~ Two versions available: 40 episodes (DVD) || 43 episodes (TV)

With the help of four beautiful teenagers, Lin Bo He, a boxing girl with a dream of music, breaks through many obstacles and successfully leads the band's partners to win a good score in the music competition.

dramas.t: Man Cheng Yun Yu Suo Huai Zhou

dramas.nt: 和暗恋对象先婚后爱了
dramas.syn: Jiang Man Sheng had a crush on Lu Qi Chen for many years when she was a student, but Lu Qi Chen didn't remember her name. When she thought that they would never meet again, her family arranged for them to have a blind date. Jiang Man Sheng decisively agreed to marry Lu Qi Chen, and the two lived in separate rooms. She knew that he only had a sense of responsibility towards her, so she kept her crush deep in her heart.
dramas.t: He An Lian Duì Xiang Xian Hun Hou Ai Le

dramas.syn: Mao Ya Ya is dumped by her long term boyfriend and fiancé. She meets Liu Huo, who saves her from some embarrassing events. He bonds with her over the fact that his ex-girlfriend was also caught cheating on him.

Struggling screenwriter Gu Yi Meng and AI developer Yan Jun Gu are transported into an alternate reality created by an AI scriptwriting program, where they embark on a journey to rewrite destinies and discover redemption.

Ru Zhu, a servant of the Shen family, has always been respectful and well-behaved, while her younger sister Si Yu is naturally uninhibited and reckless. Influenced by Si Yu and unwilling to remain trapped in servitude, Ru Zhu ultimately embarks on a path of killing her master and fleeing. Assuming the identity of a noblewoman, she infiltrates the provincial governor's residence. Meanwhile, her former master, Shen Qing Jue, unexpectedly loses his memory and is reduced to a servant, completely reversing their former positions.

The desire for power grows wildly within Ru Zhu, while her ambition and true nature constantly struggle against each other. Amid difficult circumstances, she maneuvers carefully at every step, breaks free from the constraints of her status, and searches for her own path to survival through the choices brought about by desire.

CEO Liu Qing Ying faces a career crisis and agrees to travel to the ancient kingdom of Xiliang to help its ruler overcome a life-threatening challenge. Unexpectedly, she finds herself entangled in palace intrigue and a harem of would-be suitors, all while uncovering hidden motives and forging unexpected alliances.

Li Xin Yi is a rural college student, independent and smart, but she has been oppressed by her original family since childhood. She has no tuition fees, and is facing the dilemma of being forced to marry, so she decisively escapes. On the way to escape, she accidentally got in the luxury car of Gu Han Song, a billionaire president. Gu Han Song, who never liked any woman to get close to him, fell in love with Li Xin Yi the first time he saw her. So, a "life-saving grace" made the two know each other.

Yi Ran, the heiress of a martial arts school, finds herself mysteriously trapped in a time loop, reliving May 18th over and over again. In her search for a way out, she turns to Cheng Nuo, a digital restorer of ancient artifacts linked to the phenomenon. But when he, too, becomes ensnared in the loop, the two discover that the truth behind their endless day is bound to a fate they share.

(Source  TMDb)

Liu Zi Xin's perfect marriage turned out to be a scam. Her husband not only cheated on her but also had ulterior motives. So, she turns to Zhang Xiu Qi, a private detector, for help to get back at her husband, but Zhou Ping revealed that she had cheated on him with Zhang Xiu Qi a year ago. A car accident caused her to lose part of her memories. But why did Zhang Xiu Qi get close to her hiding his identity? Liu Zi Xin is caught in a heavy fog...

Four years later, Xiao Heng is finally released from prison. He deliberately avoids Xia Shi Sheng, who came to pick him up. But Xia Shi Sheng refuses to run away—she senses that Xiao Heng’s imprisonment must have something to do with her, and she also wants to confirm if he was the one who had been secretly sending her flowers all those years ago. Yet Xiao Heng wants to escape, believing he is no longer worthy of her, while Xia Shi Sheng remains persistent and refuses to give up.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hu Die Yin" (蝴蝶瘾), also known as "Ji Che Wen Hu Die" (机车吻蝴蝶), by Ba La La Chen (巴啦啦晨).

Yu Jiu Qi, an adopted daughter, falls in love with Sun Xi, the son of her family's sworn enemy. Bound by a decades-old blood feud, guilt forces them apart. Three years later, Sun Xi returns, reigniting both their buried love and lingering hatred. Beneath the freezing northeastern winter, they pretend to be strangers while secretly drawn to each other. Can love finally break the cycle of vengeance?

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Dong Feng Chui You Sheng" (冬风吹又生) by Chun Ya (淳牙).

Blogger Shen Man, in her quest to uncover the truth behind her sister's "suicide," becomes embroiled in the bizarre murder case of Ai Xia, the head of obstetrics and gynecology, who has had her uterus removed. She becomes the prime suspect, and police officer Jiang Li helps her clear her name. A postcard that intertwines the two cases forces the two, who initially have opposing views, to join forces. However, a second murder then occurs, escalating the mystery once again...

Modern white-collar worker Lu Yun Luo transmigrates to ancient times into the body of a concubine who's been banished to the cold palace. There she encounters the newly enthroned Emperor Ji Wu Jue. Initially content with a life of leisure, Lu Yun Luo, through a series of coincidences, uses her advanced medical and agricultural knowledge to rise above the royal family and eventually live a happily ever after with the young Emperor.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Zai Leng Gong Mang Zhong Tian" (我在冷宫忙种田) by Hong Fei (红翡).
dramas.t: Farm Busily in the Cold Palace

dramas.syn:
The story takes place in Yi An University, where a group of youths who love music chases after their dreams. 

Lin Mo is the current president of the music club, who through the help of his teacher He Luo Yi and his fellow club members manages to overcome all obstacles to revive the music club at their school.
~~ Advertisement for Marubi Skincare (MARUBI 丸美).

The ancestral grave of the Su has great feng shui; others bow and beg for sons, but they can easily have nine. When they wanted a daughter, Su Ran Ran is born. As the only daughter, she’s treated and treasured like a princess, rendering her a bit mischievous and spoiled. To help protect her from her brothers’ bullying, she’s sent to Zhu Mountain  as a disciple. Alas, she’s all grown up and the family struggles to get her (and her cousin) married. When she learns about a new potential marriage, she tries to run away but is caught off guard after accidentally poisoning a young man in white. Brought home, her potential partner arrives and to the side, he greets her with, “I don’t plan on marrying you, please drop that thought.” Rejected. It’s not like she wants to marry him anyway. She’s always pondering why they want to get her married so soon.

~~ Adapted from the novel “Su Ran Ran Zhui…
dramas.t: Su Ran Ran's Husband Hunting Journey

dramas.nt: 我的吸血鬼男友之极夜物语
dramas.syn:
In a long time after the end of the first season, the vampire family and the hunters have become increasingly fierce. It is reported that the weather-beaten Situ family in the new chapter of “The Polar Night Story” encountered a girl who could end everything. Along with her, there was also a mixed-race man who became a fan. All this seemed to be a game between the hunter and the vampire.

In the new story, love is no longer the only theme. With the debut of new characters, the vampires and hunters' struggles over thousands of years will gradually begin.
dramas.t: My Vampire Boyfriend's Extreme Night Story

dramas.syn: The stunning director Xu Ni, after being cheated on by her scumbag boyfriend, sets out to “revenge date” her ex's cousin to humiliate him. But by accident, she ends up getting the scumbag’s legendary younger uncle, Fu Gui Du, the “aloof Buddha” of the medical world… Xu Ni instantly panics, yet the younger uncle grabs her slender waist tightly: “Where do you think you're running after provoking me?"

Ning Bai Zhu, a modern girl who was killed by her boyfriend and best friend, and Ye Yun Chen, an ancient general who was scrambled by the whole family, were reborn in ancient times at the same time, starting a second journey of life. In order to survive, Ning decided to open a store to make money. Modern business ideas have made her store very popular. Although her thinking different from the ancients, has caused her to make a lot of oolong, business is still blooming.  Everything changes, when Ning and Ye meet by chance and discover how much they have in common.

~~ Adapted from novel  "The Greedy Princess - Please Respect Yourself" by Wen Ren Lin Xian.
Tells the story of a fashion company group facing a crisis. Song Chi takes over and becomes the president and has to resolve the crisis at hand.

After being betrayed and killed in a fire, Princess Sheng Yun Lin is reborn and sets out to reclaim her power. Using her wit and courage, she gathers allies, exposes corruption, and seeks justice for her family, all while navigating a dangerous love with the proud Grand Tutor Xie Fei amid courtly intrigue and political battles.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhang Xiang Yi" (长相忆) by Qing Xi (晴夕).
