Approaching thirty and at the lowest point in her life, the female protagonist writes thirteen farewell letters, expressing the heartfelt thoughts she has kept hidden and sending them to the people around her. The chain reaction triggered by these letters forces her to confront the absurdities of life through dark humor, rethink her life, and once again give it her all.

~~ Adapted from the novel "For Every Solution, a Problem" (Für jede Lösung ein Problem) by Kerstin Gier.
Song Shu Tong just returned home, only to cross paths with her sworn enemy, Mo Han Cheng. Bound by deep-seated hatred, they despise each other openly—yet secretly, they ache for one another.

Jiang Wan Sheng was drugged by her classmate and unexpectedly spent the night with her best friend's uncle. Afterwards, she wanted to keep her distance, but Qin Mo already harbored ill intentions towards her. With Qin Mo by her side, Jiang Wan Sheng was no longer a pitiful little girl to be bullied.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Nan Yi Zhao Jia! Jing Quan San Ye Di Tou You Chong"  (难以招架！京圈三爷低头诱宠) by Mu Mu Cuo (木木错).

Wu Nai Juan, a skilled counselor, quits after betrayal, starts her own clinic. Helping others, she meets lawyer Li Zhi Zhong and doctor Li Jia Liang. Through these relationships, she learns love's true meaning and ends up with Li Zhi Zhong.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Hua Chang Hao Yue Chang Yuan Ren Chang Jiu" (花常好月常圆人长久) by Yi Shu (亦舒).
Spin-off from KO One Series. Airing as a web TV series.

Under the social background of war and chaos, unyielding changes in fate, with the heart to serve the country, actively participate in the revolution. Xue Yun Jin is a trustworthy person who reports grievances directly. When he was a child, his father was ill in bed for many years. After his wealth was gone, the father and son lived on the streets, begging for a living, and tasted the warmth of the world. This kind of drifting life formed Xue Yun Jin's extreme character. 

The rough fate in the early period, and the national justice in the later period, the two-sided life at different stages fully demonstrated the fullness of Xue Yun Jin's character. The simple and kind-hearted Duan Si Qi only wants to live the ordinary life of her husband and son, and Xue Yun Jin, who looks cold and wants to join the army to serve the motherland, the two are childhood sweethearts and love each other,…

On a lively Lawyers' Street in a city in Northeast China, the chivalrous and humorous female lawyer Xiao Long Nv opens a law firm above a public bathhouse. She previously worked at Honghu Law Firm, the most prestigious law firm in the area, but resigned after taking a stand for justice in a case and also fell out with her colleague and childhood friend, lawyer Li Xin.

With different views of the law, the two follow completely different paths. Li Xin rapidly rises through the ranks to become Honghu's youngest senior partner, while Xiao Long Nv loses all her sources of cases and becomes the "laughingstock" of Lawyers' Street. Despite being at a low point in her life, Xiao Long Nv remains resilient and optimistic. Together with administrator Gu Miao Miao, who voluntarily follows her, Dong Bei Hu, whom she befriends after an initial confrontation, and Luo Zhi, who has repeatedly struggled…

Plastic surgeon Mu Yan is all against marriage, to the despair of his family, especially his mother, who hopes to see him settle down soon. On the contrary, Yuan Yin, a hostess for escape games, dreams of getting married. 

To get some peace from his family, he decides to bring Yuan Yin as a fake girlfriend. Yuan Yin not only wins over his whole family but also wins over Mu Yan himself, who finds himself falling for her. He starts to pursue, hoping to make their fake relationship a real one.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Kai Qi" (开启) by Qi Dao Jun (祈祷君).

Wen Ru Yu, a Southern scholar, marries Northern Princess Hai Lan Zhen to strengthen ties between their kingdoms, only to uncover a web of secrets and danger. As their lives intertwine through cycles of fate, the two navigate love, betrayal, and sacrifice in a journey to overcome the forces that threaten to tear them apart.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Kuai Chuan Zhi Nan Zhu Zong Xiang Gan Diao Wo" (快穿之男主总想干掉我) by Yi Jiu De Jiu (一九得九).

Tong Jia Xu was entangled with the gangster Liang Tai Sheng. She asked her fiancé Wei Chuan to marry her early but failed. She was sold at the wedding. Liang Tai Sheng saved her and proposed to her but was rejected. Her mother was seriously ill, Liang Tai Sheng brought money to help her, and Tong Jia Xu married him for a year. After marriage, Liang took care of his mother-in-law and protected Tong Jia Xu. Later, he accidentally learned that it was Liang Tai Sheng who saved Tong Jia Xu that year, and the two finally stayed together.

While expanding her e-commerce business abroad, Chinese entrepreneur Guan Meng Meng is swept into royal intrigue in the Kingdom of Manbo. A contract marriage with the eldest prince, Song Pai, turns into a powerful partnership, as she helps him fight for the throne and he backs her mission to bring digital change to his country.

~~ Co-production with Thailand.

Song Shuang Xu, the adopted daughter of the Shen family, was involved in a rumor vortex with her adopted brother Shen Yu for no reason. She had no choice but to leave her hometown and travel across the ocean to start an exiled life in a foreign country for five years. This year, she returned to Yancheng and met He Ting Zhou, the cold and venomous president of Yundun Group, in order to promote the drone project. He Ting Zhou's words were sharp on the surface, but he was actually gentle in his heart. He had secretly fallen in love with Song Shuang Xu many years ago. Since then, the two have been involved in their career cooperation and family relations, and they have gradually approached each other from the initial tit-for-tat, and the red line of fate has quietly entangled.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Guo Fen Ye" (过分野) by Niao Song Mi (鸟松米).

The drama is shot from the perspective of women and tells a story about finding light in the darkness and embracing hope in motherhood.

Lin Xu Zhi is a woman who doesn’t have a past. She was adopted and is still scarred from being abandoned by her birth mother. She’s an elementary school teacher that realizes one of her female students is receiving abuse from her mother. Her maternal instincts kick in, and she impulsively decides to bring the girl into her own care. In caring for the young girl named Xiao Ou, two broken souls find solace in each other.

The five girls' days with each other continued, and more difficulties came one after another, but fortunately, they knew each other well enough, and their feelings became increasingly deep, and they could support each other through these difficulties. While Ye Zhen Zhen was infatuated with scientific research, she was also frequently affected by Dai Wei's family. How to live a simple life had become a problem, but fortunately, her firm position was clear enough, and her family cared for her very much; she solved these difficulties. Fang Zhi Heng accidentally had a sister, which made her change a lot, and she gradually returned to the right track in life. 

Zhu Zhe accumulated through years of struggle, completely relying on her own in Shanghai, and finally broke through the bottleneck of the cause. After a detour, He Min Hong left the 22nd floor and finally came back. She began to learn…

The first impression he had of her was nothing more than a lifeless doll - until she calmly helped him to throw a corpse downstairs. That crack in her porcelain facade hooked him, and the deeper he looked, the more her madness bled through the silken mask. She sought only to borrow his power, to grind her vicious family into dust. She thought it was nothing but a sordid bargain off desire, yet he was willing to be her blade and her armor - so long as she could live fiercely as she longed to.

Wang Guo Guo is a novelist whose motto in life is not to yearn for love, that is until she meets the leading man of her dreams. Yi Feng, the lead singer of a band, will be staying at her place. Luckily, her younger brother also has her back as she tries to win Yi Feng's heart.
dramas.t: My World Is All about You

dramas.nt: 我被困在同一天十万年
dramas.syn:
Lin Yue has been trapped in a time loop, reliving the same day over and over for the past one hundred thousand years. After unintentionally saving the young saintess of the Wangxian Sect he breaks free from the cycle. From then on, Lin Yue, empowered by the wisdom and experience he has gathered, embarks on an adventure across the Hongmeng Continent. At the same time, a foe he never managed to defeat during those many years, awakens in the shadows of this world.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Bei Kun Zai Tong Yi Tian Shi Wan Nian" (我被困在同一天十万年) by Huang Tian Zai Shang (凰天在上).

Su Man, a betrayed housewife, uncovers her husband Deng Wen Liang’s affair and embarks on a mission to expose the mistress. However, her husband and piano teacher Ye Xing fabricate evidence to cast her out. Determined to reclaim custody of her daughter, Su Man allies with the mistress against her ex-husband. Amid revenge and rebuilding her life, Ye Xing reappears, seeking redemption and sparking a potential romance. But a deeper conspiracy unravels: Ye Xing and the mistress were plotting to seize her husband’s fortune. Caught in a web of betrayal, Su Man must navigate revenge, survival, and an uncertain future.

Ji Shu Yu drove out to relax after discovering Pei Jing Zhi had cheated, but her car broke down on a mountain road. There, she met Qiao Ye, a struggling college student working a part-time job repairing cars. A chance intersection of fate turned this destitute young man into a "goldfinch" in her home. Yet, Qiao Ye turned out to be the Crown Prince of the Beijing circle who had been missing for years! The dramatic change in his identity suddenly unbalanced this "sister-brother" romance, leaving it precarious. In order to regain the right to control his own destiny, Qiao Ye chose to temporarily leave, unaware that Ji Shu Yu was already pregnant.

In the glittering Tang-era capital of Chang’an, civilian sleuth Shentu Bai Qi teams up with Dali Court official Yao Yuan to unravel a series of strange crimes. As they peel back superstition and corruption, they chase the truth and justice hidden beneath the city’s splendor.
dramas.t: Mysterious and Absurd Cases of the Tang Dynasty

dramas.syn: Story of Xin Huan who was accidentally dragged into the world of comics by the system. With the cannon fodder script in hand, she can return to reality only after completing the tasks.

The story revolves around two brothers, Shen Lin and Shen Fang, and their different political stances and beliefs. They originally belonged to different revolutionary camps, but in the end, they fought together because of their common belief and joined the revolutionary wave. 

After the victory of the Anti-Japanese War in 1945, Shen Fang of the Intelligence Dept. of Kuomintang Military Command HQ returned to the organization. After connecting with Mr. Ren, he began to picket out the traitors of his party, obtained the "Ganoderma Lucidum Plan", and destroyed the premeditated operation of "Jinling Society". 

The long-term dormant life was always in darkness. Even with the help and care from the organization, Shen Fang still felt physically and mentally exhausted, and the shrapnel left in his brain kept tormenting him and threatening his every action at any time. However, the…

Story of a family of five who realize the real meaning of family after going through a series of arguments. 
Father Zheng suddenly collapse and then woke up from a coma. He reflected on himself and set about unknotting past grievances, helping his four children: a busy surgeon, a housekeeping manager, an auto repair shop owner and a pampered youngest daughter, find themselves, understand and embrace life.

Qin Zhen, a modern financial female executive dreamed of returning to the Great Wei State and became the wife of the first bodyguard agency that was about to go bankrupt. Together, Fight with playboy husband and used modern management...

Campus beauty Li Xing, in order to raise money for her grandmother’s medical treatment, works as a “custom girlfriend.” When she is harassed by a wealthy heir, she is rescued by Lou Chong. Under the alias “Hunter”, Lou Chong places an order to approach her in disguise, even threatening her with her grandmother’s medical expenses to make her comply, claiming he would make her fall in love with him.

During their time together, Li Xing gradually falls for him, only to later discover that Lou Chong was treating her well out of guilt—her father once sacrificed his life to save Lou’s father. Heartbroken, she breaks up with him and goes abroad.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bo Li Yan" (玻璃焰), also known as "Si Wen" (私吻), by Mei Lu Bi Bi (美绿哔哔).

This story follows Qi Wu, a relentless narcotics officer from the Jincheng Anti-Drug Unit, as he tirelessly investigates drug traffickers. His fate becomes intertwined with Feng He, a skilled worker who, on his wedding night, is accused of "killing his wife" and later, after being released from prison, searches for his wife. Together, they join forces to dismantle a drug trafficking organization and apprehend the drug lord.

In the eyes of outsiders, Su Yu Ning almost has a perfect life: a thriving career, a gentle husband and a well-behaved daughter. Unexpectedly, this wonderful life fell apart overnight. First her husband cheated, and then her daughter was injured and unconscious.  Soon, Su Yu Ning discovers, that's she's was already part of and in the midst of a calculated conspiracy. And what was entrenched, in the center of the conspiracy was the person she never expected. In order to protect her daughter, Su Yu Ning had to stand up and declare war on "her".

Su Jin Li, a headstrong princess, is transported into a game world where danger, betrayal, and hidden rules govern her fate. As assassins close in and the system itself turns unstable, she joins forces with Yun Lang to uncover the truth behind the game and find a way back to reality.

Ruan Jia Xi was betrayed by her boyfriend Jiang Hao and her sister Zhao Yan. She slipped and rolled down the stairs. Before she became unconscious, she learned that there was something strange about her mother's death. Ruan Jia Xi, who woke up in the hospital, pretended to have amnesia and didn't trust others. While secretly investigating the truth of her mother's death, she plots revenge to get back everything that belonged to her. In the process, Ruan Jia Xi and Jiang Rui Chen, head of the Jiang Group, became acquainted with mutual love and trust, and joined hands to become a pair of enviable soul mates.

After being betrayed and stripped of her power, Meng Li awakens from a century-long slumber and disguises herself to get close to the reincarnated prince Shen Que. By entering his dreams to recover her sealed spiritual root, she sets out on a dangerous path of revenge that blurs the line between hatred and fate.

Fallen from grace after taking a case she shouldn’t have, lawyer Zhai Shuang Bai was backed into a corner when her family paid the price, leaving her parents deceased and her sister, the sole survivor of arson, in a coma. Now in debt to Nie Zhi Yi, who paid for her sister’s medical fees, she’s hired to become his third brother Nie Yul Sung’s secretary and ruin his chance of becoming the heir in this sibling rivalry. 

One million dollars for every mission. 

As the lies keep piling, friends who look like foes, and foes who turn into friends, each mission becomes increasingly difficult as the passion between them ignites amidst family drama, morality, and ethics. 

Someone in the Nie family is the arsonist, and she is determined to find out who it really is.

In the past, the Empress Dowager, in her quest for power, schemed to change Feng Yi's gender, forcing Feng Yi to live a life disguised as a man. Upon reaching adulthood, unwilling to remain a puppet emperor, Feng Yi began to cultivate her own strength. However, her attempts to curry favor with the Prime Minister ended in the Prime Minister's sudden death at a brothel. When she tried to win over the Grand Tutor Sima Qi, he repeatedly attempted to kill her. This is the bitter and tragic life of a woman ruling as the emperor, where a single misstep could cost her life.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bi Xia, Bu Ke Yi" (陛下，不可以) by Wei An Wan Qing (维安晚晴).

The crown prince of the Dali Kingdom, Duan Zhi Xing, escapes from an arranged royal marriage and befriends Hong Qi, a disciple of the Beggars' Sect. Due to a mix-up, a woman named Yi Huo mistakes Hong Qi for her betrothed, turning a misunderstanding into a fateful connection. By a twist of fate, Hong Qi masters powerful martial arts and rises to become the leader of the Beggars' Sect, but an old grudge from their fathers' generation sparks a rift between Hong Qi and Duan Zhi Xing...
dramas.t: Duel on Mount Hua: Southern Emperor and Northern Beggar

dramas.syn:
The story of a young woman who returns to her childhood home in a village, after leaving for the big city. It documents how she prepares all three meals by herself.

~~ Adapted from the manga series “Little Forest” (リトル・フォレスト) by Igarashi Daisuke (五十嵐大介).

During the Ming dynasty, a murder in the capital unravels a shocking conspiracy. A story about Liu Shan Men (Department Six) - its leader Shen Li Xing solving cases, seeking revenge and crushing rebellious forces.

In a quiet coastal town, a missing bag of drugs ignites a chain of chaos, pulling together a detective, a desperate father, an ambitious young woman, and two siblings caught in addiction. As their lives collide, a risky rescue mission begins—one that no one will walk away from unchanged.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Lao Nan Hai" (老男孩) by Lei Mi (雷米).

Song Yun Hui has been promoted as the youngest deputy leader in Donghai Chemical. He brings his family to live with him in Donghai, but his wife Cheng Kai Yan’s laziness and distrust take a toll on their marriage, which eventually ends in divorce. With his innate business capabilities, Song Yun Hui continues to take up leadership roles, thus bringing his team success as they complete project after project. Sadly, Song Yun Hui's climb on the corporate ladder instils envy in those around him.

Xiao Lei's family business keeps growing with the times, yet a small blunder in the safety procedures causes a massive explosion in their copper factory. Lei Dong Bao is charged with bribery and sentenced to jail. After being released, he started his own business as an electrical distributor. Wei Chun Hong, on the other hand, is always by his side, supporting and encouraging him.

Arriving in…

There is a hidden crisis in little Gaoya County. Who was responsible for the massacre of the Yang family in the past? Is it true or false? Let's see how Liu Beibei, a handsome bandit, disguises himself as a newly appointed judge to fight bullies, resolves crises and upholds justice; How can a young lady find the right fiancé?

After losing her closest family, Jiang Tong makes a powerful comeback, determined to expose hidden crimes and take down the mastermind. Along the way, she becomes entangled in a passionate struggle with her former love, Gao Xiu Yu, while her return brings about new fates for those from her past.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Shi Gu Wei Qing" (蚀骨危情) by Qi Lao You (淇老游).

What if earth devolved into an apocalyptic hellhole? What if you found out you not only have to survive just one apocalyptic event but have to struggle through multiple worlds with different end-world scenarios? And you get to meet more superpowered crazies than you can imagine!

Presenting the worst nightmare that your weird doomsday prepper neighbour with a bunker full of canned beans could have, Doomsday Wonderland is a novel filled with subverted tropes, non-OP characters and a female friendly label which offends all politically correct fanatics.

As ‘lucky’ humans evolved to posthumans with the ability to adapt to the New World or mutate into disgusting duoluozhongs to survive, follow Lin San Jiu as she struggles through multiple challenges to just live one more day… and make sense of this New World that will no longer be the same. 

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Doomsday…

During the Tang Dynasty, Crown Prince Li Xing He went out of the palace in disguise, and met the coroner, Zhang Xiao Meng, and the official of Court of Judicial Review, Chu Qi. After the three of them have solved the mysterious Gu Case, they encountered the Red-Clothes Murder Case. In the midst of that, they even encountered Fox Spirit Locked Room Murder Case. How are they going to solve all the Mysterious Tales in Chang'an?

Gao Xin Yue has written a screenplay that was altered by her colleague, Shu Miao, without her permission. Shu Miao then submitted the altered screenplay to their company headquarters. A furious Gao Xin Yue wanted to withdraw the submission but accidentally travels into the world of the screenplay. She is now the concubine of the third prince Ling Hong. 

Due to the script change, Gao Xin Yue experiences countless obstacles after marrying into the palace as various characters plot and scheme for her downfall. What's worse is that Shu Miao has also time traveled along with her and is manipulating events from behind the scenes. Nonetheless, Gao Xin Yue manages to rise up the ranks from concubine to Ling Hong's consort. Thinking that everything would be back to normal once the story reaches its happy conclusion, Gao Xin Yue soon realized that things are not as simple as it seems...

This is about how three best friends set off to find a bread tree that belongs to them. The 'bread' could be a physical substance, vanity, or could be nonexistent. The three met each other at 13 years of age, and their friendship started with a game of volleyball.

Together, they encounter the happiness of growing up, the confusion of first love, love and hate, sorrow and pain. The best and worst thing women have done is fall in love with men. Zhu Di Zhi said if she died, her elegy would be about a girl always meeting and loving bad guys. Shen Guang Hui said marrying off to Tuen Mun is not reputable enough - you at least have to marry someone living in Happy Valley. Cheng Yun said someone who makes the other person sad is the stronger of the two. 

Some people say that a woman's biggest happiness is being a silk rose and finding a tree that can support it forever. Others say a woman's…
It revolves around the relationship between a newbie and her highly temperamental boss that is a source of many misunderstandings and an eventual romance.

The story is set in Republican Shanghai. Four young people with completely different experiences in life come together to break into the underground world of “Qianmen Jianghu” and solve mysterious cases. Su Zi Quan is quick-witted and calls himself the “number one master sleuth on earth”. Despite his excellent memory, he can’t recall his early childhood. His biggest weakness, however, is that he’s allergic to women. Whenever he comes into physical contact with a woman, he has to sneeze. Tang Dai Yun is a pure and kind-hearted, but also willful rich young lady. While looking for her lost older brother, she meets Zi Quan. Joining these two is the cold butler of the Tang household Chen Yi Ming who has great fighting skills and is only gentle to Dai Yun, and Zi Quan’s childhood friend Lu Zi Xiao, the only woman he’s not allergic to.

On the eve of college graduation, Ye Fan finally plucked up the courage to confess to Tao Tao, whom he had been secretly in love with for many years. However, Tao Tao died in an car accident, and the two were separated from each other. While packing up Tao Tao's belongings, Ye Fan accidentally obtained her old mobile phone and gained the ability to connect to the past. In order to save Tao Tao, Ye Fan decided to launch a time and space rescue.

Among a batch of cultural relics, there is a diary in urgent need of restoration. The sincere and kind young restorer Liu Yuan takes over the task, and her partner is Wang Ze, a suave restoration expert who has returned from studying abroad. 

The two people with different positions inevitably had some "friendly" exchanges at work, but as the restoration work progressed, the two also uncovered a dusty past: in the 1930s and 1940s, the female agent Zhao Deng Man was ordered to sneak into a hotel and perform a mission with a man code-named "Fox". 

A sudden accident trapped everyone in the hotel for investigation. Many forces were involved. It was full of mystery about who was the enemy and who was the friend... What other secrets are waiting to be revealed?

Story of an avid gamer Ji Xiao Fei, who managed to enter her favorite gaming company and got a job as a programming cheerleader. Despite being tricked by her male colleagues, Ji Xiao Fei remains cheerful and optimistic, and finally wins over them.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Don't Underestimate the Otome's soul" (不要小瞧乙女之魂啊) by Lao Chan Mao (老馋猫).

Jiang Shi Qian, who used to be a victim of violence and bullying, comes back after a beautiful transformation with a meticulous plan of revenge against her abusers.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhang Xin You Ni Duo Huan Xi" (掌心有你多欢喜) by Shang Ju Jun (山谷君).

Xuan Yi broke with her boyfriend at the scene of Da Lang's affair. After falling out of love, she accidentally became the assistant of the popular male idol Long Yi. She helped Long Yi embark on the road of transforming into a powerful actor and stayed with him every step of the way, overcoming various difficulties and gaining a true love.

Five years ago, Mai Mang was attacked. At the critical moment, Wan Qing appeared and saved him, but this also caused her arm to be injured, leaving her with a lifelong injury. Five years later, the two met again by chance. During the quarrel, Wan Qing accidentally injured her arm, which made Mai Mang doubt whether she was the lifesaver. He ordered people to investigate her information. The two unfolded a series of funny and sweet stories during the struggle, and finally, they were able to recognize each other.
dramas.t: Wan Zhang Guang Mang Nuan Si Liang

dramas.syn:
Lying in bed reading a comic book on her phone, Meng Qi is agitated about the novel’s main lead whom she thinks is a real scumbag. Still ranting on about him, she falls asleep. When she wakes up, she finds that she has somehow entered the comic book and is now in the body of female lead. She quickly encounters the main lead, Qin Yue Wen (the owner of Black Wind Fortress), whom she knows approaches her because of an alleged treasure map on her body.

Yue Wen soon manages to insert himself in Meng Qi's life and in order to avoid his scheme - and make good use of him in the process - Meng Qi decides to make him help her run her restaurant. Running the restaurant is seriously challenged when a rival restaurant starts to compete with them and try to ruin their business. In dealing with their challenges they occasionally get the help of a local police officer Xiao Sa who works for the county…
dramas.t: The Villain Loves Me Too Much

dramas.syn: Liu Fan, a playboy and the heir of the Tengyue Group, is secretly arranged by his family to be exiled to the remote Jiong Island. There, he coincidentally meets Chen Jiaqi, a descendant of the island’s indigenous people. Through a series of funny and challenging events, the two go from disliking each other to working together to protect the island’s marine ecosystem. Along the way, they uncover a decade-long mystery that had been buried in the past.
dramas.t: I Wait for the Sea Breeze to Hug You

dramas.syn: Detective Captain Gu Zhen leads his team in investigating a series of crimes, solving complex cases with his sharp instincts and intelligence. Meanwhile, he discovers that he has become the target of revenge orchestrated by the family of a past victim. To protect the people and his loved ones, Gu Zhen confronts a vengeful adversary who has embraced darkness. In the end, justice prevails, and the criminals receive the punishment they deserve.

On her wedding night, Gu Chao Chao is betrayed by her husband and best friend and left for dead. Five years later, she returns as Ji Yun Chao, plotting a calculated revenge to expose their deceit and take back control of her destiny.

After a difficult childbirth, Jiang Rong falls into a coma and wakes up to find herself transformed into an empress dowager with a newborn son but no memory of the father. To survive the taboo of a widow giving birth, she must navigate her relationships with three suspected fathers, uncovering secrets, romance, and unexpected humor.
dramas.t: The Empress Dowager on a Second Spring

dramas.syn: The story of a girl who struggles alone in the big city and transforms her growing experience from a poor and naive girl to a mega influencer with tens of millions of fans.

Zheng Ling Xi had a one-night stand with Zhuang Jing Chen in order to borrow sperm to have a child. She thought they would never see each other again. But she didn't expect Zhuang Jing Chen to become her immediate boss. By chance, Zhuang Jing Chen discovered that Zheng Ling Xi was pregnant. They contracted to get married with the idea of ​​using each other, but they fell in love with each other day after day.
dramas.t: Sheng Xia Ai Qing Gu Shi

dramas.syn:
Five years ago on a full moon night, Shen Si Wei got drunk and went into the wrong room. She had spent the night with the werewolf leader Pei Xing Ye and got pregnant. Since her grandmother passed away, she had no family anymore, so she gave birth to her son Xiao Xi.

When Xiao Xi was four years old, he began to show symptoms of a werewolf cub. His aunt regarded him as a monster and sold him to a laboratory for research. Luckily, Pei Xing Ye arrived in time and saved the mother and son. Then the family of three began to live together.

Lu Shi Man traveled through the book and became a female villain with three vicious brothers. On the first day of traveling through the book, she vomited on the male protagonist Fu Bo Wang's hand, washed his hands with boiling water, and kowtowed to Ji Lin Shen in the elevator and successfully slept with him. They met again at the birthday party, and at this time, Ji Lin Shen turned into a villain boss that everyone feared.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chuan Shu Fan Pai Bian Tuan Chong, Yin Zhi Da Lao Qing Dian Chong" (穿书反派变团宠，阴鸷大佬轻点宠), also known as "Man Man Guai! Ce Er, Yin Shi Ji Shao Chan Shang Lai Le" (曼曼乖！侧耳，阴湿季少缠上来了), by Li Wu (黎巫).

Chen Shan, a renowned female lawyer, has reached the apex of her career at the age of 40. Because of work, she has no time to care for her husband's and daughter’s needs. Her husband, Sun Lei, has put aside his career goals to accommodate the family. Although this arrangement has been working well for the past few years, it gradually loses balance and becomes a burden. At this time, investment elite Lin Qing Kun appears and Chen Shan has to beat her competitors to get his deal. Facing the pressure of managing her marriage and career, Chen Shan tries hard to balance the two but failed to do so. Sun Lei and Chen Shan goes through multiple challenges, and seem to have found a better partner than each other for themselves. However, with each stumbling step, they finally realize that with their own imperfections, they are each other's perfect partner.

"The Future Handbook" is a collection of multi-universe sci-fi films directed by young Chinese directors. The collection combines many of B-station users' favourite actors to perform six single stories in six sci-fi styles with six kinds of emotional resonance.

After the disappearance of the secret treasure of the martial arts god Qian Su, the Great Zhou Dynasty fell into chaos. Jiang Yan returned to the court to track down the secret of immortality. At the martial arts conference, he wanted to take revenge on the leader of the Qingyang Sect, Shen Gu Zhi. In the process, he and Su Zi Yuan experienced many twists and turns. After returning, various forces were plotting to usurp the throne. Jiang Yan and Su Zi Yuan worked hard to turn the tide.

Twenty years ago, Shen Ji Bai, the true young master of the Mu family, was forced into exile, living a life of poverty and danger. At the same time, Mu Zhi Yu becomes his substitute and new heiress. Their fates intertwine again when  Mu Zhi Yu returns to the country as a top auctioneer, determined to reclaim the auction house from her stepmother, Xu Ming Zhu. But at the same time, the stepmother uses Shen Ji Bai to get close to Mu Zhi Yu and gain her own profit. Soon, both of them became entangled in a vortex of power struggles, ultimately joining forces for revenge.

As the world teeters on the brink of collapse following the arrival of an alien civilization, a group of passionate high school students mount a desperate resistance to save humanity's last hope.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Huo Xing Gu Er" (火星孤儿) by Liu Yang (刘洋).

The two friends, Zhang Ruo Chen and Cheng Zhe Hai, have a common dream: They want to become part of the national swimming team. In the national swimming championship, they end up competing against each other. During the 200 Freestyle, however, Zhe Hai suddenly falls back and thus has no chance of standing on the awards platform anymore. 

Moreover, he disappears without any word after the match. Ruo Chen is angry because he believes that Zhe Hai let him win on purpose. Two years later, the two former friends unexpectedly meet again at the same sports school, but Ruo Chen is very cold, while Zhe Hai seems to have lost any interest in swimming.

Ming Liang, a young man chasing his artistic dreams in the big city, returns to his hometown at the foot of the Tianshan Mountains to care for his ailing adoptive mother, Ai Yi Sha. To revive Ai Yi Sha’s restaurant “Red Pomegranate”, Ming Liang accepts the challenge of Michelin chef An Dong. While growing rapidly, he also brings the poorly managed restaurant back to life.

At the same time, influenced by the brave dream-chasing stories of those around him, including technician Li Guang Tian and social worker Wu La Si, Ming Liang clarifies his life direction—to promote Xinjiang’s culinary culture. Ming Liang meets Gu Li Na Er, the independent and spirited leader of an animal protection organization, and develops feelings for her. However, Gu Li Na Er, focused entirely on her career, has no intention of dating. Ming Liang, with his unique life wisdom and attitude, opens Gulinaer’s heart.

Lin Chao Yue once an ancient top scholar, he wakes up one day in the body of a struggling modern-day university student — also named Lin Chao Yue — who wasn’t exactly known for academic excellence. To protect his identity, he must play along, survive lectures, and adapt to dorm life. The twist? He gets assigned a roommate who couldn’t be more different from him.

Zhang Chen a “perfect student” type who once had everything going for him — popularity, talent, and a bright academic future. But after losing someone important, he stepped away from high-pressure expectations and now prefers to stay distant from everyone. His peaceful, low-key life flips upside-down when this strange, unpredictable time-traveller moves into his dorm

dramas.nt: 早逝白月光穿十一年后，成全家福星
dramas.syn:
Lin Mo opened her eyes to find herself transported to the eleventh year after her death. On her deathbed, she learned that this world was a novel, and her three younger brothers were all villains in the original novel's counterpart, each meeting a tragic end. Unable to accept that her adorable brothers had become part of the protagonists' play, Lin Mo decisively acted to sever the evil connection, unaware that her former nemesis was now gazing at her with fascination the moment he saw her again.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Si Hou De Di Shi Yi Nian" (我死后的第十一年), also known as "Zao Si Bai Yue Guang Chuan Shi Yi Nian Hou! Jing Quan Da Luan" (早死白月光穿十一年后！京圈大乱), by Pi Ka Hei (皮卡黑).

Jiang Miao Miao, who hopes to find love, and Gu Zuo Wei, who wants nothing to do with romance, are paired in a popular relationship class where completing romantic assignments is required to pass, forcing them to navigate clashes and unexpected feelings along the way.

At sixteen, Shen Zhu Ying falls in love at first sight with Fu Si Zhuo, the boy in a white shirt. For the next eight years, her feelings remain hidden in moments of missed chances. A blind date finally brings them together, and at twenty-six, they marry in a flash. But it isn’t until the spring of their eleventh year that Fu Si Zhuo discovers a love letter—written five years too late.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "An Lian Ta De Di Shi Yi Nian Chun" (暗恋他的第十一年春) by Bie Jiao Wo Mei Li (别叫我美丽).
dramas.t: Wo Ben Wei Mo Fan Chen

dramas.syn: In Haidong Province, prosecutors uncover a false accusation against Zhang Wen Qing while reviewing the “Wan Group Gang Case,” exposing deep corruption among judicial officials. Teaming up with law enforcement and courts, they use whistleblower leads to investigate the “213 Shooting Case.” They work to dismantle the powerful Tianlong crime syndicate and bring corrupt officials to justice.

Everyone knows that Zhang He Nian is brilliant and unattainable. Only Qin Tang knows how crazy he is under his serious appearance. She wanted to bury this wrong secret love, after all, he was her nominal uncle. But she didn't expect that he would trap her by his side in the name of care, and surrounded her with his passionate love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Cang Yu Zhou Ye" (藏于昼夜) by Lan Diao (蓝掉).

Guan Xin has been with Li Yi An for 7 years after becoming deaf because of a car accident. But now, she has finally regained her hearing. Since Guan Xin suspects that Li Yi An is cheating on her, she hasn’t told him yet. One day he informs her that he has something important to do and asks her to go home by herself. When she follows him, she sees him hugging his White Moonlight, Bai Xin Yue, a dancer, who has just returned to the country.

Fortunately, she meets Wen Zhi Yu, her attending doctor, who is also the heir to a very big business Group, and she gets a ride home. He speaks to her about smiling and looking forward. Finally, she decides to leave the man who is obviously still entangled with his White Moonlight (an object of affection who exists as flawless only in memory).

Set in a reimagined martial arts world, this tale follows the legacy of the Five Greats — legendary figures whose untold pasts shaped the martial world. As hidden stories emerge and new rivalries ignite, a fresh generation of heroes rises to carry forward the spirit of chivalry, honor, and adventure.
dramas.t: Duel on Mount Hua: The Five

dramas.syn: An Xiao Tong has a special ability called the "Horus Eye"; she can see people's souls. She helps detective Jiang Yi Ming solve cases. As they solve crimes, they uncover a sinister conspiracy together.

The drama is based on the story of Uncle Cao Guo, the last immortal teacher of the Eight Immortals. He has gone through several generations of reincarnation, overcome numerous difficulties and obstacles, and finally completed the growth and transformation from human to god. It tells the story of the Eight Immortals punishing evil and promoting goodness and helping the world.

Three years ago, the famous Fourth Young Master Jiang, Jiang Cheng Lin, and Fourth Young Miss Fu, Fu Ruan, had a business marriage in Haicheng. Unexpectedly, they divorced due to numerous misunderstandings. The two angry people started a story of pretending to be "cuckolding" with each other.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ri Ye Wang Xiang" (日夜妄想) by Yu Bu Yu (鱼不语).
Respect the law and love the Yangtze River. This time, we tell the world the Chinese story of judicial protection of ecological environment.
~~ Advertisement for the luxury fashion house, LOEWE.

Due to her striking resemblance to her stepsister, Mu Zi Xue is forced to consummate the marriage in her sister’s place with the powerful warlord. But little do they know, the seemingly innocent heroine is actually a cunning mastermind. Beneath her gentle exterior lies a black lotus with a secret mission—avenging her mother. Determined to rise from a mere "bed substitute" to the true wife of the warlord, she vows to win his love and take everything from her stepmother and stepsister.

In Luoyang, a string of murders targeting young women throws the city into turmoil. Dali Temple official Hu Zheng Yi is tasked with uncovering the truth, while young martial artist Li Jian Xing, seeking to solve his family’s massacre, approaches Hu Zheng Yi with hidden motives. Together, they unravel chilling mysteries, transforming from wary strangers to loyal allies in a high-stakes quest for justice.

Bai Shao, Bai Ji, and Bai Su, daughters of a Chinese medicine practitioner named Bai Shou Cheng, are all troubled with relationship problems. Bai Shao and Bai Su don't want to carry on their father's occupation, so they decide to wait until their father remarries, goes to America to start his new life, and then they'll work on their lives. Bai Shao started a fake relationship with Lu Liu An, who is younger than her. Bai Ji's husband is having an affair and decides to divorce her. Bai Su somehow falls in love with a much older man whose profession is also related to the medical field. Within each relationship, there are new problems arising. Seeing his daughters trapped in troubled situations, Bai Shou Cheng decides to stay and delays his trip to America in order to help his daughters achieve happiness.

Through handling a dead body case, Gao Feng, a policeman from a family of police, discovers the case related to his grandfather and father many years ago. During the investigation, he encountered many obstacles and tried to find the truth behind the case.

A story about risk management follows a team of investigators who work together to eliminate fraud.

Xia Dong, who works as an investigator for a global company that specializes in risk management, has always considered professional ethics to be his life's mission. In order to complete a job that was assigned to him and to uncover the truth behind an incident that got him framed while studying abroad, Xia Dong transfers from the US headquarters to the Shanghai branch. In his new office, he encounters Jian Yan, his junior at school who now works as an investigator.

In the following days and nights, Xia Dong's righteousness and kindness shine through and easily help in resolving the misunderstandings from the past. Soon after, Xia Dong and Jian Yan are conducting a background check on a company and find themselves facing repeated threats on their life after they helped Lin Jun Wen, an…

Qin Xin was the only daughter of the Qin family, but as soon as her grandfather passed away, her father brought back a sister. Her sister targeted her everywhere, and her father was very partial to her, even abandoning her like garbage in the cemetery on rainy days. When Qin Xin thought she was going to be homeless, she met a gloomy president.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ling Zheng Hou, Pian Zhi Da Shu Mei Tian Wen Wo 99 Ci" (领证后, 偏执大叔每天吻我99次) by Tian Mao Er A (甜猫儿吖).
dramas.t: Ni Shi Wo Sheng Ming Zhong De Guang

dramas.nt: 好麻烦，每天都要谈恋爱
dramas.syn: Xu Ming Xin who appears sweet on the outside but is a bad girl on the inside, was forced to participate in a love variety show by her friends. She also had to play the part of a sweet girl. Unexpectedly, her ex-boyfriend, who was a scoundrel in college, is also on the show. Originally, Xu Ming Xin wanted to avoid him until her very last breath, but this cohabitation kept the two of them in constant intimate contact...

What's the best form of revenge when your adopted sister almost kills your mom and steals your fiancé... Well, marrying her single father-in-law and becoming her sister and ex-boyfriend's mother, of course.

And that's exactly what Nan Di does, but things get a little complicated when the attractive older man she manipulates into marrying her turns out to be the loving and protective soulmate she never knew she wanted.

As a child, Zhong Mu Yao witnessed her mother's murder at the hands of the Fang siblings. Imprisoned and tortured, she was forced to disguise herself as a mute and marry Fang Zhuo Yang, where she became entangled in a complex relationship with Fang Zhuo Yang's son, Fang Shao Cheng. From exploiting each other to a life-or-death bond, the two gradually uncovered Fang Zhuo Yang's crimes and reclaimed the Xue family fortune. Amidst forbidden entanglements and bloody intrigue, they worked together to rip apart lies.

Xu Ru Lin, a calm and rational prosecutor, reunited with his former apprentice, Luo Xun, during a court trial. Luo Xun, who was already a lawyer, was in a tit-for-tat confrontation with her master, and they became a pair of rivals who knew each other as well as the enemy. Luo Xun left the procuratorate three years ago due to an old case. She returned again with a clear goal: defeat Xu Ru Lin. However, Xu Ru Lin accepted the move calmly, although the two had many disagreements. 

With the reunion and intelligent rivalry, Luo Xun gradually realized Xu Ru Lin's good intentions, their sharp edges softened, and the misunderstanding gradually melted away. Xu Ru Lin saw Luo Xun's growth and was warmed by it. The two healed and changed each other. Within their positions, they both upheld justice righteously.

Three families with different backgrounds face challenges as they send their children to study abroad. Huang Cheng Dong must accompany his son Huang Xiao Dong to the US after his wife’s visa is rejected. There, he meets Lin Sa, a former executive who sacrifices her career to marry into a rich family and help her stepdaughter, Wu Dan Dan, study abroad. After a series of mishaps, Huang Cheng Dong discovers that Liu Ruo Yu, his son’s guardian, is facing troubles of her own, forcing him to find a way to stay in the US. Through laughter and tears, the families navigate trials that test their relationships.
dramas.t: Over the Sea I Come to You

dramas.syn:
Yang Guang, a modest interior decorator, joins a larger firm after family troubles strain his small business. There, he clashes with Chen Xi, a talented designer from a very different background. Despite a rocky start, the two discover a strong professional chemistry while collaborating on a major project.

Through challenges in the competitive design world, they hold onto their values and grow determined to build the "ideal home" for clients. As their partnership deepens, they not only find career success but also come to understand the true meaning of home, and fall in love along the way.

Song Shuang Xu was fostered in the Shen family. She was young and ignorant, and mistook her dependence on Shen Yu for love. The Shen family forcibly sent her abroad for the sake of reputation. Five years later, Song Shuang Xu chose to return to China because her best friend was seriously ill, and put aside her feelings for Shen Yu. After returning, she met He Ting Zhou because of work, and the two went in both directions.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Guo Fen Ye" (过分野) by Niao Song Mi (鸟松米).

Meng Jiu Yi disguised herself as a club waitress to secretly film Tan Yu Chen for money. After being exposed and escaping, she fell into his trap again. Jiu Yi is the unloved illegitimate daughter of the Meng family, while Yu Chen is the unruly heir of a wealthy family. Though they appear to have no connection in public, a secret entanglement quietly begins between them.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jiao Yi You Xi, Ta Xian Chen Lun" (交易游戏，他先沉沦) by Yi Ke Zi Jiang (一颗仔姜).
dramas.t: Jiao Yi You Xi Li Ta Xian Chen Lun

dramas.syn: Chu Yue Li somehow ends up in her own novel with a magic paintbrush that allows her to rewrite parts of the story. While trying to find a way to return to the real world, she meets her male protagonist, Yun Jing Ye. Love begins to blossom between the two, but new developments in the novel's storyline keep interfering. The cause of these unexpected changes is that of another novelist in the real world who is also working on rewriting the novel's storyline.
As the New Year approaches, a sudden landslide causes 13 people to be trapped in Luobai Department Store, an old shopping mall in Haizhou City. Now, the 13 people have to fight for survival.

The story follows the bold and spirited neurosurgeon Liu Zi Yi, who is preparing to marry her boyfriend when she discovers that he has been admitted to the hospital where she works due to a special circumstance. Devastated, she decides to end the relationship gracefully.

Meanwhile, the optimistic cardiothoracic surgeon Qin Wen Bin appears carefree, but in reality, he is fully aware of his situation. His career is smooth, but his marriage is on the rocks, leaving him unsure of what to do next. Despite the chaos in their personal lives, both of them find solace and support in each other as they work together in the operating room, growing and healing together.

Wu Xing Yu, the new captain of the Jinlin Guard, is newly married to silver hairpin maker Hua Jian Jiu when a mysterious murder case occurs in the capital. As she investigates, the clues begin to point to her loving and considerate husband as the culprit and killer of her father. 

Is the husband she loves really a vicious killer? And if he is, will she be able to turn him over into the hands of justice... and execution?

A journalist, Su Li, is accidentally mistaken for the daughter-in-law of a wealthy family. In the process of punishing the evildoers and upturning the family, she wins the heart of her wealthy husband and encounters Mu Shao Ze, a man who shares her unwavering resolve and rebellious spirit.

~~ Adapted from web novel "Zai Jian Ai Ren: Qi Yue Dao Qi, Ti Shen Pao Bu Diao" (再见爱人: 契约到期, 替身跑不掉) a signed IP on Migu (咪咕).

Xu Xiao Yang grew up under the high pressure of her mother. She had to accept everything arranged by her mother. She always felt that she was ordinary. Even when she was in school, she had a crush on the school idol Fu Yan Li, but she didn't dare to approach him and could only escape. 

Ten years later, she was 29 years old and worked as a small employee in a bank. The long-term work pressure caused her ill health. She went to the hospital for treatment but unexpectedly met Fu Yan Li as the attending physician. She didn't expect that he was also her blind date. After her mother issued the final task of getting married, Xu Xiao Tang decided, after drinking, that since she was going to be with someone she didn't like, she would indulge herself with the person she had secretly loved for ten years.
The story between a psychologist with dissociative identity disorder and his female alter.

In order to find grandmother who left home many years ago, a granddaughter and her grandma's older twin sister embark on an uplifting journey together.

Five years ago, grandma suddenly ran away from home to see the world, to find herself and restart her life. Five years later, her family accidentally caught wind of news about her. As such, Dou Qi is accompanied by grandma's twin sister on a journey to finding grandma.

While travelling together, Duo Qi listened to the stories about her own grandmother to learn about her experiences. It not only resonated with her but also made her realize her hidden strength that is surprising at times and contemplative at times. From one stop to the next, the puzzle surrounding grandma is slowly pieced together.

In January 1940, Liang Shuo, an underground worker of our party who suffered a head injury, woke up from a blizzard in the mountains. He lost his memory due to the injury and came to Shanghai to search based on clues. However, his identity was caught in the roundup of the Japanese army, so he suspected that he was a member of the army. People from Wang Puppet No. 76 also found him and said that he was the director of the Operations Division.

At this time, the "Peace and Co-Prosperity Conference" jointly organized by the Japanese and Wang governments is about to be held. A group of refugee workers who have been tightly imprisoned by Japan will also be pushed onto the battlefield after the conference, and their lives are at stake.

Qiao He, a young jade carving shop owner, and Huo Ting Lan, a kintsugi restoration specialist, meet by chance. Through misunderstandings, cooperation, and mutual healing, they find a heartwarming romance set in the world of antique craftsmanship.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "My Sweetheart" (送你一颗小桃心) by Su Xing An (苏幸安).

In the chaos of the Republic of China, Xu Bai, an impoverished young aristocrat, desperately tries to break away from her cruel and obsessive fiancé, Xiao Heng. To survive, she enters the service of the powerful warlord Xiao Ling Xuan,  becoming a tutor to his adopted daughter, Xiao Zhu. Caught in the middle of a conspiracy, she is forced into a ruthless power struggle between Xiao Ling Xuan and his nephew, Xiao Heng, navigating between the two dangerous men.

Miao Sha is an elite in the sales industry who is known for her ability to strive amidst difficult circumstances. Her husband, Fang Cheng, on the other hand, is an ordinary IT employee despite many years of work experience. However, an incident caused Miao Sha to lose the opportunity to be promoted, and she was switched to another department. Fang Cheng decides to work hard to support his wife. This causes the balance of the family to suddenly change but provides an opportunity for the couple to have a change in thinking. Together, they face and overcome the obstacles in front of them and understand the true essence of marriage.

Yun Xiang, a gentle 14-year-old girl longing for a warm family, is adopted into the Cheng family after a family tragedy and becomes a “sister” to Cheng Che, who is as old as her. Cheng Che is cold and distant, having grown up under the shadow of his parents’ divorce, and he views Yun Xiang’s sudden entrance into his life with hostility. The story begins with Yun Xiang moving into the Cheng household. 

Despite facing Cheng Che’s cold stares and rejection, she works hard to adapt to her new environment, hoping to become part of this family. Cheng Che, sensitive about family matters and aware of his mother’s possessive attention toward him, feels threatened by Yun Xiang’s presence, fearing she might take away the only love he receives from his mother. As a result, he treats Yun Xiang with deliberate coldness and keeps his distance, even avoiding her at school.

~~ Adapted from the web…

The three-member team reunites in a major new chapter. As they engage in medical exchanges, emotional confrontations, and struggles between ideals and reality, moments of frustration and warmth coexist side by side.

When they once again look deep within themselves, can they still hold on to the aspirations and convictions that first set them on their path?

Because of an accident, Gu Qian Yu is about to miss out on going to the art school. His sister, Gu Qian Xi, impersonated him and entered the art school in the name of special enrollment in order to prevent her brother's dream from shattering. Zhang Chi was from a wealthy family and due to the failure of his father’s investment and his departure from home, his life has undergone tremendous changes. At the age of 17, he released a single, earned a bit of fame. He also entered the art school in the name of special enrollment.

A story about family follows Qi Guo Sheng, a retired teacher who has been widowed for many years and his three sons with different personalities.

Qi Guo Sheng is a man who cares about the Chinese concept of "face", but his three sons have not afforded him the honor. His eldest, Qi Tian Zuo, is a Michelin three-star dessert chef. He has a fear of marriage due to misconceptions about his own parents.

Middle child Qi Tian You was initially his father's pride. He's a college professor who had his life together, yet he suddenly becomes a divorcee. Their youngest son Qi Tian faces problems with his love life. Including little grandson Qi Mo Wen, the Qi family home is like a male dormitory.

Three generations of male testosterone living under one roof is a recipe for disaster, not to mention the fact that everyone has inherited Grandpa Qi's temper. The road to escaping singlehood has roses…

dramas.nt: 穿书富家妯娌，我和闺蜜齐上阵
dramas.syn:
Lin Nan Qiao and Xia Lin Shi accidentally transmigrate into a wealthy family novel and become the wives of the twin brothers, Ji Chi and Ji Yu, of the Ji family. Originally sisters-in-law with a tragic fate, they team up to save money and find a way to escape, facing numerous trials and emotional entanglements along the way.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gui Mi Qi Chuan Shu, Ni Li, Wo Ge Yi Tian" (闺蜜齐穿书，你离，我隔一天), also known as "Chuan Cheng Hao Men Zhou Li, Wo He Gui Mi Sha Feng Le!" (穿成豪门妯娌，我和闺蜜杀疯了！), by Shi Jiu (柿九).
dramas.t: Chuan Shu Fu Jia Zhou Li, Wo He Gui Mi Qi Shang Zhen

dramas.syn: This is the world where people, demons, and gods exist. Xi Xiao Hui is a half-demon girl who lives as an owner of the great Wuming restaurant. One day, two mysterious men named Mu Bai and Jiang Ye come to her restaurant, and they both come to apply for jobs there. Mu Bai and Jiang Ye are actually spirit slayers who came to the town to slay the bad spirits. The three of them then team up and start their adventures to unravel the secrets behind what happened in relation to Xi Xiao Hui's past.
Internet novelist Xia You You time-travels into her new novel “Lin Manor Crisis”, taking on the role of the nasty cast member, Situ Cha Cha.
dramas.t: I Became a Vicious Supporting Actress

dramas.syn:
Shi Yue unexpectedly transmigrates into the world of her own novel. The good news: she can control the plot. The bad news: within the story exists the dangerous villain Pei Jin, who is constantly trying to harm her.

To survive, Shi Yue engages in a battle of wits with Pei Jin. Over time, their sharp confrontations evolve into a more complicated bond. Pei Jin becomes drawn to Shi Yue’s unique personality, while Shi Yue begins to see another side to him beneath his madness.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bei Zi Ji Xie De Feng Pi Fan Pai Qiang Zhi Ai" (被自己写的疯批反派强制爱) by Dao Ren Yin Xiao (道人引笑).

Xiao Hua Yong has returned but still needs medicine to fully recover his damaged organs. Shen Xi He nurses him back to health with the help of his doctor Xie Yun Huai who it seemed was with him for the 4 years he was away. Their son is just like his father but the two need to get to know each other and bond. Though there's no explanation on his survival or where he's been after faking his death, the family and their friends continue their now much happier lives.

The relationship between the rebelling Qi Qi and her foster father Lin Huan Zhi is very tense. Qi Qi who is suffering from depression turns to the internet where she gets to know Bao Bao Lan and You Nuo. Although all very different in character, the three girls come to trust and appreciate each other. Meanwhile, band leader and main vocalist Lin Nan Yi also appears in Qi Qi’s life. ~~ Adapted from the novel "Golden Castle of Elfin" (小妖的金色城堡) by Rao Xue Man (饶雪漫).

Zhang Neng Liang is a fuerdai (second generation rich) who fails the university entrance exams and joins the People’s Liberation Army as a member of the tank crew. Squad leader Niu Nul Li comes from a rural village, and missed out on a place in the military academy twice due to Zhang Neng Liang. They start off on the wrong foot, though eventually become fast friends after being allocated to the same team. The pair are joined by sole female crew member Ye Xiao Meng, an earnest tomboy who becomes the army’s first female tank driver.

A game of martial arts, two obsessions. They should have been locked in a life-or-death struggle, yet their entanglement deepens to the bone. A game of chess, two people, wielding love as their sword and affection as their blade, embarking on a pinnacle battle.

With blood and bone, rewriting the order of the martial arts world. With schemes and blades, seizing control of the hearts of the people. On the ruins, a battle of two powerful forces unfolds; the old order is about to be overturned, and new rules await.

After graduating from university, Zhen Jie works as a department manager in a webcasting company and is in a romantic relationship with surgeon Yang Zi Xuan. 

Her career is smooth, and her love is sweet. Just as she and her boyfriend start talking about marriage, a woman named Zhang Jin Ping suddenly shows up with a confession. It turns out that when Zhang Jin Ping was young, she fell in love with her college classmate Guan Wen Shan and became pregnant with Zhen Jie, but because of young age, had to give her up for adoption. Zhang Jin Ping currently suffers from pulmonary heart disease and needs her daughter to donate her lungs to extend her life. Faced with a biological mother who had fallen from the sky, Zhen Jie's life is suddenly thrown into upheaval.
The story tells about various bizarre mysteries such as "Blood Soul Forest", "Pouling Town", and "Ghost Valley" that Bao Zheng experienced in his youth on his way to Beijing to rush to the exam.
dramas.t: Justice Bao the Legend of Young

dramas.syn:
It tells the story of Cui Ye, an ordinary Go teacher in the early 21st century, who was unfortunately taken hostage in a credit union robbery. In order to protect himself, he had to assist the robbers in escaping the police. However, in the process, he discovered that his Go talent could be used for crime. 

Under the pressure of life and reality, Cui Ye gradually embarked on the road of crime and gradually lost control. His brother Cui Wei, as a policeman, hopes that he can return to the right path, but things go against his wishes. The story of the two brothers drifting further and further away on the black and white roads!

Jiang Yu Kui, the Holy Maiden of the Zhao Tribe, survives a childhood of captivity and embarks on a quest for revenge after learning of her sister's death. Armed with divine powers and drawn into the orbit of the formidable Feng Ye, she finds an unexpected ally and love while battling a tyrant emperor and his ruthless empress. 

But when Yu Kui discovers her sister is alive and the true mastermind behind a years-long scheme to seize power, a deadly game of twin deception begins. As love and vengeance collide, destiny leads them toward the day the camellias finally bloom.

To tackle the ever growing drug trade, a selection process was held to recruit the best members to join the drug enforcement agency. Three young policemen stood out in the selection process - Zhuang Yan, Li Xiao and Wei Kai. Under the leadership of captain Bai Hua and vice captain Lu Wei, the men went through life-and-death situations, successfully infiltrating into their enemies' nests and bringing the criminals to justice.
Precious Youth tells of the love and friendship between academically motivated student Liu Ting and the problematic yet passionate Xiao Xiaojun from their college days in 1997 to current times.

The story of a junior high school girl who mistakenly gets (?) into the fairyland examination room and gets accidentally admitted to the celestial college. In this college, she goes through the process of making a gang of friends and starting a dream adventure story.

Story of Shen Nian, a girl with face blindness, who one day runs into campus rebel and cool guy Song Yu, only to realize that she can clearly see his face. Song Yu takes the blame for her being late and in return she becomes his fake girlfriend...only it doesn't take long for their feelings to not be so fake anymore. Will their young love survive in the face of parent opposition, jealous suitors, and even cancer?

(Sources: MyDramaList)

The Kingdom of Huanxi held a court musician selection competition. The popular idol Wan Yu disguised herself as a man to participate in the competition. She met the secret guard Tu Qian Zhou and the rich young master Jin Xin Xin who were lurking here looking for secrets. After many hilarious mistakes, Wan Yu and Tu Qian Zhou gradually fell in love...

Shen Yang accidentally transmigrates into a book and becomes the daughter of a wealthy villain who abuses the male protagonist, Jiang Jin. To escape the tragic fate of her original owner, who was skinned alive, Shen Yang attempts to distance herself from Jiang Jin, but the entanglement gradually brings her own depression and trauma to light. Jiang Jin is also attracted by her pure tenacity, and from a hatred-driven killing machine, he gradually falls in love with her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ye Hei Ye Gong Zhen" (与黑夜共枕) by Dai Zi Gui Zhong (呆字闺中).

dramas.nt: 暖婚轻宠妻 第二季
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the manhua "Your Turn to Chase After Me" (重生暖婚轻宠妻) by Ake Culture (阿柯文化).
dramas.t: Nuan Hun Qing Chong Qi Season 2

dramas.syn: She was originally a concubine from Cheng Guo's residence, but her family was destroyed because her parents were framed. By coincidence, she became an immortal, dormant for ten years, returning from the snow, just for revenge. From the moment she stepped into Cheng's mansion again, her destiny got entangled with several men.

dramas.nt: 夜先生捡的小可怜美人有太多的心眼
dramas.syn:
In order to investigate the truth about her family's extermination, Xiao Xi, whose miraculous blood holds the cure for illnesses, pretends to be a fool and gets close to Ye Zhi Ting. But she never expects that her masks will fall off one by one. She also developed feelings for Ye Zhi Ting and vice versa. But when the truth surfaced, what should the two people who are in love with each other do?

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Pian Zhi Da Lao Huai Li De Zhang Xin Jiao Mi You Sa" (偏执大佬怀里的掌心娇美又飒) by Mei Xu Xun Xue (梅须逊雪).
dramas.t: Ye Xian Sheng Jian De Xiao Ke Lian Mei Ren You Tai Duo De Xin Yan

dramas.syn:
Ji Xuan is drugged by accident and encounters Song Zhao Li. It disrupts Ji Xuan's once peaceful life. Everyone thinks Ji Xuan is climbing the social ladder, but only Song Zhao Li knows this is his long-planned scheme. Ji Xuan gradually uncovers the mystery amid their constant entanglement, and the two embark on a relationship of extreme entanglement and mutual redemption.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Qing Mi" (情靡) by Er Xi (二喜).

dramas.nt: 时先生，你的暗恋藏不住啦
dramas.syn:
On Qin Shu Zhi's 25th birthday, she was left alone on the top of a mountain by Shen Yichen, her boyfriend of three years, in the heavy rain. She wanted to go back to her parents for comfort, but she met a gangster again. The hero appeared like a savior and saved her when she was lost and scared, and took out her favorite strawberry cake when she was sad.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shi Xian Sheng, You Xing Qu He Wo Jie Ge Hun Me" (时先生，有兴趣和我结个婚么) by Wu Jiu (舞九).
dramas.t: Mr. Shi, You Can't Hide Your Secret Crush Anymore

dramas.syn: Lin Mu Xuan disguises Xu Zhao Zhao to attract a hidden enemy for revenge. During their time running a beauty shop together, he falls for her lively personality while their secrets and true intentions slowly unravel.

Qin Xiao Yang and Tang Shi grew up together as inseparable friends, but an unexpected incident places them on opposing sides. By chance, Qin Xiao Yang comes into possession of a mysterious “key” and enlists in the “Sky Wolf” special forces unit, which specializes in computer network warfare. Working alongside cyber expert Zhu Li Tong, he infiltrates the dark web platform “Gate of Hell”, controlled by an international terrorist organization.

Together with the woman he deeply loves, big data specialist Jiang Mei, as well as comrade-in-arms Duan Yu Zhe and veteran counter-terror operatives, Qin Xiao Yang engages in a high-stakes battle of wits against terrorists, foiling attack after attack.

When Yang Qing woke up, she was surprised to find that she had entered the body of a peasant girl from the ancient times. The peasant girl Xiaoqing was about to force herself to marry into the prince's mansion by having a marriage contract with the young prince, Mu Jinfeng. Yang Qing, however, was reluctant to marry in a hurry and so she was about to ask Mu Jinfeng for the dissolution of the marriage. But every time she tries to ask him, the residual subconscious from Xiaoqing repeatedly disrupts her and turns her actions into shows of love instead!

Cheng Xia has secretly loved her childhood friend Chen She Chuan for seven years without success, only to receive the reply, "We're just friends." Heartbroken, she decides to distance herself from him and unexpectedly reunites with another childhood friend, Xu Jing Xiao, and is moved by his gentle and persistent pursuit of her love.

~~ Adapted from the short story "An Lian Zhu Ma Di Qi Nian" (暗恋竹马第七年) by Hai De Ge Zi (海的鸽子).

Shen Yan, a detective, teams up with unlikely allies to solve a series of murders linked to stolen sacred artifacts. As they follow a trail of clues, they uncover a decades-old mystery that holds the key to stopping the killer.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Ying Ni Zhe" (影匿者) by Jin Ling Yun (金凌云).

The story follows the early years of the Republic of China when legends run amok about secret treasures, and our hero is tasked by his master to locate it. He’s then embroiled in numerous dangers and revenge plots; one incident leading to his Master’s death. Our heroine is an educated miss returning from abroad with a mission to find her missing brother. They eventually discover the four items in the treasure box, which reveal two contracts; one is to break the seal selfishly or the second is to lock the seal and let the secrets flow away with the wind. They will either be treasure hunters or contract fulfillers, each with their own obstacles to overcome and decisions to make.

A story about a student who starts a judo club for the wrong reasons and has to keep it going when it blows up.

There are only three important things in Yuan Fei's life - chasing the stars, chasing the stars and chasing the stars. Having devoted all his time to his hobbies, his studies bear the brunt of the damage. He tricks his childhood friend Yu Jia into organizing a judo club because holding fake competitions can help him earn enough points for graduation. Unexpectedly, the club draws the attention of interesting personalities who sign up. Furthermore, everyone's most hated and revered top-tier student Yun Qing also signs up for the club. With no choice, Yuan Fei can only welcome Yung Qing, who is Yu Jia's biggest crush on the team. With the many challenges that come with running a school club, will they be able to keep it open?

Physician-in-training Mu Lan Qing rescues a wounded white cat. Once the cat has recovered from its wounds, however, it disappears. When searching for the cat, Mu Lan Qing has a run-in with several members of the Demonic Cult. She is rescued by swordswoman Lu Tong, and the two of them become fast friends.
dramas.t: The Tale of the Cat Spirit
tags: Censored Adaptation Of Same-sex Original Work

dramas.nt: 不装了霍总每天都想复婚
dramas.syn: Bai Luo An and CEO Huo Ling end their five-year marriage, with Bai Luo An leaving a letter behind. The story follows their complicated past and the misunderstandings that shaped their relationship. As they move forward separately, both face challenges, personal growth, and the ups and downs of love, loyalty, and emotional connection.
dramas.t: No More Pretense: Mr. Huo's Daily Desire for Reconciliation

dramas.syn: Ruan Qing Huai's parents died in a plane crash when she was seven, and Bo Shi Heng took her in, raising her as his niece. Over time, Ruan Qing Huai develops feelings for Bo Shi Heng and confesses to him on her 18th birthday. However, Shi Heng rejects her, insisting that he is only her uncle. Determined, Qing Huai decides to confess to him on her birthday every year.
dramas.t: Luo Ru Da Wu Jiang Ni Yi Wang

dramas.syn: On the wedding day, Chen Zi, a rich lady, was betrayed by her fiancé and went to the bar to get drunk. When she was fighting with gangsters, He Chuan came to her rescue. She fell in love with He Chuan at first sight. After the second meeting, Chen Zi took the initiative to propose marriage. However, she didn't know that this rough mechanic had an unknown identity behind him.

The quiet life of high schooler Zhao Zuo You is turned upside down by a mysterious new student, Xun Wei Lai, and a strange new neighbor, Zhao Liao. He never suspects they’re both versions of himself from different times. At 16, 41, and 66, the three Zhaos couldn’t be more different — each with their own motives — and now they’re all fighting for the same life.

Eighteen high-intensity, mind-bending murder cases correspond to the punishments of the Eighteen Levels of Hell. Criminal police captain Ti An and psychologist Zhao Yao investigate the subtle depths of human nature behind each seemingly bizarre case, hunting down the monsters hidden within people’s hearts.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zi Shou" (自首), also known as "Sha Ren Zhen Xiang" (杀人真相), by Liu Li Luan Hua (琉璃栾华).

During the Li Zhen Guan period of the New Tang Dynasty, the fragmented pages of "Tui Bei Tu", which was rumored to predict the future of the land, reappeared. Rumors boiled over the land, saying that the former female emperor, Empress Xiao, was about to reincarnate and usurp the throne again. Several weird and cruel murder cases occurred one after another. And all doubts point to concubine Yu Gui Fei, who was loved by the emperor. When people were in a state of panic, Li Mo Bai, a well-known gifted scholar, devoted himself to the people and went to the palace to seek officials. He was ordered to investigate the murders and find out the truths. Taking advantage of the opportunity to write poems for the imperial concubine, he vowed to "compose three hundred poems and solve three hundred cases." In the process of protecting the safety of the people and solving cases, he found himself…
dramas.t: The Untold Stories of Tang Dynasty

dramas.syn:
A young Bao Zheng heads to the capital for the civil service examinations. He encounters several mysteries, thus beginning a legendary tale as he works with Gongsun Ce and Zhan Zhao to crack the case.

The story has three main chapters. Bao Da Niang mistakenly becomes involved in a case. Bao Zheng tries to clear his mother's name but it brings to light a massacre related to the ghost bride. On the way to the capital, Bao Zheng enters the Wuji Inn where he uses his intelligence to uncover the mysteries in the blood spirit forest. Finally, the Soul Village seems to be connected to a big conspiracy in the palace.
dramas.t: The Legend of Young Justice Bao

dramas.syn:
In 1986, when Yugoslav nuclear power expert Lehmann came to the East China Sea to inspect nuclear power and question China's ability to build nuclear power plants, fitter Ye Jia Ming and buyer Lin Tian Chen, becomes his first supporters.
But during the building of a plant, Tian Chen was corrupted by Ding Li, and accused by his superior, of variety of crimes. Feeling betrayed,  Tian Chen resigns from his post and went to the United States, leaving his son Lin Qi to the Ye's family to raise.  But what he didn't except, is that his son, will folllow his footstep, and as an adult become  key figure, in developing nuclear weapons.

A story set in the world of fashionable jewelry that revolves around a woman who hides her identity to unravel a secret while proving herself to be an outstanding jeweller. 

When Bai Xi Ning was ten years old, her life was turned upside down, and she went from being an heiress of a jewelry enterprise to completely penniless. She was sent to Australia to be adopted by a Chinese couple and lost all contact with her home country. However, she eventually discovers that the reason her mother was sent to prison was because she had been framed.

Fifteen years later, Xi Ning, who earned a dual degree through her own hard work and capability, joined the company that was once owned by her mother. She finds herself in the center of a power struggle between Li Zhuo Ran and Lin Yi.

dramas.nt: 我居然闪婚了禁欲男神
dramas.syn: Su Li accidentally lost her memory for five years, woke up and got married to the boyfriend she had been secretly in love with for many years as a student! But 18-year-old Su Li has never even touched a man's hand, and now she actually has a husband who is also a male god! It's a pity that the male god has his own little childhood sweetheart, Su Li, who decides whether to fall in love or make money!

When Qiao Xing Ye was 8 years old, she was abandoned by her adoptive parents and was eventually picked up by Qiao Rong Chuan and brought up in the Qiao family. When Qiao Xing Ye was betrayed by her fiancé and hurt by her family, the man who raised Qiao Xing Ye came to Hong Kong to stand up for her, which shocked the entire upper-class society.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yao Ta Ren Cuo? Qiao Xiao Jie De Bai Yue Guang Sha Lai Le" (要她认错？乔小姐的白月光杀来了) by Fan Hua Shi Jiu (梵花十酒).

In a turbulent era, a rich young master falls for a lowly opera performer. Despite harsh social divides, rumors, and betrayal, they bravely fight for a passionate love, determined to be together against all odds.

Li Shuang, an iron-blooded female general of the Southern Jin dynasty, unexpectedly takes in a boy who has completely lost his memory and names him Jin An. Unbeknownst to her, Jin An is afflicted with a strange Gu poison: during the day, he turns into a naive child, while at night he returns to his adult form. Because the Gu parasite has consumed Li Shuang’s blood and recognized her as its master, he obeys only Li Shuang.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Yu Jin Chang An" (与晋长安) by Jiu Lu Fei Xiang (九鹭非香).

Because of a bracelet, Lu Bei Ye has been relying on dreams to linger with his beloved for a long time. He had been trying to find her but found out that she was his nephew's fiancée. So he took her away by force and protected her well, but found out that she was being emotionally controlled by his nephew to deal with him.

Two family tragedies leave one son seeking revenge while the other son tries to rebuild his life from scratch. Two decades ago in the midst of the financial crisis, Kang Rong Securities acquired the failing Gao Group, causing the shamed Gao Group owner, Gao Qi Liang, to commit suicide. His son grows up and changes his name to Luo Hao and goes to work at Kang Rong Securities to avenge his father’s death. Luo Hao rises through the ranks quickly to a position close to owner Jiang Cheng En and begins to orchestrate his downfall. When Cheng En goes bankrupt and is thrown in jail, his son, Jiang Yan is suddenly thrust from his pampered life and forced to start his life from scratch from the bottom rung of the company. With the support of Xia Bing, can Yan save his father’s company from Luo Han’s revenge plot?

A beautiful girl turns into a mini pig overnight? Zhu Zhu reluctantly decides to give away the mini pig “Oscar” just because her scumbag boyfriend, Ou Kai, intensely dislikes pigs! Zhu Zhu picks up Oscar and goes to a remote nighttime pet shop, where the ruffian-like owner agrees to take Oscar in. But Zhu Zhu is still ruthlessly ditched by the scumbag, and she bawls her eyes out and gets immensely drunk in the middle of the night.
