The next morning, she discovers that she has turned into a mini pig?! She is even in the pet shop? At the same time, her immediate superior, Lu Ming, appears at the shop entrance and gently adopts her away. Thereby, a fascinating little story unfolds…

The story begins with the unexpected situation of the concert in Shanghai in 2008. Lying on a stretcher, the third brother, Deng Chang Fu, recalled that on the morning of the early winter of 1953, the fourth child of the Deng family, "the girl", was born in the village of Taiwan's family. The girl's talent in singing appeared when she was young, but her father, Deng Shu, firmly opposed it. Deng Shu retired from the army and began his career as a market stall. 

The girl was puzzled by the depression and homesickness in her father's heart, but she became a little helper for her father to sell steamed buns. After graduating from primary school, the girl was not admitted to junior high school. However, winning the singing competition through the radio has become a regular shift for singing programmes. Deng Shu clashed with hooligans at the market stall, was beaten and injured, and went…

After scheming her way to the throne and meeting a tragic end, Bai Xi Yue is reborn as her former sister, Bai Xi Yao. Now facing her younger, ruthless past self, she must endure the very schemes she once orchestrated, seek redemption, and navigate the complexities of love and fate.

Centered on a wealthy family's age-gap romance and suspenseful revenge plot, the story intertwines the fates of heiress Jiang Wan Zhi and mysterious waiter Jing Chuan through a decade-old car accident. It explores themes of vengeance and redemption.

To save her critically ill best friend, A Zhao, Meng Rao signs a contract with the cold and imposing tycoon Shen Si Lin, pretending to be his fake lover in order to sabotage his arranged marriage into a wealthy family. She originally plans to take the money and run, but instead, he counterattacks by showering her with affection.

Develop feelings? Absolutely not! Meng Rao tells herself: All fake pampering. All illusions. I’m just here to make money!
Until one day, she discovers that she has been nothing but a tool used by A Zhao. She immediately snaps, turns dark, and strikes back, only for the once-cold boss to suddenly become a love-brained man who wants to force his devotion on her.

Meng Rao is stunned: The icy mountain turned into a volcano… this man is actually serious?!
dramas.t: The Contract of Love and Deception

dramas.syn: Tu You You discovers her fiancé's infidelity with her best friend. While drunk, she forcefully kisses his uncle, Bo Yun Qi, who is struck by lightning. The shattered jade pendant triggers a sympathetic connection. Bo Yun Qi uses this opportunity to keep her, and true love gradually blossoms.
dramas.t: Your Arrival Coincides with the Spring Time

dramas.syn: Shen Chu Yan just wants to have a child to inherit the family business, but unexpectedly she gets entangled with a clingy male model. She wants to get rid of him, but she doesn't know that he has been secretly in love with her for a long time. "Sister, you can't escape now".

After her father's scandal broke out, Xu Yan chose to divorce the domineering boss who arranged the marriage. When asked, Qin Lie said that there was nothing to regret about the family marriage. But not long after, he coaxed her to get back together. He loved her, but he didn't know what she really wanted. The reason she chose to divorce was just that she didn't want to let the vicious family implicate him and his indifference, but he didn't understand. When he understood her heart, he began to feel the love she really needed.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hun Se" (婚色) by Er Xi (二喜).

Li Zhen and Yu Sheng fell in love during university and secretly married, but later, due to Yu Sheng constantly being occupied with social engagements, Li Zhen filed for divorce. One night while drinking at a bar, Li Zhen unexpectedly got entangled with Lu Yan Ming, and the two were forced into marriage. With Lu Yan Ming, Li Zhen experienced what it truly meant to be cherished. She finally realized that some people are destined to be just passersby, while others are meant to be home.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Li Hun Hou, Bei Tong Ju Shang Si Liao Ku Le" (离婚后，被同居上司撩哭了) by Dai Feng Huo Lun De Tian Dao (带风火轮的甜刀).

To save the hero in her play, the intelligent and pretty screenwriter travels to the script by accident and meets a shy prince, a vicious rival in love, a scheming contender for the throne, a mischievous emperor who loves to mess up with lovers, a kind empress, a cousin whom she grew up with and an open and modern mother...

Will the heroine be able to save the day and get what she wants?

On the eve of her wedding, Bu Wan, who had been pursuing Huo Ming Xi for ten years, discovered that he still couldn't let go of his beloved Mu Xue. Heartbroken, Bu Wan found herself homeless and robbed. On the verge of collapse, she ran into Huo Sui, whom she hadn't seen in years. Deciding to give Huo Ming Xi one last chance, Bu Wan witnessed the unforgettable love between Huo Ming Xi and Mu Xue.

Huo Sui silently stood by her, shielding her from the wind and snow, and tending to her wounds. Half drunk and half awake, Bu Wan decided to marry Huo Sui. Though Bu Wan regretted her feelings upon sobriety, she decided to make do with the situation. To Bu Wan's surprise, their relationship gradually blossomed, with Huo Sui unconditionally doting on her, his deep love hidden in every detail of their lives.

The heroine Yan Fei inherited a down-and-out theater left by her parents. In order to revive the theater, Yan Fei did everything she could. In an accident, Yan Fei met Xie Zhi. In order to get Xie Zhi's help, Yan Fei is willing to flirt him, and she gained true love while her career was counterattacking all the way.

In the summer of 1994, in Nancheng, Beijing, a girl "committed suicide" in the well, but various signs at the scene showed that this was an intentional homicide, and the nature was very bad. After that, girls were killed one after another in the alley. Rumors of the "Alley Killer" spread widely, and a cloud of fear hung over every household.

But at that time, detection methods were far less developed than today. There were no cameras in the alleys, and there was no DNA comparison technology. To catch a suspect, there is almost no shortcut, it is to visit door to door. Even the "rogue veteran" was called in to investigate the case. There is a rumor circulating among the residents: In order to force the demolition households to leave, the developer deliberately killed a girl, and the relevant departments protected the murderer.

The police and their apprentices rushed into the case…

The love adventures of a university girl who comes into possession of a mysterious love box. By opening this blind box and falling asleep and dreaming, you can have a limited love with different types of virtual boyfriends to fulfill your romantic wishes.

Liu Lian is a 30-year-old single woman who has a tendency to not go by the book. She is contended in simply enjoying her own life. Her mother's sudden passing leaves her unsure about how to cope, so she decides to give herself a short holiday break. She may approach life with sarcasm and contempt, but deep inside, she seeks reconciliation between her mother and herself.

It mainly tells about Ye Xu Xu, the killer of the dark guards and the housemaid. In order to get rid of the fate of being tortured as a double The prime minister, Yan Xuan Ting, unexpectedly got a black-bellied husband who is capable of protecting his wife and full of love stories. During getting along with Yan Xuan Ting, Ye Xu Xu gradually changed and understood what love and trust are. Together to eradicate King Jing An, Ye Xu Xu also ushered in her true own.

The destitute star chef He Xian, who used to look down on dim sum, in order to regain everything he lost and make a comeback, he was forced to participate in the "King of Dim Sum" pastry competition. For this purpose, He Xian sought guidance from the "Pastry God," teamed up with talented teammates, embarked on the path of dim sum.

The female CEO took a fancy to the male bartender, and the two had a passionate night. Si Nan offered to support Bai Zi Hao with a high salary to help him with his sister's medical expenses. In fact, her real purpose was to transplant his kidney to her brother, who suffered from uremia. Bai Zi Hao also pretended to be a prey to be approached by a rich woman. The sister who suffered from leukemia was actually his childhood sweetheart, An Ran. 

After An Ran met Si Nan's rich brother, she didn't want to live a poor life with the bartender anymore. She lied that she had leukemia to make him give up. At the same time, Si Nan and Bai Zi Hao became more emotionally involved as they spent time together and got along. He wanted to stop the loss in time and was ready to run, but found out that An Ran was with Si Nan's brother. All the scams were revealed.

Hua Yi Long is an orphan, and a misunderstanding leads to a bar fight in which his right eye is injured. After surgery and a recovery period, Yi Long is superseded to find that his right eye now has perfect vision and X-ray vision.

After a young girl from the orphanage dies, Yi Long is motivated to go to medical school.

In a time of chaos, the fallen lady Du Xin Yue faces family upheaval and bravely overcomes adversity. While running a tavern on her own, she relentlessly seeks the truth behind her father's mysterious death. In the end, she finds love with Su Xing Luo, and together, they defeat the hidden villain threatening their people and protect their home.

Qu Xiao An and Lu Qi Nian have been in love for many years and have gotten married. However, due to the design of Lu Qi Nian's half-brother Lu Hai Yang, Qu Xiao An almost died in a car accident. Lu Qi Nian paid a huge price to finally save Qu Xiao An. 

Although Qu Xiao An survived, her brain nerves were severely damaged and she lost all her memories. Occasionally, she would simulate new memories and new identities based on some TV plots. Once she thought of her previous memories, her nerves would be stimulated and she would fall into a coma. Everyone advised Lu Qi Nian to give up, but he still stayed with Qu Xiao An.
dramas.t: The Killer Is a Bit Cute

dramas.syn: Five years ago, the bottom line of the taboo was torn apart by Ling Shi Jin. Jian Cheng took advantage of his unpreparedness to drug him and escaped. She wore a mask to hide her true identity, but still met him again. She mediated under his nose and planned to escape again, but unexpectedly, she was his prey this time! The hunter's trap was set at first glance.

Wong Fei Hung is a martial arts master and a legendary hero in his time. He is a physician who has saved countless lives in Po Chi Lam, a medical clinic in Canton but the circumstances force his hand to use his fighting abilities to defend the people.

Song Zhi Yi went to the hospital for treatment because of allergies and fell in love with Xie Ting Yan at first sight. She mustered up the courage to ask for Xie Ting Yan's WeChat messages three times, but was ruthlessly rejected! Undaunted, Song Zhi Yi made a plan to seduce Xie Ting Yan!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiang Jia Xie Yi Sheng Wei Xin, Ta Shuo Bu Ke Yi" (想加謝醫生微信，他說不可以) by Lan Qi Ming (懶起名).
dramas.t: Bei Xie Yi Sheng Ju Jia Hao You 99 Ci

dramas.syn:
Qi Xu performed a preoperative examination on Lin You Qian, who came to see a kidney doctor. She begged him to let her go. He, who was forced to marry, asked her to be his girlfriend. Qi Xu agreed in order to graduate, but Lin's mother took a fancy to her and forced Lin You Qian to marry Qi Xu within three days on the grounds that breast cancer was incurable.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Nan Ke Wu Zhen, Leng Mian Jun Guan Ye Ye Xi Chuang Dan" (男科误诊，冷面军官夜夜洗床单) by Qing Ye Duo Duo (青叶朵朵).

This is the story of campus goddess Zhu Nian Nian and her crush's nonsensical older sister Chen Jing An, who one day accidentally switched bodies. Chen Jing An became the popular and beautiful princess she had always dreamed of being, and she was finally free from her brother when she woke up in Zhu Nian Nian's body. Meanwhile, Zhu Nian Nian woke up to find herself the "sister" of her crush, Chen Chang Ning, but now she has the opportunity to be closer to him, and for once, these "siblings" actually get along.  

These two girls who used to envy each other are now seeing each other's true sides.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hua Hai" (花海) by Ju Ni Er Si (居尼尔斯).

Xia Mian, scarred by her troubled family, escapes to a small town and meets tattoo artist Zhou Ran. The tattoo shop gives Xia Mian a sense of home, while Zhou Ran’s past gradually comes to light. Facing multiple challenges, they realize the shop is their true home, join forces to save it, and rename it “Chan Mian.”

~~ Adapted from a web novel "Jiang Lin Ta Xin Shang" (降临他心上), also known as "Xiao Gou Zhua Hu Die" (小狗抓蝴蝶), by Cong Xiang Ji Dan Bing (葱香鸡蛋饼).

dramas.nt: 分手后，程医生哭出鼻涕泡
dramas.syn:
Luo Jia discovers that Cheng Jin, the new transfer from orthopedics, is the very man she had a one-night stand with the night before. Cheng Jin switches seamlessly between domineering and puppy-like, successfully winning Luo Jia’s heart. Just as their romance grows sweet, Luo Jia learns that Cheng Jin only approached her to get revenge on his ex-girlfriend. Heartbroken, she returns to Yu City. Unexpectedly, Cheng Jin follows her there, beginning his desperate “wife-chasing crematorium” journey.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Fen Shou Hou, Gao Leng Cheng Yi Sheng Ku Chu Bi Ti Pao" (分手后，高冷程医生哭出鼻涕泡) by Yu Bu Yu (鱼不语).
dramas.t: Fen Shou Hou, Cheng Yi Sheng Ku Chu Bi Ti Pao

dramas.syn: Chang Yu Qi is the optimistic daughter of a Lou Mei restaurant owner. Her days are busy with helping her mother with their restaurant business, but she dreams of being a professional video gamer in the top virtual reality game Alpha Territory. As luck would have it, she gets the opportunity to work and train at Alpha Territory alongside her idol, Feng Zhou, who leads the Beta Clan, one of the top gaming teams in Alpha Territory. As Yu Qi rises from rookie to full-fledged team member, she finds love, friendship, and all the complex relationships that come with each.

Li Tian is the leader of the grand thieves in Tang. In their search for the kylin horn, they become embroiled in the political turmoil brewing among supporters of the previous dynasty and the royal court.

Under the reign of Emperor Xuanzong, the nation and its people prospered but hiding behind the veil of peace are different factions scheming behind the scenes. It is said that the legendary kylin horn has appeared in the world. Four individuals with unique magical abilities form a team as they embark on a journey to find the treasure.

It follows the growth of students of the Department of Architecture at Binghua University.

Pei Ren Zhi is a sweet, humorous, and talented architectural student at the university. Due to an "exhibitionist" incident on campus, she comes to form the wrong impression about well-known actor Chi Ruo Fei who is also the heir of SE Group. In the process of uncovering the truth, the two go from enemies to friends and gradually develop a mutual attraction. However, many trials await the youths as they face competition at school, differences in social status, and many other issues.

~~ Adapted from the novel of the same name by Jing Nan (井楠).

An old body-burning case is reopened, and Officer Chen Jiang He is urgently called back to his small town. Upon returning, he’s swept into chaos—schemers, a lying killer, and revenge-driven victims, all closing in like a raging sandstorm. Yet, Chen believes every storm ends, and justice will prevail once the dust settles.

In the capital, Qin Chong Lou, the head of the Qin Cao Tang pharmacy, and General Yun Zi Long simultaneously seek the emperor's decree to marry the daughter of the Mo Family Medical Clinic. However, the Mo family has two daughters, the legitimate daughter Mo Jing Yu and the illegitimate daughter Mo Ban Xia. 

The emperor decrees that they should draw lots to determine their spouses: whoever they draw will be their marriage partner. Qin Chong Lou suffers from a leg ailment and hears that Mo Jing Yu is skilled in medicine. He hopes she can cure him. 

Meanwhile, Yun Zi Long bears a deep grudge from a blood feud. His family was implicated when there were errors in transporting military supplies and medicinal materials. He is the sole survivor, and those medicinal materials were sent by Mo Xiang from the Mo Family Medical Clinic. 

Yun Zi Long hears that Mo Xiang favors Mo Ban Xia and wants…

The drama is about two sisters, Ai Qing and Ai Ning. Their parents died unexpectedly, leaving only the two sisters to depend on each other. There were wild rumors in the neighborhood that the two of them had received huge compensation, but the two never responded. As they grew older, the two got married separately, but they didn't want the elder sister's husband to worry about the compensation, and the younger brother-in-law was violent and disregarded the family. When they saw the true face of their husbands, the sisters fought back together and moved towards a better new life.

In the autumn of 2011, in Haiya City, which is near the sea, the coconut breeze blew gently, and the banana shadows swayed. 

Lu Zhu, a criminal police officer transferred from Beijing, met Tong Yan, a forensic doctor from the same branch, during a dispute over injury assessment. Afterwards, the two changed their views on each other during their collision and cooperation and gradually became aware of each other's hidden pain.

At this moment, a bizarre rape and murder case forced Tong Yan to face the nightmare that had haunted her for many years: the serial killer who killed her twin sister reappeared 24 years later and was still following her!
The drama is a biopic on Prince Gong. He was known to have established positive relations with foreign affairs for the Qing dynasty. The drama depicts his rise and fall.

A story that follows three generations of a modern day Chinese family living in the Hutongs of Beijing.

Shicha Hai becoming a lively attraction has broken the peace that old man Zhuang Weitian has enjoyed in his years living at the Hutong. Furthermore, Tong Dawei's arrival and tendency to not bother with trifling matters is an affront to the old man's regard for rules and regulations. Dawei has one goal in mind - to get close to Zhuang Jing, the woman of his dreams. He tries to get on old man Zhuang's good side by studying tai chi under him and becoming his apprentice. Old man Zhuang's son Zhuang Zhiwei who has a stable job has been persistent in finding love again. However, his ex-wife's return has put a dent to his plans. His 3rd brother Zhuang Zhibin is the perfect example of someone who'd rather die than lose face. In trying to do good, he makes bad decisions and gets scammed in…

Cheng Ge, an elite assassin, infiltrates the palace as a personal attendant to Emperor Shi Yu, but becomes caught in court power struggles and haunted by dark secrets from the past, forcing a critical choice between mission and survival.

Gu Yi Xiao, a ruthless business tycoon, seeks revenge on his secretary, Ye Xing Wan, over a long-held misunderstanding, only to be drawn into a twisted love-hate relationship when she fights back. As past wounds resurface, both are forced to confront their emotions, leading to a path of redemption, though true peace remains uncertain.

~~ Adapted from the short story "Ban Xing" (半醒) by Lin Yan Nian (林言年).
A rural girl goes to the city to work. She is hardworking, kind, and brave, gets back her identity as a rich daughter, and gains a domineering president.

In a bustling district, a House of Wonders variety store has opened, where items, seemingly ordinary, each possess peculiar functions. The owner, Damon, has documented the instructions for use in the Wonders Notebook, allowing customers to select items based on their needs. People from all walks of life flock to the House of Wonders, each facing their own dilemmas and seeking ways to overcome them. However, in the end, they invariably discover that what truly resolves their issues isn't these strange and curious goods, but rather their own love and faith.

~~ Adapted from the web manhua "Guai Qi Bi Ji" (怪奇笔记) by Chuanghua Culture (创画文化).

Seven years after her family’s massacre, Jiang Chan discovers a link to Li Sha Lou, a secretive assassin organization. To uncover the truth, she masters her family’s martial arts, adopts the alias Hua Shan, and infiltrates the group.

Lu Cheng Wen is unexpectedly transported into a novel, where he becomes a doomed villain destined to die. Determined to survive by keeping a low profile, he instead unintentionally triggers the heroines to awaken mind-reading abilities, throwing the story’s plot into chaos.

In the end, he joins forces with the awakened male lead Gu Zhan Tian to defy the “Heavenly Dao” that controls their fates, ultimately finding both his true self and his path forward.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tian Gou Fan Pai Zhi Xiang Gou, Nv Zhu Bu An Tao Lu Zou!" (舔狗反派只想苟，女主不按套路走！) by Wo Shi Fen Nu (我是愤怒).

In ancient Chinese and foreign legends, there is a saying that cats have nine lives and cats can live a million times. We found cats throughout history - from ancient Egyptian to Western Han Dynasty to mural totems. The great poets. Li Shang Yin, Huang Ting Jian, and Lu You have all left poems for cats. It makes people feel a sense of reincarnation.

What is the mission of the cat, and what kind of fantasy story happened between the cat and the five boys?

Two years ago, Ye Nan Sheng was married to Si Yi Han, who was said to be short-lived, as a substitute for her sister Ye Zhen Zhen. Si Yi Han went abroad immediately after the marriage, and always thought that his nominal wife was Ye Zhen Zhen.
dramas.t: You Are the April Day on Earth

dramas.nt: 新婚夜和离替嫁医妃超旺夫
dramas.syn: I, a military doctor, traveled through time and space to become an ancient princess. The little princess was very lucky for her husband. She brought the wheelchair prince back to health. True love came to me and I became the prince's peerless favorite concubine!

Song Qing Wu was forced into marriage with the Li family by her father, using her mother as leverage. Her husband, Li Yan, neglected her and harbored feelings for his lover. She unexpectedly had a relationship with Li Yan's uncle, Li Han Xiao, the head of the Li family, and later took the initiative to get close to him, hoping to get pregnant. The two gradually developed feelings for each other in their forbidden relationship, while also having to deal with various obstacles.

Actress Su Qi Qi is filming a scene where she falls into the lake. Simple enough, right? After unknowingly traveling back in time after falling in, she comes across Prince Hei Lan bathing by the lake and assumes he's just another actor and she's still on set. She takes his clothes to warm up. But when Prince Hei Lan notices his clothes stolen, he chases her to the Chu Palace, and Su Qi Qi starts realizing she's not on set anymore. 

When his royal highness Chu Chen Jun sees Qi Qi dressed as Prince Hei Lan, complete with his royal badge, he mistakes her for him...as does the assassin sent to kill the prince. When Chu Chen Jun rescues her, he realizes she's, in fact, a girl, and to keep this interesting woman by his side, he makes her his maidservant. 

Using her modern knowledge, she helps Chen Jun strategize and govern the country, but all Su Qi Qi wants is to escape the Chu Palace and…
dramas.t: Just Because Your Heart Knows My Heart

dramas.syn: As an alien from Lingke Star, Qiao Ran could not be remembered by human beings. He had been around Xia Ming Qi and was always forgotten, until one day Xia Ming, Qi suddenly did not forget him past midnight. They became closer and Qiao Ran encouraged Xia Ming Qi to continue pursuing her dancing dream which she gave up after she got into an accident and lost her mother.

dramas.nt: 霍总我治好了您的抑郁症
dramas.syn: Xia Mo was mocked by fans at the Golden Broom Awards ceremony, and impulsively promised to stand on the podium of the Golden Rooster Awards next year. Before the awards ceremony, she accidentally collided with Huo Bei Xiao, and then exchanged bodies because of a jade pendant.

Overnight, Chu Qin, a distinguished general, was falsely accused of treason. Not only was he reduced to a "wasteful" existence, his legs broken and his life imminent, but his 80,000 soldiers were also brutally massacred. So, he transformed himself into Wu Ming, the world's foremost strategist, and plunged into the conflict, vowing to stir up a bloody storm in the court and restore the reputation of the Chu army.

Shi Yin, long neglected by her family and robbed by her sister Shi Qing He, enters a contract marriage with Han Zhan. Using his support, she fights to reclaim everything, and along the way, the two genuinely fall in love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "San Fen Guai" (三分乖),  also known as "Shi Xiao Jie Jin Tian Ye Bu Guai" (时小姐今天也不乖), by Han Da Bai (韩大白).

Qin Zhi Ai has loved Gu Yu Sheng since their youth. However, when she finally summoned the courage to ask him out to a movie, he suddenly vanished. Years later, when they finally reunite, Gu Yu Sheng has completely forgotten Qin Zhi Ai. Now, Qin Zhi Ai has finally become Gu Yu Sheng's wife, but in his eyes, she is the repulsive Liang Dou Kou.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Na Shi Xi Huan Ni" (那时喜欢你) by Ye Fei Ye  (叶非夜).

At an international space camp many years ago, two boys, Wu Wei and Ying Zi Qi, aspired to be successful astronauts. Later, the second phase of the planned project failed twice in a row, and the Chief Engineer Qin of the control center issued a military order to face more complicated follow-up lunar detection and control work. He gathered five talents from different fields, Wu Wei , Ying Zi Qi, Bai Yan, Miao Xinxian, and Yang Rui to formed a youth commando team of the control center, 'the Shepherd Team' , hoping to create Chinese characteristics for the third phase of Haoyue project.

 In the face of the doubts of other control teams, the relapse of Chief Qin’s illness, and a series of collisions between ideals and reality, the young researchers of the '' Shepherd Team' have experienced failures and hesitations. After hard work and growth in the process, an unprecedented "Chinese…

dramas.t: Journey to the End of the Night

dramas.nt: 窈窕淑女君不弃 第二季
dramas.syn: Yu Yuan Yuan is transported to ancient times through a painting. She is forced by her father to marry a eunuch named Ji Liang Yue. She tries multiple ways to avoid the marriage while trying to find the painting that will transport her back to the present day.
dramas.t: My Fair Lady, Don’t Give Up Season 2

dramas.syn: College student Shang Ya Yue strays into a comic's world and meets its protagonist, the white nine-tailed fox Si Yan, and its villain, the black nine-tailed fox Yan Yu Nan. Which one will she choose?
dramas.t: The Rules of Love Under the Moonlight

dramas.nt: 分居后，禁欲总裁缠它上瘾
dramas.syn: Ran Shuang, who was once the best trader on Wall Street, agreed to marry Fu Zhi Heng in order to repay his financial support. After three years of marriage, the two had not had sex. Ran Shuang thought that Fu Zhi Heng was thinking about his childhood sweetheart Lu Meng Lian. But in fact, it was because Fu Zhi Heng was abused by the nanny when he was a child, and he had a psychological shadow since then and could not have substantial contact with women. After being repeatedly ignored by Fu Zhi Heng, Ran Shuang decided to let go and leave, and Fu Zhi Heng gradually realized his feelings for Ran Shuang and resolutely pursued his wife.

To uncover the truth behind her sister’s death, Su Yu Nian infiltrates the decadent world of “In the Depths of Blossoms.” There, she discovers shocking secrets hidden beneath the glittering façade and becomes entangled in the ruthless power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jia Sheng. 

Her sister was silenced for holding deadly evidence, and danger quickly closes in: betrayal by her best friend, schemes from courtesans, and the ever-watchful threat of Nie Feng. As the truth tears everything apart, Su Yu Nian and Tu Jia Sheng shift between enemies and allies, while In the Depths of Blossoms reveals nothing but bloodstained lies.

Wu Ying Zhen, 29 years old, is a typical older single woman, headstrong, serious and sharp-tongued. Even though he dreams of becoming a world-class furniture designer, in reality, he can only work odd jobs in a furniture shop. After several blind dates that ended in embarrassment, she met the handsome, rich, elegant, and elite Mr. Cat, who had returned from abroad and loved to eat fish, but she never realized that he was actually her classmate and playmate at his childhood elementary school, Yang Zhao. After that, Wu Ying Zhen went on many blind dates, one after another and met men with various animal personalities.

Under Yang Zhao's careful design, they finally gathered at the class reunion. At this time, the appearance of a cat and its beautiful owner makes Wu Ying Zhen gradually learn that Yang Zhao is actually suffering from depression. Under Wu Ying Zhen's mother's opposition and…

A story which occurs in the future world, artificial intelligence AI has basically replaced humans in all walks of life. When artificial intelligence gives birth to self-consciousness, human's survival are threatened. The “Second Awakening” revolves around six awakenings based on a self-conscious AI intelligent robot.

A struggling volleyball team at Second High School loses their star player, Xu Xin, to rival Tianheng High School after a crushing defeat. With no coach, fans, or budget, captain Xiao Tuo tries to keep the team together. Newcomer Wang Jing replaces Xu Xin, but he and Xiao Tuo clash, threatening the team’s future. Can they overcome their differences and make a comeback?

dramas.nt: 替嫁娇妻，偏执总裁轻点宠
dramas.syn: In order to cure her sick grandmother, Mu Yi An was forced to marry Gu Xi Han, the eldest son of the Gu family, for her sister Jiang Xue. The rumored Gu Xi Han has a weird appearance and personality. On the wedding day, he wore a scary mask and scared away all the guests. Gu Xi Han originally thought that Mu Yi An would be scared like everyone else, but she actually possessed him and kissed him and was willing to be his wife. He decided to protect her for life.
dramas.t: Sweet Substitute Bride: Pampered by the Paranoid CEO

dramas.syn:
At Binhai Airport Customs, Chief Guo Cong leads a dedicated team in intercepting smugglers and combating illegal trade. From genetic samples to rare artifacts, they take on high-stakes cases, uncovering criminal masterminds along the way. As they navigate challenges, the team grows both professionally and personally, driven by their commitment to safeguarding national security.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wu Bei Dang Guan Zhi Bai Bu Shi Ren" (吾辈当关之百步识人) by Lie Yi Yang (猎衣扬).

Xiao Hao Feng, a young general, had been lonely since he was a child, but he accidentally developed his skills. However, just as Xiao Hao Feng was proud of the spring breeze, he was suddenly assassinated, and the assassin was actually the princess of the Bei Yue kingdom. As a result, Xiao Hao Feng not only fell into lingering love disputes but also got involved in the political whirlpool of intrigue and deceit.

Ding Ning was single until she met Xiao Ye. The destined encounter also brought an extraordinary catastrophe... Time has always stayed on the day they met, which also happened to give Ding Ning the opportunity to understand and "strategy" Xiao Ye until the cycle of time was broken.

After the Fox Clan is wiped out by Prince Xiling Xuan of Xiling Kingdom, the clan’s sacred maiden Tu Shan Yue survives as a wandering soul and possesses the body of the late Empress Jiang Xin Er. Determined to take revenge, she infiltrates the palace—only to uncover a shocking truth that changes everything.

At a lavish wedding where everyone is well-matched, her fiancé cheats on her. Qin Yue turns away gracefully amidst the sympathetic gazes of the guests. Li Yan has worked in the most dangerous profession, witnessed the darkest and most evil aspects of human nature, and ultimately fulfilled his mission, returning alive, but left with incurable aftereffects. Just when he was about to give up and accept his fate, he met Qin Yue. She said, "We're both in the same boat, our weddings have both ended badly, why not spend our wedding night together?" 

The two hit it off immediately, and things quickly became inseparable. He thought they were just passing through each other's lives, but little did he know that all the twists and turns they had experienced were for the sake of meeting each other: Li Yan, from  now on you protect the people, and I will protect you. She was like a ray of light…

Gu An An, the daughter of Gu's Group, encounters a family tragedy when her mother mysteriously falls off a cliff and into a coma. Her father, Ye Ting Feng, who is addicted to gambling, also attempts to seize all the Gu family's property. In order to protect the family property, Gu An An decides to marry Huo Si Wen, the eldest son of the Huo family. However, she meets Huo Si Ting, the second son of the Huo family, who is not valued. The two decide to form an alliance. In the process, a forbidden love quietly occurs in the mansion of the wealthy family...

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tui Hun Hou Wo Jia Gei Le Zha Nan Ta Shu" (退婚后我嫁给了渣男他叔) by Mao Tiao (猫条).

In the times of the great Yin Dynasty, lived a mysterious group of extraordinary individuals, born with supernatural abilities. One branch of the Helian clan, skilled in gold prospecting, became gold mine slaves. At the same time, the Shen family established the Divine Machine Battalion, attracting half of the extraordinary individuals to the land. The emperor, fearing the Shen family's power, forcibly took their family heiress as his empress, renaming her Ji Ming Yue.  But the temporary peace is crushed when a gold embezzlement case stirred up a storm in the court, drastically changing Ji Ming Yue's life.

dramas.nt: 大国担当之埃博拉前线
dramas.syn: Tells the story of Zheng Shu Peng, a virologist, and the Chinese medical team that involves their fight against the Ebola virus in 2014. They use their humanitarian spirit to fight the virus and finally successfully contain the spread of the virus to save a large number of lives.

It tells the story of a young and promising county lieutenant, Gu Qian Ling; a meticulous and truth-seeking coroner, Duan Chao; and a lively and playful magic master, Shang Yu. They met because of a case and were accidentally involved in a murder plot set up by the villain Cui Quan.

Gu Qian Ling and Duan Chao unraveled the mystery and solved the strange cases one after another. They gradually changed from disliking each other to supporting each other. In the face of difficulties and tests, the three-member team went from being incompatible to fighting side by side. The three continued to solve cases, punish the cruel villains, and catch the real culprits, protecting the peace of the world.

Doctor Lu Zao Zao unexpectedly transmigrates into  a Republican-era novel as Su Mu Wan after an accident at the hospital. Thrust into a dangerous household filled with conspiracies, she must survive attempts on her life and clear her family’s name. While navigating these dangers, she becomes entangled with Ling Shen Xing, and their relationship shifts from hostility to deep affection.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shao Shuai Mei Tian Du Zai Chi Cu" (少帅每天都在吃醋) by Ba Xun (八寻).

Being a wealthy heir is not always without hardships. Zhang Hao Tian (Ray Cheung) is the heir of a large corporation who faces conspiracies all around him from those who want to bring him down. Although his heart belongs to the sweet Chen Qiu Yan (Zhang Meng), Hao Tian is entrapped into marrying Song Zi Han (Dilraba Dilmurat) while Luo Shan (Hao Ze Jia) is helpless to stop it. Meanwhile, Hao Tian’s college friends, Lu Feng (Zhou Ting Wei) and Chu Yao Hui (Gao Vengo), each face their own challenges as they try to pursue their own happiness in life.

The third installment of the "Little" franchise continues to delve into the issues of education and parent-child relationships through the lenses of ordinary Chinese families. As the kids move up from elementary school to junior high, the family unit evolves in the journey.

Nan Li is anxious about her daughter Huanhuan's poor performance at school. Having realized the importance of tutoring, Nan Li gets the entire family on board to focus on Huan Huan's education yet in the face of many problems, they begin to understand the importance of providing a happy childhood for their daughter.

Nan Li's classmate and colleague Tian Yu Lan is pregnant with her second child. However, Tian Yu Lan and her husband Yan Peng's relationship has soured due to Yu Lan's distrust. Tian Yu Lan is fully devoted to her son, Yan Zi You. Yan Zi You is an exemplary student in the eyes of many parents, but the…
A young idol meets a renowned public relations officer and single mother at a wrap-up party. From then on, their lives begin to intersect.

It tells the story of Beijing’s richest daughter, Ye Xiaotang, who meets the cold-hearted Mu Jinyan and the "unfavored prince" Ling Ziran. 

~~ Adapted from the novel “Jin Zhu Da Ren Qing Zi Zhong” (金主大人请自重) by Tao Guan.
~~ Adapted from the novel "Wu Gen Gong Lue" (无根攻略) by Dian Qian Huan (殿前欢).
tags: Censored Adaptation Of Same-sex Original Work

dramas.syn: Set in China's financial capital Shanghai, the TV series features three different families and narrates the psyche of parents, who are compelled to accept separation from their children for the sake of better education abroad.

The peaceful city of Luzhou is shaken by a series of so-called justice-driven murders. To crack the case, authorities form the 909 Special Task Force, which works tirelessly to unravel the layers of the chilling exchange-killing revenge scheme.

A story about a bright and sunny public relations officer who meets a ski instructor and the complications that arise in relation to finding long-lost family and revenge.

Han Dong Shan is a new instructor at the resort. He is cold and hard to get close to, as he never makes any mention of his past. Yet he finds himself opening up to Zhao Xiao Qing, a public relationship officer catering to VIP clients who also work at the resort. Dong Shan discovers that she has a psychological problem that she refuses to admit. Xiao Qing also has another suitor, a tall, rich and handsome doctor who is the nephew of a large conglomerate.
dramas.t: Love and Revenge on the Slopes

dramas.syn:
It depicts the transformation of state-owned enterprises after China's economic reform. A Huafu subsidiary in Jingzhou faces a crisis due to changes in the market environment and problems within the enterprise. 

Founded in the 1930s, Huafu Company was the among the first batch of state-owned enterprises in China. As the company is about to usher in its 80th anniversary, its subsidiary, Jingzhou Huafu, falls into a huge predicament. Huafu Chairman Lin Manjiang sends Qi Ben'an to Jingzhou to resolve the issue. After Qi Ben'an assumes his new role, he realizes that he has many hurdles to overcome. 

On one hand, he has to unite the cadres and the masses that include individuals like Shi Hongxing to resolve the long-drawn conflicts between them. On the other hand, he must also win the support of the municipal party committee secretary and carefully maneuver the company's relationship with…

Mu Yun Qing and his wife Yu Ying Wan are killed while protecting the City Lord's Token. Yu Ying Wan awakens to find herself reborn, only to face her husband's intense aversion. Determined to uncover the true mastermind, she remains in the City Lord's mansion, skillfully countering every scheme. But she soon discovers that Mu Yun Qing has also been reborn. With the hidden antagonist lying in wait, can the two rewrite their destinies?

30-year old reporter Feng Nuan loses both her career and loved ones in one day, thus losing her direction in life. A sudden news report lets her meet Xu Chen, a university student majoring in communications. The two became partners in an assignment by the broadcasting station, and begin working together to tackle news about cyber bullying and speaking up for victims. As time goes by, their relationship gets better and Xu Chen awakens Feng Nuan's passion toward news reporting. In the midst of their assignment, Feng Nuan discovers the truth of the death of her loved one eight years ago. Unafraid of unethical businessmen and their threats, Feng Nuan and Xu Chen revealed the truth and brought the culprits to light.

Yue Ling Long had a crush on Li Xing Zhou since she was a child, but she didn't dare to get close to him because of her low self-esteem. When she grew up, she accidentally had a relationship with Li Xing Zhou, but she was afraid of being disliked, so she never dared to reveal her identity. Unexpectedly, their identities were assumed by others, causing a series of misunderstandings.

(Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = Google Translate

In order to repay a life-saving favor, Zhuang Qian Xi becomes engaged to Huo Zhi An for three years, quietly maintaining a well-known but nominal engagement. It is not until Zuo Xiao Luo, Huo Zhi An’s childhood friend, returns from abroad that Zhuang Qian Xi becomes completely disheartened. To avoid alarming their families, both sides continue to maintain a superficial relationship.

During this time, Zhuang Qian Xi meets Huo Yu Cheng, Huo Zhi An’s elder cousin and the chairman of the Huo Group. She gradually realizes that this restrained and gentle man may be the one who truly saved her. Whether the broken engagement will lead to a new destination remains uncertain.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Si Cang Huo Xin" (私藏霍心), also known as "Zhang Xin Kui Ai" (掌心窥爱), by Yi Tiao Da Yu Tou (一条大鱼头).

The actress Chu Jing Xi retires from the industry for love, only to be betrayed by her fiancé, Qi Si Qin. After exposing his disgraceful actions at their wedding, she leaves, and her career falls into a low point. Encouraged by her agent and close friend Yang Yang, Chu Jing Xi establishes a film and television company, receiving companionship and support from her devoted fan He Zheng. 

Business tycoon Fu Si Nian offers powerful assistance and openly expresses his affection, yet Chu Jing Xi gradually develops feelings while fighting side by side with He Zheng. As the project is about to launch, Qi Si Qin sets a trap to obstruct it and leaks Chu Jing Xi’s private photos, triggering public backlash. After a brief period of reflection, Chu Jing Xi chooses to face it bravely, responds publicly, and fights back, reclaiming her career and dignity and living a brilliant life.

Beneath the revelry of a grand feast, long-hidden undercurrents come to the surface, awakening those who have been pretending to sleep and triggering a survival crisis for various individuals at GST Winery. With everything at stake, every move must be made with extreme caution. Seven key figures, each deeply entangled in the unfolding events, play different roles, revealing the complexity of human nature and the harshness of reality. Through their stories, a common theme emerges: how to stay optimistic and survive in a world filled with uncertainty and fear.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Sales Fu Fu" (Sales夫妇) by You Er (右耳).

Year 2025, the era of Virtual Reality has started and gamers have become the new athletes and idols: becoming a gamer is now every teenagers' dream. In order to train the new generation of gamers, the "E-sport Academy" has been founded.

Nan Ke is a new student of the E-sport Academy, who doesn't really fit in. Around him, other outcasted but peculiar students gather, creating a new team that will challenge the best team in the school.

Ye Ke and her high school friend Ji Zhi Xia reunited after a long absence. She is working hard to become an excellent female motorcycle racer. Ji Zhixia is about to start a new life with her fiancé Zhong Yuan. Later, Xia ran away from home due to domestic violence, and was taken in by Ye Ke, Tang Xiao, Xiao Ran and Zhang Qiang. These young people live in harmony and love in the shared house. 

Ye Ke encountered a bottleneck in racing due to women's physical fitness, but with the encouragement of everyone and through extraordinary efforts, she overcame the difficulties. With the help of her housemates, Zhi Xia gradually changed from weak to independent and self-reliant. After all the twists and turns of career, family, and life, everyone in the shared house realized their dreams.

Shen Yu and Gu Xiao Wei both loved the talented Hua Wei Lin, but his sudden family troubles forced him to drop out of university and enter the workforce early.

Shen Yu married him despite her parents' opposition, enduring a hard life. Meanwhile, Gu Xiao Wei focused on her business success, secretly helping Shen Yu and Hua Wei Lin until they became financially stable.

Gu Xiao Wei's emotional struggles affected them both, but they eventually helped her open her heart and find happiness.
A thousand-year-old cat demon and a doctoral student team up to uncover the truth behind a past family massacre, traveling through time and facing hidden dangers along the way.

Xu Wei Xin, the former heir of the Xu family, was framed and disgraced. Seeking revenge and to reclaim everything, she meticulously manipulated Lu Yi, using him as a pawn. However, she unexpectedly discovered that the mastermind behind everything was someone else entirely, and the death of Lu Yi's beloved sister was also secretly connected to the power struggles within the Xu family. The two formed an alliance. 

She ruthlessly schemed to drive him forward, while he willingly served as her henchman, gradually developing feelings and loyalty in their daily interactions. Neither the one wielding the whip nor the pawn had genuine feelings, but as the mastermind relentlessly pressed forward, misunderstandings and conflicts of interest arose. Would this bond, forged in scheming, ultimately crumble, or would it allow them to escape their predicament and join forces to fight back?

They say that people who in their seventies would have told 90,000 lies throughout their lifetime. Dai Meng, Liao Duo Duo, and Hua Sheng are three individuals who use lies as a means to seek out the truth.
Expert lie detector Dai Meng resigns from his job due to a mistake at work. He opens up a firm that specializes in solving all kinds of problems from emotional disputes, debts to work-related issues. As long as it does not violate the law, he will accept any job.
Dai Meng relies on his expertise in analyzing the telltale signs of a lie to help him in his work. With business booming, he crosses paths with Liao Duo Duo, a fellow analyst, and they immediately have a go to see who's better. Dai Meng wins the round but gets stuck with her company.
Dai Meng, Liao Duo Duo, and their assistant Hua Sheng form a three-person team. As requests come in, they help their clients expose lies to make…

Tong Zi Fu, a animal hand-illustrator, accidentally entered her comic work and met Wen Jing Zhan, the first painter in Beijing. Wen Jing Zhan, who only wanted to join the army, mistakenly thought that Tong Zi Fu was a spy sent by his father, and in the process of getting along, the two resolved misunderstandings, and soon starts to trust each other, and solves each others problems.

Jiang Yun Yi, the eldest daughter of the Jiang family, was sent to the countryside as a child. At five, she saved the injured Ye Mo Han, and they agreed to marry. Twenty years later, she agrees to marry into the Fu family to search for medical scriptures and Ye Mo Han. Fu Jing Shen, actually Ye Mo Han, had to assume a new identity after being persecuted by his second uncle. After marrying Jiang Yun Yi, both unknowingly live as enemies, each longing for their childhood savior, who turns out to be the other.

dramas.nt: 嫁给残疾大佬后被宠上天
dramas.syn: Sang Nian decided to marry her boyfriend to inherit the family business. She was unexpectedly diagnosed with stomach cancer on the wedding day and was abandoned by her boyfriend on the spot. She flash married her blind disabled husband to anger the scumbag. But after marriage, she found out that her husband was not blind, and was the president of Chengfeng Group, and the richest man in the city. Sang Nian and Gu Pei Ze teamed up to get back at their exes, and took back the family property.
dramas.t: Jia Gei Can Ji Da Lao Hou Bei Chong Shang Tian

dramas.syn:
A criminal defense lawyer—whose biological father is a kidnapper and stepfather a police detective—crosses paths with a senior judge who lost his wife and child to an act of revenge years ago, and a charismatic, enigmatic legal elite who exploits human nature while navigating the grey areas of the law. These three lonely strangers engage in a high-stakes battle of wits amidst a complex criminal defense case; yet, as they clash, they find a growing mutual understanding—becoming rivals who are nonetheless like family.

In a game where the mantis stalks the cicada while the oriole lurks behind, they are simultaneously hunter and prey. Who will ultimately emerge as the oriole? And who is the cicada—lying dormant for twelve years, waiting to sing for freedom and claim a resounding summer?

It tells the tragic love story of Ling Yuan, the Third Prince of the Dongling Kingdom, and Luo Yi, a woman from the Witch Doctor Clan. Ling Yuan accidentally saves Luo Yi, and the two fall in love. However, Luo Yi is actually a pawn of the Second Prince, Ling Xiao, who intends to sow discord between Ling Yuan and the Emperor of Dongling. During the mission, Luo Yi genuinely falls in love with Ling Yuan, but her loyalty forces her to hurt him. Ling Yuan gradually becomes cruel in his quest for power, and Luo Yi is imprisoned. 

Three years later, Luo Yi escaped from captivity, only to find that Ling Yuan had lost his memory and had become a cruel ruler. Through a series of events, Ling Yuan's memory was restored, but it was too late; his actions had permanently damaged Luo Yi. Tragedy was inevitable for both of them.

Brigade Commander Xu Ling Jun is assigned to lead a military transformation pilot program. Despite challenges, he trusts Battalion Commander Guo Zi Jian, who proves himself after a past training accident. In a crucial exercise against an undefeated opponent, they use their innovative tactics to turn the tide.

Bai Jing's life was quite ordinary until she met Liu Long Ting, a snake in human form. After meeting him, she becomes pregnant, and dark entities begin to hunt for her. Things get even more confusing when a man who looks like two peas in a pod appears to Liu Long Ting.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Liu Long Ting Zhuan" (柳龙庭传) by Bai Jing Yao (白靖瑶).

This is the story of the demon catcher Xiao Tian, the cat demon Xiao Qi, and the ghost Jin Cheng who are fighting for justice in the world. In order to help Xiao Qi become immortal, Xiao Tian, Jin Cheng and Xiao Qi open a grocery store selling spells to help people realize their wishes by teaching spells. During this period, they encountered all kinds of people and all kinds of troubles in the world.

More than 900 years ago, the mermaid princess Ao Fan Fan was rescued by the scholar Huo Yun Shen, and so she was determined to commit herself to him when he reaches 25 years old. The strange thing is that Huo Yun Shen has lived in every life and died mysteriously before the age of 25 every time. In this life, Ao Fan Fan went ashore earlier to find Huo Yun Shen.

At her 7th wedding anniversary party, Guan Xin, the heir of a well-known clothing group, finds out that her husband Shen Zhuo has been cheating on her with her best friend Xu Jing. While confronting her husband, she falls off a cliff and returns pretending to have amnesia. Meanwhile, Xu Jing has been hoping that Shen Zhuo will divorce his wife. However, he is determined to take all the property for himself.

Duan Ruo Nan and Fan Xiao Wei are two friends who have no secrets from each other. Thanks to this, Xiao Wei confides that she was betrayed by her boyfriend and has nowhere to go.  Out of the kindness, Ruo Nan decides to help her and allows her to live with her and her boyfriend, Li Xiao, until she can stand on her own feet. 

But little did she know, soon after Xiao Wei moves into her house, she begins an affair with Li Xiao.

Wen Mian lost her mother when she was young. In order to fight for the huge family fortune, her stepmother raised Wen Mian to be weak and sickly. An accident happened and Wen Jing Xing re-entered Wen Mian's life, constantly stimulating Wen Mian to learn to be brave and independent.

After suffering a devastating setback in life, Xie Nan Feng unexpectedly returns to her youth in 1991. Faced with the opponents who once seized her achievements and ruined her life, she resolutely embarks on an entrepreneurial journey, relying on her foresight and unyielding determination. Amid the tide of China's reform and opening-up, she ventures into the business world and ultimately achieves personal rebirth while progressing alongside the era.

The story follows Ji Tang Tang, as she solves mysteries for the dead using her special ability and various equipment to connect to their realm. She was once a cheerful girl embraced in the arms of her parents, but those most beloved to her vanished (aka killed) after one night. She wanders from here to there, afraid of making friends, afraid of contacting relatives. Having spent four years surviving the cruel world, she has become an independent and resilient person, unafraid of killing.  The upright "man of all men" Yue Feng accompanies her throughout her journey.

~~ Adapted from the novel "The Voice of Death" (怨气撞铃) by Wei Yu (尾鱼).

The story tells the story of the twentieth century, the early days of the people, natural disasters, chaos and chaos continued, the people miserable, more ulterior motives to take the opportunity to chaos for evil. The body of the hidden dragon spirit of the small Lang Yang Yi because of the plague incident involved in the Shanghai forces wave cloud treacherous battle, and thus met the Mayor of Shanghai Mayor Mo Xiaoyu, and with love. Behind the scenes, but also the identity of Yang Yi Shi Shou as the same, because of its crazy pursuit of "longevity" delusion, at the artificial spread of the plague, to man-made medicinal herbs refining profits, and then more assassinated politicians, Fang warlord contradictions induced war, the ultimate goal is to achieve the manufacture of "six scourge", the blood sacrifices in exchange for personal survival of the evil target.

Jian Mo, a well-known modern acupuncture doctor, had an electric leakage accident in the hospital, and because of that, she accidentally transmigrated to the body of Yue Wu Yan, who is in love with the country. When she woke up, she found that she had been stabbed in the abdomen and fell in the wild. But she completely doesn't know how her new body ended up like that.

Through the journey to find the truth and on the way back to his own times, she meets Feng Qing Cheng, who disguises himself as a gay to seek power in the court. But soon, both of them will be connected not only by a journey to achieve their goals but also by a sincere feeling.

When Shen Qing Mei's brother's accidentally disappeared, she disguised herself as a man and became a magistrate in his stead. Unbeknownst to her, this led to a murder.

The first assassin in the jungle, "Bloodless", is ordered to assassinate Shen Qing Mei, but he is not good at it. After losing his memory, he is taken as Xie Lin Zhou, a scholar who stays by Shen Qing Mei's side and becomes a master. Shen Qing Mei does not know Xie Lin Zhou's identity as an assassin but only wants to help him recover his memory. So a love story between a killer and a target, a master and a magistrate, unfolds.

During a mahjong game, a down-and-out novelist narrates the story of a young woman who was murdered.  It turns out to be a true story about the suicide of a news anchor. With the endless tit-for-tat and accusations hurled, the players' secrets gradually surface.

Shen Ming Zhu lives in the old town of Nanxi, where her adoptive parents run a small restaurant, and her boyfriend, Feng Jian Qi, lives in the affluent new town. The two are in love and get married, but they are opposed by the Feng family because they are not in the right family. Jian Qi died unexpectedly, and the Feng family begged Ming Zhu to give birth to a child.

Ming Zhu's biological parents came to find her, and she met her biological sister Xu Zhi Xia, her brother Xu Zhi Dong, and her sister-in-law Bi Chen and gained the love of her biological parents and adoptive parents. The father-in-law, who supported the Feng family, died suddenly of a heart attack, and the company became insolvent. Ming Zhu's life hit rock bottom again. Everyone advised Ming Zhu to abort the child, but she became firm.

Xu Zhi Xia is troubled by her unmotivated husband and upcoming second child; Bi Chen…

dramas.nt: 少夫人的乌鸦嘴又显灵了
dramas.syn:
Lin Qiao, the female leader of an international assassin organization, is just about to retire and enjoy a life of financial freedom when she transmigrates into a melodramatic novel, becoming the cannon-fodder, love-struck wife of tycoon CEO Li Ting Zhou. 

Lin Qiao originally plans to divorce as soon as possible, follow the plot to the end, and return to reality, but unexpectedly, Li Ting Zhou can hear her inner thoughts, causing her divorce plan to fall through. Left with no choice, she plays the role of the original spoiled rich-girl persona on the surface, while secretly using her “jinx” ability to outwit Li Ting Zhou, only to end up completely captivating him.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Pian Zhi Lao Gong You Du Xin Shu Hou, Zong Bao Wo Ma Jia" (偏执老公有读心术后，总爆我马甲), also known as "Shao Fu Ren De Wu Ya Zui You Xiang Ling Le" (少夫人的乌鸦嘴又显灵了), by Fang Fei De Yan Xi (放飞的颜晞).
dramas.t: Shao Fu Ren De Wu Ya Zui You Xiang Ling Le

dramas.syn: Dumped for money by her childhood sweetheart, Gu Zheng, the Gu family's adopted daughter Lin Hua takes her best friend Xie Bao Er's advice and enters a contract marriage with Bao Er's adoptive father, Xie Zhou Han. As he quietly protects her, she learns that her late mother once cared for him in his youth and that he has secretly loved her for years. Letting go of her past, she opens her heart, and together they tear up their contract to choose a lifetime of love.
Inflexible woman architect Lin Xiao Xiao was persistent in her life principle but made her stumble along in both her career and marriage.
~~ Aired on Tik Tok.

Chu Mian was exiled to Fengdao and vowed to take revenge on the Chu family who persecuted her. Therefore, when Li Tian Que, the chaebol of country A, took her home, she chose to pretend to be crazy and lurk. Li Tian Que also indulged the girl because of his lack of childhood. The story gradually unfolds in the two people's mutual redemption and revenge plan.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Zong Cai Zhen Bu Zhu Shao Nai Nai Le" (总裁镇不住少奶奶了) by Jui Ling (九棂).

Doctor Dai Huan is on vacation in Australia. Their wife, Doctor Tao Lu,  son, and father-in-law are in tow. On the first night, he finds a mysterious box at the door of his hotel room containing a loaded gun, a picture of a stranger, and instructions to kill the pictured person. He discovers he has been forced by a mysterious organization known as The Watchers to become a player in a dark and twisted murdering game. He must participate and complete his task in the given time to save the lives of his family.

~~ Remake of the American TV series "Chosen" [2013].

Cheng Nian Yi followed Li Si Ze to visit Li Si Ze's hometown of Yin and Yang Town. The two encountered ghosts and heresies in Yin and Yang Town, and behind each bizarre incident was actually the elusive and treacherous human heart. When the truth was revealed layer by layer, Cheng Nian Yi and Li Si Ze discovered that Yin Yang Town shrouded in rumours and heresies of ghosts and gods, hid a greater secret.

Located in the busiest part of the Eastern Market, Ruyi Inn is a serene retreat that has earned a sacred reputation among the people. Despite its tranquil atmosphere, the inn is protected by three individuals with unique skills: Madame Hong, the shopkeeper; Ren Fansheng, the accountant; and Wu Ren Ai, the cook. 

According to this legend, Madam Hong's extraordinary ability to summon the "Flower of Lust" on her forehead and inhale its essence is said to grant her deepest desires. However, the inn's peaceful existence was disrupted by the arrival of A Lan, a skilled assassin from Xianyue Pavilion who has the Purest White Flower within her.

In the winter of 1937, the Japanese Kwantung Army launched the "Three Rivers Crusade" against the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army according to their three-year "rectification" plan, and the struggle of the Anti-Japanese United Army entered the most difficult period.

In the autumn of 1938, the fierce battle caused a small team of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army to suffer heavy losses. Before breaking out, the platoon leader "Old Shandong" agreed with the soldiers that the survivors would go to the eight pines outside Songlin Town, Mudanjiang, carve their numbers on the trees, and regroup and return to the team.

From then on, "Old Shandong" and five other anti-Japanese fighters embarked on a life-and-death journey back to the team. Some people were separated, some died, some betrayed, and some joined the 88th International Brigade to start new training and fighting.

In…

After being transported into a game world and bound to an NPC by a master-servant contract, Yi Nian must fight monsters, level up, and navigate an unexpected romance along the way. 

~~ Adapted from the mobile game (一念逍遥).

Jingnan University medical student Xin Zhi Yao escapes her wedding night and unexpectedly encounters the abstinent professor Zhou Ji. After becoming pregnant, they enter into a contract marriage. She's fiery, he's gentle. From teacher and student to husband and wife, from responsibility to deep love, this unexpected fate ultimately becomes their passionate spring and warmest summer!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Jiao Qi Yan Yi Hong, Jin Yu Jiao Shou Lan Yao Hong" (小娇妻眼一红，禁欲教授揽腰哄) by Lan Qi Ming (懒起名).
dramas.t: Ta Yi Fen Chun Wen Zhang Xia

dramas.syn: Su Jin He was reborn and transported back to the world before her death, only to find herself in a sadistic drama. She is a character played by fate, arranged by the screenwriter to suffer various misfortunes and pains. But this time, she is determined to fight against this fate and rewrite her own destiny. She decided to find a screenwriter and control her own destiny. She found Fu Yan Chen, the boy she loved before her death and also the male lead in the drama. They start a fairy tale like love story.

Tao Yao, a goddess charged with protecting the sacred fruit of Guoshen Mountain, is cast down to the mortal realm after losing her divine powers to the mischievous Chang Feng. Reborn as Wang Xiao Die, she endures family betrayal and hardship, only to uncover that the spirit responsible for her downfall now resides within her husband, Fu An.

After his girlfriend drowned unexpectedly in a room without water, Shi Jian set up a company called "Universal Brother", specializing in mysterious events, in order to find out the truth behind her death. He accidentally picked up a magical key that can go anywhere. There are many other objects like this, such as a cream that can change shape, fingers to manipulate objects, pendants to control water, etc. Shi Jian realizes that his girlfriend's death is related to these fantastic objects. As the incident deepens, the true origin of the objects and the conspiracy behind them surfaces...

It tells the story of the female protagonist Zhong Qing, who, in order to stand out in the "workplace survival battle", spares no effort or cost to "only talk about money". But one day, there was a sudden incident, and Zhong Qing's position as director disappeared instantly, only adding a special skill that could see everyone's balance. The new director, Bu Yi, saw the new official take office, and this pair of happy enemies went from their strained relationship to the sparks of love sparked by friction and finally felt the true meaning of life.

Her mother, who is worth hundreds of billions of dollars, is going to remarry her assistant. In order to avoid having her property divided, Chu Xi, a Hong Kong celebrity, panicked and immediately hired a poor college student with eight-pack abs to seduce her mother and destroy the relationship between her mother and her assistant. 

However, he succeeded in less than a month and "killed" her mother. As a guardian, he took over all of her mother's property. At first, she thought he was a top scumbag who relied on women to get to the top and was a ruthless person. However, he was rich enough to rival a country, saved her from danger many times, taught her to grow up, and told her to love.

In the early Republic of China, street performer Shu Yan is kidnapped and wakes up as the wife of a wealthy chamber of commerce president, Yan Qi Zhao. Surrounded by luxury and affection, she begins to question the truth behind her new identity.

The series revolves around the story between "cheerful girl" Mi Yang and "cold-hearted" Ke Yihan. The relationship between the two has been ups and downs for various reasons since they met in high school. Fortunately, they both grew up in the process of chasing each other and gaining happiness. 

~~ Adapted from the novel "Secretly Like You" (悄悄喜欢你, 春风化成雨) by Mai Jiu.

Police academy professor Xu Jing Zhi returns to investigate a strange case, where he teams up with his late brother’s friend, Zhuang Ming Cheng. Together, they work to take down a criminal gang and solve an old case.

dramas.nt: 虐爱成宠：陆总的新婚哑妻
dramas.syn:
Everyone in the circle knew that Lu Jing Chi had a beloved wife, a canary, for whom he spent money like water, for whom he would go to great lengths to win the crown and risk his life. But everyone in the circle also knew that his wife was a little mute with no sense of existence, a dodder that could only survive by relying on him. Even he thought so, until one day, this little mute handed him a divorce agreement. He was no longer calm.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Nve Ai Cheng Chong: Lu Zong De Xin Hun Ya Qi" (虐爱成宠：陆总的新婚哑妻) by Yi Ding Cheng Gong (一定成功).
dramas.t: Nve Ai Cheng Chong: Lu Zong De Xin Hun Ya Qi

dramas.syn:
The drama revolves around two police academy students with vastly different identities and four lost youths.

Su Ming and Gu Jun are classmates in the police academy. After graduation, the two begin a different path of life and love. However, one day, Su Ming was suddenly terminated from his job and disappeared. Gu Jun initially thought their difference is only due to the disparity in their social class. However, after investigation, Gu Jun discovers Su Ming's secret.

~~ Adapted from the novel “Sky Blue” (天蓝蓝).

A story that follows undercover cop Gan Tian Lei who spent 10 years of his life walking a gray area. After waking up from a serious injury, he restarts his life and tries to solve a case by relying on his lost memories.

Gan Tian Lei, Yang Xiao Lei and Xiong Guo Liang used to be the solid trio of the police academy. However, Gan Tian Lei was dismissed after he wounded someone in order to help Yang Xiao Lei. After leaving the academy, he moves south to make a living and was recruited by Che Li Zi of the Caesar Group.

Gan Tian Lei encounters undercover police Uncle Hai and due to his influence, Gan Tian Lei begins working as an informant for Tai Yong Feng. He eventually receives a special appointment to become a policeman in order to bring down Caesar Group. Before they could succeed, Gan Tian Lei gets caught in an explosion and falls into a coma. Eight years later, Gan Tian Lei awakes…

Gu Nian was a full-time housewife leading a happy life until her husband becomes involved in a criminal case and gets exposed for infidelity.

Gu Nian's husband, Song Jia Chen, is a successful lawyer and their family of three lived happily. However, everything changes when Song Jia Chen was not only embroiled in a crime but also caught cheating on her. Gu Nian finds work at a law firm through Feng Sheng's referral and attempts to start over. 

Through her stellar performance, Gu Nian gains the recognition of Ling Yi, a partner at the law firm, and works to help Song Jia Chen clear his name. The workplace has made Gu Nian more independent and strong to not only usher in a peak in her career but also move forward bravely and fearlessly to safeguard the fairness of the law.

The modern screenwriter Zhuang Momo traveled to the script "Yasha Bride" and was forced to participate in a secret marriage after becoming the ugly bride of the Long family. Unwilling to accept the arrangement of fate, she used the "immortal spirit of...

Fang Xin Yan was saved by the domineering boss. She made a deal with Jiang Ji Chun and lurked around his nephew to obtain information for him in exchange for clues about her family's murder. During this period, she was moved by the Jiang Ming Langs's gentleness and got involved in the fight between uncle and nephew, and the boss was already in love. As the clues slowly surfaced, it turned out that the real murderer had been hiding around her for a long time.

A revenge born of a political marriage reunites the Grand Princess with her former lover at court. Love and rivalry entwine, yet in the end, they discover that only each other can save them. Hand in hand, they play the empire like a chessboard, crafting an age of splendor together.

Zhang Xiao Bei, a young man in a desperate situation, possesses the key to destiny and swaps lives with Sheng Yuan Zhou, an heir to a wealthy, elite family! Facing a 30-day period filled with tests of humanity, the two teenagers find redemption and healing in each other. Together, they rise to riches, protect their families, and unravel a conspiracy to avenge themselves against the mastermind!

This is an inspirational story about a girl from the Spirit Race who was deceived into obtaining the sacred object, the Wanling Orb, which aroused the grievances between the human world and the spirit world, and thus came to the human world to meet and fall in love with Ye Zhou, breaking the racial barrier.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "The King of Hell Is Unhappy" (阎王不高兴) by Shi Tu Zi (使徒子).

dramas.nt: 拜托了! 姐姐 第二季
dramas.syn: After being abandoned by her boyfriend, best friend, and father, Sun Wei Yi determines to build a startup. Just as her cosmetics business thrives, her former best friend, Bai Ling Fei, the cause of her past failure, shows up and is discovered to be the sister of her suitor, Bai Ze Liu. Will Sun Wei Yi be able to turn the table this time?
dramas.t: A Taste of First Love Season 2

dramas.syn: Hao Meng's family falls apart due to her piano teacher, Xiao Shan. Twenty years later, Hao Meng resurfaces as Fu Chou, a maid at the Gu Manor, where Xiao Shan currently resides as the mistress. With determined resolve, she sets in motion a calculated plan to disrupt Xiao Shan's life through the unsuspecting figures of her husband, Gu Linfeng, and son, Gu Xun.

The story presents a new generation of young people who have grown up in Macau, living in the old city and struggling with new landmarks. It tells a heartwarming story about the cold-looking foreign chef Wang Ting Zhi and his daughter Wang Qian Qian and the local Macau hot pepper Huang Yi Lin and her grandmother Zhang Bao Qin. They became attached to each other because of "house", and their relationship became warmer because of "food".

Jiang Chu Yue, a noble lady from a prestigious family, secretly harbors feelings for her “elder brother.” Xie Lin Yuan, the powerful and calculating Prince Regent, has long coveted her since their fateful meeting in youth. From rivalry to desire, their bond becomes a dangerous game of possession and passion.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bi Wo Jia She Zheng Wang, Wo You Yun Ni Ku Shen Me" (逼我嫁摄政王，我有孕你哭什么), also known as "An Lian Shi Nian Bei Bi Jia, She Zheng Wang Lan Ru Huai" (暗恋十年被逼嫁，摄政王揽入怀), by Si Wan Yue (四弯月).
dramas.t: Shan You Mu Xi Mu You Zhi

dramas.syn:
"After dying for me through 99 lifetimes, in the 100th, it's my turn to save you!"The ancient shaman Xu Yan Qiu is reborn as a Republican-era heiress and is unexpectedly rescued by Bai Jin Xiao, the young deputy leader of the Xuanwu Alliance, thus breaking the cycle of fated death.

As foreign forces from the East close in and hidden tensions surge within her family, the two lovers bound by a century-long destiny fight side by side. This time, can they break free from the shackles of reincarnation and finally be together?

In the 1980s, Ma Jin grew up in Beijing with three friends who were like brothers. After an accident before high school graduation, they drifted apart, and Ma Jin left for abroad, disappearing for years. Now a vice president of a company, Ma Jin is diagnosed with a brain tumor. Facing death alone, he longs to mend old feuds and rebuild friendships. The four middle-aged friends reunite to start a business, rekindling both old bonds and Ma Jin’s hope for life.

Set in the city of Beiping during the 22 days before the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949 is a story about the drastic changes in the lives of three brothers Jin Hai, Tie Lin, and Xu Tian as well as a romance between Xu Tian and Tian Dan.
In investigating the murder that claimed the life of his fiancee, policeman Xu Tian starts on a trail that will eventually lead to his involvement in the liberation of Beiping. Jin Hai, Tie Lin, and Xu Tian are three friends who are as close as brothers. In the face of historic changes and conflicting beliefs, they make choices that take them on diverging paths. Xu Tian and communist member Tian Dan meet during their lowest moments and find a common goal that brings them together.

Three years after a female reporter exposed a drug fraud that left the responsible couple dead and their daughter in a coma, a family friend and pharmaceutical tycoon seeks brutal revenge on the reporter. But as he gets close to her, hidden truths begin to surface.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Yu Da Lao Ta Lun Xian Len" (禁欲大佬他沦陷了) by Gu Xiao Yi (顾小易).

Twelve years ago, several homicides caused a sensation in the city. The victims were all from the bottom of society, and their bodies were found in deserted and remote places.It is speculated that the murderer may be the same person, but because of his extremely cunning, the case is very difficult for the time being. Through unremitting investigations and evidence collection, the criminal police gradually identified the main suspect. On the way to a meeting with his daughter Ling Ran, the criminal policeman Ling Bin hunted down the suspect and died in the line of duty.

Twelve years later, Ling Bin's daughter Ling Ran (played by Yu Nan) worked in the Polygraph Center of the Technical Division of the Criminal Police Detachment. She used polygraph technology to successfully solve several major cases and became famous. Chen Hu, head of Interpol Detachment Crime Unit (Xing Jiadong…

The host of the game system, U Ya Ye Zi, has gone through countless failed scripts and defeats. Mainly, in every game level, there would always be an angelic bitch who steals her boyfriends. This time, there was no surprise. But what she didn't know was that by her side, a marginal supporting character Du Qin had been caring her from the beginning to the end. Du Qin gradually upgraded from an unimportant NPC to another host of the system. And at a critical moment he saved U Ya Ye Zi. She finally understood that her life should not be designed to go. This time, she has to control her own destiny and save her lover.

Top singer Tong Xin’s life unravels after a friend’s betrayal sparks scandal and trauma. Reuniting with her first love, Jiang Yin Chuan, now a gifted doctor, she uncovers hidden schemes, mends old wounds, and finds both her voice and true love again.

In a world where immortals and demons co-exist, lives a cherry blossom spirit named Tao Hua who lives in Peach Blossoms Mountain. In a battle against her enemies, she was defeated and turned back to her original self. She was picked up by a man named Chang Liu and tenderly taken care of. As time goes by, Tao Hua develops feelings for Chang Liu. But Chang Liu seems to have a hidden secret and an unknown past behind him.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ge Bi You Zhi Tao Hua Yao" (隔壁有只桃花妖) by Ping An (娉安).

Li Su flash-married her former fiancé’s younger brother.

In the third month of searching for her missing fiancé, Li Su finally received the good news that he had been found and was coming home — only to discover that he had lost his memory… and had even become someone else’s husband! Heartbroken, Li Su went to a bar that night to drown her sorrows, where she ran into her ex-brother-in-law’s younger brother, Huo Xuan Ye.

“Jie, weren’t you attracted to his face? I’m his younger brother. Marry me — I’ll be his substitute!”

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wei Hun Fu Shi Yi Ling Qu Ta Ren, Wo Shan Hun Ta Di" (未婚夫失忆另娶他人，我闪婚他弟) by Jin Yu Zi (今与紫).

The story of the aloof president Chi Qi who can hear the voices of others and closes his heart, and the screenwriter Nan Yu, who is lively on the outside but inferior and sensitive on the inside. After being forced to live together because of an accident, the two fall in love.

In the matriarchal kingdom of Liulian, facing both internal and external challenges, the royal counselor proclaimed, "The world will perish if six daughters are born."

Coincidentally, General Gu gave birth to six daughters. In order to save the youngest daughter, the Gu family falsely claimed to have a son. Their daughter, Gu Rong, of marriageable age, disguised herself as a man and married "good friend" Princess Yun together with her childhood friend, Shen Meng Chui.

From then on, this formidable trio joined forces and embarked on a struggle for the throne.
A story about five youths  Xu Weibiao, Lin Zhihua, Zhang Peng, Wang Lei and Yu Nan who grew up in Beijing in the 1980s, and later separate due to differing beliefs.

In 2015, as the internet economy surged and the capital market faced turmoil, Xie Lin Hui, a financial magazine editor, published a bold report that caused upheaval in the investment sector and impacted investment manager Jiang Yi Di's career. Both are soon caught in a larger storm as the market fluctuates, highlighting the career struggles of middle-aged women and young professionals.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Cheng Se Guang Mang " (橙色光芒) by Gao Da Guo (高大果).

Ye Yu Nuo, a member of the Ye Group's "golden money," nearly died on her wedding day when a stranger she'd never met appeared, filled with hatred and intent on wiping out her entire family. But amidst the flashes of fire and the roar of explosions, time suddenly stood still.
