A little girl named Leng Nan Nan appeared, claiming to be Ye Yu Nuo's future daughter, and that the madman Leng Wu Xin, who had intended to blow everyone up, was her father. 

Leng Nan Nan turned back time, transporting Ye Yun Nuo back to the morning of her wedding. As she cycled through time, Ye Yu Nuo gradually discovered the true faces of those around her and realized there was a vast conspiracy behind her life.

Heartbroken after catching her boyfriend cheating, Song Yan Zhi drunkenly spends the night with the cold and distant CEO Jiang Yan Cheng. When circumstances prevent him from marrying his fiancée, she steps in to impersonate the bride.

At the beginning of the Anti-Japanese War, the cook Meng Wan Fu only wanted to live but was arrested by the national army and forced to fight. General Zhang Yun Kui was loyal to the country, but the whole army was destroyed by his boss's wrong order. At the last moment, Zhang Yun Kui saved Meng Wan Fu and asked him to send a letter to his father. Wan Fu went to Nanjing to deliver letters and also went to Shanghai with Zhang's family to survive. He survived as "General Zhang Yun Kui" by mistake. 

He gradually grew from a small citizen to a hero with feelings, heart and responsibility, and he contributed to the Anti-Japanese War in his own way. Zhang Yun Kui survived but was falsely accused of being a running away general. He complained unjustly. In the end, it was empty. He simply fought a guerrilla by himself. Finally, because he came into contact with the Communist Party and realized…

A man walking the thin line between good and evil is an ingenious criminal. Yet he abides by the law and serves time in prison. One day before release, his ex-girlfriend who also happens to be his biggest rival runs into serious trouble, leaving him no choice but to escape in order to save her.

The story originates in the Golden Triangle where drug trade is proliferate. Xia Tian gambles with his life against a notorious drug lord and wins big. News of Xia Tian's misdeeds reach Zhang Li who works for the Interpol. As it turns out, she is Xia Tian's ex-girlfriend and the apple of his eye. Despite being cop and bandit, the two were lovers who relished engaging in a game of cat and mouse.

Zhang Li and her superior Peter arrive at the Golden Triangle. The drug lord gets killed in the fray and Xia Tian gets arrested as the murderer. He is sent to prison in Myanmar to serve time but breaks…

Li Ya Er steps in to receive his father’s bride, but the wedding night turns horrific when the bride mysteriously burns to death, and assassins leave him injured, amnesiac, and sold into slavery. As a buried conspiracy exposes his true identity, he becomes entangled in a turbulent master-servant romance that puts them on opposing sides. Together, they unravel the plot threatening the Tang dynasty and fight to protect both the realm and the fragile bond between them.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Chang An Gui Shi Chuan" (长安诡事传).
~~ Adapted from the novel "Hua Xu Yin"  (华胥引) by Tang Qi Gong Zi (唐七公子).

Young noble Chu Yun Xiao crosses paths with female doctor Leng Xing Chen because of a beauty portrait. Together with their friends, the six people who are pulled into a terrifying conspiracy form a detective team to uncover the secrets surrounding the portrait.

Chu Yunxiao has ventured into the pugilistic world for the first time. Aspiring to be a chivalrous hero, he relies on his outstanding martial arts skills and high intelligence to solve a difficult case. However, he unexpectedly discovers that he is also a chess piece in this dangerous game. As the fog is slowly lifted, Chu Yun Xiao becomes aware of an unbearable truth that the past twenty years of his life was nothing but a lie.
dramas.t: Unsolved Cases of Kung Fu: Portrait of Beauty

dramas.syn: It tells the story of twin brothers Guan Hong Feng and Guan Hong Yu, who were implicated in a family massacre, fighting against a criminal organization hidden in the dark, uniting forces from all sides to track down the truth of the 213 family massacre, and ultimately light defeating darkness.

Qin Ru Yan's life was turned upside down overnight due to the unexpected death of her parents. She had to go abroad. When she returned home many years later, her best friend's brother, Lu Jing Chen, suddenly appeared and stayed by her side, never leaving her side. His scorching gaze almost melted her.

In the Kunlun martial arts sect, a low-ranking disciple, Peng Da Sheng, seeks to uncover the truth behind his father’s death. Teaming up with talented allies, he works to rise through the ranks, expose dark conspiracies, and transform the sect.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Zai Jiang Hu" (我在江湖) by Ma Bo Yong (马伯庸).

dramas.nt: 我养的小白脸是京圈太子爷
dramas.syn:
Jiang Ci You had just married Yan Feng, but he eloped abroad with her best friend Xia Ling. Having been betrayed twice, Jiang Ci You kept a pretty boy named Bo Jin Xiu. She didn't know that this pretty boy was the famous prince of Beijing.

Bo Jin Xiu was willing to be her canary for the past two years. Jiang Ci You's husband came back and wanted to break up with her. Bo Jin Xiu decisively restored his identity and took steps to marry her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wan Dan! Wo Yang De Xiao Bai Lian Shi Jing Quan Tai Zi Ye" (完蛋！我养的小白脸是京圈太子爷) by La Bi Xiao Nian (蜡笔小年).
dramas.t: Wo Yang De Xiao Bai Lian Shi Jing Quan Tai Zi Ye

dramas.syn:
Fueled by a strong desire to run away from her family, an ordinary girl goes to great lengths to fake being an heiress in order to marry into a wealthy family.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wei Ming Yuan Hun Quan Fa Ze" (伪名媛混圈法则) by Ni Zhe Bang Dong Ren (你这般动人).
dramas.t: Wei Ming Yuan Hun Quan Shou Ce

dramas.nt: 大小姐不好惹，京都竹马为她保驾护航
dramas.syn:
Only at the moment of her death did Su Nian Sheng realise her marriage was a scam. Reborn back on campus, she returns to being the richest woman and reunites with her childhood sweetheart, the prince. However, her boyfriend, breaks down and comes to her with red eyes.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Cao Chu Gui, Wo Shan Hun Tai Zi Ye, Ta Feng Le" (校草出轨，我闪婚太子爷，他疯了) by Xiao Mao Giu (小毛球).
dramas.t: The Young Lady Is Not to Be Trifled with and the Kyoto Bamboo Horse Is to Protect Her

dramas.syn:
Lin Miao Miao runs for love, ends her long-distance relationship with Qian San Yi, and plans to live in Shenzhen. Taking root in Shenzhen, Jiang Tian Hao’s coffee business and Deng Xiao Qi’s career also went to Shenzhen to work hard. 

The survival and challenges in Shenzhou made them truly feel the tolerance of big cities and the harsh beatings of reality. Leaving Jiangzhou and the protection of their parents, various problems made Lin Miao Miao and others feel that Shenzhou is a gorgeous stage and a bigger place than the Colosseum.
Continues to tell the story of the legends Su Da Ji and Jiang Zi Ya who lived in the Shang period.
dramas.t: The Investiture of the Gods Season 2

dramas.syn: Bai Zai Zai, a Rabbit fairy, to get revenge for her master, accidentally broke into the palace and became the bodyguard of Liu Chang Ge, the second prince. The two of them were in the process of getting along, from knowing each other to slowly falling in love. Liu Chang Ge helped Bai Zai Zai complete the revenge for her master, and Bai Zai Zai also helped Liu Chang Ge defeat the national master Shen Yi and other princes in the dangerous palace.
dramas.t: The Princess Is a Rabbit Fairy

dramas.nt: 破产后，被哥哥扔到他死对头家里
dramas.syn:
After her parents died and her company went bankrupt, Tu Yuan was abandoned by her brother to his sworn enemy, Xie Yin He. She pretended to be poor and weak to stay, but ended up being a lamb to be slaughtered. In the end, Xie Yin He was held responsible, and his sworn enemy became his brother-in-law.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Po Chan Hou, Bei Ge Ge Reng Dao Ta Si Dui Tou Jia Li" (破产后，被哥哥扔到他死对头家里) by Jin Yu Zi (今与紫).

The death of Bai Zhen shocks the world. After taking revenge, Zhe Yan discovers something suspicious about the situation. At this time, a youth named Ge Yun enters his life. The love and hatred between Ge Yun, Zhe Yan and Bai Zhen unravel a series of mysterious cases.
dramas.t: Three Lives, Three Worlds, White Twilight Tears

dramas.syn:
His love is patient and restrained. Ten years ago, Qi Yan Jing fell in love with his teacher's daughter at first sight. In order to be close to Wen Zhi Xian, he gave up his family business and became a university professor. After knowing that she had a boyfriend, he still liked her silently. When she was extremely disappointed with her boyfriend and proposed a flash marriage with him, he did not hesitate to seize the opportunity. Ten years later, he finally got married to his secret love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Qi Jiao Shou Jie Ge Hun" (祁教授借个婚) by Fu Long (伏珑).

Luo Ying Zi, Qiu Hua and Xia Shu were kicked out of Liangcheng Law Firm. Luo Ying Zi suspected that the matter was related to an old case she was helping Mei Da Liang investigate. In order to survive, the three opened a law firm.

Chen Shuo switched jobs to Liangcheng Law Firm in order to pursue Luo Ying Zi, but failed. Luo Ying Zi still does not accept Chen Shuo, but she falls in love with her new partner, Xu Zhuo. Chen Shuo secretly helps Luo Ying Zi uncover the truth about Mei Da Liang's old case.

Wen Ran is God's messenger, who is given the mission to save the unloved Li Chao Yuan in the short drama, and to get him to live a happy life of love. The charm value of her in each world is full, and everyone around her likes her. Li Chao Yuan is really sick, and he has a family-inherited trait with pathological forced love. Anyone who wants to contact Wen Ran is regarded as a threat, including talking to her and the maid who wants to hold an umbrella for her. But she really brings him redemption and teaches him how to love. You have to believe that there will be someone who loves you, even if you are sick, even if your illness has not been cured, there will always be someone who loves you.
dramas.t: Ni Shi Wo De Ren Jian Shi Ge

dramas.syn:
Genius programmer Yang Can, together with his partner Gu Ming Cheng, secretly develops an “immersive narrative experience system” based on brain-computer interface technology. The system is created because Yang Can, who struggles to express emotions, wants to fulfill his girlfriend Ye Bing Bing’s dream of experiencing a romance like those in idol dramas.

With the help of his teammate Liu Jie Sen, Yang Can hides his involvement with the system and invites Ye Bing Bing, who works as a script editor, into it under the guise of a work opportunity. He plans to propose to her at the end of her immersive experience and reveal the truth behind the system.
dramas.t: My Rival in Love Is Me

dramas.syn: The legendary tale between a Qing Dynasty emperor and his imperial consort. Dong Xiao Wan is a beautiful singer from Jiangnan who captures the heart of the Emperor. Their relationship is not accepted as it is forbidden for a woman of Han descent to become the Qing Emperor's wife. The Empress Dowager Xiao Zhuang becomes their fiercest roadblock along with sinister forces looking to take advantage of the situation, yet the couple's unyielding devotion towards each other never wanes nor wavers.

A story with fantasy elements revolves around the god of death, the ghost keeper and the judge. In helping save others from death, three ghost keepers learn the value of living.

Xiao Yi, Wu Xin, and Yin Zheng Feng are three people whose names were mistakenly put into the book of death. As a result, they are invited to become ghost keepers and tasked with helping the god of death. Once they restore the system and save everyone who has been erroneously sentenced to die, they can then be reborn.
As Mo Yue Rong gets attacked on the street, the man she saw in her dreams appears to save her.

During the 1944 Wang Jingwei regime of the 2nd Sino-Japanese War, Lu Feng, an orphan, returns home to Shanghai after studying for two years in Japan. Unbeknownst to the world, he has been ordered to enter the No. 76 Headquarters as an undercover agent for the Communist Party. The No. 76 branch was a secret spy government organization working in cooperation with the Japanese military to wipe out resistance movements by the Kuomintang, Communist Party, and all other factions. Despite the paranoid and cautious nature of Shen Xiao, No. 76's branch leader, Lu Feng proves his worth to the group through his intelligence and perseverance. 
     
Along the way, Lu Feng encounters the mysterious Hua Xiang Yu, a capable and skilled woman who has just returned from studying abroad in America, and his old childhood friend, Huo Fei. Both individuals seem to hold secrets of their own. Time and time…

A serial murderer in the city has shaken the people of old Shanghai and a trio of investigators join hands to solve the mystery.

As he was investigating a case, private detective Chen Yi Ming crosses paths with Zhang Tian Xiao, the police director's son and Yao Fei, a beautiful woman who has returned from abroad. They come to form a three-man team determined to crack the case. However, Chen Yi Ming discovers that masked behind the series of killings are conspiracies and secrets that relate to his real identity.

'Sanatorium for Love' is a studio held by Li Xiao Ming, which helps people hurt by love and gets them to start a new life.  When a friend of Xiao Ming introduces An Ran to him, An Ran just broke up with her boyfriend, Zhu Yong.

An Ran gets to the lowest point of her life with her job and the loss of her seven-year-old love. With the help of Xiao Ming, she stays in the studio and begins looking for a new life. In the studio, An Ran met kind-hearted people who were also emotionally injured.

Constantly interacting, they comfort and encourage each other, regain confidence in love, rebuild a positive and healthy view of love, slowly retrieve their self-worth and start a new life...

~~ Adapted from the novel.

Lin Yu, who plans everything, and Chen An An, a smart and quick-witted girl were deskmates in high school for a short time. After eight years of separation, they reunited and live under the same roof. Despite different personalities and dispute, they often comfort each other. However, what they don't know is that a wonderful fate called "Vivian" has already sprouted eight years ago and connected the hearts of these two. Because of "Vivian", they fell in love with each other. And eventually they will bid farewell to "Vivian" and be a better version of themselves.

When Shen Wu Han discovers her husband cheating she decides to get a divorce. Eventually she's got two men to choose from: her husband and a dark, handsome, powerful stranger.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ni Chu Gui Zai Xian, Wo Li Hun Ni Ku Shen Me" (你出轨在先，我离婚你哭什么) by Jin Tang (锦棠).

dramas.nt: 天降五宝，千亿爹地快投降
dramas.syn: Su Li was framed by her stepsister Su Yue, and had a one night stand with Li Han Ting. After returning home, she found out that her mother was killed by her biological father and stepmother. Ten months later, she gave birth to quintuplets and left her hometown. Seven years later, Su Li became a genius designer. In order to find evidence that her father killed her mother, she returned to China. She didn't expect that her children would take the initiative to find their father.
dramas.t: Tiang Jiang Wu Bao, Qian Yi Die Di Kuai Tou Xiang

dramas.syn:
At eighteen, Wen Ning experienced love for the first time, beginning a ten-year secret relationship with Mu Tang Sheng, one of her father's subordinates. But when her brother died in battle, and her father fell critically ill, she begged this man, eight years her senior, to marry her to appease her brothers and father for the tenth time. Mu Tang Sheng refused again, turning instead to his childhood sweetheart, Ye Wan Xin, who was the same age as him. This time, Wen Ning didn't cry or make a scene. She knelt before the Buddha, drew lots, and chose Zhou Ye, the infamous captain, as her groom, setting the earliest possible wedding date.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chou Qian Xuan Le Bing Pi Hou, Qian Nan You Hou Hui Le" (抽签选了兵痞后，前男友后悔了) by Ru Huo Ru Tu (如火如荼).

Lawyer Wen Xu leaves her firm due to a conflict of principles and heads to Hong Kong Island for a retreat. There, she develops feelings for the seaside inn owner, Zhou Lie. After her playful advances are met with his teasing response on a stormy night, the two agree to a three-month short-term relationship. As they grow closer, Wen Xu is forced to return to Beicheng when a close friend faces trouble.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhi Lie" (炙烈), also known as "Yi Jian, Zhong Qing" (一见，钟情), by Jiu Jiu Mao (纠纠猫).

A movie star and two business CEO's died one after another in "S" city, and the causes of their deaths were very strange. What is even more bizarre is people report that a dark shadow appeared at the scene of these three murders. As a result, the S City Criminal Investigation Brigade quickly launched an investigation. Among the suspects are the richest female in S City, cynical rich second generations businessman, and some bastard at the bottom of society...

It focuses on the perseverance of the Central Plains Mining Police in upholding justice. It tells the story of the public security police officers who are unyielding in their fight against the village bullies, and their wisdom and courage ultimately lead to the elimination of the criminals.

Xia Zhi Yao has secretly been in love for years with Shen Yan Ci, the uncle of her best friend Shen Qing. She uses Shen Yan Ci as the male lead in her comics and becomes a well-known shojo manga artist under the pen name Tang Xin. When Xia Zhi Yao loses inspiration and stops updating her comic, Shen Yan Ci returns once again. The two reunite, and through their private interactions, their feelings gradually deepen.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Pian Ai Du Chong, Jin Yu Fu Zi Lou Yao Chan Wen" (偏爱独宠，禁欲佛子搂腰缠吻), also known as "Shi Chong! Fu Zi Shu Shu You Zai Hong Xiao Jiao Qi" (侍宠！佛子叔叔又在哄小娇妻), by Heng Ye (恒叶).

On their third wedding anniversary, yamen officer Chen Yi Qu and physician Yang Tao are about to peacefully divorce when they’re suddenly framed as enemy spies and forced to go on the run, turning their farewell into a thrilling fight for survival and the truth.
Li Jin Yu and Ye Meng's daily life after marriage.

After a large-scale police crackdown, narcotics officer Yang Yi Peng seizes a critical lead with captured but defiant ringleader Mou Hai Dong. Alongside rookie officer Zhi An and informant Duo Zai, Yang follows a trail back to Mou Sen’s new synthetic drug operation, uncovering a complex web of drug networks. But as they delve deeper, the true mastermind remains elusive, hidden behind layers of secrecy.

~~ Adapted from the documentary "Ju Feng Xing Dong: Wei Lie" (飓风行动·围猎) by Ding Yi He) by (丁一鹤).
Pang Linglong, the waiter of a hot pot restaurant, is a fan of Gongdou drama, dismissing all kinds of clichéd plots. Suddenly, one day, she time travels and entered the palace.

The story follows the challenges that young parents face when they become determined to buy a new house so that their son can attend the top elementary school. The couple's different attitudes cause a series of family conflicts.
dramas.t: As Long as We Are Together

dramas.syn: They knew each other in high school. 8 years later, desperate for money,  she is hired to be his contract marriage wife and the maths tutor to his nephew. A case of switched identities leads to misunderstandings and re-connection.

Yu Jin pretended to be crazy and imprisoned in the Shen family. In order to get revenge, she approached Jinzhou Prince Mo Yang. After using him to destroy the Shen family, she wanted to escape, but was caught by Mo Yang. He knew her disguise and embraced her with a smile: "I am willing to be used by you for the rest of my life." Dark revenge and indulgent love are intertwined. She planned the game and he joined it.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Guai Guai Ru Ju, Jiao Si Da Lao Wu Bu Di Tou" (乖乖入局，娇肆大佬无不低头) by Xiao Ba Wang Hui Ji Fei (小霸王会击飞).

In a matriarchal kingdom, Pei Jing Heng, a noble heir raised in disguise as a woman, meets Su Zhi Yao, an orphan who lost her memory after her family’s massacre. As their connection deepens, long-buried memories and shocking truths begin to emerge.

This is the story of a single mom, her HIV-positive daughter and a doctor that walks into their lives. Li Xiao Han is the comely single mom whose angelic little girl unknowingly contracts HIV. An Jie Luo is an accomplished doctor who loses his girlfriend to a terminal illness and then goes looking for the mother-daughter pair to fulfill his girlfriend's dying wish.

Set during the Warring States Period, the story follows an extraordinary genius whose identity is shrouded in mystery. Like a master in chess, Wang Chan moves the pieces at play in tumultuous times to quell dissidence and help his nation grow in strength as he eventually becomes the revered Gui Gu Zi.
In 390 BC,  the Crown Prince of Wei was able to crush a coup with the help of Wang Cuo. As a result, Wei Huan is exiled and Wu Qi flees to Chu. Just as Wang Cuo celebrates his victory, Wu Qi returns to take revenge and covet Sun Tzu's The Art of War for himself. He surrounds the manor with five hundred of his men and kills everyone in sight. Madame Wang manages to give birth to her son Wang Chan who eventually grows up to become a skilled political strategist.

Lin Su is a soul reincarnated through countless lifetimes. Strikingly beautiful and naturally alluring, she possesses a golden finger (cheat ability) and a wealth of worldly experience. Clever, sharp, vengeful and sly yet composed, she never lets a grudge go unavenged. 

In this life, to complete a mission, she assumes the identity of the second lead to get close to the male lead, Yan Zhou.

Shi Yan and Qin Xiu Han's marriage is in name only. Qin Xiu Han keeps his chastity for his white moonlight Liu Ru Yan. Lonely and desperate Shi Yan meets Xiao Chen Yan and seeks comfort in his gentle company. It was not until Qin Xiu Han found out that Liu Ru Yan had cheated on him that he begged for reconciliation. However, he did not expect that Xiao Chen Yan, who was with Shi Yan, was actually the heir of a top warlord.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hun Nei Yue Gui! Wo Zhao Re Le Ding Ji Jun Fa Da Lao" (婚内越轨！我招惹了顶级军阀大佬) by Liu Qing Ci (柳清辞).

In the twenty-fourth year of the Changhe era, the death of the founding emperor sparks a fierce battle for the throne. Yan Qing Shu is falsely accused and forced into a broken engagement, only to witness the destruction of her family. After being rescued by Xiao Jing Yan, the two form an alliance and return to the capital seeking revenge. Together, they uncover the treasonous schemes of Prince Ling, the Xie family, and other powerful forces conspiring against the throne.

Set during the warlord period in Linghe City, a merchant, Xiao Ge Ran, was unfortunately embroiled in a murder case and during his journey to find the truth, he meets Bai Qi, the descendant of a fox. Together, they unravel the schemes of the Yin Yang Master, Jin Chuan.
dramas.t: The House of the Fairy Fox

dramas.syn:
In Beijing, Li Hui Yan is a perpetually broke but sharp-witted police detective who lives in a modest traditional neighbourhood with his teenage son. He is forever trying to borrow money from his co-workers. Meanwhile, Zhou You is a funeral parlour  worker troubled by his past, who is occasionally contacted by the police for cadaver removal to the morgue. One fateful day, he is called out to pick up a body and discovers the police has been duped by a fake death certificate – the dead man had actually been  a murder victim. Li Hui Yan becomes curious and interrogates Zhou You, noticing that the latter is an extraordinary talented detective by his own right.

When one of his son’s school girl friends is kidnapped by two masked assailants, Li Hui Yan investigation leads him to a small icy town in the north.  Zhou You’s father is murdered under violent circumstances at the same time. The…

The introverted girl Fang Xiao Ying has been easily overlooked since she was a child. One day, she finds herself forgotten by everyone and becomes a completely transparent person. In a state of despair, she accidentally discovers that only Yu Zhiang, with whom she'd had a misunderstanding, can see her. The two strike a deal, and Yu Zhiang helps Fang Xiao Ying with a promise so she can find herself again.

Wang Hu, an underachiever from a high school in northeast China, went alone to the southern city of Macao, which has a huge cultural difference from the northeast China, to study. A series of hilarious stories would happen.

A story that revolves around a small-town girl who overcomes societal prejudice and many roadblocks to become a supermodel. 

Zhang Mei Li is a fast food worker who finds herself becoming the subject of a bet between a big company called Fashion Group and its investors. She is recruited by chief editor Lin Da who vows to put her through rigorous training to turn her into a supermodel. 

Afraid to lose her, Mei Li's fiancee Da Bao who also works in the fast food industry, does everything in his power to hinder her success. Moreover, Mei Li encounters various prickly personalities, such as fashion editor Song Chu Chu and Zhuang Bei Di. Through it all, she meets Li Ze Yu from market research, who encourages and helps her unconditionally.

Secret bodyguard Jin Hua, who helped the beloved second prince Nangong Yi win the throne, suffered hardships but ultimately met the tragic end of being betrayed and killed by his loved one. Before her death, she recalled her true identity as Shen Chang Ge, the elder daughter of the Grand Preceptor, and was reborn at a turning point in fate.

In this life, Shen Chang Ge, relying on her wisdom, avoids the hidden arrows of harm and makes sure that everyone who has hurt her experiences the pain of losing everything. However, she never expected the Crown Prince Chang Ping, Mu Heng, to appear in her life repeatedly, and his gentle yet passionate affection stirs waves in Shen Chang Ge’s heart…

Blinded by grief after losing her family, Shen Ming Zhu faces betrayal by relatives forcing her into marriage. She risks a dangerous union with the ruthless yet wounded Prince Yu Wen Xiao, seeking love in desperation.

After the obedient daughter of a wealthy family, Qiao Nian, falls from a building, her spirit possesses Jiang Ze Chen. With only seven days to recover her missing body before her soul is lost forever, Jiang Ze Chen, guided by Qiao Nian’s ghost, embarks on a desperate journey to reclaim her body and save her life.

A story that spans ten years follows a group of young men and women from their schooldays until the time they enter society as adults.

It begins in the year 2005. Bai Yi Han has gotten accepted to a prominent school. She becomes attracted to school genius Lin Xing Ze and with the help of her close friends, she tries to gain his approval. While they fail in the endeavor, they succeed in getting his attention. At the same time, Yang Tian Ran transfers from abroad and becomes acquainted with Bai Yi Han. Chen Si Yu starts to fall for Zhou Xiao Yu.

In the long and winding road of youth, Bai Yi Han, Lin Xing Ze, and Yang Tian Ran are caught in a love triangle. The addition of Chen Si Yu and Zhou Xiao Yu further complicates the relationship between the group. As time passes and they become adults, destiny brings forth a different ending.

At seventeen, Jiang Chun Yu becomes the target of cruel bullying led by Gu Nian, a torment that ends with the heartbreaking death of her mother, the only family she had left. Years later, forged by suffering, she returns transformed into an angel of vengeance. In this gripping tale of retribution, no one will escape the consequences of her revenge.

Jiang Yan Qiu, a boy with superhuman strength but struggling academically, is tricked into enrolling in Xinzi Academy, a school consistently ranked at the bottom in academic evaluations. Faced with struggling students who use books as weapons, he unexpectedly uses his physical prowess to overpower them, forming a study group with the sickly but academically gifted Shen Qing Qu and the wealthy Ji Lin Shuang. When the female principal, Qin Zhao Xue, disguised as a boy, attempts to elevate the "bottom-ranked academy" to an excellent institution, a hilarious campus drama unfolds, with pens as swords and books as shields.

The emperor of Great Zhao Kingdom was weakened day by day, and wanted to give his throne to the Crown Prince Ning Xiao. The emperor also forced the Crown Prince to marry the daughter of the prime minister. Rather than comply, he planned to escape the marriage. After a few days, escaping the marriage ning xiao was seriously injured. Later, he was rescued by doctor bai zhi. Unexpectedly, they developed feeling for each other.
In other hand, wei shu, Wuzhou kingdom's general was sent to find the long lost princess of Wuzhou kingdom, Ruo Xi.

Jiang Yun Shu, who pretends to be foolish on the surface but is actually knowledgeable in medicine, marries the paralyzed young master of the Gu family, Gu Jue Feng, in a “warding-off” wedding. However, she discovers that her mother-in-law repeatedly tries to harm them.

Gu and Jiang reach cooperation, helping each other and gradually developing feelings for each other. After learning that the mother-in-law is using a secret medicine to treat a mysterious person, Jiang Yun Shu disguises herself to go for treatment and discovers that this person looks exactly like Gu Jue Feng.

The mysteries and conspiracies of the Gu family gradually were unfold by Gu Jue Feng and Jiang Yun Shu…

After the brutal murder of the Fu family, only daughter Fu Zhao Xue survives, with evidence pointing to her former lover, Gu Jing Zhou, as the culprit. She returns under a new identity as Lin Qian Yu, marrying into the Gu family as Gu Jing Zhou's sister-in-law to uncover their hidden secrets. Determined to get close to him, she navigates a tense, complex relationship, stirring conflict among the Gu brothers. As the truth unfolds, long-buried feelings between Lin Qian Yu and Gu Jing Zhou are rekindled, leading to an intense clash of revenge and forbidden love.
It tells the bittersweet love story between Jiang Yi, a down-on-her-luck kept woman, and Pei Jing Chuan, a devoted family heir.

After successfully confessing her love, 18-year-old girl Xu Chu Nian traveled through time and space to become a 24-year-old abandoned wife of a wealthy family. Faced with her indifferent husband, Jiang Huai Xu, and her mute daughter, Zhu Zhu, she was determined to save everything. When strange memories and men in black appeared frequently, she discovered that the world was actually set in a novel! Xu Nian Chu broke free from control and fought against the plot. She could only write her own life!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jing! Mei Shao Nv Yi Jiao Xing Lai Hai Zi San Sui!" (惊！美少女一觉醒来孩子三岁！), also known as "Hun Hou, Leng Mo Lao Gong Cheng Le Bei Shang Xiao Gou" (婚后，冷漠老公成了悲伤小狗) by Yu Yi Er (余宜尔).

Mu Si Yu, a competent urban woman, has a successful career but a bad love experience. In a gathering organized by her ex-boyfriend, she hires a cute guy, Fang Zi Yin, to pretend to be her boyfriend. But as a result, she becomes infatuated with Fang Zi Yin. Later, Wu Bowen, another ex-boyfriend of hers, also joins her company. In a subtle atmosphere, things get interesting among her, her ex-boyfriend and her fake boyfriend.

In the plot, the only daughter of a general is forced to accept an imperial decree to marry a prince. However, she unexpectedly falls in love with a substitute prince—a man who has been living in the shadows, filling in for the real prince. This substitute is cunning, with a masterful grasp of political power, and highly skilled in martial arts.

 Despite his cold and calculated nature, his heart begins to thaw only for the woman who becomes his weakness. As the power struggle intensifies, the protagonists find themselves as pawns in a much larger game. Although their feelings develop, the deep-seated betrayal between them sparks intense emotional conflict. 

Love turns to hate, and they become adversaries, fighting with swords rather than words. Their complex relationship, rooted in deception and entangled with personal ambitions, is full of anguish and emotional depth, symbolized by…

Mi You Chu, a general’s daughter, marries the heir Su Bu Xiao out of love, but suffers betrayal and the destruction of her family. Reborn with revenge in her heart, she hones her skills to take down Su Bu Xiao—unaware that his body now hosts a game player trying to win her love. What begins as a deadly chase turns into a reluctant partnership when a mysterious figure threatens her family again.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "I Am Not Your Enemy" (别动！自己人) written by Bo Jiang (波酱) and illustrated by Hei Quan + Bai Dian (黑圈+白点).

Orphan Ruan Zhi suffers a double betrayal: her step sister, Ruan Jia Jia,  plots to drug her, and her boyfriend of many years cheats on her with her best friend. 

Ruan Zhi unexpectedly has a relationship with her boyfriend's father, Hong Kong business mogul Rong Jun Heng.   Ruan Zhi faces inheritance disputes within the Ruan family while simultaneously discovering Rong Che's infidelity. Under this double pressure, Ruan Zhi agrees to Rong Jun Heng's proposal—marriage! After the marriage, Rong Jun Heng transforms into a fiercely protective husband, helping Ruan Zhi reclaim her shares and punish her uncle's family. 

With Rong Jun Heng's support, Ruan Zhi gradually transforms from a manipulated victim into a woman who takes control of her own destiny. Their relationship evolves from a marriage of convenience into a mutual commitment.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zha Nan Pi Tui Gui Mi,…

Set in the Republican-era Shanghai, Gu Man Zhen works as an assistant in a factory, while Gu Man Lu works at a nightclub to support the family. Gu Man Zhen falls in love with the wealthy Shen Shi Jun, a young engineer who happens to be engaged.
Gu Man Lu marries the lustful Zhu Hong Cai, though is unable to prevent him from hankering after her younger sister. Gu Man Zhen and Shen Shi Jun meet again a decade later when both are married and try not to let societal expectations ruin their prospects for happiness.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Half a Lifelong Romance" by Eileen Chang.

In January 1933, the Japanese army captured Shanhaiguan and occupied Chengde in March. The anti-Japanese situation in North China was in jeopardy. Shanghai's multinational forces are glued and undercurrent.  Gu Pan, Tian Qiao Jie and Tan Zhong Wen are agents of Qingshan Military Academy. Gu Pan was alone in completing the assassination of the Japanese Economic Secretary, Koji Koji. Gu Pan was wounded to complete the mission but was rescued by Wei Dong, an outstanding soldier. Under the guidance of Wei Dong, Gu Pan was tested and entered the secret organization "Nest" to try to find out why he was framed.

In the process of pursuing justice, Gu Pan gradually moved closer to the Red Revolution and used the "Hippo" as the codename to become a communist fighter.

Shen Mansion's young lady, Chu Qi, heard that her sister, Shen Shi San, who had been inseparable from her since childhood, went missing while searching for a specific medicine. In a desperate situation, she had a conflict with the medicine vendor Wang Wu. Chu Qi was rescued by Gu Yusheng, the son of a military officer and her childhood friend. Wang Wu fled, but mysteriously died that night. The investigating officer, Wu Xu, guided by clues, identified Chu Qi as the suspect. Driven by her concern for her missing sister, Chu Qi broke into the charity house at night to search for clues on Wang Wu's body. The clues pointed to a place called "Fengming Town."

Coincidentally, Wu Xu, who came to inspect the body, apprehended Chu Qi. In a struggle, Chu Qi accidentally tore her clothes. Wu Xu, in an unexpected gesture, lent her his own clothes and accidentally dropped his police badge. Chu Qi…

Xiao Yan hurts her vocal cords in a fire accident and become mute. Her mother was injured in the same accident and got in coma. Now Xiao Yan works several jobs just so she could pay her mother's medical bills. She had contract relationship with wealthy man, Gu Huai Zhi. After the contract expired, Xiao Yan was pushed to get engaged to another man by her stepmother, using Xiao Yan's mother as a leverage. But Gu Huai Zhi isn't over with Xiao Yan. There's a secret about the fire accident , but now only 2 people know the truth, and one of them is Xiao Yan's mother.

Seeing his beloved Pei Yan about to marry another man, Fu Huai Zhou, who has had a secret crush on her for nine years, sets a trap. He feigns intimacy with her fiancé, Li Yue Ting, under the guise of being a "good brother," setting a trap for her. On the eve of the wedding, he personally delivers a video of his infidelity, severing the engagement. Desperate, Li Yue Ting drugs Pei Yan, playing right into Fu Huai Zhou's hands. He appears at the right moment, posing as a savior, and coaxes the unconscious Pei Yan into signing the marriage agreement.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tou Yu Ru Huai" (偷玉入怀), also known as "Nan You Zha Wo Zhi Hou, Wo He Ta Xiong Di Jie Hun Le" (男友渣我之后，我和他兄弟结婚了), by Qu Bu Zhi (曲不知).
dramas.t: Jiu Ming! Wo Lao Gong Cha Xiang Si Yi

dramas.syn: Three girls with completely different professions, personalities, and schedules live together under the same roof, but they have one thing in common: no matter what conflicts or problems they encounter in life, love, or work, they will cook when night falls. The three of them get together to have a serious dinner. For them, every day's problems seem to be solved after dinner.
dramas.t: The Corner of the World Is Dinner

dramas.syn: Amidst the factional strife in the Great Wei Dynasty, Shen Su He was forced to marry the Second Prince which lead to endless humiliation, the demise of her family, and ultimately a tragic death. When she's reborn on her wedding day, she decides to feign madness to investigate the truth. Joining forces with Prince Yu, Mu Yun Zheng, they work together to uncover the truth behind her injustice.

A 21st-century scientist goes back in time and solves crimes. He will get married and have four wives.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Na Qie Ji" (纳妾记) by Mu Yi (沐轶).

An intern who just entered the workforce, suddenly wakes up one day to discover that she remembers her past life. In her past life, she was a lowly maid who rises step by step to become a wise and intelligent Empress. Hence, He Jiaojiao decides to use her memories and harem strategy to deal with workplace problems to help her climb up the corporate ladder.

When Ruan Ning Xia and her boss, Fu Ling Cheng, have a one-night stand that results in a pregnancy, they get married for the sake of their child. During their marriage, Ruan Ning Xia spends her husband's money lavishly and enjoys a papered life. Disliking her materialistic ways, Fu Ling Cheng has never had a good impression of his wife. 

One day, Fu Ling Cheng is in a car wreck and becomes paralyzed. He is disowned by his family, kicked out and bankrupt. Abandoned by nearly everyone he knows, Fu Ling Chen has no choice but to rely on his wife. As she cares for him, the couple begin to develop romantic feelings for one another.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yi Jiao Xing Lai Tian Ta La! Hao Men Lao Gong Po Chan Le" (一觉醒来天塌啦！豪门老公破产了) by Mao Mao Bu Tiao Shi (猫猫不挑食).
dramas.t: Juan Zi Ji Bu Ru Juan Lao Gong

dramas.nt: 幸运玫瑰，周先生超宠我
dramas.syn: After being humiliated by her childhood sweetheart, she got drunk and slept with an uncle! She wanted to escape when she got pregnant, only to find out that the other party was her rival's adopted father!

Sheng Chang Tian was saved by Gu Qing Qing when he was a child. He had been looking for her and swore not to marry her for this. However, he was forced to marry by his family, so he contracted to marry the marriage broker girl. Gu Qing Qing came to the blind date on behalf of her best friend. As they got to know each other, they gradually fell in love, and Sheng Chang Tian realized that the Bai Yue Guang he was looking for was her.

The story of love and hatred between the heroine Yun Lei, the descendant of the enemy, and the young knight Zhang Danfeng, under the background of the battle for the Central Plains. The story of love and hatred born from a deep and bloody family feud. But a sincere love and knowing the value of cherishing each other, Zhang Danfeng and Yun Lei are even more united to break through numerous obstacles and overcome their enemies.

~~ Adapted from the novel “Ping Zong Xia Ying Lu” (萍踪侠影录) by Liang Yu Sheng (梁羽生).

"When You Are In Love" is fascinating with its extremely small size, detailing the appearance of urban young men and women in different periods of love. Each episode is only about 5 minutes, but they are all independent stories, telling wonderful love with a very short story length  The content has become a major feature of the play.  In the play, there is a small fortune in love, a small regret for love but not for love, a cooling after quarrel, and a madness for love, reflecting the truest urban life and creating a miniature "love apartment".

Mr Cool is a love story of novel time traveler Qu Yan who performs the task of attacking the cheating scumbag and then meets the male protagonist, who is the cold and domineering president and begins to fall in love with him.

Yue Fei's second son, Yue Lei, was naturally rebellious and cynical. After the death of his father and brother, Yue Lei set foot on the road of revenge alone. But he failed to assassinate Qin Hui and was used instead and was on the verge of death several times. With the help of Wu Chi Prince and Zhongliang Yishi, Yue Lei worked hard to find evidence of Qin Hui's treason. He wandered through the imperial city and experienced the hardships of the people. He became a changed person.

However, in the Southern Song Dynasty, the upper-level officials struggled strongly, and the entanglement between the monarch and the ministers was complicated. In the end, Yue Lei became the protector of the country after his father.

Betrayed LIVE while streaming, Jiang Qing Yu breaks off her relationship with Lu. Zhang Ji Jun rescues her from an attack but finds her oddly familiar. He eventually coerces her into a cooperative marriage despite his engagement to a long-missing heiress.

Ghostwriter Tu Cha Cha is tasked with writing love letters for Miss Wen, who hides her romantic pursuits. Over time, Tu Cha Cha falls for Shen Bu Yan, the letters' recipient. To shield him from Miss Wen’s father’s schemes, she forms a fake family, but their ruse backfires, trapping them in a dangerous plot. Together, Tu Cha Cha, Shen Bu Yan, and their makeshift family must navigate betrayal and uncover a shocking conspiracy that threatens them all.

Xiu Ju, a clever young woman from a poor family, sells handmade goods to care for her sick mother while secretly learning outside at school. She falls for the kind-hearted Shen Yan Zhou, but to save her mother and repay a debt, she’s forced to marry his older brother, Shen Yanqing. 

Trapped between love and obligation, Xiu Ju finds herself in a tangled web of emotions within the Shen family. Will she be able to break free with the real man she loves?

~~ Adapted from the novel "Ju Zi Hong Le" (橘子红了) by Qi Jun (琦君).

On what should be the happiest night of their lives, a newlywed couple transforms a simple bar outing into a high-stakes game of wits and charm. He's a confident, free-spirited doctor who never loses, while she's a shrewd and ambitious business powerhouse who refuses to settle for second place. What begins as a marriage of convenience and strategy soon transforms into an emotional battleground where pride meets passion. As hidden pasts resurface and carefully constructed facades begin to crack, their constant rivalry gives way to unexpected tenderness. Amidst laughter, heartbreak, and betrayal, two stubborn souls discover that love is the riskiest game of all—one neither can afford to lose.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yu Liao" (欲撩), also known as "Ye, Cai Dai Jin" (野，才带劲), by Hong Mao Zi (红帽子).
Four years later, Fang Yuan's family and their neighbours gather again, experiencing a new series of happiness.

Air Force Captain Qin Lang overcame difficulties in a live-fire exercise and completed the task, but was sent to refit the air tanker. Qin Lang, who wanted to refit the K-type aircraft, refused to obey but had to obey the orders of his superiors. In Jiangcheng, Qin Lang met Feng Lei, an air force colonel who was dismissed due to an accident. Feng Lei, who was rigorous and inhumane, and Qin Lang, who was arrogant and emotional, had a great conflict in concept. The two often battled wits and courage during training. . In an accident, Feng Lei found that Qin Lang had a serious psychological shadow on the right-hand parking in the air. Feng Lei tried various methods to make Qin Lang overcome his psychological fear regardless of his previous suspicions. Neighboring countries were in turmoil, but our army went abroad to counter terrorism but encountered terrorist attacks. The plane was hit by…

dramas.nt: 闪婚后，豪门老公马甲藏不住
dramas.syn:
Meng Ning was arranged to go on a blind date, and by some strange coincidence, she ended up in a flash marriage with the head of the powerful Fu family in Beijing. She had always believed her husband was an ordinary person without a house, and she hoped to live a simple life there. Fearing that his background would affect their relationship, he secretly doted on her, hiding his true identity. Until one day, Meng Ning discovered her husband's secret about his wealthy family.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shan Hun Hou, Hao Men Lao Gong Ma Jia Cang Bu Zhu" (闪婚后，豪门老公马甲藏不住) by Yi Lu Kai Hua (一路开花).
dramas.t: After the Flash Marriage, Mr. Fu Couldn't Hide

dramas.syn:
In a calm coastal town of Sanping City, the narcotics squad accidentally seize a batch of new methamphetamine that had a rare purity in an action, so Sanping Public Security immediately launches an investigation. The transferred police officer Zhao You Nan with keen sense of smell and insight, makes a target of Huang Zong Wei who did the chemical business from scratch. 

The cunning Huang Zong Wei ignites Zhao Younan’s fighting spirit. She keeps an eye on Huang Zong Wei. No matter where Huang Zong Wei hides, no matter how false her appearance is, she can dig up clues and find the truth without hesitation to arrest. The Public Security team led by Zhao You Nan versus the drug dealers led by Huang Zong Wei. Zhao You Nan goes after Huang Zong Wei, and Huang Zong Wei is good at hiding, which stages a “game of cat and mouse”…

A serial killer is victimizing the city of Linghai so criminal police investigator Ji Fan, Captain Xiong Zhen Nan, and forensic doctor Zhao Qing Yan create a task force to launch an investigation. The case becomes complicated when Ji Fan realizes that the killer might be close to him and found to be related to an old case 27 years ago that leads back to his own family - his Ji Ting Shan and older brother Ji Ping who lives with him.

In this suspenseful story, scholar Fan Luo Luo disguises herself as a man and comes to Yecheng Yamen to work as a police officer. Unexpectedly, she met Gu Qian Mo, a young minister from Dali Temple who had concealed his identity and had come to investigate the theft of weapons. The two started a full-fledged daily life as colleagues. As the truths emerged one by one, love also grew and spread in their hearts...

On the eve of her engagement, Lin Xi escaped from her cheating husband and her family who sold their daughters for fame and fortune, and unexpectedly became pregnant with the child of Fu Chi Ye, the prince of Shanghai. The big hotel where Lin Xi worked was also acquired by Fu Chi Ye, who was chasing her closely, but she just wanted to work hard to realize her self-worth. However, Fu Chi Ye kept pressing her, and Lin Xi continued to fall into despair. In the end, she not only relied on herself to gain a foothold in the hotel, but was also spoiled by the prince of Shanghai.
dramas.t: Dong Ri Lian Ge: Qing Ding Da Fan Dian

dramas.syn: Wen Tan was exploited and forced by her agency to sign a contract lover hype with Meng Chen An. She was bullied by anti-fans all the time. Wen Tan almost died of depression. She was rescued by her best friend Lin Chu Yao by accident. She met Ming Zhuo, a professor of geology, and fell in love with him at first sight.

Wen Zhi Yan has been secretly married to Shen Ji Han for four years. She is his most capable subordinate during the day and his beloved wife at night. She always thought that their relationship would not deteriorate, but under the guidance of her mother-in-law, she gradually discovered that Shen Ji Han gradually crossed the line with the young and lively Gu Qing Tang. He would accompany her to book the ski resort to play when on business trips, and allow her to run wild in the office. Wen Zhi Yan was heartbroken about Shen Ji Han and decided to divorce. She replanned her future and met Zhao Xuan Zhou, the prince of Junyi.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ni Chu Gui Zai Xian, Wo Li Hun Ni Ku Shen Me" (你出轨在先，我离婚你哭什么) by Jin Tang (锦棠).

The 18th-tier rookie assassin accidentally fell into the devil's lair and became the bride of the Number 1 public enemy in the martial arts. She thought that being the wife would lead to an easy life, but unexpectedly, the gang has already been impoverished and precarious.
dramas.t: Zhe Ge Jiang Hu Bu Yi Ban

dramas.syn:
The treasure of the town hall of the Jianzhou Museum (a pair of tiger amulets of the Han Dynasty) was stolen strangely. The gang of thieves had superb methods of crime. The police found that it was an organized and premeditated theft. The case caused a sensation all over the country. Through a series of investigations, Sun Shao Shuang, the leader of the task force, suspected that the case was committed by thieves in the ancient city of Fengjing and that the man behind the scenes was known as the "king of thieves".

In order to recover the national treasure, Sun Shao Shuang appointed the policeman Ping San Ge to pretend to be a little-known thief, and with the assistance of the anti-pickup police officer Li Chuang, he went deep into the thieves'  gang to investigate.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Dou Zei" (斗贼) by Chang Shu Xin (常书欣).

The Day I Skipped School For You depicts the school life of the post-90s generation. It follows the naughty but handsome Chen Mo, his desk-mate Zhao Xiao Yu, and other high schoolers as they make their first experiences with love, form friendships and fight for their dreams.
dramas.t: The Day I Skipped School for You

dramas.syn:
Young girls who dream of making it into the top fashion group attend a peculiar makeup school.

Every student in Mary Academy is working hard to master the art of being beautiful. The arrivals of transfer student Song Shiyao and newcomer Lin Xi cause a stir in the school grounds. Together with Xiao Zhu and school boy Huang Zhengyu, they form the makeup society and battle other schools to become the best of the best.

Yu Wan Wan is reading a novel when she somehow enters it. She is now the heroine of the story, intending to marry Yan An Tang, the male lead of the story - ending the story with a kiss. Only by kissing the male lead is it possible for her to go back to the real world.

But something goes wrong with the script, and she ends up entangled with the male lead's illegitimate half-brother, Chi Han, the villain of the story. He believes she is a spy planted at his brother's side by the Emperor so at the wedding, he snatches away the bride. Preventing them from kissing and thereby ending the story.

Dealing with this dangerous villain scares Yu Wan Wan, but when she realizes that she has the “aura” of the heroine, not only preventing him from killing her but also making him obey her only by saying “Please”, a whole different story starts to unfold. But despite having the upper hand in regards to…
dramas.t: Qiu Qiu Ni Bie Xin Dong

dramas.syn:
"Lu Zhi Ling, you have tried your best to survive, but can you tell whether this is the world or hell?"

Five years ago, the Lu family was mysteriously destroyed, leaving only Lu Zhi Ling in the world. She became a pawn of her scumbag fiancé and was forced to seduce his elder brother. Both sides were destroyed, and when she met Bo Wang again, she revealed all her vicious calculations.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xin Gan Chong" (心肝宠) by Jiu Ling (九棂).

Chief disciple Zhao Fei Yang possesses the legendary "Nine Heavens Codex." When the Nether Hall wipes out the Heavenly Sword Sect, his meridians are shattered, and his fiancée even rips out his Dao bone and breaks off their engagement. At his darkest hour, he saves Bai Xi, an ancient demon saint, who grants him a saint-grade Dao bone, allowing him to cultivate again. Rising at an astonishing pace, he sets out to settle his old scores and found his own sect. A demonic sword recognizes him as its master, and even Earth Immortals submit to him. When the great tribulation finally descends, Zhao Fei Yang stands defiant against fate and declares, "If Heaven demands that I face this tribulation, then I'll stain the heavens with blood!"

Ji San Mei, a Doctor of Law, joins the Juvenile Prosecution Department of the High-Tech Zone Procuratorate in Jihai City as a juvenile prosecutor. Teaming up with criminal police officer and longtime friend He Liang, she relies on her sharp insight and rigorous logical thinking to solve a series of cases, safeguarding the growth and well-being of minors.

However, unbeknownst to them, the real danger has already been lurking close at hand. Standing at the crossroads of difficult choices and inner struggles, the two remain steadfast in their belief in the rule of law, embarking on a relentless battle between justice and evil.

Lu Zhao Zhao spent three years with the scumbag Shao Ming. After discovering that he was cheating on her, she live-streamed their passionate office scene and resigned with the project book. Shao Ming's revenge made it difficult for her to find a job, so she had to join Chaoyan Group. 

In order to get back together, her ex-boyfriend, Fu Jin Yan, also came to the company, hiding his identity as the president. The two pretended to be interviewers to eliminate other interviewees. When Lu Zhao Zhao was waiting for the interview, Fu Jin Yan showed his ID. This is a love story of a hard-mouthed and soft-hearted president who got back a girl who dared to love and hate, and reunited.
dramas.t: Hao Tu Jiu Chi Wo Bian Cao

dramas.syn:
Anthology collection of five independent stories, directed by five accomplished directors, built around breaking through the awkward state of life amid the ridiculous and bittersweet moments, when searching for a truly free and authentic self:

>> Story 1: "See You Later… Maybe" (囧徒之预演告别)
>> Story 2: "Crazy Key " (疯狂的钥匙)
>> Story 3: "Tong Tian Ta" (通天塔)
>> Story 4: "The King of Drama " (戏剧之王)
>> Story 5: "Love Hunting Plan" (猎爱计划)

A loser college student was having a really bad day: The girl he was in love with only thought of him as her bestie; and he was diagnosed with terminal cancer with only three months to live. Then an alien life form that looked like a yolk body snatched him. It not only cured his cancer, it gave him super human abilities. But with the happy surprise came danger of extraterrestrial kind. For his friends and love one, he had to overcome his loser mentality and be a hero.

Du Qing Qing and Gao Leng's president Pei Chen met in the Oolong incident, while Du Qing Qing was in a tit-for-tat confrontation with Pei Chen, but he had a good impression of the president. The two have been on a bumpy road of love, but they encountered a sudden epidemic. How will their fate change?

The boxer Liu Yan, influenced by her chef mother since childhood, has a remarkable talent for gourmet cuisine. Through a twist of fate, she leaves the boxing ring and bids farewell to her childhood friend Wang Yang, embarking on a journey to find her mother. In a foreign land, she meets the decadent lawyer Lu Tian Chi, the beautiful and arrogant "versatile lady" Tang Shuang Shuang, the independent and precocious top student Li Zan, and others, beginning her "survival" journey from a boxer to a star chef.

Jiang Mei Shan and Tian Chuan had been good friends since the third grade cram school. All kinds of mistakes have kept them from being able to express their feelings, so they have maintained a good relationship for five years. Finally one day the two of them boldly express their love, and change from good friends to lovers. After falling in love, Jiang Mei Shan and Tian Chuan, like other young couples, also faced various problems: Shi Bao Lian's girlfriend, ex-boyfriend's phone number, ex-girlfriend's taunts, how should they deal with this problem?

A modern college girl, Si Nian, travels back to the 1980s and mistakenly becomes a fake daughter. She meets Zhou Yue Shen, the owner of a pig farm, who is a divorced man with two children. While discussing marriage with Zhou Yue Shen, she battles wit and courage with her relatives. At the same time, she also expands and strengthens her food business.
dramas.t: Back to the 80s: Be a Stepmom

dramas.syn: Xiao Zi Qi, a young man from Yongzhou with a quite good luck, was accidentally taken away by Zheng Li Pei, the sister of the Changliu Mountain's Master with a troublesome personality, and became her husband. Changliu Mountain, which was originally peaceful, became the battleground between Shaozhou and Yongzhou. The quarrelsome lovers were involved in the battle of power and began an adventurous love story of defending their homeland.

It tells the story of Shen Ji Xing, the legendary movie star of Inner Entertainment, whose identity is in tatters after encountering a big blackout. When he is homeless, he calmly knocks on the door of his nemesis, Zhou Yi Li. Zhou Yi Li is an up-and-coming top-flight rock musician with a flamboyant and gangly demeanor, and the two of them share a complicated emotional entanglement.

~~ Adapted from the novel “Runaway Starlight” (失控星光) by Si Jiao (司皎).

Poor and talented Bai Zhi, armed with a revenge plan, conspires with her best friend, Su Tian, to capture Beijing's richest man, Zhou Chong Ye. Bai Zhi uses all her cunning to set up a trap to seduce him, and in a thrilling duel, he is captivated by her talent and cunning, gradually falling for her. The two, transcending the vast class divide, find true love through mutual conquest and redemption.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Nian Ling Cha Hen Da, Ke Da Shu Ta Shen Ti Hao Ya" (年龄差很大，可大叔他身体好呀) by Ying Guo (樱果).

In the new media era, Jiang Zi, an unlucky girl who relentlessly strives to be seen, quits her stable job in her hometown to become a self-media blogger and moves to Beijing alone. She gets the opportunity to work with her former idol, Ivy; their relationship is both adversarial and friendly, admiring and competing with each other. 

Smart, capable, and daring, Jiang Zi gradually carves out her own niche in the new media industry. Meanwhile, she meets Luo Xin, a quirky engineering student. From initial bickering to mutual support, Luo Xin becomes her escape from the mire of her career and a remedy for her despair.

~~ Adapted from the novel 'The Metaphor of the City' (化城喻) by Ji Wen Jun (计文君).

Military commander Wu Qian Li has returned to his hometown. Wu's elder brother died in the Huaihai Battle and his third brother, Wu Wan Li, is a troublemaker in their fishing village. Qian Li decides to set his little brother on the path to becoming a soldier. The two return to camp just in time for the army to set out in the battle known in Chinese history as the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea.

The pugilistic world is plagued by turbulence, and disputes have become an ordinary occurrence. Four unique individuals - Guo Da Lu, Wang Dong, Lin Tai Ping, and Yan Qi have gathered in Gui Shan Zhuang through a stroke of fate. As they are novices in jianghu, a series of funny and humanistic encounters surround them in a coming-of-age story about young martial arts heroes.

By chance, he meets Zheng Ji, a marriage envoy who travels to the modern era. It turns out that Zheng Ji is Du Yuhou from more than 1,000 years ago. He was ordered to take the princess of the Central Plains back to Chang An. He mistakenly recognized the anchor Yuan Jia as a special envoy and was determined to help complete the task of taking the "princess" home.
Meng Nan just returned from oversea in search of a patient, which led him to an isolated mental institution.  As he interns there along with Mu Si Fan, they start to find out about secrets of people.

During a turbulent time from 1915 to 1921, Chen Du Xiu and Li Da Zhao, along with other like-minded individuals, founded the Magazine La Jeunesse that started the New Culture Movement. The magazine promoted science and democracy and revolutionized the thinking of the masses and encouraged them to fight against imperialism that has been ingrained in everyone. The series follows a colorful cast with various well-known authors, politicians, and revolutionists as they all try in their own way to save their country.

The story of three new mothers who gave birth and spent a month of postpartum care in the same hospital.

A woman in 1993 whose husband not only abandoned her at the hospital but also left her with significant debt.

A woman in 2008, who was still a child at heart, was trapped between her hovering mother and mother-in-law.

A divorced woman in 2022 juggled between keeping her highly competitive job and custody of her newborn.
dramas.t: For the First Time in My Life

dramas.syn: It's the Black Lotus of Revenge that's been dormant for five years. Duan Ling Xiao is a dissolute Buddhist with an overpowering desire for control. He treats An Jun Yue as a stand-in, and she sees him as prey in a chess game! In this game of hate, whoever falls in love first loses everything!

Mei Yan, a career woman, encounters the aloof Dr. Chu Yi Xiao during a gynecological exam and unexpectedly discovers he's her blind date. Pressured by her mother to marry, she impulsively asks for a hotel room, only to be struck by Chu Yi Xiao's gentleness. When he defends her during a banking crisis, Mei Yan bravely resigns and resists the oppression. 

After a drunken romance, their relationship blossoms, only to be faced with the decision of Chu Yi Xiao's return to the United States. A childhood sweetheart's confession to her boss further strains the relationship – when a jealous doctor meets a stubborn bank woman, who will surrender first?

In a near-future metropolis, a supernatural attack thrusts a reluctant courier and his Special Response Bureau protector into a conspiracy unraveling a decades-old classified project as shadowy origins of its erased architects emerge.

The suicide of her best friend, Cheng Ru Ying, ripples through the lives of four mothers – Fang Yuan, Jin Lu, You Xiao Zhu and Ding Mu Mu – as they search for the truth about her suicide. This accident shatters the perfect life of full-time housewife Fang Yuan. When Jin Lu, a non-maritalist curator, is about to realize her career dream, she accidentally gets pregnant and the father of her baby is her temporary boyfriend. The four mothers bravely face up to the twists and turns and search for their initial dreams, and at the same time, they work together to reveal the truth about Cheng Ru Ying's death and to do justice to the dead.

Xu Ru Yuan, a legendary thief, accidentally assumes a false identity and marries into a royal family, planning to steal a fortune and escape. But when two sharp-eyed princes blow her cover, she’s forced into palace intrigue. With her thief clan disguised as her entourage, she balances sweet deception by day and stealthy missions by night, leading to comedy, romance, and royal chaos.
dramas.t: May All Your Wishes Come True

dramas.syn: Sun Xiao Fei, a recently graduated nerd, starts working in the IT department of a fashion company.  Along with colleague Xie Tian and former college classmate Du Xi Guan, Xiao Fei often frequents a popular coffee shop on the top floor of the company.  Here, Xiao Fei meets colleagues Wu Ping, Han Lu, and Xu Yan Yan.  Over time, they get to know each other.  Wu Ping likes Sun Xiao Fei, but Xiao Fei thinks of her as a buddy. The show explores Sun Xiao Fei's development in love and career.

A story about Chong'er's unwavering determintion for the sake of his country and the emotional sometimes heart-wrenching relationships formed with Qi Jiang, Li Ji, Ying Yue and Ji Wei. . Chong'er loves his country and has thought of many ways to help the people. However, he becomes the victim of a conspiracy cooked up by corrupt officials.
(source: chinesedrama. info)

The story opens with the failed uprising in 1927. Foshan Communist Party members Chen and his wife died tragically to provide cover for their comrades. Years later, their three children go on to make spectacular achievements in the field of Cantonese medicine, cuisine and opera to earn fame in all of Guangzhou, staying true to their intentions even in wartime.

Due to the drastic countermeasures against the revolutionaries in Guangzhou on April 15, 1927, CCP underground members Chen and his wife died heroically and their three children were adopted by ordinary people. The eldest son Chen Shan He becomes an apprentice of medicine, the second son Chen Qing Wei becomes a chef, and the youngest daughter Chen Li Xia becomes an opera performer. Under the tutelage of their respective masters, they become legends in their own fields.

Just as they are about to take revenge on the enemy who…

dramas.nt: 渣男逃婚，她当场改嫁首富
dramas.syn: After her despicable fiancé, Shen Yan, abandoned her before their marriage, Wen Shu Yao was heartbroken. But, due to an unfortunate car accident, she began a contract marriage with the president Fu Nien Cheng. However, the couple's life is not easy in the Wen family because of the constant conspiracies and schemes of her ex fiancé Shen Yan and the young lady of the Wen family, Wen Yu Ning. Now the two have to engage in the battle for family empire presidency...
dramas.t: Zha Nan Tao Hun, Ta Dang Chang Gai Jia Shou Fu

dramas.syn:
Shu Mian had been secretly in love with Tan Xu Ze for many years, but she didn't dare to hope for a result. The most daring thing she had done was to write an anonymous letter to him when Tan Xu Ze seemed very depressed. But she didn't expect that the person she had been thinking about would take the initiative to walk towards her and tease her one day. It turned out that he had already fallen deeply in love with her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Ye Tou Wen Ni" (今夜偷吻你), also known as "Tang Zi Gao Bai Wen" (糖渍告白吻), by Zhe Qian (折浅).

Regent Lu Qing Cang and Empress Shen Shu Ying's lives and deaths become bound together by the Yin-Yang poison, forcing them to keep each other in check. Lu Qing Cang and Shen Shu Ying are caught in a scheme devised by someone with ulterior motives and are forced to use their own bodies as a medicinal catalyst, binding their fates together in life and death. Despite standing on opposing sides, they are ultimately destined to perish together.

During the time of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, five young individuals with unique skills wander into Chang'an, thus beginning a wuxia story as they venture into the Western Region.

Shui Ge (Qin Junjie) is the only person to escape the massacre of his whole family. He receives the teachings of a revered master and goes to Chang'an, the capital of the Tang Dynasty, to find a safe place to settle down. He becomes sworn brothers with Jin Ge (Wang Chuang), Yin Ge (Ran Xu), Tong Ge (Gao Haicheng) and Tie Ge (Cao Jun) and they brag about being chivalrous heroes. He also becomes lifelong friends with Sai Ma (Artemis Lou) and Ah Budu (You Haoran) who hail from the Persian Empire. The five men initially wanted to seek good prospects, but they mistakenly entered the house of Wang Yu Shi, not knowing that he is the backer of the Western Region gangs and their enemy from very the start.

Tang Yan is a substitute for the real daughter of the Tang family. On the day when the real daughter was found, Tang Yan was forced by her adoptive parents to marry a lame man. The old lady of the Huo family snatched her grandson's wife and brought Tang Yan back to the Huo family. The elders vowed to be responsible for Tang Yan, especially after knowing that she had given birth to a child for the Huo family. They wished that the two of them could get a marriage certificate immediately.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bao Bao Guai! Huai Zai Hou Bei Jin Yu Da Lao Bao Zhe Hong" (宝宝乖！怀崽后被禁欲大佬抱着哄) by Xiao Xiao Yun Yun (小小云云).

Shen Qing became the canon fodder of the book after travelling through time and space. She started pursuing Emperor Xuanyuan Ling in order to live a happy life in the palace, and he eventually developed feelings for Shen Qing during this time.

Chu Bei Chi, the Divine Warrior of Kunlun, fell into a coma saving the realm. Awakening in secret, he assumes the identity of a low-born son in the Chu Family. His rise defies all, restoring honor to his clan, crushing bloodthirsty bandits, and unraveling the legendary Cosmic Game. As empires tremble, he slays the treacherous chancellor and subdues ten thousand kingdoms, all while the Princess, Empress, Merchant Queen, and General vie for his heart. Now, the world bows before its true master.

The story is about Yu Tang, which is an ancestral descendant of Tang, who, in ancient times, made a heroic sacrifice. Tang Yu, in the present, accidentally finds a bottle containing medicinal power, which gives him the incredible ability to heal others.

Six years ago, An Ran, suffered a series of accidents such as the death of her mother in a car accident, accidental pregnancy, etc. After giving birth to twins, her stepsister took her son away and drove him abroad. Six years later, An Ran returned with her daughter to take revenge, finding her long-lost son and reuniting with the child's father, Situ Mo.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yi Tai San Bao: Zong Cai Die Di Zhui Qi Pao" (一胎三宝: 总裁爹地追妻跑) by Zi Su (紫苏).

Gu Qi Yan, a god who has lived for over two thousand years, was tricked by the old lady of the Shen family into signing a contract, obliging him to protect the Shen family three times, finally saving the second daughter, Shen Yu Zhen. After saving her, the contract should have been terminated, but the pendant split into two bodies, forcing him to stay within three meters of her. "You must stay closer to me from now on." "Be careful not to get into trouble!"

When strong-willed servant Huang Yu is wrongly accused during a Jinyiwei mission, she’s forced by stoic commander Lu Zhan to join the Northern Bureau as a constable. Gifted with a unique ability for solving crimes, Huang Yu uncovers shocking truths about her past. Amid perilous conspiracies and growing feelings for Lu Zhan, she rises from a humble maid to a fearless seeker of justice, determined to clear her family’s name.

Si Nian once regarded Shen Yan Ru as her salvation, but after witnessing his intimate behavior, she turned away and married Gu Lin Chuan, the head of the Gu family. At first, she thought it was a formal marriage, but later she was shocked to find that Gu Lin Chuan had been waiting for her silently for ten years.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Lun Xian! Dai Jin! Qing Leng Mei Ren Bei You Chan Kuang Chong" (沦陷！带劲！清冷美人被诱缠狂宠) by You Yi Li (幼一栗).

Due to family troubles, An Jing, an international student, served as Yan Liang Ye's kept woman for three years in Western Europe. Finally, upon completing her studies and returning home, she resolutely ended their relationship. That night, the usually calm and composed man suddenly lost his composure. He had thought that this time, like before, as long as he properly trimmed the kept woman's wings, she would return to his side. However, he never expected that this time the roles would be reversed; the kept woman was going to soar to her own sky, while he was left behind.

Five individuals, Lin Yuan Su, Die Qi, Qiu Ling, Xia Gu Duo, and Zhou Qi, meet while searching for a missing dog. Despite their differences, they form an agency to search for missing people. Over time, they develop a strong friendship and discover the true purpose of their work. As their bond deepens, Lin Yuan Su finds the courage to search for his own missing father, enlisting his friends' help.

Tang Wei Wei, closed off to love, unexpectedly falls for intern Li Shu after a series of comical misunderstandings. Just as she begins to find happiness, she learns Li Shu is the younger brother of her deceased first love—and his arrival was driven by revenge.

Due to family reasons, Wei Ran never believed in love until Xu Nuo appeared. His pursuit was passionate and firm, and finally moved her, and the two became husband and wife. But just three years after marriage, Xu Nuo cheated because he couldn't stand the dullness of marriage. After Wei Ran learned about it, she resolutely participated in her mother's scientific research before her death - freezing human technology, became a scientific research subject, and disappeared in Xu Nuo's world. But when she disappeared, Xu Nuo panicked.
dramas.t: Deep as the Sea Love Becomes Empty

dramas.syn: Game designer Shi Zi is transported into her own fantasy game, where she must tame spirits by cooking magical dishes to find her way home. Along the way, she teams up with a mysterious young man and uncovers a hidden conspiracy tied to his true identity. As she nears her goal, she realizes she’s fallen in love—but if she completes the game, will she lose him forever?

The "Three Herbs of Wumeng" promoted agriculture, animal husbandry, and cultural tourism, driving rural development. Miao embroidery artisans turned traditional skills into economic value, becoming intangible cultural heritage inheritors with products reaching nationwide and global markets. Village officials led efforts to link poverty alleviation with rural revitalization, advancing primary, secondary, and tertiary industries, and improving village conditions and residents' well-being.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Mo Dao Jun Xing Zao" (莫道君行早) by Ouyang Qian Sen (欧阳黔森).

Bai Fei Fei returns to the martial world seeking revenge, drawing hero Shen Lang, heiress Zhu Qi Qi, and the cunning Wang Lian Hua into a deadly clash over a powerful treasure, where love and betrayal blur the lines of loyalty.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Wu Lin Wai Shi" (武林外史) by Gu Long (古龙).

A struggling couple accidentally moves into a lavish mansion and discovers a hidden fortune. But as unexpected troubles follow, they begin to question whether their sudden luck is a blessing or a curse.

25-year-old Jiang Shi Qi is a struggling actress, always playing minor, insignificant roles. 25-year-old Liu Hao Qun is a carefree, frivolous rich kid. One day, she is on her way to a film shoot, while he is on a blind date. Their cars are parked side-by-side. Because his car is parked too close, she can't open the door and misses her acting opportunity. To get revenge on him, Jiang Shi Qi plays a woman dumped by him, ruining his blind date.

When Liu Hao Qun's grandmother finds out, she wants to meet Jiang Shi Qi. So they sign a contract, with Jiang Shi Qi pretending to be his girlfriend. The two initially intend for the grandmother to dislike her, but things go wrong; the grandmother likes her very much and even lets them both move into her large house. In the process of playing the contract couple, they gradually discover each other's good qualities.

dramas.nt: 年下娇夫对我一往情深
dramas.syn:
To take back her mother's company, Ye Qing Huan, the eldest daughter of the Ye family, planned to kill her father and keep her son. She chose Bo Yu Chuan in the club, but unexpectedly, Bo Yu Chuan was the richest man in Yancheng, with a net worth of hundreds of millions. He was in a car accident and lost his memory, and ended up getting together with Ye Qing Huan by accident.

In fact, Bo Yu Chuan fell deeply in love with Ye Qing Huan many years ago. After regaining his memory, he hid his identity and helped Ye Qing Huan recover his mother's company.

A story revolving around individuals who bought the same Fukubukuro online. Upon receiving a mysterious delivery, their lives take a spectacular turn. Even as modern men and women have different experiences and losses in romance, they continue to believe in love.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gong Zi He Shi Xiu" (公子何时休).
dramas.t: When Is the Son Off Season 2

dramas.syn: As a nanny, Gu Ci only did two things around Jiang Qi Yun, to please him and to please his son. In daily life, Jiang Qi Yun found that Gu Ci's smiles and frowns gradually overlapped with the girl in his memory, and the past slowly emerged.
dramas.t: How Can We Resist Her Charm

dramas.syn:
In university, the chubby girl Cheng Qing Miao had a secret relationship with Pei Huai Yu. After overhearing Pei Yu Zhi say that being with her was just for fun, she decisively broke up with him on her own. Seven years later, Cheng Qing Miao has slimmed down, changed her name to Ni Wu, and takes her daughter Sui Sui, who suffers from heart disease, to see a doctor—only to find that the doctor is Pei Huai Yu. As time goes by, Pei Huai Yu keeps seeing traces of Cheng Qing Miao in Ni Wu and gradually falls for her again.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wu Se Mi Mi" (雾色靡靡), also known as "Bie Hou Chong Feng, Pei Yi Sheng Zhui Qi Tao Lu Duo" (别后重逢，裴医生追妻套路多), by Chen Ruo Zhuo (陈若舟).

New SWAT instructor Tan Yan and Captain Liao Bu Fan, who had difficulty cooperating, gradually become united in their thinking. The SWAT team also gets better and better under their leadership. Tan Yan mistakenly became a "hero" in a case, gave up his "honor" after discovering the truth, and successfully completed the task of the "Hidden Front" plan.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Cang Feng" (藏锋) by Lu Zheng (吕铮).

Extremely Urgent takes place after the fall of the Qing Dynasty in 1911. Thanks to the weak post-Qing warlord government, thieves from all over have their eyes on the country’s treasures, many of which have fallen into the hands of the people. He Cai wants to protect a treasure map that may lead to the 64 volumes of the Yongle Encyclopedia, so he creates and becomes the leader of a treasure protection organization named Dancing Sand.However, he doesn’t bargain on meeting Chen Mo, an American-raised Chinese-boxing expert who returns to Shanghai to hunt down a precious artifact. After her birth father was killed when she was thirteen, Chen Mo was rescued and adopted by an American man named Henry, who taught her the ways of treasure hunting. Although she and He Cai are initially on opposite sides, they find themselves drawn to one another and fall in love.

The mysterious wife of the president of the Shaw Group is going to get her first job ever. She will be an intern at her husband's company. But the rumor has it: she never graduated from high school! Will she survive the workplace?
