A girl who lives a difficult life but strives for self-improvement met and fell in love with the indifferent CEO Fu Xuan Yi. Fu Xuan Yi's favor freed Wei Yu Xian from the shackles of her family, and the two finally lived happily together.

In the huge city of Beijing, Zhao Ping Jin and Xi Tang went from passionate love to breakup, reunited after separation, and finally overcame the obstacles of reality, faced their inner selves and got back together.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jing Luo Zai Wu Jia Ren" (京洛再无佳人) by Qiao Wei An (乔维安).
dramas.t: Cross the Ocean of Time to Love You

dramas.syn:
Yu Jing and Gu Jiahui have been married for three years, but they've been too busy with their careers to think about starting a family. When Yu Jing's mother-in-law, accompanied by her niece, forcefully intrudes into their lives and pressures them to have children, their marriage is pushed to the brink of danger. Little do they know, behind this chaotic situation lies a sinister conspiracy. In the end, the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law join forces to confront their cunning former father-in-law.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jian Nan Bei Yun" (艰难备孕) by Xiao Zhi Qing Diao (晓之情调).

Carrying the blood feud of her mother, the once innocent An Chu Xia completely transformed and turned into a dark revenge queen. Her goal is clear: to take back everything that was stolen and make her enemies pay the price. To this end, she carefully set up a plan and locked her sights on Shi Mo, the powerful head of the Shi Group. She deliberately approached him and lured him into the love web she had woven, even at the risk of using herself as a pawn. 

However, under Shi Mo's strong and precise emotional conquests, An Chu Xia was horrified to find that not only did she fail to control the overall situation and retreat unscathed, but she also sank step by step in the whirlpool of desire and sincerity, and even lost the heart that should have beaten only for revenge.

dramas.nt: 捡个男神做老公 第二季
dramas.syn:
Gu Liang is the head of an entertainment company where her ex-husband Jiang Yun Ze is the CEO. A position he got when he married Gu Liang. She is murdered for her company shares by her cheating ex-husband and sister Gu Su Yan. Somehow she gets a second chance to go back one year and change her life.

Changing the decisions she made back then stirs up trouble with her ex-husband and sister, but also leads to meeting a mysterious young man whom she offers an acting contract to. Who is the young man, how will she avoid falling into the same traps and is she able to find her true love along the way?

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Bright Stars: Pick A Boss To Be A Husband" (星光璀璨: 捡个boss做老公) by Ake Culture (阿柯文化).

At her engagement party, An He, the only daughter of a wealthy family, catches her fiancé Chen Yi Fan and his best friend having an affair. He harms her, forcing her into an intimate relationship with her fiancé's uncle, Chen Wang. To exact revenge on Chen Yi Fan, An He decides to marry him and become his aunt. As they spend time together, Chen Wang gradually discovers that An He is the woman he's been yearning for.
dramas.t: He Yue Qi Jian Ai Shang Ta

dramas.syn: The Sixth Prince Xiao Shi Qing wants revenge against the Crown Prince Xiao Yan for causing the death of his mother. He seeks the aid of the Grand Eunuch Pei Huai Zhi, but the Grand Eunuch has his own agenda. He aims to take control of the throne by making the Sixth Prince his puppet. Shi Qing agrees to become Huai Zhi's puppet and thus begins their collaboration.

On the day Ruan Chao Yang is about to become a full-time employee, she is laid off. By chance, she meets Cheng Huai Zhou, and her life trajectory changes from that moment on. With his recommendation, Ruan Chao Yang secures an opportunity at the top consulting firm, Maxwell. Relying on strong resilience, she gains a firm foothold and grows from a newcomer into an independent business analyst.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yang Cheng Pian Cha" (养成偏差) by Qiu Dao Yu He San Zhi Mao (秋刀鱼和三只猫).

Jiang Shuo accidentally took over the business of buying and selling houses, where gruesome murders took places. Together with his partner Qin Yi Heng, through his bravery and ingenuity, as well as his determination to break the stigma around the houses, he helps the homeowners to break the rumors and allow the buildings to return to the market for sale. But is it really true that the bad reputation of the locations is based only on urban legend or do those buildings really hide some dark secrets?

~~ Adapted from the novel "Haunted Houses Handbook" (凶宅笔记) by Er Shi San (贰十三).

dramas.nt: 冷漠老公成了悲伤小狗
dramas.syn:
18-year-old Xu Chu Nian confessed to her crush, and woke up 6 years later after a hangover. As far as she knows, the 24-year-old her is acting like a fool. Her husband, whom she has secretly loved for many years, is disappointed, and the child is not close to her. The 24-year-old her doesn't know what's going on, but the 18-year-old Xu Chu Nian is loved by everyone! When the dust settled, she found out that this is not an ordinary time travel at all.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jing! Mei Shao Nv Yi Jiao Xing Lai Hai Zi San Sui!" (惊！美少女一觉醒来孩子三岁！), also known as "Hun Hou, Leng Mo Lao Gong Cheng Le Bei Shang Xiao Gou" (婚后，冷漠老公成了悲伤小狗) by Yu Yi Er (余宜尔).

It tells the story of Su Wan Wan, the most beautiful young lady in Xijing. On the surface, she is a canary kept by her adoptive father, Su Yu, but in reality, she is a black lotus flower plotting revenge. She uses her beauty to lure the tyrannical Prince Gong Lin into a trap, but is instead redeemed by Gong Lin's love. The two go from mutual exploitation to mutual redemption, and ultimately join hands to overthrow the Su family's conspiracy.

Yan Xi Zhi poured her heart and soul into her eight-year marriage, becoming a free caregiver in her ex-husband's eyes. After the divorce, however, she became the only "cure" for Huo Yan Ting, a powerful figure in Hong Kong. Huo Yan Ting signed a contract with her to help her divorce and escape her ex-husband's family.

In this mutually beneficial relationship, she used the opportunity to turn her life around, publicly humiliating her ex-husband, breaking free from the shackles of her family of origin, and becoming an independent woman admired by all. Huo Yan Ting's devoted protection gradually melted her frozen heart, and the two moved from a contractual relationship to genuine affection, spending the rest of their lives together in happiness.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gang San Shi Sui, Zheng Shi Huan Nan Ren De Hao Nian Ji" (刚三十岁，正是换男人的好年纪), also known as "Ta Ren Jian Qing Xing,…

Sun Guang Ming, the secretary of the Youth League Committee of the Bureau of Commerce, went to Dahuaishu Village as the first secretary in order to strengthen the grassroots training. He wanted to keep the results in the village and easily complete the tenure tasks, but because of the "poisonous vegetable incident", he was faced with the tricky work of removing the village.
Xu Hong, a reporter who reported on the "poisonous vegetable incident," was condemned from the heart to come back to rectify the name of Dahuaishu Village, which undoubtedly added chaos to Sun Guang Ming. Villager Liu Yu Jiu also returned to the village at this time, eager to seize the weakness of Liu Shi Rong, the parent of the Liu family, and tempted him to stand on the side of supporting the removal of the village.
The removal of the village seemed to be a foregone conclusion. Unexpectedly, the villagers held a…

On her wedding day, Heng Tian realizes that someone is out to kill her and her husband General Lin Xian. Fortunately, she has a device that makes it possible to travel back in time. She uses this several times in order to counter whatever plan there is to prevent her from marrying the love of her life. This includes solving a murder case that is related to the wedding. But there seems to be someone or something who keeps interfering.

Ye Ke Le, an unlucky person, operates a tea shop in Wanle City that his father left him. Unexpectedly, he becomes entangled in a mysterious murder case involving a strange perfume. To assist in the investigation, he becomes a patrol guard, unintentionally turning into a spy.

Bizarre events continue to occur, and the clues become increasingly convoluted. He meets a Japanese girl named Ruo Ye and, based on Japanese spice clues, deduces to Princess Qi. Ye Ke Le falls in love with Princess Qi at first sight.

To clear his name and find Princess Qi, he uses his sensitive nose to search for clues. The clues were missed due to a broken river bank. He then traces it back to Jiu Ruo Shui and Lan Qing Yue using wine and on-site evidence. Lan Qing Yue is silenced, Jiu Ruo Shui awakens, rebels against the true instigator, and with the accidental guidance of Xiao Qi and the help of Ruo Ye, they…
dramas.t: Fate of Broom Star and Lucky Star

dramas.syn: Li Yan Hao, a freshman wrongly accused of being a pervert after trying to help someone, sees his reputation ruined. Feeling lost, he joins Yu Lan's team to create a short film and finds a new direction and purpose despite the team's lack of experience.

The son of a convicted astronomer from the Imperial Observatory follows the clues left in his father's secret notes. Teaming up with the Ninth Princess, a skilled healer, they unravel a series of bizarre cases involving witchcraft, divine lightning, and earth-shattering sorcery. But as they peel back the layers of mystery, all signs point to a prophecy in the mysterious tome —the prophecy that says, "Two Fish Doom the Nation."

The drama mainly talks about the electrician Lao Lin who is frustrated in the workplace. To protect the life of his wife and daughter, he unexpectedly received a mysterious huge sum of money after he failed to get a promotion. According to their assigned tasks, everyone was involved in a star abduction case. The five were forced to flee together and accidentally learned each other's true identities on the way. What happened was not a coincidence. A bizarre adventure belonging to social animals officially started.

Jiang Li, a female forensic medicine student, accidentally enters the world of the character trial game. She can only return to the real world by helping the game NPC character Shen Xiu Ning solve the case together. Jiang Li relied on modern scientific techniques to repeatedly solve strange cases, and found that he had fallen deeply in love with Shen Xiuning, but the two had to face separation...

Qin Luo Yan, a skilled weapons designer, finds herself transported into the body of the unlucky second daughter of General Qin in the Nanyue Kingdom. Despite her delicate appearance, she is oppressed by authority and forced into a marriage with an old man old enough to be her father, all for the sake of political gain.

Not one to be bound by traditional rules like a well-behaved young lady, Qin Luo Yan devises a bold plan to escape the marriage. Seizing the opportunity, she involves herself with the infamous Prince Xuanwu, Fu Zi Mo, notorious for his frequent visits to brothels. After spending a passionate night with him, she successfully achieves her goal of avoiding the marriage.

She initially believes she can now roam the world as she pleases, but who know that Prince Xuanwu is like a persistent shadow, sticking to her like glue and impossible to get rid of.

dramas.nt: 厉总我真的只是来报恩的
dramas.syn: During their student days, the two fell in love and briefly dated for a week. Li Yu Chuan was then dumped miserably. Many years later, they met by chance in a bar and had a one-night stand. He made a deal to get Shen Zhi Yu to marry him. He said he would take revenge on her every day! But he was hooked instead.
dramas.t: Li Zong Wo Zhen De Zhi Shi Lai Fu En De

dramas.syn:
Su Mian is actually the eldest daughter of the Jiang family in Beijing. Everyone thinks she is an uneducated, ugly, and dark country girl, not as good as the Jiang family's little daughter Jiang Wan Er. Little did they know that Su Mian is a hidden boss who is an all-around in medicine, academics, hacking, and martial arts. She slaps everyone in the face again and again, and makes the first boss in Beijing from an iceberg president into a wife-loving maniac.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Zu Zong Ta Shi Quan Neng Da Lao" (小祖宗她是全能大佬) by Qiu Liu Ying (秋流萤).
dramas.t: Xing Guang Bu Ji Ta Yao Yan

dramas.nt: 穿书求生指南：请勿对NPC动心
dramas.syn: Online writer Su Xing Xing accidentally traveled into the sadistic novel she wrote, and was bound to a strategy system. She needed the hero Li Yan Chen's love value for her to drop to negative 100 before she could travel back to reality. Su Xing Xing acted like a demon and slapped Li Yan Chen in the face, but found that Li Yan Chen's love value for her was full. Su Xing Xing was shocked to find that Li Yan Chen had another identity.

Li Chao Chao, the daughter of a nanny, has been secretly in love with Zhou Mu, the young master of her employer's family, for years. However, the social disparity and the disdain of his mother have left her feeling insecure. To be worthy of Zhou Mu, she gave up her passion for comics and transformed herself to meet his standards, but gradually lost herself. With the support of her parents and her good friend Chen Chi, she realized that this relationship was only draining her and resolutely decided to let go. After returning to comics, she found her direction in life and blossomed, discovering the true love that Chen Chi had been silently protecting.

~~ Adapted from the short story "Chao Chao Lai Chi" (朝朝來池) by Er Fen Zhi Yi Tian Kong (二分之一天空).

Lawyer Wen Xi unexpectedly discovers that she and Yan Zhao were switched at birth. After being reunited with her birth family, she is forced into a marriage with business tycoon Shang Chen due to family interests. The couple begins as strangers in a "contractual marriage." 

Wen Xi must contend with her adoptive mother's favoritism, her adoptive sister Yan Zhao's constant scheming, and the challenges of her legal work. The rigid yet deeply affectionate Shang Chen steadfastly protects his wife, gradually melting Wen Xi's heart with his meticulous care. Through mutual adjustment, they lower their defenses and become honest with each other, moving from a respectful relationship to a mutual commitment.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xin Hun Man Shu" (新婚慢熟), also known as "Shang Xian Sheng, Xin Hun Qing Jie Zhi!" (商先生，新婚请节制！), by Jie Jie (芥婕).

A girl accidentally arrives in a world inhabited only by men. Through her experiences, she finds love and friendship and learns the meaning of sacrifice.

Wang You Ya is dealing with two big blows in her life. Not only is she distressed because of the boy that she likes, but she also fights for her life because of a terminal illness. When she decides to participate in a hibernation experiment, she surprisingly awakes in a world full of men. Because of how rare she is, You Ya is hailed as a goddess.

Si Yao's family was destroyed overnight, her father jumped off a building, her mother was mentally ill, and she was also auctioned off as an item. Unexpectedly, she met Feng Li, who came to the auction to find the Wheel of Fortune diamond necklace in order to find out the truth about his parents' death.

Ten years ago, the Feng family was destroyed, Feng Li's parents died in a car accident. He was rescued by the leader of the Black Water organization, KING, and trained to grow up to be the second in command of Black Water. Ten years later, Feng Li looked at Si Yao and thought of himself at the beginning. He was soft-hearted and saved her. Of course, it could also be that the old man fell in love at first sight.

In the eighth year of the Tianyuan era, Yue Qian Xue is betrayed and killed in battle, followed by Hua Qing Ming’s failure to protect the capital, leading to widespread chaos. To change this tragic fate, Zhuge Ren Feng sacrifices his lifespan to send them back two years in time. Reborn in the sixth year of Tianyuan, Yue Qian Xue and Hua Qing Ming must join forces to rewrite destiny and save their world from destruction.

During the Late Qing Dynasty, the Thirteen Hongs in Guangzhou served as a window for trade and cultural exchange between China and the world, disseminating Eastern civilization to the globe. The story follows the Guangdong merchants, led by Lin Bing Yuan, and their cunning and courageous teamwork with the Guangdong Customs Supervisor, as they engaged in friendly trade with the East India Company and the United States. Amidst internal and external turmoil, they persevered, saving the people and upholding China's spirit of independence.

The drama takes place in republican-era China in Hengshan Hospital, centered primarily on the conflict between the Communist Party and the KMT in 1930s Shanghai.

Ma Tian Ming is a faithless, greedy, and selfish man who makes a living by cheating and lying. A coincidental accident drags Ma Tian Ming into a case in which he becomes the suspect. Trying to escape, he impersonated the chief doctor of Hengshan Hospital, Cai Li Kun. However, Ma Tian Ming soon found out that Cai Li Kun is a member of the underground Communist Party.

dramas.nt: 服了她满级你惹她干嘛
dramas.syn: The super female killer was reborn in the ugly girl Qiao Ying. After gaining insight into the main body's life experience, she vented her anger for Qiao Ying, and accidentally saved Qin Shi Yan, the most powerful man in the imperial capital. Qin Shi Yan became very interested in this girl with a strange appearance but great personality.
dramas.t: The Reborn Girlfriend Is a Big Shot

dramas.syn: Su Nian An was forced to separate from her childhood sweetheart, Gu Ling Xiao. When they reunited, she was a mechanic. He was the captain. After experiencing plane failures, workplace conspiracies, family entanglements and other tests, Su Nian An went from being inferior to being brave, and Gu Ling Xiao always protected her.

dramas.nt: 是机器人的话，结个婚也没关系吧？
dramas.syn: Zhang Jin Ye, who is afraid of men, received a "top AI boyfriend" from her bestie on her birthday. Seeing the "robot" Xiao Xu Xu, who looked exactly like her crush Shen Shi Xu, she believed it to be true. Since it was a machine, she gradually let down her guard and even chose to fulfill her grandmother's wish.
dramas.t: Is It Okay to Get Married with a Robot?

dramas.syn: Ye Zhi Qiu infiltrates the Zhou family as the fifth concubine to uncover her sister’s mysterious death. Inside the mansion, she meets the enigmatic eldest son, Zhou Yi Mo, and together they navigate hidden dangers, unravel family secrets, and find love amid suspense and intrigue.

An old case from ten years ago affected the world of several people. Ten years have passed, and fate has brought these people together, and they will eventually solve the mystery together.

A woman fell to her death from a building. Xiao Yi took orders at the critical moment but found that there was a secret hidden behind the case, which seemed to be related to the captain Lu Guo Xun. Facing all kinds of new cases, Xiao Yi and the team slowly got along, from strangers to familiarity, from differences to unity. At the same time, Xiao Yi also attracted the attention of another person, Bai Zhe, the son of the victim in the unsolved case investigated by Lu Guo Xun. Xiao Yi discovered that Bai Zhe was also investigating the matter, and his methods were somewhat extreme, so he repeatedly tried to dissuade him. But Bai Zhe has always insisted on revenge in his own way.

After peeling off the…

Wrongfully accused, Mei Ping is reborn as a servant but fights her way back to the powerful Dongfang family for justice. With Lan Wei Xing’s help, she exposes corruption, challenges oppression, and empowers women to break free and reclaim their futures.

In order to raise money for her grandmother's medical expenses, Li Xing took a part-time job as a custom girlfriend. An encounter brought her into contact with a notorious rich kid, but she didn't know that she had been regarded as his prey. The more she avoided him, the more fiercely he pursued her!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bo Li Yan" (玻璃焰), also known as "Si Wen" (私吻), by Mei Lu Bi Bi (美绿哔哔).

Shen Mo Lin, a top-tier soul receiver, unexpectedly takes on a B-level mission and encounters Lu Zhao Ning, who is plagued by bad luck. Amidst struggles in the underworld, system anomalies, and memory seals, the two gradually awaken to the truth—they are reincarnated lovers forced apart by a conspiracy. 

Facing obstruction and treachery from the higher-ups of the Bureau, they join hands to uncover the truth across time and space—a forbidden love between a reincarnated god and a human soul.

A struggling musician, Liu Ma, travels to Lincang, Yunnan to collect a debt, only to be drawn into the lives of a group of sincere, music-loving locals. As he bonds with them and joins a high-stakes music competition, their shared journey forces Liu Ma to confront his own disillusionment.

After failing to make a career in Beijing, Wang Can has no choice but to return to his hometown to seek support. With his parents' recommendation, he is offered a position as an embalmer at QingLing Mountain funeral parlor, which he accepts as a temporary fix to his problems. There, he is reunited with his three childhood friends: Chen He Xu, Song Tian Shuang, and Mao Er Zhe. 

Working alongside them, Wang Can begins to understand the value and meaning of the funeral business, and with each farewell, he gradually learns to become an excellent undertaker. When faced with the decision of returning to the city or staying at QingLing Mountain, Wang Can decides to stay with his friends to maintain the funeral profession.

Bao Zheng is a man who has solved multiple cases in Kaifeng and Yu Rou is a young woman wholeheartedly devoted to him. Liu E is the beloved concubine of the Song Emperor but she conspires with Zhang De Lin in a quest for more power.

~~ Adapted from the novel "San Xia Wu Yi" (三侠五义) by Shi Yu Kun (石玉崑).

The well-known writer Han Xi wanted to propose to his fiancée Jiang Lai at the signing ceremony, but received a message from his girlfriend who died in a car accident. Han was sorrowful and unexpectedly came to parallel. Different time and space, and the time of different time and space is two months later than the original world. The mysterious diary brought in contact with the current Jiang Lai is inextricably linked, and the rescue plan is about to begin.

Princess Sheng Tao Tao of Sheng Xuan Kingdom is an upright and kind-hearted person, but because of her rebellious behaviors, which are incomprehensible to people, she causes the emperor a lot of headaches and is sent back to her fiefdom, Qingcheng, to reflect on her growth story.

Qingcheng was originally a rich and fertile place, famous for its garment-making culture, but as the young and strong gradually went out to work, leaving only the elderly and children to guard their homes, the skill of garment-making was gradually lost. Sheng Tao Tao was born with a love of beauty, and when she was relegated to the fiefdom, she witnessed the old people's unique dressmaking skills and resolved to promote them.

After Sheng Tao Tao's series of actions, the court issued an order on old age care, innovating a series of old age care practices. Spreading the culture of respecting and loving the…

The Demon Lord Feng Xiao Xiao was gravely injured during an ambush by the cultivators of Qingyun Sect. To escape, she had no choice but to let her spirit leave her body to lead the pursuers away. However, upon her spirit's return, she discovered that her physical body had been burned by Zhaqing Master Li Zi Mu, who also took her life-bound magical weapon, the Fengming Sword. With no other choice, Feng Xiao Xiao's spirit entered the body of a courtesan named Su Su. In order to regain her power and retrieve the Fengming Sword, she was forced to approach Li Zi Mu under the guise of Su Su.

Li Zi Mu, on the other hand, noticed that whenever he came into contact with Su Su, the seal on the divine stone within him began to react strangely. As both sides cautiously probed and investigated each other, their interactions evolved into a romantic and playful tug-of-war.

As the story unfolds, the…

In a quiet coastal town, two mysterious murders disrupt the peaceful lives of single mother Li Xiu Lan and her daughter Li Yan, as an unexpected police investigation draws them into a chilling web of secrets.

After Sang Lu’s personality awakens, she strives to change the tragic fate of the “vicious supporting female” she has become. Determined to build a good relationship with her mute husband, Feng Yan — who suffers from aphasia — she uses her bright, talkative, and sunny nature to gently heal him. Under her warmth, Feng Yan gradually overcomes his psychological barriers, learns to speak again, and falls in love with her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Gei Ya Ba Zong Cai Zuo Hua Liao, Hao Men Quan Meng Le" (我给哑巴总裁做话疗，豪门全懵了) by Lu Chi (鹿迟).
dramas.t: The Mute Tycoon's Battle with Cancer

dramas.syn:
A female forensic doctor who died unjustly and then traveled back to the Republic of China era, a powerful and ambitious police chief, and a shocking massacre that wiped out an entire family in Shuncheng, all lead to a twenty-year-old unsolved mystery. Watch as the female forensic doctor navigates the power struggles within a wealthy family, and how she teams up with the police chief to solve numerous bizarre cases. Together, they are invincible!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Shao Shuai Mei Tian Du Zai Chi Cu 2: Fu Ren You Qu Ming An Xian Chang Le" (少帅每天都在吃醋2：夫人又去命案现场了) by Ba Xun (八寻).

A daughter from a loving family learns that she has two dads when she meets her birth father in the most unexpected way and realizes that the father she knows and respects is actually her stepfather.
 When she graduated from university, Wang Xiao Mi has already fallen in love with the talk shows industry in China. She manages to impress investor Ke Lei during an open mic session and gets hired for a job. Wang Xiao Mi invites her parents to watch her performance. However, her mom Luo Qing catches a glimpse of Ke Lei who turns out to be her ex-husband that she hasn't seen in twenty years.

Shen Yan, who was deeply in love, went to meet Fu Feng's parents. She was humiliated by Fu Qing Zhou and then had a car accident. When she woke up, it was five years later. She had become Fu Qing Zhou's wife and had a son. While exploring the truth, she had constant disputes with Fu Feng and others.
dramas.t: Qing Shu Lai Zi Wu Nian Hou

dramas.syn:
Ms. Liang Qing Yan and Song Yuan Ye star in a secret love rescue story that spans five years. The "whimsical" childhood friend Song Yuan Ye, despite appearing slovenly, actually accompanies Liang Qing Yan with deep affection. After Liang Qing Yan loses his memory, he secretly unravels a conspiracy, making the two become closer again in the midst of crises, with a mutual emotional tension that is irresistible.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhan You! Qiang Duo! You Ta Ru Huai" (占有！抢夺！诱她入怀) by Jin Li King (锦鲤King).

Healing Master is the sequel to the 2014 hit movie The Breakup Guru. This time focusing on an office with the goal of bringing couples back together instead of breaking them up, the story will mix romance with suspense in an exceptional way.

This is a cartoonist virtual planet, the same planet as Earth, only there is no love.
Scientist Li Ruoer discovered and used a drug that stimulates the emotion of love. Inadvertently, company leader Yan Yan also accidentally drank the love medicine. "Only two" people on the planet can feel love and start making up all kinds of cute and touching love stories.

At the fifth anniversary celebration of Xiao Xu and Qi Jing Luo's wedding, Qi Jing Luo's half-sister, Qi Tong Tong, suddenly appeared and shocked the audience by asking Qi Jing Luo to return her fiancé to her. Qi Tong Tong deliberately pushed Qi Jing Luo down, causing her to have a miscarriage, but Xiao Xu left first, holding Qi Tong Tong. This made Qi Jing Luo realize her mistake and decide to divorce Xiao Xu.

In the first year of the Zaichu era, Tang Dynasty, a bizarre suicide resembling a ghost-summoning ritual shocks Yuezhou’s West District. Investigating the case, Si Wen, the young magistrate of Yue Prefecture, discovers the victim is none other than Liu Zhao Di, a once-renowned courtesan he once loved deeply. But as the seventh day of her death arrives, abandoned infants rise as vengeful mountain spirits, unraveling a meticulously planned retribution...
1949, Yelu Qi, a talented private detective, solves hard to crack cases at the dawn of the communist regime with a common thread: a fleeing Kuomintang spy.

Yun Shitong's father Yun Ding suddenly goes missing during her wedding. Leng Feng tells Duan Fei that his father's death is likely to have been closely connected to Yun Ding. At the same time, Hong Ding company is on the brink of collapse and Han Zhiming works with his father to go against Yun Shitong. Shortly after, Yun Ding dies from an accident and Duan Fei goes missing. Various evidences point to Duan Fei as the murderer. Can Shi Tong solve the mystery?

In the near future, a game development company, Cooltron, has developed a love game called "Listening to the Heartbeat". To promote the test game, Cooltron organizes a competition with a special bonus in which Yan Xiao Yu participates. According to the system, she is matched with engineer Ji Yun Feng. The ultimate clearance condition of this game is the heartbeat of both parties.

dramas.nt: 幸孕双宝：爹地每天都在装穷
dramas.syn: Shen Ru Chu was setting up a stall in the night market and was attacked by a cute girl who asked her to marry the richest man Song Yan Chen. In order to get rid of her stepmother's pressure to get married, Shen Ru Chu agreed to a flash marriage. Song Yan Chen also agreed to avoid harassment, but asked to conceal his identity. After the two received the certificate, Song Yan Chen pretended to be poor and started to make trouble. When they started to fall in love, Song Yan Chen's ex-wife returned to China.
dramas.t: Xing Yun Shuang Bao: Die Di Mei Tian Du Zai Zhuang Qiong

dramas.syn: After a car accident, Shen Xing Chen awakens to find his soul transported three years into the future, inhabiting the body of his twin brother, He Yu Chuan. Now living under a false identity, he faces constant tests from his former lover, Jiang Mu Yi. As they work together to uncover the truth behind the accident and reveal a deeper conspiracy, their love story finds a new beginning.

As the Deputy Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, Zhang Yi harbors a bloody vendetta, biding his time in silence. Outwardly, he joins forces with Shen You Zhi of the Imperial Guards to track down criminals, their relationship evolving from confrontation to cooperation. In secret, however, he is the mastermind pulling the strings of revenge. When all conspiracies converge towards an end, a meticulously crafted trap for justice suddenly springs shut. The fates of all involved collide violently in this moment, culminating in a final choice amidst a labyrinth of espionage and shadows.

In Fengtian, a city embroiled in warlord conflicts during the Republic of China era, a jade Buddha head is mysteriously stolen, and the opera troupe leader lies dead on the stage, pushing the cold-blooded young marshal Xu You An and the Kunqu opera star Rong Xiao Nan into an irreconcilable conflict.

Soon after, a head is found, but only the fake one,  and the discrepancy between the real and fake Buddha heads triggers a series of murders, unraveling a long-buried bloodbath and entangling the fates of the three people - Xu You An, Rong Xiao Nan and Jiang Chun Er.

There is such a website where as long as you pay a few dollars and set up a password, you can easily enter the world of novels and leave home to live the adventure. Every time you enter this world, the following experiences will automatically generate novels. When new novelist Lan Pi saw this introduction, he clicked, closed his eyes, so he entered the VR world and so began the amusing love story between the gentle king of the Black Sheep Tribe and the foolish and upright women of the wolf tribe.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Pi Zhe Lang Pi De Yang" (披着狼皮的羊) by Hei Quan (黑圈) and Bai Dian (白点).
dramas.t: Lian Ai Zi Dong Sheng Cheng

dramas.nt: 福到万家：团宠厂花献祥瑞
dramas.syn: He Xiu Wan, who was forced to drop out of school, originally only wanted to apply for a part-time job, but she was hunted as a little white rabbit, and even got pregnant with triplets overnight! It is rumored that Mr. Huo in the imperial capital is cold and ruthless and extremely misogynistic. There is even the possibility of extinction of his family, but he can't control his possessive desire for her. He originally just wanted to take He Xiu Wan home to give birth to a child, but he fell deeper and deeper. Vampire family bullies his wife? Teach them a lesson! Colleagues in the factory bully his wife? Dismiss and ban them all!
dramas.t: Fu Dao Wan Jia: Tuan Chong Chang Hua Xian Xiang Rui

dramas.syn: Li Jing Nian and Lin Xiao Ran travel to Chang’an, unraveling a string of mysterious and unsettling cases along the way. With each investigation, they come closer to exposing the true culprit behind the chaos plaguing the empire. Through relentless pursuit of justice and intense confrontations, they fight to restore order and bring peace back to Chang’an.
dramas.t: The Crime Unit of Tang Dynasty

dramas.nt: 幽兰湖之御厨驾到第二季
dramas.syn: The story continues from Consort Yi's arrival into the present day, which further complicates the existing love triangle that has been bogging the main couple. Who does Xiao Hao Zi really love? Is she in his past or in his present?

dramas.nt: 古董局中局之鉴墨寻瓷
dramas.syn:
After passing on the shame of the traitor to the grandfather, Wumai's successor followed the training and traced the old dynasty of the antique counterfeiting group, but otherwise, the sympathetic medicine turned to the old dynasty. During the tracing, he learned that the Qingming Shanghe collection in the Forbidden City was a fake. This is a trap set by the Hong Kong auction company Berylian, which intends to monopolize the domestic antique and fake market. 

Wishing to make a fortune, he had to join forces with Lao Chao Feng, or together with the medicine, and the twists and turns finally proved that the Forbidden City had concealed it as a genuine product. However, Lao Chao Feng Lao Chou did not show up as promised. Wishing and Huang Yanyan have gone through hardships and hardships, competing with the old dynasty for the five cans of blue and white porcelain. 

With the help of the…

A story of love and hatred among four women unravels due to a missing person's case that sheds light on the permanent scars left by school bullying.
Chen Qian receives clues to a case involving a woman's disappearance and his investigations on Han Xiaoting lead him to discover a chilling incident that took place in a school ten years ago. Her seat mates Liu Tao, Zhang Beilei and Chai Zijing once left a thorn in her heart.

Police detective Zhao Yi Chen's wife, Hu Jia Ying, who is six months pregnant, disappears one day leaving behind nothing but an 11-second emergency call. Nine years later, he receives a letter that leads him to a stranger's home, where he learns that his wife has been dead for a year and has left behind a mute 9-year old daughter.

The drama tells both the story of Zhao Yi Chen's relationship with Hu Jia Ying and his investigation of the strange circumstances of her death, in which he uncovers shocking information about her.

~~  Adapted from the novel "The Twelfth Second" (第十二秒) by Sunness (从阳).
A woman and a CEO hide their identity from each other and pretend to be poor. Will they fall in love with each other?
dramas.t: Zong Cai, Kan Wo Men Shei Geng Qiong

dramas.nt: 白小姐的人生被剧透了
dramas.syn: Bai Si Yue received a trailer for a costume idol drama on her phone. The heroine Bai Jun Zhu in the drama looked exactly like her! And the hero, General Duanmu, turned out to be the new director, Duanmu Wen Yu! Strangely, what happened in reality overlapped with the plot. In order to prevent the plot in the trailer from happening, Bai Si Yue began her journey to change her fate.

A group of young patients with serious illnesses meet in the hospital and form a bond. Cheng Hui, a first-time cancer patient, and Lu Yu Qing, a sickly overachiever, are guided by Tie Yi, a long-term patient. They support each other with optimism and humor, facing their challenges together. Among them are Li Zong, with ovarian cancer; Tian Ran, who has autism; and Tang Tang, in a vegetative state. Together, they find hope and strength, looking forward to brighter days ahead.

Amid the ups and downs of marriage, Yan Li Dong and Mu Chen Xi find their fates intertwined. Misunderstandings and conflicts push them to the brink of divorce. However, when Yan Li Dong is injured while saving Mu Chen Xi, he unexpectedly loses his memory, causing his mind to revert to that of a 19-year-old. As they navigate this unexpected turn, Mu Chen Xi begins to realize the neglect and indifference she once showed. Through her time with her husband, whose heart and memories remain at 19, she gradually rediscovers the power of love and its sweetness.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ting Shuo Ni Wai Mian You Gou Le? Li Hun!" (听说你外面有狗了? 离婚!) by Xiang Bei (向北).

Since her mother fell into a coma and became a vegetable, Fu Rao had been disliked by her father and stepmother. The family favored her younger sister Fu Shu. Due to the broken capital chain of the Fu Group, Fu Rao was designed by her family to seduce and marry Ji Yuan, the head of a wealthy family who was rumored to need a woman to prolong his life. 

Fu Rao was forced to agree to the marriage, but in fact, she secretly contacted the Night Owl Lord, the only one who could tie with Ji Yuan, to snatch the bride at her wedding, but she didn't know that the Night Owl Lord and Ji Yuan were originally the same person.

During the Republican era in Shanghai, bizarre cases occurred one after another. The psychic Wu Yue forms an all-female investigative team with a policewoman, a forensic doctor, and a sketch artist, joining forces to solve strange cases such as corpse reanimation and serial murders. The wealthy young master Ji Wen Xuan, whom Wu Yue comes to know, harbors secrets. As the investigation unfolds, family conspiracies, the darkness of human nature, and plans for revenge gradually come to light.

(Soource: Chinese = iQiyi || Translation = MyDramaList)

Everything is going great for Du Lala. Now in her 30s, the insecurities of her younger years are behind her. She is happily married to Wang Wei and is the HR manager at work and is about to face a promotion to become the HR director. But Lala’s complacent life is challenged when a new employee shows up in the form of Kathy, a beautiful woman in her 20s whose professional star shines brighter than Lala’s.

 Not only does Kathy threaten to take Lala’s promotion away from her, she also turns out to be a beloved former student of Wei’s mother and is well-liked by the whole Wang family, including Wei himself. To make matters worse, Kathy moves into the apartment right below Lala and Wei! Can Lala defend her career and her marriage from her new archenemy?

~~ Adapted from the novel by  Li Ke (李可).

Han Youxi accidentally stole the first kiss from CEO Lu during a mission. Lu Jing Shen took the opportunity to make a contract agreement and trapped Youxi to pretend to be the long-lost grandchild of his grandfather. But in pretending to be brothers and sisters, feelings develop.

Emotional blogger Chen Rui had an accident during a live broadcast and turned into a supporting actress in the novel - Gu Le Er, and got the system task: raise Su Bai's favourability towards her to 100%. Only then could she return to her own world. Gu Le Er repeatedly advanced and failed, but the sudden 180 degrees change of attitude towards Su Bai attracted his attention, slowly melting Su Bai...

Zhu Jin Hao, the heir candidate of the Zhu Group, is known for being decisive and efficient, always prioritizing interests. On her way to negotiate a business acquisition, she falls victim to a conspiracy, leading to a car accident. Fortunately, she is saved by Lin Qing Yi, who happened to pass by.

After regaining consciousness, Zhu Jin Hao suffers from amnesia and transforms into a sweet and lively girl with a pure heart. Through Lin Qing Yi’s investigation, the truth behind Zhu Jin Hao’s attack is revealed, and the mastermind behind it pays the price they deserve. As they endure various hardships, Zhu Jin Hao and Lin Qing Yi gradually develop mutual feelings and an affectionate bond starts to grow between them…

It tells the story of a prince stationed at the frontier, who received a secret order from the crown prince and rushed to Yuncheng with his cavalry. However, he was ambushed by the secret guards as soon as he arrived at the gate, and was inexplicably accused of treason. After a fierce fight, he finally escaped, but he was turned into a child. As a child with a body of only 10 years old, how can he solve the mystery step by step, and how can he survive the pursuit?

When An Tang was young, she witnessed her mother and brother being killed by Li Wan, and transplanted her brother's heart to her son, Zhou Yi Chuan. So An Tang designed a plan to get close to the murderer.

Li Wan's son, Zhou Yi Chuan, has been working step by step for more than ten years and finally sent the murderer to prison. However, she found that she had not completely let go of her revenge, and the emotional entanglement between her and Zhou Yi Chuan was still disturbing her mood again and again.

She chased after him with unwavering determination, breaking down his defenses one step at a time. Just as he gave in and fell deeply, she disappeared without a trace.

When fate brings them back together, the tables turn. He becomes the one who won't let go. For love, he's willing to soften, to yield, to do whatever it takes to keep her by his side.

The illegitimate son of the Lu family, Lu Huai Feng, is hunted down and saved by Song Xia. He ends up falling in love with her at first sight. Song Xia's adoptive parents are killed by Lu family's eldest son, Lu Xuan, in a hit-and-run, and the Lu family covers it up. Lu Huai Feng conceals the truth and keeps her by his side. 

After learning the truth, Song Xia feigns amnesia to take revenge, obtaining evidence of Lu Xuan's crimes, triggering internal strife. Lu Xuan kills his father and is arrested. When Lu Huai Feng tries to stop him, he is shot and loses his memory. Upon reunion, he does not recognize her.

Sheng Shi and Gu Lan Shan have harbored a secret love for many years, but one wants to stay with the other while the other wants to escape.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Ai Ni, Shi Wo De Di Lao Tian Huang" (爱你，是我的地老天荒) by Ye Fei Ye (叶非夜).
A detective series set in China's Republican Era involving a private detective and his female counterpart in the police.

A woman entering showbiz at the age of 30 gains overnight fame, but realizes that surviving the cutthroat competition may prove to be more difficult than she imagined.

Despite being considered too old, Gui Mi makes a name for herself as the 'hot search queen' after joining a reality show. Her rise to fame opens up doors, but along with it are endless schemes and conspiracies to take her down. In order to survive, Gui Mi works hard to conquer this arena as a real queen in the industry.

dramas.nt: 我与玫瑰，随时为公主待命!
dramas.syn:
Jiang Xun embarked on a mission with the dream of finding his sister, but in the end he made a resolute choice for the country. Zhou Jin inherited his will and spent half his life defending the country and the other half protecting her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Yu Mei Gui, Sui Shi Wei Gong Zhu Dai Ming!" (我与玫瑰，随时为公主待命!) by Nai Tang Su (奶糖酥).

In 2003, a mining town in Ningxia faced relocation when suddenly a burned female body appeared in front of the police station. The circumstances of the case are very similar to an unsolved murder case from 10 years ago. The retired police officer Chu Zhi Qiang and Zhang Tao, who was reassigned to Ningxia, work together to solve the case while simultaneously having to deal with the relocation of the town.

After being released from prison, Lin Ye Ye intends to start a new life, but is unexpectedly pulled back into hardship by Jiang Zhou. Jiang Zhou becomes Lin Ye Ye’s creditor and sets up a plan that requires her to repay the debt by placing herself in a dangerous situation, including approaching his older brother, Jiang Yu Hua. During this process, Jiang Zhou gradually develops feelings for Lin Ye Ye that go beyond his original intentions. He comes to regret sending her to Jiang Yu Hua’s side, yet finds himself uncertain about what he should do next.

dramas.nt: 花落宫廷错流年第二季
dramas.syn:
The second season takes a much darker path as it focuses on the battle among the princes, all vying to fill the Crown Prince's now empty seat.

Despite Crown Prince Yin Reng's loss of power, Nian Shu Yuan remains by his side. When Empress Dowager Xiao Zhuang becomes critically ill, the two leave the palace to offer her their prayers so that she may get well. Kang Xi is moved by their sincerity.

When the First Prince's plot to conspire against Yin Reng is exposed, Yin Reng is reinstated as the Crown Prince. Meanwhile, the returning war hero, Nian Geng Yao, has gained both ‘military strength and political clout  Even the Fourth Prince, having always kept his ambitions hidden, is now moving toward capturing the throne for himself.
dramas.t: The Flowers Filled the Palace and Missed the Time Season 2

dramas.syn: In the early 80's of the 20th century, Wang Xue Hua, Dong Fang Hong and Yang Si Yu are all born on the same day. With the birth of the children,  emotional entanglement of three families and two generations unfolded little by little. But soon, this peaceful families coexistence ends abruptly. The feud between the Wang's family and the Yang's family's fathers starts involving their beloved ones, and causes the two people who loved each other to separate.  Unable to look at the crumbling, long-term ties, the youngest generation decides to do everything to reconcile the feuding parties.

Xu Shi Yang grew up in an environment where men are valued over women. Her younger brother owed numerous gambling debts, forcing her to stop working. In desperation, she thought of interviewing the eldest grandson of the Zhou family in Gangcheng to save her career. Zhou Yan Jing, who was obviously not interested in women, was moved by Xu Shi Yang who suddenly broke in. The two, each with their own ulterior motives, had sparks of love...
dramas.t: Falling in Love with the Port City

dramas.syn:
The family of Chu Tong, the richest in Jiangling City, suffered a series of misfortunes due to the design of their adopted daughter Chu Qing: Mrs. Chu fell to her death, Chu Kuo was arrested on suspicion of money laundering, Chu Tong and her boyfriend Pei Man were in distress in a car accident, and Pei Man unfortunately died. 

After Chu Qing revealed the layout, she threw the seriously injured and disfigured Chu Tong into the sea. Chu Tong changed her face after being rescued, and returned five years later with the support of her mentor Zhu Jiang Shan to take revenge. 

She teamed up with the mysterious man Pei Guan Chao to stir up the storm, but in the process of revenge, she revealed even more terrifying secrets. The old family affection and intrigue are intertwined, and the truth subverts everyone's fate.

The two ladies, Ni Hao and Joann, foray into the entertainment circle as they jointly create the "Heartbreak Club" series.
Five years ago, all the hard work that Joann had poured into Orris generated big profits for the company. However, she has become the victim of office politics and has been fired from her job. Just when everyone thinks that Joann is done, she returns to the scene with a new business venture.

She sets up a production company and becomes a movie and television producer. With Ni Hao's creative writings, they create the "Heartbreak Club" series. Lu Yuan Yang, the chairman of Orris, is the former boss and ex-boyfriend of Joann. He is also interested in the entertainment business. Will he become her biggest competition or partner up with her once more?

~~ Adapted from the novel "Queen Joann" by Zhang Xiao Han.

Upon discovering her long-engaged fiancé having an affair with her legitimate half-sister, Bai Pu impetuously seduces her boss, who also happens to be her fiancé's uncle. Bai Pu struggles to find direction as she is torn between her fiancé's betrayal and her mother's last wish (the arranged marriage). In addition, her own illegitimate status weighs on her mind even as Lu Zhao He keeps entangling her body and emotions.

dramas.nt: 顾总，太太又把您拉黑了
dramas.syn:
A badly injured Qiao Ruo Xing tries repeatedly to contact her husband between the scene of an accident and treatment in the hospital. Instead, she witnesses him rushing to the side of his first love after she is slightly bruised. This last straw breaks her, and she becomes determined to get a divorce. Gu Jing Yan, meanwhile, is adamantly against divorce even as he is pulled away by honor, commitments and secrets. Conflicts continually bring Qiao Ruo Xing and Gu Jing Yan together and force them apart, while neither seems to recognize the remaining affection of the other.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gu Zong, Tai Tai You Ba Ni La Hei Le" (顾总，太太又把你拉黑了) by Qiao Shi Yi (乔十一).
dramas.t: Mr. Gu, Your Wife Has Blocked You Again

dramas.syn: Lin Xing Ran, a young doctor, returns home to investigate her mother’s murder. Disguised as a family physician, she infiltrates the household of Master Fang, a wealthy suspect, but becomes the prime suspect herself after his sudden death. When Jiang Bei Chen, her former lover and now the lead investigator, takes on the case, old tensions reignite. As they uncover the truth together, a shocking discovery turns their world upside down.

It mainly tells a story about youths chasing their dreams and it revolves around a foodie alliance at school comprised of dancing goddess, Hao Yuan, and master of culinary art, Xia Chu. 

Hao Yuan is a cheerful girl who has dreams of being a dancer since she was young. She has gone on an extreme diet to lose weight for dance. Her classmate, straight-A student, Xia Chu, is a culinary master. Together with a group of energetic youths on campus, they often study together and gradually become friends because of their love for all kinds of food.
~~ Adapted from the web comic "Cat Demon's Seduction" (猫妖的诱惑) by Qing Yu Gaffey (青玉Gaffey).

Qi Yuan, the most powerful man in Beijing, is arrogant, indifferent, and unattainable. After a night of drinking, Qiao Luo Luo, a little orphan, got involved with him and was married him with a one-month pregnant belly. She thought this was a marriage of convenience, where he wants the child and she gets freedom. Unexpectedly, Qi Yuan doted on her even more.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiao Tian Qi Yun Tu, Yin Chen Chen Da Lao Xin Teng Dao Ku" (小甜妻孕吐，陰沉沉大佬心疼到哭) by Xiao A Xiao A Man (小 阿 小 阿 蠻).

Set in the eponymous White Deer Village in Shaanxi Province where the two most important families – Bai and Lu – and their sons have always lived together in peace. But the turmoil leads to a fierce struggle for land ownership. A young woman new to the village soon finds herself caught between the two camps. Director Liu Jin uses the story of these two families as a metaphor for the fate of the Chinese people as first Chinese war lords are overrun by Japanese invaders, then civil war follows hot on the heels of the Second World War and finally the victorious Maoists begin waving their red flags. The drama is based off the novel by Chen Zhong Shi.

Police officer Bao Yu is working undercover as drug dealer Jin Fei's subordinate and is eventually able to work directly under powerful drug lord Tian Jing after befriending his daughter, Tang Guo. However, Bao Yu is not fighting the drug cartel alone - he also has a support network including fellow undercover colleague and romantic interest Guan Xiao Zhi, police chief Fang Qing Long and anti-narcotics team leader Lian Zhong.

dramas.nt: 乡下真千金竟是老祖宗
dramas.syn:
Sang Ning was born into a family of noble birth and was raised as the mistress of the house. But when she opens her eyes, she arrives in a strange era and becomes a real daughter lost in the countryside by a wealthy family. Fortunately, she is still the eldest daughter. The fake sister claims to be noble, graduating from a prestigious school and having extraordinary talents? How dare she do that when she is not good at piano, chess, calligraphy and painting? The family members say they feel guilty, but in fact, they are partial to the younger sister? 

It doesn't matter; house fighting has also been a compulsory course for her since she was a child. Say she has no rules? Less than a month after the eldest lady returned home, the Nan family was shocked to find that the eldest lady who grew up in the countryside was even more feudal than the old man!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xiang…
dramas.t: Xiang Xia Zhen Qian Jin Jing Shi Lao Zu Zong

dramas.nt: 吴邪私家笔记 第二季
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the novel "Wu Xie Si Jia Bi Ji" (吴邪私家笔记) by Kennedy Xu (南派三叔).
dramas.t: Wu Xie Si Jia Bi Ji Season 2

dramas.syn:
A story that follows the romance, friendships and familial relationships of three old friends.

Zhen Kai Fang, Xiao Qing and Ouyang Yan Yan were all born in 1978. Because their fathers were good friends, they've also been friends since they were young. However, things tend to change with the passage of time. Their reunion more than 30 years later felt strange and unfamiliar but as their fathers arrived, the three began to reconnect.

At this time, Zhen Kai Fang is an unemployed single-mom who's been divorced once. Xiao Qing experiences a new battlefield in dealing with her daughter who has just started university. Ouyang Yan Yan who was supposed to be the one who had it all figured out suddenly quits his job to the surprise of his family. As they face different problems in their adult life, they turn to each other for comfort and find renewed hope towards the future.

~~ Two versions…

It is an anthology drama about the lives of eight legendary figures in China:

Yu Min: Involvement in national defence and security from his youth until he reached his middle age.
Shen Jilan: Advocating "equal pay for men and women" and her election to the first National People's Congress.
Sun Jiadong: Countless defeats become the starting point to depict the relentless spirits of the Chinese scientists.
Li Yannian: Heroic feats during the Korean War (known in China as the war to resist US aggression and aid Korea.)
Zhang Fuqing: A war veteran has gone to live in one of the poorest regions and helped people out of poverty.
Yuan Longping: Worked tirelessly to provide food and clothing for his motherland and the people of the world.
Huang Xuhua: It recounts the difficult process in China's independent research and development of nuclear submarines.
Tu Youyou: Development of the new…

Jiang Tang and Feng Ling are brought together through an arranged marriage between their families, but unexpectedly, this seemingly ordinary family alliance conceals hidden complications. At first, Feng Ling is completely opposed to the marriage, but as they spend time together, Jiang Tang's charm gradually wins his heart. Meanwhile, business rivalries and family conflicts arise one after another, and a secret that Jiang Tang has kept hidden for many years is also about to come to light.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hun Qian: Bie Ai Wo, Hun Hou: Lao Po Tie Tie" (婚前：别挨我，婚后：老婆贴贴), also known as "Wo Jiu Pa Lao Po Zen Me Liao" (我就怕老婆怎么了), by Jiu Wen Rou (旧温柔).
dramas.t: Take the Young Man under the Year

dramas.syn:
Wen Ning fled from an arranged marriage to Ao Island, where she unexpectedly encountered Xie Zhi Yu. She discovered that he was not only an influential figure on the island but also the mysterious guest her father had been secretly meeting. Connecting the strange happenings at home with her father’s unusual regard for this man, she suspected that Xie Zhi Yu might be linked to a hidden illegitimate child her father was concealing. Determined to uncover the truth, she devised a plan to deliberately approach him.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jing Ao Chun Chao" (京澳春潮), also known as "Jing Zhi Nan Pan" (京枝难攀), by Zhong Xia Yu (仲夏雨).

Deep in the neon lights of Hong Kong, He Jun Ting hides his identity as the prince of the He family and becomes just an ordinary friend to Yu Fei Wan. What others see as a coincidence is actually a pre-planned approach by him. He uses love to redeem her from her low point. This invisible protection stems from the rain in his youth. She held up a leaky blue umbrella and protected him from the family's rejection and injury. Her words, "Don't be afraid," became the beginning of his long-planned secret love for her.

About the life of mothers, and their relationship with their children.

The relationship between husband and wife, parent-child, and intergenerational relationships in the four families has experienced tremendous challenges.

Just one year of preschool education for their young children allowed young parents to gain important growth experiences in their lives, learning not to be entangled with competition but to return to the original intention of helping children stand on the true starting point of their life.

Chen Ju Yi, a divorced elementary school physical education teacher, bought a big house with all his savings and just moved in with his daughter. But one day, a strange woman opens the door and claims that the house is hers, and after the two argue, they learn that they have fallen into the trap of "one room, two sales". The woman's name is Fang Ling; she's the brand director of an international clothing company, beautiful in appearance, divorced due to her husband's cheating, and living alone with her six-year-old son. 

Neither of them wants to give up their house, so they follow some legal advice and temporarily start living under one roof.  But very soon, Chen Ju Yi and Fang Ling start a "guerrilla war", both wanting to kick each other out of the house.  However, they don't expect that soon, due to many life perturbations, the couple will become the greatest support for each other.

Jiang Shi Qi, a skilled martial artist residing in the remote mountains, ventures into the city to seek revenge on her father's old nemesis's son.

~~ Advertisement for skincare brand, Pechoin (百雀羚).

At the wedding ceremony of Li You You, the daughter of the Chairman of Li’s Group, and her love Ning Yang, the secretary Xin Ran was harassed. The groom, Ning Yang, showed up and saved her, and they then spent a night together. At the same time, a car accident suddenly struck Chairman Li. Therefore, Ning Yang became the descendent of his place. Yet Xin Ran noticed that all the women around Ning Yang, including Li You You, started to disappear. The cover of Ning Yang was slowly revealed.
dramas.t: A Thousand Lies and a Hundred Plans

dramas.syn: Zhong Xian, driven by the tragic death of her sister, who depended on her, is drawn into the fierce rivalries of a powerful aristocratic family. Navigating the conflicts between Qin Hao and his son Qin Lang, she uses herself as bait and risks her life as a gamble, stirring up strife between father and son. However, through the intense power struggles, Qin Feng gradually falls into a downward spiral. In the end, Zhong Xian realizes that the grudges and betrayals within the noble family are far more complex than they seem, and she herself is merely a pawn in Qin Hao's game. Just when she believes her revenge has succeeded, the real storm of bloodshed and chaos is only just beginning.

Lin Xiao Pan's parents divorced when she was young, and she moved to Japan with her father, graduating from Japan Junior College in home economics. Though sweet and seemingly silly, she is actually stubborn, enthusiastic, and just. After her boyfriend Zhou Zhi Wei unexpectedly runs off, Xiao Pan moves to Shanghai to start fresh. She takes a job as a building cleaner, which leads her to meet Zuo Fei, a man mourning his wife. The two grow closer as their paths cross.

Forensic expert Zhou Li is transported into a rebirth revenge novel as Jiang Ruo Li, the villainess accused of killing protagonist Jun Wu Ye and his mother. Using her knowledge of the story, Zhou Li helps Jun Wu Ye uncover the real culprit while guiding him back to his principles and faith in humanity. As their partnership deepens into trust and affection, they discover a shocking truth that changes everything.

To protect mortal Xie Nan Zhi, Dragon Prince Qin Mu willingly sacrifices his heart to ensure her reincarnation. A millennium later, now heartless and dying, he searches for her in the modern world. When they reunite, they must defy fate’s cruelty together, but can love conquer a curse forged in sacrifice?

A story that follows three men who are coming from their respective failed marriages. They decide to go to the same city to start a journey of healing.

Bai Zhi Yong, Huang Jiu Heng, and Lan Tian Yu are three strangers from the same city. After experiencing heartbreak, they decide to start over at a new place where they meet the mysterious Jiang Xiao Mei. Through their time together, the four become good friends and learn to support each other through rough times. They come out of the journey with a renewed outlook towards family, love, and work.

dramas.nt: 落魄老公总裁身份曝光了
dramas.syn: Tang Li is the eldest daughter of the Tang family, the richest family in Haicheng. In order to prevent her father from making decisions for her in marriage, she made an agreement with her father that as long as she earned 100 million yuan on her own, her father would give up his control over her marriage. So Tang Li concealed her identity and went to deliver food, determined to make money on her own. However, on the way to deliver food, Tang Li accidentally saved Qin Xiao, who was seriously injured and unconscious. Afterwards, Tang Li took Qin Xiao in at her home, and the two began to live together without knowing each other's true identities. Since then, the two started a happy relationship.
dramas.t: Luo Po Lao Gong Zong Cai Shen Fen Bao Guang Le

dramas.syn: After graduating from the police academy, Qin Chuan and his friends return to their hometown as police officers, determined to pursue their dream of becoming detectives. Despite challenges, Qin Chuan’s career takes off when he proves his courage in a critical situation. Under the guidance of his superiors, he grows into a skilled detective, facing the weight of his responsibilities and the realities of the job.

Lu Ming Yu's parents died in a car accident, and was placed under house arrest by her uncle Lu Qiu Liang, and was forced to hide her talent. By chance, Lu Ming Yu met Duan Xiu Ming, the second son of the Hong Kong Duan family, a dark overlord. Duan Xiu Ming was attracted by her unique temperament and decided to do everything he could to protect her and become a sharp blade on her road to revenge.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hao Yi Ge Guai Guai Nv" (好一个乖乖女) by Wo Sha Fei Ku Xin (我煞费苦心).

On the day when Fu Qing Yin was completely disappointed with Song Zi Yan, she went to Song Zheng. In front of the teahouse, Fu Qing Yin asked: Mr. Song, do you really want to marry me? Song Zheng said: Miss Fu, marriage is not a joke. You have to spend your whole life with me after getting the marriage certificate. On the day of getting the marriage certificate, Fu Qing Yin drew the best fortune: I will see you once in my life, and I will live with you forever. Since then, Fu Qing Yin has been deeply loved by Song Zheng.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Qing Se Wei Xun" (青色微醺) by Jie Jie (芥婕).

After being betrayed by a despicable man, Shen Xing Li drowns her sorrows in alcohol and has a one-night stand with her best friend's younger uncle, leading to their forced marriage.

After their marriage, Sang Mu Ye treasures his wife more than his own life. He even personally whips his elder brother to avenge Shen Xing Li and sets aside his long-standing hatred to protect her career prospects.

An incident that had been deliberately planned long in advance leads the two to become a source of light in each other's lives.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Yu Lao Gong Si Xia Wei Zhuang, Tian Tian Ba Wo Qin Ku" (禁欲老公撕下伪装，天天把我亲哭), also known as "Re Shang Feng Pi Xiang Pao Lu, You Hong Hui Jia Chong Dao Ku" (惹上疯批想跑路，诱哄回家宠到哭), by Lou Xiang (陋巷).

Su Wan was invited by her college best friend to live at her fiancée's manor with her while Su Wan looked for a job. She was shocked to see that her best friend's fiancée, Zhou Sheng Yan, looked exactly like the man who kept appearing in her dreams. Tensions rise as the attraction between Su Wan and Zhou Sheng Yan becomes more noticeable.  Su Wan tried to leave multiple times, but something unexpected always happens, and Zhou Sheng Yan has no intention of letting her go either. As her stay in Fogang Manor lengthens, she realizes that her connection to Zhou Sheng Yan is deeper than it seems.

dramas.nt: 大唐狄公案 第二季
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the novel series "Judge Dee" (大唐狄公案) by Robert van Gulik (高罗佩).

Ten years ago, Ming Yue's parents tragically passed away in a car accident, and was adopted by her father's colleague, Li Chuan Yan. Under Li Chuan Yan's care, Ming Yue grows up. However, as time passes and Ming Yue matures, the relationship between her and Li Chuan Yan takes on a peculiar turn as they begin to develop feelings for each other.

The heroine, Yao Yao, gets caught up in a book she has written and has to make the sickly villain Qi Zhi fall in love with her and die for her so that she can return to the real world. The heroine goes through three identity changes as a palace girl, queen and eighth princess. She constantly tries to build a relationship with the male lead, but the process is convoluted, and the characteristics and complex psychology of the male lead bring many twists and turns to the plot.
dramas.t: Bìng Jiao Fan Pai Gong Lve Jì Hua

dramas.syn: Wen Yan was a servant of the Chu family and Chu Shi Yu's nanny. She has been silently giving and handling everything for him. However, when Chu Shi Yu hurt her family, she decided to leave. When they met again, Wen Yan had become Fu Han Si's secretary. On a rainy night, Chu Shi Yu knelt down and begged Wen Yan to return, but Fu Han Si domineeringly declared his ownership of Wen Yan. The love between the two became more and more firm in the interweaving of power and emotion.

It tells the love story of Lin Ruo, the eldest lady of Lin mansion, who was forced to marry the Prince of Qi, Lu Jun Yi. But Lu Jun Yi has a dark secret that nobody knows. Three years ago, he was suddenly infected with a strange poison, which caused him to attack and transform every three hours, sometimes becoming another man, sometimes a woman, and sometimes a child.

The play is set in the turbulent period of the Republic of China in Shanghai. In the 1930s, Shanghai's most prosperous city, Shiliyangchang, was also known as the "Magic Capital of the East". Despite being a prosperous city, it hides numerous confusing and unimaginable criminal cases.

Gu Yuan, who had just been promoted to the chief inspector, and with the assistance of the famous female forensic doctor Che Su Wei, joined forces with Kang Yi Chen, the president of the Shanghai First Chamber of Commerce, to jointly detect bizarre and strange cases.

Xia Yu Tong was dumped for the fifth time on her 28th birthday. Her manager wanted to cheer her up, so she drugged her. Xia Yu Tong eventually had a one-night stand with a masked man. The masked man is none other than Ye Xiao.

Ye Xiao, the CEO of Canshin Group, suffers from a condition: paranoid personality disorder. When he was 16, he fell in love with Xia Yu Tong at first sight and became obsessed with her. Xia Yu Tong is six years older than him and the best friend of his older sister, Ye Ying. To win Yu Tong over, he transformed himself into a shy, timid man and lured her step-by-step into a true love trap.

In the late 1980s, two feuding families are drawn back together when Wang Ying Rong, who has lost her factory job, rebuilds her life with the help of Zheng Min Jiang. As the two grow closer through hardship and entrepreneurship, old grudges slowly give way to reconciliation and love.

The storyteller concludes the story of the general's daughter Bai Li Xing Xuan and masked hero ‘The Red Demon,' Fu Ye.

~~ A vertical screen drama adapted from the manhua "Ru Meng Ling" (如梦令) by Hao Jia Si (郝佳思).

Set in the Ming dynasty, the drama challenges the mystery genre in a comedic form. The series is also the second period drama directed by Chung Shu Kai, who has dramas such as Lan Ling Wang, and several other tvb dramas to his credit.

dramas.nt: 腹黑邪王宠入骨 第一季
dramas.syn:
The Central Plains has four countries which are Dongyue, Ximing, Southern Xinjiang, and Beiling, which divide the world equally.

Modern secret agent Su Qing Ying failed a bomb demolition mission. Then, she crossed to another time era and became the fifth princess of the Dongyue Kingdom with the same name and surname. Su Qing Ying woke up in a ruined temple, and all kinds of memories flashed, letting her know her identity and fate in this era. From the clues of the memories, she discovered that her fiance, Xuan Yuan Che, king of Ximing Kingdom, tricked her into the ruined temple and set a trap to try to destroy the marriage, but because of the identity of the secret agent, Su Qin Ying easily escaped this catastrophe. After escaping from the ruined temple, she met the male protagonist Jun Li Ye who was healing in the woods. In the night, Jun Li Ye, the regent of the Beiling, was angry…
Nan Xing was a carefree college student, until one day, she wakes up and finds that the surrounding environment is very unfamiliar, and she actually works as a cleaner in a company.

In the early 1970s, Jing Qiu, a girl from a "politically problematic" family, is sent to the countryside for re-education. While documenting village history in Xicunping, she meets the talented and handsome Lao San. Their budding affection faces harsh trials: class stigma, family opposition, and the rigid social hierarchy. Can their promise to reunite under the hawthorn tree ever bloom true?

~~ Adapted from the novel "Under the Hawthorn Tree" (山楂树之恋) by Ai Mi (艾米).

In an era of great turmoil, warlords vie for supremacy, and the Snowfall Tribe's Saintess, Xin Yue, possesses the divine ability to foresee the future. It is said among the nations that whoever wins the favor of the Saintess will gain dominion over the realm. When the Crown Prince of Beirong personally seeks Xin Yue's insight, she seizes the opportunity to escape during a great fire, sparking fierce competition among the nations. Rescued, Xin Yue is sold to the Donglin Palace. To repay the Saintess for her kindness, the Primordial Sacred Tree of Xuefeng Mountain Tai Chu assumes the appearance of Donglin King Guang Ye and becomes his substitute. Prince of Dashang employs the Meng Ji to incapacitate Xin Yue's divine sight, seeking to manipulate the fate of the nations through puppetry.

As the powerful Beirong Kingdom seeks to counterbalance Donglin's influence, they force Donglin's…

Kong Le, whose parents both died, married into the famous Yin family and married the domineering female CEO Yin Qian Tong. The security guard was suppressed by the domineering wife. The cute and sinister young master Yin Shao Bo secretly colludes with the mastermind behind the attempt to overthrow the Yin family, resulting in a shocking crisis. The Yin family group is in turmoil. 

With the help of his parents, he not only discovered the hidden truth behind the accidental death of his parents but also used his secret identity as a popular stock god to smash the evil plan of the mastermind behind the scenes, successfully saved the Yin Group from the fire and water, and also completely conquered the heart of the domineering wife, and then reached the pinnacle of life.

It tells the story of a former out of date movie star in old Shanghai who gets involved in a confusing murder case. In order to prove her innocence, she joins hands with her personal female assistant to find out the truth. 

This drama focuses on the two girls with extremely contrasting personalities and identities. Hu Xiaodie was originally an over-packaged commercial female star; Hua Xiaoqing is a young independent woman, who had returned from abroad to her family’s downfall. In order to clear the suspicions on them, they begin to learn the knowledge of investigation and reasoning skills, and eventually grow to become the nemesis of crime, with the help of the Central Police Station.

Having grown up alongside Fu Yan Ze, Li Zhi finds herself cast out by the Jiang family upon the return of their biological daughter, Jiang Zhi You. To make matters worse, Fu Yan Ze abandons her for the sake of his own family’s interests, becoming engaged to Jiang Zhi You instead. Meanwhile, Li Zhi is targeted by malicious rumors labeling her a "homewrecker," leading to a brutal wave of online harassment.

In her darkest hour, Lou Yan Jing—a powerful, influential figure in Beijing’s elite circles who has harboured a long-standing, secret affection for Li Zhi—steps in to support her. The two enter into a sudden, unexpected marriage. To silence the rumours and prove their detractors wrong, they appear together on a reality dating show. Throughout the program, Lou Yan Jing dotes on Li Zhi and fiercely defends her; as a result, she sheds her reserved nature, becoming increasingly playful and…

Jin Xiao Wan, betrayed by her boyfriend and killed in a car crash, reincarnates into a 5-year-old prodigy in 1999. Using modern knowledge, she helps mother Lin Han escape her toxic boyfriend, transforms her into a tiger mom, and becomes a wealthy kid. While pushing Lin toward romance with Ying Hui Ming, she discovers her mother is also reborn, but Lin's secret scheme surpasses her plans.

Northern Song Dynasty Bianjing's supernatural catcher Shen Shi Wu, a highly trained constable with a cold appearance, not only looks handsome but is also a technical and technology nerd. He is deeply interested in technology and has a large number of fans. Like a god, he has contributed to the maintenance of the social order in Bianjing, but the most troublesome thing for him is the street gangster Liu Xing Yu, a cheat and master in seducing girls. 

Constable Shen is engaged to talented artist Wang Shi Shi but falls in love with her alternate identity Yue Er. At the same time, delinquent Liu also falls for Wang. Despite the complications, they work together to fight against evil forces and solve all kinds of strange cases in the area.

Police officer Qiao Heng came to the haunted Pinghe village during the Chinese Republican era to investigate the murder case of embroidered shoes. Qiao Heng encountered all kinds of terror and bizarre events in Pinghe village. Successive death cases introduced the truth about the past secrets of Pinghe village. What is hidden in this small village?

In a kingdom where martial arts is highly respected, Bai Xi Yao, the lord of the Long Cha Sect, and Ling Hao Xian, the leader of the Feng Qi League, participate in the kingdom's treasure hunting battle.  During  the battle, an energy explosion of the Heavenly Book Order caused the two rivals to switch bodies. Forced to work together, Xi Yao and Hao Xian come to understand and respect each other as they deal with the various crises in their sects. Little did they know that the two who possessed the Order of Heaven had already been targeted by the Holy Light Society, and they now  begin to sense a mysterious and evil force secretly arising.

dramas.nt: 薄爷，夫人把您卖了换钱花
dramas.syn:
Shen Ci Yu, a good-for-nothing daughter, was lying down at home and was kicked out by her parents, who asked her to be self-reliant. Shen Ci Yu learned that her best friend's uncle was recruiting a wife with a high salary, so she immediately went for an interview and finally got a marriage certificate under the temptation of a high salary. She thought she could live a carefree life, but she didn't expect that the curtain of a secret love would slowly be unveiled.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bao Ye, Fu Ren Ba Nin Mai Le Huan Qian Hua" (薄爷，夫人把您卖了换钱花) by Nan Jia Xiao Jiu (南家小九).
dramas.t: Mr. Bo, Madame Sold You for Money

dramas.nt: 公主绝色，影卫日日以下犯上
dramas.syn:
The most powerful imperial concubine of the Nine Provinces was reborn in the body of the infatuated young princess of Xiqi. Upon awakening, the world was astonished. The Emperor has returned. Disobeying the emperor? Beat him! Threatened by a court official? Kill him! As a prince, what's the point of tangling with a man? Fighting for power and the throne is what matters. Three thousand secret guards, under my command! Raid the Shangshu's house! Father, it's time to abdicate!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "He Li Hou, Gong Zhu Ta Bei Po Si Ying Bing Jiao Fan Pai" (和离后，公主她被迫饲养病娇反派) by Nan Huang (南凰).
dramas.t: Gong Zhu Jue Se, Ying Wei Ri Ri Yi Xia Fan Shang

dramas.syn: Lu Jing Tang was originally the rightful heir of the Xu family. After her mother, Xu Wang Shu, passed away, her father, Lu Yun Chuan, who coveted the family fortune, along with her stepmother, Zhou Yun Rou, and their illegitimate daughter, Lu Lin Yan, sent her to a mental hospital. Over the course of three years, she carved out her own path in the violent mental hospital, becoming ruthless and eccentric, with her sole goal being revenge.

This is a story about growth of youths ranging from 18-24 years. It is about the youths finding their dreams whilst experiencing life’s realities, forming new friendships and losing some, and coping with the challenges of love.

The simple and kind-hearted boy Wang Yi Chuan was admitted to the acting department of Southeast University of Arts because of his handsome appearance and solid professionalism. And there he met the roommates with whom he would live together for the next four years: Duan Shi Jie, who has the same handsome looks but often lacks confidence because of his height, Chen Dong Dong, a sarcastic hipster who has dropped out of school for two years, and Gu Shu Heng, a 16-year-old boy from the opera and literature department who has grown up under the pressure of his parents. 

Together they experienced academic shocks and relationships problem. From enemies to best friends, they become sworn brothers. The first semester of freshman year was over, and the dormitory lights fell into the old alley of time, illuminating their youth.

A gripping story of espionage during peaceful times follows a group of security officers who rely on their intellect, investigative skills and love for their country to help them win the final victory. They are ordinary people around us with unusual backgrounds and secret identities in a gunless war against hidden opponents.

After the fishmonger Xia Xiao Feng and Xiao Ye entered into a contract marriage, she gained Xiao Ye's trust and favor by spreading rumors and flattering him.
