However, after they confessed their love to each other, Xia Xiao Feng remembered her lost memories and identity due to a head injury, but forgot about Xiao Ye, so Xiao Ye began to pursue his wife by using all means possible.

If you're going to be a canary, why not be the one on the highest branch? Ji Ming Wei, the top beauty of Jinghai, is betrayed by Lu Jin Ran, the younger brother of the Lu family's heir. After Jin Ran swaps identities with his twin brother, Ming Wei plays along to seek revenge. But when she tries to end things after achieving her goal, she realizes Lu Shi Qin is serious about her.

dramas.nt: 早逝白月光穿十一年后，成全家福星 第二季
dramas.syn:
In the first season, after an unexpected car accident, Lin Mo discovers that the world she lives in is a novel, and her three younger brothers are cannon fodder villains in this world, meeting tragic ends. When she opens her eyes again, Lin Mo is reborn eleven years after her death.  The second season continues the high-energy theme of "bloodline suppression" and "family redemption". The story focuses on the third brother's storyline, revealing more humorous and tearful moments.  

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Si Hou De Di Shi Yi Nian" (我死后的第十一年) by Pi Ka Hei (皮卡黑).
dramas.t: Zao Shi Bai Yue Guang Chuan Shi Yi Nian Hou, Cheng Quan Jia Fu Xing Season 2

dramas.syn: After being set up and betrayed, boxing champion Shen Zhi Xia mysteriously wakes up in the body of a wealthy young mistress. To return to the real world, she must complete the original owner’s revenge mission. Armed with her exceptional fighting skills, Shen Zhi Xia rises against the powerful family and tears through every enemy in her path, while the cold and aloof CEO Lu Jing Heng gradually falls for her. Caught between revenge and love, will she choose to return to her original world, or embrace this new destiny?

Liu Jing Li struggles after her 18-year-old daughter, Zhou Yi, disappears. An unexpected discovery pulls Liu Jing Li into the past, joined by her friend Xu Xiao Feng to uncover the truth behind the mysterious circumstances surrounding Zhou Yi’s fate. The search for answers also brings in journalist Liu Xiu Lian, the adoptive mother of Zhou Yi’s classmate, Li Si Bo. Li Si Bo appears gentle and kind, seemingly helpful in uncovering the truth, but his own secrets gradually surface, linking him to Zhou Yi’s past and revealing the complexities of his relationship with his mother. 

Told across two timelines, blending past and present, the story follows the three women as they peel back layers of complex family dynamics, unsettling truths about certain aspects of Zhou Yi’s past, and the secrets surrounding Li Si Bo. As the investigation deepens, bringing shocking revelations that deeply…

dramas.nt: 替嫁夜我成了病娇老公的心尖宠
dramas.syn:
The dark and tolerant little white rabbit VS the yandere and ruthless boss.

Gu Bei Sheng, the eldest daughter of the Gu family, was framed for giving birth to a stillborn baby five years ago and was thrown into a mental hospital. Five years later, the Gu family asked her to marry the sickly second young master of the Fu family on behalf of her sister. In order to find out the truth of the past, Gu Bei Sheng agreed to marry into the Fu family. As she got along with Fu Xi Zhou, their relationship gradually warmed up.
dramas.t: The Substitute Wife Is a Big Shot

dramas.syn: An Yang and Ye Lan share a one-night stand, but An Yang doesn't remember Ye Lan's face the next morning. However, she later shows up at his company to help him run it, claiming to be his sister.

The special task force is adrift after their epic loss to Darker, the mastermind behind a series of high-profile vigilante killings. With their captain on the run for murder and them no closer to catching Darker, the team switches gears and investigates a decades-old hostage case. In those dusty old files, they discover Darker's real identity and a possible police cover-up, but establishing the wrongdoer and the aggrieved party has proven more difficult than it seemed. The team must determine the true culprit before Darker does, lest he kills his way through the suspect list.

~~ Adapted from the novel series "Death Notice" (死亡通知单) by Zhou Hao Hui (周浩晖).

Liu Jia Dong and Zhang Ran met each other on the banks of the beautiful Fuchun River, only to later meet again as heiress of the Summit Group and hired bodyguard. Little did these two know at first meet all the hardships and feelings they would have to go through and overcome together.

Nan Yan Zhi, the daughter of a craftsman, lost her family to a massacre. She becomes Zhuang Wu Jiu's apprentice, who helps her transform from a naive girl to a ruthless woman, struggling in the mire of life. Using only a few clues, she infiltrates the Lingya Tower alone to seek revenge. Rumor has it that those who enter the place become beasts in the arena, with no one surviving. Just when Nan Yan Zhi thinks she is alone and helpless, she witnesses Zhuang Wu Jiu reappearing as the no other, than ruler of the Lingya Tower…

The story revolves around the "Cat Hire House" in the city of Lin'an during the Southern Song Dynasty. The proprietress, Zhang Qiao Er, learned some cat-training techniques from the artisans when she was young. Whenever families in the city needed a cat servant, they would hire a cat from her shop.

Unexpectedly, a major case in the city implicates Zhang Qiao Er, and then she meets Ma Qing Shan, an honest junior constable of Lin'an Prefecture. As the case unfolds, Zhang Qiao Er's other identity gradually emerges. It turns out she is the notorious "Cat Burglar" known among the common folk, and she has been the target of Ma Qing Shan's pursuit all along.

Between their game of cat and mouse, affection blossoms, and eventually, they work together to expose the mastermind behind the scenes, safeguarding the city of Lin'an.

Jiang Wan Ning, a wealthy heiress and gifted designer, becomes an apprentice to a Chinese qipao master, inherits a time-honored brand, and independently establishes the renowned jewelry brand GK. One day, Jiang Wan Ning wakes up to find herself in the same bed as Chu Jun, the recently bankrupt heir of Jinghai, only for her own grandmother to discover them. As a result, Grandmother Jiang demands that the two register their marriage.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Liao Chong Mei Gui" (撩宠玫瑰), also known as "Gou Ye, You Ta Shi Kong" (够野，诱他失控), by Huai Xia (淮夏).

Liu Yang, a girl from Jiangcheng, became an intern in the emergency department of the hospital and was about to marry her boyfriend. When Shuang Xi came to the door, Liu Zhi Hua, her father, who left her and her mother and married Feng Juan twelve years ago, decided to return to her family and remarry her mother. This incident closely united the two families and gradually changed the life trajectory of the eldest daughter Liu Yang and the eldest son Qin Fei of the two families. Liu Yang and Qin Fei grew up in the workplace and life. Their understanding of life is getting deeper and deeper, and their understanding of life is gradually maturing. "Three-point knitting and seven-point sorting" is the essence of Liu Yang's mother's weaving of concentric knots, and it has gradually become their life wisdom, and finally reconciled with each other's family.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Zhong Guo…

My name is "Xin Xin". Mysteriously, I was in a car accident and lost all my memory the day I decided to ask my husband for a divorce. When I woke up, I realized I was living a fake life. Now, I'm going to look for the truth and find out what happened to me before the accident.

No one ever loved her - used by her family, betrayed by her best friend, and treated like a wallet by her boyfriend. She thought she'd die alone - until he came into her life: kind, gentle, genuine, and loving her like she was his whole world. For the first time, she almost believed she could start over - if only she hadn't been told she had three months left to live. Dear God, why give me the one thing I've always longed for...when I have no time left to keep it?

After Qi Miao’s death, she was bound to a system and transmigrated into the Great Qin dynasty, with the task of avenging the body’s original owner. When the tyrant Qin Li appeared, she prepared to assassinate him in order to achieve the “exterminate nine clans” mission. However, the tyrant unexpectedly possessed the ability to read minds. Upon hearing Qi Miao’s inner thoughts, he became intrigued. The tyrant, who had long been bent on dying, was slowly healed by Qi Miao’s kindness and warmth.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Du Xin? Zuo Jing Niang Niang Dai Zhe Wu Ya Zui Sha Feng Le" (读心？作精娘娘带着乌鸦嘴杀疯了), also known as "Xin Hun Ri Bei Qiang, Bao Jun Fa Dian Wo Fa Feng" (新婚日被抢，暴君发癫我发疯), by Yi Zhi Xiao Chan Chan (一只小蝉蝉).

Housewife Fang Tang is happily married - or so she thought. Sometime after her 30th birthday, she notices that her husband, Gao Jia Wei, has been acting oddly, only to discover that he's having an affair. While tormented by his infidelity, she remains calm in the hope that he can be honest with her. Instead, he remains evasive, lying continually and refusing to take responsibility for his actions.

Gao Jia Wei's business partner and competitor Qi Miao hoped to take advantage of Gao Jia Wei's marital crisis, only to sabotage herself when her plan pans out.  All the while, she had been so busy pursuing fame and fortune that she alienated her husband to the point of filing for divorce. 

Qi Miao's assistant, Da Yu, is focused only on avenging her broken heart, overlooking her family in the process. 

After everything she has gone through, Fang Tang realizes she can no longer rely on her…

Nan Li is an actor who specializes in playing the villainess. One day, she becomes fed up with this kind of role—and the abuse from viewers—so she decides to stop. Somehow, however, she gets sucked into the world of her latest production, Koi Love. There, “The Script System” gives her three months to finish her scenes in the script in order to be able to leave the world—or be forever stuck. 

Nan Li's mission starts with forcing her “husband” Mu Jing Cheng to sign a divorce agreement—a task that proves quite difficult, since it requires him to give her all his money. What's more, the script seems to control all her lines. Luckily, as she plays out her scenes, she is rewarded with some freedom within the frame of her character’s personality. Despite her many efforts to disappoint him and get him to sign, all strategies fail.

Lin Zhin Yi and Li Zheng He first got married and then fell in love. When the relationship was at its best, Li Zheng He died in a car accident. Eight years later, the heroine met her brother-in-law who had the same face as her late husband.

dramas.nt: 缠她上瘾陆总的娇气包
dramas.syn: Lin Mo Mo, a college student, is exploited by her foster mother and forced to work long hours. One day, she crosses paths with the third young master of the Lu family, Lu Yan Ze. After an unexpected pregnancy, the two grow closer through work, and Lu Yan Ze begins to fall for Lin Mo Mo's genuine nature. As her foster mother pressures her into marriage, Lu Yan Ze steps in to rescue her, promising to take responsibility, and the two enter a secret marriage.
dramas.t: Chan Ta Shang Yin Lu Zong De Jiao Qi Bao

dramas.syn:
Wen Ruo Yun, an orphaned heir to a jewelry group, thought her marriage to artist Gu Yan Cheng was a match made in heaven, but after a kidnapping case she discovers that her husband was hiding behind their marriage a huge conspiracy. Gu Yan Cheng was not only cheating on her, but he was using their marriage in a deadly scam carefully designed by him! 

Wen Ruo Yun, who woke up from the whirlpool of sweet love, discovered Lin Jia Yi, another woman betrayed by Gu Yan Cheng looking for revenge. These two women join forces and unite with other victims to carefully design a revenge counterattack against Gu Yan Cheng!
Sweet and hilarious journey between the patriarch Duan Ruo Rou and the consortium's heir Lu Ao Tian, who accidentally became the "Son-in-Law" in Yunnan's semi-primitive tribe Huacheng.

Xia Xiao Qing, a young woman in the workplace, dreams of traveling back in time after getting drunk and becoming a courtesan in ancient China. While enjoying the experience of ancient life, she soon faces unexpected challenges. With her unwavering determination, Xia Xiao Qing is forced to choose between her personal feelings and her duty to her country. She single-handedly resolves the crises and finds love, completing her self-redemption. After returning to reality, she finally understands the meaning of life.

Chef Li Lan accidentally enters the comic "The General and the Farmer's Wife" and becomes acquainted with the cold-blooded general Wang Jin in the comic. In order to pay off the debt owed by Li Lan's father, the two opened a restaurant together. Li Lan relied on her modern marketing methods and superb cooking skills to expand their business. Not only did the father pay off his debts, he also became the richest man in Qingshui County.

dramas.nt: 抄家后她娇入骨，战神王爷偏要宠
dramas.syn:
Modern-day doctor Duanmu Xu Qing wakes up in the body of a disgraced noble family’s second young lady in ancient times. To save her family, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the attendant of Prince Jing, Long Jing Xiu.

With her medical skills and access to a mysterious storage space, she repeatedly saves lives and earns his trust. Prince Jing gradually develops feelings for the “boy.” Meanwhile, she hides the secret of her Heavenly Fragrance Sacred Body, navigates court conspiracies, and fights to protect her loved ones. When her true identity is finally revealed, the two join forces to break the deadlock—saving her family and gaining love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chao Jia Hou Ta Jiao You Liao, Zhan Shen Wang Ye Qia Yao Chong" (抄家后她娇又撩，战神王爷掐腰宠) by Yue Yu Qing Yan (悦语清言).
dramas.t: Chao Jia Hou Ta Jiao Ru Gu, Zhan Shen Wang Ye Pian Yao Chong

dramas.syn: The city of Shi rises to prominence thanks to its logistics boom, but gangs are rampant. Undercover police officer Ling Che is forced to partner with hoodlum Shen Yan Lin, and the two go from initial conflict to mutual respect. Their investigation uncovers numerous moles and hidden secrets within the police force. When brothers become pawns and justice becomes a bargaining chip, a storm of good versus evil has only just begun...

Confused, Yan Tang wakes up in her bed on the day of her wedding to Qin Jing An. She soon realizes that she has somehow been reborn after being poisoned by her husband and her cousin, Zhao Ying Ying. In her previous life, her husband wanted to gain merits by carrying out the Emperor’s edict, saying that the whole Yan family was to be beheaded. This time around, she refuses to marry him and sends him away.

Soon, Yan Tang receives an edict to marry Jun Jiu Xiao, the 9th Prince, known to be a dandy and violent man - and the very same Prince who ordered her family to be killed in her previous life! Fortunately, she is offered a deal with the deity, Great Jade, who grants her the current trial rebirth. 

The deal is for her to marry the 9th Prince and help him ascend the throne. If she succeeds, she will get the truth behind her family’s death in her first life and be given a true rebirth.…

Ye Zhi Ting is a terminally ill heir of a wealthy family. He "purchases" a seemingly mute and innocent woman whose miraculous blood holds the cure for his illness. But the woman has many secrets of her own, and her crossing paths with Ye Zhi Ting is part of a much deeper plot.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Pian Zhi Da Lao Huai Li De Zhang Xin Jiao Mi You Sa" (偏执大佬怀里的掌心娇美又飒) by Mei Xu Xun Xue (梅须逊雪).

Shi Jian Lian, the owner of the Thirteen Villages, pretends to bury her father by selling her body and stops Wen Ming, the son of a general, to enter the general's mansion to steal the rumored treasure. However, when Wen Ming is attacked, Shi Jian Lian accidentally becomes Wen Ming's senior bodyguard on call all day long. Shi Jianlian goes from worrying about how to "kill" her employer to falling in love with him.

Everyone knows that Jiang Qing Yue loves Gu Pei Si terribly, but he seems to have forgotten that she was once an excellent and bright girl. For love, she was willing to wash clothes, cook and take care of him for seven years. In return, he was fickle-minded, cheated, and played games without a sense of boundaries in front of his girlfriend. 

She forgave him 99 times, then finally, she broke up with him decisively and restarted her life. This time, Jiang Qing Yue never forgave him again. Gu Pei Si realized that he had lost the person who loved him the most.

Shen Nian, the biological daughter of the Shen family, was kidnapped by her adopted daughter Shen Wan Er. In order to prove who her family cares about, the adopted daughter gave her a gift and set the warehouse on fire. When Shen Nian was in danger, her parents and brother chose to save their adopted daughter Shen Wan Er and ignored Shen Nian. 

When her life was in danger, Shen Nian saw her uncle coming to save her. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself reborn three years ago. This time, Shen Nian was determined to change her life...
dramas.t: After Severing Ties, My Uncle Spoils Me Very Much

dramas.syn: Ji An Ning was chosen as a child bride by the Ji family because of her good fortune. On the day of their engagement, her fiancé, Ji Jing Feng, cheated on her. Heartbroken, she drank to drown her sorrows, but unexpectedly had a one-night stand with a man. She was coerced into being his lover for three years, unaware he was the Ji family's youngest son, Ji Chi Cheng! Until he revealed his true identity in public.

The femme fatale, Sang Man, deliberately approaches Zhou Jing Zhi (the hidden boss). One is obsessed with revenge and has no feelings, while the other is completely infatuated with love. She abuses the scumbag, he hands him the knife; she sets up a trap, he protects her. The scumbag and the mistress fight back, and the crazy couple join forces to overturn the business world and reach the peak...

A metaphysics expert undergoes a tribulation and enters the mortal body of Jiang Chu Wan, gaining the ability to see the countdown of people’s remaining lifespan above their heads. In her spare time, she takes on the identity of a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner, treating people who suffer from various unusual illnesses. Fu Yan An is one such patient.

Three years earlier, Jiang Chu Wan happened to save Fu Yan An when his life was in danger, only to discover that he had been afflicted with a rare and difficult love-related curse. From that point on, Fu Yan An develops feelings for her. When they meet again, Fu Yan An immediately recognizes Jiang Chu Wan as the person from three years ago and can no longer suppress his emotions. Knowing that his time is limited, he decides to act for himself once, proposes marriage, and holds on to a small hope that they may continue to love…

In order to find the core secret of Ambergris to create a revival incense, Ye Xiao Cong, the only descendant of the exclusive Fanxiang sect in the mountains, disguised herself as a maid in the mansion of the Marquis of Pingyuan. She meets the Marquis of Pingyuan, Bai Zhang Shu, but is mistaken as a spy from the North. Through constant bickering and misunderstanding, they become a pair of happy friends. Amidst the chaos, they face many problems in life together and finally become lovers.

After betrayal leaves him for dead, Chen Yuan Qi gains extraordinary powers and, with three formidable allies, embarks on a vengeful quest to defy fate, crush powerful clans, and protect the world from destruction.

The story begins with the heroine's entrance into the imperial palace, setting a timer to solve the case. In the quest to track down the true culprit, she must navigate the power struggles among the imperial concubines and the complex relationships with three men of varying identities. Each key piece of evidence in the play connects to the secrets of the past and present dynasties, forming a cohesive narrative thread.

~~ Adapted from the game "Qing Gong Ji" (清宫计) on the Cheng Guang (橙光) platform.

The story takes place 3,000 years ago, when the Immortal Lords and the Shadow Clan waged war against each other for years. Immortal Lord Jing Wei seized the Shadow Clan’s sacred artifact, the Floating World Mirror, and sealed away the legendary demon Xie Yun. To prevent Xie Yun from breaking free, Yaoyang ultimately sacrificed himself, perishing alongside Jing Wei, restoring peace to the Three Realms and granting Bai Ruo Xi an era of tranquility.

The story takes place between two generations of three families in contemporary Lhasa. Thubeng, an opera performer who has dedicated his life to the Tibetan opera troupe, suffered blows one after another: his eldest son, Suo Lang, resigned from public office and started a business without his back, and he was heavily in debt; his youngest son Ta Shi said he did not want to be a doctor and wanted to sing Tibetan opera; his eldest daughter Qu Zong also faced love difficulties. 

Tibetan doctor Ten Zin plans to go to the mainland to enjoy his retirement life with his wife, Qiao Yan Ru, who is about to retire. Unexpectedly, his wife filed for divorce, and his daughter Da Zhen, who returned to Tibet for business, faced dual pressures from family and career.

Jiu Mei, an equestrian team member who is about to retire, is faced with the final choice of his career as an athlete. His younger…

Zhou Nan Feng travels back in time to stop Zhong Zi Ye from taking revenge on Qin Zhi Yi, but Zhong Zi Ye manipulates events to tear them apart. After Zhong Zi Ye’s sudden death and Zhou Nan Feng’s sacrifice, Qin Zhi Yi uncovers the truth and time-travels again, only to find everything rooted in Zhong Zi Ye’s love for Song Xing Yue. As the four are caught in a cycle of fate, love, and vengeance, the truth remains hidden in blood and destiny.

Lou Yue, who was betrayed by Xie Jia Shu for family interests, was forced to return to her old home. She thought she was walking into a trap, but unexpectedly, she is fiercely protected by Lin Zhou Huai, the second son of the family. Amidst their growing entanglement, Lou Yue gradually discovers that Lin Zhou Huai is actually the 'shadow knight' who has secretly loved her for five years.
dramas.t: Moonset in the Embrace of the Boat

dramas.syn:
Set during World War II in 1942, the series follows a high-stakes intelligence mission after an Allied aircraft carrying a mysterious and vital figure is shot down in Japanese-occupied territory. Faced with an impossible task, the military intelligence department reactivates a covert operative who has been dormant for five years and sends him, along with a local assistant, to infiltrate a heavily guarded island.

Under constant surveillance by occupying forces, the two must earn the trust of the island’s residents while navigating danger, deception, and shifting loyalties. As the mission unfolds within this isolated “sea prison,” survival, trust, and duty are put to the ultimate test.

~~ Based on real events.
~~ Co-production with the U.S.A.

It features main characters from the hit TV drama “Chinese Paladin,” combining elements of animation, fantasy and comedy. Chinese Paladin series protagonist, Li xiaoyao, goes with his friends on a quest crossing time and space.

A story revolving around the double life of a young man in the world of lingerie design. It's a niche that is fresh, trendy and a topic with an uncanny potential for comedy.

Ah Jing tries to juggle two lives simultaneously and works tirelessly to keep up the cover. At the lingerie company, he is cowardly cute and a rookie employee with a lot to learn. In the setting of a family-owned business conglomerate, Ah Jing is the headstrong president. He is calm and unbending in the face of competition, and his off-the-wall ideas often become a source for hilarious hijinks.

A group of young people working hard for their dreams in the city have decided to go to the green mountains to find other opportunities. In their venture to start a business, they inject the vitality of urban youth and the concept of market management into the countryside, overcoming many difficulties to to create a beautiful picture.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chuan Cheng Nong Men E Po Po" (穿成农门恶婆婆) by Yu Hua Qi (遇花期).

At the Best Actress Award Ceremony, I was so glorious that I was framed by my fiancé and my sister! Falling into an abyss, ending in tragedy, I was reborn after death! In this life, I will never make the same mistakes again.
dramas.t: She Came out of the Abyss

dramas.syn:
There are imperfect marriages in the world, but there is no wedding that he can't do! Peng Yuan is a gold medal wedding planner, invincible in the realm of love.... until he walked in on his girlfriend cheating on the night he was going to propose. While drinking his sorrows away, he accidentally met Qin Nan, a "marriage breakup master". Qin Nan not only saved Peng Yuan's life but also agreed to play the role of a fake girlfriend to deal with her mother's marriage urging. 

Zhou Jun Ping and Fu Xiao Cong are old classmates who meet again after many years apart. These four people go through a series of funny misunderstandings because of their different professional identities, but they also gain real friendship and love.

After four years of engagement, her fiancé changed his girlfriend to a deck of playing cards. Jiang Fu cried on her face, but smiled in her heart: she didn't have to fulfill her husband's duties and could marry into a wealthy family. Where can I find such a good thing? She met a very handsome man in the elevator and had a crazy night. She thought she would never see him again, but at the family dinner, the man sat in the main seat with his beads in his hands. Her fiancé smiled and introduced him: "This is my uncle!" Jiang Fu realized that she had offended a man she shouldn't have offended.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ci Ji! Wo Di Di Xia Qing Ren Shi Wei Hun Fu Xiao Shu" (刺激！我的地下情人是未婚夫小叔) by Yao Gu Tou (妖骨头).

When Shu Yan was ten years old, her father was wrongfully accused and tragically died. Lawyer Shu Yan disguised herself to approach the suspect’s son, Fu Li Shan, but he had already seen through her disguise. Shu Yan's curiosity was real, and her feelings genuine. In a web of love and hate, the two of them were pulled in different directions. As the fog cleared, the proximity that began with revenge eventually shattered hatred in the clash of true feelings, leading them to embrace each other.

In order to surpass her rival, female cartoonist Bi Shi Ye agrees to continue the serial comic "Thou Shalt Not Love" on behalf of "Xiao De" who's disappeared.

Bi Shi Ye agrees to a request from art director Qiu Qian Gu where her rival "Xiao De" works to become a ghostwriter for them. At this time, Bi Shiye's two best friends, Mi La and Lei Zhen Zi, both encounter relationship problems. Mila is a goody two shoes who has always been submissive to her childhood boyfriend and rarely has her own opinions; Lei Zhen Zi is a model focused on her career. She refuses to fall in love but starts to have feelings for bodyguard Wu Qin. Meanwhile, Mi La has grown tired of having no self worth. 

Bi Shi Ye observes the emotional journey of the two girlfriends and continues the "Thou Shalt Not Love" comic based on their stories. She also falls in love with Qiu Qian Gu. The three ladies support each…

It continues the ambitious reenactment of a significant time in history to tell a story that revolves around Ying Ji, the king of Qin, whose efforts to conquer the six warring states contributed greatly to the eventual reunification of an empire.

The sequel continues the story between the Crown Prince, the Crown Princess and the son of the Prime Minister with the addition of his martial arts sister that turns the love triangle into a square.
 
After Su Yu and Ye Qing Ge are forcibly separated, the couple finds their way back to each other through a fake death. Xie Qing Yun has no choice but to withdraw from the love triangle, which unexpectedly leads him to cross paths with martial sister, He Lian. However, the four encounter their biggest problem yet when the Empress Dowager of Beichu reveals the truth behind Su Yu's identity, causing Ye Qing Ge's life to be in danger as the King contemplates killing the fake Crown Prince.

Mark is in his middle life crisis, but doesn’t act his age. Wang Xiao Mi has always dreamed of being treated like a princess and believes that marrying Mark who is the same age as her mom will let her reach her dream. However, she has to deal with his son and daughter as well as his mom and ex-wife.

A story that takes place at the Shanghai Bund during the 1930's. It revolves around a man from a clan of magicians who treads on a path of patriotism after starting on a road to avenge his father's death.

Ye Fei's father Ye Jin is the head of the Jin Rong troupe which is home to generations of great magicians. After challenging and winning against a German magician, Ye Jin Rong is ostracized by other troupes and dies from despair. Driven by the desire to take revenge, Ye Fei travels North to come under the tutelage of a famous school.

After completing his training, Ye Fei goes to Shanghai where he meets Xiao Yao, the daughter of a ganglord, and she becomes enamored with him. War erupts at this time, putting their story of love and revenge aside as they are pulled into a fight for their country.

During high school, Xia Ming Yue's family was met with misfortune. Her father passed away in an accident, and not long after, her mother became incapacitated by illness. Ming Yue takes on the responsibility of single-handedly caring for her mother, brother Ming Tian, and sister Ming Xing, even after discovering that she's not the Xias' biological daughter. To support her family and make ends meet, she decides to drop out of school just before the college entrance exams and instead opens a food stall.

Ming Yue's classmate Xu Chong is drawn to her optimism and strength, and quietly supports her. Things are settling down for Ming Yue, but her relationship with Xu Chong makes Xu Chong's girlfriend, Ding Yun, jealous. Ding Yun starts scheming against Ming Yue, who is once again forced to endure hardship.

A story about a conceited star fencer who loses everything in an instant. After five years, he returns to the sport in a bid to reach the top once again.

Fencing prodigy Ou Yang experienced the highest highs and lowest lows of his life on his 20th birthday. Having just won the world championships, Ou Yang's life flashes before his eyes when he gets into a motorcycle accident and falls into a coma.

Five years later, Ou Yang wakes up and learns that his father has mysteriously died while his close friend Fan Qi everything from him. Ou Yang breaks down from the setbacks, but his love for fencing reignites his fighting spirit to take back what is his.

A combination of games and reality. Many people's expectations of real life in many games are displayed in the form of film and television. It not only relies on the game, but also makes people more relatable and realistic. Lets the people who wants to fall in love have a jolt to the heart.

Under a cloud of identity doubts, they accidentally became husband and wife, and they joined forces in a crisis. See how Mr. Yu, Mr. Ba, turned the danger into a safe place and turned the world around!

dramas.nt: 如何在无脑霸总漫里艰难求生
dramas.syn: Shu Heng proved herself through a VR interview system and staged a story of struggling to survive in "the mindless boss manga".  The CEO came to save her in the system, playing the paper man. The two also gained an unexpected and beautiful love.
dramas.t: Ru He Zai Wu Nao Ba Zong Man Li Jian Nan Qiu Sheng

dramas.syn: He forced her parents to death and kept her by his side since she was a child, but just to take away her heart. Unexpectedly, she was pregnant with his child.

Yan Yan's novel was modified by a game company. And her favorite character, Luo Li, was turned into a target. 
During the game trial, her dissatisfaction summoned Mr system, Xiao Ba, and she was pulled into the game as Yan Zhi Yan. Mr system declares that only by changing Luo Li's fate and making him the male lead, can she leave the game.

In order to find out the truth about her father's imprisonment, Jiang Ke Hua made a deal with Lu Zhi Zhan. Lu Zhi Zhan helped her see her father in prison, and she gave him her body. Both of them told themselves that they should not be tempted by the deal, but they were tempted. The past was full of mysteries, and the emotional entanglements nowadays also make people feel uneasy and hesitant.

dramas.nt: 小瞎子认错老公，糙汉大叔宠上天
dramas.syn: The blind girl Jiang Li accidentally fell in love with her fiancé's uncle for half a year. When her eyesight recovered, she found that everything was wrong and she had recognized the wrong person. But at this time, Xiang Ye had already been obsessed with Jiang Li, and his possessiveness was extremely strong. He would not allow Jiang Li to leave, and made an agreement that she could not leave for a month. When Jiang Li was struggling and in pain, her fiancé returned to China, and the uncle and nephew quarreled. After a month, what choice would Jiang Li make?
dramas.t: A Blind Girl Mistook Her Husband for a Rough Man

dramas.syn: Psychologist Li Mo Chou joins the Baizhou Public Security Bureau, giving Captain Ding Wei a powerful edge. With her criminal profiling skills, Ding Wei leads her team in solving a series of mysterious cases. As they dig deeper, the real mastermind behind a major unsolved case from years ago is finally exposed, bringing long-buried truths to light.

Song Ye had dreamed of the same woman countless times. On this day, he went to a class reunion with his girlfriend and saw a woman who was very similar to the one in his dream. Not only did she actively add him on WeChat, but she also sent him a message at the end of the party saying, "You have a nice figure. Next time, take off your clothes for me to see." Song Ye thought that she was just flirting with him on a whim, but it turned out to be a long-planned robbery. Later, he gradually fell under her step-by-step calculations.

Fang's youngest daughter Xiang Xiang has just entered society after graduating from university. Her elder sister Fang Hong believes that "eldest sister is like a mother," and regardless of Fang's feelings, she is enthusiastically involved in her sister's work and life. The two sisters with very different personalities are constantly clashing. Father Fang Ming is in a dilemma: he spent most of his life living for his daughters, but as his daughters become more mature and independent, Fang Ming feels less and less needed. So Fang Ming began to try to find a sense of existence in his daughters' minds.

In June 1993, the transnational cooperation between Donghai Chemical and Luoda Company was in full swing. Song Yun Hui, the key person behind the joint venture with Donghai, is leading the workers of Pengyang, a factory inferior to Donghai in all aspects, to begin its process of reform. Despite the difficulties in narrowing the gap between the two companies, Yunhui continues to adhere to his original intentions.

Lei Dong Bao leads Dengfeng Electric and merges with small factories to establish a cluster. He sets rules, finds investments, engages in foreign trade, and experiences the reality of human relationships. Nonetheless, he makes sure to always put the interests of the people first.

Yang Xun and Liang Si Shen are working together to build a shopping mall. In the midst of things, Liang Si Shen tries her best to balance Luoda's and Donghai's interests. The two gradually open their…

The outbreak of blue-green algae in Qijiang City, H province. Wang Wu, the vice mayor in charge of environmental protection, had to suspend his work due to overwork. Lin Han Jiang, a university professor who has made great achievements in the field of environmental protection, was appointed director of the Environmental Protection Bureau of Qijiang City. 

After Lin Han Jiang took office, he found that cyanobacteria hide behind a greater environmental risk, and evidence is shown over the years from the Qijiang water sample testing report. With the support of the organization, Lin Han Jiang, without fear of power, found out the real cause of the blue-green algae outbreak. He was determined to solve not only the blue algae problem but also the water quality of the Qijiang River. However, it is easier to treat the symptoms than to cure the root causes. It is necessary to solve the…

dramas.nt: 总裁爹地，你找错妈咪了
dramas.syn: Before Cheng Shi Nian went abroad to study, she had a one-night stand with Si Bei Yuan. Six years later, Cheng Shi Nian returned to China with her son and became Si Bei Yuan's secretary. She learned that he already had a fiancée. After careful consideration, Cheng Shi Nian decided to help Si Bei Yuan, but found out that Si Bei Yuan's fiancée was her best friend Qiao Ruo An who had impersonated her.
dramas.t: CEO Dad, You Got the Wrong Mom

dramas.syn:
In the first year of high school, Xie Huai, the prince of Beijing, fell in love with the freshman representative Song Nuan at first sight and started pursuing her. Because of his unusual behavior, Song Nuan avoided him. She ran away to college in another city to avoid him, and the two separated. Until one day ten years later, Song Nuan accidentally fell into Xie Huai's arms, and the gears of fate started turning again. She was running away from him and he was chasing her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ta De Xiao Nan Hong" (他的小难哄) by Tian Tao Yao Yao (甜桃夭夭).

In order to pay for her father's medical expenses, Wen Xin swapped her identity with her twin sister and married into the Gu family in her place. She was cautious and tried to please her husband. A year later, her twin sister asked to be swapped back. Seeing her twin sister taking over her life with ease, Wen Xin left with a broken heart. However, the husband, who used to be indifferent to the marriage, discovered that his wife had been swapped and became very anxious.

Police officer Yang Li Nian and his partner Liu Hua Sheng investigate the theft of a golden crown from a Qing Dynasty coffin, which is placed on an "amber female corpse" bearing a lotus totem. This reveals a criminal organization exploiting modern emotional vulnerability through superstitious rituals.

The investigation uncovers that the crown is used for "ghost marriages," part of a larger "spiritual ascension" scheme targeting the lonely homeless man Zaxi. As they dig deeper, more complex rituals like the "Seven Star Scheme" involving figures from different social classes (Aunt Gu, Zhang Tian Lin) emerge. The duo must confront this sprawling conspiracy to dismantle the mysterious phenomenon and restore the city's moral integrity.

dramas.nt: 原来你还在这里少年番外篇
dramas.syn:
Su Yun Jin and Cheng Zheng's love story began when they were in high school.

Cheng Zheng  likes Su Yun Jin but doesn't know how to approach her, so she's often put into situations where she doesn't know whether to laugh or cry. She gradually warms up to his presence but the differences in their family background causes her to shy away.

Shi Lai, an ordinary man, connected to a mysterious stone, experiences three unique romantic encounters and a twist of fate that changes his life. As he faces challenges in the enigmatic town of Gu Mie, he must find a way to turn his life around and rise to the top.

Meng Qing Yao traveled into a short drama and became a Beijing Circle Miss worth hundreds of billions. Based on the principle of making the best of it, she first kicked the soft rice scumbag and then tore the extreme stepmother. By chance, she met the "top male model" Li Huai Qian. The two of them gained love and growth in their battle of wits and courage with various villains.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chuan Cheng Jing Quan Da Xiao Jie, Hao Heng Yi Dian Zen Me Le" (穿成京圈大小姐，豪横亿点怎么了), also known as "Fen Shou Hou, Jing Quan Da Lao Yin An Fa Feng Gao Qiang Zhi" (分手后，京圈大佬阴暗发疯搞强制), by Bai Jie Zi Huo (白芥子火).
dramas.t: The Gorgeous Adventure of the Princess

dramas.syn: When young crown prince Chu Ying ascends the throne, his childhood friend, the eunuch Xiao Man, is expelled from the palace. Years later, Xiao Man returns in disguise, and as they navigate court intrigues together, their bond deepens and begins to shift in unexpected ways.

“Baixiao Manor” is located within a forest shrouded in poisonous miasma and has remained a mysterious, forbidden place for decades. On the eve of the Baixiao Night Banquet, the Manor Lord suddenly disappears without a trace.

Death-row prisoner Ye Li volunteers to investigate the case and joins forces with Dali Temple constable Hua Qian Kun. The two throw themselves into the heart of the situation, only to unexpectedly uncover a vast conspiracy hidden behind the manor…

Guan Yu, a meticulous and resilient criminal police officer, rises from a rookie to captain of the Lanhe County Criminal Police Team, solving countless cases along the way. After the 1223 major case, his health deteriorates, and he faces mounting pressure from superiors, personal loss, and hidden threats. As dark forces lurk beneath the surface, can he still uphold justice and hope?

Ai Lin, who regained her sight after many years of blindness, was devastated to discover her husband and nanny having an affair. Seeking revenge, she pretended to be blind, playing mind games that made them suspicious of each other. After feeling she had gotten her revenge, she planned to leave with her son, only to return from summer camp to find him replaced. Desperate, Ai Lin rushes to the police, where she encounters her husband claiming she’s lost her mind. Now, she must unravel what is real and what is illusion.

Liu Po Xiao goes to Beijing in order to find the person who hurt her mother. Believing that she can find information at Yan Mu Xi's house, she agrees to become his personal chef. The only problem is that he fell for her at first sight! While she is searching for clues, he keeps pestering her to go out with him.

Her parents were killed. In order to protect her comatose brother, she pretended to marry into an enemy's family to find out the truth. However, an unexpected flirtation led to her being attracted by a vicious second man, who fell in love with her at first sight. A scheming woman meets a sinister man.

This story follows Shi Yao and Lu Miao who grew up in a small, isolated town. They unexpectedly meet at a low point in their lives to find redemption in each other. 

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Suan Zhi" (酸枳) by Xiao Ke Bu Cai (小可不才).

An accidental exchange of room cards caused Chu Ruo Yun to accidentally fall into a contractual marriage with her best friend and boyfriend Long Hao Tian. Although it was a commercial marriage forced by the interests of the group, Long Hao Tian was dissatisfied with the Chu family's bullying of Chu Ruo Yun, and still domineeringly proposed to protect his fiancée. The two fell in love unknowingly, secretly promised their hearts, and decided to get married sweetly. But the appearance of the ex-boyfriend and the sudden return of his best friend broke everything that seemed peaceful...

dramas.nt: 闪婚后，顾总马甲藏不住了
dramas.syn: Duan Qing Yu mistakenly enters the wrong hotel room and spends the night with Gu Huai Yan. Three years later, amid parental pressure for them to marry, they encounter each other again and decide to enter a three-month marriage contract to avoid further pressure. Surprisingly, Gu Huai Yan, who develops rashes when touched by a woman, doesn't react the same way towards Duan Qing Yu.
dramas.t: Shan Hun Hou, Gu Zong Ma Jia Cang Bu Zhu Le

dramas.syn: Follows a young man who falls into a game with a mission to raise the main character's happiness meter; failure to do so results in his death.

In order to find out the cause of her sister's death, Qiao Yan Zhen approaches Lu Cheng Ye, and the two gradually develop feelings for each other. Lu Cheng Ye keeps pushing Qiao Yan Zhen away because of the trauma of his childhood, which leads to her being used by Lu Cheng Kai. Lu Chen Kai appears to be gentle and elegant, but in fact he is cunning. His provocation makes Lu Cheng Ye realize his deep affection for Qiao Yan Zhen and begin to learn how to truly give. In the end, Lu Cheng Ye sacrifices for love, and Qiao Yan Zhen sees his true heart. After the truth comes out, the two let go of the past and move towards a new life together.
dramas.t: Paranoid Boss Only Wants Me to Himself

dramas.nt: 温软玫瑰沦为他心尖偏宠
dramas.syn:
Bitten by a zombie while defending her team, dedicated defender Wen Yao is abandoned. She strains against the odds to survive and hopes for Shen Yi Chuan's promised return. Paranormally powerful Ji Ming Chen finds her after a particularly harsh battle. Having loved her for a long time, he abandons his original mission to take her back to his rival base. Jealous, the protected daughter of an important researcher, tries to remove her from the equation. 

Meanwhile, Wen Yao searches for her family, Ji Ming Chen tries to protect her, Shen Yi Chuan tries to woo her back, and they all battle the world as it has become. Gradually, they uncover a conspiracy around the developing paranormal powers and the zombie apocalypse.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wen Ruan Mei Gui Lun Wei Ta Xin Jian Pian Chong" (温软玫瑰沦为他心尖偏宠) by Luo Jin Chao (落今朝).
dramas.t: Wen Ruan Mei Gui Lun Wei Ta Xin Jian Pian Chong

dramas.syn: Operation Moscow is based on the real “Trans-Siberian Train Robbery” incidents in 1993. An organized gang robs Chinese merchants and rapes women on the Trans-Siberian train, which travels six days from Beijing to Moscow. A special-investigation team led by Chen Ya Li is formed and a thrilling hunt for the gang leaders ensues.

Puff travels through the novel to become Princess Xiulian. Facing the prince’s push, Puff recalled the novel. If he wanted to go back to the modern era, he had to open the gate of heaven and wait until seven or seventy-nine days to complete the house. The difficult royal palace survival has officially kicked off, and the puffs have opened the arduous road of keeping virginity...

Mu Zhi Lan, Gong Shu Yi, and He Bao Zhu find their lives intertwined after a sudden ship explosion. Together, they take on the responsibility of their family businesses, facing external pressures and challenges. Throughout their journey of struggle and transformation, they showcase extraordinary courage and resilience.

A story about the complicated emotional entanglements between one man and four women.

Zhou Yu Lou is a reputable doctor with a bright career, a beautiful fiancee, and the enviable lifestyle that many aspire to have. However, he has trouble saying no to people. In the field of psychology, it is known as the disease to please. His fiancee Jiang Dan is rattled when Xia Chu Rong confesses her feelings for Zhou Yu Lou. Xia Churong is an idealistic woman who longs for a romantic relationship, but she is stuck in an unhappy marriage with her husband, Tang Kai. After finding out about Zhou Yu Lou, Tang Kai makes a scene at Zhou Yu Lou and Jiang Dan's wedding and dies from a heart attack during the confrontation.

Shaken by her husband's passing, Xia Churong views Zhou Yu Lou as the last piece of driftwood to keep her sanity. Zhou Yu Lou is racked with guilt over Tang Kai's death and also…

A story about a goddess from the future who travels back in time to save herself and the people that she loves and gets pulled into the complicated school life of impassioned youths who are the second and third-generation heirs of wealthy conglomerates.

Lin Da Yu and Wang Xiao Ru are childhood friends. They both get accepted to WJC which is a school for the elite. On their very first day, a mysterious student named Ran arrives. She appears to be extremely familiar with Lin Da Yu and Wang Xiao Ru and divulges that she is from the future. She also has inexplicable powers and only time will tell how her appearance will affect the lives of everyone around her.
~~ Advertisement for AI home electronics brand, "Xiao Du" (小度).

dramas.nt: 母凭子贵后被老板全家宠上天
dramas.syn: A relationship caused by accident made her pregnant and gave birth to her son Du Du. Five years later, the Jiang family discovered that Du Du was Jiang Mu Bai's biological son and launched a drama of "looking for the son in the whole city."
dramas.t: Mu Ping Zi Gui Hou Bei Lao Ban Quan Jia Chong Shang Tian

dramas.syn:
Yu Zhi Yuan and Zhao Jia Ni have been married for five years with a 3 year old son. They are weekend parents, working five days a week and leaving their son with the grandmother until they take him home for the weekend. The two eventually come to cherish the importance of being there for their child and they strive to make a better home. 
Zhao Zhu Di and Shao Jie are the second pair of parents putting their daughter's education above everything else with the mindset that she can never lose out in life.
Love you thousands of times and be abused thousands of miles.

In her first year of high school, Xia Zhi Cha, a soft and transparent girl, met Fu Ci Yu, a transfer student from a wealthy family, who was wanton and flamboyant. She fell in love with him uncontrollably. However, due to the gap in family background and inner inferiority, she hid her secret love in her heart and didn't say it out loud for three years. She worked hard to get into Fu Ci Yu's university, but didn't dare to hope to meet him again. But he unexpectedly broke into her field of vision and protected her, spoiled her, and pursued her again and again.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Di Sheng Hong! Bao Bei, Wo Zhi Yao Ni" (低声哄！宝贝，我只要你), also known as "Ta De Pian Ai Shi Kong Le" (他的偏爱失控了), by Che Jing (澈净).

dramas.nt: 提款机不当了，校草全家急疯了
dramas.syn: Love-brained Jiang Xin Yao is reborn, and once again faces the lover who took her family's wealth and killed her in the previous life. Jiang Xin Yao just sneered and said, "See how I will kill you in this life!" The great revenge was completed, and she also gained true love. But she never thought that the infatuated man was actually the prince of the Beijing circle!
dramas.t: Ti Kuan Ji Bu Dang Le, Xiao Cao Quan Jia Ji Feng Le

dramas.syn: Gu Jing Ze and Chi Wan had secretly loved each other for 13 years. When Gu Jing Ze was in danger, he went to find Chi Wan, and she really appeared. From that moment on, Gu Jing Ze decided not to endure and miss her anymore, while Chi Wan suppressed the surging emotions in her heart and pretended not to know him.

After her soul transmigrates into an ancient book, socialite Lin Qian Jin finds herself accused of poisoning - but no matter how hard she tries to clear her name, her nemesis, General Li Yan, remains hellbent on killing her. Left with no choice, she switches tactics: flirting shamelessly while investigating the case. Yet the truth remains elusive, and everyone seems to have a motive to murder her! As Lin unexpectedly falls for Li Yan, her hilarious, chaotic love story begins...

After Ming Shuang discovers her boyfriend's infidelity, she enters into a contract marriage with Ji Xing Zhou. The two fall in love amidst family strife, uncovering the truth behind Ji's mother's death and the family's bankruptcy. Eventually, the two find happiness with each other.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hun Hou Yue Gui" (婚后越轨), also known as "Dui Ta Xin Dong!" (对她心动！) by Xian Yu Mei Mei (咸鱼妹妹).

Ma Liang is a carefree person who does what he wants without worrying about consequences.  However, this has exhausted his girlfriend of two years, Xiao Meng, who proposed a breakup.  Ye Man Ling is a rich woman who just experienced a failed marriage.  She comes back to China to succeed her deceased father's company.  On the way to an award ceremony, Ye Man Ling and Ma Liang bump into each other and thus, began an unfortunate relationship.

A fantasy romance between the descendant of an imperial chef and the President of a fine dining chain. 

Hailing from a family of chefs, Gu Cong Lai has an extraordinary gift. She can see the taste of food and use different flavors to effect a person's emotions. Through a chance encounter, Cong Lai meets Liu Shang Jun, the domineering President of a fine dining food chain. Liu Shang Jun intends to recruit Cong Lai but their clashing personalities and differing ideals result in a love-hate relationship between the two.

A story about targeted poverty alleviation in Wanmixi village follows a second-generation poverty alleviation officer and an urban reporter from the big city who overcome numerous difficulties in their efforts to lead the villagers out of poverty.

The per capita arable land in Wanmixi Village is very small. Resources are scarcely coupled with transportation difficulties. For hundreds of years, people haven't been able to escape poverty. In 2015, a young man by the name of Pu Quansheng arrives at the village. He is well-versed in the Miao and Tujia dialects and gradually makes changes to improve the situation at Wanximi Village.

However, idealism may be beautiful but difficult to implement and the process is full of challenges. Under the guidance of the party, Pu Quansheng enforces new policies and resolutely looks into village cadres who favor their own relatives and friends. In…
dramas.t: A Land So Rich in Beauty

dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the novel "Tui Guan Jun Wu Jiu" (推官君无咎) by Su Qiao (苏桥).

Continuing the plot of the first season, it follows the story of Zhong Wu Yan, who has given birth to a "freak" prince, and King Qi imprisons her in the cold palace. Their relationship evolves from indifference to reconciliation until they find love again.

The Spring and Autumn Period and Warring States Period were a time rife with war, and people struggled to survive. However, the King of Qi abandoned his duties while his Queen, Zhong Wu Yan, was thrown into the cold palace. As time passes, the King becomes more and more enamoured with Xia Ying Chun. He also misplaces his trust towards Wei Wen Bin, a surrendered general who was once an enemy.

As it turns out, Wei Wen Bin and Xia Ying Chun have been plotting a rebellion, and it is thanks to Zhong Wu Yan's foresight that she was able to save King Qi. King Qi regrets his actions and releases Zhong Wu Yan from the cold palace, but with…

It tells the story of two elite policemen, Luo Song and Gao Chuan, who work together to investigate the truth behind the accident which caused their teacher and benefactor, Cheng Feng Hua, to pass away.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Zui Yin Zhe" by Leng Xiao Zhang.

Quick-witted high school student Lin Yang Fei, seasoned female gamer He Ying Yue, and the burly man from Northeast China Chen Dong Hui, all woke up to find themselves in an escape game.

Only Lin Yang Fei had seen an escape guide, and they were faced with a sudden real-life survival situation, experiencing strange and unbelievable events and facing mysterious and unpredictable challenges throughout their journey.

~~Adapted from a webnovel "Wo You Yi Fen Tao Sheng Zhi Nan" (我有一份逃生指南) by  Yi Li Hui Jin (一粒灰烬).

In order to investigate the reason why his captain’s sister was injured and fell into a coma, Su Ye disguised himself as the bodyguard of the female president Song Yue Xi. In order to conduct the investigation more effectively, Su Ye even moved to live next door to Song Yuexi’s house. During their daily interactions, the two became attracted to each other and eventually became a couple.
dramas.t: Wo De 23 Sui Mei Nv Lin Ju

dramas.syn: Lu Hua Yan, the star performer of the Paramount, comes to seek revenge for her sister. She encounters Li Mo Tong from another world called "Wujian." In his quest to find a treasure that can make "Wujian" eternal, he must kill the mortal songstress Lu Hua Yan. Unexpectedly, he discovers she is his lover from a past life. Thus begins a tale of intertwined love and hatred, where passion and vengeance collide.

The pure and lovely Tang Wei, admiring the prosperity of Chang'an, came here and met Duan Qi, the prime minister's son, and a story full of jokes unfolded. The two shared food and thoughts together, and their relationship grew warmer day by day. 

Later, Tang Wei and his friend Su Shu opened a braised meat stall together, thus starting their entrepreneurial career. As the stars change and the world changes, Tang Wei and Duan Qi's relationship gets better and better, but the gap between their identities and positions also become prominent, and their relationship path becomes subjected to many tests. 

From winter to spring, crabapple flowers bloom, the two never leave each other. They overcome many difficulties, Tang Wei finds her life dream, and under the influence of Tang Wei, Duan Qi also completes his pursuit.

Through a coincidence, Mu Xiao Xi met Kong Chen Yi, the male god of music. Mu Xiao Xi originally thought that they would never meet again, but the school celebration party once again narrowed the distance between the two. As their understanding of each other deepened, they turned from friends to ambiguous and finally to lovers.

After graduation, Mu Xiao Xi followed Kong Chen Yi to Beijing. The problems of work, life and career caused troubles and contradictions in their relationship with Xiao Xi choosing to leave. Many years later the two met again at an event.

At the start of the 20th century in China, Mao Ze Dong rose as a revolutionary leader under the guidance of Li Da Zhao and Chen Du Xiu, helping to found the Communist Party of China. Amid internal betrayals and Chiang Kai Shek’s counterrevolution, Mao led uprisings and built a revolutionary base in Jinggangshan. After setbacks and the Long March, Mao’s leadership was solidified at the Zunyi Conference. During the Japanese invasion, the CCP united the nation in resistance. After victory, a civil war saw Mao's forces defeat Chiang, who retreated to Taiwan. When U.S. forces entered the Korean Peninsula, Mao sent Chinese troops, leading to a hard-fought victory. Under the CCP, New China stood firm in the East.

Lin Qiang was originally the deputy director of the audit department of the United Bank Head Office. Because he was unwilling to sign a problematic loan, he offended his superiors and was transferred to the Longyuan branch, which had the lowest performance. His close friend Zheng Shuai entered the bank at the same time. After being implicated in this matter, he was demoted together. 

The management of the Longyuan Branch was chaotic. Lin Qiang quickly discovered the crux of the problem with his professional ability and helped the tellers of Longyuan Branch fight for the benefits they deserved. This move angered Hao Wei, the branch president, and he put pressure on Lin Qiang everywhere. Lin Qiang, whose career was in crisis, had to fight back and trace the root cause of the problem in the loan case. In the end, the problem was eliminated, and Lin Qiang also realized his desire to serve…

To avenge her father and her fallen kingdom, Song Wei Wei, daughter of Chen Kingdom’s greatest general, disguises herself as Princess Wen Rou to get close to Prince Wen Zhi Yuan. As she plots to destroy him from within, she unexpectedly becomes entangled in a complex web of trust, love, and shifting loyalties that could change everything.

In her previous life, angel Yue Xi gave her heart to demon Zhang Tian Chen. Angel Yue Xi reincarnated as heartless “playgirl” Shen Yue Xi. He finally found her after 5000 years and began the battle of wits of true love between glamour girl and innocent man.
dramas.t: It's Just Not Sure That It Matters

dramas.syn:
An Jing is a senior girl living in the small town of Songxi. During the process of independently writing a school novel entitled "Goodbye, Seventeen", she takes on the roles of An Na, An Qi, and An Jing, the protagonists of three separate stories.

She travels through different spaces and times and meets different classmates, including the timid Straight-A-Student Han Yun, the warm senior Chu Yu, and the twin brothers Cheng Haoxuan and Cheng Haoyu, who have very different personalities.

From strangers to friends, they find friendship in the intense high school life, and together they go through the bitterness of adolescence to finally welcome the transformation moment of 17 years old.

On his first day at the Liangcheng Police Station, forensic pathologist Cheng Huai An found himself at his next-door neighbor's house, a crime scene. Cheng Huai An, who never liked spending much time with colleagues, found himself unexpectedly thrust into the life of female detective Wen Yan. The two teamed up to solve cases, becoming tacit partners who enjoyed playful banter.  Cheng Huai An's cold personality was melted by Wen Yan's warmth, but Wen Yan's advances seemed to have ulterior motives. 

While investigating the mysterious death of their neighbor, a psychic blogger, they accidentally uncovered a red cloth that brought bad luck. Cheng Huai An subsequently faced numerous life-or-death crises, helping Wen Yan and developing feelings for each other amidst the dangers. But even stranger things awaited them.

Wen Yan had a car accident. The nurse called Shi Mu Bai and asked him to come over, but he ruthlessly refused and asked the nurse to wait until Wen Yan died before notifying him to collect the body. As much as Wen Yan once loved Shi Mu Bai, her heart felt so dead now, and she eventually died with endless regret. Unexpectedly, she turned around and was reborn a year ago. Wen Yan decided not to wrong herself anymore and resolutely signed the divorce agreement that Shi Mu Bai had given her long ago. Faced with Wen Yan's sudden change in temperament, Shi Mu Bai was in a daze for a moment...

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chong Sheng Hou, Zhe Ge Zong Cai Fu Ren Wo Bu Dang Le" (重生后，这个总裁夫人我不当了) by Qiao Xu Xu (乔栩栩).
dramas.t: Zong Cai Fu Ren Wo Dang Ni Le

dramas.syn: On a snowy night in the Year of the Snake, on the day Qiao Xi and Gu Jin Chen were supposed to register their marriage, Qiao Xi waited anxiously outside the Civil Registration Office, only to hear an "I'm sorry" from Gu Jin Chen. Recalling the sweetness of the first snow five years ago, his heart shattered. As she took off the ring, it fell, and while trying to pick it up, she was hit by a car. At that moment, Gu Jin Chen was driving by with Jiang An Yu and their son.

Yan Ruo Ting was cursed by his family and turned into a Doberman after being called a "dog" by Jiang Xiao Xi. If the curse is not broken within three months, he will be turned into a dog forever. Only Jiang Xiao Xi can break the curse. However, in order to avenge her beloved dog, Jiang Xiao Xi frequently sets obstacles, but in the process of binding, she gradually falls in love with Yan Ruo Ting and gradually falls into a dilemma.

Based on the strong setting of "Soul Exchange", the play tells the various problems and challenges faced by the new drama director Nie Wei and his girlfriend Yue Yue when they first entered the society from campus. Nie Wei Yi, who had just graduated for a year, didn't directly make a film, and experienced a huge psychological gap from the star senior to the delivery boy, which severely affected his self-confidence and led to his breakup with Yue Yue. At this time, Nie Wei saw a technology company summon product testers with huge bonuses. In order to make up for the rent of the theater, Nie Wei signed a contract on the spot, so he exchanged souls with his ex-girlfriend Yue Yue. The two started to break up and then broke up again. Forced to experience the funny journey of each other's life.

Meng Ci is transported into a novel and becomes a character in the story. She finds herself in a love triangle with the male lead and the second male lead, but she is determined to stay out of their way and not interfere with the plot. However, things get complicated when the male lead starts to show interest in her, and she begins to develop feelings for him. As she tries to navigate her way through the story and find a way back to the real world, Meng Ci must also deal with the jealous second male lead and the challenges that come with being a character in a novel.

~~ Adapted from a webnovel "Zhe Fan Pai Wang Fei Wo Bu Dang Le" (这反派王妃我不当了) by Ban Tang Bu Tai Tian Xiao (半糖不太甜小).
dramas.t: Bai Tuo Le, Nan Zhu Bie Guo Lai

dramas.syn: Yan Ying, a fearless general from a fantasy novel, enters the real world to change her tragic fate by finding the author who wrote her story. As she falls for Xu Chi, a rising publisher, she uncovers his secret and a cycle of love and loss that spans multiple crossings. Now, she must choose between rewriting her past or embracing a new future with him.

After being rejected for the 99th time, Song Cheng finally decides to give up on her four-year crush on Jiang Xing Yue. After returning home, she impulsively agrees to go on a blind date only to discover that the person is Jiang Xing Yue's uncle, Jiang Yu.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "He Dao Shi Xiang Qin Hou, Wo Jia Jin Le Ding Ji Hao Men" (和导师相亲后，我嫁进了顶级豪门), also known as "Shang Ke Kai Xiao Chai, Bei Jiao Shou Lao Gong Dang Chang Zhua Bao" (上课开小差，被教授老公当场抓包) by Fei Ran (匪然).

A homebody named Su Yan accidentally clicks on an online ad and stumbles into the demon world's capital city, Linyuan. Unexpectedly, he somehow becomes a demon king who doesn't know anything about magic. In order not to let others find out that he's a powerless pushover and get himself killed, Su Yan decides to fawn on the powerful General Hua, whose power is only second to that of the Demon King. 

However, it turns out that General Hua is also a person who has traveled through time and space from the modern world. So the two moderners begin their journey of leveling up and battling monsters together in Linyuan City. They tame the mount, Silver Dragon, and outwit the demon world's high-ranking officials while concealing their identities. On the once-in-300-years Dengming Assembly, they promote talks between the monster clan's Young Master Ying Ri and the immortal realm's Lord Lu Zhen…

Sheng Mu Mu has been transported into a TV series, forced to become the wicked stepmother of a 17-year-old wealthy young master, with a tragic end in store. To reverse her hellish start, Sheng Mu Mu vows to be a good stepmother to her rebellious stepson and her scheming husband. She plays the caring, supportive husband, yet the paranoid, wealthy daughter, Qu Hui, is determined to destroy their relationship. Her stepson backs her up, her husband dotes on her to no end, and she unexpectedly discovers she's also the daughter of a wealthy family! Starting with a shaky hand and desperately trying to save herself, Sheng Mu Mu unexpectedly becomes a winner in life!

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Piao Liang Hou Ma, Tian Fan Quan Jia" (漂亮後媽，甜翻全家) by Lu Chi (鹿遲).
dramas.t: Piao Liang Hou Ma Tian Fan Quan Jia

dramas.syn:
Nan Xi is the adopted daughter of the Meng family and lives with her adopted brother Meng Li Chuan. The two have been in love for many years, but Nan Xi suddenly "agreed" to the marriage proposal of his good brother, Xu Yan, the driver's son. Feeling doubly betrayed, he went abroad.

Six years later, Meng Li Chuan returned to China and met Nan Xi again. He kept testing and provoking Nan Xi with his resentment and suppressed emotions for the past.
dramas.t: Nan Feng Bu Shi Jiu Shi Ren

dramas.nt: 夫人她专治不服 第二季‎
dramas.syn:
The mysterious powerhouse Shen Qing Ci enters a flash marriage with Beijing’s top playboy Xi Xing Ye to reclaim her mother’s company. Less than a year into their marriage, Xi Xing Ye’s grandfather suddenly falls ill, pushing the Xi family into crisis. Shen Qing Ci steps up with both strength and strategy, restructuring the company, “strictly” reforming her unreliable husband, and conveniently straightening out Xi Xing Ye’s circle of playboy friends, winning over their grandparents as well.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Lao Po Tai Ye, Fan Gu Tai Zi Ye Ku Zhe Qiu Tie Tie" (老婆太野，反骨太子爷哭着求贴贴), also known as "Hong Bu Liao, Zuo Jing Tai Zi Ye You Cha You Ku Bao" (哄不了，作精太子爷又茶又哭包), by Tu Lao Xi (秃老师).
dramas.t: Fu Ren Ta Zhuan Zhi Bu Fu Season 2

dramas.syn:
Su Zhuo, a wander, enters the martial arts world and become involved in case of a village massacre and curse. Through a series of investigations, the truth is revealed that the culprits are actually a group of soldiers.

This incident leads to the formation of a trio in the Jianghu, including the mysterious Ding Xiu. Unexpectedly, Ding Xiu is the daughter of a power official, Wei Hou, and her goal in getting close to Su Zhuo is to discover his true identity. However, Ding Xiu develops feelings for Su Zhuo during their interactions, leading to a love story intertwined with martial arts world

~~Adapted from a web novel  "Jiang Hu Tan An Chuan Qi" (江湖探案传奇) by Zhu Xiao Chuan (朱小川)

After her family is massacred, Shen Qing Ru infiltrates the General’s household through marriage to seek revenge against the man she believes destroyed her life. Trapped within palace intrigue, she becomes entangled in a turbulent relationship of love and hatred, until the truth behind the massacre is revealed—forcing both to choose between vengeance, sacrifice, and redemption amid a brutal power struggle.
dramas.t: The Ultimate Vow, Unknown to You

dramas.syn:
Modern artist Su Xiao Chen transmigrates into the body of Feng Zhi Wei, a disgraced concubine banished to the Cold Palace. To survive, she begins creating illustrated storybooks under the pen name “Mr. Qing Qiao,” unaware that her protagonist is actually the Crown Prince himself, Gu Jian Chen. The Crown Prince secretly suffers from four distinct personalities: the gentle and refined Gu Jian Chen, the ruthless night demon Ye Xuan, the flirtatious nobleman Fu Yi, and the innocent youth Ruan Che. 

Feng Zhi Wei soon discovers that her kisses are the only key to triggering his personality switches. Thus begins a mutually beneficial bargain: he needs her help to stabilize the imperial court, while she needs his power and influence to secure her freedom and a future beyond the palace.

The story is about a guy named Tang Zhong who happens to debut in the entertainment scene on behalf of his twin brother. He encounters with Dong Pu Ti, an exchange student who isn't friendly at first, but they end up falling in love with each other.

A romance in the skies follows an older woman and a younger guy who are both working in the field of aviation.
In order to fulfill his late mother's wishes, Li Qianyun learns to overcome his fear of heights through the encouragement of flight attendant He Xiaoxiao.

Jiang Li discovered that Jiang Mo Chen and Liu Ning had no boundaries when they were together. She broke up with him after witnessing their intimate interaction during camping. She ran into Xie Yan, who had been secretly in love with her since college. When he learned that she was single. Xie Yan proposed to her, and she agreed because of her family. After marriage, Xie Yan was very caring, but Jiang Mo Chen came to pester her. Jiang Li finally realized that it was Xie Yan who had always loved her.

In 1941, Ding Xiao He, who served as the executive director's secretary of the Shanghai Examination Institute of the Wang Puppet National Government, stood at the crossroads of his life. His direct leader, Lao Tang, was attacked by political enemies. Seeing that he was desperate, Ding Xiao He suddenly discovered that his "sister" Xiao Qing was actually an underground member of the Communist Party of China.

He had to help Lao Tang negotiate the conditions for surrender with the Military Control Commission, while protecting Xiao Qing from being discovered by Wang Puppet No. 76. He set up a careful plan to take Xiao Qing to Hong Kong with Lao Tang, but Lao Tang abandoned him and ran away. Ding Xiao He, who was desperate, was mistakenly transferred to No. 76 by the Japanese and became a spy for the Military Control Commission by chance. After witnessing the doomsday carnival-like…

Middle-aged Xu Meng An thought she had everything under control, but her life suddenly went out of control. The company laid off a large number of employees, promotion was blocked, her husband Li Lin lost his job, her daughter was suspected of premature love, and she unexpectedly had a second child. All these problems came at once, leaving her exhausted. How to find the motivation to start again under the pressure of reality and strive to balance between self-growth and family responsibilities are the problems she needs to solve urgently.

On the other hand, her best friend, Chen Wan Zhen, was ignored by her husband, Yu Hai, in her life as a full-time housewife. She was so distressed that she decided to return to the workplace. Xu Meng An's sister, Xu Meng Xin ​, suffered from hormone imbalance during pregnancy. In the struggle and pain, they overcame the difficulties with softness and…
~~ Two versions: 45 eps (Original) || 42 eps (DVD)

Wu Yu Xin, a resolute and resolute advertising agency director, has a frightening office style, but no one would have expected that she is actually an otaku in private. She loves the two-dimensional contrast, but she just wants to preserve her own image in the workplace and never let others know this secret. Until one day her two-dimensional male god broke the two-dimensional wall and came to her world, but he also has a double-faced personality. Can Wu Yu Xin accept the unknown side of the male god?

Song Shuang Xu was exiled abroad for five years because she fell in love with her brother, who was not related to her by blood. When she returned to China, she met He Ting Zhou. He was her brother's friend, and she avoided him as much as possible. She never thought that one day, she would have an unspeakable relationship with him. Little did she know that this game was a long-planned seduction by He Ting Zhou.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Guo Fen Ye" (过分野) by Niao Song Mi (鸟松米).

Xu Xing Ran had been in love with He Han Sheng for seven years. On the day of the engagement, it was cancelled because of He Han Sheng's white moonlight's birthday. She left resolutely in grief. He Han Sheng mistakenly thought that she was just being impulsive, but she turned around and found another good partner. He has always been arrogant and aloof, but now he is in a state of extreme madness. 

Xu Xing Ran was born with the ability of a crow's mouth, but she cannot use it when facing the person she loves deeply. When she was devoted to He Han Sheng, this ability seemed to be dormant, but it awakened again after they broke up. At this time, Xu Xing Ran has a sincere protector beside her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "He Zong Wei Bai Yue Guang Qu Xiao Ding Hun, Wo Bu Jia Le" (贺总为白月光取消订婚，我不嫁了) by Xing Hui (星茴).

dramas.t: Honey on the Edge of a Knife

dramas.nt: 桑总别虐了，夫人她要嫁人了
dramas.syn: Nan Feng has been Sang Yin Heng’s secretary by day and mistress by night for the last five years and now things are changing. Mr Sang is getting married to a wealthy heiress, his mother disapproves of his relationship with Nan Feng and is out to set her up with someone else.
dramas.t: Sang Mulberry Atrocities, Tatadae Needs to Get Married

dramas.syn: Ye Lan Xi got drunk at a bar and accidentally slept with Lu Yan Zhou, the president of Lu Group. Unexpectedly, after a night of passion, she got pregnant with his child! Six years later, Ye Lan Zi returned to China with her genius babies and started the road of abusing scumbags and slapping faces, and also attracted Lu Yan Zhou's attention.
dramas.t: Lu Zong Ni Jia Si Bao Yao Ni Tian

dramas.syn:
Lin Xing Yue transmigrates as a vicious supporting character in some novel. A system demands that she torture the docile male protagonist, Jiang Jin, into a state of paranoia before returning to reality. Little does she know that Jiang Jin possesses the ability to read minds and is able to see through her gentle nature beneath her veneer of malevolence. To avoid punishment from the system, Xing Yue resorts to a "performance" of abuse, secretly protecting him. He plays along, but in reality, he sinks deeper into depravity.

~~ Versions: 76 episodes (iQiyi) || 82 episodes (Apps)

Police captain Song Cheng, who is persistent in his work and has extraordinary powers of observation, discovers that a case he's working on is inextricably linked to another case from four years ago. The two cases also have a common witness, Yu Xiao. As Song Cheng dives into the investigation between the two cases, the secrets of Yu Xiao's life are revealed one by one. With Song Cheng's encouragement and help, Yu Xiao joins hands with the police to find the truth and bring the real culprit to justice.

~~ Adapted from the novel "An Lian Zhe De Jiu Shu" (暗恋者的救赎) by Fan Shu (樊树).

Cute Jiang Xiao Li accidentally discovers that her favorite swimming team captain Ouyang Xi turns into a cat. This leads to them cohabitating by chance. With her help, Ouyang Xi gradually finds a solution.
dramas.t: Zhe Ge Xue Zhang You Dian Tian

dramas.syn: As the daughter of Duke of the Anye Clan, Yue Lan Shan is famous for her unique skill, Heart Tune. To find her benefactor, she travels under the alias, Nan Xia, and make a name for herself in the martial arts world. She discovers that a member of the Qingfeng Clan has a birthmark of the shape of peach blossom on his chest, the same as the one she saw on her benefactor. A love story of the martial arts world unfolds…

Zhong Li Xue, from the Zhongli Medical Center, was influenced by her father from a young age to hold onto her beliefs of love and staying true to oneself as a way of life.

However, when she was seven years old, her father suddenly passed away while treating the disabled young master Chu Lu Yan from a prominent group. The medical center was falsely accused by malicious people of delaying Chu Lu Yan's treatment, causing their reputation to plummet and their business to suffer.

In order to revive the medical center, Zhong Li Xue, when she grew up, was willing to become Chu Lu Yan's bodyguard. However, in the process of battling with the useless young master, she discovered that the accusations against the medical center were just a long- planned lie. Chu Lu Yan, who she had always seen as an enemy, was actually just like her, a victim of lies.

Therefore, in the face of the safety of…

To avenge the extermination of her family, Shen Nan Zhi took over Su Ying's identity and sneaked into the Governor's Mansion to find out the truth. She was unexpectedly favored by Yan Jiu Lin. But the next day, she was replaced by the scheming woman Meng Ying and became his concubine. Meng Ying was determined to get rid of Su Ying and teamed up with Butler Wang to frame Su Ying in various ways, but was saved by Yan Jiu Lin every time. 

Yan Jiu Lin also found out that the person that night was not Meng Ying and began to flirt with Su Ying in various ways. Su Ying, who was originally determined to take revenge, fell in love with Yan Jiu Lin during their time together. Su Ying was faced with a choice between revenge and love.

dramas.nt: 闪婚后被千亿老公宠上天
dramas.syn: Shen Mu is forced into a blind date. To avoid a man who's been married four times, she forcefully kisses Lu Shi Yan, a top figure in Beijing's inner circle. Lu Shi Yan then takes her home and arranges a flash marriage.
