Their daily interactions gradually develop feelings for each other, but jealousy leads to a series of misunderstandings, which are quickly resolved. Lu Shi Yan discovers that the genius Cindy he's been searching for is actually a young woman who's been married off in a flash and harbors many secrets.
dramas.t: Shan Hun Hou Bei Qian Yi Lao Gong Chong Shang Tian

dramas.syn:
Sports reporter Yu Sheng Kai receives her first major assignment: an exclusive interview with tennis star Fang Ming. She tries to avoid the task at all costs, finding it impossible to control her feelings whenever he is near — a dangerous and forbidden attraction that deeply troubles her. 

Years earlier, as a young girl, Sheng Kai had developed a profound crush on the tennis team's star athlete. However, following their parents' remarriage, the two — who share no biological ties — unexpectedly became step-siblings. Unable to bear the awkwardness of living under the same roof, Sheng Kai eventually fled abroad to escape her complicated emotions. 

Now, upon their sudden reunion, Fang Ming goes to great lengths to entice her, forcing her to finally confront the true feelings hidden in her heart.

Yun Yao Yao accidentally traveled through time and space and became a cannon fodder in the novel of Tyrant, but after assassinating the tyrant Tu Shan Jin, she exchanged souls with him.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ta, Yu Bao Jun Hu Huan Hou, Sha Feng La!" (她，与暴君互换后，杀疯啦！) by Xiao Pang Zi Kuai Pao (小胖子快跑).

Cui Yun Tan discovers that the aloof school heartthrob, Shi Jin, is secretly dating someone behind her back. Without hesitation, Cui Yun Tan finds a blond-haired guy on the street as her new love interest. This blond-haired guy is not only obedient and sensible but also very professional, often making Cui Yun Tan's heart flutter. Little does she know that this understanding and well-behaved younger brother is actually Shen Yan, the heir to the Shen Group. 

At this time, Shen Yan is using the alias Zhou Xi and has run away from home to pursue his dream of entering the entertainment industry. Because Cui Yun Tan witnessed her sister being hurt by her lover since childhood, she doesn't understand love and is afraid to love, only daring to be with the person she likes in unconventional ways.

Song Wei Wei found her husband, Li Bai Han, cheating with Miao Yi Ren. Rushing out in anger, Song Wei Wei gets into a car accident, after which she changes her face and identity to Song Wei Yi. 

Six years later, Song Wei Yi gets close to Li Bai Han under her new identity as his secretary to save her son.

Su Yuan suffered emotional betrayal and her life hit rock bottom. At her most helpless moment, the mysterious man Chen Lie was like a ray of light, helping her many times. From misunderstanding to knowing each other, the relationship between the two gradually warmed up. However, Chen Lie's true identity is a mystery. Does he care about Su Yuan for other purposes? 

When Su Yuan decided to escape from the predicament and pursue an independent life, Chen Lie took the initiative to propose a further relationship. Faced with the entanglement of her ex-boyfriend and the new emotional opportunities, how will Su Yuan choose? A game of love and conspiracy is being played out. Can Su Yuan see the truth and find her own happiness?

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Luo Ru Ta De Quan Tao" (落入他的圈套) by Ye Cao Mei (野草莓).
dramas.t: Luo Ru Ta De Quan Tao

dramas.syn:
A marriage contract brought Su Shi Mo down from the mountains. When she saw her frail, seemingly terminally ill fiancé, Pei Jin Heng, who she was marrying in someone else's place, she thought it was hopeless. However, Pei Jin Heng turned around and offered a ten-billion-dollar dowry. Su Shi Mo’s eyes sparkled instantly—who said he was hopeless? He’s very capable! And even if he weren’t, she could make him capable.

With her medical skills in hand, Su Shi Mo declared, “Mr. Pei, I’ve got this!”

Feng Wei Yue, the leader of a modern spatial research team, suffers an accident during an experiment and is transported to the Yinbei Dynasty alongside her colleague Ye Chang Jiu and her superior Jun Qing Ye. Transmigrating into the body of the Grand Tutor's legitimate daughter, she wakes up inside the bedchamber of Prince Rong (Mo Yu Ya) and finds herself saddled with the unfortunate reputation of being a hopelessly lovestruck consort. Meanwhile, Mo Yu Ya is the frequent target of assassination attempts by Gu Nan Ke, the master of Xingzhao Pavilion, with whom Feng Wei Yue unexpectedly shares a complex connection. Fortunately, the dimensional bracelet on her wrist, carried over from the modern world, becomes her greatest secret advantage.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Meng Fei Tian Jiang: Fu Hei Xie Wang Re Bu De" (萌妃天降：腹黑邪王惹不得) by Yun Jin Que (云锦鹊).
dramas.t: Phoenix Rising from the Faint Moon

dramas.syn:
"Campus Basketball," tells the high school students Yan Yufeng, Xiang Jie and Gao who love basketball.
The original Big Three, from the school team to the high school league championship, watched them put the basketball and its passion and blood and algebra, geometric problems, English words into the mind. Concentrate all feelings in a high-five, all the blood, all expectations, all the love of basketball, and all the pursuit, persistence or abandonment of dreams. There have been contradictions, setbacks, failures, and finally harvested friendships and growth. In retrospect, only tears burst into tears. Basketball is not a tool to play handsome, basketball is an attitude! If you really like basketball, no matter how high or low, talent, please stick to it.

“The workplace requires strategy, and love involves combat, so we must fight with elegance.” 
 
These words, shared in a dialogue between Xunuo and Shen Zhize, sum up protagonist Xunuo’s personal dilemma when the young woman is faced with a choice between her career and her lover. When workplace battles are more complicated than war, Xunuo’s every move must be calculated. This TV drama reflects the realities of young Chinese adults in today’s competitive society and intends to inspire young people to fulfill their dreams through perseverance, even when in the face of adversity and temptations.

Actor Hu Jun plays a single dad to his only daughter played by Gina Jin. The modern drama explores the relationships between various types of parental figures as Hu Jun learns the dos and donts of being a dad. Beside a hormonal daughter, he also has to deal with his own stubborn mother and a potential love interest in his life.

The drama tells a story about youth and how their growth is triggered after a simple game of hide-and-seek. The participants in this process reveal an unknown secret, and the game becomes a catalyst for crushing several strong friendships.

Wei Yin Xian has one goal - a college education - but her abusive family gets in the way.  Fu Xuan Yi's family has two goals - getting him to break his celibacy and continuing their line, something they have struggled with for generations.

dramas.nt: 死后才知，我竟是京圈太子白月光
dramas.syn:
Shen Xi Wei gives everything to a man she once pitied—money, gifts, even the family company—only to be used and betrayed. On the day he marries someone else, a single, cruel phone call pushes her life to a tragic end. As the truth around her death slowly comes to light, unexpected secrets and long-hidden feelings emerge, forcing everyone to reckon with love, betrayal, and the price of sacrifice.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Si Hou Cai Zhi, Wo Jing Shi Jing Quan Tai Zi Bai Yue Guang" (死后才知，我竟是京圈太子白月光), also known as "Wo Cuo Jia Can Si, Jing Quan Da Lao Wei Wo Ku Hong Yan" (我错嫁惨死，京圈大佬为我哭红眼), by Ye Li Wan (叶梨晚).
dramas.t: Si Hou Cai Zhi, Wo Jing Shi Jing Quan Tai Zi Bai Yue Guang

dramas.syn:
Tang Miao Xin enters a mystery game and becomes the wife of King Ning Gu Zhou through an arranged marriage. As she navigates palace intrigue and excels at Dayan Academy, she uncovers Ning Gu Zhou’s hidden pain and helps her friends defy injustice, all while facing the growing threat of powerful adversaries.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wang Fei Ta Bu Jiang Wu De" (王妃她不讲武德) by Tang Hua Lao (棠花落).
The drama follows the love story between the heir of a tea business and a tea picker.
dramas.t: When Shui Met Mo: A Love Story Season 2

dramas.syn: A secret that has been dormant for thousands of years is revealed, but found full of crisis. Retreat or surrender? A story of love and protection across thousands of years is coming.
dramas.t: Love You for Thousands of Years

dramas.syn: Mu Jun Ze has had a crush on Chu Meng since they were in school. However, she has always liked his brother. Years later, she was broken up and her stepmother urged her to marry an old man. That night she met Mu Jun Ze by chance. She signed a marriage contract to deal with their parents, but she didn't know that he had been thinking about her for ten years. After marriage, the two maintained a physical relationship. One day, Mu Jun Ze landed in Chu Meng's company as the new general manager. Working together day and night, Chu Meng finally gradually fell in love with her husband. When her ex-boyfriend came back, she realized her own heart more clearly.

dramas.nt: 替身秘书：厉总别撩了，我只是机器人
dramas.syn: Li Shao Chen, the president of Li's company, spent a night with Shen Xing Chen. When he woke up, he found that he was not allergic. He began to look for the special Shen Xing Chen. At the same time, in order to avoid his grandmother's urging to get married, Li Shao Chen spent a lot of money to make a robot to pretend to be his girlfriend. On the day of delivery, the robot malfunctioned, and Shen Xing Chen, who looked like the robot, came to Li Shao Chen's company and pretended to be a robot.
dramas.t: Ti Shen Mi Shu: Li Zong Bie Liao Le, Wo Zhi Shi Ji Qi Ren

dramas.syn: Song Qian Qian, an ordinary waitress, lives a simple and quiet life. One night, she accidentally ran into Fu Jing Xing who was being plotted against. The two had sex. Afterwards, Song Qian Qian was terrified and fled in a hurry. Just when she was being forced to marry by her mother and tortured by her family to the point of despair, Fu Jing Xing appeared domineeringly and started the mode of protecting his wife. She was also shocked to find that she was pregnant with his child. How will this love between two different statuses end?
dramas.t: Addicted to the Celibate Tycoon at Night

dramas.nt: 心动！他眼里有一束月光
dramas.syn:
Gu Han Zhang returned to her 17-year-old self. In this life, she never wanted to repeat the same mistakes, but she met Ji Xing Zhou. She avoided him and did not want to have any contact with such a person. But Ji Xing Zhou came to her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chong Sheng Zai Ni De Xin Shang Yin Ge Zhang" (重生在你的心上印个章), also known as "Xin Dong! Ge Bi Wu Shi Li You Yi Shu Yue Guang" (心动！隔壁舞室里有一束月光), by San Sheng San San (叁生三三).

Wandering scholar Xie Yuan accidentally enters a matriarchal kingdom where women take multiple husbands. Admired for his looks, he’s forcibly taken by the eldest princess to become her consort. Refusing to yield, Xie Yuan plans his escape, but when the gentle second princess aids him, he’s drawn into a dangerous struggle of power and deceit within the royal palace.

Fashion designer Li Zhi Nan holds a personal fashion show in order to establish a relationship with Cesar, the richest man in Italy, in order to break into the international market. An emergency crops up when the main piece is damaged, but Zhi Nan handles it calmly, making a decisive cut and immediately spotting Song Xing Ye, a model with an outstanding physique, and lets him walk the finale on the runway. The show is well-received, and the two also fall in love. Zhi Nan assumes the relationship is purely transactional, but it turns out to be an exclusive trap set for her by a big shot disguising as a puppy-like nobody.

Jiang Ye, a rebellious young woman, has a strained relationship with her mother, Jiang Ai Hua. After a car accident, she is unexpectedly transported back to 1990. There, she meets Chen Zhi Yuan, a promising young elite, and through a series of misunderstandings, becomes his temporary girlfriend. She also finds her mother as a child—then known as Jiang Xiao Hua—living a difficult and troubled life.

Determined to protect the young mother who suffered so much in her childhood, Jiang Ye conceals her true identity and pretends to be a “cousin from Hong Kong” so she can stay by Jiang Xiao Hua’s side. With Chen Zhi Yuan’s help, she confronts the challenges around them and helps free Jiang Xiao Hua from the control of abusive relatives.

The two make an agreement to form a temporary family and, taking advantage of the opportunities of the era, work together while safeguarding Jiang Xiao Hua’s…

Chen Xian Qi, the editor of a small fashion magazine, accidentally misplaces a borrowed diamond. She mistakenly suspects intern lawyer Xiao Jia You of taking it. While tracking him down, she not only fails to recover the diamond, but also loses her job and falls into heavy debt to pay for its replacement.

At her lowest point, Xian Qi inherits a mysterious jade bracelet with magical powers. By a twist of fate, she and Jia You end up sharing a two-bedroom apartment. Forced to live together despite their mutual dislike, the two use the powers of the bracelet to help others, gradually growing closer and falling in love along the way.
dramas.t: Make A Wish Miss Xian Qi

dramas.syn: In 1910, in old Shanghai, a once-inconsequential paparazzi becomes an industry darling when he publishes his portrayal of ten female celebrities, revealing the dark side of their glamorous lives.

Li Zhi Qing gives up her career for marriage, only to face betrayal when her husband cheats with her best friend. As her father’s fall puts the family business in crisis, her husband turns greedy, fighting for control. Determined to reclaim her life, Li Zhi Qing fights back, rising stronger and taking revenge.

dramas.nt: 机长大人，请勿偏离心动航线
dramas.syn: When Nebula Airlines' ace female pilot Lu Ling was frustrated in her career and in her life, she happened to meet the new president Cen Yi Lou. She found that Cen Yi Lou was like her ideal man and fell in love with him. Later, she became his co-pilot and fought side by side in the flight mission, and their relationship warmed up.
dramas.t: Ji Zhang Da Ren, Qing Wu Pian Li Xin Dong Hang Xian

dramas.syn:
The play tells the story of Zheng Ke, the number one assassin in the world, who went to the palace to prepare to assassinate his father in order to avenge his death. However, he never imagined that a huge conspiracy was about to be revealed. Zheng Ke, who was dormant in the palace, accidentally exchanged bodies with Qi Wan Er, the princess who was loved by thousands of people. So, the two began to look for a way to switch back together. 

As their understanding deepened, the two went from being suspicious of each other to protecting and understanding each other, gradually strengthened their feelings for each other, and worked together to overthrow the conspiracy of the prime minister who attempted rebellion...
dramas.t: Gong Zhu De Jiao Huan Ren Sheng

dramas.syn: Wen Qing was framed and had a one-night stand with the domineering CEO, Fu Ruo Ting. Unexpectedly, she got pregnant. She met the handsome uncle again and smiled charmingly. The business tycoon turns into a wife-loving maniac and spoils her like a princess!
dramas.t: Shi Jian Fan Hua Zhi Yin Ni

dramas.syn:
Two years ago, popular actress Shu Xing attended a dinner party where she was framed for murder. The public's opinion of her instantly fell, as she fell into the abyss. 

After being dormant for two years, she made a domineering comeback, vowing to find the truth of that year, so that all those who did wrong will be punished!

As the plan unfolded, the secrets hidden by Ling Yun, Guang Yue, Su Yu, Molly and others gradually emerged. Ex-boyfriend Gu Chen and current boyfriend Jing Ning were also involved. Faced with chaotic and complex emotions, how will everyone complete their salvation?

~~ Adapted from the web manhua "The Broken Star" (粉碎星辰) by San Shi Er (三十儿).

Programmer Hao Duan Duan lost his job due to the collapse of his previous company. Sun Yi Liu, a returnee investor, saw a profitable opportunity in the AI ​​travel app that was previously created by Duan Duan. This led to the two of them forming a team to start a new business, and to solidify the team, they also brought in Li Meng and the executive Zhou Xiao Ou, who's going through a mid-life crisis.

dramas.nt: 和你分手后的第七个冬
dramas.syn: On a snowy night, single mother Xia Qin reunites with her child and her first love, Meng Sheng. Seven years ago, to protect Meng Sheng and his siblings from being blackmailed by their biological father, she used the money from selling her house to force him to back down, only to be misunderstood as someone who abandoned Meng Sheng for wealth. Now, Meng Sheng is a rising star in the business world, witnessing Xia Qin's hardships working at a convenience store, and his initial motivation shifts from revenge to discovering the truth. When Xia Qin is bullied by the villain Zhou Yan Ran and her son Tong Tong goes blind, Meng Sheng risks his life to protect her.

At the end of some dynasty, wokou pirates run amuck and the eunuchs had the imperial power in their hands. Eunuch Cao of the Eastern Bureau colludes with the pirates to slaughter the people of the martial arts world and plot a rebellion. The leader of the Magpie Saber Sect Chang Hai is actually a member of a secret anti-pirate organization. Apart from wiping out the pirates, his other important task is to discover the officials who collude with the pirates. Meanwhile, Eunuch Cao is secretly  monitoring all sects for those who oppose him.

To conceal his identity, Xi Men Chang Hai finds his twin brother, Xi Men Chang Zai, who is living in their hometown, and asks the latter to take his place. Although twins, they are utterly distinctive in character and life choice. Chang Hai is a hero while Chang Zai is a timid cook. Initially Chang Zai doesn’t agree but is persuaded  by Chang Hai’s…

After Wen Zhi Xian broke up with her fiancé, she impulsively decided to marry Qi Yan Jing, whom she had only met a few times. After marriage, Gu Yu Chen still pestered her and repeatedly came to the house to cause trouble to the newlyweds. Qi Yan Jing gradually opened up to Wen Zhi Xian, and Qi Yan Jing gradually walked out of the haze...

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Qi Jiao Shou Jie Ge Hun" (祁教授借个婚) by Fu Long (伏珑).

When she was sixteen, Xia Zhi Cha fell in love with Fu Ci Yu, who was an untouchable star in the sky. She quietly hid her love and persisted in a corner where no one was around for three whole years. Unexpectedly, when she was nineteen, she met Fu Ci Yu again in college. Later, because of a game, the two had a brief relationship.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Di Sheng Hong! Bao Bei, Wo Zhi Yao Ni" (低声哄！宝贝，我只要你), also known as "Ta De Pian Ai Shi Kong Le" (他的偏爱失控了), by Che Jing (澈净).

The Wen family of Hong Kong fell overnight, and Wen Yu was imprisoned by Shen Ji Bai. For the sake of the Beigang docks, Shen Ji Bai used Wen Yu's twin sister, Wen Ruan, as a substitute, making her pretend to be his loving wife. Wen Ruan, wanting to escape Shen Ji Bai's clutches, turned her attention to Pei Yan, the Hong Kong heir, while Pei Yan also became curious about this woman with a mysterious identity.

In her past life, Li Bei Nian was deceived by her fiancé Mu Dong Li and her so-called best friend, suffering a tragic end. Reborn, she vows to tear off those hypocritical masks and trample all those who bullied her underfoot! So she teams up with her unruly brother-in-law to launch a revenge plan! Little did she know that Mu Xi Chen had been plotting against her for a long time.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chong Sheng Cheng Fan Pai Xin Tou Xue" (重生成反派心头血) by Wan Li Li (万里里).

Set in a declining industrial city in Northeast China during the 1990s, the story begins with a series of bizarre and tragic murders — a drunkard frozen into an ice sculpture, a strong man brutally dismembered, and a local thug who vanishes without a trace. Though seemingly unrelated, their fates intertwine through a web of emotional entanglements and coincidences. As the chain of “accidental deaths” unravels, it reveals the warmth within complex human nature and the flickers of hope that persist under the harsh rules of survival.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Yu Hong" (于洪) by Ban Yu (班宇).
dramas.t: The Old Story of Yu Hong

dramas.syn: Ferryman Zhao Li, college student Xia Dong Qing, and celestial maiden Ya reunited once again for their ghostbusting adventures. Except for this time, Xia was on the other side of the life/death divide after getting killed by a vengeful ghost. Fortunately, Ya's blood was able to keep him "undead" as he tried to collect 99 souls for the ferryman in exchange for returning to his "alive" state.

After the young lady Feng Er loses her mother, her father remarries and sends Feng Er to Ling Shan to study. She thus has to part ways with her childhood friend Chang Geng. Upon returning home after completing her studies, she surprisingly discovers that the house is deserted. When she becomes involved in a dispute, she saves a group of girls and takes them with her on her quest for her father and Chang Geng. Along the way, they meet the carefree Jing Rong, who starts harboring feelings for Feng Er.

I am not just a spoiled son-in-law who hasn't slept with my wife for 2 years. My wife thinks that I am uselesss and she wants to divorce me. But I am skillful and I am the young master of the Mo family.

dramas.nt: 破产后，我成了死对头的秘书
dramas.syn:
When rumors start swirling, spoiled young master Song Chen Yu lands a job as secretary to his archrival, Fu Jin Chang.

When a spoiled young heir's family goes bankrupt and his father vanishes, he's left to fend for himself. To pay off his father's debts, he becomes the secretary to his lifelong rival, CEO Fu. Their unlikely partnership leads to rumors of romance, which surprisingly sparks interest from potential sponsors. Forced to keep up the charade of being a couple, the two navigate a mix of rivalry, attraction, and high-stakes business deals.

After being emotionally hurt by a despicable man, Shen Yue Xi mistakes Sang Nan Feng for the most sought-after male entertainer at an establishment offering romantic and sexual services, and the two have a one-night stand.

To protect the Shen family's reputation, they are forced to marry.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Yu Lao Gong Si Xia Wei Zhuang, Tian Tian Ba Wo Qin Ku" (禁欲老公撕下伪装，天天把我亲哭), also known as "Re Shang Feng Pi Xiang Pao Lu, You Hong Hui Jia Chong Dao Ku" (惹上疯批想跑路，诱哄回家宠到哭), by Lou Xiang (陋巷).

In order to fight against criminality and achieve his dream of becoming a police officer. The young Liu Zi Ming joined the Criminal Investigation Detachment of the Criminal Security Bureau with enthusiasm. But, the tedious and uninteresting investigation work bored him. However, under the guidance of his superior, he gradually corrected his attitude and teamed up with his colleague to solve cases. 

As he got experienced and excelled in his job, Liu Zi Ming had a good understanding of the duality of the human nature. 
Now a Captain, he truly realizes the huge responsibilty of a criminal officer. This, thanks to the unreserved guidance of his superior, the trust of his  brothers in arms and the changes in his family and marriage. Being a police officer, he is honored to ensure social stability...

~~ Adapted from the novel "Yi Ge Xing Jing De Ri Zi" (一个刑警的日子) by Lan Yi (蓝衣).

dramas.nt: 老公是哑巴，别慌我是喇叭
dramas.syn:
Sang Lu is a vicious female supporting character in a romance novel. She married the mute Feng Yan, but he despised her. She did all kinds of bad things out of jealousy of the heroine and was ignored and slapped. After awakening, she tried to please Feng Yan and used talk therapy to get closer to him.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Gei Ya Ba Zong Cai Zuo Hua Liao, Hao Men Quan Meng Le" (我给哑巴总裁做话疗，豪门全懵了) by Lu Chi (鹿迟).
dramas.t: Lao Gong Shi Ya Ba, Bie Huang Wo Shi La Ba

dramas.syn: The warlord’s wife, the fake Su Ying (actually Su Lan), forces the mute girl Shen Wan Yin into surrogacy. But Shen Wan Yin is in fact the real Su Ying, who has returned with a new face. Pretending to be mute, she conceals her sharpness while plotting revenge for her parents. Su Lan once slaughtered Su Ying’s entire family and assumed her identity to marry in her place, unaware that what the warlord truly loved was Su Ying’s unique voice and soul. The warlord finds himself unable to resist his true feelings, while the fake Su Ying schemes and pursues her ruthlessly—until the story culminates in a dramatic reversal.
tags: Pretends To Be Mute / Mistaken As A Mute

dramas.syn:
It tells the story of Ling Luo, a female demon whose combat power rivals the three realms, who is reborn and, under the influence of her mortal enemy Yue Liang Ze, leads all those who have lost their way to turn the tide, become their own masters, and follow their own path.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Mie Le Tian Dao Hou Wo Cheng Le Si Dui Tou De Shi Mei" (灭了天道后我成了死对头的师妹 ) by Gui Shan Yu (归山玉).

In the new era of interconnectedness, there’s Zhu Meng, a programmer who has a natural talent for technology and has just entered the workplace, and there’s Luo Fengxiang, an internet giant.

The tech geek Zhu Meng sees through the true face of industry leader Luo Fengxiang. He decides to break free from the shackles of capital and start a journey of entrepreneurship for the ideals he holds dear.

He gathers a group of highly capable, eccentric, and interesting partners and establishes the Baohulu Technology Company. Although Baohulu faces challenges in financing, product development, and company operations, constantly experiencing life and death tests, Zhu Meng always sticks to his original intention and leads everyone to continue to grow.

Queen Rong Dai was killed in a palace conspiracy. When she opened her eyes, she found herself an unloved wife of a wealthy man in the modern era. She immediately recognized her rival as a scheming concubine from her past life and later found that her husband also looked familiar. Regal in bearing, she quickly has to learn how to adjust to this new time while negotiating the situation she has found herself in. Determined not to be betrayed again, she vows to repay a debt and earn her freedom.
dramas.t: Ai Ya! Huang Hou Niang Niang Lai Da Gong

dramas.syn:
The story of He Lin and Xu Ning, who suffers from a skin disease, from acquaintance to misunderstanding and love. With the help of He Lin, Xu Ning overcomes the disease, and the two experience twists and turns together, and finally harvest true love.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ke Fu Zheng Huan Zhe De Tie Tie Zhi Nan" (渴肤症患者的贴贴指南), also known as "Nv Peng You Huan You Ke Fu Zheng Shi Zhong Shen Me Ti Yan" (女朋友患有渴肤症是种什么体验), by Qu Bu Zhi (曲不知).
dramas.t: Cannot Fall in Love With You

dramas.syn:
In her previous life, Sheng Ge found out that Zhou Ye, a boy with a bad reputation, had committed suicide for her after she died. Her impression of him was that he was frivolous and careless. In her new life, Sheng Ge took the initiative to approach Zhou Ye.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhi Re Lun Xian" (炙热沦陷) by Jun Bu Qi (君不弃).

A graduation story focusing on senior high school "special class" students along with their headteacher Lao Mo and class teacher Yao Jing.
This drama is supported by the Teaching & Work Department of the Ministry of Education China. The drama production aim is to fully implement the party's education policy and promote the good character of teachers in the new era.

dramas.nt: 当戏精影后在霸总虐恋中摆烂
dramas.t: Dang Xi Jing Ying Hou Zai Ba Zong Nue Lian Zhong Bai Lan

dramas.syn:
Jiang Wan Ning had a one-night stand with the bankrupt Chu Jun because of drunkenness and was forced to marry by her grandmother. After marriage, the two gradually got closer in the entanglement of family, career, and emotion. The two tested each other and bickered, but protected each other in the crisis.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Liao Chong Mei Gui" (撩宠玫瑰), also known as "Gou Ye, You Ta Shi Kong" (够野，诱他失控), by Huai Xia (淮夏).

dramas.nt: 直播算命后我成了团宠
dramas.syn:
The master of metaphysics Lin Pian Bian disguised herself as a soft and cute fiancée to get close to Lu Ling, who was carrying a purple aura, in order to restore her spiritual power. While catching ghosts live to accumulate merit, she hid her vest and recognized her brother from the Nan family. When the villain Wen Qi used forbidden techniques to disrupt the world, she joined forces with Lu Ling to break the conspiracy, but was exposed and was pampered by him, and they worked together to break the fateful fetters of thousands of years.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zong Cai Bu Zhun Fu Ren Gao Xuan Xue" (总裁不准夫人搞玄学) by Xing Hui (星茴).

In a city plagued by terrifying undead and mysterious illnesses, the sorcerer Dong Qing emerges from seclusion to investigate. Suspicious of both supernatural and human causes, he sets out to uncover the truth behind the deadly chaos threatening Xuancheng.

The richest man becomes a vegetable? And the substitute bride turns out to be me! Greedy and dramatic Lin Shu Wan marries in her sister’s place to bring good luck to the comatose heir Qi Yan Zhi, thinking she can easily live a rich, carefree life. But her “vegetative” husband turns out to be able to hear her thoughts! Their hilarious daily inner banter unfolds as they go from a marriage of convenience to true love—slapping villains in the face and showering each other with affection.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Fu Ren Yi Shen Fan Gu, Jiu Ai Gei Qi Zong Tian Du" (夫人一身反骨，就愛給祁總添堵！) by Gu Liao Liao (顾了了).
dramas.t: Du Xin Lao Gong You Dian Tian

dramas.syn:
A riverbed dredging operation in the city uncovers skeletal remains. Forensic pathologist Qin Ming's autopsy reveals the body to be that of a woman from a long-standing cold case. 

On Qin Ming's birthday, a solar eclipse occurs, and a toy walkie-talkie unexpectedly connects him to his father, Qin Tian, ​​from thirty years in the past. Qin Ming warns of an impending explosion, saving Qin Tian but triggering a series of "Rainy Night Hammer Demon" cases. Two generations of police officers cross time to solve the case and uncover the truth.

~~ Adapted from the 7th novel "The Damned One" (天谴者) in the novel series "Medical Examiner Dr. Qin" (法医秦明) by Qin Ming (秦明). It covers three cases, namely "Shi Bian" ("尸变”), "Yu Zhong De Mu Nai Yi" (雨中的木乃伊), and "Xue Se Jiao Yu" (血色教育).
dramas.t: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: Bones of the Past

dramas.syn:
In the distant past, the "Heavenly Scar" appeared, bringing calamity to humanity. The young demoness Shangguan Zi Yan and the Taoist priest Yuan Chu are intertwined in fate, embarking on a journey to mend the heavens as ninth-rank demon hunters. 

Shangguan Zi Yan suffers from a malevolent disease, experiencing eccentricities between her body and spirit. At the same time, Yuan Chu is trapped in a love tribulation, where his lover is dying in the process. Having witnessed the full spectrum of human and demonic nature, the two ultimately weave a tapestry of love to mend the heavens and save the world.

I Am Yu Huanshui is a story for the underdogs about a man who tolerates as much as he can, yet things change when he discovers that he is terminal ill.

~~ Adapted from the novel “If There Is No Tomorrow”.
The story is based on the love between college students. There are many different couples that go through sweet and sour.

During a delivery, Wen Yan was trapped in an elevator with Fu Yanzhi, the president of Fu Group. When the elevator fell rapidly, the two accidentally swapped souls. At that time, the project of Fu Group suddenly encountered a crisis. Wen Yan was forced to go to work in the company instead of Fu Yanzhi, and Fu Yanzhi also lived as Wen Yan. Faced with the current situation, the two could only guide each other and help each other cover up.

Freelance photographer Mo Xiang Bei unexpectedly gets pregnant while her childhood boyfriend, Mu Yi Nan, is focused on his career. As tensions rise over his frequent absences and an actress's advances, Mo becomes increasingly suspicious. After the loss of her mother and miscarriage, she breaks down and leaves Mu, starting a new life in Dali with a small shop called "Regret Inn", seeking self-redemption.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ai Qing Yi Nan Xiang Bei" (爱情以南向北) by Nan San Hua (南三花).

Jia Ji Xiang and Sha Li, once strangers in a bustling city, cross paths by chance. Their journey from animosity to a whirlwind romance and flash marriage is tested by family ties, friendships, and life’s struggles. After misunderstandings lead to divorce, they grow individually, only to reunite and rediscover their love.

After being betrayed and left disabled by her scheming stepsister, Jiang Mu Sheng vows to take everything back. To exact revenge, she sets her sights on Zhou Chao Xuan, the powerful fiancé of her rival and president of the Zhou Group. What begins as a calculated game of hearts soon reveals deeper truths: a daughter’s determination to avenge her mother, and a CEO’s long-hidden devotion. As the Jiang family empire falls, Mu Sheng fights to reclaim her rightful inheritance and finds unexpected redemption in a love that is mutual and unwavering.

dramas.nt: 一觉醒来，我和死对头结婚生崽
dramas.syn:
Ruan Tang transmigrates into her body six years in the future, only to discover that her husband is her former most hated nemesis, and that they have a son, Leng Nian Chen. She learns that she cheated on her husband with Qin Yu when she was twenty-four, and later discovers that she is just a supporting character in a novel centered around Qin Yu. After her consciousness awakens, she begins to make amends to Leng Nian Chen. After discovering that her former nemesis now dotes on her, she gradually falls in love with Leng Jing.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yi Jiao Xing Lai, Wo He Si Dui Tou Sheng Le Ge Zai!" (一觉醒来，我和死对头生了个崽！) by Ri Cun Jin Xin (日寸今心).
dramas.t: Yi Jiao Xing Lai, Wo He Si Dui Tou Jie Hun Sheng Zai

dramas.syn: Senior slacker Gu Bei is transported back in time and becomes a frontier general. After spending three carefree years living off the success of Xiaoyao Pavilion, an imperial decree summons him back to the capital, where he discovers that Emperor Xiao Ce is actually his former roommate. One dreams of taking it easy and becoming the richest man alive, while the other is determined to become one of history's greatest emperors. Together, the two brothers use modern thinking to outsmart corrupt officials, take down powerful drug lords, fend off western invaders, and hilariously rewrite their destinies in the ancient world.
dramas.t: No Way! My Bro Is the Emperor

dramas.syn: During the early years of liang, the Emperor ascends to Heaven, and Ye Xingyun was tasked to take over the Tian Yuan Deity Origin. As the last prince of Da Luo Kingdom, he decides to challenge the Qi Kingdom's new reign, and sets on a journey to avenge his country. In order to avoid direct confrontation, he sneaks into the Qing Yu family, and assumes the identity of the Prince Qi's estranged brother. In the midst of his journey, he meets the quirky and adorable Ye Yanran, and talented lady Ye Xueyun.
dramas.t: The Wizard of Ten Thousand Worlds

dramas.syn:
The drama revolves around a married couple as they tackle everyday experiences that ordinary people face from problems of the heart to friendship and career, that is if the real world is full of people with killer looks and are ultra successful.

Bai Can Lan is a stone-cold HR executive whose speciality is ridding people of their jobs. Outside of work, she is a young, loving, and beautiful wife who has a no-pregnancy policy. Zhao Yang Guang is an IT genius with enviable good looks and a high IQ. He is pretty much the all-around guy who has a stubborn side.

Northern Machinery Corporation was going bankrupt because of maladministration. Sun He Ping, an overseas sales manager in Southeast Asia, was called back in an emergency to take over the job as the director of Northern Machinery Plant. Years of work in the international market gave Sun He Ping a market-oriented sense, so he led Northern Machinery Plant to join Hanzhong Group, where his old classmate Yang Liu was in charge. He began to introduce plenty of bold and profound changes in the corporation.

Bai Xiao Fei, a grassroots hero, forms the "Survival Alliance" with a group of diverse characters: the fierce and charming Yang Jie, the naive and cute Lu Lu, the fugitive teaching assistant Guan Zai Jia, and the handsome crossbow master Qin Yang. Together, they embark on a high-stakes adventure to combat the mutants and survive the perilous environment. 

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Zombie Brother" (尸兄) by Qi Du Yu (七度鱼).

When a tour group accidentally encounter a beach and become trapped on a deserted island not far from the city. Seven men and four women explore and try to survive on this island, encountering things like shortage of fresh water and food, the various dangers of ferocious beasts and wild thoughts eroding their beliefs and faith.
Wen Wen, part of this tour group, is a strong, kind, sweet and capable girl. Here, she met a rogue man, Qin Lang Tian, and technology savvy He Lin. All three of them have very different personalities, but they walked together because of fate. In order to be able to get out of this deserted island alive, they went through the test of different dangers together and experienced the emotional turmoil of love and hate. When they returned safely, the survivors were suprised to find out that this was all part of a conspiracy.

The tragic heroine, Su Nuan Nuan, desperately sought death but failed. Unexpectedly, she activated a system, leading the original owner on a series of suicidal adventures, beating up scumbag men and ruthlessly punishing scheming women, thus beginning her own exhilarating life. Just as Su Nuan Nuan was about to give up, she suddenly realised that the original owner didn't truly want to die, but rather to break free from the shackles of fate. The system, however, had helped her alter the trajectory and ending of her life.

After Xia Wan Wan died suddenly from tightening screws for twenty years, she was reborn and unexpectedly encountered Jiang Ye, the "big devil" of the No. 1 Middle School and the son of the factory director in her previous life. Everyone thought that she would have a bad time after offending Jiang Ye, until the two quarreled and were pulled into an alley. Jiang Ye lowered his eyes and begged for forgiveness in a low voice, and even said, "I'll act cute for you." His unexpected behavior surprised everyone.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jian Ye" (见野) by Ning Yu Chen (宁雨沉).

At a class reunion, Shen Yue is drugged and faints, accidentally entering Li Chen’s room, where she mistakes his injured body for a “cure” and unintentionally takes his inner core.

Five years later, Li Chen comes searching for his lost core and is mistaken by the amnesiac Shen Yue as her blind date — she drags him off for a flash marriage. When their enemies resurface, Shen Yue learns the truth: she had been set up years ago, lost her innocence, and gave birth to a child. Li Chen helps her reclaim her daughter.

Ding Chong Xi and Lin Yu, who have gone together through high school until college, are struck with a tragedy, when after a car accident, Lin Yu ends up in a coma. Using virtual reality, Ding Chong Xi uploads Lin Yu's consciousness to an alternate reality, hoping to wake her up that way. But instead, every time Lin Yu is on the verge of waking up, a script is triggered, the whole reality is restarted, and Chong Xi needs to start everything from the beginning, over and over again. Things take an even worse turn when the boy discovers that all those restarts have consequences, and the chances of saving Lin Yu become slimmer with every try.

In August 1949, Wu Shi, who was supposed to welcome the liberation in Fuzhou, was suddenly appointed by Chiang Kai-shek as the Deputy Minister of National Defense of the National Government. 

In order to obtain more intelligence, Wu Shi resolutely went to Taiwan to take office according to the instructions of the party organization and used his work convenience to provide the East China Bureau of the Communist Party of China with important information, such as the changes in the troop strength on Kinmen Island and the mobilization of the national army in the Southwest Campaign. 

Zhu Feng was originally going to return to Shanghai, but he learned that Wu Shi's original courier had died and the organization needed to send a new courier to Taiwan, so he resolutely gave up the opportunity to reunite with his family and went to Taiwan alone. Wu Shi and Zhu Feng worked closely together and…

dramas.nt: 雪中悍刀行 第二季
dramas.syn:
As the snowstorms of Northern Liang return, Xu Feng Nian ventures alone into the Northern Wilds. In this untamed land, will he repeat his father's fate, or forge his own path to kingship?

Divine soldiers descend upon the land, and extraordinary heroes emerge. Who will rule the world?

After returning to his homeland, Han Feng, the Ninth Prince, solves the mystery of the Ghost Soldiers to gain a foothold in the court. Through this investigation, a deadly quest that binds his fate with Wei Zhuang, Zi Nv and Zhang Xian, the Quicksand organization is officially established. 

Together, these brilliant youths embark on an epic journey of unearthing dark conspiracies and solving mysteries, battling formidable villains and passionately fighting for their ideals and their country.

Sheng Xia and Xiao Ning Ning, two talented but contrasting women, become close friends while working at Jia Mei Department Store. As they navigate challenges in their careers, they support each other in balancing their professional and personal lives. Sheng Xia's ambition leads her to explore new opportunities alongside her growing relationship with Lin Chao.

A love story revolving around Luo Xiao Fan, the doctress of the medical immortal sect, and Nan Chu Fei, the Great General Ding Nan. 

Luo Xiao Fan is the doctress of the medical immortal sect, who has a smart and straightforward personality. She had extraordinary skills in medicine and was one of the skillful young doctress in the sect. One day, she went out without permission and rescued Nan Chu Fei, who was being chased. She uses Nan Chu Fei to find out the truth about her mother's disappearance.

Nan Chu Fei is the son of Marquis Nan Hou, who has skills in martial arts. He also has an introverted and cold personality since he was abandoned by his family. Later, he gained fame and was named Great General Ding Nan. He assisted the seventh prince to solved various cases. One day, when he went to solve a case, he was shot by an assassin and was saved by Luo Xiao Fan. As the two spend…

After her father's wrongful conviction ruins her family, Jiang Yu Xin falls from a motorcycle queen to an outcast, only to uncover the buried truth a decade later as a lawyer alongside Lang You Yan—and find love.

Three mothers—Yang Liu, Xu Yue Juan, and Jiang Dan Hua—each impose their own ambitions on their children, leading to strained marriages and children struggling under immense pressure. Yang Liu pushes her son relentlessly, Xu Yue Juan neglects her children's education while focusing on her husband, and Jiang Dan Hua forces her son into a path he isn’t suited for, resulting in depression. As their families begin to unravel, the mothers finally confront the damage they've caused, learning to reconcile with themselves and grow alongside their children.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Yi Zi Zhi Ming" (以子之名) by Yang Xiao Yan

In the late 1990s, the Pinghai National Cotton Factory went bankrupt, and delayed resettlement fees sparked corruption rumors about director Xiao Geng Shi. When worker Jiao Tong Sheng, who had been gathering evidence, drowned under suspicious circumstances, police officer Luo Shi Xiang began investigating. Jiao’s daughter, Lin Shuang Sheng, also sought the truth behind her father's death.

As Luo closed in, Xiao Geng Shi retaliated against Lin and tried to manipulate Luo. Pretending to cooperate, Luo gathered evidence from within. Though Lin briefly withdrew, she ultimately helped expose Xiao. With their combined efforts, Xiao was brought to justice, and the workers finally received their rightful compensation.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Cheng Qiang Zhi Shang" (城墙之上) by Xu Chong (徐翀).

Haunted by a recent tragedy, cartoonist Xia Xiao Duo is unexpectedly transported from 2026 back to the year 2002. There, she meets university archery captain Wu You. Armed with her knowledge of future events, she teams up with Wu You to prevent impending disasters, slowly uncovering a dark mystery that binds their lives across time. by Bu Guo Qi Yue (不过七月).

Zhou Tian Na, a much-discussed actress in the entertainment industry, is entering a golden period in her career, yet her relationship with her husband, Liang Che, is on the verge of breaking down. Unwilling to remain constrained any longer, she refuses to be defeated by past pain or present obstacles. Instead, these experiences ultimately make her stronger.

Rebellious and carefree, He Yi joins aviation school chasing someone from his past, only to find his plans unexpectedly disrupted by the cheerful and quirky Tang Xiao Li, a comics enthusiast pursuing her dream of becoming a flight attendant. From their very first encounter, sparks fly — not the romantic kind, but the kind born from endless bickering and misunderstandings.

As they navigate the challenges of campus life, intense training, and personal setbacks, He Yi and Tang Xiao Li go from rivals to unexpected allies. Through four years of ups and downs, they grow, support each other, and gradually discover what it truly means to fly — both in the sky and in life.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Qi Luo An Tuo" (起落安妥) by Ping Zi Jun Zi (平子君子).

The story centers on Zhou Yan, a top female thief, who was imprisoned in Thailand five years ago for stealing the “Heart of the Earl.” After her release, she and her younger brother Zhou Hui rely on each other to get by in China. Just as Zhou Yan attempts to return to a peaceful life, she is once again drawn into the turbulent underworld of thieves. Through the clues surrounding a genius heir, the series unravels the layers of mystery behind the long-standing family of thieves.

He hasn't the courage to love for his being the adopted son of her family who spent his childhood in poverty while she is born in a rich family and has never experienced poor life. Their love is destined to have no fruit therefore he never says "I love you" to her despite his deep love for her. She, however, leaves him at their most sweet time. The most moving pledge in the world is not "I love you",  but  "I stay with you forever".

~~ Adapted from the novel “Wo Zai Hui Yi Li Deng Ni” (我在回忆里等你) by Xin Yi Wu (辛夷坞).
dramas.t: Wo Zai Hui Yi Li Deng Ni

dramas.syn: A terminally ill woman, Chen Luo Xia, seeks revenge and her missing friend, Wang Jing, colliding with the deceitful Wang Min and the justice-seeking officer Wu Ying in a complex narrative of crime, salvation, and the enduring human spirit.

After high school, Qin Chuan gives up his studies to help his father pay off his debts. He finds work in Shanghai as a coffee shop waiter. He works hard and earns a promotion, becoming a barista. Now a barista, Chuan dreams of creating a coffee brand. Initially, he faces hardships but succeeds in establishing his signature brand-Yinong Coffee. 

His coffee now being established, Chuan's oversight begins to suffer, causing significant disagreements among the company's senior management over company decisions. A serious rift among the company's founders forces Yinong Coffee to close down. Unwilling to accept defeat, Chuan and some friends open up a catering firm in the rapidly growing city of Xuzhou.

It is a historical drama about four women defying societal constraints and traditional roles, choosing to take control of their own lives. Through friendship and mutual support, they rebel against their fates, emphasizing that every individual is the protagonist of their own story.
dramas.t: Sonder: Wo Jiu Bu Shi NPC

dramas.syn:
The dust of the Xiantian Coup has settled, and Princess Tai Ping meets her end by poison. However, this political conclusion is merely a prelude, marking the beginning of the investigation team's exile to the Ba-Shu region. Lu Ling Feng and Su Wu Ming are no longer the Special Investigation Unit for the Court of Judicial Review in Chang'an, but instead serve as the Shudao Travel Record Officers exiled by the imperial court. 

As they travel south, their cases become deeply intertwined with the eerie glow of the Sanxingdui Bronze Divine Tree and the rhythmic drumbeats of Nuo ritualistic whispers masked beneath the decaying wood of the ancient Three Kingdoms plank roads. While Su Wu Ming delves into the historical chronicle of military campaigns during the Three Kingdoms period, Lu Ling Feng reaches the ultimate culmination of his arcane origin, putting him in a position of conflict…
dramas.t: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty V: The Forbidden Shu Road

dramas.syn: In the year 1950, a Nationalist spy was deployed from Taiwan to the city of Yongjiang to assassinate prominent people who were charged with reviving the Chinese economy. The Communist party sends their own men undercover to find the mastermind behind the scenes.

Lin Yuan Yuan pretends to be goddess idol Ouyang Na and participated in a reality show to help her boyfriend. However, when the real Ouyang Na reappears, Yuan Yuan's true identity is revealed. The betrayal of her boyfriend, distrust of her family, and the accusations of the world made Lin Yuan Yuan lost and confused. Eventually, she uses her love of life to win the title of idol of the commoner.
~~ Adapted from the novel "The Dark Forest" (三体II·黑暗森林) by Liu Ci Xin (刘慈欣).

It tells the story of Mei Shun, a rural young woman marrying into a Beijing family, and her kind-hearted, intellectually limited husband, Chang Sheng. Their life unfolds in a three-generation household amid Beijing’s rapid urban changes. The narrative reads like a pure spring that persists through hardship—lucid, luminous, and quietly strong. Despite the setbacks, their mutual dignity and self-respect remain intact.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Mei Shun Yu Chang Sheng" (美顺与长生) by Mao Jian Jun (毛建军).

In a past life, the Song Dynasty scholar Zhang Sui saved Hu Wu De, an eight-tailed black fox spirit; the fox subsequently entered the mortal realm to repay the debt of gratitude, even though the scholar himself stubbornly refused to believe in the supernatural. 

Possessing a rare, mystical treasure that attracted the covetous gaze of various demons, the scholar — after achieving success in the imperial examinations and assuming an official post — joined forces with the fox. Together, they battled plague-spreading spirits and traversed the boundaries between the living and the dead, solving a series of bizarre mysteries and unfolding a fantastical tale of companionship between man and fox.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ba Wei Chuan Qi" (八尾传奇) by E Bo Jue (E伯爵).

Mei Gui, a young woman from Jiangnan, becomes entangled in a complicated web of grievances with He Yan, a musician with a mysterious identity, because of an ancient book. As duty to their country and their personal feelings become intertwined, their dual identities place them in a position of mutual restraint, unfolding a story of deep love, hatred, and emotional entanglements amid troubled times.

dramas.t: The Longest Day in Chang'an Season 2

dramas.syn: New members of the national training team, Li Qing Ri and Bai Dong Chen, stood out in the trials and became new teammates to the old players such as Fang Yan and Chen Huo Huo, but their starting point to realize their dreams was not very smooth. The "inexplicable" conflict between the old players and the new coach left them at a loss; the heavy training and the huge psychological and physical pressure generated by the game made the young players gradually "sink"; coupled with the inherently complicated family problems, As well as uncontrolled emotional entanglements, have become numerous obstacles for them to breakthrough themselves. Under the guidance of the sacred identity of "national team members", and with the care and help of their coaches and teammates, these young people worked hard and finally achieved "transformation", shouldering the glory of the motherland and the nation,…

Modern lawyer Jiang Xiao Bai transmigrates to the ancient and turbulent kingdom of Bojue. Using her professional knowledge, she defends the grievances of the common people, challenges millennia-old customs like wife-selling, and is even tasked with revising the kingdom's laws. During this process, she and Prince Si Zhou go from misunderstanding to falling in love and pledging their lives to each other. Later, they are unfortunately drawn into court intrigue and a power struggle for the throne, steadfastly upholding their principles amidst love, justice, and conspiracy.

A youth military idol drama following Su Han who formed a brigade team and meets her ex boyfriend Jiang Tian in an operation. Jiang Tian still harbors feelings for Su Han but mistakenly thought she is in a new relationship. Su Han was gravely injured during a rescue mission. After clearing up many misunderstandings, Jiang Tian began a heart-warming journey towards winning Su Han's trust and love again.

Deceived by a married jerk, lawyer Wen Wan Qing gets drunk and accidentally kisses her best friend's younger brother, surgeon Pei Yi Qiu—who has secretly loved her for years. As misunderstandings give way to romance, she breaks free from her toxic relationship, while he offers the tenderness she's always deserved. A two-way journey that began in their youth finally comes full circle, bringing them both a chance to heal.

When detective Li Yu Jing is brought in to help officer Yue Qing Chuan investigate a series of child trafficking cases, the case takes an unexpected turn. He stumbles upon fresh clues linking the kidnappings to an armed bank robbery from 13 years prior. Working together, the duo must unravel a web of secrets across two timelines in a high-stakes, hardcore manhunt.

Top lawyer Su Yan, now thirty, lives by one rule: love yourself first, at least eighty percent. Abused by her mentor, neglected by her family, and cheated on by her fiancé, she has sworn off letting anyone close. Then Cheng Lin reappears. At nineteen, he is no longer the boy she once helped at a juvenile detention center. For five years, he has never stopped loving her. His return forces her to face the wounds she has buried. Together, they heal each other, piece by piece, and slowly remember what it means to trust, to risk, and to love again.

Through the smoke and fire rising from the kitchen stoves of Wantangju, a century-old restaurant in Beijing, the turbulent rises and falls of China’s modern history over the past thirty years are reflected. In the 1990s, Fan Da Cheng was recruited into the kitchen to apprentice under Yang Yue Jun, the head chef of Wantangju. There, he befriends Yang Yu Zhu, Xu Qian Yin, and Ge Qing, as well as three senior fellow apprentices, Feng Bing Ge, Chen Qi, and Shi Yu Ming. Yang Yue Jun intends to cultivate Fan Da Cheng as his successor, but due to conflicts in philosophy and the truth of past events, Fan Da Cheng leaves in anger.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Shou Shan" (收山) by Chang Xiao Hu (常小琥).

Yin Zheng He, a legend in the legal world, has never lost a case. Distinguished, formidable, and contemptuous of everyone around him, he stands at the pinnacle of his profession. Liang Yi Shan, a self-made lawyer who grew up in a welfare institution, is sharp, composed, and meticulous in her calculations. To uncover the truth behind an old case involving her father, she pretends to be mute and deliberately approaches Yin Zheng He, determined to bring this star lawyer down from his pedestal. But amid schemes within schemes and plans within plans, she has calculated everyone's moves except her own growing feelings for him.

As the truth from twenty years ago draws ever closer, she tears open a path toward the truth in plain sight, while he secretly lays an inescapable net. Their calculations, tests, and deceptions ultimately turn into an unspoken understanding in which they entrust their…
tags: Pretends To Be Mute / Mistaken As A Mute

dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the novel "Nu Wu Qing Zheng Yan" (女巫请睁眼) by Mang Ren Yue Dao (亡人越刀).
tags: Censored Adaptation Of Same-sex Original Work

dramas.syn:
Shen Zhen joins her dream company TL but faces constant setbacks. Just as she’s about to become Director, her ex-husband Liang Xiao Feng unexpectedly takes the role. Ten years after their breakup, old misunderstandings keep them in conflict, but they set aside personal feelings to work together, forming a powerful partnership where buried emotions begin to reawaken. 

Meanwhile, her cousin Xie Yi Xin falls into a romantic trap set by the seemingly poor but manipulative Zhou Wei, and their friend Zhang Wan Lin faces marital doubts as her husband’s behavior suddenly changes. Through career struggles, emotional setbacks, and personal challenges, the three women stay determined and ultimately find their own paths to strength, growth, and happiness.

~~ Adapted from the web comic "Ben San Na Nian" (奔三那年) by Zi You Yao Qi (自有妖气).

dramas.t: The First Half of My Life Season 2

dramas.syn:
On the outskirts of Longfan, a woman's body was found in an iron cage, devoured by a stray cat, fatally wounded by a stab wound to the chest. Forensic pathologist Qin Ming discovers hallucinogens, fluorescent powder, and a mysterious letter from a "divine messenger," leading to a series of interconnected murders. A missing daughter, a domestic violence vice president, and a long-lost "white moonlight"—each case points to a locked room in a villa and a revenge scheme lurking for a decade. When all the clues converge, the truth is far more suffocating than the crime itself.

~~ Adapted from the 7th novel "The Damned One" (天谴者) in the novel series "Medical Examiner Dr. Qin" (法医秦明) by Qin Ming (秦明). It covers three cases, namely "Xiao Shi De Xiong Qi" (消失的凶器), "Yu Yi Chui Mo" (雨衣锤魔), and "Gui Ying Shi Lu" (鬼影实录).
tags: Death Of A Friend (show hidden tags)

dramas.syn:
A shadowy figure clutching a syringe emerges through thick fog, umbrella shielding their purpose. Four chemical test tubes brimming with blood-red liquid stand beside a floating corpse, while a heart, necklace, and pistol form cryptic evidence. As the laboratory transforms into a lethal battleground, a deadly reversal unfolds: who's predator and who's prey in this mist-shrouded game of vengeance? The cat-and-mouse chase begins with science itself as both weapon and witness.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Nuan Qi" (暖气) by Man San (慢三).

Determined to become a top martial arts master, Jia Fu Gui founded the famous Muyebang gang at 18. Now 26, he is prematurely balding and often mistaken for a second-rate character in the martial world, leading to frequent disrespect. Embarrassed by this, Jia Fu Gui, along with his loyal second-in-command Tang Lin, embarks on a quest to find the secret to restoring his hair.

~~ Adapted from the manhua "Jue Ding" (绝顶) by Xiao Xin Yu (肖新宇).

Focusing on the sweeping family upheavals and parallel life experiences of progressive youth Tong Jia Ting, a law student at National Central University, and his father, Tong Shuang Wei, a high-ranking Kuomintang Central Committee official, this historical epic presents a panoramic view of Chinese society during the War of Resistance Against Japan.

In 1937, following the fall of Nanjing, the father and son are cast into a perilous eight-year journey of displacement spanning Wuhan, Hong Kong, Shanghai and Chongqing. As they navigate the harsh realities of a nation at war, their paths diverge ideologically. Tong Shuang Wei gradually witnesses the deep structural corruption of the KMT government, leading to the ultimate disillusionment of his traditional ideals. Concurrently, inheriting the legacy of his mother, Liu Wei, and guided by his uncle, Liu Zhong Hua, the young Tong Jia Ting…

On the night of the Lantern Festival, a bloody case leads to Prince Pei Jin being exiled, while the loyal Shen family is massacred. Five years later, Shen Heng, the legitimate daughter of the Shen family, returns under the identity of the courtesan Jiu Ge, while Pei Jin reappears as the national preceptor Xuan Ji, both having changed their faces.

When they meet again in the Eastern Palace, the former lovers fail to recognize each other and instead become enemies. As the truth and their past feelings gradually resurface, an even greater conspiracy quietly unfolds…

To uncover the truth behind the deaths of his wife and daughter, Wei Tian, who possesses exceptional security and protection skills, gives up his identity and establishes the "Silent Ones Agency" in Antilokaris, where the incident occurred. The agency provides security services to businesses and civilians in the Belt and Road economic zone.

Wei Tian shares a life-and-death friendship with Xiang Ping Sheng, the president of Zhong'an Group, but his personality clashes with that of Xiang Ping Sheng's son, Xiang Lai. Although Zhong An Group and the Silent Ones operate independently, both have a strong sense of belonging to a community with a shared future for humanity. Each protects the safety of Chinese citizens overseas in the Belt and Road economic zone in its own way.

Jiang Lai donates a kidney for love, only to be cruelly betrayed by the person she loves. She is even framed as "mentally unstable" and nearly killed to silence her. After narrowly escaping death, she changes her face and assumes the identity of Zhao Ke. Joining forces with the mysterious Zhao Mai, she returns and carefully sets one trap after another, turning the tables on those who wronged her. Amid intertwined love and hatred, she uncovers the long-buried truth and finally seeks the justice that has long been denied to her.

Liu Lai Cai, who has always been a loyal player of the game "Hu Lai San Guo", accidentally enters the game and finds that he has really come to the "Three Kingdoms" era. In the chaotic world, different heroes appeared on the stage, and Liu Lai Cai also embarked on a tortuous and full of adventures in life among the heroes of the Three Kingdoms.

One year after the Trial of Ghost Cry Abyss comes to an end, Su Mu Yu is ordered by the Hall of Soul Retrieval to escort the Heavenly Mechanism Box to the Kingdom of the Eastern Sea. Along the way, he becomes the target of assassination attempts by numerous factions from both the righteous and demonic sides of the martial world. After killing Shen Xiao Han, the greatest martial artist of Lingnan, during a snowy night battle, Su Mu Yu is poisoned and rescued by a mysterious young man named Lin Xing He.

When he awakens, Su Mu Yu discovers that all of his connections to Dark River have been severed by an unknown force. As a result, the Hall of Soul Retrieval issues a written decree declaring him a traitor to Dark River and dispatches assassins from its three major families to hunt him down.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Tales of Dark River" (暗河传) by Zhou Mu Nan (周木楠).

21st century girl Xiao Die loves Tang Dynasty poet Li Bai. When she is transported back in time to the Tang Dynasty and meets her idol Li Bai she finds that everything is messed up. What is a 21st century girl to do when she discovers that the poet she idolizes and loves wants to be a chef?

The Yun family of Xizhou has twin daughters. The younger sister, Yun Si, has studied medicine under a physician since childhood, while the elder sister, Yun Si, marries into the residence of Prince Chu, where she is persecuted and killed by Prince Chu, Huo Lin Ye, and his secondary consort, Su Yun Rou.

After rescuing the Ninth Prince, Huo Shen Zhi, who has fallen from a cliff, the younger sister receives her elder sister's final letter and assumes her identity to enter the prince's residence and seek revenge.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tian Ming Cheng Huang" (天命成凰) by Zhao Xiao Qiu (赵小球).

Yu Hao, a professional psychologist, specializes in healing others, but she can't heal Lu Huai Zheng. She thinks it's a career trial; he thinks it's the start of a romance. Neither of them could have imagined that this misplaced unrequited love would arrive a full twelve years late.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Di Er Shi Ba Nian Chun" (第二十八年春) by Er Dong Tu Zi (耳东兔子).

In 2035, Song Yang, a top AI student, is framed for the murder of his girlfriend and her mother. While on the run, he forms an alliance with A Da, an android who has awakened to self-awareness. Together, they solve a series of bizarre cases, uncovering the dark secrets of the Cedar Corporation.

Zhao Dong, an immortal sovereign obsessed with enlightenment and blind to earthly attachments, is backstabbed by his immortal beloved and enters a calamity with nothing but regret. After rebirth, he inhabits the body of a country thug also named Zhao Dong. Through his dual existence as immortal and mortal, he comes to understand that everything has its limits. Determined to stay in the mortal realm, he vows to right his past wrongs and reawaken the Dao.
dramas.t: Braving the Famine with My Wife

dramas.syn:
In 1934, Japanese imperialism intensified its aggression against China. Despite the nation's impending doom, Chiang Kai Shek, clinging to the policy of "pacifying the country before resisting foreign aggression," launched the largest-ever "encirclement and suppression campaign" ever launched. Faced with a life-or-death situation, the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army were forced to strategically shift and evacuate the Soviet areas north and south of the Yangtze River. 

With an average age of under 30, the Red Army troops journeyed through 11 provinces, crossed 18 mountain ranges, crossed 24 rivers, traversed desolate grasslands, and traversed snow-capped mountains, covering a total distance of 25,000 miles. The Long March concluded in October 1936, when the three main Red Army forces reunited, marking the triumphant conclusion of the Red Army's Long March.

Bai Su Zhen, who had cultivated for five hundred years, could have ascended to immortality, but due to unresolved romantic entanglements, she lost an important memory and had to follow the orders of the gods to descend the mountain to find Xu Xian and repay his kindness. 

Bai Su Zhen and Xiao Qing entered the mortal world and met Xu Xian, a demon hunter burdened with the hatred of his family's annihilation, and Fa Hai, a disciple of Jinshan Temple. The four of them embarked on a journey together, unfolding a fateful entanglement.
~~ Adapted from the interactive visual web novel "Ba Wei" (八尾) on Shanyi (闪艺).

dramas.t: Tai Zi Fei De Mi Tan Sheng Ya

dramas.syn:
Gu Qing Yu once had an ordinary, happy life, until a deliberate explosion took the lives of her husband and unborn child. She changes her face and assumes the identity of Guan Tian Tian, approaching the prime suspect, Lin Ji Ming, with hatred in her heart.

But as they spend their days together, her hatred quietly begins to fade, and she realizes that the tenderness in his eyes does not seem to be an act. When the truth is revealed, she discovers that someone else is the real culprit, while the man she once regarded as her enemy becomes the only person she can rely on...

A priceless painting vanishes into thin air, along with the perfect man who navigates the relationships of three women. Separated by an elaborate social media facade, they spy on each other and envy one another.  As rivals, they find themselves at the same gambling table one midnight. As the woven shell of lies is pried open, the roles of hunter and prey subtly reverse. 

They exchange information, revealing each other's incriminating evidence and vulnerabilities. It turns out that within the man's carefully constructed cage of gentle intimacy, the most inconspicuous beast has already sharpened its claws. Is this meticulously planned disappearance a premeditated counterattack, or an inescapable vortex of emotions?
About brothers who find themselves on the opposite sides of the law while investigating a case.

When Yuwen Jing Xuan was about to be crowned the heir apparent, he learned that Tang Zhi Luo, who had been imprisoned, had appeared at a villa outside the city. Knowing it was a trap, he still braved the machinations to rescue her that very night. The amnesiac Tang Zhi Luo fainted after being struck by the Soul-Destroying Nail. After making a deal with the masked owner of the villa, Yuwen Jing Xuan took her back to the palace. The amnesiac Tang Zhi Luo felt both strange and familiar with Yuwen Jing Xuan, caught between him and Yuwen Jia, and even doubted him due to Yuwen Jia's instigation.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Fei Yao Chu Tao: Xie Wang Zhui Qi Dao Xian Dai" (妃要出逃：邪王追妻到现代) by Mo Ran Jin Shu (墨染锦书).

dramas.nt: 异人之下之恶童、魔头与宗师
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the webcomic "Under One Person" (一人之下) by Mi Er (米二).

Tang Xin and Li Yan are a post-90s couple. Against their parents' wishes, they got married the day of their graduation and soon bore a child together. Alone, without the help and support of parents, the two ventured into their newfound identities as working parents. Both worked hard at their jobs to strive for a promotion and at the same time dealt with taking turns caring for the child. Unfortunately, unable to successfully balance family and work, both faced setbacks.

Despite their efforts, the situation became too much to handle. Tang Xin hovered on the brink of breaking down and Li Yan's attitude started to change.  Conflicts created distance among the once sweet couple and they eventually decided to have a divorce. 

After breaking up, the two of them reflected on the highs and lows of their life and career. Deciding to learn from their mistakes, and to encourage and support each…

Shu Ting Lan, scarred by family trauma from her upbringing, grew into a sensitive, love-starved young woman. As an adult, she crosses paths with Zhuo Yu An, the CEO of a tech company, through work. What neither realizes at first is that they were already close back in high school, only to be torn apart by a misunderstanding at graduation. When they reunite, they find themselves in an unexpected client-and-vendor relationship.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jin Ri Yi Pian Ai" (今日宜偏爱) by Shang Gu Jun (山谷君).

This story is about a sweet and inspiring coming-of-age campus romance.

Two bright and radiant individuals, Li Ming Zhou and Xia Ming Yue, cross paths after entering the same university. Standing out effortlessly among their peers, the two find themselves drawn to one another, sparking a year-long journey of mutual unexpressed feelings, subtle chemistry and gentle emotional tugs of war.

Alongside a vibrant group of close friends, they navigate the delicate emotions of first love, deep companionship, and the pursuit of their personal dreams. Through shared laughter and the quiet support of youth, they transition from a beautiful double-sided crush into a lasting romance, proving that the brightest moments of youth are found in the warmth of growing up together.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Hai Shang Sheng Ming Yue" (海上升明月) by Wen Ji Er (文吉儿).
dramas.t: The Moon Rises above the Sea

dramas.syn:
In 1965, a drilling accident in the Arihundi Gobi Desert led to a disaster in which exploration worker Chu Han Wen mysteriously disappeared. Twenty years later, the Lenghu Oilfield receives a mysterious signal from the depths below, bringing the long-buried case back to the surface.

Beneath the Gobi Desert exists an unknown life-form known as Hundi. It can parasitize human bodies and cause mutations, while creating an underground network of shared consciousness. Chu Nan Fei, Liang Yi Han, Zhou Fang Hua, and others venture into the perilous depths beneath the Gobi Desert. There, they confront both mutated infected people and the ambitious organization known as the "Natural Science Society," while also facing family trauma and difficult choices concerning human nature.

Humanity attempts to suppress or control this mysterious power, while Hundi, which possesses a consciousness of its…

Chen Yan and Song He are a couple working and living in Beijing. They decide to take out a loan to buy a new house far exceeding their income, hoping to improve their family's quality of life. Chen Yan firmly believes that life cannot be settled once and for all; she must continuously strive to earn a better life. 

Some of her female friends are experiencing marital changes, some are facing new life choices, and some are experiencing career crises. Their seemingly glamorous lives actually hide hidden troubles. When the new house may not be delivered on time, Chen Yan and Song He also experience a relationship crisis, casting a shadow over their once-happy life. Chen Yan suddenly realizes that family happiness is the true meaning of life.

~~ Adapted from the novel "An Imperfect Wife" (不理想的妻子) by Wang Xin (王欣).

dramas.t: Shi Shang Zui Qiang Nan Zhu Jiao

dramas.nt: 异人之下之奇技现世！终极之战
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the webcomic "Under One Person" (一人之下) by Mi Er (米二).

He Mei, the daughter of Rongcheng’s wealthiest man, suffered a tragic childhood: a nanny named Zhang Xin orchestrated a fire that claimed her mother’s life, and her adoptive brother, He Shi, obstructed her escape, ultimately allowing the housekeeper to traffic her into a remote mountain area.

Years later, she returned to the He family under the alias "Li Zhang Xin," only to discover that Zhang Xin had usurped her place and become the mistress of the household. Determined to reclaim her identity and uncover the truth, she infiltrated the family as a nanny.

Through household chores, she soon discovers complex family dynamics and meets He Yu, who will unexpectedly become her greatest help at home.

Warlord Lu Zhen Tian controls Fancheng. His adjutant, He Jing Chen, plots to seize the Lu family's hidden treasure, hoping to strengthen the army and protect the people. Su Yu Tang, an orphan from an opera troupe, goes undercover to seek revenge. 

After uncovering He Jing Chen's plan, she turns it to her own advantage, throwing the situation into turmoil. When they discover that Lu Zhen Tian plans to trade the treasure for opium and harm the people, Su Yu Tang and He Jing Chen see through each other's facades and join forces.

Tells the story of the son of a disgraced official who assumes a fabricated identity and takes the place of an undercover agent within the Jinyiwei. He becomes entangled in the power struggle between the Noble Consort and the Crown Prince’s factions. Relying on his exceptional “confiscation” skills, he investigates and raids corrupt officials and powerful elites along the way.

On one side, his false identity could be exposed at any moment; on the other, he faces nearly impossible confiscation missions under intense time pressure. He must not only rise swiftly through the ranks of the Jinyiwei’s officialdom, but also struggle to survive amid pursuit, suspicion, and constant danger.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Zai Jin Yi Wei Fu Ze Chao Jia De Ri Zi" (我在锦衣卫负责抄家的日子) by Zan Jiao Liu Ke Le (咱叫刘可乐).
Zang Hai is forced into a conspiracy and returns to the capital, where his reappearance sets off a new wave of conflict and power struggles.

Shen Fang was once scammed and hired by an intelligence organization in the name of an "overseas security agency" because he needed funds for his father's treatment. In the process, he was disgusted by the terrorist means and disgraceful acts of the intelligence organization. He met Lin Yan Qi when he was on a mission in Southeast Asia, so he faked his death and escaped.

As an "ordinary salesman", he hid in Chengqing City on the southeast coast for more than ten years and lived a plain and happy family life. However, after many years, the intelligence organization infiltrated Chengqing City, breaking the peace, and Shen Fang was forced to get involved in a dangerous espionage vortex.
~~ Adapted from the short story "Shi Fu Nian Shao" (师父年少) of the novel "Shi Fu Xin Sai" (师父心塞) by Jiu Lu Fei Xiang (九鹭非香).

In the Wanli year of the Ming Dynasty, Japanese riots resumed again. Patriotic compatriots overseas unexpectedly learned that Japan was planning to invade Ming Dynasty via Korea and sent a signal to Ming Dynasty. Mistakes also broke out in the capital here. Shi Shi Yong, Zheng Shi Yuan and Cheng Yi Xue of the Royal Guards were forced to jointly investigate the case.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Ri Luo Dong Ying" (日落东瀛) by Ma Bo Yong (马伯庸).

At the beginning of university, the cold and handsome Su Yian Xun quickly became a "male god" among the 61 freshmen. He is usually lazy and arrogant and does not want to make progress. In order to graduate successfully, he had to join the school fencing club. With mixed credits, he met Lu Xing Ran, who was stubborn and resolute on fencing as his future. The two are always disagreeable. The national college fencing trials begin and Su became an unexpected "dark horse" of the fencing team. Lu Xing Ran now sees Su in a different light and discovered the pain hidden in Su's heart about family and fencing.

Shanghai, 1936. Mei Yu He, a seamstress who works for the wealthy elite, takes matters into her own hands after her younger sister's mysterious death, personally dissecting the body. Together with Ding Zhao, a loan shark, she pieces together the scandalous secrets of high society, exposing the sordid sexual networks hidden beneath the neon lights.

Set against the turbulent backdrop of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republican era, this biographical drama is loosely based on the life of legendary Peking opera pioneer Tan Xin Pei. The story follows Meng Jin Fu, a boy born into poverty with seemingly mediocre talent. 

After completing a grueling, traditional opera apprenticeship at the age of 18, he starts at the absolute bottom of the theatrical world. Through sheer resilience, he rises from a minor martial comic and acrobat to a celebrated martial lead, eventually mastering the prestigious senior male roles. 

Navigating the changing tides of a volatile era, he transforms from an obscure, struggling newcomer into a revered master, securing an enduring legacy in the capital’s fiercely competitive Pear Garden.

~~ Based on the life of Tan Xin Pei.

In 2015, exceptional police officer Tang Jin Ze successfully infiltrated and dismantled the notorious criminal syndicate known as "Black Snake". However, his victory came at a devastating personal cost when remnants of the organization retaliated during his pre-wedding trip, causing his fiancée, Yang Jing Ya, to vanish without a trace. Despondent and broken, Tang Jin Ze stepped away from the frontlines.

Seven years later, a new crisis strikes Yujiang City: a critical psychological medication named "Laerbao" goes missing from a major pharmaceutical company, and lead researcher Yu Kang is mysteriously kidnapped.
