Driven by his unyielding sense of duty, Tang Jin Ze returns to join the newly formed "4.20 Task Force". As the investigation deepens, it uncovers a dark web of serial murders and a massive corporate conspiracy. Amidst the chaos, Tang Jin Ze is shocked to cross paths with someone…

Yuan Shi Kai's brief proclamation was nothing but a farce that lasted 83 days, but for the down-and-out young master Zu Xian Zhi and the robbery woman Li Shu De, it was enough to change their lives. In order to complete the mission of recovering the ancestral family, Zu Xian Zhi and his family went north to Changchun and started a new journey. A few people messed up a city. After coming to Changchun, Zu Xian Zhi started from scratch and founded Yuelai Inn with the concept of "Yuelai is far away". The city's economy has injected new vitality. But when everything was prosperous and flourishing, the Japanese who had been coveting for a long time tore off the mask of hypocrisy, and gradually revealed the fangs of aggression. The people in the Yuelai Inn had to use their own methods to endure humiliation and burden under the aggression of the Japanese invaders, resolve the dangers one after…

The young female escort Su Yue Jiao and the talented scholar Cheng Qi come from vastly different backgrounds, have different aspirations, and approach things in completely different ways. In order to achieve their respective goals in life, the two are unexpectedly forced to come together.

Wu Tong, an executive in the industry, is pregnant with her baby as she wishes and realizes that waiting for labor, giving birth, breastfeeding, and recovering from childbirth is a painful and joyful journey in life. Hu Yi Chuan, a warm-hearted husband, is deeply convinced that women bear too many family and social responsibilities for the sake of nurturing life, and with the arrival of the baby, Hu Yi Chuan loves Wu Tong even more.

At the postpartum moonlight center, Wu Tong becomes good friends with their second-born mother, Song Bing Xue, young hot mom Li Lu, and celebrity mom Jin Yu Tong. Although it is not easy to recover from childbirth and caring for a newborn is often devastating, the confident and self-reliant Wu Tong always warms everyone like the sun.

With Wu Tong's help, Song Bing Xue realizes that she must first learn to love herself before she can love her child; Li Lu…

dramas.nt: 凡人修仙传 第二季
dramas.syn:
Although Han Li possesses only average talent and aptitude, he relies on perseverance, intelligence, and careful planning to overcome countless challenges. Through his own hard work and calculated decisions, he gradually advances along the path of cultivation and ultimately attains immortality.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality" (凡人修仙传) by Wang Yu (忘语).

Rising from poverty, Chen San Jiu defies fate through resilience—surviving widowhood, entrepreneurship, and rival sabotage. Capitalizing on Reform policies, she builds a commerce empire while overcoming corrupt adversaries, ultimately finding love and legacy amid China’s era tides.

Prosecutor Luo Xun, who rose from a difficult childhood to join the Women's and Children's Division of the prosecutor's office, faces a series of high-profile cases that expose complex social issues, moral dilemmas, and the challenges of pursuing justice. Each investigation tests her legal skills while revealing the human stories hidden behind the crimes.

As Luo Xun navigates difficult cases alongside former rival-turned-ally Lin Xudong, she must also confront questions about family, identity, and her own definition of success. Through her experiences, she gradually learns that true justice requires more than winning—it demands fairness, empathy, and respect for the law.

In 2008, a Jiaodong Peninsula family’s demolition windfall uncovers decades of dysfunction. Patriach Sai Duo Xi controls his five children—from the spineless eldest to the adopted youngest—until cancer shakes his authority. As they confront moral bonds, the family realizes love thrives on equality, not patriarchal power.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Duo Xi Yi Jia Ren" (多喜一家人) by He Feng Chui (荷风吹).

Set in a crumbling psychiatric hospital after Japan's surrender, a former apprentice doctor must protect the institution from various corrupt forces. As chaos ensues, he navigates the madness with the help of the hospital's inhabitants, where the line between sanity and insanity becomes increasingly unclear.

Rookie DNA analyst Xu Zi Qi joins the Xinnuo Paternity Testing Center, where she trains under director Mo Li and teams up with the passionate Zhu Xin Chen. As they take on one case after another, their investigations uncover hidden secrets and the complicated truths behind people’s lives.

~~ Adapted from the book "DNA Jian Ding Shi Shou Ji" (DNA鉴定师手记) by Xiao Jian Ding Shi Da Bao (小鉴定师大宝).

Let’s see how the two male leads who have swapped identities conquer the first female war goddess in the fairy world.

~~ Adapted from the short story "Shi Fu Nian Mai" (师父年迈) of the novel "Shi Fu Xin Sai" (师父心塞) by Jiu Lu Fei Xiang (九鹭非香).

dramas.nt: 指尖上的旋律是甜蜜蜜

dramas.syn: Princess Xihe of Changling saves the assassin sent to kill her, only to discover that their bond is rooted in a buried family secret that could tear them apart just as war threatens the kingdom.

Tian Xiao Wan, a high school student from a small fishing village, loses her parents in an accident and fails her college entrance exam. Defying local customs that forbid girls from riding boats, she leaves her hometown inspired by her father’s words: “Girls can also ride the wind and waves.”

In the 1990s, amidst the reform era, Tian Xiao Wan starts her journey from scratch, using skills from her mother and her father’s encouragement. Despite numerous challenges, her determination leads her from being a garment factory worker to founding her own clothing company as a successful entrepreneur.
dramas.t: The Wind and the Waves Will End

dramas.syn:
Zhao Xun Xun, who has always longed for a stable life, carefully maintains her less-than-perfect marriage—until the unexpected arrival of Chi Cheng shatters her illusions. After disappointment and struggle, she chooses divorce, only to find Chi Cheng appearing again and again on her path of self-discovery.

Through challenges and cooperation, their bond begins to grow, but hidden truths from the past threaten to unravel everything. As love and pain collide, can they face each other with honesty and heal old wounds? A heartfelt story of resilience, growth, and unexpected connection unfolds.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Fu Shi Fu Cheng" (浮世浮城) by Xin Yi Wu (辛夷坞).

Amid political turmoil in Xijing, the Emperor lies gravely ill while the Crown Prince governs as regent. Regional military governors wield enormous power, and the threat of fragmentation looms as local warlords tighten their control.

Beyond the palace walls, ordinary people struggle to survive. The world is filled with the madness born from unchecked private power and the bitter consequences of countless evil deeds. There are condemned prisoners launching desperate uprisings, assassins fighting for survival through impossible means, man-eating snow demons, cursed islands haunted by drowned spirits, and people willing to do anything to cling to life. There are also those who have spent more than a decade plotting a cause for which they are prepared to die without regret.

And what of her? The person she loves is trapped, her closest friend is on the brink of death, and the trusted…

The victim beneath a nodding oil pump, a man torn apart by vicious dogs, swarms of ferocious rats feeding on human flesh... A group photograph of oilfield workers taken twenty years earlier becomes a chilling omen of death.

The children of the men in the photograph, who all grew up together in the oilfield community, find their fates inextricably bound to the image. Is it a mere coincidence? Divine retribution? Or a meticulously planned series of murders?

Faced with another baffling case, how will forensic examiner Qin Ming pierce the veil of mystery and uncover the truth?

~~ Adapted from the 7th novel "The Damned One" (天谴者) in the novel series "Medical Examiner Dr. Qin" (法医秦明) by Qin Ming (秦明).
dramas.t: Once upon a Time in Longfan

dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Di Xin Nan Cang" (帝心难藏) by Mo Cha Shi Guang (抹茶时光).

Meng Qian is drawn into the political and martial conflicts of the Northern Song dynasty, where his struggle to save his family leads him to embrace a greater mission to protect the nation.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Bian Jing Shang Yuan Ju" (汴京上元局) by Niu Deng (牛凳).

Da Yu Er is a Khorchin Mongol princess who is deeply in love with Dorgo, one of the several sons of Nurhaci, a Jurchen chieftain. Yet, she soon becomes the concubine of Dorgon's older brother, Hong Tai Ji. Hong Tai Ji is already married to Da Yu Rr's aunt, Jerjer, to secure the alliance between the Khorchin Mongols and Later Jin. Hong Tai Ji initially has feelings for Da Yu Er but realizes that she only loves Dorgon, so he directs his affections to her sister, Harjol.

Hong Tai Ji later becomes the founder of the Qing Dynasty.

Five teenagers from a junior high school were kidnapped one night. The kidnapper turned out to be the mother of one of the teenagers. After receiving the report, criminal police captain Chen Juan and her colleagues immediately started investigating the case. Mysteries emerged before the police: one month before the incident, an unusual incident occurred when these families went camping in the suburbs; the five kidnapped children were recently fascinated by the "King Game" that could order someone to do anything; the mother who kidnapped them had planned similar incidents before...

~~ Adapted from the novel "Wu Ge Shi Zong De Shao Nian" (五个失踪的少年) by Ning Hang Yi (宁航一).

Chen Shou He, a craftsman who weaves with grass, incurs the wrath of Consort Chen over a piece of "Twinroot Grass" and is brutally tortured to death. His wife, Su Wan Niang, eagerly awaits his return, only to receive his corpse stuffed with withered grass. Devastated by grief, she assumes the identity of Su Cao, a female physician, and infiltrates the imperial city. Using a herbal medicine stall as her cover, she quietly builds an intelligence network and carefully plots her way closer to the emperor, one step at a time. She has only one goal: to avenge her murdered husband.
Prosecutor Ye Ran leads a team focused on juvenile prosecution. Together, they work to redeem troubled youths, helping them rebuild their lives and warmly reintegrate into society.

Since childhood, Lin Guo Cheng has been separated from his younger brother and has never given up searching for him. By a twist of fate, he arrives in Kowloon Walled City, where he puts down roots and works alongside the local residents to build a livelihood and create opportunities for the community.

During this time, he meets Mu Ya Li, the daughter of the Mu family. As they grow closer, Lin Guo Cheng gives her unwavering support, helping her rise to prominence. Eventually, Mu Ya Li secures the management rights to a tong lau, a building that serves as a symbol of the local spirit of perseverance, mutual support, and survival against the odds.

Zhang Ju Zheng is a legendary figure who has passed through the annals of history due to drastic reforms during the Wanli Period of the Ming Dynasty. Zhang Ju Zheng was the first assistant to the cabinet, ranking under the high arch. When Long Qing was seriously ill, the conflict between the two broke out, and a battle was started for the first assistant position. Long Qing died, and the ten-year-old prince ascended the throne as the Wanli Emperor. Zhang Ju Zheng officially became the first assistant, and then he launched the Wanli reform drastically. 

Zhang Ju Zheng used the ”Examination Method" to rectify the bureaucratic system, greatly improving the hard-working spirit of officials and the country's organizational strength, and used the Qingzhang policy to ease the people's tax burden. When all the groundwork for the reform was ready, his father died suddenly, but Zhang Ju Zheng…
dramas.t: Feng He Jin Qi Zhang Ju Zheng

dramas.syn:
The seasoned old prosecutor, tempered by social experiences, and the passionate young blood, just starting their career, are two prosecutors with completely different values.

They interpret a series of societal hot-topic mystery cases, revealing the common fate of all beings. Beneath the tragic destinies, there are mysterious events and unexpected twists, reflecting the multifaceted nature of humanity behind the truth.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tian Ya Zhi Wai Wo Deng Ni" (天涯之外我等你) by Mao Xiao Jiu  (猫小久),

As retirement nears, forensic expert Dong Ming Jian is tasked with training the next generation at the An Tai City Procuratorate’s technical center. He brings in chief pathologist Zhang Han as deputy director, while young assistants Zhao Yi Ran, Ke Hao, and newcomer Luo Xiao join the team. 

Together, they tackle complex cases—including suspicious drownings and high-profile accidents—navigating both criminal and civil investigations. Through challenges and mentorship, the team grows in skill and purpose, paving the way for Zhang Han to eventually take the lead and carry on Dong Ming Jian’s legacy.

He Xiao Jun, a seemingly perfect housewife in her forties, faces hidden cracks in her marriage despite her successful husband and high-achieving daughter. Just as she plans to divorce, her husband is in an accident, forcing her to return to work at Gaon Auction House. There, she uncovers a deeper conspiracy while rediscovering her self-worth. Through courage and wisdom, He Xiao Jun balances her career and family.

dramas.t: Nin Hao, Yue Fu Da Ren

dramas.syn:
Detective Geng investigates a murder tied to an unsolved kidnapping. The victim's mother grows distant from her husband while another couple stands by her. As the truth emerges, the cold case resurfaces.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yuan Di Tao Li" (原地逃离) by Li Da Fa (李大发).

dramas.t: Sha Zhou Ying Xiong Chu Shao Nian

dramas.syn:
The story follows the intertwined lives of two married couples—Gu Qun and Zeng Yao, Shao Xiao Yi and Gu Yuan Yuan—living in a bustling metropolis. Gu Qun and Gu Yuan Yuan are siblings, and together with their mother, He Shu Min, and Gu Qun’s young son, Guo Guo, they form a multi-generational household navigating the chaos of urban life.

The series explores how each of them wrestles with the demands of love, family, and survival, while also being shaped—and often worn down—by the very life they are trying to build. Through emotional conflicts and quiet moments, the show reflects on what it means to remain clear-headed in the messiness of real life.

The drama revolves around two female leads working together to solve a murder case. It unfolds around a ten-year-old unsolved case involving the remains of a body found in a clock tower. The clues to the case are scattered like pieces of a puzzle, and the truth is hidden deep within the abyss of human nature. The battle between good and evil is intense and constant.

Yang Tai, a criminal police officer of the Provincial Public Security Department, suffered from insomnia due to high-intensity work. Under the strong persuasion of his sister, Yang Guang, who works in the Criminal Investigation Team of the Municipal Bureau, Yang Tai took a leave to go to the hospital for examination. He accidentally heard that a child was suspected of being kidnapped. He was sharp and immediately told the city criminal investigation team where Yang Guang was, and the police began to investigate.

A story that revolves around real stories and undercover efforts of the Chinese narcotics enforcement agency.

Gao Huai Yuan is a former undercover cop who has shifted to traffic duty after returning to service. He inadvertently witnesses his friend Wei Feng being killed during an operation. Gao Huai Yuan vows to resume his work as an undercover to get to the bottom of the truth. With the help of inspector general Fang Qing Long and Zheng Qing Hao, Wei Feng's widow and an intelligence agent herself, Gao Huai Yuan infiltrates the drug syndicate to begin his investigation, thus beginning a deadly battle between cop and criminal.

Sixteen years after his entire family was killed in a devastating New Year's Eve explosion in the small town of Xinchun, Zhao Long — an orphan born with heterochromia and a photographic memory — returns under the alias Wang Hong. Posing as a timber merchant, he begins to quietly investigate the old case. 

However, his arrival disrupts the local illegal logging trade and triggers a string of serial murders, with the killer leaving his signature - distinct calling cards next to the victims. Wang Hong's quest for vengeance quickly intertwines with Li Xue Fei, a young woman desperately searching for her missing mother, and Cao Jin, a dedicated criminal police officer, as the case slowly uncovers a generational web of dark secrets connecting the town's prominent families.
~~ Adapted from the novel "Gu Jie" (古街) by Liu Yu Xin (刘育新).

Lian Ming, a criminal police officer from Lingdong, goes undercover at Heidao Prison to solve a case involving missing people along the border. Meanwhile, Wen Bang, a retired special forces soldier from Nanling, is forced to serve time in the same prison in order to rescue Yachun and her daughter—the only family he has left. Inside, the two men evolve from adversaries into allies.

In the late Qing Dynasty, the Hakkas were persecuted by the Qing government and forced to flee overseas. They formed a group of eighteen relics of the Hakka family of the Hakka leaders. Under the leadership of Zhong Mengchang, they crossed the Nanyang. Sell ​​piglets, open mines, and establish a commercial system that is popular among Chinese. Another part of the people traveled across the Pacific to the depths of the Rocky Mountains to repair the railway for Americans. In the struggle to risk their lives, they learned to survive, learned technology, learned to use the law, and became the representative of industrial civilization.
After many years, 18 Hakka disciples scattered around the world returned to Guangzhou from all directions, carrying the dream of revitalizing Tangshan and bringing the commercial revolution and industrial revolution back to China. But the reality is that they…

Qin Chuan, a rookie cop, joins a special task force and is sent on an undercover mission to the Golden Triangle. After stepping in as the lead agent, he infiltrates the cartel to uncover vital intelligence and tries to prevent the cartel from setting up a drug factory on the mainland.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Gu Ying" (孤鹰) by Shao Xue Cheng (邵雪城).

After reaching the age of 30, challenges escalated. Gu Jia experienced five years of ups and downs and encountered a new rival, Jiang Li Li, on the journey of life. This time, they are determined to become the protagonists of their own lives and take control of the latter half of life. However, at the age of 35, everything remains as it is!

Xiao Yun Yi is the most lowly adopted daughter of the Xiao family in a marquis household. On the day of her coming-of-age ceremony, she is arranged by her legitimate elder brother Xiao Jing Xing into an extremely unfavorable marriage, being married off as a concubine to a notorious butcher.

In order to change her tragic fate, Yun Yi decides to take a risky path and tries to stir feelings in the cold and aloof gentleman Xiao Jing Xing. By day, she appears as a meek and innocent girl, but by night, she disregards propriety with her adoptive brother, determined to make him fall for her within the seven days before her marriage…

After her fiancé died on the battlefield, Hu Shan Wei entered the palace to become a female historian in order to avoid her stepmother forcing her to remarry. During her experience of editing books in the palace, Hu Shan Wei met like-minded friends, was appreciated by her superiors, and was promoted to the seventh-rank Dianzheng, becoming a female official in charge of the affairs of the harem. She also formed an indissoluble bond with Mu Chun, the son of Xiping Hou. 

After resolving several palace incidents, her talent and courage impressed Empress Ma, and she was promoted to the sixth-rank Si Yan to assist the Central Palace. Hu Shan Wei and Empress Ma were both teachers and friends. She set a life goal of following the path of a female official to the end and also offended the villains because of her adherence to justice.

After Empress Ma passed away, Hu Shan Wei was framed and…

dramas.nt: 金庸武侠世界之神雕侠侣
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from book 2 "The Return of the Condor Heroes" (神鵰俠侶) in the novel series "Condor Trilogy" (射鵰三部曲) by Jin Yong (金庸).
dramas.t: The Legend of Heroes: The Return of the Condor Heroes

dramas.syn: Chi Xia, a socially anxious manga artist, travels to Peach Island, where her past is buried. There, she meets Xie Yi Heng, a socially adept worker who is seeking redemption. Despite their contrasting personalities, they work together to solve challenges related to the manga and the island. Through their journey, they come to understand each other, encourage one another, and find the courage to reconcile with their pasts and pursue their dreams anew.
dramas.t: Xia Ri Chu Tao Re Lian Dao

dramas.syn:
During the Hongwu era of the Ming dynasty, Yang Tian Lin, the orphaned son of a county magistrate, fled the chaos with his younger brother. They were taken in by a master carpenter who taught Yang Tian Lin the ways of the world and exquisite woodworking techniques. Years later, during the Yongle era, an imperial edict officially decreed the historic relocation of the national capital. Though Yang Tian Lin intended to hide his identity and live a quiet, humble life, his exceptional craftsmanship led to his forced conscription into the monumental project of building the new imperial city.

As tens of thousands of artisans converge on Beijing, an unprecedented epic of engineering unfolds. However, the construction site becomes a breeding ground for chaos. The imperial court faces severe budgetary crises, civil and military factions clash over war versus construction, corrupt officials and…

A bizarre drug-related homicide revives a three-year-old cold case, leading Guan Tian Hang back to the anti-narcotics unit. As he hunts for the killer, he reunites with long-lost neighbor Yuan Yue Xin, who’s tangled in the deadly mystery.

Lin Yue appeared energetically on the opening day of the University of Macau in neat sportswear. Her eyes were full of longing for the palace of knowledge and ardent expectations for the future. She was walking through the campus tree-lined streets, holding a brand new textbook tightly in her hands, her hair ruffling in the breeze, looking youthful and agile. Lin Yue grew up in an old neighborhood of Macau. The Cantonese opera singing in the neighborhood and the aroma of Portuguese tarts in the streets all combined to weave her pyrotechnic childhood. However, her ordinary family background did not restrain her from pursuing her dreams. She was admitted to the University of Macau with excellent results and majored in cultural heritage protection, determined to do her best to protect the precious cultural treasures of her hometown.

Su Ran, coming from a wealthy family, was attracted to…

Criminal police officer Shi Qiang, after his radiation overdose, and scientist Wang Miao investigate the theft of nanomaterials, uncovering a conspiracy by a mysterious organization to destroy human unity.

~~ Adapted from the novel "The Three-Body Problem" (三体) by Liu Ci Xin (刘慈欣).

Mo De Xian, a fitter at a machinery factory, takes his entire family and follows a group of refugees into the mountains, where they settle in "Gezhi Town" together with Xiao Yan, an anti-aircraft artillery commander who has been left behind by the main force, and his men.

However, the peaceful life of Mo De Xian, his wife Xia Cheng, the Old Master, and their son Mo Deng Xian is shattered by the unexpected arrival of a small unit of Japanese reconnaissance soldiers. Unwilling to stand by or retreat, the townspeople risk their lives to defend their home, setting off a deadly confrontation between the ingenuity of ordinary civilians and a formally armed military force.

It tells the stories behind several buildings, a woman's struggle and counterattack, a city history recorded by architecture, and the ordinary people of all kinds and their choices. Whether it is favorable or not, they take root and struggle here, just for the dream above and the home in their hearts.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Kai Pan" (开盘) by Qi Dian Jun (祈祷君).

dramas.t: Liao Bu Qi De Wo Men

dramas.syn:
Fu Rong, an official's daughter, was forced into the palace by her own family. There, she gave birth to a mute girl. Mother and daughter cling to each other in the depths of the palace, hoping nothing more than to survive. But the young girl accidentally stumbled upon the Noble Consort's secret and was silenced forever. 

With her last weakness gone, the gentle mother turns into a blade. She buries her former self and uses herself as bait. With the help of her former lover, an imperial physician, she sets one trap after another, striking at the heart step by step. Concubines, the consort, the prince, the emperor- no one escapes her chessboard. Not a favored concubine, not a virtuous empress, she wants only blood for blood. As chaos engulfs the inner palace, a mother's revenge has only just begun.

A reckless young man hides a Bitcoin mining rig in his ancestral tomb for cheap electricity, but his scheme backfires when the "smoking tomb" attracts both bumbling thieves and a criminal gang, pushing his chaotic life toward total collapse.

The fourth installment of the "Mi Shi" series gives a fictionalized spin on Kang Xi's maturation process and the road to independent rule, complete with love triangles and dramatic emphasis.

After Regent Suo Ni's death during Emperor Kang Xi's eighth year of reign, Kang Xi sees an opportunity to gain complete independence as a ruler. One day while visiting the home of one of his ministers, Kang Xi encounters and becomes smitten with Ao Bai's beautiful daughter, Qing Ge Er.

Unaware of Kang Xi's true identity, Qing Ge Er tries to reject his aggressive advances. Minister Nalan Ming Zhu's gallant and talented son, Nalan Xing De, sees her plight and comes to her rescue, angering the spoiled young Emperor. This fateful encounter marks the beginning of both rivalry and eventual mutual respect.

dramas.t: Yu Xiang Rou Si Wo Xiang Ni

dramas.syn: Lan Yi, the museum director, and detective Wang Sen team up to infiltrate the underground antique market and track down stolen Song Dynasty treasures, risking their reputations and lives to return these priceless artifacts to their rightful home.

A thin layer of ice covers the frozen lake, a path through a pine forest unguarded by surveillance cameras leads a man to the lakeside, dragging a six-wheeled suitcase. The next morning, a naked female corpse is discovered in a lakeside park in the city center. 

Ma Xue Song, the criminal investigation captain of the Qiaocheng branch, arrives at the scene, searching for clues left by the killer. A victim who can speak sign language, a birdcage-like house, a peculiar room, a missing girl—an unseen hand is reaching out to those who cannot speak. Amidst the thick fog of mystery, Ma Xue Song's investigation uncovers a silent and cruel past.

The central plot focuses on a girl named Yun Lei seeking revenge for her grandfather's death. Unfortunately, the person most responsible for his death is the father of the man she has mutually fallen in love with. There are also subplots like Zhang Dan Feng's father planning to stage a coup and start his own dynasty and the touching but tragic romance between Princess Jing and Yun Lei's brother, Yun Zhong.

~~ Adapted from the novel “Ping Zong Xia Ying Lu” (萍踪侠影录) by Liang Yu Sheng (梁羽生).

"Ni Shui Han" follows the journey of Qi Shao Shang in his quest to find the truth behind his sword, Ni Shui Han. Gu Xi Zhao is the antagonist in this story. He pursues Qi Shao Shang in hopes of stopping him before he finds the truth about the sword. The characters, in their clashes and struggles, weigh the importance of loyalty and justice and the meaning of love and life. Ni Shui Han examines several layers of human feelings and the meaning of life for the characters.

~~ Adapted from the novel by Wen Rui An.
Four teammates—Captain, Ji Li, Da Xiong, and Professor—join a live-action tournament. Through teamwork and determination, they win the championship and thwart a villainous organization’s scheme.
dramas.t: He Ping Jing Ying: Jia You Te Zhong Bing

dramas.syn:
Luo Ying Wei, Shi Lin Lin, Huang Fei and Zhou Tian entered the obstetrics and gynecology department of the affiliated hospital of Pingling university with their own ideals and goals. The four continued to improve their medical skills with their respective teachers.

They faced various difficulties together and gained precious friendship on the way to becoming doctors. When they are respected by their peers and grateful by cured patients, they find a heartfelt recognition of the profession of doctors.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zhi You Yi Sheng Zhi Dao! " (只有医生知道!) by Zhang Yu (张羽).

The series will be divided into two parts. 

The first part, entitled "Emperor Wu," recounts how Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty bolstered central authority from within, launched campaigns against the Xiongnu tribe, expanded territories, and propelled the dynasty to its zenith. 

The second part, "Emperor Guangwu," narrates how Emperor Guangwu, Liu Xiu, rose from a fallen noble family, rebelled against Wang Mang, restored the unity of the nation, and revived the Han Dynasty, achieving the "Guangwu Zhongxing" era.

Through a modern lens, the "Han Dynasty Epic" series captures historical shifts, offering a comprehensive portrayal of the nation's destiny and the grandeur of a mighty nation during the Han Dynasty's most prosperous epoch—a testament to the pinnacle moments of the Chinese nation.

After years of grieving their missing daughter, the Lu Cong couple finally begins to heal with the birth of their second child—until their lost daughter suddenly returns. But she’s not alone. Her so-called husband hides a dark truth, masking control and abuse behind a facade of kindness.

Chu Zi Yuan, the gifted heir to a renowned family of imperial clay sculptors is betrayed by the man she loves, leading to her family's destruction. Transported from ancient China to the modern world, she sets out to avenge the past, only to find herself drawn into an unexpected relationship with her greatest enemy.

In the early years of the Republic of China, a mysterious police death and the murder of a famous wealthy businessman made headlines, with the killer remaining elusive. Police officers were baffled. The victim's fiancée was Jiang Si Yao, a once-renowned detective who had retired years ago. To find the murderers of her husband and father, she teamed up with her best friend, policewoman Huo Yi Ning. With the help of Ye Shi An, a wealthy young man hiding in the shadows, the three faced numerous dangers along the way.
~~ Adapted from the novel  "Poison Genius Consort" (天才小毒妃) by Jie Mo (芥沫).
dramas.t: Re Bu Qi De Han Yun Xi

dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the 9th novel "Doll" (玩偶) in the novel series "Medical Examiner Dr. Qin" (法医秦明) by Qin Ming (秦明).
dramas.t: Fa Yi Qin Ming Zhi Wan Ou

dramas.syn:
In the 1970s, Xu Bu Shi, a mother who defies convention, arranges a marriage exchange for herself in pursuit of love. However, she falls for the wrong man and is fortunately rescued by Liang Gui Sheng, an honest and kindhearted worker. The two eventually marry. They then work together to overcome one challenge after another, including entering the city to work in a factory and starting their own restaurant.

By the 1990s, their daughter, Liang Ru Yi, has inherited her mother's rebellious nature. After a period of estrangement and a complete falling-out with her mother, the two gradually resolve their emotional conflicts through a relationship marked by both love and confrontation, ultimately coming to understand and support each other.

When Qin general Bai Qi lays siege to Ying, the capital of Chu, three hundred thousand civilians are slaughtered. Desperate to rewind time, the shamaness Chu Li invokes the Chu Phoenix Call, only to be cut down by a single sword strike from Song Zi Yuan, a man she has never met. The two are thrown forty-nine days into the past. Bound together against their will to save the people, they endure a series of eerie, fantastical events, and their fated love from lifetimes past slowly begins to resurface.

Liu Gao Xing, a villager in Qingfengzhai, took his five rich brothers to work in Xi'an City. Under the introduction of fellow villagers, they started the work of collecting waste. 

The two strangers who arrived here for the first time experienced many difficult situations, such as being bullied when they crossed the border to collect waste, being misunderstood and looked down upon, clashing with street gangsters, almost getting caught collecting medical waste, and having difficulty for their children to go to school in the city. They were happy with their wits. Use your mind and optimistic attitude to solve the problem.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Gao Xing" (高兴) by Jian Ping Wa (贾平凹).

Once Zhang Ding Bang, who once became the first college student in the village, has been jailed for fifteen years for manslaughter and returned to a normal life track, his only wish is to find the children who were separated and untie each other. Fulfill the promise that the family will never give up before his wife's death. But time has passed, and he has almost no clues about finding a few children. It is like finding a needle in a haystack.

Fortunately, although fate had given him despair time and time again, the family still met again in the dark, but the misunderstanding of the eldest son, Qing Yun, the amnesia of the second daughter, Yi Lin, and the escape of the third daughter Xue Xin made this road to reunion. Always blocked by layers. 

Seeing the hardships come, the family finally recognized each other and resolved the conflicts of the year. In order not to leave the…
~~ Adapted from the manhua "Rakshasa Street" (镇魂街) by Xu Chen (许辰).

In Beidou Village next to the tower of the Satellite Launch Center, an interesting story about how high the sky is and how thick the earth is happened between Liu Wei Xing, a cadre of the launch center stationed in Kochi, and Niu Wei Xing, a grassroots villager.
dramas.t: Li Xing Xing Zui Jin De Ren

dramas.syn:
A story about a team of righteous prosecutors who are unbending in their mandate to fight corruption.

A public official commits suicide which ignites a chain of events. Jian Jie  is a prosecutor tasked with investigating the case, but he encounters hurdles every step of the way. Not long after, Lawyer Mei Dong Sheng who is Jian Jie's future father-in-law goes missing and becomes the prime suspect to a murder case. The lives of Jian Jie and his fiancée are turned upside down until Jian Jie realizes that something bigger is at play. Under the leadership of their superior, Jian Jie, Ji Jia Ni  and their team of prosecutors begin the uphill battle against major political powers who will cover their tracks at all costs.

We are afraid of spoilers because once the suspense is gone, the joy of exploration disappears with it. Yet in reality, too many people are living in a world that has already been spoiled for them: others map out the script of their lives far in advance, parents set the standard answers for education, career choices, and marriage, while social conventions dictate "what must be accomplished by what age." We hurry forward holding an ending we already know, losing the everyday moments and surprises of exploration along the way.

As the abyss gazes back and life and death roar in defiance, a remote island at the turn of the century becomes the stage for a dark fable. On the eve of a dangerous typhoon, when peril lurks at every corner, a series of seemingly chance encounters draws multiple parties together. What unfolds is a story that explores the boundaries between life and death, good and evil, and the complexities of the human heart.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Yuan Dao Fang Zhou" (远岛方舟) by Yan Guang (言桄).

In 1999, Luo Wei Min, a prison investigator at Gucheng Prison, accidentally discovered that Wang Guo Yan, a serious criminal serving his sentence in prison, had committed several crimes. A murder case full of doubts. When Luo Wei Min wanted to investigate the case further, he encountered unexpected levels of resistance. Luo Wei Min and his comrade Zhao Zhong He were determined to uncover this thick and dark secret. With the help of the old political commissar, the two worked together to conduct an in-depth investigation.

However, just when the truth was about to be revealed, a sudden change occurred, and all Luo Wei Min's efforts were in vain. With the launch of the special campaign against gangs and evil in 2018, He Bo, a member of the supervision team, entered the ancient city, and the dusty past was salvaged. In 2021, the education rectification team continued to deepen. With more…

Dancer Xiao Miao Miao, peerless artistry leads her to reopen the "Nishang Pavilion" (Pavilion of Splendid Attire). Her fame sweeps through the capital, catching the eye of Lord Wei Yi An but, at the same time, drawing the ire of Xue Tao Er, the third wife of the Wei household, who from then on starts to scheme against Xiao Miao Miao. Fighting through all the obstacles, Xiao Miao Miao slowly starts discovering hidden truths from her past about her family and creates a revenge plan to punish everybody who tried to bury the truth about her origins.

Di Wu Ming, a university student from a rural village, strives to uplift his hometown after economic setbacks. Teaming up with breeder Sun Ting and entrepreneur Tie Ma, they build a koi breeding and feed business, to revitalize the local economy, expand internationally, and attract investment through a koi competition.

A female lawyer, Gu Xing Can, infiltrates a criminal organization to avenge her father’s death. Betrayed and thrown into the sea, she is rescued by Chen Yao, a soul ferryman. Trapped in a cycle of revenge that repeatedly bends time, the two go from a contractual bond of protection to a love that transcends life and death.
dramas.t: I’d Do It All over Again for You

dramas.syn:
The story revolves around Chu Ting Yin, an orphan girl in a chaotic world. Her life is filled with hardship and suffering, but she finds a confidant who joins her in conquering the world, breaking free from the control of the obsessive crown prince, and ultimately ascending to the throne.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "From Sacrifice to Empress" (听银) by Ban Cai Ming Yue (半裁明月).

Delivery worker Liang Jin is unwittingly drawn into a struggle between mainland China's state security authorities and Taiwanese spies. After facing life-or-death crises, his second and third identities are revealed in succession: a Taiwanese gang boss and an undercover police officer working for the Ministry of State Security. Torn intensely between family ties, hatred, and faith, he keeps a low profile while maneuvering among multiple forces and hesitates at the boundary between light and darkness.

Within the cold, secluded halls of a noble household, she is an illegitimate daughter treated as someone to be trampled upon. Yet beneath the surface, schemes and political intrigue are constantly unfolding, and she quietly becomes a master strategist, carefully planning every move.

Struggling to rise from obscurity and hardship, she refuses to be defeated, steadily climbing toward honor, power, and the pinnacle of her destiny.

When Zhou Yan travels to Langia to find his fiancée, he is abducted by traffickers and trapped in a brutal scam compound, where he narrowly escapes having his organs harvested. But his ordeal is far from over. Framed for a crime he didn't commit, Zhou Yan is thrown in prison. After his release, he poses as a feared underworld kingpin and begins taking down local crime bosses and ruthless gangs one by one. Joining forces with undercover cops Mo Na and Layla, he uncovers the mastermind behind it all and fights his way to the top, bringing the entire criminal network crashing down.

Bai Luo Ru, an office worker who has grown tired of her company and endured years of psychological pressure, resigns from her job and leaves to escape it all. After arriving in a village, she loses her phone and finds herself in a difficult situation. Han Xi Yang and the villagers quietly offer her help.

She initially intends to spend a few peaceful days there, but she becomes unwillingly involved in the lives and affairs of the villagers. Through these experiences, she begins to confront her own confusion and reexamine her relationship with her mother.

A driven elite lawyer, estranged from her fearful daughter and cheating husband, teams up with her rival to prevent her child's fatal accident by unraveling a 15-year-old mystery that reveals chilling ties between her family's collapse and the tragedy she's desperate to stop.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Zao Chun Qing Lang" (早春晴朗) by Gu Niang Bie Ku (姑娘别哭).

An emotionally hypersensitive prosecutor, a mysterious boy with Asperger’s syndrome, and a series of juvenile crime cases — through their confrontations, they seek the truth behind each case, and through redemption, they safeguard the bottom line of humanity.

The court's “executive duo”, Ye Mu Yuan and Wen Zhu Shi, each with their own thunderbolt tactics, side by side to fight the top rogue forces, but because of the different concepts of black and white on both sides of the road. One of them plays with fame and fortune, and is ultimately victimized. One is as solid as a rock and can save the day.

Inspired by the true 1949 "Chongqing Ship Uprising," the series is set between 1948 and 1949 as the "Chongqing" — the Nationalist Navy’s premier flagship cruiser — returns to China, only to become an isolated vessel plagued by factional infighting, secret surveillance, and collapsing morale.

Inside its cabins, stern and enigmatic training officer Yu Wei Ran hides a dangerous secret while navigating competing forces. Meanwhile, young sailor Jiang Zhou and his British-trained comrades — naval cadets averaging just twenty years old — are forged into true warriors under Yu’s brutal discipline.

As the war closes in and the ship opens fire at Tashan, these passionate youths are stripped of their innocence and swept into an inescapable tide of history, ultimately choosing a new faith to become the founding sparks of the new Chinese navy.

~~ Based on the historical event of the 1949 mutiny…

Li Chuan is a new firefighter who unexpectedly receives the belongings of Li Shun Zhang, a firefighter who died during the Chongqing bombings of 1941. To unravel the secrets behind these belongings and to pass them on to Li Shun Zhang's descendants, Li Chuan begins his investigation and, by chance, travels back to the Republic of China era. The timid and cowardly Li Chuan begins a complete transformation and gains a deeper understanding of this period of history.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Xun Zhao Li Shun Zhang" (寻找李顺章) Liu San Xiao (柳三笑).

In the late 1970s, Liu Hai Zhu, a young man from Songliao, becomes involved in conflicts within the underworld after intervening to help someone in need. He forms a life-and-death friendship with Dong Ba Tian.

Amid the changing times, he goes from being an ordinary worker to becoming deeply entangled in the underworld. Along the way, he experiences brotherhood, complicated relationships of love and hatred, and difficult moral choices, ultimately achieving personal growth and redemption amid the snow-covered landscapes and black soil of Northeast China.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Hei Dao Bei Qing" (黑道悲情) by Kong Er Gou (孔二狗).

Twenty-two-year-old Feng Ling, the only son of the Feng family, is pressured by his grandfather, under threat of death, into signing a contractual marriage agreement with twenty-seven-year-old Jiang Tang, the president of the Jiang Group. Initially resistant, Feng Ling gradually becomes attracted to the gentle and mature Jiang Tang after their wedding night.

From acting proud and refusing to admit his feelings, to silently becoming jealous and secretly paying attention to her, and then to actively standing up for her and carefully planning a marriage proposal, Feng Ling falls for her step by step. Jiang Tang, meanwhile, patiently and understandingly waits for the younger Feng family heir to personally say, "I love you."

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Hun Qian: Bie Ai Wo, Hun Hou: Lao Po Tie Tie" (婚前：别挨我，婚后：老婆贴贴), also known as "Wo Jiu Pa Lao Po Zen Me Liao" (我就怕老婆怎么了), by Jiu Wen Rou…

Story of Xiang Kui, a once-famous actress who “time-travels” into the palace as a maid. She unexpectedly learns that the young emperor, Ye Qian Yu, is being coerced by the Empress Dowager and secretly disguises himself as an eunuch to secretly collude with external ministers, forming alliances and plotting his comeback. 

To escape the palace, Xiang Kui and Ye Qian Yu start out with ulterior motives but gradually join forces, devising strategies together while their feelings for one another slowly blossom. However, just as they succeed in overthrowing the Empress Dowager, they discover that this world is not the real ancient era—it’s actually a meticulously constructed illusion.

This series tells the life story of Yin Reng, the son and heir apparent to Emperor Kangxi. Yin Reng was installed as the crown prince and demoted twice throughout his life. His younger brother, Yin Zhen, eventually takes the throne and becomes Emperor Yongzheng.

To seek justice for her father, Yu Song takes a job as an assistant in the Song household. Her sincerity wins Song Cheng over, and she teams up with Jing, a driver, to gather evidence and expose the Song family's crimes. But she refuses to let hatred consume her. She breaks free from what has held her back and realizes that real victory means taking control of her own life.

One unsolved case after another comes to light, with each scar bearing witness. Two formidable individuals join forces to unravel a strange and intricate mystery, together seeking the truth that has been concealed.
dramas.t: Wo De Wu Zuo Qian Bei

dramas.syn:
The year 1927 marked a major turning point in the course of China's Great Revolution. While the revolution and military campaigns under the cooperation between the Kuomintang (KMT) and the Communist Party of China (CPC) were continuing to develop, the right wing of the Kuomintang, represented by Chiang Kai-shek, and the Wuhan Kuomintang authorities, led by Wang Jing Wei, successively launched the April 12 and July 15 counterrevolutionary coups. They openly betrayed the policy of cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, as well as the anti-imperialist and anti-feudal program established by Sun Yat Sen, and carried out large-scale massacres of Communists and revolutionary masses.

To save the revolution from this crisis, the Communist Party of China solemnly assumed the historic mission of continuing the struggle against imperialism and feudalism. It decisively adopted…

Zhan Hong Tu, a hairdresser, was struck by a falling signboard—ironically inscribed with the phrase "Grand Ambitions"—and transported to another era. He awoke in the body of a good-for-nothing, matrilocal husband of the Su family. In an age where everyone wore their hair long, Zhan Hong Tu feared he would be utterly useless—but fate had other plans for this hairdresser! When the Princess of the Great Xia Dynasty issued a public reward for anyone capable of creating the "foreign-style" curls seen among travelers from afar, Zhan Hong Tu stepped up. Using nothing but a pair of heated iron tongs, he crafted a voluminous, chic, wavy hairstyle for the Princess—earning him a grand, high-profile escort back to the Su family estate. 

His fiancée, Su Xing Wan, and his three future sisters-in-law all held deep prejudices against him. Yet, with his insatiable love for money and his slick,…
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chun Feng Bu Gai Jiu Shi Bo" (春风不改旧时波) by Qin Shu Ying (秦疏影).

Gongsun Jian Jue, a police academy graduate who is unfamiliar with the ways of the world, encounters his mentor, Uncle Qi (Jiang Wu), a highly experienced criminal investigation team captain, shortly after arriving in Bianhe. Uncle Qi is highly skilled at his work and deeply values loyalty and personal bonds, making him a role model in Gongsun's eyes. However, Uncle Qi does not think highly of Gongsun.

Determined to persuade Uncle Qi to accept him as his apprentice, Gongsun quietly resolves to work hard. Whether handling minor and routine cases with the Pu'an Unit or major cases with the Major Crimes Unit, Gongsun remains consistently diligent, rigorous, conscientious, and meticulous, doing everything in his power to apprehend criminals.

~~ Adapted from the novel series "Xing Jing Shi Tu" (刑警师徒) by Ren Jian Bo (任剑波).

In 1995, the Great Hanshin Earthquake in Kobe, Japan, unexpectedly changed the fate of a Chinese port city. Four young people from different backgrounds and with different ambitions are swept up by the tide of the times and devote themselves to the bustling docks.

Over the course of thirty years, they witness the dramatic transformation of the port, from manual labor and shoulder-borne cargo handling to remote-controlled operations, and the rise of port technology from a period of open exploration to a position of global leadership.

Their personal relationships also undergo many twists and turns amid the changing times. From standing side by side to ultimately reaching the same destination by different paths, they support one another through struggle and help each other through difficult choices. Through their perseverance, they embody the craftsman’s spirit of “choosing one…

Born into a wealthy family, Yao Nan Qin appears to have a perfect life on the surface. However, behind the glamour and privilege lie hidden schemes, family conflicts, and carefully guarded secrets. As she becomes entangled with Ou Wen, a man carrying his own burdens and ambitions, the two gradually heal each other's emotional wounds while navigating the power struggles and intrigues surrounding them. Amid deception, rivalry, and shifting loyalties, a sincere romance begins to blossom.
dramas.t: Hao Yi Ge Xiao Xiao Jie

dramas.syn: On the surface, Mo Qi Qi is an effortlessly confident "player" who is either breaking up with a boyfriend or on her way to breaking up with one, firmly declaring that she "never goes back to an ex." But after getting drunk and adding seven of her ex-boyfriends to a group chat to ask them to get back together, her life begins to spiral completely out of control. Forced to navigate both a cutthroat workplace and an emotional maze, she begins to reexamine her philosophy of "never looking back."
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Pan Gao Zhi" (攀高枝) by Bai Lu Cheng Shuang (白鹭成双).

When the general breaks the ritual, strange incidents begin to plague the border city. Under his command, there are no gods; in her gaze, she hunts for the killer. The mystery unfolds like a game of chess. Are the players human, or ghosts?

The Shen family is massacred, and young Shen Li witnesses Zhao Wu Jiu, Cui Hong, and a mysterious figure with a man-eating flower tattoo committing the murders. After narrowly escaping death with Xie Yun Gui's help, she takes the name Gu Han Yi and masters both medicine and strategy. Joining forces with other women, she carefully sets her revenge in motion. But after eliminating two of her enemies, she is shocked to discover that the third has been by her side all along...

Set against the gritty, vibrant backdrop of the late Sui Dynasty and in a turbulent era of Jianghu conflicts, the once-glorious Suyan Escort Agency has completely collapsed under a mountain of inherited debt. Forced to step up, Yan Ru Yu takes over as the new head of the agency, joining forces with a witty, sharp-tongued strategist, Shu Xiu Zhong, to orchestrate an impossible financial comeback.

With a crew made up entirely of down-on-their-luck commoners with only mediocre martial arts skills, they turn the traditional escort industry on its head by introducing modern business strategies, creative marketing prints, and promotional vouchers. Travelling between treacherous mountain passes and dangerous roads, they look past fame and fortune to focus on survival, inherited debts, and upholding the ultimate bottom line of trust and righteousness.

Yun Qing Qing’s life falls apart in an instant. Hoping to find a decent place to quietly end it all, she is instead tricked into becoming the acting manager of a guesthouse. Before she can make sense of her new life, she finds herself chased by debt collectors and caught in the sights of Shen Feng, the owner of a local tea plantation. To her surprise, Shen Feng turns out to be the online boyfriend she ghosted years ago. Amid the chaos and unexpected encounters of everyday life, Yun Qing Qing gradually heals and rediscovers the courage to love—and to let herself be loved.

During the Republic of China era, Wang Lao Wu, a veterinarian by trade, accidentally becomes the county magistrate of Fuhu County. Once in office, he encounters endless troubles and fights his way through every obstacle in this absurd, comic tale. Centering on ordinary people, the drama reveals how small characters forge a grand era in Republican China.
~~ Adapted from the 8th volume in the novel series "Candle in the Tomb" (鬼吹灯) by Zhang Mu Ye (天下霸唱).
The story follows grassroots entrepreneur Sun Meng Xiang, who, after his online store goes bankrupt during an e-commerce startup, joins the e-commerce platform "Youpai".

The story focuses on the turbulent lives of Liang You Fu and Qi Da Mei, a married couple living in Xingfu Courtyard in Weicheng, and their seven sons. Taking the changing fortunes of the seven Liang brothers over more than forty years as its main thread, the drama vividly reflects the sweeping transformations of Chinese society from the 1970s into the new century, depicting the character of the era preserved in collective memory.

Through the individual life paths and struggles of the seven brothers amid the currents of changing times, the drama deeply portrays the perseverance, struggles, and growth of ordinary Chinese people during a period of social transformation, while celebrating the spirit of the era embodied by constant self-improvement and the pursuit of a better life.

In the 1990s, Guan Shao Jie rose from humble beginnings, starting out at a clothing stall. After being framed, he turns to automobile sales and saves his company by securing a major deal. His nephew, Fang Yi Lin, loses his mother and goes undercover to capture a motorcycle gang, but is shaken by black market interests before being persuaded by Guan Shao Jie to return to school.

Ten years later, Guan Shao Jie’s automobile company is embroiled in corruption and faces a crisis from foreign patent competition, prompting him to call Fang Yi Lin back to help combat corruption. Another decade later, the new energy sector of the Shuangjie Group becomes the target of foreign espionage schemes.

To follow Yan Tong, a top authority among senior lawyers, young lawyer Fu Ting must complete psychological analyses of thirteen capital cases in one month. Locked in a sealed room, he unexpectedly "travels" into the world of the case files and lives through the "crime scenes." When the last case points to the truth behind the murder of Yan Tong's mother, Fu Ting must deliver the ultimate verdict at the border between reality and illusion.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Fei Ke De Wan Yan" (费可的晚宴) by Luo Jia (珞珈).

In her previous life, the gentle and insecure Qin Sheng Yi had no control over her own destiny and ultimately fell victim to an unjust world. Given a second chance at life, she is determined to break free from her cruel fate. She forges herself into the sharpest blade.

After securing a divorce and escaping her marriage, she is pressured by her family and disguises herself as a Princess Consort to enter the Prince Commandery’s residence. There, she joins forces with Xiao Ji Yun to thwart her stepmother’s schemes and investigate an old case.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Guo Se Fang Hua" (国色芳华) by Yi Qian Chong (意千重).

Detective Tu Yong is shocked to learn that the mastermind behind a major car theft ring is his long-lost adoptive sister, Chen Lu, now a ruthless crime boss bent on revenge, pulling them into a hidden, emotional showdown where family loyalty and justice collide.

Criminal psychologist Gu Yan, the exceptionally perceptive Shen Yu, and frontline detective Lu Yuan form an unlikely investigative team to solve a series of crimes across the city. Despite using a wheelchair, Gu Yan relies on her expertise in psychological profiling to understand the minds of criminals, while Shen Yu's sharp observational skills and Lu Yuan's ability to uncover physical evidence complement her methods.

As the three combine their strengths to investigate seemingly unrelated cases, they begin uncovering clues that point to a long-buried tragedy deliberately concealed from the public. Amid dangerous confrontations, hidden motives, and growing suspicions, the team must navigate their own troubled pasts while working together to expose the truth.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yu Lang Gong Mian" (与狼共眠) by Fu Jiu (傅九).

The story follows a group of ordinary people exploring the path ahead while caught between the "broad" and "narrow" paths of life. Coming from all corners of the country, they gather in Chengdu. Amid the everyday bustle of the city, they experience confusion, growth, and warmth, finding their own rhythm between running forward and stopping to rest.

In the Tianbao era, Yun Wu Shuang disguises herself to uncover the truth behind her father’s wrongful conviction. Teaming up with deputy minister Zheng You Cheng, they navigate dangerous conspiracies and hidden relics, fighting to protect a thousand-year-old Tang dynasty treasure while uncovering justice and love.

Yang Ming is a menial disciple of the Xuanji Sect with no cultivation. Cheerful, optimistic, and quick-witted, he is skilled at exploiting loopholes in the rules and uses "unjust" means to do just things. By a twist of fate, he becomes Dao companions with the exceptionally gifted Jiang Si Yao, activating the hidden "Marriage Blessing" system within him—whenever his Dao companion makes a breakthrough, he gains ten times her cultivation, and whenever he gives her a gift, he receives ten times the value in return.

Deeply loyal and devoted to those he cares about, Yang Ming changes from someone concerned only with protecting himself into a responsible and dependable person as he fights for survival and revenge. Both his strength and state of mind undergo tremendous changes.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Tang Ping: Lao Po Xiu Lian Wo Bian Qiang" (躺平：老婆修炼我变强) by Wan Hong Zhuang (万红壮).

In the thirteenth year of the Jinghe era, the discovery of a corpse dressed in red floating in the Dimu River shocks the capital. While investigating, Embroidered Uniform Guard deputy commander Shang Guan Yu rescues a scholar named Shen Yun Zhou, whose appearance bears a striking resemblance to someone from his past. The two soon join forces to investigate a series of mysterious murders.

Initially suspicious of Shen Yun Zhou, Shang Guan Yu repeatedly tests him, but the two gradually develop a strong bond as they face danger together. As the investigation deepens, however, a web of hidden identities, family secrets, and long-buried conspiracies begins to emerge, threatening both their friendship and everything they believe about the case.

In the winter of 1989, Bayier was about to leave Ili and head to Harbin. Three days before his departure, a friend held a farewell banquet for him at a small tavern. Drunk, he happened to run into several prospective college students coming to inspect magnetic poles. After a quarrel, he struggled and later realized he had taken the wrong cotton jacket. In his pocket, a handkerchief was wrapped in a walkie-talkie. Thus, the marvelous dual space-time connection began.

~~ Adapted from the song "Apple Scent" (苹果香) by Lang Ge (狼戈).
dramas.t: Zai Yi Li, Xiang Jian Ni

dramas.syn:
A medical aid team to Tibet, represented by Su Ke, arrives at the Central Hospital of Zang'an County in the western Tibetan region. Chang Zheng, a poverty alleviation official temporarily serving as deputy county magistrate, is responsible for medical care and poverty alleviation work. Located on the plateau, the western Tibetan region faces poverty caused by illness as one of the main obstacles preventing local people from escaping poverty, making it one of the most difficult fronts in the battle against poverty.

Su Ke and Chang Zheng lead post-1990s trainees such as Sang Ji and Lu Xin. With the assistance of local Tibetan doctor Jie Bu, young entrepreneur He Wei, and others, they overcome numerous difficulties. With unwavering dedication to poverty alleviation, they provide assistance and care in the fields of medical treatment and medicine to ethnic minority communities and people…

While restoring a cursed painting, art restorer Ning Cai Chen awakens the spirit of Nie Xiao Qian. As they uncover a demon’s plan to resurrect by consuming the souls of star-crossed lovers, they realize they share a love that spans lifetimes and must risk everything to stop him.

dramas.nt: 大王别慌张 第二季

dramas.syn: In the near future, after death, humans can upload their consciousness to the metaverse, redefining the boundary between life and death. Fan Bu Fan, a dungeon designer who accidentally falls into the metaverse, teams up with uniquely talented teammates to uncover the truth of this sci-fi world. Together, they navigate bizarre and dangerous dungeons, overcoming challenges and uncovering the shocking secrets hidden behind the metaverse.
dramas.t: Qing Zai Hao Hao Huo Yi Ci

dramas.syn: Food courier Zhang Yong Sen's consciousness is connected to parallel realities to save his gravely ill fiancée, Lin Duo. He reunites with her in five vastly different worlds, where every choice and loss deepens his understanding of love and redemption. At the end of time, a new chance to defy fate awaits him.

Five separate yet interlinked stories. A revenge plotted through a "summer camp", a "useless man" who reconciles with his regrets, warring personalities in one body, like a "scratch-card", a loyal "emergency contact" at the bedside, and a film queen's collapse into postpartum darkness.

Top actress Xia Yi Mo loses out on a coveted leading role and suddenly collapses on set, only to awaken in a mysterious realm known as Xuyu. To return to reality, she must undergo five reincarnations and protect Xue Ruo Wan, the heroine of the screenplay "Moxiang".

A series of brutal murders shakes Longfan City, prompting the police to launch an urgent investigation and quickly identify the apparent perpetrators. However, behind each of these "culprits" lies an unseen mastermind manipulating everything from the shadows, as though orchestrating a deadly game of murder.

As Qin Ming and his team carefully unravel the clues, they discover that every person involved is connected to a cold case that occurred fifteen years earlier.

~~ Adapted from the 7th novel "The Damned One" (天谴者) in the novel series "Medical Examiner Dr. Qin" (法医秦明) by Qin Ming (秦明).
dramas.t: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: Tian Qian Zhe

dramas.syn:
Lin Yuan Chuan is a senior nurse in the cardiothoracic intensive care unit at Ningdong Hospital. After fifteen years in the profession, he has learned to rely on strict rules and emotional restraint to cope with the demands of his work. Meanwhile, his marriage to fellow nurse Yang Xin Yue is strained by their conflicting schedules and growing emotional distance.

When inexperienced newcomer Lu Zhen Zhen becomes his apprentice, their contrasting personalities initially lead to frequent clashes. However, as they navigate life-and-death situations together, the two gradually develop mutual respect and understanding. Amid career setbacks, conflicts with patients and their families, and the unexpected resurfacing of his troubled past, Lin Yuan Chuan must confront his own emotional barriers and rediscover the compassion that first drew him to nursing.

After her tragic death in ancient times, dancer Su Yun Xia awakens in the modern world as the contract wife of a prince’s reincarnation. Determined to avenge her sister, she harnesses past-life memories and sharp business instincts to change her fate and uncover an unexpected love.
dramas.t: Yun Gui Qian Xia Fan Hua

dramas.syn:
In 2000, Li Xiao Dong and Xu Ran, freshmen in the Chinese Department, met for the first time on the train to the university. Neither of them expected that this would be the beginning of a long lingering or entangled relationship.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Zhong Wen Tao Li (中文桃李) by Liang Xiao Sheng (梁晓声).

In 1938, China was in the midst of war, and Kunming became the last utopia in the war. Rong Rui Hong, a tile cat craftsman, ran away from home to escape from a caged life, and met Ning Huai Yuan, a painter who hid her identity to avoid being hunted, at the Mituo Temple in Wuhua Mountain. Invited by Wen Mu Bai, the two went down the mountain and lived in the Rong family's School of Literature. Here, Rong Rui Hong and Ning Huai Yuan successively uncovered their past, supported each other, and finally broke through their own chains and gained nirvana. As the war swept Kunming, the two had to go their separate ways to follow their mission.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Wa Mao" (瓦猫) by Ge Liang (葛亮).

The mountains and rivers stretch far and wide, while the fleeting course of life rests in the palm of a hand. A single lamp pierces the long night of Wolf Valley, and half a jade pendant seals a promise concerning the land. They stand in the palm of fate, each carrying the hardships and experiences of their past, and meet amid the turmoil of troubled times.

When Lian Ye, hall master of the Sanshan Gang, loses his whole family in a massacre, he teams up with childhood friend Li Ming Yuan, deputy police chief of Rongcheng, and Chen Die Yi, proprietress of the Huamoli Cabaret, to investigate and avenge. They uncover a web of eerie cases spun by Japanese spy mastermind Jiiichiro Matsui to penetrate Rongcheng, battling the invaders and putting their lives on the line to protect their country.

When a young man discovers a screw inside his grandfather’s urn, he uncovers a cremation mix-up involving three families. Determined to return his grandfather’s ashes to their rightful place, he embarks on a cross-border journey filled with mistrust, unexpected challenges, and the hope of bringing peace to the departed.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Piao Yang Guo Hai Lai Song Ni" (漂洋过海来送你) by Shi Yi Feng (石一枫).
dramas.t: Piao Yang Guo Hai Lai Song Ni

dramas.syn:
The story follows Zhang Wei Li's grueling path to the top of the combat sports world. The series depicts her struggle not only against opponents in the ring but also against the doubts and prejudices surrounding a female fighter. Throwing punch after punch, she strives to shatter stereotypes, defy her limits, and ultimately define herself on her own terms.

~~ Based on the true story of Chinese mixed martial arts athlete Zhang Wei Li (张伟丽).

This is a hilarious and heartwarming story set in an "all-purpose" night school. The founder, Ye Si Si, leads a diverse team of instructors who use a "trouble-fixing" tool to craft custom courses for their students—addressing an array of bizarre and eccentric requests. Through a series of uproarious mishaps, they help city dwellers resolve their life problems and find the courage to face life head-on.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gui Cheng" (龟城).

This drama centers on prosecutor Fang Wei, depicting the relentless pursuit of truth and justice by the procuratorate in handling a series of complex cases. The story primarily revolves around the murder case involving Wei Feng. To uphold the bottom line of the law and safeguard fairness and justice, Fang Wei, along with Xu Yi Shan, Chang Kai Xin, and Zhou Yan, form an investigation team. Facing multiple challenges, these prosecutors showcase their unwavering professional spirit despite pressure and adversity.

It tells the story of the confrontations between the optimistic and passionate prosecutor Zhong Tian You and lawyer Liang Dong Yu, who go from university classmates to courtroom opponents. The two develop a misunderstanding over the death of their mutual university friend, Xie Ruo Yi. After graduation, as they face each other in a series of cases, they gradually begin to uncover the truth behind the murder that occurred three years earlier. Zhong Tian You upholds his aspiration of becoming "the nation's finest public prosecutor" and uses his rigorous investigative abilities to unravel the mysteries surrounding the cases. Liang Dong Yu relies on meticulous logic to argue his position in court and safeguard procedural justice under the law.

Through their investigations, the two discover clues related to the smuggling of cultural relics that Xie Ruo Yi had uncovered before her death.
~~ Adapted from the novel "Xian Xia Qi Yuan Zhi Hua" (仙侠奇缘之花千骨) by Fresh Guo Guo (Fresh果果).

In the dead of winter, a mentally ill woman stops a passing vehicle to report that her husband has committed murder. Her shocking accusation leads detectives Shen Dong Liang and Wu Hong Bing to uncover the truth behind a series of gruesome dismemberment murders. But before the dust can settle, a string of new crimes erupts—a deadly savings bank robbery, the disappearance of a teenage girl, and a violent carjacking spree. As Shen and Wu pursue the perpetrators, they are drawn into a devastating human tragedy that will forever alter both of their lives.

Jian Dan, a 35-year-old working woman, unexpectedly enters a cycle of repeated lives, experiencing several different versions of her life. She discovers small glimmers of hope in ordinary life, experiences the warmth of human relationships amid illness, and reshapes herself while pursuing her dreams.

When her close friend is in danger, she does everything she can to save them. Ultimately, she comes to understand that the meaning of life lies in everyday moments, in the bonds between people, and, above all, in every present moment lived wholeheartedly.

dramas.nt: 唐朝诡事录 第六部
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the novel "Tang Chao Gui Shi Lu" (唐朝诡事录) by Wei Feng Hua (魏风华).
dramas.t: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty VI

dramas.syn:
Huo Jia Yao, a talented young chef, uses her exceptional culinary skills to gain entry to a prestigious gathering of renowned chefs, hoping to uncover the truth behind the injustice suffered by her father. Her investigation draws her into a dangerous web of palace intrigue, political conspiracies, and secrets surrounding the murder of a ruler.

Along the way, she meets Du Zi Teng, a seemingly foolish young man who secretly belongs to the imperial family and is conducting an investigation of his own. As the two join forces, they navigate deadly schemes and hidden rivalries, gradually developing feelings for each other through their shared experiences in the kitchen.

Against a backdrop of imperial power struggles and the everyday lives of ordinary people, food becomes both a means of uncovering the truth and a source of comfort and connection. Through culinary challenges, mysterious…
dramas.t: Bu Fu Mei Shi Bu Fu Qing

dramas.syn:
Xiao Xuan, a top employee at a modern matchmaking agency, travels back in time and finds himself in the body of a former crown prince who has been living among the common people. He unexpectedly activates an “Encyclopedia System,” which grants him new knowledge and abilities whenever he successfully marries into a family as a live-in son-in-law to bring good fortune to someone who is ill.

After dozens of such marriages, Xiao Xuan becomes the most sought-after live-in son-in-law in Guiyun City, but remains under the control of the powerful Jile Gang. Determined to regain his freedom, he forms an alliance with Gu Qiu Shui, the daughter of the Martial Arts Alliance leader. His efforts soon draw him into dangerous family struggles, martial arts conflicts, and political conspiracies tied to his hidden identity and the fate of the realm.

dramas.nt: 穿成炮灰女配，我只想当公婆的宝贝
dramas.syn:
Song Jin Jin unexpectedly travels into the world of a novel, where she takes on the identity of the male protagonist Lu Yan Chuan's cannon fodder ex-wife. At the very beginning, she receives a divorce agreement.

While temporarily staying with the Lu family during the divorce cooling-off period, she abandons the original character's vain and malicious traits. Through her lively and energetic personality, she gradually changes the Lu family's negative impression of her.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Li Hun OK La, Dan Gong Gong Po Po Bi Xu Gui Wo" (离婚OK啦，但公公婆婆必须归我), also known as "Li Hun, Xian Wen Guo Wo Gong Po Zai Shuo" (离婚，先问过我公婆再说), by Bei Shang Yuan (北上渊).
dramas.t: Chuan Cheng Pao Hui Nv Pei, Wo Zhi Xiang Dang Gong Po De Bao Bei

dramas.nt: 关于唐医生的一切 第二季

dramas.syn: Meng Shu, the adopted daughter of the Lu family who has endured constant mistreatment, uses the pretext of receiving help from her eldest brother to establish herself in the Lu household. She exposes a smuggling conspiracy, resolves entanglements of fate, retrieves a national treasure to make up for regrets from her previous life, and finds lasting love and mutual understanding with her beloved.
Young Li Si Feng develops an increasingly deep attachment and growing affection for Yan Ling, the older girl next door who raised him.
dramas.t: Why Does He Love Me So Much

dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chong Sheng Zh Tai Mi Ji? Wo Dai Guo Jia Dui Xia Chang" (重生者太密集？我带国家队下场), also known as "Mo Ri Te Qing Chu" (末日特情处), by Bian Lu (边鹿).

The drama tells the story of a bizarre double homicide that breaks the peace of a remote town. Xu Xiang Yang, a former anti-drug police officer, went into business and wanted to live in anonymity, but he was unexpectedly involved in a murder and drug case. Shen Dan, a female worker who had been humiliated, accidentally killed her husband. Her already fearful and chaotic life became even more precarious, and she fell into a deeper vortex. 

Two people who had no connection were forced to be tied together by the case. In the web of lies and truth, the desires and secrets that were originally hidden in the town also surfaced. People with different thoughts played a game of mutual games under the temptation of interests and the pressure of survival, making the truth more and more elusive with each reversal. A survival game that began with absurdity and ended with humanity was thus staged.

In the early 1990s, shortly before the formation of Serious Crime Unit Six in Dong’an City, provincial detective Zeng Ke Qiang is transferred to the local major crimes unit on a special assignment. Taking over the unfinished investigation of a fallen colleague, he must overcome suspicion from his new teammates while secretly pursuing the truth behind a powerful criminal network operating throughout the city.

As Zeng Ke Qiang investigates from within and Ji Jie confronts the organization directly, the team tackles a series of complex and unusual crimes, from bombings and murders to insurance fraud, carjackings, and mysterious incidents on the river. Through each case, the detectives gradually close in on the corruption and organized crime threatening Dong’an.
dramas.t: The VI Group of Fatal Case

dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the novel "The Dark Forest" (三体II·黑暗森林) by Liu Ci Xin (刘慈欣).
dramas.t: Three-Body Season 2: The Dark Forest - Part 1

dramas.syn:
Zhuang Rui, a young pawnshop clerk, accidentally injures his eyes with fragments of an ancient jade, gaining the supernatural "Golden Eyes" ability to see through cultural relics and trace the marks of history. He subsequently embarks on a treasure-appraising adventure, teaming up with policewoman Miao Fei Fei and others to gradually uncover the conspiracy of a transnational cultural relic smuggling ring.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Huang Jin Tong" (黄金瞳) by Da Yan (打眼).

In 1980, at Hongxing Machinery Factory in western Hunan, Lu Zhi Ang, a technician from Shanghai, and Shen Xiao Man, a local female welder, are the two people at the factory who get along the least. To protect Duo Duo, an orphan left behind by their late mentor, the two sign a fake marriage agreement—they will not share a room, interfere in each other's affairs, or take responsibility for each other.

The moment they produce their marriage certificate, their workers' apartment building erupts in an uproar. A mother-in-law suddenly arrives, romantic rivals show up at their door, and the entire factory watches the spectacle unfold. They think they will only have to keep up the act for a few months before going their separate ways. But deep in the mountains, amid life in the workers' apartment building, the countless hassles of everyday life, one rainstorm after another, and repeated…
Shows Yun Shao and Pei Zhao's lives 10 years later.
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wo Zai Fei Tu Shi Jie Sao Le Se" (我在废土世界扫垃圾) by You Hua Zai Ye (有花在野).

The Mad Monk wanders the mortal realm, guiding and saving those in need, only to find himself trapped in a fateful love tribulation. When he reunites with a woman from his past, the two are drawn into a tangled struggle of love and hatred as demonic forces unleash chaos upon the world. Between the playful daily life of Lingyin Temple and a deadly clash between the divine and the demonic, he must see through greed, anger, delusion, and delusive thoughts. Amid joys and sorrows, partings and reunions, he battles the forces of evil to restore peace to the mortal world.
dramas.t: The Mad Monk: Subdue Demons of Dragon's Fall

dramas.syn:
To uncover the truth behind her adoptive father's disappearance, criminal psychology expert Cheng Shu uses a novel as a means of approaching criminal investigator Tu Wei. After joining forces to solve a case, the two fall out because of lies, only to reconcile when faced with life-and-death circumstances.

However, an old acquaintance of their fathers' generation, who was believed to have died, unexpectedly reappears, reigniting mysteries surrounding long-buried events in the underworld.

Tianjin, the Republican era. Guo De You, the young River God, and his master probe a chain of connected murders, only to discover that the victims have banded together to avenge themselves against the despotic Sha family. In those turbulent times, the case exposes the clash between right and wrong and the complexities of the human heart.

~~ Adapted from the novel "He Shen" (河神) by Tian Xia Ba Chang (天下霸唱).
~~ Adapted from the novel "Xian Xia Qi Yuan Zhi Hua" (仙侠奇缘之花千骨) by Fresh Guo Guo (Fresh果果).
