After a decade of struggling as a science fiction writer, Li Zhi Wei finally receives a nomination for the prestigious Galaxy Award for his novel "The Death of Mara". However, during a celebration on a secluded island, he becomes trapped in a mysterious time loop and discovers that he is destined to be murdered at midnight.

With everyone at the villa hiding secrets, including his longtime friend, his current girlfriend, his troubled ex-girlfriend, and a copyright representative, Li Zhi Wei struggles to identify his would-be killer. Using a mysterious nursery rhyme to travel through time, he repeatedly relives the same events, searching for clues and a way to escape his fate.

As he investigates, Li Zhi Wei uncovers connections between his predicament and the disappearance of a boy named Mara ten years earlier. With each new loop revealing more about the people around him, he is forced…

dramas.nt: 穿进赛博游戏后干掉BOSS成功上位
dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chuan Jin Sai Bo You Xi Hou Gan Diao Boss Cheng Gong Shang Wei" (穿进赛博游戏后干掉BOSS成功上位) by An Bai (桉柏).
dramas.t: Chuan Jin Sai Bo You Xi Hou Gan Diao Boss Cheng Gong Shang Wei

dramas.syn:
In the early years of the Republic of China, the northern youth Lin Xiangfu and the southern woman Xiaomei met and fell in love by accident, but Xiaomei suddenly left after giving birth to a daughter and never heard from her again. Lin Xiangfu took his infant daughter south to find his mother. 

After many twists and turns, he settled in Xizhen because of a tornado and was taken in by the kind-hearted Chen Yongliang and his wife. His daughter also ate Baijia milk and grew up with the children of Xizhen.

Lin Xiangfu did not expect that Xizhen, a place thousands of miles away from home, was the Wencheng he had been looking for, and it was also his second hometown to settle down. He spent the rest of his life here, experiencing love, hate, sorrow and joy with Xiaomei and the various characters connected to them.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Wen Cheng" (文城) by Yu Hua (余华).

dramas.nt: 女心理师2: 灯火通明

dramas.syn:
In the Southeast Asian country of Nagapur, a bridge collapse leads to the discovery of a series of murders. Soe Win, the bridge's designer, devises an elaborate scheme to frame someone else for the crimes.

Xu An Di, a female police chief of Chinese descent, follows the clues and gradually uncovers the truth behind a case from fourteen years earlier, along with the collusion between money and political power and a series of murders committed to silence those involved.

A life-and-death struggle involving identity, revenge, and justice thus unfolds.

Yang Geng Xin, a widower who has fallen on hard times, seeks out his older brother, a murderer who has been on the run for twenty years, in order to save his sick young son. This sets him on a journey to save his son and seek revenge.

With blood ties above all else and hatred as the foundation, the intense conflict between two biological brothers overturns conventional distinctions between good and evil, right and wrong. The two men, mirroring each other, become embroiled in a fierce psychological battle carried out in the name of love but destined to end in hatred.

One step onto the wrong path may lead to eternal ruin, with no possibility of return.

Yang Guan, a former racing champion, is framed by someone, and his car dealership falls into trouble. He decides to sell his house to pay off the debts. His father dies after falling from a building, leaving behind an enormous financial burden. Just then, a little girl named Le Le shows up claiming to be his daughter, forcing Yang Guan into an unexpected role as a single dad.

Meanwhile, real estate agent Ye Zhi Qiu, whose father is critically ill, accepts a commission from Yang Guan's sister, Yang Ying, to move into Yang Guan's home under the pretense of collecting debts, but in reality, she is an undercover agent searching for their father's research findings. Living together, the two clash frequently, yet their feelings gradually warm as they overcome difficulties together.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Jia You Yi Chan" (家有遗产) by Lian Jian (连谏).

When Su Bai Yi was young, his family suffered a tragedy. Just as he was on the verge of losing his life, he was rescued by Xie Kan Hua. Su Bai Yi then became his disciple and learned the cultivation techniques of the Book of Immortals.

Many years later, several martial arts masters die under mysterious circumstances, and the clues point to Xie Kan Hua as the murderer. To save his master, Su Bai Yi enrolls in the Academy and joins Nangong Xi Er, Feng Zuo Jun, and Xie Yu Ling in investigating the cases. The four, each harboring their own concerns, work together to uncover the truth.

~~ Adapted from the novel series "Shao Nian Tian Xia Xi Lie" (少年天下系列) by Zhou Mu Nan (周木楠).
~~ Adapted from the novel "The Dark Forest" (三体II·黑暗森林) by Liu Ci Xin (刘慈欣).
dramas.t: Three-Body Season 2: The Dark Forest - Part 2

dramas.syn: The story follows Ran Qing Xi and Zou Si Yan, who met briefly in their youth and unexpectedly reunite in Shanyue Town many years later. Zou Si Yan falls in love with Ran Qing Xi at first sight.

When Zhou Dong Bei returns to his hometown in Northeast China, he unexpectedly digs up a bucket of gold in his own backyard. With his buddies and his longtime crush by his side, he sets out on an ambitious entrepreneurial journey, launching one outrageous business venture after another—from “KenDeQi” and “Hali Baba” to “Penguin QQ.” 

But his longtime rival, Wang Jin Sheng, is always close behind, pulling every trick in the book to bring him down. Just as Zhou Dong Bei seems poised to finally defeat his rival, a long-buried secret at the hospital suddenly comes to light—revealing that the people he thought were family and enemies may have been mixed up all along.

Following a collision at the Strait Command Tower, Yan Zi Zhou (codenamed "Night Blade") is tasked with an investigation—only for his younger sister, Yan Xiao Xiao, to suddenly fall from a building. Employing a series of ingenious stratagems, Yan Zi Zhou—along with his second brother, Zong Xiao Quan, and long-lost twin sister, Xie Li Li —assists the local police. Through Li Li, they uncover the truth behind the murder of their parents eighteen years earlier, ultimately bringing the primary culprits to justice.

Wufang Street — a cultural tourism block recently renovated and upgraded by the city government — is home to both familiar old neighbors and newcomers from all corners of the country. The street isn’t big, yet it contains the truest, most ordinary shapes of life.

At the street entrance sits a small café, which has become both the resting point and the observation window of the neighborhood. From here, Su Xiao Yuan watches the flow of people, listens to the warmth and chill of everyday stories, and quietly writes the tales of this street into her “Xiao Yuan Diary.”

This year, the old house owned by the Yu family has become lively again. Eight female tenants move in one after another, and with them come eight life-related topics:

— A young woman who left home to struggle for a living in the city.
— An older single woman troubled by constant pressure to marry.
— A young mother anxiously…

Set against the backdrop of the Yellow River corpse retrievers known as "River Lords," the story begins fifteen years ago, when Chen Ke Shui, a River Lord, adopts Xiao Ju, a baby girl born after her father's death and the sole survivor of a massacre that wiped out her entire family.

Fifteen years later, Chen Duo, Chen Ke Shui's senior fellow disciple who was expelled from their sect, colludes with drug trafficker Second Master Jiang. After the truth about Xiao Ju's origins is revealed, she finds herself in danger.

A mysterious lightning strike causes Xiao Qing Wan, the daughter of a marquis's household, and Li Mu Fan, the leader of Qingfeng Stronghold, to exchange souls. Forced to survive in each other's worlds, the two become entangled not only in the grudges and conflicts of the martial arts world but also in disputes within the imperial court.

While living under each other's identities, they each come to understand themselves anew and, through their exchanged circumstances, seek a path toward self-discovery and change.

The story centers on the healing journey of Huang Xiao Xi, a young urban woman who returns from a major city to her hometown of Yunnan. With a creative tone that is "natural, fresh, warm, and healing," the story extensively incorporates regional elements such as Yunnan's seedless wampee fruit, the nationally recognized intangible cultural heritage "Helou Dance," and traditional Lingnan architecture, conveying the values of "health first and life as the foundation."
~~ Adapted from the novel "Rui Can" (蕊灿) by Liu Lian Zi (流潋紫).

When Liu Xi Tang, who's been trapped in the gilded cage of a wealthy family, encounters Chu Nan Qiao, mired in the hell of domestic abuse, these two women, shattered by their marriages, forge a blood-soaked alliance for revenge. Amidst a web of lies and blurred lines between good and evil, they become each other’s armor, waiting in the dark of night for the dawn to break and the flowers to bloom. (Source: Chinese = Weibo || Translation = Google Translate

The drama is set against the backdrop of the Yijiangshan Island Campaign in 1955, which was the first joint land, sea, and air military operation by the People's Liberation Army (PLA). It follows the heroic soldiers of the 5th Company, 2nd Battalion, 178th Regiment as they transform from inexperienced recruits into an elite amphibious assault unit tasked with securing the beachhead and capturing the main peak.

A terminally ill father puts his own life on the line to avenge his son through a bloody reckoning, but beneath his ‘full confession’ lies a death list as a series of murders unfolds.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Lao Qiang" (老枪) by Wan An (万安).

This story follows Li Yi Ru, the daughter of Li Xiao Yao and Zhao Ling Er, as she overcomes numerous obstacles to defy fate, protect world peace, and write a passionate tale of a new generation of Nuwa’s descendants.

~~ Adapted from the video game "Xian Jian Qi Xia Chuan Yi" (仙剑奇侠传一)  produced by Softstar Entertainment (大宇资讯股份有限公司).
dramas.t: Yiru: A Sword and Fairy Story

dramas.syn:
Chun Niang is a street beggar who is as sly as a fox and regards money as her lifeblood, yet possesses a heart full of warmth and compassion. An unexpected encounter with a ring draws her into the grip of fate, where she discovers that she has been a player in the game all along.

Song Shan, the Great General of the Northern Frontier, is plunged into the depths of despair after losing his father and elder brother in battle and seeing his closest friend wrongfully accused. From then on, he dons a mask and becomes a lone martyr, living in the shadows.

When Chun Niang and Song Shan cross paths, their encounter offers a chance to break through the tangled schemes and mysteries that have ensnared them both, setting their fates on an entirely new course.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Full Moon over Spring Mountain House" (月满春山楼) by Shi Qi Jin (十七今).

A highly experienced detective teams up with a rookie female police officer to investigate cases. The mentor and apprentice constantly bicker and get caught up in comical misunderstandings as they solve various everyday cases while pursuing an underworld villain who has escaped from prison in search of treasure.

dramas.nt: 真千金她不装了，嫡女归来炸场
dramas.syn:
Sheng Lan Yin, a retired soldier, returns to her hometown after receiving an urgent letter from her family. She takes over the family's affairs, resolves family disputes, and becomes determined to put an end to the chaos within the household, standing up against her biased father and outsiders who interfere recklessly in family matters.

As soon as she returns to Macau, she becomes the target of a malicious plot. Her father, feeling guilty toward his first wife, who died young, is particularly affectionate toward Sheng Lan Yin, his daughter from that marriage. However, this favoritism repeatedly draws her into disputes and places her in dangerous situations.

To resist a marriage alliance arranged by her family, Sheng Lan Yin hastily finds a stranger and enters into a whirlwind marriage with him. Unbeknownst to her, the man she has married by chance is actually a highly influential…
dramas.t: Zhen Qian Jin Ta Bu Zhuang Le, Di Nv Gui Lai Zhan Chang

dramas.nt: 清明上河图密码之山河火种
dramas.syn:
In the final years of the Northern Song dynasty, danger lurks beneath the surface of the capital city of Bianjing. Zhao Bu Qi, a property broker, purchases a residence at a bargain price and looks forward to a peaceful and happy life. Instead, he finds himself caught in a deadly conspiracy. His beloved wife is kidnapped and brutally murdered by enemy spies, setting him on a path of vengeance.

As Zhao Bu Qi pursues the truth, he gathers a group of courageous companions: Shan Hong Yu, a female scout from the frontier army; Cui Hao, a loyal and streetwise rogue; Wang Ruo Han, the daughter of a corrupt minister; and Lu Nian, a gifted craftsman. Together, they develop a greater sense of purpose—to save books, artisans, women, and children from the doomed city and preserve the legacy of civilization itself.
dramas.t: Riverside Code at Qingming Festival: Embers of the Land

dramas.syn:
After a family crisis leaves her with nowhere to turn, Su Wan Qing enters into a marriage of convenience with Wen Yan Qi, a wealthy business heir she has only met twice. Despite officially becoming husband and wife, they live separately for six months, remaining practically strangers.

Fate brings them together again when Wan Qing unknowingly applies for a job at Yan Qi's company. Soon, they find themselves living under the same roof, with him becoming both her boss and her husband. As they navigate this unexpected turn in their relationship, two hearts accustomed to loneliness gradually grow closer, turning an arrangement of convenience into a love neither expected.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Chun Ye Kun Du" (春夜困渡) by Yan Zhi (晏执).
~~ Adapted from the novel "Fu Fu Zi Zi" (父父子子) by Liang Xiao Sheng (梁晓声).

dramas.nt: 清明上河图密码之雷霆之火
dramas.syn:
Set during the Xuanhe era of the Northern Song dynasty, the drama follows the investigation of the mysterious and sinister “Fire Skull” case. Through this investigation, it tells the story of Liang Xing, a low-ranking soldier who is determined to uncover the truth for his fallen comrades, confront the intrigues of the imperial court, and uphold justice for ordinary people.

Using the criminal investigation as its central narrative thread, the series portrays the moral struggles and steadfast convictions of Liang Xing, Chu Lan, and others as they navigate a world shaped by political power struggles. Despite their seemingly insignificant positions, they display unwavering determination in defending fairness and righteousness.
dramas.t: Riverside Code at Qingming Festival: Thunderfire

dramas.syn:
When a supernova explodes and an apocalyptic crisis suddenly descends, a group of young people is thrust into an unknown journey that will determine the future of humanity.

When protecting the world becomes a challenge they must face as part of growing up, how will they respond? Confronted with crises and difficult choices, the young people use their intelligence and courage to explore their own potential. Through tests of human nature and the passing down of emotional bonds, they embark on a journey to find the answers that will lead them toward the future.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Supernova Era" (超新星纪元) by Liu Ci Xin (刘慈欣).
~~ Adapted from the web novel "Yi Ni Wei Ming De Xia Tian" (以你为名的夏天) by Ren Ping Zhou (任凭舟).

dramas.syn:
In the early years of the reign of Emperor Huizong of Song, the powerful Feng family, one of the leading commercial dynasties in Bianjing, is struck by a financial crisis triggered by counterfeit jiaozi banknotes. Their decades of wealth and influence are suddenly placed in jeopardy.

As the family is thrown into turmoil, the destinies of the three Feng brothers begin to diverge. The eldest brother, Feng Shi, becomes consumed by desire; the second brother, Feng Ren, is drawn into a vortex of political power; and the youngest, Feng Sai, walks the dangerous line between the lawful and the illicit worlds.

What begins as a mysterious commercial catastrophe gradually unfolds into a conspiracy capable of shaking the very foundations of the state. Holding different beliefs and loyalties, the three brothers repeatedly clash in a ruthless arena where human nature, ambition, and self-interest…
dramas.t: Riverside Code at Qingming Festival: No Way Back

dramas.syn: ~~ Adapted from the novel "Deng Chun Tai" (登春台) by Ge Fei (格非).

In 1949, the retreat of the Kuomintang to Taiwan separated two brothers, Lin Xiu Wu and Lin Xiu Wen, leaving them on opposite sides of the Taiwan Strait for more than three decades.

By 1983, the younger brother, Lin Xiu Wen, has become a skilled intelligence operative working under the codename "Cold Crow." Sent to the Golden Triangle on a dangerous mission involving infiltration and assassination, he continues searching for his long-lost older brother. Unbeknownst to him, Lin Xiu Wu is now a counterespionage officer in mainland China, operating under the codename "Wind Chime."

As their opposing missions bring them closer to an inevitable confrontation, the brothers find themselves caught between family ties, political loyalties, and the dangerous world of espionage. With hidden agendas and deadly threats surrounding them, their long-awaited reunion threatens to change everything they…

In 1980s Liuyang, a family transforms their traditional firecracker workshop into a thriving fireworks factory. Through teamwork, innovation, and dedication, they work to overcome challenges and light up the night sky.

dramas.nt: 清明上河图密码之匹夫之怒
dramas.syn: Through its vivid portrayal of the artisan community during the final years of the Northern Song dynasty, the drama successfully combines historical storytelling with modern perspectives. It features both gripping suspense and mystery elements as well as rich cultural depth, offering an engaging narrative that is both entertaining and thought-provoking.
dramas.t: Riverside Code at Qingming Festival: Commoner's Fury

dramas.nt: 清明上河图密码之相由心生
dramas.syn:
Set during the Xuanhe era of the Northern Song dynasty, the story follows Wang Xiao Huai, a young man from the countryside, and Lu Qing, a physiognomist skilled in reading faces and fortunes. Together, they solve crimes through metaphysical reasoning and physiognomy, gradually uncovering the truth behind the mysterious “Pleated Fields” case, which conceals a web of family infighting and collusion between officials and merchants.

As they navigate a world stained by bloodshed and political intrigue, Wang Xiao Huai and Lu Qing engage in a battle of wits against powerful figures and the true culprit behind the conspiracy. Along the way, each confronts his own unresolved past—one seeking justice for his father's wrongful death, the other struggling to overcome a long-held obsession.
dramas.t: Riverside Code at Qingming Festival: Faces Reveal the Heart

dramas.syn:
Turmoil rises once again in Hong Kong, as hidden rivalries unfold in the culinary world. With a spatula, mysteries are unraveled; with a hundred flavors, the course of events is decided.

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Da Guo Ming Chu" (大国名厨) by Yan Dou Lao Ge (烟斗老哥).
~~ Adapted from the web novel "A Chan" (阿禅) by Ding Mo (丁墨).

dramas.nt: 以下犯上之后宫章妃传
dramas.syn:
Zhang Fei, a domineering CEO from the modern world, finds his soul transported into the imperial harem of ancient times. When he opens his eyes, he discovers that he has become Consort Zhang, a woman who has been sentenced to death for engaging in illicit sexual relations within the imperial harem.

He initially intends to stay away from the conflicts of the imperial harem and return to the modern world to resume his life as a powerful CEO. However, he soon discovers that the other imperial consorts are watching him closely and plotting to kill him. His only chance of survival is to seize the Empress's seal.

With a man's soul trapped in a woman's body, she is forced into the power struggles of the imperial harem. The former CEO is subjected to the harsh schemes and tactics of palace life, leaving her deeply shaken. Gradually, her perspective changes from simply wanting to survive to…
dramas.t: Yi Xia Fan Shang Zhi Hou Gong Zhang Fei Zhuan

dramas.syn:
Amid sweeping historical changes, three young people from Meiling set out on intertwined journeys across business, politics, and law enforcement, each hiding their own secrets — and each destined for an uncertain fate.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Ping Yuan Ke" (平原客) by Li Pei Fu (李佩甫).

Huo Shao Tian is a renowned traditional clown performer who passes down his exceptional skills to his two sons, He Jia Bei and He Huo Ju. Beyond mastering their craft, he teaches them the importance of integrity, adaptability, and staying true to their principles.

However, the brothers take vastly different paths after their father's death. Ashamed of his family's performing tradition, He Jia Bei pursues fame and fortune, determined to build a modern comedy empire. Meanwhile, He Huo Ju remains devoted to his father's teachings and the artistic heritage of traditional clown performance. As their ambitions and values increasingly clash, the brothers face the challenges of preserving their family's legacy while navigating a changing entertainment industry.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Xi Ju" (喜剧) by Chen Yan (陈彦).

Xin Yue once worked in the fashion industry but withdrew from the workforce to focus on her family after getting married. After experiencing her husband's betrayal, she returns to the workplace.

She gradually develops feelings for Huo Yun Xiao, a business investor who deeply values loyalty and quietly supports her.
~~ Adapted from the novel "Yi Ri San Qiu" (一日三秋) by Liu Zhen Yun (刘震云).

Tu Jia Sheng is sentenced to life imprisonment, and "Deep in the Bustle" nearly collapses from within. In Haifeng Prison, Tu Jia Sheng allies with prison officer Xia Yu Yan and earns Old Ghost's trust. Nie Feng commits all manner of evil to run for Speaker. Tu Jia Sheng feigns submission and, at the critical moment, exposes all the crimes of the Nie family. A new showdown begins.

"Ordinary Greatness: Side Story" is a prequel to "Ordinary Greatness", set ten years earlier at the Balihu Police Station.

When “Balihu” township was dissolved and merged into a new urban district, the local police station faced the challenge of transformation. After the sacrifice of Director Xia, the political instructor Wang Shou Yi was entrusted with leadership responsibilities.

Wang Shou Yi acted decisively—abolishing the “small treasury,” improving police conduct and discipline, and standardizing law enforcement—while also addressing the pain and problems brought about by reform.
~~ Adapted from the novel "Xing Kong Yu Ban Ke Shu" (星空与半棵树) by Chen Yan (陈彦)
